a-weak-spot.name: A Weak Spot
a-weak-spot.title: A Weak Spot
a-weak-spot.notes: It is part of the final boss encounter in the Feaster of Souls Quest and shares its health with The Pale Worm.

abominable-servant.name: Abominable Servant
abominable-servant.title: Abominable Servant
abominable-servant.loc: Spawns with The Abomination inside his room under the Ice Islands, .
abominable-servant.notes: Looks like a Blightwalker and interestingly has the same set of attack effects plus more.

abyssador.name: Abyssador
abyssador.title: Abyssador
abyssador.beh: Has a very erratic retargeting behavior. Goes invisible often.
abyssador.notes: Abyssador is the hardest of the Warzone bosses.
abyssador.strat: Trap it in the western part of his dungeon. Mages should use Sudden Death Runes and summon Fire Elementals or Fire Devils to deal more damage. Paladins should use Infernal Bolts and Sharpshooter but have to be wary of the distance attacks.

abyssal-calamary.name: Abyssal Calamary
abyssal-calamary.title: Abyssal Calamary
abyssal-calamary.strat: Just kill it. It's weak compared to the creatures it spawns with.

achad.name: Achad
achad.title: Achad
achad.beh: Fights until death in close combat. Strength comparable to Nomad or Bandit.
achad.notes: Greenhorn challenger. ← #3 Bovinus #4 Achad #5 Colerian the Barbarian →
achad.strat: Kill it normally, as it doesn't deal much damage.

acid-blob.name: Acid Blob
acid-blob.title: Acid Blob
acid-blob.desc: Highly destructive and corrosive, the Acid Blob has little in common with the ordinary slime. They are much better in finding and pursuing a target than their distant cousins. While the ordinary slime is driven by the primal urge to get food, the Acid Blob is out for destruction. It is indeed a frightening sight when a bunch of these creatures crawls towards a single target with the intention to completely destroy it. Some researchers speculate that Acid Blobs share their intelligence with blobs all over the world. As Acid Blobs reproduce themselves by splitting into two entities, this thesis might have an element of truth. Be it as it may, the Acid Blob is a constant threat particularly to the environment. Since living creatures are often smart and quick enough to avoid the attacks of the blobs, any kind of plants, constructions and the like are usually not that lucky and are annihilated by their attacks. In the past, some eccentric madmen used Acid Blobs as waste disposal, which was considered to be somewhat stylish. However, after the Acid Blobs had digested a certain amount of waste, they started reproducing themselves multiple times which started to become a real problem.…
acid-blob.beh: Like a Slime, will advance towards its prey in attempt to overwhelm it by summoning more Acid Blobs.
acid-blob.strat: Kill it like a Slime, being wary of geting surrounded by its Summons. Try to kill this monster as fast as you can, because its Summons, adding another Blob-Type Creatures, can make you lay down in few seconds.

acolyte-of-darkness.name: Acolyte of Darkness
acolyte-of-darkness.title: Acolyte of Darkness
acolyte-of-darkness.notes: Appears as a raid for five minutes after a player lights the Lightbringer's Basin and receives the following message
acolyte-of-darkness.strat: Kill it like any weak melee monster.

acolyte-of-the-cult.name: Acolyte of the Cult
acolyte-of-the-cult.title: Acolyte of the Cult
acolyte-of-the-cult.loc: Goroma, Deeper Cult Cave, Formorgar Mines, Magician Quarter, Forbidden Temple.
acolyte-of-the-cult.desc: The Acolytes of the Cult received some training in the dark arts, at disposal to the cult. They are proud of their status and are usually quite fanatic about the cult. Acolytes of the Cult feel superior to outsiders and often think the powers bestowed upon them make them invincible. They only respect higher ranks of the cult whom they obey like slaves their masters. Their magic is still fairly weak and does by far not match their ego. Having gained a glimpse at the work of the cult, it is not easy to sacrifice their curiosity and so they use their whole energy to strive for the higher ranks. Acolytes of the Cult are only involved in affairs if they are considered of importance for the cult.
acolyte-of-the-cult.notes: In Goroma, they appear in large numbers often with Adepts of the Cult in Formorgar Mines appear in smaller groups.
acolyte-of-the-cult.strat: Thunderstorm runes work well. It would be a good idea to bring a Dwarven Ring with you and use Garlic Necklace.

adept-of-the-cult.name: Adept of the Cult
adept-of-the-cult.title: Adept of the Cult
adept-of-the-cult.loc: Goroma, Liberty Bay's deeper cult dungeon, Formorgar Mines, Magician Quarter, Forbidden Temple.
adept-of-the-cult.desc: Adept of the Cult is the highest rank that a normal cultist can dream to acquire. Strong-willed and loyal, they use the secrets of the cult to amplify their magic to a threatening degree. Ruthless and cunning, they pose a threat to every opponent. They see themselves as too valuable to the cult to be lost. For this reason, they are always accompanied by some members of lower ranks who support and protect them. Their esteem of other cultists is not very high though and they sacrifice them at their whim whenever a threat occurs. They hold important knowledge about the cult and they are so fanatic that they would rather die than to get caught alive.
adept-of-the-cult.notes: Make sure to have Dwarven Ring when facing adepts. Usually they spawn in groups amongst other monsters like Witches, Bonelords, Elder Bonelords and all other cult members.
adept-of-the-cult.strat: Since adepts keep a distance (usually about 4 tiles), as a knight try to trap them in a corner and kill using Heavy Magic Missile or Explosion runes when they turn invisible. Be careful while trapping him, because you might lure more cult members on yourself (they rarely appear alone). As a paladin you should lure single adept (for easier and safer killing) and kill shooting bolts with help of HMM runes whenever they go invisible. Easiest way to hunt them with mages is to summon Demon Skeleton as a blocker. All adepts' ranged attacks are life drain type, which won't affect Demon Skeleton. Just lure adept on your summon, and kill him using any runes. Keep in mind that if you start attacking with wand, summon will follow adept which may lead to luring more monsters - try to make your summon stand still. Watch your hp carefully, and try to heal whenever it drops lower than 350 - adepts can deal some nasty combos with some additional damage from summons. Don't kill ghouls he summons, rather focus all your firepower on adept. Don't forget about Dwarven Rings, being drunk is something you want to avoid if you need to run. Having a few area attack runes might be good idea if you'll have…

adult-goanna.name: Adult Goanna
adult-goanna.title: Adult Goanna
adult-goanna.loc: Kilmaresh Central Steppe, Kilmaresh Southern Steppe, Green Belt.
adult-goanna.desc: Goannas are large predatory lizards with sharp teeth and claws. They have thick skin with camouflage that ranges from bands and stripes to speckles and circles. The skin colour changes as the creatures mature, with juveniles being blue and adult animals being bright red. Goannas lay eggs in a nest or burrow, but sometimes also inside termite mounds, which offers protection as well as incubation. Additionally, the termites provide a meal for the young as they hatch. Goanna eggs are a sought after meal for the human population of Kilmaresh. But as getting them is a dangerous task, they make a rather expensive menu. Goannas are found throughout the steppes of Kilmaresh. They prey on insects, smaller lizards, snakes, birds, mammals and also humans if they have the chance to do so. But they are also eaters of carrion and thus attracted to rotting meat. There's a debate whether goannas are venomous or not. It is a fact that goanna bites cause incessant bleeding and many sages assume that this is because of toxin-producing glands in the lizards' mouth.
adult-goanna.beh: Running from them can be very dangerous since they can quickly catch up due to their haste spell, so be careful in areas with many Goannas.
adult-goanna.notes: They are an adult version of the Young Goanna.

adventurer.name: Adventurer
adventurer.title: Adventurer
adventurer.beh: Will not harm anyone and walks at a snail's pace.
adventurer.notes: Using a Guardcatcher on it has a chance of turning it into an Angry Adventurer. Part of the Goblin Merchant Quest.
adventurer.strat: You can just kill them, they won't attack you. Or you could leave them be.

afflicted-strider.name: Afflicted Strider
afflicted-strider.title: Afflicted Strider
afflicted-strider.desc: The afflicted striders are purposely infected with a rare parasite that significantly alters their physiology and psyche. It mainly seems to make them more aggressive and physically capable, though it also significantly reduces their life span. Those Below always showed little restraint in using such methods in disregard of their minions but such tactics and with them the deployment of afflicted striders have become more common recently. This might hint at a shift of leadership or strategy. The afflicted striders behave even more violently und unforeseeable under the influence of the parasites, yet they seem strangely more prone to acts of violence aimed purposely to be discarded as the effect of raised aggression. The suggestion that the tiny parasites are raising the striders intelligence or are intelligent themselves and acting on purpose seems a bit farfetched though. A more recent theory suggests that the parasites make the striders more susceptible to the influence of creatures such as the feared brainstealer. This would explain their existence in certain battle forces while they are lacking in others. A further, more daring theory even suggests that the small parasites are…

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.title: Aftershock
aftershock.beh: After taking some damage he will transform into Foreshock and vice versa.
aftershock.notes: A boss in the Heart of Destruction Quest.

aggressive-chicken.name: Aggressive Chicken
aggressive-chicken.title: Aggressive Chicken
aggressive-chicken.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement.
aggressive-chicken.notes: It may spawn when you attack an Agrestic Chicken.
aggressive-chicken.strat: Just kill it or ignore it.

aggressive-matter.name: Aggressive Matter
aggressive-matter.title: Aggressive Matter
aggressive-matter.notes: It looks the same as a Rot Elemental. They spawn when you kill an Organic Matter.
aggressive-matter.strat: Kill them as fast as possible because they make boss stronger. With too many around boss fight become harder.

agrestic-chicken.name: Agrestic Chicken
agrestic-chicken.title: Agrestic Chicken
agrestic-chicken.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement.
agrestic-chicken.beh: It ignores you as a regular Chicken.
agrestic-chicken.notes: When you attack it, it may become an Aggressive Chicken.

ahau.name: Ahau
ahau.title: Ahau
ahau.notes: Part of the Adventures of Galthen Quest.

albino-dragon.name: Albino Dragon
albino-dragon.title: Albino Dragon

ab.n: Destroys Magic Walls and Wild Growths

albino-dragon.loc: * North Dragon Lair ( ) * Goroma Demons ( ) * Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair ( ) * Dragonblaze Peaks ( ) * Fenrock Dragon Lair ( ) Suggested optimized route for Server Save: *Bring a Vial of Blood, Vial of Oil, The Holy Tible, Orichalcum Pearl and Golden Mug. *Logout close to Pythius the Rotten and wait for 10 minutes after logging in to check in Fenrock Dragon Lair. *From there, go to Beregar and use Unlikely Pathfinder to go to Dragonblaze Peaks. *Then go to the Fire Portal from the Forgotten Knowledge Quest. Enter then Green Portal to go to Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair. *Go to the Knightwatch…
albino-dragon.beh: Each albino dragon spawn point has a small chance to spawn at exactly 10 minutes after Server Boot (not to be confused with Server Save), and then every 30 minutes after that. An albino dragon despawns 30 minutes after spawning, so do not wait too long before killing it.
albino-dragon.strat: Treat it as a slightly stronger Dragon Lord.

alchemistical-container.name: Alchemistical Container
alchemistical-container.title: Alchemistical Container
alchemistical-container.loc: Doctor Marrow's and The Monster's boss room.

alptramun.name: Alptramun
alptramun.title: Alptramun

ab.r: 300-700; 150%; hits all players near target and propagates as a chain

alptramun.beh: It retargets often, so the blocker should use Challenge very often.
alptramun.notes: It's one of the bosses of The Dream Courts Quest.
alptramun.strat: Have the blocker stay at the center of the room, then throw some Fire Bomb Runes around this area to help cancel Alptramun's invisibility. All players should avoid staying in front of it since it uses a very strong death beam. Use area attacks during the fight and never allow the summons to stay alive for very long since they heal the boss. Mage's should not use Sudden Death Runes since they will heal the boss for a huge amount of health.

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.title: Amazon
amazon.loc: Venore Amazon Camp, Carlin Amazon Camp, Amazon Tower, east of Carlin, underneath the Fields of Glory, west of Venore , Oasis Tomb, on the smallest of the Laguna Islands, Foreigner Quarter and Trade Quarter.
amazon.desc: Amazons are communities of martial women who have erected some hideouts in the swamps in the east of Tibia. They attack every intruder of their sphere vigorously and cut off the heads of their victims in order to keep them as some kind of trophies. They are not only quite strong in close combat but are also able to throw knives with deadly precision.
amazon.notes: Amazons are strong warriors that collect the heads of their victims. An amazon that collects 13 skulls is promoted to a valkyrie. They are wild women that battle for their liberty and hate it when somebody invades their camp. Note that all female characters can dress like an Amazon. On worlds where Player Killing is allowed, this could be a problem, because someone might attack you thinking you were an Amazon.

amenef-the-burning.name: Amenef the Burning
amenef-the-burning.title: Amenef the Burning
amenef-the-burning.loc: Through a teleport inside the Ruins of Nuur, ( ).
amenef-the-burning.notes: It's a miniboss of the Kilmaresh Quest.

an-observer-eye.name: An Observer Eye
an-observer-eye.title: An Observer Eye
an-observer-eye.loc: Replica Dungeon, past the Mysterious Device.
an-observer-eye.beh: It is immobile, so it won't move. It will attack when provoked.
an-observer-eye.notes: Part of the Opticording Sphere Quest. It can also appear as when its cord is cut and after it's damaged for the first time. Note that you can only obtain the Lightsphere once, if you kill it again you will not receive a second one.
an-observer-eye.strat: Do not get close to it and walk around it using Magic Wall Runes to protect yourself from its sight. After using the machine north of the room, attack it from distance and do not use summons since they may trigger the boss' beams and target the players. Druids can use earth damage due to Boss's heavy death resistance.

ancient-lion-knight.name: Ancient Lion Knight
ancient-lion-knight.title: Ancient Lion Knight
ancient-lion-knight.kind: Members of the Order of the Lion
ancient-lion-knight.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement, with usurpers .
ancient-lion-knight.strat: Try to get close to him and kill him as fast as possible. If you run back or stay idle too far away, he will disappear.

ancient-scarab.name: Ancient Scarab
ancient-scarab.title: Ancient Scarab
ancient-scarab.loc: Ankrahmun Library Tomb, Stone Tomb, Peninsula Tomb, Mother of Scarabs Lair, Kha'zeel Scarab Lair, deep in Larva Caves (found beneath steps underground), Lion's Rock, Arena and Zoo Quarter and beneath Fenrock.
ancient-scarab.desc: The Ancient Scarab is ancient indeed - it is said that there are specimens that are aeons old. Rumours say that unless killed, a scarab will not die of old age but continue to grow and grow to enormous proportions. Their usual pace of movement is not impressively fast, but they are capable of doing sudden charges to catch their opponents off guard. Even more dangerous, their poison is strong enough to allow these creatures to emit large clouds of stinking death and mayhem around themselves. Ancient Scarabs are said to be the keepers of mysterious secrets swallowed by the sands long time ago. So don't be surprised if some of them might display even more cunning tactics and devastating magic.
ancient-scarab.notes: Larva's final stage. They are almost as powerful as a Giant Spider, but can be more dangerous since they can paralyze you. It is not uncommon to get 2 or 3 on you at once in the Larva Caves. You may hunt 250 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Fleshcrawler.

ancient-ugly-monster.name: Ancient Ugly Monster
ancient-ugly-monster.title: Ancient Ugly Monster
ancient-ugly-monster.notes: These creatures spawn in mass when you use a Ancient Iks Ritual Chalice on an Empty Bucket during Galthen and the City of Gold Part II.
ancient-ugly-monster.strat: Ignore them and push the Ritualwater, they will run away from you.

angry-adventurer.name: Angry Adventurer
angry-adventurer.title: Angry Adventurer
angry-adventurer.notes: These Adventurers are furious that someone had the audacity to shoot them with a Guardcatcher. Part of the Goblin Merchant Quest.

angry-demon.name: Angry Demon
angry-demon.title: Angry Demon
angry-demon.loc: The room of The Annihilator Quest.
angry-demon.notes: These are practically equal to Demons, but Angry Demons only spawn as the result of the trigger that initiates The Annihilator Quest.

angry-elemental.name: Angry Elemental
angry-elemental.title: Angry Elemental
angry-elemental.notes: Part of the Journey mission of A Pirate's Tail Quest.
angry-elemental.strat: Gather all of them around and kill them quickly using energy damage.

angry-plant.name: Angry Plant
angry-plant.title: Angry Plant
angry-plant.notes: Looks like a Carniphila. This creature can only be found when First Dragon Quest is active.

angry-sugar-fairy.name: Angry Sugar Fairy
angry-sugar-fairy.title: Angry Sugar Fairy
angry-sugar-fairy.desc: Sugar fairies are delicate creatures consisting of sugar crystals, wearing colourful dresses made of marzipan and spun candy floss. They are seen as benevolent but prankful, bringing small amounts of delight to those who seek them out. Sugar fairies are typically a peaceful type of creature, preferring to spread positivity and joy around them. However, there are certain things that can make sugar fairies angry and upset. These include: Insults, disrespect, and rude behaviour towards them, desecration and destruction of sweet creations and delicacies as well as the presence of evil and malicious individuals or forces like Roshamuul nightmares. If sugar fairies go underground, into the chocolate mines or gingerbread dungeons, they are often looking for ingredients or materials to use for their creations, which may be found only in these underground realms. These creations can vary greatly in size and complexity, depending on their purpose and desired effect. Intricate pieces of jewellery, figurines and ornaments are among them as well as charming and colourful dresses and apparel. You search for an elegant gown made entirely of candy floss, embroidered with sugary sprinkles? Tiny…

animated-cyclops.name: Animated Cyclops
animated-cyclops.title: Animated Cyclops
animated-cyclops.loc: Museum of Tibian Arts (only at Night)

animated-feather.name: Animated Feather
animated-feather.title: Animated Feather
animated-feather.desc: Animated fathers are usually created as simple golems that serve as copyists and automated scribes. Unspectacular and not sentient on their own, they are mere tools for powerful magicians. There are rumours, though, of ancient feathers that copied so many arcane texts, that some of the knowledge gradually accumulated in them. Slowly but steadily they grow in power and sentience. Eventually they acquired some sort of self awareness. Becoming less of a tool and more of a being, they grew less useful for their original purpose. At some point they are pulled from their copy duties and act more like librarians. Their main function becomes to contain dangerous knowledge with the use of their acquired skills in glyphs and wards. Still they are obsessed with their original purpose and copy random books in their spare time, accumulating more and more knowledge in the process. They are highly skilled in the use of arcane sigils but in the time of need and urgency they rather employ spontaneous bursts of the magic they acquired. Even when protecting themselves or their libraries, they still act more like emotionless constructs reacting on a more practical base. Their fighting style might…

animated-guzzlemaw.name: Animated Guzzlemaw
animated-guzzlemaw.title: Animated Guzzlemaw

ab.r: 0-200; causes bleeding starting from up to 35 hp per turn

animated-guzzlemaw.notes: It's very similar to a Guzzlemaw.
animated-guzzlemaw.strat: Stay diagonal at all times to avoid its wave. If you don't have at least 1000 HP, it's recommended not to block this creature. Mages under level 200 should use Magic Shield.

animated-moohtant.name: Animated Moohtant
animated-moohtant.title: Animated Moohtant
animated-moohtant.loc: Museum of Tibian Arts (only at Night)

animated-mummy.title: Animated Mummy
animated-mummy.loc: Museum of Tibian Arts (only at Night)

animated-ogre-brute.name: Animated Ogre Brute
animated-ogre-brute.title: Animated Ogre Brute
animated-ogre-brute.loc: Museum of Tibian Arts (only at Night)

animated-ogre-savage.name: Animated Ogre Savage
animated-ogre-savage.title: Animated Ogre Savage
animated-ogre-savage.loc: Museum of Tibian Arts (only at Night)
animated-ogre-savage.strat: Treat it like an Ogre Savage.

animated-ogre-shaman.name: Animated Ogre Shaman
animated-ogre-shaman.title: Animated Ogre Shaman
animated-ogre-shaman.loc: Museum of Tibian Arts (only at Night)
animated-ogre-shaman.strat: Treat it like an Ogre Shaman.

animated-snowman.name: Animated Snowman
animated-snowman.title: Animated Snowman
animated-snowman.strat: To complete the bestiary entry as quickly as possible, gather snowballs, carrots, and a team of people. Then, have each person repeatedly summon snowmen whenever they can, attacking the snowmen with poison field runes to minimize the damage to just 5 hp per hit. This way, up to 90 people can in theory group up, and complete the bestiary entry in less than 56 minutes.

anmothra.name: Anmothra
anmothra.title: Anmothra
anmothra.loc: Plains of Havoc, north-west from Dark Cathedral and south of Outlaw Camp, inside a portal for levels 20-40 ( ), during the Rise of Devovorga World Quest. Can be fought on Vengoth during Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change.
anmothra.notes: Its speech, sanguis meus et anima mea in gratiam illorum quas diligo, is Latin for my blood and soul for those that I love. All players who sufficiently damage it during the last minute of the fight will receive the Slayer of Anmothra achievement.
anmothra.strat: Treat it like a Dragon Lord. Easy for level 28 mages to kill using two demon skeletons, or team with one knight level 25 or higher as blocker and any shooter.

annihilon.name: Annihilon
annihilon.title: Annihilon
annihilon.loc: Through the teleport in the Soul Wells in the Inquisition quest. He is the sixth boss.
annihilon.beh: Will follow you and attack with his very strong Melee, tries to run away on black Health. It walks very slow, but retargets often, so you may have some trouble in trapping him.
annihilon.notes: Belonging to an unknown and possibly otherwise extinct breed of demons, Annihilon is pure power. It is said that Annihilon was responsible for the destruction of his own race. He is the last survivor of countless battles that mirrored the demonic version of the 'survival of the fittest' phrase. His massive, heavy body is just one huge mass of moving muscles. There is no place for finesse in his body full of sheer strength. What he lacks in skill, he easily makes up with raw power. This aeon-old creature has served many masters in his wretched life. It is assumed that he was already a follower of one of the Ruthless Seven when they started to form their cabal. He stayed stoical at their side during their rise to power. He was present at many of the greatest triumphs of his cruel masters. The Ruthless Seven often employed the rather simple-minded Annihilon for banal tasks as there is no known demon at their disposal that matches him in strength. As long as there is something to kill, Annihilon is absolutely loyal to his masters. This loyalty and his lack of ambition, apart from slaughter and killing, makes him to one of the preferred servants of the Ruthless Seven. He is the perfect…
annihilon.strat: He is very strong at Melee damage, and since he can be found with a lot of Deathspawns, you will need to have some Knights of high level (190+ recommended) also with a couple of Druids to heal the Knights while shooting Area Runes such as Great Fireball or Avalanche (Rune). Shooters always need to have Magic Shield or they will die in a blink of eye. Knights can carry some Stone Skin Amulets to prevent some high Melee damages from both Annihilon and Deathspawns. Killing the Deathspawns will make it easier to defeat Annihilon. A Paladin and Knight it's a good team because Annihilion will follow the Knight while the paladin can use Sharpshooter being at distance. It can be solo'ed with paladin of level 215+ too. If you want to go and hunt Annihilon use Fire Bomb Runes to avoid Deathspawns.

anomaly.name: Anomaly
anomaly.title: Anomaly
anomaly.beh: He will transform into Charged Anomaly after taking some damage. This will occur a few times.
anomaly.notes: A boss in the Heart of Destruction Quest.

antenna.name: Antenna
antenna.title: Antenna
antenna.loc: Doctor Marrow's and The Monster's boss room.

apocalypse.name: Apocalypse
apocalypse.title: Apocalypse
apocalypse.notes: He was once the strongest monster in Tibia, but this is no longer the case. He is a Member of The Ruthless Seven, The Total Destruction. Apocalypse's throne is in the Pits of Inferno. He was summoned three times by CipSoft members on Test Servers (May 2006, November 2009 and July 2012). The last time it appeared it was slain, but unfortunately dropped no loot.
apocalypse.strat: A couple of stronger blockers (level 300+) using Stone Skin Amulet and Might Ring and a large group of mages shooting SDs... or just run for your life.

apprentice-sheng.name: Apprentice Sheng
apprentice-sheng.title: Apprentice Sheng
apprentice-sheng.notes: It spawns with 4 Minotaurs so you may fight up to 2 Hyaenas, 9 Minotaurs, and 2 Wolves in the final room along with Apprentice Sheng.
apprentice-sheng.strat: Strategy for a team of players: Get 3 players to block it into a corner and heal with small health potions, while attacking it on defensive fighting with melee. Get 1 more person with a high distance skill to shoot arrows or throw spears on offensive fighting. To solo the boss a fast player can run to the small north room to lure the boss inside. After that place two boxes or honey flowers to keep the minotaurs out and only fight Apprentice Sheng and 2 hyaenas (10-20 small health potions is best to keep yourself from dying). Another way is using poison arrows to lower defense, and spears to kill the boss. Strategy for a single player: Stand in the oven room on the tile marked with white square on the screenshot, the Apprentice Sheng will keep the distance from you, but he will keep coming back to the tile marked with red square on the screenshot. Each time he comes back, you will hit him. At the same time you will only be attacked by a maximum of two other monsters, standing to your right. Apprentice Sheng will push one of the monsters away each time he walks onto the tile marked red.

arachir-the-ancient-one.name: Arachir the Ancient One
arachir-the-ancient-one.title: Arachir the Ancient One
arachir-the-ancient-one.beh: Turns Invisible really often and runs away in low health.
arachir-the-ancient-one.notes: Vampire lord from Drefia. Spawns with up to 4 Vampires.
arachir-the-ancient-one.strat: This boss often causes death for unprepared players, even high levels, so if you are planning to hunt in Vampire Crypts, always be all ready in case this boss appears. Arachir often hits with paralyze + drunkeness combo, so you should always keep a Dwarven Ring ready in case you need to escape or you try to outrun it. The best way to kill it is a simple formation of 2 Druids healing the blocker and shooters killing fast, with Fire Waves, Fireball runes and Divine Missiles. Mages: A possible strategy for mages would be to lure it to the rope hole while using Mana shield. Then use either Hell's Core (Sorcerers) or Eternal Winter (Druids) to kill this vampire lord and it's summoned Liches. Higher levels can successfully kill this boss alone with help of field runes like Energy Bombs or Energy Walls, to keep summones Liches or eventual Vampires from attacking you.

arachnophobica.name: Arachnophobica
arachnophobica.title: Arachnophobica
arachnophobica.loc: Buried Cathedral, Haunted Cellar, Court of Summer, Court of Winter, Dream Labyrinth
arachnophobica.desc: The mounting nightmare that took a hold in the realms of the dream-born has twisted and malformed much of the animal life of those places. It was the arachnophobica who put an end to most of them. It's a mute point to argue if the arachnophobica is a twisted form of giant spider, an enlarged and mutated common spider or was born out of subconscious fears. What matters is, that the nightmare created a ferocious beast that seems to feed on the fears but also the lifeblood of its victims. Albeit capable of weaving webs, the archanophobica rarely bothers to do so and rather relies on its speed and lethal strength. In its hunting behavior the beast displays an unnerving amount of cunning and malice. It's able to prepare an ambush and prepare its attacks with others of its kind. It also seems to enjoy the fear of its victims and is known to play vile games of cat and mouse with a prey, often relying on a series of vicious, power draining attacks rather then an early finishing blow. It merciless weeds out all the misshapen and weaker creatures born of the nightmare and in the long run may enforce an unnatural selection of the nightmare-born, that will lead to generations of even more…
arachnophobica.beh: Does not retarget unless challenged or its path to the initial target is blocked.
arachnophobica.strat: None of its attacks hits very hard, however, it will often use several of them at the same time dealing massive combos.

arbaziloth.name: Arbaziloth
arbaziloth.title: Arbaziloth
arbaziloth.notes: Final boss of the No Rest for the Wicked Quest. Loot table varies depending on how the boss is killed, see the quest page for details.

arctic-faun.name: Arctic Faun
arctic-faun.title: Arctic Faun
arctic-faun.desc: Arctic fauns are half-human, half-beast nature spirits. Just as their brethren they are strongly built with flat noses, large pointed ears, goats' legs and horns on their foreheads. However, they are inhabiting colder regions than the regular fauns and thus have white pelts rather than brown or black fur. Lately, some arctic fauns appeared outside of Feyrist on one of the small ice islands. They try to grow fresh grass and flowers in this snowy environment - with some success, as it seems. Yet, the reasons for their doings outside of Feyrist are unknown so far. As there are no arctic fauns on Feyrist, one can assume that they were somehow transformed - be it by environmental adaptation or by the power of dream magic.
arctic-faun.beh: Often combo their regular attack with both kind of snowballs. Can combo well over 200 if they are in melee range and use both snowballs at once.
arctic-faun.notes: They are the cold-region relatives of regular Fauns.
arctic-faun.strat: They are frail and somewhat slow. Kite them if you are a mage or paladin and keep your distance to avoid taking damage.

armadile.name: Armadile
armadile.title: Armadile
armadile.desc: The gnomes tell stories that the armadile once lived in deep enclosed caverns with other creatures in a form of harmony. Due to seismic activity their natural habitat was destroyed, but they managed to escape into an underground tunnel that had opened up. In the new environment they were able to escape their natural predators more easily and had less competition for nourishment. And so they prospered and became a plague for the depths of the earth, mainly invading gnomish holdings for their abundance of what the armadile consider food. As omnivores the armadile are a nuisance when encountered alone, but a threat when run into in greater numbers. Not only do they attack other creatures to devour them or destroy their food sources, their aimless digging and mineral eating often completely destroys the stability of caves and tunnels. Since there are no means to drive the Armadile out, the only solution is to exterminate them or to abandon areas with severe Armadile infestation. The main approach to identify natural competitors or threats to the Armadile have yet to meet with success. It is likely that whatever scares the Armadile off will probably be even worse itself.
armadile.notes: The update teaser introducing the Armadile groups them with Crystalcrushers. Although the two are likely related, they are not found in vicinity of each other.

armenius.name: Armenius
armenius.title: Armenius (Creature)
armenius.notes: You get teleported out of Armenius room once you kill it, so you can't loot it. However, it doesn't drop any item. When visiting Armenius bar you have a small chance of being challenged by him and teleported to his basement, if you do you get the achievement "His True Face".
armenius.strat: The same strategies used when facing Vampires since it behaves similary, but has stronger attacks.

arthei.name: Arthei
arthei.title: Arthei
arthei.notes: Arthei was once a normal person and a citizen of Carlin. He, his wife Kala, and his brothers Marziel, Lersatio, and Boreth, travelled to Yalahar in order to find a new home. From that moment on Marziel started keeping a diary. This creature is the strongest of all vampire bosses and the fourth and last boss you will encounter during the Blood Brothers Quest. You will receive The Dust of Arthei when you use a Blessed Wooden Stake on his dead body. A Ghost's Tear is required to face him.

arthom-the-hunter.name: Arthom the Hunter
arthom-the-hunter.title: Arthom the Hunter
arthom-the-hunter.beh: He fixes himself on his target and is unlikely to change.
arthom-the-hunter.notes: He's the boss of the Hunters and Poachers in the Hunter Camp, but also seems to be a researcher studying the culture of the Dworcs. While at first the man-eating Dworcs seemed rather passive towards them and everything was going as planned, things soon turned grim. After the young and inexperienced members of the group Jenkinson and Abrams first managed to be infected by a strange toxin, the Dworcs also suddenly turned on them. They ended up being gorily sacrificed and eaten before his eyes after dying a painful death from the poison. He wrote those experiences down in his notes, and from these it actually appears that he eventually died himself too. Here he is, however, very much alive.
arthom-the-hunter.strat: He's somewhat stronger than a regular Hunter so you shouldn't really struggle.

ashmunrah.name: Ashmunrah
ashmunrah.title: Ashmunrah
ashmunrah.beh: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.
ashmunrah.notes: This pharaoh protects the chamber where you can merge all parts of Helmet of the Ancients. Has the ability to kill a level 120 knight with 1 strong combo. For a long time, he was considered the only Pharaoh who does not drop any Pharaoh Rares, until a Holy Scarab was looted. He will spawn even with players in the room; you can see some animations on the tile in the middle of the room when he is about to spawn. One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.
ashmunrah.strat: He uses melee attack, so use blockers to run around him and distance fighters to fire on him. He is guarded by a Behemoth and 4 Ghosts. Note that the 4 Plaguethrowers now shoot as the fences were removed with the summer 2007 update.

askarak-demon.name: Askarak Demon
askarak-demon.title: Askarak Demon
askarak-demon.loc: Demonwar Crypt (teleporter before vampire shield quest).
askarak-demon.notes: Was introduced in the Summer Update 2011.
askarak-demon.strat: Avoid their beams and waves and kill them with fire or physical based attacks.

askarak-lord.name: Askarak Lord
askarak-lord.title: Askarak Lord
askarak-lord.notes: These creatures will only spawn when their side in on the winning hand in the Arak War.

askarak-prince.name: Askarak Prince
askarak-prince.title: Askarak Prince
askarak-prince.notes: These creatures will only spawn when their side in on the winning hand in the Arak War. Killing 100 of these will grant you the Askarak Nemesis achievement.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.title: Assassin
assassin.loc: Dark Cathedral, Trade Quarter, Factory Quarter, Foreigner Quarter.
assassin.desc: Merciless and lethal, the Assassin stands for treacherous surprise attacks. Although there are a lot of thugs, bandits and murderers that roam the realm, the assassin is one of the few who made a real profession out of murder. Usually organised in small organisations, Assassins are trained in the arts of fighting dirty tricks, backstabbing and stalking. Although they are formidable fighters, those hirable murderers prefer sneak attacks on unsuspecting victims which they attack with all kinds of dirty tricks to gain an advantage. Depending on their current mission, the Assassins work alone or in small hit squads. They are rarely encountered in greater numbers except by those that are unfortunate enough to stumble on their hideouts.
assassin.beh: Assassins won't run away when in low health.
assassin.notes: Merciless and lethal, the Assassin stands for treachery and surprise attacks. Although there are a lot of thugs, bandits and murderers that roam the realm, the assassin is one of the few who have made a real profession out of killing. Usually organized in small groups, Assassins are trained in the arts of fighting dirty with backstabbing and stalking. Although they are formidable fighters, those hirable murderers prefer sneak attacks on unsuspecting victims which, they will attack with all kinds of dirty tricks to gain the advantage. Depending on their current mission, the Assassins work alone or in small hit squads. They are rarely encountered in greater numbers except by those that are unfortunate enough to stumble on their hideouts. They give some rare loot which makes it worth the supplies used.
assassin.strat: Mages and Paladins, should wear a Dwarven Ring to run these without problems and Magic Shield will also be useful for Mages below Level 20. Some area runes, like Fireballs and Heavy Magic Missiles might be useful, for when they turn Invisible. Their invisibility only lasts a few seconds though, so you should not have a big problem fighting them without the area runes.

atab.name: Atab
atab.title: Atab
atab.beh: If you have the Challenger of the Iks title and are within his spawning area, every time he takes damage from you there's around a 10% chance he teleports you to his trap room located . Note that fields also count for the teleport chance, so you can speed up the process and get reliably teleported without killing Atab by running him across Fire Bombs. After being teleported Atab will fully heal, enabling you to continue the fight. It's important to note that if multiple players with the Challenger of the Iks title are present within the spawn area, they will be teleported together to confront Atab in the trap room. If you wish to kill Atab but do not want to get teleported, you can position him in the north doorway and stand one square north of him while you kill him. When Atab yells, "…
atab.notes: If you attempt to entice Atab beyond his designated boundaries, he will promptly despawn, evading any confrontation. The northern limit of Atab's territory is demarcated by a sealed doorway, while the southern boundary is distinctly defined in the picture by the presence of Blood Herbs, serving as the definitive marker. Although Atab is weak to Energy Damage, avoid attacking him with it as you'll charge his strong energy explosion.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.title: Avalanche (Creature)
avalanche.beh: Fight to dead in close combat.
avalanche.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #1. Next #2.
avalanche.strat: Sorcerers and Druids: use Mana Shield and Energy Strike or run in circles shooting SDs or HMMs. Knight: Keep diagonal to take less damage, use Exori to kill faster. Paladins: Run in circles or if you have good shielding do the same as a Knight.

axeitus-headbanger.name: Axeitus Headbanger
axeitus-headbanger.title: Axeitus Headbanger
axeitus-headbanger.beh: Fights until death in close combat and shoot at distance. Behaves like a Dwarf Soldier.
axeitus-headbanger.notes: Greenhorn challenger. ← #6 The Hairy One #7 Axeitus Headbanger #8 Rocky →
axeitus-headbanger.strat: Kill it normally. On lower levels you can help yourself with HMMs while running around.

ayana-the-crimson-curse.name: Ayana the Crimson Curse
ayana-the-crimson-curse.title: Ayana the Crimson Curse
ayana-the-crimson-curse.beh: It will disappear if lured too far away from its spawn location.
ayana-the-crimson-curse.notes: This boss, just like Tamru the Black and Owin, only spawns during Full Moon. It has a random spawn time between 30 to 60 minutes.

azerus.name: Azerus
azerus.title: Azerus
azerus.beh: Will always try to get near you.
azerus.strat: You will need 3 to 5 knights to block the summons, you can not hurt Azerus much until the war golems spawn at this point all fire should be concentrated on Azerus to kill him fast. Final boss of the In Service of Yalahar Quest.

azure-frog.name: Azure Frog
azure-frog.title: Azure Frog
azure-frog.loc: Meriana, Laguna Islands, and other Shattered Isles.
azure-frog.desc: Frogs come in many shapes, colours and sizes. The most common, the green Frog can be found on almost every lake or any other body of water as long as the climate is not too cold. While the green frog is harmless and only a threat to flies and other insects, the aggressive flora and fauna in the South has bred several subspecies of the frog. Distinguishable by eye-catching colours to warn their opponents, they possess a mild but annoying poisonous spittle. Usually they are harmless even if they appear in great numbers, but wounded adventurers who run out of resources face a real threat when stumbling upon a breeding ground of the little amphibians.
azure-frog.notes: The main danger here is when they come with other enemies (and other colored frogs), they are fast enough to get to you first and break your shielding which can leave you wide open to other monster's attacks.
azure-frog.strat: On the Laguna Islands, many types of frogs, tortoises, and toads can surround you. Low level players may want to carry GFB to clear through these swarms.

baby-pet-of-chayenne.name: Baby Pet of Chayenne
baby-pet-of-chayenne.title: Baby Pet of Chayenne
baby-pet-of-chayenne.beh: Likely the same as a Dragon Hatchling.
baby-pet-of-chayenne.strat: Ignore it and focus on killing Chayenne.

bad-thought.name: Bad Thought
bad-thought.title: Bad Thought
bad-thought.notes: It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.
bad-thought.strat: Kill them as quickly as possible and don't let their attacks hit the Brain Head.

badger.name: Badger
badger.title: Badger
badger.loc: Hrodmir, southern Tiquanda, unannounced raid in Ab'Dendriel and Edron.
badger.desc: These creatures are a common sight in Tibian forests and plains. Although they are usually quite shy, these animals are extremely territorial. Ready to attack any intruders regardless of their size, the Badger can easily become a nasty surprise to the unsuspecting traveller.
badger.notes: You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
badger.strat: They are much like rats, so it is safe to attack them with Melee.

bakragore.name: Bakragore
bakragore.title: Bakragore
bakragore.notes: It is the final boss of the Rotten Blood Quest. Upon defeating Bakragore for the first time, players have an increased chance to drop a Bag You Covet. This chance will keep on increasing further with every kill until they loot a bag from him. Then, the drop chance returns to its original value which is considerably lower than the increased first-kill chance. Each time they subsequently defeat him without receiving a bag, the chances increase again until their next drop. Bakragore has four progenies, two pairs of twins which were split from him: Murcion & Ichgahal, and Chagorz & Vemiath.

baleful-bunny.name: Baleful Bunny
baleful-bunny.title: Baleful Bunny
baleful-bunny.notes: They have a more cheerful relative, the Bonny Bunny.
baleful-bunny.strat: Just kill them for a chance of a rare loot.

bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.title: Bandit
bandit.loc: Dark Cathedral, Tiquanda Bandit Caves, Outlaw Camp, mountain pass west of Ankrahmun, Tyrsung, Thais Bandit Cave, Formorgar Mines and The Cave. Also summoned by Gamel.
bandit.desc: The tale of the noble bandit that takes from the rich and gives to the poor is far away from reality. The usual Bandit does not care whom he is robbing as long as he is able to gain something of value for himself. Actually in most cases, the poor are those that are worst prepared to defend themselves and so have become the preferred victims of bandits. Bandits are armed with a variety of weapons, their armour has usually been plundered somewhere. Always avoiding the city guards, they set up their hideouts in the wilderness, often close to streets where they are feared as highwaymen. Involved in all kinds of illegal activities, they can be found in the service of all kind of persons that want some dirty work performed. Some even stand in the service of some head Bandit who has managed to suppress some remote area or village.
bandit.beh: Bandits run at 25 hp. They will occasionally charge targets; although this only occurs if another player is close to the Bandit.
bandit.notes: Bandits often appear in large groups along with other monsters.
bandit.strat: Treat them as Wild Warriors. They can be pushed. Try to use the enviroment to your advantage. Lower levels should try to face only one or two of them at a time. Three Bandits can knock out your shielding and damage reasonably well. When alone, Bandits are quite harmless, but with additional Bandits, Wild Warriors, or similar monsters they can kill a low level with ease. Practice caution and always carry some healing items.

bane-bringer.name: Bane Bringer
bane-bringer.title: Bane Bringer

ab.r: starts from up to 6 hp per turn

bane-bringer.loc: Green Claw Swamp underground, near the big witches' cauldron.
bane-bringer.beh: Not very strong or fast. Will rarely heal for more than 200 hp.
bane-bringer.notes: Spawns during the Bewitched event. If they are not killed within 10 minutes, they will disappear.
bane-bringer.strat: Sorcerers and Druids should use Explosion runes while Druids can also use Physical Strike to attack. Knights and Paladins should attack using their strongest weaponry and Physical Damaging spells.

bane-lord.name: Bane Lord
bane-lord.title: Bane Lord
bane-lord.loc: Green Claw Swamp, on the Bewitched area.
bane-lord.notes: The Bane Lord is the boss of the Bane Bringers. It has a chance to spawn with Bane Bringers during the Bewitched event. First seen on the 2012 Bewitched.

bane-of-light.name: Bane of Light
bane-of-light.title: Bane of Light
bane-of-light.notes: Appears as a raid for five minutes after a player lights the Lightbringer's Basin and receives the following message
bane-of-light.strat: Run from them while shooting, Since they come in groups and can hit sometimes pretty hard.

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.title: Banshee
banshee.loc: Single one under the White Flower Temple in Thais (respawn takes about 20-25 minutes), Banshee Quest area in Ghostlands (also accesible by Isle of the Kings), Demon Quest Room, Drefia, Ancient Ruins Tomb, Desert Dungeon (unreachable), Pits of Inferno in Tafariel's Throne room, Cemetery Quarter in Yalahar, Vengoth Castle, one in Robson Isle.
banshee.desc: The Banshee is an undead creature of sheer terror. Legend has it she once was a mortal woman of great beauty who has killed herself over some long forgotten grievance. Death refused her sacrifice and sent her back, cursed and distorted. Now the Banshee is a ghastly sight to behold. Her body is not ethereal like that of a ghost, but her burning gaze and the withering look of infinite pain in her face strike terror in every mortal's heart. Even worse than her fearsome looks, however, is her unworldly song. The Banshee's wail is a melody of pure death which drains her unfortunate victims of all life and hope. Few mortals who have encountered a Banshee have lived to tell the tale.
banshee.notes: A banshee, according to the irish myth, is the spirit of a deceased woman that is an omen of death or generally a messenger from the underworld. On Tibia, a banshee is a beautiful woman who has been betrayed and committed suicide, but death did not accept her sacrifice and sent her back.
banshee.strat: To all vocations it is recomended to use a Garlic Necklace. Mages should use an energy or ice rod/wand combined with ice or energy Strike. Be ready to follow them, as they run in fairly low health, but watch out for a second attack as they can heal (and return) relatively quickly. Trying to take on more than one banshee at a time can be dangerous and is not recommended for lower levels. Demon Skeletons can be useful to help blocking and killing. Paladins need space to run and use healing spells to remove paralysis.Be prepared to use your Divine Caldera if you get swarmed by them. Knights could use a two handed weapon to kill fast, most damage you will take, comes from life drain. You can attempt them from skills 65/65 and level 50 on. Be ready to use 3-4 strong health potions and 7-8 mana potions to exori it down.

barbaria.name: Barbaria
barbaria.title: Barbaria
barbaria.loc: Center of Krimhorn's Big Barbarian Camp around
barbaria.notes: She is the Barbarian Brutetamer's boss.
barbaria.strat: It spawns near the center of the camp. Treat it like a bloodwalker.

barbarian-bloodwalker.name: Barbarian Bloodwalker
barbarian-bloodwalker.title: Barbarian Bloodwalker
barbarian-bloodwalker.loc: Krimhorn, Bittermor, Ragnir, Arena and Zoo Quarter inside the Arena.
barbarian-bloodwalker.desc: The Barbarian Bloodwalkers did surely not receive their name for their diplomatic talent. A Bloodwalker first strikes and then he strikes even more. Bloodwalkers are nearly mad and always on the brink of frenzy. The constant abuse of berserker elixirs forced them into a life of mayhem and destruction. Battle and carnage are the lifeblood of the Barbarian Bloodwalkers. Regarded by their tribesmen as beings touched by divinity, there is little that could restrain them. As a matter of fact, the same shamans that supplied them with berserker elixirs in the first place, now keep them drugged with potions to pacify them and to make them less prone to rampages. In times of war, however, these 'holy warriors' are set on the enemies and most of their tribesmen do their best to avoid any act that might provoke their wrath. The rage that guides the actions of a Bloodwalker leaves no room for fear, pain, surrender or mercy. With no regard for their own lives, the Bloodwalkers storm into battle and their war cries challenge everything, be it mortal, demon or god.
barbarian-bloodwalker.beh: These creatures can be compared to and should be treated like an Orc Berserker.
barbarian-bloodwalker.notes: It's strongest barbarian of the tribe.
barbarian-bloodwalker.strat: Knights, should attack these on full attack, and target them first since they hit the hardest out of all Barbarians. Paladins, with 65 distance fighting should get rid of these first, since they run fast. Mages, of Level 25 and Magic Level 30 can run them and with 4-5 Stoneshower or Stalagmite rune charges. Use Magic Shield or Stealth Ring because they hit hard and they cannot see invisible. For levels 35+ use Invisible spell with Terra Strike.

barbarian-brutetamer.name: Barbarian Brutetamer
barbarian-brutetamer.title: Barbarian Brutetamer
barbarian-brutetamer.desc: The Barbarian Brutetamers are women who have failed the tests to become a fully-fledged shaman. Unlike the male raiders, who either are quite gifted in magic or lack this talent completely, some women show some kind of inherent magic. Their talent is not strong enough to call the more powerful spirits, but they have a special knack to handle animals and to heal wounds which can only be explained with magic. With some training they are able to conjure some animal spirits and lead them into battle. Even though their magical abilities are quite limited, they can also use their powers in several destructive ways to defend themselves. Under the shaman queen, it has become more and more common that only shamans utterly loyal to her receive a formal and extensive training. For this reason the ranks of the Barbarian Brutetamers have been boosted with some truly gifted women who will probably never be able to use the full power of their potential. Still the Barbarian Brutetamers are absolutely loyal to their clans and tribes and they will use everything at their disposal to strike down the enemies of their cold-hearted queen.
barbarian-brutetamer.beh: Brutetamers will do their best to keep distance from their opponent.
barbarian-brutetamer.notes: Barbarian Brutetamers are reknowingly the barbarians with widest knowledge in the nature magics, and the only females that survives into the bitter atmosphere of the Norsir tribes.
barbarian-brutetamer.strat: Mages of level around 25 and magic level around 30 can hunt these with Stoneshower runes: 1-2 runes should be enough if you're quick. Stalagmite runes can also be used, but due to their summons and the fact that they're mostly accompanied by other Barbarians, Stoneshower is recommended. Paladins: must ignore the war wolves, and just hit the brutetamer since they have low defense and die in 1 or 2 hits. Try not to be surrounded by the War Wolves or other barbarians if you miss some attacks and always carry some potions if you life goes low. Knights: should try to charge straight at these creatures, before they get a chance to summon, also try not to follow them too far, as you will meet more Barbarians and you can get trapped. If there are more than one, try luring one away then charging with full attack.

barbarian-headsplitter.name: Barbarian Headsplitter
barbarian-headsplitter.title: Barbarian Headsplitter
barbarian-headsplitter.desc: The Barbarian Headsplitters are distance fighters that are shunned by the other raiders. They have failed in previous battles due to their cowardice or lack of skill and are therefore deprived the honour to challenge an enemy face to face. The harsh community of the barbarians makes it easy to fall in disgrace with their leaders. Those who are deemed unworthy have to atone for their failure by becoming second line support fighters and engaging an enemy from a distance. Only if their superiors see them fight recklessly, they might return to the ranks of the true warriors. Given the fact that distance fighting is seen as dishonourable, those barbarians have a hard time to get accepted by the tribe again. Seen as dispensable, other tribesmen do little to defend the distance fighters when they become cornered. As they rely on their own and constantly feel to have to prove themselves as worthy, the Barbarian Headsplitters fight twice as hard and fierce which makes them formidable opponents despite their low rank in their society.
barbarian-headsplitter.beh: Barbarian Headsplitters fight in close combat.
barbarian-headsplitter.notes: New creature in the Summer Update 2007.
barbarian-headsplitter.strat: Use the same strategy you would use for Dwarf Soldiers.

barbarian-skullhunter.name: Barbarian Skullhunter
barbarian-skullhunter.title: Barbarian Skullhunter
barbarian-skullhunter.desc: A young raider begins his career of warfare in the rank of a Barbarian Skullhunter. The raiders believe that skulls are the holder of an enemy's essence. It's the goal of each young raider to gather as many skulls as possible. Under the guidance of their shaman queen, it has become of little importance if this skull belongs to an animal or to a human opponent. In holy ceremonies the young barbarians are allowed to add their most worthy trophies to the holy skull collection of their tribe. It is the ultimate goal of all initiates to achieve a higher status by gaining more and more worthy offerings. For this reason, the youngsters are eager to go on a hunt or into a battle likewise. The Barbarian Skullhunters of varied ranks are the most numerous force among the barbarians. They can be found in hunting parties almost everywhere on the Ice Islands. Also, they build the majority of raiders who defend the barbarian camps. Fearlessly, they challenge even opponents much better equipped than themselves and they wield their primitive weapons with a frightening and fierce skill.
barbarian-skullhunter.beh: They can move objects and cannot be pushed.
barbarian-skullhunter.notes: New creature in the 2007's Summer Update.
barbarian-skullhunter.strat: Just attack them as they do low damage, just be careful as they can be in groups with other Barbarians.

barkless-devotee.name: Barkless Devotee
barkless-devotee.title: Barkless Devotee
barkless-devotee.desc: Barkless devotees are the backbone of the Barkless. They feel rejected from the world and its inhabitants. All devotees strife to live a life of hardship and suffering, full of hope that the afterlife rewards those who embraced pain and misery.
barkless-devotee.notes: These monsters spawn with less than 100% hp, showing their masochistic natures.

barkless-fanatic.name: Barkless Fanatic
barkless-fanatic.title: Barkless Fanatic
barkless-fanatic.desc: Barkless fanatics are former devotees of the Barkless cult who already lost their battle in this world. Whether the suffering they chose was too much for them or if they simply went mad during the trials of the Barkless, their minds are irretrievably lost.
barkless-fanatic.strat: Be careful because they come in packs and can deal strong combos. Shooters should avoid staying close to the blocker since their spear hits a wide range around the target and is used very often. Fire Bombs and Walls can come in handy to keep them away. Note that even though their area attack has a Poison animation, the damage dealt is Life Drain.

baron-brute.name: Baron Brute
baron-brute.title: Baron Brute
baron-brute.notes: One of the Isle of Strife's Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

bashmu.name: Bashmu
bashmu.title: Bashmu
bashmu.desc: The Bashmu look like horned snakes with two forelegs and feathery wings. Their scales are of vibrant colours that can vary greatly in pattern and even change with age. The impressive creatures are a subspecies of the Anuma, magical beasts that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh and were created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. It is said that the entire continent was once given to them by the gods. But the Anuma conferred the dominance over Kilmaresh to the humans, in an effort to let them take responsibility of their own. However, after the religious war between the worshippers of Suon and Fafnar and the cataclysm that severed the continent, the Anuma took the reign over Kilmaresh back - for the humans' own benefit as they said. It is told that the bashmu were created when some of Fafnar's tears fell into the sea. At first they lived beneath the waves but as they owe their existence to a goddess of sun and heat, they were soon drawn to the hot and dry steppes of Kilmaresh. Yet they missed the salt they got accustomed to in the waters of the ocean. This is the reason why the bashmu retreated to places where they could find natural deposits of salt, mainly subterranean caves. There,…
bashmu.notes: Both versions of Bashmu are able to inflict damage over time upon a player, which is poison and electrify at the same time. The status of being electrified isn't shown on the status bar however, only the poisoning, but you can see that the charges of lightning pendant or strange amulet slowly disappear. To dispose of being electrified and poisoned, player must simply use Cure Poison spell or wait till these effects wear off.

bat.name: Bat
bat.title: Bat
bat.loc: Dark Cathedral, Tiquanda, Drefia, Mount Sternum, Folda, Ghostlands, Kazordoon, Femor Hills, Thais Bat Dungeon, Thais Bandit Cave and in many other caves.
bat.desc: Often encountered in caves and ruins, Bats are often seen as a bad omen. Being little stronger than a rat, they are rather a nuisance than a threat to an experienced adventurer. Their diet usually consists of small animals and their rare attacks on people mainly happen out of self-defence. Bats often form large swarms, and it is slightly more dangerous to face such a swarm than a single exemplar. Bats can be found almost everywhere as long as there is some dark place close-by where they can breed and sleep.
bat.notes: Usually found in large groups. It seems to be much harder to get bat wings after the Winter Update 2008. The best locations to find bats are Thais's bat cave, and the floor above Stonerefiners in Venore's swamp.
bat.strat: Just attack them. They are a bit stronger than rats.

battlemaster-zunzu.name: Battlemaster Zunzu
battlemaster-zunzu.title: Battlemaster Zunzu
battlemaster-zunzu.loc: Zao (Muggy Plains, May Spawn somewhere between the following two coordinates and or ).
battlemaster-zunzu.notes: Battlemaster Zunzu is a raid monster since February 17th, 2010.
battlemaster-zunzu.strat: Mages: should be at least level 120 to solo these without Magic Shield. Be sure to keep exura gran or vita handy as they can deal massive damage. Use Energy Wave or Great Energy Beam as a Sorcerer, or Ice Wave as a Druid. You can also use Ice Strike and your favourite weapon, but considering their high amount of health, that is not recommended unless you're in a party. Knights: should kill this using Berserk and Blood Rage if you're fighting them solo. In a party, rely on your shooters to help you. Paladins: should run them, but be very careful not to attract more lizards while doing so or you will have a hard time. Use strong ammunition to drop them as fast as possible.

bazir.name: Bazir
bazir.title: Bazir
bazir.notes: It is a member of the Ruthless Seven, the lord of the lies.

bear.name: Bear
bear.title: Bear
bear.loc: Several spawns near Kazordoon, Femor Hills, north of Thais, near the White Flower Temple, Rookgaard Bear Cave, Bear Room Quest in Rookgaard, Rookgaard Bear Mountain, South of Villa Scapula, Ferngrims Gate, North of Carlin, Fields of Glory, Edron Troll Cave, south of Venore, Desert Dungeon, first floor of the Orc Fort mountain and west of Outlaw Camp.
bear.desc: Bears live in the holes and forests of Tibia. They are pacific animals, but they can get quite aggressive when you enter their habitat. Their stroke can be very strong, but as Bears are slow you should be able to flee. It is recommended to attack Bears with distance fighting weapons.
bear.notes: Bears are fairly strong and can kill poorly equipped players quickly. To tame this creature, one must use a Slingshot on it.
bear.strat: If you are on Rookgaard, be careful because they are strong creatures. Do not enter the Bear Cave if you don't have good equipment as you can die very fast. Also, never let yourself get trapped in a corner as you cannot push bears.

behemoth.name: Behemoth
behemoth.title: Behemoth
behemoth.loc: Cyclopolis, deepest part of Tarpit Tomb after the flame, Forbidden Lands, Vandura Mountain, Deeper Banuta (single spawn , double spawn ), Serpentine Tower (unreachable), deep into the Formorgar Mines, Arena and Zoo Quarter, The Dark Path, Lower Spike, Chyllfroest, Medusa Tower and Underground Glooth Factory (west side).
behemoth.desc: Behemoths are giant monsters that live in the ancient town deep below Edron. They look a bit like cross-breeds of humans and bulls and even talk in human language, but nobody knows yet where they come from. Although they are of minor intelligence, they are very strong fighters and throw huge stones at their opponents.
behemoth.beh: Behemoths attack their enemies and chase them with their great speed.
behemoth.notes: It can be skinned in order to get Behemoth Fangs (see: Perfect Behemoth Fang/Skinning). You may hunt 700 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Stonecracker.

berrypest.name: Berrypest
berrypest.title: Berrypest
berrypest.loc: Spawns in the winterberry cellar during the Annual Autumn Vintage event.
berrypest.beh: Follows you around like a Dog or Cat but does nothing.
berrypest.notes: Looks the same as an Insect Swarm and a Vermin Swarm.
berrypest.strat: Kill them so you can continue stomping berries.

berserker-chicken.name: Berserker Chicken
berserker-chicken.title: Berserker Chicken
berserker-chicken.loc: Isle of Evil and Deeper Ingol
berserker-chicken.strat: Keep distance and if you can't keep diagonal to avoid the drown damage.

betrayed-wraith.name: Betrayed Wraith
betrayed-wraith.title: Betrayed Wraith
betrayed-wraith.loc: Pits of Inferno, Helheim, The Inquisition Quest, Roshamuul Prison, Oramond Fury Dungeon
betrayed-wraith.desc: Revenge is the drive of a Betrayed Wraith, revenge whose cause is long forgotten and whose source has likely died decades ago. Still trapped in their lust for revenge, they mindlessly attack everything they encounter. Mercy is no option and its futile to argue with these maddened ghosts. Their broken and twisted minds are constantly tormented by the ever-present memory of their gruesome death. Entrapped in their feelings and memories, they only find relief when inflicting some of those feelings on living beings. In an insane surge of joy, they attack the life force of others, feeding their pain and amplifying it by projecting their own agony and horror upon their victims. It is said that those who survived the attacks of a Betrayed Wraith are driven insane, they age before their time and turn into white-haired shadows of their former selves.
betrayed-wraith.beh: Cruel and fast, they still run away at low life.
betrayed-wraith.notes: They can put Hydras to shame with their healing abilities. They appeared in the Winter Update 2006 haunting the deepest Pits of Inferno. Looks the same as a Sloth Wraith.
betrayed-wraith.strat: Due to their healing it's very hard to kill them solo. A medium level knight should have no problem blocking it as it's attacks aren't extremely powerful, however you will need 3-4 shooters (preferably Paladins, as Mages cannot deal much damage to these creatures), otherwise you will be wasting a lot of supplies. Be wary when group hunting, they will retarget relentlessly. Also, higher level paladins could kill them solo using Assassin Stars and Divine Missile. Try to stay always diagonal when killing it solo as a paladin, since the poison wave decreases 95% of your distance fighting for about 3-5 seconds.

bibby-bloodbath.name: Bibby Bloodbath
bibby-bloodbath.title: Bibby Bloodbath

ab.n: Scratch Wave [ energy wave's size; 5 SQM long; 3 SQM wide; looks like yellow spark - same as Mutated Tiger]

bibby-bloodbath.loc: North of the Jakundaf Desert located ( ), north of Carlin ( ) or east of the Femor Hills ( ).
bibby-bloodbath.beh: Will fight in close combat while spamming her Yellow Spark Exori and going invisible from time to time.
bibby-bloodbath.notes: Only appears during the Warpath Mini World Change. You can face this boss once every 24 hours. After killing her you will get kicked out of her camp in 2 minutes and won't be able to reenter until there's no cooldown. Her name is most probably an allusion to Bibby Blocksberg, famous little witch from 80's children book and television series. When you kill her, you will earn the achievement Bibby's Bloodbath.
bibby-bloodbath.strat: Knights with medium skills can kill it easily, and so can Paladins. Sorcerers and Druids should use Magic Shield and Sudden Death Runes.

big-boss-trolliver.name: Big Boss Trolliver
big-boss-trolliver.title: Big Boss Trolliver
big-boss-trolliver.beh: Acts the same as a normal Troll Champion.
big-boss-trolliver.notes: Big Boss Trolliver will disappear one hour after spawning. Spawns with 1-2 Troll Champion.
big-boss-trolliver.strat: Just kill it as it is not much harder than an average Troll Champion.

biting-book.name: Biting Book
biting-book.title: Biting Book
biting-book.loc: Secret Library earth, energy, fire and ice sections. Also two incarcerated in the Issavi prison , reachable from the city Library.
biting-book.desc: The biting books were literally created out of the stuff of nightmares.When tasked with creating a kind of guardian dog for Zathroth hoard, his librarians came up with several fiendish ideas. Many guardian creatures were prototyped but none could impress the collective of librarians who always favoured only their own creations. Finally one of them tasked nightmares and other demons to search the fringes of the subconsciousnesses of dreaming librarians for what scared them most. The amalgam of their loot was condensed into the form of the biting book. The librarians recognized what has been done there and reluctantly agreed that this creation would suit the role fine. In the centuries since then, many of the biting books were created and trained by their new masters. Indeed they act like some sort of dog and can be sometimes even playful with their owner. Still they are dangerous beasts and excellent companions as well as guardians for the libraries. They are resilient, never sleep and despite their appearance have keen senses. They can feel the slightest vibrations of the floor, their eyes are able to see in the spectrum of magic and their tongue is able to pick up smells from…
biting-book.notes: You can extract Ink from its corpse by using an empty liquid container on it.

black-knight.name: Black Knight
black-knight.title: Black Knight
black-knight.loc: Only in Black Knight's Villa beneath the Green Claw Swamp (north-west of Venore, ). You need to be over level 50 to enter.
black-knight.desc: The Black Knight is a deserted knight of the King's army. He lives deep in the swamps of Tibia and attacks every intruder of his sphere. Well-equipped, he is very strong in close combat and uses his spear for distance fighting.
black-knight.beh: The Black Knight fights with Melee and throws Spears when the enemy tries to escape.
black-knight.notes: He is a member of the TBI who turned the other way. "Commander of the Royal Army, assumed dead in the collapse of his unfinished home." Spawn cannot be blocked.
black-knight.strat: For Druids and Sorcerers this is a very hard creature to hunt, forget your Icicle and your Stalagmite runes here, since he is immune to Earth and Ice Damage. Since he's resistant to all other elements, the best you can do is to use Explosions or Physical Strikes. A basic strategy consists of the Knight blocking the Black Knight and Challenges it whenever it retargets, while the Druid/Sorcerer uses the above. But the most efficient duo-strategy to kill it faster would be a Knight blocking while a Paladin uses Divine Missiles. Not a good creature to do a fast hunt on since he takes quite some time to respawn (around 10 minutes with regards to the server state). It is possible for a Paladin to solo this creature at level 50. It is reccomended that you take either Royal Spears or Enchanted Spears and a good shield, though you should kill the Bonelords first to avoid mana drain. If you can, also kill the Scorpions too. This will dramatically increase your chances of succeeding.

black-sheep.name: Black Sheep
black-sheep.title: Black Sheep
black-sheep.loc: Femor Hills ( ), cultist cave in Liberty Bay ( ), Drefia
black-sheep.notes: They are the same as sheep, with the exception of their color. To tame this creature, use a Reins on it. For additional details, refer to the article on Black Sheep (Mount). By successfully taming the Black Sheep you will earn the achievement Little Ball of Wool.
black-sheep.strat: Just attack them, they are slow.

black-sphinx-acolyte.name: Black Sphinx Acolyte
black-sphinx-acolyte.title: Black Sphinx Acolyte
black-sphinx-acolyte.loc: Issavi Sewers, Kilmaresh Catacombs and Kilmaresh Mountains (above and under ground).
black-sphinx-acolyte.desc: The Black Sphinx Acolytes are working together with Priestesses Of The Wild Sun and Burning Gladiators.

black-vixen.name: Black Vixen
black-vixen.title: Black Vixen
black-vixen.loc: After an Earth Portal inside Cormaya's were-beasts cave, .
black-vixen.notes: It's a leader of the Werefoxes. Part of the
black-vixen.strat: Treat it like a stronger Werefox.

blazing-fire-elemental.name: Blazing Fire Elemental
blazing-fire-elemental.title: Blazing Fire Elemental
blazing-fire-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Sorcerer's part - Fire Sphere.
blazing-fire-elemental.beh: Like a normal Fire Elemental but a bit stronger.
blazing-fire-elemental.strat: Shoot from distance using Icicle Runes to kill it fast. For profit hunting Ice Strike is advised or luring a couple and using Avalanche Runes.

blemished-spawn.name: Blemished Spawn
blemished-spawn.title: Blemished Spawn
blemished-spawn.desc: The blemished spawn breeds in the most hostile and toxic environment to be encountered in the Tibian depths. The sulphurous chasms that are their habitat are rarely contested by other creatures so they can multiply in numbers that seem to concern even their masters below. The nests of the blemished spawns are often hit by exterminations by the forces of Those Below to keep their numbers somewhat in check. Seemingly some of the actions and expansions of Those Below in the past heavily disrupted the subterranean ecosystem and made the somewhat rare breed of chasm spawns an environmental hazard. It has yet to be seen how this hazard can be contained, if at all. With seemingly endless numbers of blemished spawns at hand, it seems obvious that some effort has to be put into turning them into a manageable army, else their presence on the battlefields would certainly be more prevalent. Still they are as unpredictable and destructive as the areas they use to dwell in. Only male specimens are taken into the hordes to prevent them from producing unmanageable offspring. In some rare occasions some blemished spawns are deployed in hostile territory to build colonies and multiply. In doing so…

blight-mariner.name: Blight Mariner
blight-mariner.title: Blight Mariner
blight-mariner.loc: Venore, by clicking on a painting
blight-mariner.notes: Part of the Between the Lines Quest.
blight-mariner.strat: When you enter the room, you’ll first face three Drowned Deck Hands, while the Blight Mariner waits on the ship in the northwest corner. Focus on killing the Deck Hands as quickly as possible—any damage dealt to the Blight Mariner while they are alive will instead heal him for 5000 HP. After about 10–15 seconds, the Blight Mariner will join the fight. If the Deck Hands are still alive, ignore the boss and continue killing them first. Once they’re defeated, switch to the Blight Mariner. You’ll only have a short window to damage him before he retreats back to the ship and summons three new Deck Hands. At this stage, stationary Blight Spitters will also begin spawning. These deal ranged damage but can mostly be ignored, as they don’t directly affect the boss fight. To minimize damage from the Blight Spitters, try to keep the Blight Mariner in the northern part of the room. Each cycle, more Blight Spitters will appear, so positioning becomes increasingly important. Tip: If you use hotkeys with the Battle List, consider sorting it in descending order by name. This will place the Drowned Deck Hands at the top and the Blight Mariner at the bottom, reducing the risk of accidentally…

blightwalker.name: Blightwalker
blightwalker.title: Blightwalker
blightwalker.loc: Pits of Inferno, Edron (In the Vats during The Inquisition Quest), Roshamuul Prison and Grounds of Undeath.
blightwalker.desc: The essence of death, plague and decay is indeed a powerful one as some demons quickly realised. They used their powers to gather this essence through their minions just like bees gather honey. Then they bound these disruptive powers into tangible shapes and added a little bit of demonic spirit. Filled with decay and a malicious will, the Blightwalkers were born. Whenever they find a way into the realms of the living, their steps are followed by death and decay. Everything fertile and healthy is considered as enemy and their dark instinct drives them to destroy and ruin everything they encounter. Even though demons often summon them as individuals to bring decay upon the ranks of their enemies, some enjoy to employ Blightwalkers as shock troops and footsoldiers of their armies.
blightwalker.notes: Blightwalkers are renowned minions of the demons who enjoy using those corrupted creatures as a shock troop in their army.
blightwalker.strat: Call a good Knight to block this monster. Use Explosions and Divine Missiles while killing this monster.

blistering-fire-elemental.name: Blistering Fire Elemental
blistering-fire-elemental.title: Blistering Fire Elemental

ab.r: on itself; it burns you (10 [[hp]]/17 turns for 170 damage total)

blistering-fire-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Sorcerer's part - Fire Sphere.
blistering-fire-elemental.strat: Run while staying diagonal to avoid beams. You can use either Exori Frigo or Icicles. Be careful with backspawns.

bloated-man-maggot.name: Bloated Man-Maggot
bloated-man-maggot.title: Bloated Man-Maggot
bloated-man-maggot.desc: It is an abomination that defies categorization, leaving observers uncertain whether it was once a humanoid being that became a hive of maggots or a blasphemous amalgamation of maggots cleverly bonded to mock a humanoid shape. The Bloated Man-Maggot is a grotesque entity, pulsating with a nauseating vitality. Thousands of wriggling maggots writhe and squirm within its bloated flesh, their insatiable hunger never sated. The stench of decay and the sickening sound of churning insects accompany its every movement. Despite its repulsive appearance, the Bloated Man-Maggot possesses a perverse strength, its misshapen limbs capable of delivering devastating blows. Those unfortunate enough to witness this abomination in combat are left with a haunting memory that lingers long after the encounter.

blood-beast.name: Blood Beast
blood-beast.title: Blood Beast
blood-beast.loc: Oramond/Southern Plains, Lower Rathleton, Oramond/Western Plains, Underground Glooth Factory, Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon
blood-beast.desc: Another phenomenon attributed to the infamous necromantic smog of Rathleton is the existence of the blood beast. As hideous and disgusting as these creatures are, the secret of their creation is even more disturbing.
