chayenne.strat: Trap her behind one of her summons and kill her fast.

cheeky-sugar-cube.name: Cheeky Sugar Cube
cheeky-sugar-cube.title: Cheeky Sugar Cube
cheeky-sugar-cube.notes: Part of the bossfight against Sugar Daddy. It was introduced on September 03, 2024 as a replacement for regular Sugar Cubes that doesn't yield any experience points.

cheese-thief.name: Cheese Thief
cheese-thief.title: Cheese Thief
cheese-thief.notes: Appears during the supply mission in A Pirate's Tail Quest.
cheese-thief.strat: Use a Helmet of the Deep to counter its drown damage. Just kill it.

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.title: Chicken
chicken.loc: Sabrehaven, Rookgaard, The McRonald's Farm in Thais, Northport, Fibula, Carlin (killable but unreachable), Greenshore, Krimhorn, Orc Fortress, Factory Quarter, also there's one in the farm near Edron.
chicken.desc: Chickens are domesticated animals that usually live on farms. Their eggs and their flesh makes them quite useful and neither the rumour of evil battle chickens nor the myth of a hidden town inhabited by talking chickens turned out to be true. Chickens have accompanied mankind and other races from the beginning and they have spread over the world as civilisation advanced.
chicken.beh: Normally, it walks around pecking at the ground, and tries to avoid players. When influenced, it follows players but, much like Dogs, does not attack them.
chicken.notes: Appeared in the Summer Update 2005. During Easter chickens also semi-rarely drop Blue, Green, Purple, Red and Yellow Coloured Eggs.
chicken.strat: Just attack them. If you're in Rookgaard's Premium Hunting Area, be prepared to face other Creatures like a snake or a spider.

chikhaton.name: Chikhaton
chikhaton.title: Chikhaton
chikhaton.loc: Edron, behind the portal , during the Rise of Devovorga World Quest. Can be fought on Vengoth during Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change.
chikhaton.beh: Chikhaton will focus on the enemy with the highest attack until it's death.
chikhaton.notes: All players who deal sufficient damage during the last minute of the fight will receive the Slayer of Chikhaton Achievement. One of its speeches, victis, is Latin for the word vanquished.

chizzoron-the-distorter.name: Chizzoron the Distorter
chizzoron-the-distorter.title: Chizzoron the Distorter
chizzoron-the-distorter.notes: He is a lizard boss which spawns with the 5 th message of the Orcs raid on Zzaion.

chocolate-blob.name: Chocolate Blob
chocolate-blob.title: Chocolate Blob
chocolate-blob.desc: Many Tibians may be familiar with the acid blob or death blob. Far fewer get to see the chocolate blob, although it is a much more delicious version of its slimy cousins. As the name suggests, it consists entirely of sweet, creamy chocolate. Although the chocolate in Candia melts less quickly than ordinary chocolate, it is not completely impervious to it either. When the summer sun shines particularly strongly on the tops of the chocolate mountains, they melt and the liquid chocolate drips down into the marzipan grass. There, chocolate blobs form, which from then on streak across the surface of Candia. However, they are harmless and, unlike other blobs, they do not attack unsuspecting hikers. Sometimes they retreat underground, into the vast chocolate mines, where they merge back into the mountains. Others eventually dive down into the cocoa lakes, where they liquefy and enrich these lakes with a fine nutty chocolate flavour.

choking-fear.name: Choking Fear
choking-fear.title: Choking Fear

ab.r: Poisons you starting from up to 45 hp per turn

choking-fear.loc: All over the surface of Upper Roshamuul and Nightmare Isles.
choking-fear.desc: Like a giant, gaunt goblin, cunning and swift-footed with slender, long arms that are fearfully strong, the Choking Fear searches for anything to throttle. It has no head, but loves to twist heads off. A Choking Fear will always chase after opponents, trying to get close, eager to have his long cold fingers around their necks. It enjoys the sound and feel of the dying and delights in feeling their death rattle. It is surmised that somewhere, in a dark prison cell, horrible pains and fears had been inflicted to the father of all Choking Fears, maddening him beyond belief until his rage took a ghastly form and he escaped. Any Choking Fear will always see all that breathes as its enemy, and chase them relentlessly while taunting them about their nearing end. Choking Fears love to tease and toy with their victims, prolonging their death; and they tie up their victims in their hemp ropes as a ghastly dangling trophy attached to high trees or roof beams.
choking-fear.beh: Chases the enemy and fights in close-combat. Rarely retargets.
choking-fear.strat: A rather annoying enemy, especially with their frequent partners, the Retching Horrors. Lower level and solo players may take advantage of their reluctance to run over Energy Fields, and lure them into a relatively empty area where you're less likely to get swarmed. Recommended for all vocations to use garlic necklace and protection from death attacks.

chopper.name: Chopper
chopper.title: Chopper
chopper.beh: Stays in close combat until the death.
chopper.notes: One of the Hive Bosses. Part of the War Against the Hive Quest
chopper.strat: Separate it from other monsters and simply kill it. It's not too strong alone.

cinder-wyrmling.name: Cinder Wyrmling
cinder-wyrmling.title: Cinder Wyrmling
cinder-wyrmling.desc: Cinder wyrmlings are small but dangerous dragons that are said to inhabit the volcanic regions of Tibia. Their scales are red-hot from the heat, and their breath is a stream of fire and sulfur. They are impetuous and unpredictable creatures that like to set fire to everything in their path. They are resistant to fire and heat and should be approached with extreme caution. It is said that lava flows through their veins and that they sleep in the depths of volcanoes, surrounded by mountains of gold and precious stones. They are said to be greedy and possessive, defending their territory with all their might. However, they are little more than a legend, as there are no reliable reports of cinder wyrmling sightings. They seem to appear only in fairy tales and stories.

clay-guardian.name: Clay Guardian
clay-guardian.title: Clay Guardian
clay-guardian.loc: Horestis Tomb, Middle Spike, Medusa Tower.
clay-guardian.desc: Clay Guardians are constructs like Stone Golems, yet stronger.
clay-guardian.beh: Fights in close range until death.

cliff-strider.name: Cliff Strider
cliff-strider.title: Cliff Strider
cliff-strider.desc: It is yet unknown if the Cliff Strider is some sort of elemental, a golem, an organic life-form, or a strange hybrid. Usually only encountered in the hottest places of the world, they were rarely seen in the past. Recently, though, there have been more and more sightings in the depths of Tibia. When they are encountered, they are usually in liaison with 'those below'. It can only be speculated what this means for the race as a whole. While they were formerly seen as some strange life-form that was only dangerous when it was disturbed in its unbearably hot and hostile living spaces, it is now speculated that the Cliff Striders are some form of cattle for 'those below' that are also commonly used in their wars as some kind of weapon. Still, there are relatively peaceful and territorial enclaves of Cliff Striders that seem to pose no threat to outward communities. In the light of the connection to 'those below' there are furious debates how to handle such known enclaves. While there are voices to eradicate them all before the enemy can employ them, the majority is still voting to monitor the situation and get more solid information before any preemptive action is taken.
cliff-strider.strat: Paladins planning on hunting these creatures should use Fire Wall Runes or Fire Bomb Runes and run around them while hitting the cliff striders with Crystalline Arrows.

cloak-of-terror.name: Cloak of Terror
cloak-of-terror.title: Cloak of Terror
cloak-of-terror.desc: The cloaks of terror are the remnants of demons that entered the realm of Zarganash just to be devoured and ripped to pieces by its inhabitants. Their demonic residue slowly remained trapped in the realm and over time mixed and fused with other soul fragments, ultimately forming a new, vile construct that once again roamed Zarganash as mindless force of hunger and destruction. The cloaks are predatory and mostly instinct driven beings that prey exclusively on the living. When no living being is present they roam wide areas in their mostly futile hunt for prey. Eventually they slow down considerably and fall into dormancy after some time. While dormant they meld into the environment and are almost undetectable. Their overall composition makes them an undesirable prey for other denizens of Zarganash and so they can spent their time in dormancy relatively save. How long it takes to let them slip into such a state is widely different and probably dependent on several factors. Yet it seems common that they gather at some spots before going into dormancy. If a living being, in theory a rare occurrence in Zarganash, enters their presence, they wake up almost simultaneously which is a…
cloak-of-terror.beh: Attacks from close range and moves very fast.
cloak-of-terror.notes: Cloaks of Terror are the creatures from Furious Crater that can trigger Goshnar's Taints. It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.
cloak-of-terror.strat: Be very careful when moving around the spawn as one extra creature can be very hard for the team to deal with. As a shooter, stay far from it to avoid being hit by its area attacks around itself.

clomp.name: Clomp
clomp.title: Clomp
clomp.desc: Clomps are large pachyderms bearing a resemblance to woolly rhinoceri. Their tall hunch is covered with small horns and a downright oversized horn is jutting out of their foreheads. Both adult males and females feature this horn, though not the newborn young. Besides fighting with it, a clomp uses its horn to scrape away mud in wallows, to pull down plants for eating, and to open paths through thick vegetation. Clomps form a variety of social groupings. Adult males are generally solitary, except for mating and fighting. Adult females are largely solitary when they are without calves. Mothers will stay close to their calves for up to four years after birth. Yet sometimes clomps congregate in small groups at salt licks and mud wallows. Salt licks are very important because of the essential nutrients the clomp receives from the salt - provided it's not the toxic salt of the dried seas and rivers which cover the entire peninsula of Krailos. The clomp is herbivorous, eating diverse plant species, especially their shoots, twigs, young foliage and fallen fruit. Clomps are the largest animals in Krailos, but although they are very strong and have a reputation for being tough, they are…
clomp.notes: They are used as a food source by the Ogres. Raw Meat can be obtained by skinning their corpse.
clomp.strat: The weakest creature on Krailos surface, but do not underestimate them as they do quite high damage and usually come at you in groups with Ogre Brutes, Ogre Savages and other Clomps. If you're hunting ogres using Field Runes, make sure you focus on these guys first as they will walk straight through them.

cobra.name: Cobra
cobra.title: Cobra
cobra.loc: Ankrahmun Library Tomb, Tarpit Tomb, Mountain Tomb, Peninsula Tomb, Darama, Tiquanda, Drefia, Forbidden Lands, Arena Quarter, Lion's Rock.
cobra.desc: The desert-creeping Cobra has become a symbol of assassination and venom throughout the world. Contrary to the slithery green snakes which dwell the swamps and in general prefer a moist surrounding, Cobras have well adapted to the dry and hostile environment of the desert. The silent killers usually prey on smaller animals and even insects, digging their bodies into a sandy dune until they are almost not visible anymore to the unaware eye. As soon as a potential victim passes by, the Cobra will perform a fast and surprising strike, injecting its highly dangerous poison into the prey. Usually only chasing for nurture, Cobras can be easily provoked or irritated and might consider any encounter a threat, fearlessly attacking everything regardless of its size. Although the tales of the fatality of its poison and its toughness are wildly exaggerated, they still pose a significant threat to all unaware wanderers and explorers.
cobra.notes: They are like Snakes but more dangerous. They are also summoned by Lizard Snakecharmers.
cobra.strat: Knights: just kill them. Mages and Paladins: kill them while they are far from you, because their Poisoning Spit is weaker than their Melee's Poison.

cobra-assassin.name: Cobra Assassin
cobra-assassin.title: Cobra Assassin
cobra-assassin.kind: Members of the Order of the Cobra
cobra-assassin.desc: When Scarlett Etzel turned towards the shadows, her loyal followers turned away from her. Her change in tactics and the more covert approach has led to the hiring of shady characters to reinforce the order. Cobra Assassins are tough and stealthy, their resilience most likely only matched by their cunning. They attack swiftly, hide in dark corners and could very well end a life before the victim would even realise its imminent fate. Through training and small dosages of snake poison, they are immune to numerous toxic substances.
cobra-assassin.strat: They are the most common creatures in the Cobra Bastion. Mages and paladins should avoid blocking them due to their high close-range damage.

cobra-scout.name: Cobra Scout
cobra-scout.title: Cobra Scout
cobra-scout.kind: Members of the Order of the Cobra
cobra-scout.desc: When Scarlett Etzel turned towards the shadows, her loyal followers turned away from her. Her change in tactics and the more covert approach has led to the hiring of shady characters to reinforce the order. Cobra Scouts are a vital backbone of Scarlett's forces. While they are often used for small errands and basic reconnaissance missions, their true purpose is to act as an extension of Scarlett's reach. They are sent out to all corners of the known world and receive their orders directly from her. They are often the first and probably last glimpse of the complex Cobra network for an outsider to witness.
cobra-scout.strat: Knights should use Chivalrous Challenge to bring them into melee range and kill them, while other vocations should keep moving as ranged creatures attack less often in these cases.

cobra-vizier.name: Cobra Vizier
cobra-vizier.title: Cobra Vizier
cobra-vizier.kind: Members of the Order of the Cobra

ab.r: 600-900; range of ~4 sqm; also chains to multiple players if they are within ~4 sqm on its target whenever Vizier receives any damage (~50% chance to trigger)

cobra-vizier.desc: When Scarlett Etzel turned towards the shadows, her loyal followers turned away from her. Her change in tactics and the more covert approach has led to the hiring of shady characters to reinforce the order. Any Cobra Vizier is a dangerous foe but in combination with other viziers, they become an unstoppable force of magic. They act as the real guard of the order and defend Scarlett and the other Cobras with an intricate web of spells. Their dark magic is arcane and twisted, to oppose them is to challenge mighty, long lost arts. Born in the shadows and nurtured by death.
cobra-vizier.strat: Try to stay at distance and do not lure more than a couple at your tank. Beware of its very strong parry chained attack - when running by or trapped by multiple Cobras it's wise not to attack them to avoid this spell.

coldheart.name: Coldheart
coldheart.title: Coldheart
coldheart.notes: One of the Isle of Strife Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

colerian-the-barbarian.name: Colerian the Barbarian
colerian-the-barbarian.title: Colerian the Barbarian
colerian-the-barbarian.notes: Greenhorn challenger. ← #4 Achad #5 Colerian the Barbarian #6 The Hairy One →
colerian-the-barbarian.strat: No strategy needed. Just kill it.

community-handler-2-0-ciphard.name: Community Handler 2.0 CipHard
community-handler-2-0-ciphard.title: Community Handler 2.0 CipHard
community-handler-2-0-ciphard.beh: Announced abilities: * - Turns into Community Handler 2.0 CipSoft * - Fear attack
community-handler-2-0-ciphard.notes: First seen during the Test Server for the Summer_Update_2020
community-handler-2-0-ciphard.strat: Don't attack it, it reflects most damages (ice, fire, energy, earth, death at 50%). Wait for it to turn into Community Handler 2.0 CipSoft. It walks quite slow making it easy to out run.

containment-machine.name: Containment Machine
containment-machine.title: Containment Machine
containment-machine.loc: The Orc Cult boss room under the Edron Orc Cave.
containment-machine.notes: It looks like a Strange Apparatus.
containment-machine.strat: Just kill it but be ready. Once it dies The Armored Voidborn will be released.

control-tower.name: Control Tower
control-tower.title: Control Tower
control-tower.loc: Second floor of the Underground Glooth Factory, south side.

converter.name: Converter
converter.title: Converter
converter.desc: The Converters are monstrous beings of living devouring energy, born from the darkest recesses of the fallen realm. Their existence is sustained by their insatiable appetite for various forms of life force, which they consume with an unsettling voracity. They appear as a swirling vortex of shadow and ethereal energy, constantly shifting and distorting as they draw in and assimilate the vital essence of their surroundings. The air crackles with malevolent energy in their presence, and the ambient light seems to dim as they grow stronger. The Converters serve as conduits of the fallen realm's power, transforming and channeling the life force they consume into a raw, corrupted energy that fuels the insidious workings of the decaying realm.

coral-frog.name: Coral Frog
coral-frog.title: Coral Frog
coral-frog.loc: Meriana, Laguna Islands, and other Shattered Isles.
coral-frog.notes: Very fast. The main danger here is when they come with other enemies (and other colored) frogs are fast enough to get to you first and break your shielding and leave you wide open to other monster's attacks.
coral-frog.strat: On the Laguna Islands, many types of frogs, tortoises, and toads can swarm you. Low level players may want to have GFBs to clear these swarms.

corrupt-naga.name: Corrupt Naga
corrupt-naga.title: Corrupt Naga
corrupt-naga.loc: Boss room of Timira the Many-Headed.

corrupted-ghost.name: Corrupted Ghost
corrupted-ghost.title: Corrupted Ghost
corrupted-ghost.notes: Drops different loot depending on the Vocation of the player who dealt the most damage.

corrupted-skeleton.name: Corrupted Skeleton
corrupted-skeleton.title: Corrupted Skeleton
corrupted-skeleton.loc: Corrupted Mines, Yalahar Cemetery Quarter ( and )
corrupted-skeleton.notes: Drops different loot depending on the Vocation of the player who dealt the most damage.

corrupted-soul.name: Corrupted Soul
corrupted-soul.title: Corrupted Soul
corrupted-soul.loc: Zao Temple Complex, with Dragonking Zyrtarch.
corrupted-soul.notes: When killed it will turn into a Vortex (Green), Vortex (Purple) or Vortex (Red). Part of the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.

corym-charlatan.name: Corym Charlatan
corym-charlatan.title: Corym Charlatan
corym-charlatan.loc: Venore Corym Cave, Tiquanda Corym Cave, Corym Black Market, Carlin Corym Cave/Dwarf Mines Diggers Depths Mine, Upper Spike.
corym-charlatan.desc: The Charlatans are the scouts and spies of the Corym. They are formidable diggers and unsurpassed in agility by any other Corym. They are able to crawl through even the smallest and most twisted tunnels, and reach places where other Corym can not go. As opportunity makes thieves, other races consider the Charlatans to be the worst of thieves, but by other Corym, they are held in regard as daring heroes. Their campfire stories are full of the exploits of the Charlatans, and detail how they outsmarted and outran their enemies. In combat, the Charlatans like to fight dirty. What they lack in strength they make up for in agility, and their attacks are often aimed at vulnerable spots and accompanied by feints, to catch their opponents off guard. The more Charlatans are involved in a fight to overpower an enemy, the bolder their attacks. Although they generally tend to be rather cowardly, most Charlatans are so convinced of the superiority of the numerous talismans and fetishes they wear that they will not back away even from a fight with more powerful opponents; and the Corym believe that through their talismans, a kind of supernatural power is bestowed upon them as well. They…
corym-charlatan.notes: Can often be found together with stronger Corym.
corym-charlatan.strat: Knights of level 20 with 60/60 skills and decent armor can fight up to 4 at a time using Wound Cleansing and Health Potions. Very similar to a Cyclops.

corym-skirmisher.name: Corym Skirmisher
corym-skirmisher.title: Corym Skirmisher
corym-skirmisher.loc: Venore Corym Cave, Tiquanda Corym Cave, Corym Black Market, Carlin Corym Cave/Dwarf Mines Diggers Depths Mine, Upper Spike.
corym-skirmisher.desc: The Skirmishers are the leaders, priests and oracles of the Corym. They divine the will of their gods, interpret omen and are responsible for the laws of the Corym civilisation. Oddly enough, the abilities of the Skirmishers are quite similar to that of others, regardless of whether they serve as justice squeakers, priests of their Snake God of Death, or mushroom-eating diviners of future events. They claim to gain knowledge by consuming books of all kind. Consuming here actually means eating the books. It is deemed a fact that a Skirmisher who has eaten a lot of books is more powerful than his brethren; but whether these two circumstances are truly linked to each other is still unknown. Skirmishers employ a lot of tricks that they claim are magic, together with simple forms of alchemy and medicine, and most notably poisons. It is verified that Skirmishers use a lot of alcohol to 'magically' make Corym warriors fearless and 'mighty'. It is the Skirmishers who create the numerous charms and fetishes that are highly prized by their kin; and given the superstition common throughout the Corym society, the superior status of the Skirmishers is absolutely undisputed. Admittedly only the…
corym-skirmisher.beh: Nothing special, behaviour similar to cyclops, rushes at you.
corym-skirmisher.notes: The identity of the second 'very rare' loot item remains unknown at this time.
corym-skirmisher.strat: They are usually in groups, corym skirmisher alone is weak, but in group they can hit hard with their melee, so be careful.

corym-vanguard.name: Corym Vanguard
corym-vanguard.title: Corym Vanguard
corym-vanguard.loc: Venore Corym Cave, Tiquanda Corym Cave, Corym Black Market, Carlin Corym Cave/Dwarf Mines Diggers Depths Mine, Upper Spike.
corym-vanguard.desc: The Vanguards are the gatherers, tinkerers and craftsmen of the Corym. Usually of a build somewhat more muscular and hardy than the regular Corym, they have many responsibilities in the Corym society. They are the guards that keep vigil over the den and all resources. They craft the crude but mean weaponry of the Corym, and repair stolen or found goods to render them suitable for Corym usage. Most importantly, certain Vanguards are responsible for keeping the slime tunnel system running. The slime tunnels are a well-kept secret of the Corym and work with specially prepared slime and swamp gases to provide long-range transport between remote Corym dens, in a way everyone else would consider rather disgusting as well as insanely dangerous. The gruesome accidents in the tunnel system are usually discarded as the failure of a charm the deceased, or crippled user had been wearing. There is nothing a Vanguard cannot put to good use. They collect all kinds of stuff, broken or new, and stockpile it for later use. It is a great disgrace for a Vanguard not to have something somewhere, for to at least temporally fix something or rather, everything - aside from their ordinary tasks, most…

cosmic-energy-prism-a.name: Cosmic Energy Prism A
cosmic-energy-prism-a.title: Cosmic Energy Prism A
cosmic-energy-prism-a.loc: Boss room ( ) accessible through Replica Dungeon and Energy Portal.
cosmic-energy-prism-a.notes: Appears with the boss Lloyd in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
cosmic-energy-prism-a.strat: They can only be killed one-by-one when Lloyd has been killed.

cosmic-energy-prism-b.name: Cosmic Energy Prism B
cosmic-energy-prism-b.title: Cosmic Energy Prism B
cosmic-energy-prism-b.loc: Boss room ( ) accessible through Replica Dungeon and Energy Portal.
cosmic-energy-prism-b.notes: Appears with the boss Lloyd in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
cosmic-energy-prism-b.strat: They can only be killed one-by-one when Lloyd has been killed.

cosmic-energy-prism-c.name: Cosmic Energy Prism C
cosmic-energy-prism-c.title: Cosmic Energy Prism C
cosmic-energy-prism-c.loc: Boss room ( ) accessible through Replica Dungeon and Energy Portal.
cosmic-energy-prism-c.notes: Appears with the boss Lloyd in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
cosmic-energy-prism-c.strat: They can only be killed one-by-one when Lloyd has been killed.

cosmic-energy-prism-d.name: Cosmic Energy Prism D
cosmic-energy-prism-d.title: Cosmic Energy Prism D
cosmic-energy-prism-d.loc: Boss room ( ) accessible through Replica Dungeon and Energy Portal.
cosmic-energy-prism-d.notes: Appears with the boss Lloyd in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
cosmic-energy-prism-d.strat: They can only be killed one-by-one when Lloyd has been killed.

count-tofifti.name: Count Tofifti
count-tofifti.title: Count Tofifti (Creature)
count-tofifti.notes: Appears during the Tibia's 15th Anniversary, in a raid at a random time once a day. A message will appear: "A mummy has appeared somewhere east of Grizzly Adams... start counting!" "The countdown to your death has started somewhere east of Grizzly Adams. Do you dare meet Count Tofifti?"
count-tofifti.strat: Get knights to surround him and kill him as fast as you can.

count-vlarkorth.name: Count Vlarkorth
count-vlarkorth.title: Count Vlarkorth
count-vlarkorth.loc: Under the Cemetery north of Edron.
count-vlarkorth.notes: It's one of the bosses of Grave Danger Quest.
count-vlarkorth.strat: Use Death Damage on the boss and Avalanches if you need to kill the summons. Make sure you keep the Soulless Minions away from the boss, otherwise it will heal too much and be very hard to kill. Twice during the fight, it will summon one Dark <vocation> for each player in the room. These must be killed and the respective vocation must use the corpse on Count Vlarkoth to make it vulnerable again. For example, a Druid must use the Good Remains of a Druid on the boss. Demon Skeletons can be summoned in the room to help trap the boss, since its only magical attack deals Fire Damage.

countess-sorrow.name: Countess Sorrow
countess-sorrow.title: Countess Sorrow
countess-sorrow.beh: Summons fast and hit slowly and usually doesn't do comboes. But, Countess Sorrow can send you and your team directly to the Temple in a blink of an eye.
countess-sorrow.strat: You can't hit this monster with Physical Damage. Mages must use Fire-Based Attacks and a Druid must heal the blocker always (Druids' elements are not necessary because Countess Sorrow is strong against Ice Damage and immune to Earth Damage).

courage-leech.name: Courage Leech
courage-leech.title: Courage Leech
courage-leech.desc: Courage leeches are not actual entities but an actual manifestation of a void that the loss of courage by the souls in Zarganash leaves behind. All the more does the animalistic intelligence that they display mock such origins. Yet as it was the realm of Zagarnash that gave birth to them, this fact might only be an expression of some cosmic law that makes everything in Zarganash a twisted mockery of sane expectations. The courage leech are not actually leeching courage but they poison their victim's soul with a numbing enchantment that makes their targets prone to their fearsome attacks. They carry desperation and fear like a disease they spread, albeit involuntarily. While their own intention is probably more mundane, the stealing of essence and the spread of inner corruption is what makes the leeches extremely dangerous, especially for the living. Even more disturbing is the fact, that even when someone survives their attacks or overcomes them, the attacks of the leeches leave a spiritual scaring on the soul that never truly recovers. The interpretation of such scaring differs wildly. The most common interpretation is, that the soul is actually damaged if not diseased and that…
courage-leech.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.
courage-leech.strat: Be very careful when moving around the spawn as one extra creature can be very hard for the team to deal with. As a shooter, stay far from it to avoid being hit by its area attacks around itself.

court-warlock.name: Court Warlock
court-warlock.title: Court Warlock
court-warlock.notes: Final boss of the The Order of the Stag Quest. Its cooldown can be reset by using a Twisted Marionette.

crab.name: Crab
crab.title: Crab
crab.loc: Arena and Zoo Quarter, Goroma, Edron, Port Hope, Nargor and other Shattered Isles. There is also one located underwater by The Tibianic, however it is unreachable.
crab.desc: Sailors often call the Crabs the 'knights of the sea', on the other hand, sailors drink plenty and no one should care much about what they have to say. In fact Crabs live on the beach or in the sea. Their natural armour is very thick and their pinchers are suited to crush shells. Obviously, Crabs are well prepared to defend themselves and they surely will if they feel threatened. Usually they try to scare away intruders from their territory, but they do not pursuit trespassers for long. The taste of their flesh is rather unusual but not bad, some call it even a delicacy.
crab.beh: They walk sideways, just like a real crab.
crab.notes: They travel quite fast and have decent attack. Their defense rather high for a creature of this level, so you may have trouble hitting them if your skills are low.

craban.name: Craban
craban.title: Craban (Creature)

ab.n: Blood bomb (summons Crabs and Blood Crabs)

craban.notes: Appears during the Tibia's 15th Anniversary, in a raid at a random time once a day. Before Craban appears, two messages are broadcast in white text to all players: "A harmless looking little crab has appeared in Stonehome. Don't trust it, citizens of Edron..." "Craban is visiting Stonehome - beware of Sudden Death!"

crape-man.name: Crape Man
crape-man.title: Crape Man
crape-man.desc: The crape men are one of the stranger creations of the mad Dr. Marrow. In fact several found failed specimens that have been discarded hint at a gruesome failure rate in their creation.Despite their misleading naming, there are individuals of both genders present, yet without a thorough medical examination it's impossible to tell them apart.Seemingly bred as a first line of defence in the ranks of his creatures, the crape men are stout and durable yet slow and dull.They lack most of the intelligence of their human parts and more often than not are below the average intelligence of gorillas. They have, however, a grasp on human language and can understand simple phrases. The creatures in itself are rather docile and passive, yet due to training their stoicism is usually overcome and they attack all presumed aggressors in a given area. The training of crab men is a slow and arduous process. Some of them prove to be untrainable at all and are often released into the wilds where most of them just starve to death as they seem to have little own drive to sustain themselves. The crape men have a love for the sea and despise the dwelling on land, yet their physiology is far better suited…

crawler.name: Crawler
crawler.title: Crawler
crawler.desc: The Crawler seems to be less specialised than its hive brethren. It has been observed that they fill in any role that is needed. They even change their given role so quickly sometimes that an observer might come to the conclusion that Crawlers could make decisions consciously. Still, this is disputed and it seems more likely that they are only extremely sensitive to the commands or needs of the hive. Be it as it may, the Crawler can be encountered in each part of the hive and on the battlefield. They fight less aggressive and more coordinated than their brethren, though, they lack somewhat the strength of the others. They are even known for their retreats in a battle, just to regroup and attack again. Crawlers are swift and seem never to get tired. Even in futile tasks, they will not give up. Their tireless persistence is one of their most notable traits. They seem to be able to exist for an incredible long time without any form of nourishment and are one of the few Hive Born that can operate a significant amount of time underwater. As allrounder, they often aid their brethren in battles and seem to be capable fighters on their own. Speed and effectiveness are the hallmarks of the…
crawler.strat: Similar to a Giant Spider, but somewhat weaker. Mages below level 40 avoid being too close to Crawlers as two can easily send a mage to temple.

crazed-beggar.name: Crazed Beggar
crazed-beggar.title: Crazed Beggar
crazed-beggar.loc: Factory, Foreigner, and Trade Quarters in Yalahar.
crazed-beggar.desc: Crazed Beggars are victims of disease, hunger and desperation. They have fled from their hopeless, dark lives into insanity. Their twisted vision and mind result from dangerous home-brewed alcohol and make them a threat to everybody, including themselves, when they roam the dark alleys of the cities they live in. They are neither impressive fighters nor do they have good equipment, but their madness gives their gaunt bodies frightening physical power and resilience. They become particularly dangerous to travellers when they appear in a group led by an invisible hand. Even though, an adventurer might rather want to mourn these pitiful beings, he will quickly raise his weapon when he is attacked with sticks, clubs, stones and teeth. Regardless of their own safety and with the fury of a madman, they might not pose a real threat to an experienced fighter, but their attacks can be fatal for an ordinary citizen. In their few sane moments, they travel much, so they can be encountered almost everywhere. Some cultures, which are usually hostile towards humans, praise Crazed Beggars as blessed beings. In rare cases, it has also been reported that one of them started to see his madness as…
crazed-beggar.beh: Will not run in low health.
crazed-beggar.notes: May be found alone or with other creatures throughout its quarter.
crazed-beggar.strat: Kill it like you would kill a Wild Warrior.

crazed-dwarf.name: Crazed Dwarf
crazed-dwarf.title: Crazed Dwarf
crazed-dwarf.notes: A weak Dwarf that spawns among Muglex Clan Assassin Goblins, Lesser Fire Devils, Wasps, Spiders, Dwarf Miners, and others. Unlike regular Dwarves, they don't seem to drop Copper Shields but do drop Plate Shields.
crazed-dwarf.strat: Just kill it, but be mindful of its high defense. Clear the area beforehand and avoid running into monsters, especially Lesser Fire Devils.

crazed-summer-rearguard.name: Crazed Summer Rearguard
crazed-summer-rearguard.title: Crazed Summer Rearguard
crazed-summer-rearguard.desc: The dream-born are a reclusive race of creatures that are shrouded in mystery. Only recent events led to a contact that shed some light on these peculiar beings. There seem to be two distinctively different kinds of dream-born, that align themselves with either the winter or the summer. Though there are conflicting reports about that alignment, the current theory is that there are two rivaling courts exists though it's still possible that there is just one court that changes in accordance to the seasons. In the few recorded encounters, the dream-born claimed to live in realms that their god created with his dreams. Given their obvious kinship to the common elves it's of course far more likely that they are just descendants of elves that fled the godwars into some kind of pocket dimension. They usually shun outsiders and rarely leave their own realm at all. What little information could be gathered about them suggests a lifestyle akin that of the other elves, though they seem to lack a cast system and have a feudal oriented society. Due to their isolation they developed odd quirks like the overemphasising of seasons, that hints at a primitive, animistic world-view. It's still…
crazed-summer-rearguard.strat: They are the weakest of the dreamelves, but can still be dangerous in groups. Use Ice Damage and Physical Damage.

crazed-summer-vanguard.name: Crazed Summer Vanguard
crazed-summer-vanguard.title: Crazed Summer Vanguard
crazed-summer-vanguard.desc: The dream-born are a reclusive race of creatures that are shrouded in mystery. Only recent events led to a contact that shed some light on these peculiar beings. There seem to be two distinctively different kinds of dream-born, that align themselves with either the winter or the summer. Though there are conflicting reports about that alignment, the current theory is that there are two rivaling courts exists though it's still possible that there is just one court that changes in accordance to the seasons. In the few recorded encounters, the dream-born claimed to live in realms that their god created with his dreams. Given their obvious kinship to the common elves it's of course far more likely that they are just descendants of elves that fled the godwars into some kind of pocket dimension. They usually shun outsiders and rarely leave their own realm at all. What little information could be gathered about them suggests a lifestyle akin that of the other elves, though they seem to lack a cast system and have a feudal oriented society. Due to their isolation they developed odd quirks like the overemphasising of seasons, that hints at a primitive, animistic world-view. It's still…
crazed-summer-vanguard.beh: Chases its target and does not retarget often.
crazed-summer-vanguard.strat: Stay at distance if you can to avoid its strong melee and berserk attacks.

crazed-winter-rearguard.name: Crazed Winter Rearguard
crazed-winter-rearguard.title: Crazed Winter Rearguard
crazed-winter-rearguard.desc: The dream-born are a reclusive race of creatures that are shrouded in mystery. Only recent events led to a contact that shed some light on these peculiar beings. There seem to be two distinctively different kinds of dream-born, that align themselves with either the winter or the summer. Though there are conflicting reports about that alignment, the current theory is that there are two rivaling courts exists though it's still possible that there is just one court that changes in accordance to the seasons. In the few recorded encounters, the dream-born claimed to live in realms that their god created with his dreams. Given their obvious kinship to the common elves it's of course far more likely that they are just descendants of elves that fled the godwars into some kind of pocket dimension. They usually shun outsiders and rarely leave their own realm at all. Due to their isolation they developed odd quirks like the overemphasising of seasons, that hints at a primitive, animistic world-view. It's still…
crazed-winter-rearguard.strat: They are easier to hunt in teams than their Summer counterparts since they don't walk over fields. Take advantage of their huge Fire Damage weakness and use as much of this element as you can.

crazed-winter-vanguard.name: Crazed Winter Vanguard
crazed-winter-vanguard.title: Crazed Winter Vanguard
crazed-winter-vanguard.desc: The dream-born are a reclusive race of creatures that are shrouded in mystery. Only recent events led to a contact that shed some light on these peculiar beings. crazed-winter-vanguard.strat: They are easier to hunt in teams than their Summer counterparts since they don't walk over fields. Take advantage of their huge Fire Damage weakness and use as much of this element as you can.

cream-blob.name: Cream Blob
cream-blob.title: Cream Blob
cream-blob.desc: Among the inhabitants of Candia, the cream blobs are the least busy and prefer to indulge in idleness. They like to wander through the Peppermint forests or lie on the sand of the vanilla sugar beaches on the shores of the Blueberry or Moon Melon Sea. Sometimes, however, they can be persuaded to help the truffles decorate their cakes or donate a portion of cream for the fruit drops who are working with the ice cream machine.

creepy-crawler.name: Creepy Crawler
creepy-crawler.title: Creepy Crawler
creepy-crawler.desc: The Creepy Crawler embodies everything unsettling about necromantic craft. It scuttles low to the ground on four limbs, its horned skull thrust forward, its maw bristling with jagged teeth. The way it moves, sudden, raking bursts of speed followed by unnerving stillness, unsettles even hardened adventurers. Unusually for undead, they are impulsive, prone to break free of control, and roam the world untethered, perhaps as a consequence of their generally unstable nature.

crimson-frog.name: Crimson Frog
crimson-frog.title: Crimson Frog
crimson-frog.loc: Meriana, Laguna Islands, and other Shattered Isles.
crimson-frog.notes: Very fast. The main danger here is when they come with other enemies (and other colored) frogs are fast enough to get to you first and break your shielding and leave you wide open to other monster's attacks.
crimson-frog.strat: On the Laguna Islands, many types of frogs, tortoises, and toads can swarm you. Low level players may want to have GFBs to clear these swarms.

crocodile.name: Crocodile
crocodile.title: Crocodile
crocodile.loc: In the crocodile cave and the jungle east of Port Hope as well as the swamp to the north, Fenrock, Arena and Zoo Quarter, Trade Quarter, Talahu, also located on Meriana and Laguna Islands.
crocodile.desc: Crocodiles lurk in the murky waters of swamps or lie seemingly lazy at the shores of rivers and seas. They are astonishing agile when they are catching their prey though, and many were misled by their otherwise slow motions. The strength of their jaws is incredible and they hunt animals much larger than themselves with ease. For hours they can wait motionlessly for the unwary to approach and then to strike at complete surprise. If they manage to catch some mammal in water, there is almost no escape. On land, their claws and their thick scale skin makes it an impressive fighter and a threat to everything alive. You are advised to stay away from shores or to go there only with utmost caution.
crocodile.beh: These creatures will push or kill weaker monsters to get to their target.
crocodile.notes: A fairly good source of food and drops the very popular Crocodile Boots. You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face The Snapper.
crocodile.strat: Just attack them, but remember that they can deal good damage if you have 3 or more on you.

crusader.name: Crusader
crusader.title: Crusader
crusader.desc: The crusaders are the minions of the sinister Sir Leonard, once noble knights who served the light but have now fallen into darkness. They are a mixture of human, lion, and dragon, perhaps created by dark magic, by spells that Sir Leonard found in an abandoned library of Ferumbras. Their leonine lower bodies are muscular and powerful, armed with sharp claws, while their human upper bodies are clad in shining armor. The strongest among them even have dragon wings. These elite crusaders serve Sir Leonard as his personal bodyguards. While they were once protectors of the common people, since their corruption they have become proud and brutal, despising those weaker than themselves. They are dark villains who turn fairy tales into horror stories. But of course, these are just stories from an old book.

crusader-guardian.name: Crusader Guardian
crusader-guardian.title: Crusader Guardian
crusader-guardian.notes: Summoned by Sir Leonard. Similar to a regular Crusader.

crustacea-gigantica.name: Crustacea Gigantica
crustacea-gigantica.title: Crustacea Gigantica
crustacea-gigantica.loc: Calassa ( and [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 125.110-127.228-12-2-1-1 here]), Treasure Island ([http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 125.183,128.172,9,4,1,1 here]), Seacrest Grounds ( , , , and ). In the Seacrest Grounds the spawns are Varying Monster Spawns in which the common creature is an Abyssal Calamary. The chance to spawn a Crustacea Gigantica seems to be around 1%-2%.
crustacea-gigantica.desc: The discovery of the Crustacea Gigantica came to the scientific community like a thunderbolt. A creature like that was not even assumed to exist. Neither did it match any description of mythical creatures. All the more it is astonishing that considering their formerly unknown status sightings of Crustaceae Giganticae have become more and more common nowadays. These dwellers of the deep seem to leave their ancient habitats for unknown reasons and seek new areas to live in. Given the warlike nature of the Crustacea Gigantica it is somewhat unsettling to think what might have driven them away from their old realms. As of today, there are no valid theories about this occurrence, and although the quara are often mentioned as a possible cause, it seems more likely that the real cause is a new threat that lurks in the depths of the ocean. The Crustacea Gigantica itself is not necessarily destructive but very territorial. When something enters their habitat, the simple-minded beasts distinguish only between food and robber. Both are to be eliminated by their powerful pincers. Their armoured shell serves for more than adequate defence in such cases.
crustacea-gigantica.beh: Attacks with melee, uses Ice Strike and Ice Wave.
crustacea-gigantica.notes: Crustacea Gigantica are a semi-rare spawn in wet and sunken areas. You can tame them using a Giant Shrimp.

crypt-construct.name: Crypt Construct
crypt-construct.title: Crypt Construct
crypt-construct.desc: The Crypt Construct is a horrific parody of once regal strength, its massive humanoid frame crowned with the undersized skull of a horned, cattle-like race that has long since vanished from the world. The grotesque mismatch of body and head makes it all the more horrifying, an image of brute force twisted into mockery by some necromantic mind. Sickly green energy leaks from its joints, trailing like fumes of decay as it lumbers forward, hungering for any living thing to devour.

crypt-defiler.name: Crypt Defiler
crypt-defiler.title: Crypt Defiler
crypt-defiler.desc: Only a few grave robbers live to see the day to get the renown and experience needed to be known as crypt defilers. Most members of their trade die soon by traps, ancient guardians of the tombs or blades of adventurers. Only those cunning and tough enough to survive those perils become the dreaded and despised crypt defilers. They have gathered a meagre fortune to be able to afford better armor and weaponry and some of them even learned to turn the parts of buried creatures into toxins. They are responsible for leading bands of grave robbers out of their customary regions and finance expeditions to seek fortune in far lands. It is due to their dubious courtesy that parties of grave robbers can be encountered almost everywhere in the known world. They and their henchmen are often drawn to a newly discovered crypt like flies to a cadaver. Though some of the crypt defilers are in the employment of eccentric collectors or dealers of stolen goods, most of them are just unscrupulous thieves. Some of them have learned that strength comes in numbers and band together for a common goal, often employing a bunch of less experienced grave robbers. Such alliances usually don't last for long…
crypt-defiler.notes: Slightly stronger version of a Nomad.

crypt-fiend.name: Crypt Fiend
crypt-fiend.title: Crypt Fiend
crypt-fiend.desc: Few secrets of ancient necromancy are darker than the creation of Crypt Fiends, only possible through bargains with entities beyond the veil. Their hulking frames bristle with jagged, horn-like protrusions and are crowned with skulls marked by jutting tusks. They exude malice, a palpable aura of evil and a tangible hatred that clings to the air and corrodes the will of the living. Their attacks are brutal, their resilience formidable, and their very presence inspires dread. The method of their creation has long been lost, known only to the eldest bonelords. Some believe it required the sacrifice of entire tribes to forge even a single Crypt Fiend. When one appears, it is a sure sign that the soil has been disturbed by the most forbidden rites. Even among the undead, these creatures are seen as aberrations, feared weapons whose loyalty lies not with their summoner, but with the pulse of undeath itself. Disturbingly, some believed lost to the ages have endured the ravages of time, entombed in stone and buried in cursed ground, waiting to be unearthed by the foolish, the desperate or the damned, that disturb their unholy slumber.

crypt-mage.name: Crypt Mage
crypt-mage.title: Crypt Mage
crypt-mage.desc: Few bone constructs unsettle the soul like Crypt Mages, whose twisted frames echo with remnants of true sorcery. The bones chosen for their assembly once belonged to creatures of great magical power, and fragments of that arcane strength remain bound within. Their hollow eye sockets flicker with sickly green sparks, as if haunted by lingering spells, their skeletal fingers twitch as if still weaving mystical signs. They cast not with studied discipline but with a feral instinct, the primal reflex of a predator that has learned to claw with unholy power.

crypt-shambler.name: Crypt Shambler
crypt-shambler.title: Crypt Shambler
crypt-shambler.loc: Ankrahmun Tombs, Trapwood, Ramoa, Hellgate, Helheim, Mount Sternum Undead Cave, Deeper Catacombs, Cemetery Quarter, Treasure Island, Upper Spike, Lion's Rock, Forgotten Tomb.
crypt-shambler.desc: For a long time it was believed that the Crypt Shambler was a mere myth, and even though today most scholars agree that this undead abomination exists, little else is known about it. A common theory holds that Crypt Shamblers are created from the bodies of lesser necromancers and death cultists who were turned into undead creatures while they were still alive! Although this theory remains unconfirmed, it would help to explain the burning rage that seems to be a common trait of all Crypt Shamblers. Whatever the truth, Crypt Shamblers are dangerous undead that far exceed many other undead in power and ferocity.
crypt-shambler.notes: Very slow, similar to Demon Skeletons, but weaker. Elder Bonelords and Enlightened of the Cult summon these.

crypt-warden.name: Crypt Warden
crypt-warden.title: Crypt Warden
crypt-warden.desc: Crypt Wardens are more aggressive than common Lamassus.

crypt-warrior.name: Crypt Warrior
crypt-warrior.title: Crypt Warrior
crypt-warrior.beh: Fights in close combat until death.
crypt-warrior.strat: Treat it as a weaker Skeleton Elite Warrior.

crystal-spider.name: Crystal Spider
crystal-spider.title: Crystal Spider
crystal-spider.loc: Atop of the Formorgar Glacier and deep inside Formorgar Mines, Frost Dragon Tunnel, Ice Witch Temple, Nibelor Ice Cave, the Crystal Caves in The Inquisition Quest, Mushroom Gardens, Crystal Gardens.
crystal-spider.desc: Crystal Spiders are a rare breed. Just like the frost dragons, the Crystal Spiders are also the results of a transformation, probably being descendants of Giant Spiders. However, the Crystal Spider was affected much more heavily than the frost dragon. Its body drastically changed to a crystalline or rather icy consistence, emitting an enormous cold. Its spiderwebs are not made of silk but of concentrated ice which is extremely cold. The cold alone is sufficient to freeze most creatures to the web which therefore does not need a gluey coating. The poison of the spider is like an injection of pure ice. It painfully freezes the flesh and numbs the extremities. The good resistance to cold that many creatures on the Ice Islands possess makes such advantage, however, redundant. For this reason, Crystal Spiders have specialised in hunting warm blooded creatures that are susceptible to their special abilities. This includes humans, elves and dwarfs. It is unknown if Crystal Spiders can survive in warmer climates. If they were able to adapt to warmer environment where much more prey is available that is susceptible to their attacks, they would easily spread through the lands like a plague.
crystal-spider.beh: Crystal spiders chase their enemy down and fight until death. Changes target frequently.
crystal-spider.notes: They are similar to Giant Spiders, but have less attack power and more defense. You should be careful with them since they're found most of the time in groups and in small places, also they paralyze you very often, making it hard to keep distance. Since Summer Update 2010, crystal spiders drop Jewelled Backpacks. You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face The Bloodweb.
crystal-spider.strat: Watch your step! They are located in smaller areas along with Wyverns, Ice Golems and other Crystal Spiders, so you may have trouble outrunning them. Strike hard and fast with a Knight blocking and have Paladins or Mages attacking with offensive spells to dispatch it quickly. Soloing them on a Knight can be risky. Mages should use exori vis and while druids should use a death rod, sorcerers should use an energy wand. Keep in mind they are similar to Giant Spiders but use weaker melee attacks and paralyze, so running them is not needed. Paladins should keep distance and use Ethereal Spear to kill them quicker therefore lowering the risk of running into other spawns.

crystal-wolf.name: Crystal Wolf
crystal-wolf.title: Crystal Wolf
crystal-wolf.notes: This elusive creature can only be spotted during the Mini World Change known as the Thornfire World Change. To transform it into a majestic Crystal Wolf, you must skillfully lure a Thornfire Wolf to the sacred grounds of the Bog Temple. To tame this creature, use a Diapason on it. For additional details, refer to the article on Crystal Wolf (Mount). By successfully taming the Crystal Wolf you will earn the achievement The Right Tone.
crystal-wolf.strat: Stay diagonal to avoid the wave attacks.

crystalcrusher.name: Crystalcrusher
crystalcrusher.title: Crystalcrusher
crystalcrusher.loc: Crystal Grounds, Mushroom Farms, Middle Spike.
crystalcrusher.desc: The Crystalcrusher is more commonly known as 'Gembane' since it seems to be magically drawn towards cut gems, which are their favourite diet. It is not known by which means they can find cut gems or why they would specialise on a food resource that cannot to be found in nature. It is probable that this fondness is connected to crystal resonances and light reflection, though even the masters of these arts, the gnomes, cannot tell for sure how these factors influence the crystalcrushers' hunger or even their life cycles. On their constant search for new food, they often settle for other minerals in lack of greater amounts of cut gems. It seems that the crystals are used in the digestive system of the creature to pulverise other minerals. Given the Crystalcrusher's appetite, such digestive gems are used up quite fast which might explain its constant search for more gems and crystals. On their hunt they usually see everything either as food or competition for food and become quite dangerous.
crystalcrusher.beh: Crystalcrushers prefer to fight in close combat.
crystalcrusher.notes: Part of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

cublarc-the-plunderer.name: Cublarc the Plunderer
cublarc-the-plunderer.title: Cublarc the Plunderer
cublarc-the-plunderer.loc: Spawns randomly and during 3 different raids: * When orcs are invading Zzaion, it spawns near the gate. * During the Orc raid at the steppe, it spawns first , then and finally after 5, 18 and 30 of the raid announcement. * During an unannounced, small raid around .
cublarc-the-plunderer.beh: It behaves in the same way as an Orc Marauder.
cublarc-the-plunderer.notes: Appears during raids on Zzaion and the steppe.
cublarc-the-plunderer.strat: Be careful when facing this creature because it spawns with many others. The strategy is the same as an Orc Marauder. Remember that they only appear during a raid so kill it fast, make sure you have enough supplies with you because the real problem are the Orc Marauders that appear with him. Try not to lure the other orcs or you may die quickly.

cult-believer.name: Cult Believer
cult-believer.title: Cult Believer
cult-believer.desc: The Cult Believer is a stronger version of Adepts Of The Cult.
cult-believer.strat: They are not very hard and die rather quickly, treat them like a weaker Vicious Squire.

cult-enforcer.name: Cult Enforcer
cult-enforcer.title: Cult Enforcer
cult-enforcer.desc: The Cult Enforcer is a stronger version of Adepts Of The Cult.
cult-enforcer.strat: Treat it like a Vicious Squire.

cult-scholar.name: Cult Scholar
cult-scholar.title: Cult Scholar
cult-scholar.desc: The Cult Scholar is a stronger version of Adepts Of The Cult.
cult-scholar.strat: Avoid standing in front of it because of its strong beam.

cunning-werepanther.name: Cunning Werepanther
cunning-werepanther.title: Cunning Werepanther
cunning-werepanther.desc: Werepanthers are humans under a curse - others claim infected with a disease - that causes them to transform into savage beasts. At the beginning, the transformation only takes place at full moon, and the victim regains its human appearance the next morning. In the course of time, the transformation lasts longer and the full moon is no longer a necessary condition for the transformation. At a certain point, the beast takes over more and more often. Werepanthers are quick and agile, but not as tough and strong as the weretigers. They are cunning predators and their appearance is a mix between a panther and a human being. Like panthers, Werepanthers favour warm jungles as their homesteads and are smart and adaptable. It is believed that werepanthers whose fur has a bluish hue are even more cunning than their black-furred counterparts.

cursed-ape.name: Cursed Ape
cursed-ape.title: Cursed Ape
cursed-ape.desc: Cursed warrior apes rumoured to dwell deep in the Tiquandan jungles. Said to be kin to the Kongra, they hide in the darkness of the jungle and attack from the shadows. Freed from the shackles of feelings like pain and compassion yet filled with insufferable rage, they hunt and kill their prey with furious might. With the origins of their curse unknown and the consequence of an encounter with them most certainly death, it is impossible to determine whether this bane could actually be lifted.

cursed-book.name: Cursed Book
cursed-book.title: Cursed Book
cursed-book.desc: Though some potent books can gain consciousness and sentience on their own, this fiendish creature is created by botched attempts to read them and harness their power. Sometimes wannabe magicians try their luck on spells way out of their league with typically dramatic consequences. Most such misfortunes lead to the untimely death of the vain caster in spectacular fashion, sometimes, however, it happens that some lesser demon is partly summoned and melts into the book containing the spell by absorbing the life force of the unfortunate reader. Such demon-book conglomerates can become enormously powerful by harnessing the knowledge contained in the book, demonic forces and whatever might be left of the casters memories and fractured soul. For their raw power and potential but also for their contained knowledge, such cursed books are hunted down by Zathroths librarians and bookkeepers and dragged away to some sinister place of forbidden knowledge. There they are trained, their skills honed and they become part of Zathroth's collection and serve as his guardian dogs to protect other secrets. Perhaps because of the way of their unwilling creation, cursed books feel nothing but spite,…

cursed-gladiator.name: Cursed Gladiator
cursed-gladiator.title: Cursed Gladiator
cursed-gladiator.notes: Greenhorn challenger. ← #8 Rocky #9 Cursed Gladiator #10 Orcus the Cruel →
cursed-gladiator.strat: Run around it shooting wand/rod/distance weapon as it's very slow. Knights melee it, if you see that it go slow, help yourself with HMMs. After fight, remember to refill hp and mana before last arena boss.

cursed-prospector.name: Cursed Prospector
cursed-prospector.title: Cursed Prospector

ab.r: 500; 1125 or 1687; depending on the distance from the center of the attack
500-600; also chains to multiple players if they are within ~4 sqm on its target whenever Prospector receives any [[Parry]]-like damage ;around 50% chance to trigger

cursed-prospector.desc: Long deceased miners, cursed to roam the hollows of drifts and mines. Some of them humble and diligent in life, others greedy and ungrateful until death and beyond. They are ghost-like creatures with devious attacks and tend to call for the aid of other ghosts when in distress.
cursed-prospector.notes: These are the only creatures known to have an area spell that deals different damage depending on the target's distance from the center of the attack, its Energy Ball attack. The target at the center of the spell always receives 500 base damage, those right adjacent to the target receive 225% of that (1125 base damage) and those at the edge of the spell receive 337,5% damage (1687).
cursed-prospector.strat: Prospectors aren't worth killing for experience or loot, but some players may want to kill them for their bestiary. In those cases, you must be extremely careful with their energy ball attacks which can deal massive combos to players near the attack's target, as described above.

custodian.name: Custodian
custodian.title: Custodian
custodian.kind: Members of the Order of the Cobra
custodian.notes: It is an Order of the Cobra boss, and part of the Grave Danger Quest. Its respawn time is directly related to the Cart Packed with Gold. The impact is confirmed via community tests, but the specifics are still unknown: it seems the cart reaching end of the tunnel or being destroyed is a prerequisite for the respawn timer of Custodian to start counting.

cyclops.name: Cyclops
cyclops.title: Cyclops
cyclops.loc: Plains of Havoc, Mount Sternum, Femor Hills, Cyclops Camp, Cyclopolis, Ancient Temple, Shadowthorn, Orc Fort, Mistrock, Foreigner Quarter, Outlaw Camp and in the Cyclops version of the Forsaken Mine.
cyclops.desc: Cyclopes are a human-like race but with only one eye and minor intelligence. They even talk in a similar language. They live in holes where they prospect for gold and other metals. Be warned that they get very angry about adventurers entering their claim. They will slay every intruder using their incredible power.
cyclops.beh: A cyclops will retarget to other players in their vicinity. They kill weaker creatures and move items that are in their way, therefore items are not effective in blocking their path.
cyclops.notes: Cyclops are strong and giant creatures, also believed to be skillful in metallurgy. As rendered in Tibia, they appear to have 4 toes on one foot and 3 toes on the other.

cyclops-drone.name: Cyclops Drone
cyclops-drone.title: Cyclops Drone
cyclops-drone.loc: Cyclopolis, Mount Sternum, Mistrock and in the Cyclops version of the Forsaken Mine.
cyclops-drone.desc: The so-called Cyclops Drones are the workers among the cyclops society. They are born physically different from their kin. The most prominent feature of a Cyclops Drone are its four muscular arms. They are stronger and more persistent than the ordinary cyclops, though they lack considerably on intelligence. They are usually calm, but their fellow cyclopes train and condition them in order to ensure that their passive attitude changes quickly when facing one of the 'lesser' races. Conditioned Cyclops Drones usually attack on sight. Fortunately, they hardly seem to understand what they are doing and therefore rarely use the full strength of their imposing arms. Still, the sheer force of a thoughtless blow can crush bones and break weapons and armour. Cyclops Drones are not numerous, and as they are also not much valued among the cyclops, they are usually found deep underground working under supervision of other cyclops.
cyclops-drone.beh: Cyclops drones have strong melee and distance attacks. They can throw boulders even off screen.
cyclops-drone.notes: A subspecies of cyclops with four arms. Judging from the rocks that they carry, they are the workers of cyclops society.

cyclops-smith.name: Cyclops Smith
cyclops-smith.title: Cyclops Smith
cyclops-smith.loc: Cyclopolis second floor and below, Mistrock, Mount Sternum, Cyclops Camp second floor and in the Cyclops version of the Forsaken Mine.
cyclops-smith.desc: The Cyclops Smiths are somehow the nobility amongst the cyclops. Cyclops praise those skilled in the art of blacksmithing the same way as humans praise great artists. Although cyclops work usually lacks refinement and is rather functional than pretty, the wares of the Cyclops Smiths are in great demand of all other races. All cyclops, with the exception of the simple-minded drones, are constantly trying to enhance their smithing skill. It's the aim of all cyclops to be recognised by their society as master smith. Of course being the cream of the crop is not achieved easily, and the cyclops never grant this prestigious title thoughtlessly.
cyclops-smith.beh: Cyclops Smiths have strong melee and distance attacks. They also make you drunk quite often.
cyclops-smith.notes: They are the artisans and weaponsmiths of their race. They can easily be identified by the distinctive blue mohawk on their heads.

cyclursus.name: Cyclursus
cyclursus.title: Cyclursus
cyclursus.desc: Grotesque and ancient, the Cyclursus is an amalgam of beast and relic, fused by necromantic design. It lumbers forward on four powerful limbs, its body crowned by a single horned cyclopean skull. This unholy visage is enough to break the resolve of weaker foes, but the danger does not end at close quarters. Its horn pulses with volatile necromantic force, unleashing blasts that strike with the fury that rivals that of its bone-shattering charge.

damage-resonance.name: Damage Resonance
damage-resonance.title: Damage Resonance
damage-resonance.beh: It stays at a distance. Spawns with 4 Sparks of Destruction. When a Damage Resonance spawns, any damage dealt to Rupture will heal Rupture for 5000 hitpoints.
damage-resonance.notes: Appears when Rupture is damaged a certain amount of hitpoint. It may spawn multiple times.
damage-resonance.strat: It is important for all members of the team to not use any utori spells on Rupture. Also recommend all member to stop attack right away when the Damage Resonance spawns. A clear indication of that is when Spark of Destruction spawn.

damaged-crystal-golem.name: Damaged Crystal Golem
damaged-crystal-golem.title: Damaged Crystal Golem
damaged-crystal-golem.strat: Ignore them or just kill them.

damaged-worker-golem.name: Damaged Worker Golem
damaged-worker-golem.title: Damaged Worker Golem
damaged-worker-golem.strat: Paladins: Just run from them and shoot, they are pretty weak and should go down quickly for any paladin with 50+ distance. Mages: Attack with energy strike and avoid getting surrounded. Knights: Just attack them, they are weak. They are good to train with on higher skills.

damned-soul.name: Damned Soul
damned-soul.title: Damned Soul
damned-soul.loc: Grounds of Damnation in Shulgrax's room.
damned-soul.notes: Apppears in the Ferumbras' Ascension Quest with Shulgrax.
damned-soul.strat: Kill them and use the Purified Soul on the nearby Sin Devourers.

darakan-the-executioner.name: Darakan the Executioner
darakan-the-executioner.title: Darakan the Executioner
darakan-the-executioner.notes: Is the boss of Warlord level Pit #2. Next #3.
darakan-the-executioner.strat: To all vocations you don't need to be diagonal with this monster. Druid and Sorcerer: Use Magic Shield and SD or just Flame Strike and heal. Knight: Melee and Exori. Paladin: Shoot and Ethereal Spear.

dark-apprentice.name: Dark Apprentice
dark-apprentice.title: Dark Apprentice
dark-apprentice.loc: Magician Tower, Dark Cathedral, Hero Cave, Magician Quarter
dark-apprentice.desc: Some of the fallen dark magicians take their apprentices with them when being cast out of the magic orders. Others take apprentices later to have compliant henchmen at their disposal. The Dark Apprentices are nothing than a shadow of their masters who greedily hide their secrets and only share small parts of their knowledge if there is no choice. Kept in line by the promise to gain forbidden knowledge and parts of their master's power, they are just as scrupulous as their masters. Sometimes a dark magician has several apprentices and enjoys their rivalry for his attention. This way, the Dark Apprentices usually focus their scheming minds on other apprentices instead on their master. Being constantly treated badly by their masters, they use every opportunity to demonstrate their own malice over other beings. Usually more ambitious than competent, they are minor threats only. However, several apprentices that are trying to support and impress their master can still be fatal for badly prepared adventurers though.
dark-apprentice.notes: New creature in the Winter Update 2007. They seem to be a parody of low level Sorcerers. Note that if they turn you into a cyclops or a broom they will cancel your invisibility and dismount you.
dark-apprentice.strat: Be sure to kill the Dark Magicians first when they are together. Consider them as a stronger bandit. As a knight, you can kill one with skills 55/55.

dark-carnisylvan.name: Dark Carnisylvan
dark-carnisylvan.title: Dark Carnisylvan
dark-carnisylvan.desc: Carnisylvans were once humans, exposed to a dark ritual at birth they unwillingly abandoned their former lives to morph into tree-like shadow beings. Some time after coming of age they wander away to fall into a neverending slumber deep underground. Standing in pitch-black darkness, sleeping still, dreaming quaint dreams of death they await the time of joint uprising. Some are born to be chosen custodians of their siblings, awake and sentient. Dark carnisylvans are tainted by corrupted magic and try to enchant their victims with bizarre spells. It is not easy to escape the clutches of a dark carnisylvan as most of its spells are also instantly affecting the mind.

dark-faun.name: Dark Faun
dark-faun.title: Dark Faun
dark-faun.desc: Dark Fauns are stronger and more aggressive than common Fauns.
dark-faun.notes: They live underground and only show up on the surface during the night.
dark-faun.strat: Avoid its melee hit, which is a Dark Faun's strongest attack and can easily combo a level 200 mage if more than one is present.

dark-magician.name: Dark Magician
dark-magician.title: Dark Magician
dark-magician.loc: Hero Cave (Edron), Magician Tower, Dark Cathedral and Yalahar Academy of Magic in Magician Quarter and a single one on The Witches' Cliff (only accessible during a quest).
dark-magician.desc: The road of sorcery has led many to great wisdom and power. Others have left the way that the magician orders have aspired. Fallen victim to the misuse of their magical powers for personal and selfish goals, those magicians have turned their backs on their fellow sorcerers and tread forbidden paths to acquire more and more power. Some magicians are pursuers of the dark arts of sorcery right from the beginning of their career, others became Dark Magicians by looking for revenge or sometimes only survival after being cast out by the magic orders. Still, knowing that they are magically gifted and thus feeling superior to humanity and ordinary mortals, the Dark Magicians carve their own niches in existence. They can be found in hidden caves as well as in ruins or remote hideouts. Although usually loners, they sometimes have minions to help them with their evil schemes or serve themselves under the rule of a more powerful being. In the service of some scrupulous leader or for their own good, they pursue sinister researches and projects. In their aspiration for power, they often meet their death by the hands of more skilled adventurers. Only a few of the Dark Magicians have what it…
dark-magician.beh: Will try to keep a distance from opponents while using a variety of spells.
dark-magician.notes: New creature in the Winter Update 2007. They are often found with other Dark Magicians, Dark Apprentices and Mad Scientists. They seem to be a parody of high level Sorcerers.
dark-magician.strat: Kill them fast to reduce the damage done to you.

dark-merudri.name: Dark Merudri
dark-merudri.title: Dark Merudri
dark-merudri.loc: Under the Cemetery north of Edron, with Count Vlarkorth.
dark-merudri.notes: It becomes Good Remains of a Merudri when it dies. They appear in the fight against Count Vlarkorth during the Grave Danger Quest.

dark-monk.name: Dark Monk
dark-monk.title: Dark Monk
dark-monk.loc: Dark Cathedral, Vandura (Cult Cave), Foreigner Quarter.
dark-monk.desc: There are several monks that lost faith or were lured to the dark side, but the Dark Monks form an own secret order whose goals lie in the shadow. Not much is known about their agenda or where they have come from. The official brotherhoods of monks deny any knowledge about this special order. It is commonly assumed that Dark Monks serve some evil power since they react hostile to most people and attack them on sight. Their fighting style clearly indicates a training in martial arts and they even use a small array of spells of which some, like draining of life-force, point to a darker purpose of their order.
dark-monk.beh: Dark Monks will fight to the death.
dark-monk.notes: Be careful. They often appear in groups or with other creatures so you may find yourself surrounded quickly. A level 96 knight or level 38 paladin will have enough mana to convince these to train with on Open PvP worlds.
dark-monk.strat: Practice caution. Running into a spawn can get you easily surrounded. Move slowly and lure monsters out at a time to keep things easy. When you're comfortable with the spawn you can use a Great Fireball rune a couple times. GFB is also a good way to free yourself from a swarm. They heal like regular Monks so act quickly or you will end up wasting a lot of runes or mana.

dark-torturer.name: Dark Torturer
dark-torturer.title: Dark Torturer
dark-torturer.loc: Pits of Inferno, Vengoth, Blood Halls, Oramond Dungeon, Oramond Fury Dungeon, Roshamuul Prison, Grounds of Damnation and Halls of Ascension.
dark-torturer.desc: Dark Torturers are distant relatives of the diabolic imps. Like all members of the imp family, they enjoy pain and havoc they wreak upon other creatures. Their physical abilities exceed by far those of their cousins, the diabolic imps. Since they lack the magical affinity of the latter, those creatures tend to sell their services to more powerful demons or even some malicious mortals. Given their somewhat lazy and cowardly nature, they prefer to take up the roles of jailers and torturers. There they can indulge their malicious instincts without risking too much in open warfare. Those disgusting qualities have earned this race the fitting name Dark Torturer in the vernacular.
dark-torturer.beh: They will try to get in melee contact with you. They run in low health, but be careful even then, as they can deal out 800~ combos while running away from you.
dark-torturer.notes: It is a relative of the Diabolic Imp. The Dark Torturer's boss is Mr. Punish located in Tafariel's throne room.
dark-torturer.strat: Run from them and try to shoot them before they catch up with you. They can hit quite hard in close combat.

darkfang.name: Darkfang
darkfang.title: Darkfang
darkfang.loc: After a teleport inside Edron's were-beasts cave.
darkfang.notes: It's a leader of the Werewolves. Part of the
darkfang.strat: Treat it like a stronger Werewolf.

darklight-construct.name: Darklight Construct
darklight-construct.title: Darklight Construct
darklight-construct.desc: As the decay of the fallen realm takes hold of living things, the corrupting influence of the Darklight extends its reach to unliving entities. Stones and crystals, once dormant and lifeless, become animated by the unholy fusion of darkness and light. The Darklight Constructs stand as twisted embodiments of this corrupted union, their forms bearing the scars of their transformation. Veins of pulsating, malevolent energy traverse their stony bodies, emanating an eerie glow that casts haunting shadows in their wake. These constructs, infused with an unholy sentience, wield their newfound powers with an unsettling grace, becoming relentless agents of destruction under the influence of the darklight's corruptive touch.

darklight-emitter.name: Darklight Emitter
darklight-emitter.title: Darklight Emitter
darklight-emitter.desc: Opposing its unholy brethren, the Darklight Constructs, the Darklight Emitters possess a unique ability, they do not absorb light but emit darklight. These twisted entities pulse with an unholy radiance, emanating waves of corrupted energy that cast sinister shadows on their surroundings. Some speculate that they are connected to the constructs in an abominable symbiotic relationship, serving as catalysts for the darklight's corruptive powers. The Darklight Emitters stand as beacons of malevolence, their presence instilling a profound sense of unease and foreboding in those unfortunate enough to encounter them.

darklight-matter.name: Darklight Matter
darklight-matter.title: Darklight Matter
darklight-matter.desc: A mass of living unlight, the Darklight Matter is a writhing entity pulsating with corrupted energy. It is an aberration, formed from the merging of darkness and light in the fallen realm. Dark tendrils writhe and coil within its form, as if reaching out to snuff out any remaining traces of illumination. The Darklight Matter emanates an aura of suppressed power, drawing in the surrounding shadows and distorting the fabric of reality. Its mere presence causes disturbances in the natural flow of energy, leaving a trail of darkness and corruption wherever it ventures. To encounter the Darklight Matter is to confront a living paradox, an entity birthed from the very essence of the fallen realm.

darklight-source.name: Darklight Source
darklight-source.title: Darklight Source
darklight-source.desc: The Darklight Sources are malignant constructs of darklight and stone, unlike their mindless brethren, possessing a palpable hatred for the truly living beings that venture into the fallen realm. These abominations pulse with a malefic energy, their crystalline forms infused with the corrupted essence of the darklight.
