They stand as guardians of the realm's twisted secrets, channeling the decaying energy to unleash devastating attacks upon any perceived intruders. The Darklight Sources radiate an aura of malevolence, casting an eerie glow that illuminates their surroundings with an unholy light. The air crackles with suppressed power in their presence, as if the very fabric of reality recoils from their dark influence. To confront a Darklight Source is to face an entity fueled by hatred and dark intent, a testament to the fallen realm's malevolent nature.

darklight-striker.name: Darklight Striker
darklight-striker.title: Darklight Striker
darklight-striker.desc: The Darklight Striker is a creature formed of rock and unlight, bound to an unstable existence that defies conventional understanding. Legends speak of these elusive entities dispersing at random, only to reform in another location, leaving observers puzzled by their enigmatic nature. Darklight pulses within their core, resonating with chaotic energy, and their stony exteriors are etched with jagged cracks, hinting at the volatile forces contained within. The Darklight Strikers move with an unnatural grace, their movements accompanied by discharges of dark energy that crackle and writhe. Their attacks are swift and devastating, as they harness the destructive potential of the darklight to unleash a barrage of ethereal assaults upon their foes. While accounts of their transient nature persist, the true nature of the Darklight Strikers remains shrouded in mystery, leaving those who encounter them in awe of their enigmatic existence.

dawn-bat.name: Dawn Bat
dawn-bat.title: Dawn Bat
dawn-bat.notes: Usually found in small groups with other creatures. They look the same as bats. Unlike bats, dawn bats do not drop Bat Wings.
dawn-bat.strat: Just attack them. They are a bit stronger than rats.

dawn-scorpion.name: Dawn Scorpion
dawn-scorpion.title: Dawn Scorpion
dawn-scorpion.notes: They are a weak Scorpion. The Dawn Scorpion has considerably weaker poison in comparison, making them a lot more manageable. They can be found with the Minotaurs in the Dawnport Crystal Dungeon.

dawnfire-asura.name: Dawnfire Asura
dawnfire-asura.title: Dawnfire Asura
dawnfire-asura.desc: Asuri are demonic creatures who usually hide their true face and appear in the form of beautiful women. Though they can take different shapes they favour a seductive appearance, for example in the form of young dancers. These demonesses are driven mainly by greed and envy. They enter the mortal world because they begrudge humans and other peoples their vigour, beauty and happiness. They seek to destroy positive feelings as love, contentment and mirth, because herefrom they gain their energy. An asura especially stalks men she regards as handsome and happy. These victims are lured into gorgeous palaces full of riches and conveniences, inhabited by several asuri. There they ensnare the men with amusements such as wine, music, dance and intoxicating substances that indulge their senses and make them submissive and weak-willed. Then the asuri divest them of vitality and beauty. When an asura gets weary of her victim or if captives unexpectedly oppose the demonesses, these unfortunates come to know the true face of the palace: As the asuri show a beautiful face outwardly and are in truth terrible demons, likewise the palace, behind its marvelous veneer, is full of prison cells, torture…
dawnfire-asura.beh: Tends to stay diagonally positioned relative to you, often causing beams to miss.
dawnfire-asura.strat: Always wear a Dwarven Ring when fighting them; otherwise, you'll be heavily affected by Drunkenness. Do not underestimate these creatures, as they deal strong physical damage and often appear in large groups.

dazed-leaf-golem.name: Dazed Leaf Golem
dazed-leaf-golem.title: Dazed Leaf Golem
dazed-leaf-golem.beh: When it spawns, it moves slowly around the room before falling asleep and staying still.
dazed-leaf-golem.notes: Part of The Secret Library Quest.

deadeye-devious.name: Deadeye Devious
deadeye-devious.title: Deadeye Devious
deadeye-devious.loc: Just outside the south exit of the Liberty Bay depot. Task Boss -
deadeye-devious.notes: Responsible for raiding the Liberty Bay depot in some raids. You get a chance to kill him in the Killing in the Name of... Quest after killing 3000 pirates for Raymond Striker. The teleporter is located [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 124.233-128.85-1-4-1-1 here].
deadeye-devious.strat: GFB's are a must - the amount of pirates that swarm this area is phenomenal. So try and pick them off and weaken Deadeye at the same time. Try Magic Shield and running in and out of the depot - or up and down stairs.

death-blob.name: Death Blob
death-blob.title: Death Blob
death-blob.loc: Alchemist Quarter, Drefia, Razachai, Souleater Mountains, Northern Zao Plantations and Raging Mage tower.
death-blob.desc: The Death Blob is the undead version of the well-known green slime. While the green slime is constantly absorbing living things as a source of food, the Death Blob is less picky in this matter. It devours everything that comes into contact with it. Death Blobs are even able to dissolve harder materials using its gastric juices. Death Blobs arise out of green slimes. In the course of centuries, a green slime tends to eat quite a lot of negative energy which usually comes in form of cursed objects, undead material, demonic remains and other sources. This negative energy slowly poisons the slime up to the point where the ordinary green slime turns into a black undead slime, consisting of a huge amount of negative energy. The undead characteristics make the Death Blob quite a strong opponent. Although it has quite some power and extra abilities, it seems to be driven by its primitive instincts and only aims to destroy everything in its way.
death-blob.beh: Like a Slime, it advances towards its prey and will attempt to overwhelm them by Summoning more Death Blobs.
death-blob.strat: Kill it like a Slime. Be wary of geting surrounded by its Summons, especially if the Death Blobs with other creatures (Bog Raiders, Mutated Tigers, etc). Although one Death Blob can be defeated easily by most adventurers, the combined damage of its Summons and the potential creatures with it can be a potential free trip to the temple.

death-dragon.name: Death Dragon
death-dragon.title: Death Dragon
death-dragon.notes: Apppears in the Ferumbras' Ascension Quest with Ragiaz.
death-dragon.strat: Every time you kill one, another appear, try to trap them in north.

death-priest-shargon.name: Death Priest Shargon
death-priest-shargon.title: Death Priest Shargon
death-priest-shargon.notes: He is part of the Dark Trails Quest.
death-priest-shargon.strat: It is extremely important to kill the Lesser Death Minions first, before they become stronger. Also, although one would expect items that provide protection from Death Damage such as Koshei's Ancient Amulet to be useful against Shargon, extra attention is recommended as such items will increase the holy damage taken from both the dazzled status and the holy wave. It is strongly recommended to not use Wild Growth or Magic Walls because if you do so, the boss will disappear and summon around 20-30 Death Reapers.

deathbine.name: Deathbine
deathbine.title: Deathbine
deathbine.beh: It will try to get close by paralyzing you, in order to attack with its earth and melee attacks.
deathbine.notes: Carniphila's boss. Part of the Paw and Fur Society tasks of Grizzly Adams. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
deathbine.strat: Just treat it like a somewhat stronger Carniphila.

deathbringer.name: Deathbringer
deathbringer.title: Deathbringer
deathbringer.notes: The boss of Warlord Level, Pit #9. Next #10.
deathbringer.strat: To all vocations: stay diagonal and watch out when doing attacks like Exori or Ethereal Spear as you may get exhausted and unable to heal so make sure your hit points is full before using those attacks. Druid and Sorcerer: Use Magic Shield and try to shoot Heavy Magic Missile runes or Energy Strikes since it's weak against that element, Energy Beam deals great damage but it's dangerous as you stand on the way and vulnerable to waves. Bringing some Stone Skin Amulets might be handy. Using an Energy Wall and run over it to make Deathbringer run around is a good strategy (also works for paladins). But be careful: Deathbringer takes a lot of time to kill for mages and don't let your mana low. Knight: Melee and use Whirlwind Throw (makes you waste more potions) or Fierce Berserk. Paladin: Shoot Assassin Stars and Divine Missile.

deathling-scout.name: Deathling Scout
deathling-scout.title: Deathling Scout
deathling-scout.loc: Ancient Ancestorial Grounds, Deathling Menace, Sunken Temple
deathling-scout.desc: Deathlings or elder deeplings are precursors to the current breed of Njey. With their fish-like appearance but an upright walk, both share a lot of features. Their origin has not been sufficiently studied and they were a mere myth to the younger Njey. Until they appeared on various sites all over Tibia - even on the surface. They once walked the surface in times long past and inherited their will to conquer the world to their descendants. It is unclear how their reappearance on this world came to be. What is in fact clear is that they have similar goals as the younger deeplings yet they are deadlier and more aggressive than anything that crawled out of the sea before them.
deathling-scout.beh: Their shout means "defy the light!" and means "Death!".
deathling-scout.strat: Shooters should stay a few tiles away from them to avoid their area attacks which are used often. Be careful when around them as these creatures can deal strong combos and surprise even high level players.

deathling-spellsinger.name: Deathling Spellsinger
deathling-spellsinger.title: Deathling Spellsinger
deathling-spellsinger.loc: Ancient Ancestorial Grounds and Sunken Temple.
deathling-spellsinger.desc: Deathlings or elder deeplings are precursors to the current breed of Njey. With their fish-like appearance but an upright walk, both share a lot of features. Their origin has not been sufficiently studied and they were a mere myth to the younger Njey. Spellsingers are versatile casters with an array of devastating spells. Compared with the weaker Njey siblings they are far more dangerous, even if faced alone. This old breed of spell-singing horrors has perfected their magic and enhances their powerful spells with ancient wisdom of the original Njey.
deathling-spellsinger.beh: They fight in close combat and do not retarget very often.
deathling-spellsinger.strat: If possible, avoid staying in front of them because of their strong Holy Beam. Be careful when around them as these creatures can deal strong combos and surprise even high level players.

deathslicer.name: Deathslicer
deathslicer.title: Deathslicer
deathslicer.loc: Deep in Tarpit Tomb, Formorgar Mines during Ghazbaran's raid.
deathslicer.beh: Deathslicers will get as close as possible to you, attacking with its strong Melee and heavy Energy-Based Spells.
deathslicer.notes: Deathslicers are immune to all known damage types that players can attack with. However, if someone manages to kill one of them, it will respawn immediately after dieing. Note that they are pushable.
deathslicer.strat: Use a stronger monster such as a Demon to destroy it, when it's trapped. You can push it.

deathspawn.name: Deathspawn
deathspawn.title: Deathspawn
deathspawn.loc: Annihilon's Ward on The Inquisition Quest.
deathspawn.beh: They are summoned by the Hell Holes and will attack whoever is closest to it. It usually attacks first whoever is on the sides of the lavahole, if no one is on the sides it will attack whoever stands diagonally, if no one stands diagonally it will attack whoever is closest to the north of the lavahole(to be confirmed)?
deathspawn.notes: They are summoned by Hell Holes in the Annihilon's Ward on The Inquisition Quest.
deathspawn.strat: Try to keep using area runes to kill them off when killing Annihilon. Use Fire Bomb on self, and as long as you don't move and stand in the middle of the fire, it can't reach you.

deathstrike.name: Deathstrike
deathstrike.title: Deathstrike
deathstrike.beh: Heals and goes invisible very often.
deathstrike.notes: He is an overgrown Stone Devourer.
deathstrike.strat: Trap him in a corner and have your team shower him with Sudden Death Runes. Sorcerers should rotate energy beams & waves, along with sudden deaths. It is recommended to bring a team with 10 players at least. Good tip is for druid and sorcerer to do summon of fire elemental and fire devil for some more damage.

deep-terror.name: Deep Terror
deep-terror.title: Deep Terror
deep-terror.loc: His lair in the Underground Glooth Factory in Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon
deep-terror.beh: Retargets to whoever deals the most damage.
deep-terror.notes: It is the first boss you will encounter during the Hero of Rathleton Quest. It will spawn when you kill the four Tentacles of the Deep Terror on the quest. Like the other bosses, you will not loot anything unless you have first slain Professor Maxxen. Thus you will not loot anything on the first kill. After entering and triggering the raid, players need to wait around 10 minutes before being able to enter its room again.
deep-terror.strat: Trap it with knights and wild growth runes so that it cannot reach the shooters. All shooters should use their strongest spells to bring it down as fast as possible since it heals a lot and you have only 10 minutes in the boss room.

deepling-brawler.name: Deepling Brawler
deepling-brawler.title: Deepling Brawler
deepling-brawler.beh: You can block this creature's respawn.
deepling-brawler.notes: This creature is the strongest version of a Deepling Worker. It will often combo its autoattack with its spear attack to combo its foes.
deepling-brawler.strat: Treat them as you'd treat a slightly stronger Deepling Worker. While they often combo their attacks like other deeplings, the fact that they are way weaker than the Deepling Warriors you find on the way to their lair makes them unremarkable.

deepling-elite.name: Deepling Elite
deepling-elite.title: Deepling Elite
deepling-elite.beh: Deepling Elites are stronger Deepling Warriors.
deepling-elite.strat: Treat it like a stronger Deepling Warrior. Beware of the aforementioned Warriors, Deepling Spellsingers and Deepling Guards that might be near.

deepling-guard.name: Deepling Guard
deepling-guard.title: Deepling Guard
deepling-guard.loc: Fiehonja. During Deeplings stage 1 around 10 spawns exist ( , , , , 2 , , and 2 . Also may spawn during the gemcutting mission (anywhere )). Many more spawns in almost all areas of Deepling stage 2 and 3.
deepling-guard.desc: Ever watchful, these defenders of the God King Qjell are members of a higher caste within the Deepling society. From their earliest days, the purpose of the Deepling Guards lies in the protection of the temple cities and inner sanctums of God King Qjell. They are cunning hunters and powerful fighters with unmatched endurance, feared by even the fiercest creatures of Tibia's seas.
deepling-guard.beh: Deepling guards are fast. They will try to fight in close-combat while shooting spears from a distance. Guards have a somewhat unique retargeting behavior in that they do not move around players in the way to their target, but they do not immediately attack the obstructing player either. In this way, they will stand by the obstructing player and continue to throw spears at their target - and nobody will receive melee damage. The only ways to force a guard to attack you are by the use of Challenge or by having the target leave the guard's sight.
deepling-guard.notes: Killing Deepling guards will contribute to the progression of the Deepling world change during stage 1. Killing 1 Deepling guard will count for 1 point (200 needed) until 100 points have been contributed.
deepling-guard.strat: Treat them as you would treat a behemoth; although they have less health, their attacks strongly resemble those of a behemoth. Try to single them out and avoid third-hitting Deepling guards. Beware that they come with Deepling Spellsingers which drain your mana and reduce your skills immensely; focus on the spellsingers before the guards (especially for knights and paladins). Mages and paladins should try to keep a distance from the guard but avoid running in uncleared areas, as they come in large groups with other Deeplings. Don't let it run as it has strong healing capabilities. In group hunts, shooters should be wary of a Deepling guard's retargeting behavior and expect to heal often as their spears can cause considerable damage.

deepling-master-librarian.name: Deepling Master Librarian
deepling-master-librarian.title: Deepling Master Librarian
deepling-master-librarian.beh: Same as a Deepling Spellsinger. It gains advantage in battle by weakening its opponent.
deepling-master-librarian.notes: Stronger version of the Deepling Spellsinger. Their wave is less sprite-saturated than the one shown while hovering the mouse pointer on the attack.
deepling-master-librarian.strat: Kill it quickly before any other Deepling, just as you would for a Deepling Spellsinger. Its skill reduction will render you helpless and its mana drain will make you incapable of healing.

deepling-scout.name: Deepling Scout
deepling-scout.title: Deepling Scout
deepling-scout.loc: Fiehonja, Sunken Mines (inside of Pick 'N Shovel Mine, ).
deepling-scout.desc: The Deepling Scouts are an ancient race. It is not known how old they are exactly or when the first Deepling Scouts emerged from the depths of Tibia's seas. There are no known records of these creatures so far and the first sightings were reported only recently. Usually inhabiting the very depths of the world, it seems their number grew significantly over the years and at some time, they started ascending. It is currently unknown when or why this ascent started. As of now, their origin is shrouded in mystery.
deepling-scout.beh: They try to stay in melee range and combo his normal hit with their water spear often.
deepling-scout.notes: If you kill 300 Deepling Scouts, you will earn the achievement Invader of the Deep.
deepling-scout.strat: Be prepared to use some health potions or healing spell, they can do significant combos when facing more than 3 at a time since the Water Spear will go through your shielding. Knights and Paladins can easily kill them, they are similar to Cyclops but with distance attack. However, skills 70/70 and strong equipment are needed if you plan to hunt them. Mages should use earth/energy strike to kill.

deepling-spellsinger.name: Deepling Spellsinger
deepling-spellsinger.title: Deepling Spellsinger
deepling-spellsinger.desc: The Deepling Spellsingers were once members of the priest caste. They were the librarians of the greatest treasure of the Deeplings - their amazingly vast knowledge and rich culture. Their turn to violence could be the result of the recent call to arms that made most members of the higher castes abandon their temples and obligations. They are also the keepers of most secrets of the forsaken Drowned Library. However, their vast knowledge of the workings of magic and the labyrinthine caves of the deep make them formidable foes who are not likely to part easily with their sacraments.
deepling-spellsinger.beh: They can spam the earth hit with the meele reduction ability at ths same time.
deepling-spellsinger.notes: Visually, their ice wave sprites are less saturated, but they share the shape of sorcerers' Energy Wave and druids's Terra Wave. You gain the achievement Death Song by killing 300 Deepling Spellsingers.
deepling-spellsinger.strat: Kill them before you focus on other Deeplings. Despite their health, they are threatening because of their skillset - strong manadrain and harsh skill reduction will make killing large groups difficult and expensive.

deepling-tyrant.name: Deepling Tyrant
deepling-tyrant.title: Deepling Tyrant
deepling-tyrant.beh: Almost exactly the same as a Deepling Guard, though it moves faster and deals more damage with each of its attacks.
deepling-tyrant.notes: One of the elite deepling forces, along Deepling Master Librarian and Deepling Elite. The tyrant drops the same loot as a Deepling Guard (including Foxtail) although the drop rate for rares is slightly higher to accommodate the boosted health and strength of the tyrant. There are only 8 tyrant spawns in-game.
deepling-tyrant.strat: Treat it as you would a Deepling Guard. Be aware that the tyrant has more than 2.5x the health of a deepling guard so the battle will inevitably be longer.

deepling-warrior.name: Deepling Warrior
deepling-warrior.title: Deepling Warrior
deepling-warrior.desc: The Deepling Warriors of the Njey are born with the fire of both suns in their hearts. Fierce and fearful creatures, prepared to squash all enemies of Qjell, they emerged from the depths. An event not so long ago drew their attention to the surface. Currently, they gather somewhere beneath the island of Quirefang.
deepling-warrior.beh: Uses Whirlwind Throw very often. When gets close to you, it will use both of its attacks simultaneously.
deepling-warrior.notes: You gain the Depth Dwellers achievement by killing 300 Deepling Warriors.
deepling-warrior.strat: Knights with level 90 and skills around 90/90 can kill these, but hunting them would be a waste. Sorcerers and Druids can kill them easily with their Wand/Rod and Energy Strike or Terra Strike. Be careful not to be surrounded as they have very high physical burst and 2 of them in melee range can easily kill a mage from full HP. If you have to face many at at time, try to hit all of them with Terra Wave/Energy Wave. If you don't have have room to run, energy/poison bombs and walls can be used to protect yourself from hordes. Since they have relatively low HP, a Energy/Terra Wave followed by Rage of the Skies/Wrath of Nature is usually enough to kill them in a pinch.

deepling-worker.name: Deepling Worker
deepling-worker.title: Deepling Worker
deepling-worker.loc: Deepling Temple Complex, Hatchery, Fiehonja soul net area ( ), coral mine ( ).
deepling-worker.desc: Once members of the lowest castes, these Deeplings mostly work in the mines of the deep. Forging the weapons of their masters and delving deeper and deeper in the ice-cold stone of the deep, they are the backbone of the arising Deepling war machine. Before the great uprising, the tasks of the Deepling Workers consisted of tending to the spawn, raising the Deepling offspring and maintaining a constant supply of food. Members of the lower castes are suppressed by higher ranked Deeplings and forced to labour. This "constraint" is not to be taken literally, however, as each member knows its place in society and usually shows contentment with its fate.
deepling-worker.strat: Just kill it or ignore it.

deepsea-blood-crab.name: Deepsea Blood Crab
deepsea-blood-crab.title: Deepsea Blood Crab
deepsea-blood-crab.loc: Oramond, Sea Serpent Area, Seacrest Grounds, Drefia ( ). There is also one under Rookgaard Academy, however it is unreachable.
deepsea-blood-crab.beh: A deepsea blood crab rarely retargets.
deepsea-blood-crab.notes: There are 2 types of blood crabs - the ones that live on land and the ones that live underwater. The ones that live on land usually spawn with other turtles around. The underwater ones also hit slightly harder. These creatures are frequently hunted for their Bloody Pincers, a key component in two popular Imbuements: Intricate Vampirism and Powerful Vampirism.
deepsea-blood-crab.strat: Knights should just melee. Paladins should use a one-handed weapon (such as royal spears or enchanted spears) and a shield. Mages should use a wand/rod that does energy or death damage and exori vis. All vocations should avoid getting surrounded.

deepworm.name: Deepworm
deepworm.title: Deepworm
deepworm.desc: The while the tiny fungusworm is a common pest in the underground, that is destructive for fungus farms but easily repelled, the fifty times bigger deepworm with its ravenous appetite for even living beings is an entirely different matter. Gnomes tend to exterminate all fungus worm populations entirely, not only for the damage they could cause on fungus farms but for the fear they might be a younger state of evolvement of the deepworm. Though every research end evidence has disproven this theory, the typical gnomish mushroom farmer will take no risk. The true reproduction of the worm is as disgusting as it's other habits. Deepworms are both male and female. In their mating that is more an entangling and wrestling with each other, both compete to penetrate the other with some kind of stinger on their belly. The winner injects their eggs into the losers body. After a few days that worm becomes slow, fat and tired. After a few days he bursts and the deepworms that were eating it from inside out scurry in all directions. The deepworm itself is a disgusting creature with even more disgusting eating habits. Though it's usual diet consists only carrion and plant matter, the worms are…
deepworm.strat: Deepworms are not particularly dangerous to players above level 100. Mages should keep their distance and attack using fire-based spells or Sudden Death Runes. Knights and Paladins can handle them in close combat, but should watch for their strong melee and occasional earth attacks. Using fire-based weapons or spells is especially effective due to their elemental weakness.

deer.name: Deer
deer.title: Deer
deer.loc: Darama (Devourer, Kha'labal), in most grassy areas of Tibia, also found in Rookgaard and on Tutorial Island. There are also 2 unreachable Deer found near Fiehonja's protection zone.
deer.desc: Deer live in the forests and are nourished only by plants. They are absolutely peaceable and very shy. They provide a wealthy source of food, but you must be very quick or work in teams in order to hunt them down. Bows are effective weapons for that task.

defiler.name: Defiler
defiler.title: Defiler
defiler.loc: Pits of Inferno, The Vats - Edron and Grounds of Plague.
defiler.desc: It is unknown whether the thing known as Defiler is a variant of the ordinary slime or if it is the elder form of the said creature. Although they share numerous characteristics, the Defiler is by far more powerful and dangerous. Since the Defiler is often found accompanied by some kind of demon, it is theorised that the greater slime is possibly not even native to our world. It is assumed that some life form brought it here from the demons' realm of existence. Still, just like the common slimes, it shares the love for humid places of decay and darkness and like its smaller variant it does not care about living or dead as long as it is organic when it comes to eating habits. When the slime is seen as a symbol of poison and decay, those characteristics cannot be overlooked in the Defiler. Its relation to poison and decay also becomes evident in its attributes. A choking stench surrounds the Defiler and it can shoot some parts of itself to infect its victims with poison and decay.
defiler.notes: Its body turns into a poison field after rotting. Somewhat related to Slime. The Defilers bosses are The Plasmother - located in Verminor's Throneroom - and The Abomination.
defiler.strat: They are usually found together with other creatures that Paralyse you often, so be ready to heal often or avoid running. Use Fire damage and Earth protection.

delany.name: Delany
delany.title: Delany (Creature)
delany.notes: Appeared during Tibia's 15th and 20th Anniversary celebrations, in a raid at a random time once a day. The following message will appear: Then, 20 minutes later he will spawns:

demodras.name: Demodras
demodras.title: Demodras
demodras.loc: PoH Dragon Lair ( ) on the way to the Ornamented Shield Quest, PoI Dragon Lair ( ), Thais Dragon Lair ( ) on the way to the Naginata Quest. The special task teleport is located inside the PoH Dragon Lair, .
demodras.notes: It is the Dragons' boss. Looks the same as a Dragon Lord. Always spawns with two Dragon Lords, save for in the quest room. Demodras' corpse can be skinned for a chance of getting a Red Dragon Leather. [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7drOFPGOf0o Video of a Level 120 Royal Paladin Killing Demodras for Task on Fidera] killing Demodras (special task)]]
demodras.strat: Mages: Get a good blocker, and use Sudden Death Runes or Icicle Runes if your level and magic level are high enough. Otherwise, bring a Paladin or other Mages for back-up. A Mage or Paladin may attempt the special task at level 100 with reasonable success. Paladins will probably not need Magic Shield. Knights: It is possible to solo this creature with good skills and high level using Fierce Berserk. It is advised to attempt the special task on at least level 130 when you can use Ultimate Healing Potions.

demon.name: Demon
demon.title: Demon
demon.loc: Hero Cave, Ferumbras' Citadel, Goroma, Ghostlands (Warlock area; unreachable), Liberty Bay (hidden underground passage; unreachable), Razachai, deep in Pits of Inferno (found in every throneroom except Verminor's), deep Formorgar Mines, Demon Forge, Alchemist Quarter, Magician Quarter, Chyllfroest, Oramond Dungeon, Abandoned Sewers, Hell Hub and Halls of Ascension.
demon.desc: The famous knight Apoc once wrote: "Demons are the most malevolent, powerful, and dangerous creatures in Tibia. In addition to their awesome physical strength, they can also use powerful spells, such as fireballs and fire fields. Especially dangerous is their gaze, which can produce beams of pure energy to annihilate their poor victims. Moreover, they drain mana off their victims, heal themselves and summon fire elementals as their vassals. Fortunately, Demons usually live in the deepest dungeons near hell but sometimes they appear also on the surface. When they do, they leave a track of death and destruction behind them. Nobody has ever been able to slay even one of these entities and only very few adventurers have survived an encounter with them."
demon.notes: Demons are the servants of evil. More or less devoted servants of Zathroth, they cause strife and havoc wherever they appear. Their masters are known as Demonlords, Demon Overlords and Archdemons. They shout , which means "SACRIFICE YOUR BLOOD!", according to this book. You can use a Blessed Wooden Stake on a slain Demon for a chance to gather some Demon Dust (see: Demon Dust/Dusting).

demon-outcast.name: Demon Outcast
demon-outcast.title: Demon Outcast

ab.n: Mana Drain Ball (Only affects Mages inside the range)

demon-outcast.desc: Demon outcasts are demons who have somehow fallen out of grace with their superiors. In demon society, this might happen for any reason and usually, punishment is swift and final. Sometimes though, annihilation may be considered too swift or too much of a waste. Outcasts are branded for eternity, and even if they manage to serve their way back into the ranks of the demons, they are still considered inferior and disgusting - if only because they remind other demons of how quickly anyone may fall. The treatment of outcasts varies with the whims of the local demonic rulers; some outcasts might serve as gladiators for entertainment, others are used as subjects for various tortures and experiments. Only in rare cases do demons bother to keep outcasts as prisoners; usually if they are supposed to be in possession of valuable information or particularly useful powers. The life of an outcast is miserable at best, and either way a constant fight for survival. The continuous hardships permit only the most cunning and resilient of them to survive, and their natural aggressiveness is magnified to an extreme extent. Outcasts are prone to going berserk, and even if they should somehow have…
demon-outcast.strat: These are the most common creatures inside the Roshamuul Prison, so special attention must be paid at them. Their summons are more annoying than dangerous. When hunting in teams, the blockers should throw a Poison Bomb Rune under their feet in order to avoid the Energy Elementals from getting close and taking the spot of other stronger creatures. When facing them solo, low level paladins can run around energy walls. Mages should shall use their strongest ice and energy attacks to take down this creature. Their mana drain is an area attack on target of the size of the Berserk spell, but it will only drain mana from Mages.

demon-parrot.name: Demon Parrot
demon-parrot.title: Demon Parrot
demon-parrot.notes: Kills weaker creatures. It's dangerous to follow him when he runs in low health because he can lure you into a bigger spawn of Isle of Evil monsters.
demon-parrot.strat: Try to stay at a distance and to stand diagonal of it to evade his beam.

demon-skeleton.name: Demon Skeleton
demon-skeleton.title: Demon Skeleton
demon-skeleton.loc: Triangle Tower, Hellgate, Draconia, Plains of Havoc, Pits of Inferno, Thais Ancient Temple, Fibula Dungeon, Mintwallin, Mount Sternum hidden cave, Drefia, Ghost Ship, Edron Hero Cave, Forgotten Tomb, Shadowthorn, Elvenbane, Ghostlands, Femor Hills, White Flower Temple, Isle of the Kings, Dark Cathedral, Ankrahmun Tombs, Ramoa, Helheim, Vengoth, Upper Spike, Lion's Rock.
demon-skeleton.desc: Demon Skeletons are undead monsters that live in the deepest dungeons of Tibia. Nobody knows where these creatures come from. They are much stronger and faster than normal skeletons - from which they differ externally only by colour. Like them, they can drain life energy off their opponents.
demon-skeleton.beh: They are quite slow. This creature will retarget, kill weaker monsters and push objects to get to you.
demon-skeleton.notes: This is an excellent summon because its immune to many elements.

denson-larika.name: Denson Larika
denson-larika.title: Denson Larika (Creature)
denson-larika.loc: Around the pirate tavern, near Klaus.
denson-larika.notes: Appears during the Tibia's 15th Anniversary, in a raid at a random time once a day. Before Denson Larika appears, two messages are broadcast in white text to all players: "Something's a-cooking in Klaus' tavern on Nargor. The pirates are feeling watched." "Denson Larika has started an epic pirates vs. ninjas battle in Klaus' tavern on Nargor!"

depowered-minotaur.name: Depowered Minotaur
depowered-minotaur.title: Depowered Minotaur
depowered-minotaur.loc: Second floor Glooth Underground Factory, east side during a minotaur raid.
depowered-minotaur.notes: It's the weakened version of the Glooth Powered Minotaur.
depowered-minotaur.strat: Once they are in this form, they can be easily killed since it's weaker than the other minotaurs.

despair.name: Despair
despair.title: Despair
despair.notes: Apppears in the Ferumbras' Ascension Quest with Tarbaz.

desperate-white-deer.name: Desperate White Deer
desperate-white-deer.title: Desperate White Deer
desperate-white-deer.loc: Same as White Deer: around Ab'Dendriel, Carlin (east from Lothar), Femor Hills and Ferngrims Gate.
desperate-white-deer.notes: To fight one, you must kill a regular White Deer. If the deer doesn't become enraged, it will despair.
desperate-white-deer.strat: Kill it before it runs away. Be careful though, as two Elf Scouts might spawn to avenge its death. When the elves are summoned, it says: "The elves came too late to save the deer, however they might avenge it."

despor.name: Despor
despor.title: Despor
despor.notes: When killing this boss, you can kill Maliz, Vengar, Bruton, Greedok, Vilear, Crultor, or Despor in any order. However, only Dragon Pack will show in Bosstiary.

destroyer.name: Destroyer
destroyer.title: Destroyer
destroyer.loc: Pits of Inferno, Formorgar Mines, Alchemist Quarter, Oramond Dungeon and Grounds of Destruction.
destroyer.desc: The Destroyers, a rather minor demonic race, can be found at many places serving many purposes. By all accounts much stronger than smart, they are particularly effective in close combat. Powerful enough to be noticed by other demons but still too weak to be of any importance, Destroyers love to torment and bully creatures that are lower in the demonic pecking order. This gets them often into fights with the smart but physically weak imps. Since both races feel superior over the other, they do not get along too well. Under a strict leadership the Destroyers prove quite competent in the area they are employed, which is usually to destroy things and to mash people. However, their true strength comes through quantity. Demons of higher ranks like to accumulate a horde of such minions and let them loose on a target. Such an unleashed horde of Destroyers is virtually unstoppable. Having a seemingly endless supply on Destroyers, only the difficultly to enter the realms of the mortals keeps the demons from using them on a larger scale.
destroyer.notes: You may hunt 650 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Bretzecutioner.

devoted-radiant-acolyte.name: Devoted Radiant Acolyte
devoted-radiant-acolyte.title: Devoted Radiant Acolyte
devoted-radiant-acolyte.desc: Devoted Radiant Acolytes are more powerful than Radiant Acolytes.

devoted-radiant-inquisitor.name: Devoted Radiant Inquisitor
devoted-radiant-inquisitor.title: Devoted Radiant Inquisitor
devoted-radiant-inquisitor.desc: Devoted Radiant Inquisitors are more powerful than Radiant Inquisitors.

devoted-radiant-paragon.name: Devoted Radiant Paragon
devoted-radiant-paragon.title: Devoted Radiant Paragon
devoted-radiant-paragon.desc: Devoted Radiant Paragons are more powerful than Radiant Paragons.

devoted-radiant-templar.name: Devoted Radiant Templar
devoted-radiant-templar.title: Devoted Radiant Templar
devoted-radiant-templar.desc: Devoted Radiant Templars are more powerful than Radiant Templars.

devoted-radiant-warden.name: Devoted Radiant Warden
devoted-radiant-warden.title: Devoted Radiant Warden
devoted-radiant-warden.desc: Devoted Radiant Wardens are more powerful than Radiant Wardens.

devoted-radiant-zealot.name: Devoted Radiant Zealot
devoted-radiant-zealot.title: Devoted Radiant Zealot
devoted-radiant-zealot.desc: Devoted Radiant Zealots are more powerful than Radiant Zealots.

devourer.name: Devourer
devourer.title: Devourer
devourer.loc: Rathleton Sewers, Lower Rathleton, Oramond/Western Plains, Underground Glooth Factory, Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon.
devourer.desc: The source of the devourers are slime creatures of unknown origin that over the cause of generation have soaked that much glooth residue that they became something new. The driving force of these creatures is an insatiable hunger and their digestion relies on incredible strong fluids. In the past the tiny ancestors of the devourers were used in Rathleton in waste disposal and they were deliberately allowed to roam the sewer system. First incidents with the nearly mindless creatures brought the officials to rethink that strategy. But it was already too late to stop the spread of the devourers. Even worse several extermination campaigns lead to an increased survival of the fittest evolution of the devourers and in few generations the slime creatures had doubled in size and fierceness. As a cannibalistic species they begun to further their own evolution by eradicating the weak and sick which lead to further selection. Some scientists speculate that the devourers are still evolving with each generation and that they will eventually grow even further with no limits. There are rumours about devourers that fused together is fearsome fights and continued as even larger and more dangerous…
devourer.strat: Devourer's will usually apear together with many other Glooth creatures, so the best strategy is using area spells and attacks to kill all of them at once. Other than that, simply attack it using anything but Earth damage.

devovorga.name: Devovorga
devovorga.title: Devovorga
devovorga.notes: Part of the Rise of Devovorga World Quest. According to the featured article of August 26th 2010, "this will be a battle against the largest and most powerful monster Tibia has ever seen." Its sound " " is Latin for Let the world perish! All players who sufficiently damage her during the last minute of the final fight will receive the Devovorga's Nemesis achievement.
devovorga.strat: Have a Knight with level 250 or higher to block it using many Stone Skin Amulets and Might Rings, as it have very powerful Melee. It can also be trapped with Magic Walls while the shooters stay behind the bridge.

dharalion.name: Dharalion
dharalion.title: Dharalion
dharalion.loc: Shadowthorn, the Time Ring Quest room.
dharalion.notes: He is the boss of the Elves. Always spawns with at least 2 Elf Scouts and 1 Elf Arcanist. Looks the same as an Elf Arcanist.
dharalion.strat: Just treat him like a strong Elf Arcanist. It's recommended to use a Stealth Ring or the spell Invisible when fighting him, so his summons cannot see you.

diabolic-imp.name: Diabolic Imp
diabolic-imp.title: Diabolic Imp
diabolic-imp.loc: Inquisition, Pits of Inferno, Fenrock, Fury Dungeon and inside the Hellgore volcano on Goroma during the Fire from the Earth Mini World Change.
diabolic-imp.desc: Imps are some of the smaller and physically weaker demons. The only thing that allows them to exist in the demonic society, that has no tolerance for weakness, is their cunning and the magical forces they have under their command. Diabolic Imps tend to be somewhat cowardly and when it comes to the crunch, they esteem the value of their own lives much higher than any agenda of the master they might serve. For this reason, they are not trusted and, despite their intelligence, rarely appointed to any position of power or influence. The scheming little Diabolic Imps still found their niche in the demon society. They often serve in logistics or as messengers. In the latter role, they are frequently sent to the realm of the mortals. Here they even pose as advisors of mortal allies of the demon kind for a while.
diabolic-imp.notes: Diabolic Imps have 2 bosses: The Imperor and Minishabaal (not in game anymore).

diamond-servant.name: Diamond Servant
diamond-servant.title: Diamond Servant
diamond-servant.desc: After a great gathering of not so great mages planning to do great things, it was decided to launch the production of helpful servants to speed up the process of being - great. Each of them had his own special field. One was a master of manipulating all kinds of ore with his bare mind, another was able to wield powerful energies, and again another would know how to use the strangest of substances in Tibia to his benefit. All of them combined their knowledge to create their own loyal servants. Several prototypes were made. Some constructed of metal, others of gold or even diamond but all of them were based on flesh and bone. Some of them were faulty from the start. It is said that one of the mages even used whole armies of servants to take care of his experiments.
diamond-servant.strat: Focus on coordinated wave clearing. Make sure your team communicates which creatures remain, as the next wave won't spawn until all current Servants are defeated. Ensure to maintain steady damage output and reposition to avoid getting surrounded, especially in larger rooms.

diamond-servant-replica.name: Diamond Servant Replica
diamond-servant-replica.title: Diamond Servant Replica
diamond-servant-replica.notes: You have to kill 5 of them in a mission of the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.

diblis-the-fair.name: Diblis the Fair
diblis-the-fair.title: Diblis the Fair
diblis-the-fair.beh: Run when is on yellow health.
diblis-the-fair.strat: Mages should have a blocker while using Energy Damage/Fire Damage based Spells and Magic Shield. Paladins should also have a blocker and use Divine Missile to kill it fast. Knights should have a shooter and use using either Berserk or Fierce Berserk when the banshees reach you. Use Inflict Wound on him right away because he will go invisible a lot and run with a lot of health left.

dipthrah.name: Dipthrah
dipthrah.title: Dipthrah
dipthrah.beh: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders. He will walk diagonally through summons to reach his target.
dipthrah.notes: Dipthrah was sentenced to be locked away, after his part in the conspiracies against the pharaoh, Arkhotep. He is the pharaoh of divinity, and the only pharaoh immune to physical damage. One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.
dipthrah.strat: In his room there are 9 Magicthrowers and 5 Bonelords. He has a standard non-blockable spawn, spawning on the west side of the room (right by the Coal Basin). Due to his physical immunity, mages are highly recommended. Paladins should use elemental arrows and knights enchanted weapons. His mana drain makes up a lot of his damage, so knights can quite easily block it. Bronze Amulets may be a good choice for mages and Garlic Necklaces for knights. Knights: enter the room first to distract the pillars. Be sure to challenge the pharaoh to protect the shooters. Dipthrah will drain your mana a lot and most of your attack spells will be blocked, so it may be a good idea to just block the pharaoh. It may help your shooters to shoot Fire Bombs for their safety. Paladins: if there is a knight, stand behind him and shoot with elemental arrows. If there is no knight, you can substitute a blocker with some difficulties (you will need a healer - your mana will be depleted fast). Mages: shoot from a distance with Flame Strike or Ice Strike. A mage (preferably druid for Mass Healing) can quite easily camp this pharaoh alone after the first clear by having a Demon Skeleton summon block for them.…

dire-penguin.name: Dire Penguin
dire-penguin.title: Dire Penguin
dire-penguin.loc: Many places with penguins. * Up the Formorgar Glacier , and * At Helheim, * Tyrsung, * West of Svargrond , and * Way to Chyllfroest , even though no regular penguins spawn there. * North of Bittermor,
dire-penguin.beh: Chases the opponent shooting stones and casting paralyze bomb around itself. It moves objects but doesn't kill weaker creatures.
dire-penguin.notes: They generally spawn around other penguins.
dire-penguin.strat: Kill them with melee or use energy based attacks.

diremaw.name: Diremaw
diremaw.title: Diremaw
diremaw.loc: Gnome Deep Hub (north and south tasking areas), Warzone 6
diremaw.desc: Given the highly aggressive and predatory nature of the diremaw, it's a marvel how the hidden masters in the depths keep them under control. Even amongst themselves there is a constant aggression and re-establishing of the pecking order. When left alone the diremaws constantly challenge each other to fights, though weaker devourers submit to the threats of the stronger ones and fights are averted. This aggressiveness extends to other minion races of those bellow and they usually leave the diremaws on their own. In battle the direwmaws are forced to work alongside each other and allies. Even then they can't supress the occasional hissing and threatening of others that come to close or steal their kill. Still they relish in combat and seem to enjoy it. The stronger diremaws are often seen in the front of assaults where they excel in spreading fear and mayhem amongst the ranks of the enemy. Their focus on aggression levels often an opening for a counterattack but the diremaw seems nit to care. Especially they seem to feel no pain at all and even try to fight when cut into pieces. Their constant fighting has honed their reflexes and trained them into fighters that are matched only by…
diremaw.notes: Beware: A secondary spawn mechanic allows a Diremaw to emerge from its rotting corpse when Gnomish Pesticides are used during the Dangerous Depths Quest. This spawn does not display the usual three Teleport Effect warnings and cannot be blocked. As a result, a player could drag a Diremaw corpse into a semi-safe area and trigger this mechanic to ambush or kill another player.
diremaw.strat: Mages with level above 200 shouldn't have problem dealing with one of these creatures, but groups of them can be very dangerous. Keep your distance and attack with Sudden Death Runes or ice-based spells. They have very strong melee and spells so it's advised to wear equipment that reduces Physical and Earth Damages.

dirtbeard.name: Dirtbeard
dirtbeard.title: Dirtbeard
dirtbeard.notes: It's the second floor boss. Use his body to get a random reward before you use the body of Evil Mastermind, otherwise you may not get any item. Probably an allusion to Blackbeard.

diseased-bill.name: Diseased Bill
diseased-bill.title: Diseased Bill
diseased-bill.strat: Shoot from the door or run around a hole. If you are a lower level mage, you can also summon a demon skeleton inside the room with Diseased Bill since it is immune to earth damage and life drain. You can aid it with runes when they move away from the door.

diseased-dan.name: Diseased Dan
diseased-dan.title: Diseased Dan
diseased-dan.notes: He's an infected human, a plague carrier.
diseased-dan.strat: Open the door and shoot, go out if you need to heal. Note that more than one player can enter the sealed door at the same time, so ask a friend for help if you need a blocker. Since the Summer Update 2012 the hp decreased from 2000 to 800 and the attacks became weaker.

diseased-fred.name: Diseased Fred
diseased-fred.title: Diseased Fred
diseased-fred.loc: Alchemist Quarter, . Since the Summer Update 2012 you can reach him easier by a ramp directly from +1, instead of having to walk past the pit with Bog Raiders.
diseased-fred.beh: Like a Bog Raider, but he runs in low hp.
diseased-fred.notes: Is an infected human. He is the strongest of the diseased humans.
diseased-fred.strat: Same strategy you would use for a Bog Raider, run around and shoot him.

disruption.name: Disruption
disruption.title: Disruption
disruption.notes: Appears with The Destruction and with the World Devourer in the Heart of Destruction Quest. Looks like a Magic Forcefield (Green).
disruption.strat: When this creature appears, the team must kill it as fast as possible, otherwise it will transform into a Charged Disruption and later an Overcharged Disruption which are much harder to kill.

distorted-phantom.name: Distorted Phantom
distorted-phantom.title: Distorted Phantom
distorted-phantom.desc: Zarganash's hostile environment gave birth to an own breed of phantoms that differs depending on the hazards that help to form them from the tormented souls they once were into a phantom denizen of Zarganash. The most desperate and self-loathing souls eventually emerge as distorted phantoms. Unstable and unhinged even for the standards of Zarganash, the distorted phantom is on a futile quest to end its own existence. By angry attacks it tries to provoke to be killed. The harder the resistance they are met with, the higher are its hopes of destruction and the more furious their attacks become. They drive themselves into a frenzy and ceaselessly continue to attack without any regard for their own protection. In the end, even if destroyed, the distorted phantom is soon reformed at another place of Zarganash, to embark on its endless mission of self-destruction once again. Ironically the inner conflicts are what keeps the distorted phantom in existence and from slipping into oblivion. Only by resolving such conflicts the phantom would have a chance to find inner peace and a final rest. This though is due to its nature and the laws of Zarganash almost and impossible feat. Without any…

doctor-perhaps.name: Doctor Perhaps
doctor-perhaps.title: Doctor Perhaps
doctor-perhaps.notes: It's the first floor boss. Use his body to get a random reward before you use the body of Evil Mastermind, otherwise you may not get any item. Doubtlessly an allusion to "Doctor No", the villain in James Bond's first movie.

dog.name: Dog
dog.title: Dog
dog.loc: Isle of the Kings, North of the Thais temple, Lubos house, west of Carlin (with sheep), Edron north of castle and one south towards Ivory Towers, Liberty Bay (Silverhand Manor), Mintwallin central park and on the way to the old Mintwallin area, Factory Quarter (Yalahar).
dog.desc: Dogs can be found as pets or roaming the streets of the cities. They are absolutely peaceable and very affectionate. As they yield neither experience nor loot, killing them may be considered pure cruelty by animal-rights activists, and they might take revenge.
dog.notes: Dogs are harmless straying animals, but can be annoying when they get in your way. They are the favorite food of trolls (see the week's specials).
dog.strat: Just attack them and they will run or die shortly after.

domestikion.name: Domestikion
domestikion.title: Domestikion
domestikion.notes: Domestikions are support melee creatures that increase the damage output of all monsters in Tibiadrome. Multiple Domestikions stack their buff. They attack with physical, holy and energy damage. They also cause life and mana drain.

doom-deer.name: Doom Deer
doom-deer.title: Doom Deer
doom-deer.strat: Try to stand diagonal to it or it will use its energy beam very often. The beam can be used to kill other monsters; try to make it face other creatures and they will receive damage from the commonly used wave.

doomhowl.name: Doomhowl
doomhowl.title: Doomhowl
doomhowl.notes: One of the Isle of Strife Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

doomsday-cultist.name: Doomsday Cultist
doomsday-cultist.title: Doomsday Cultist
doomsday-cultist.loc: Tarpit Tomb around [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=129.169-127.178-11-2-1-1 the Lightbringer's basin].
doomsday-cultist.notes: Appears as a raid for five minutes after a player lights the Lightbringer's Basin and receives the following message

dracola.name: Dracola
dracola.title: Dracola
dracola.beh: Behaves just like a regular Undead Dragon, except that it is much stronger. It also runs in low health.
dracola.notes: It is the Undead Dragon boss. If he is spawned, there may be more liches than usual in the room.
dracola.strat: Treat it like a regular Undead Dragon, just keep in mind it can do very high comboes. Have a Knight stand diagonal, a Druid to heal the Knight and as many Mages and Paladins shoot at Dracola.

dragolisk.name: Dragolisk
dragolisk.title: Dragolisk
dragolisk.desc: Dracolisks are a heretical creation among dragonkind, designed to rival the fabled basilisks with a dark and potent grace. While they may not quite match the basilisks' otherworldly power, dracolisks are undeniably menacing and dangerous creatures, which is amplified by their malicious shrewdness. These dragons bear a subtle, smouldering resentment toward their kin, their bitterness manifesting as sarcasm and cunning. Harbouring little sympathy for other dragons, they are unusually comfortable amongst other dracolisks, forming cabals and circles to work towards common goals. As longtime goals and personal ambitions seldom align, for most of the time a dracolisk is often a loner, following its own agenda. Dracolisks excel in manipulation through their dark intellect and deceptive wiles, relishing in the slow torture, subversion, and ultimate destruction of individuals and communities. Instead of relying on brute force, they take pleasure in devious tactics like poisoning wells and abducting villagers to accomplish their sinister objectives.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.title: Dragon
dragon.loc: Thais, Ancient Temple, Darashia Dragon Lair, Mount Sternum Dragon Cave, Mintwallin, deep in Fibula Dungeon, Kazordoon Dragon Lair (near Dwarf Bridge), Plains of Havoc, Elven Bane castle, Maze of Lost Souls, southern cave and dragon tower in Shadowthorn, Orc Fortress, Venore Dragon Lair, Pits of Inferno, Behemoth Quest room in Edron, Hero Cave, deep Cyclopolis, Edron Dragon Lair, Goroma, Kha'labal Dragon Lairs, Tiquanda Dragon Lairs, Draconia, Dragonblaze Peaks, some Ankrahmun Tombs, underground of Fenrock (on the way to Beregar), Krailos Steppe and Crystal Lakes.
dragon.desc: Dragons were among the first creatures of Tibia and once ruled the whole continent. Nowadays, there are only a few of them left which live deep in the dungeons. Nevertheless, they are very powerful monsters and will strive for killing every intruder. Besides their immense strength, they shoot fireballs at their victims and spit fire. Moreover, they can heal themselves.
dragon.notes: These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife (see also: Green Dragon Leather/Skinning).

dragon-essence.name: Dragon Essence
dragon-essence.title: Dragon Essence
dragon-essence.notes: This creature can only be found when First Dragon Quest is active.

dragon-hatchling.name: Dragon Hatchling
dragon-hatchling.title: Dragon Hatchling
dragon-hatchling.loc: Thais Dragon Lair, beneath Fenrock, Darashia Dragon Lair, Venore Dragon Lair, Edron Dragon Lair, Dragonblaze Peaks, Krailos Steppe. Also summoned by Lizard Dragon Priests.
dragon-hatchling.desc: Even though it might appear small and cute, one should always keep in mind that also the youngest dragon is a fierce beast. The sharp teeth and the instinct of a born predator paired with an ever ravenous appetite make the little Dragon Hatchlings not only a threat for other races but also for their brood mates. Only the most vicious of the numerous Dragon Hatchlings reach adulthood. In their tireless pursuit for food, they know no fear nor restraint. Adventurers visiting a dragons lair are often faced by a whole pack of Dragon Hatchlings, swarming over him like famished locusts. To make matters worse, Dragon Hatchlings are hardly encountered without their parents being close. Lured by the cry of their brood, the enraged parents tend to enter the battlefield in the worst moment. Furious about the threat posed to their offspring, the elder dragons become even more formidable opponents. Of course, also the Dragon Hatchlings do not cease their own attacks as they hope to get to taste some delicious adventurer.
dragon-hatchling.beh: Same behavior of an adult Dragon.
dragon-hatchling.notes: It is usually found together with a dragon, so be careful if you meet one, as a dragon may be near!
dragon-hatchling.strat: Generally easy kill, but can easily get in your way when trying to get to the mother, just stay away from the flame wave and its melee if you're not a knight. Have mana or health potions ready if needed. Also try not to anger the mother.

dragon-hoard.name: Dragon Hoard
dragon-hoard.title: Dragon Hoard
dragon-hoard.notes: An unreachable creature that shares health points with the seventh and last dragon boss you kill in the 20 Years a Cook Quest final bossfight. It is the creature that grants players their reward for the fight.

dragon-lord.name: Dragon Lord
dragon-lord.title: Dragon Lord
dragon-lord.loc: Ankrahmun Dragon Lairs, Banshee Quest final room (level 60+ to open the door), Deeper Cyclopolis past the Dragon Spawn (level 30+ to open the door), Draconia, Edron Dragon Lair, Fibula Dungeon (level 50+ to open the door), Maze of Lost Souls (level 30+ to open the door), Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair, Dragon Lord hole in Plains of Havoc, Carlin Dragon Lair, Thais Dragon Lair, Goroma Dragon Lairs, Hot Spot, Venore Dragon Lair, Arena and Zoo Quarter (Yalahar), beneath Fenrock, Darashia Dragon Lair, Razachai, Dragonblaze Peaks, Ferumbras Citadel, Fury Dungeon, Lower Spike, Krailos Steppe.
dragon-lord.desc: Dragon Lords are the leaders of the dragons. They are even more powerful than normal dragons that can usually be found in their company. Like normal dragons, they can throw fireballs, spit fire, and heal themselves, but they can also throw great fire bombs.
dragon-lord.notes: You can skin a Dragon Lord with an Obsidian Knife (see Red Dragon Leather/Skinning).

dragon-lord-hatchling.name: Dragon Lord Hatchling
dragon-lord-hatchling.title: Dragon Lord Hatchling
dragon-lord-hatchling.loc: Thais Dragon Lair, Venore Dragon Lair, Edron Dragon Lair by the Fire Axe Quest, on the way to Pythius the Rotten, Razachai, Dragonblaze Peaks.
dragon-lord-hatchling.desc: Usually it takes decades or even centuries until a dragon lord evolves from an ordinary dragon. Sometimes though, when very ancient and powerful dragon lords mate, a child is born with a fraction of its parents immense power. The body of such a Dragon Lord Hatchling is protected by red scales which already hint on its powerful destiny. The powers of a Dragon Lord Hatchling outclass those of any ordinary hatchling. So to speak born into the nobility of dragon kind, the Dragon Lord Hatchlings contain the worst traits any dragon hatchling could have. Although they are able to control their appetite in a better way than other hatchlings, they only use this self-restraint for cruel cat and mouse games they love to play with their soon-to-be food. And food can be almost everything that is or has been alive, even their own kind. Particularly, old and sick dragons, that did not leave early enough for the fabled dragon cemetery, often fall prey to their malicious offspring. As dragons are not willing to teach anything to their hatchlings, the youngsters have to become keen observers to pick up a few tricks and some magic from the older generation.
dragon-lord-hatchling.beh: Often comes in groups with Dragon Lords.
dragon-lord-hatchling.strat: Same as used with Dragons, however they have ability to burn you with Firebomb. Be careful as they usually spawn near dragons and dragon lords, they're more annoying than dangerous, but can give you a free trip to temple if they combo with a dragon, it's better to make them run by lowering their hp to focus on stronger creatures. Knights: Try to kill them as fast as you can before they spit fire fields on you, if you get surrounded cast exori or exori gran, as this will make them run and clear space for you to run, not really worth hunting as most will be empty or yield low amount of gold. Paladins: Try to kill them as fast as it is possible also avoid their waves.Also, you will need mana to heal if he hits you with the waves. Mages: Just use wand and exori frigo/vis to kill them as fast as you can.

dragonling.name: Dragonling
dragonling.title: Dragonling
dragonling.loc: Fury Dungeon and Goroma volcano (surface floor, inner volcano) only during the Fire from the Earth Mini World Change.
dragonling.desc: The Dragonling is a remote cousin of the known dragons. Though sharing many traits with the dragons and sometimes seemingly getting along with each other, the Dragonling has many biological distinctions which imply that any relations to dragons are remote indeed. Above all, they share a number of traits and organs with mammals, which has led many researchers to believe that the Dragonling might rather be an artificial chimera or construct instead. Extinct creator races as well as the ancient Yalahari are named as possible origins of the Dragonlings. Whatever the real origins of the Dragonling, it is evident that today it reproduces on its own and has preferred habitats. After mating, a Dragonling lays a dozen eggs in a hidden nest at some warm or preferably hot place. It leaves the nest alone for about a year, only to return when the eggs are ready to hatch. Often it finds its nest destroyed or the eggs gone due to the actions of other creatures. If there are eggs left, they will hatch as soon as the mother is there, seemingly recognising her proximity. The young will then follow their mother who will feed and protect them for several years until they are roughly the same size as…
dragonling.notes: It can be tamed. Use a Decorative Ribbon or a Music Box to tame it.

draken-abomination.name: Draken Abomination
draken-abomination.title: Draken Abomination

ab.n: Poison Ball that makes you drunk
Death Beam that does life drain damage

draken-abomination.desc: Even the mighty Draken are not immune to the taint that spreads through the land of Zao. Some of them succumbed to the harrowing influence of the corruption. They have been disfigured in body and soul and became a disgrace for their own kind. And yet by decree of the emperor, they are still part of the society. That did not save them from the scorn of they brethren, though. Being physically even more powerful than the ordinary Draken but easily influenced by magic, they became slaves and servants of the spellweavers. The remains of their sentience is nearly burnt out by the cruel use of spell power with which they are programmed as loyal and obedient golems without any own ambitions. What is left of their sentience rarely recovers from this process, and so they roam the palaces of the dragon kings and their servants as nearly mindless drones. Their conditioning usually involves to attack anything that does not belong to the place they are bound to. If this command is triggered, the usually slow and passive Draken Abominations display a frightening amount of rage. It is unknown if this berserking is the result of the cruel conditioning process or an inherent state of mind caused by…
draken-abomination.notes: You may hunt 900 Draken Abomination, Draken Elite, Draken Spellweaver, Draken Warmaster combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Paiz the Pauperizer.
draken-abomination.strat: Stay diagonal. If you are running them, you might need a Dwarven Ring. Having a team of a Knight and a Paladin at level 110 is a good choice to hunt this, setting up energy fields you won't even need to move and paladin won't have any risk.

draken-elite.name: Draken Elite
draken-elite.title: Draken Elite
draken-elite.loc: Razachai, including the Crystal Column chambers in the Inner Sanctum.
draken-elite.desc: The Draken heritage is one of power and competence. Their training is merciless and their honour leaves little room for failure. All Draken use the best of their abilities to serve the dragon emperor, willing to die for the slightest failure. Yet, only the best of the best make it into the elite of the Draken society. The harsh and rigorous training hones their skills and makes them a living weapon at the disposal of the emperor. Wielding arcane power and weapons alike, the Draken Elite combines this with an impressive physique, turning it into a one man army. Using combat skills and spells, the Draken Elite has just the right answer to any combat situation in its claws. The Draken Elite have become some sort of knightly or religious order in the lizard society. Their grandmaster receives his order only from the dragon emperor himself, and their chapter house is part of the dragon emperor's palace. If the need arises, the emperor lends some of the elite warriors to one of the dragon kings. Sometimes out of need, another time as a boon or token of respect. The elite forces handle even the most trivial duty they are assigned to with precision and unwavering diligence. Often it is…
draken-elite.beh: Chases you quickly and fights until death. Behaviour similar to a stronger Dragon Lord.
draken-elite.notes: Walks in packs with other Drakens deep under Razachai. You may hunt 900 Draken Abomination, Draken Elite, Draken Spellweaver, Draken Warmaster combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Paiz the Pauperizer.
draken-elite.strat: First of all, try to stay diagonal all the time, because his wave is very strong. Mages should use Ice-Based spells, while Paladins should use Crystalline Arrow/Prismatic Bolts and Ethereal Spear. It's a hard creature for Knights, and one should use a weapon combined with Berserk based spells all the time to kill it fast.

draken-spellweaver.name: Draken Spellweaver
draken-spellweaver.title: Draken Spellweaver

ab.r: on itself; it burns you (10 [[hp]]/17 turns for 170 damage total)

draken-spellweaver.desc: The more cunning Draken often choose to become Draken Spellweavers. Combining their intellect with their inherent magical talent, probably comparable with that of a dragon, they make great spell casters of formidable power. Sadly, at least for the Draken this often means a rather dull life full of bureaucracy. They are high-ranking members of the hierarchy and with that they are often deeply involved in palace politics and intrigues. It is said their valued intellect binds them to such positions and all these intrigues and deceit are only ways to blow off steam. So when the rare occasion arises that a Draken Spellweaver takes part in a battle, they are often more fierce than their warrior cousins. They combine spells and physical attacks and so pose a threat to even the most experienced fighters. Although highly capable in the realms of magic, they only use a limited array of spells. Most of them are quite direct and have an immense damage output. The majority of Draken Spellweavers see battles as an welcome escape from their duties such as studying and regulating. They enjoy to leave all finesse and intrigues behind and to taste the blood of an enemy.
draken-spellweaver.notes: This creature was added with the Christmas Update 2009. It is somewhat ironic that the Spellweaver's Robe provides +10% resistance to energy because Draken Spellweavers are weak to Energy. The more cunning Draken often choose to become Draken Spellweavers. Combining their intellect with their inherent magical talent, probably comparable with that of a dragon, they make great spell casters of formidable power. You may hunt 900 Draken Abomination, Draken Elite, Draken Spellweaver, Draken Warmaster combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Paiz the Pauperizer.
draken-spellweaver.strat: Be ready to countermeasure invisibility with thunderstorm runes or another instant spell. Any damage over time spell, such as Inflict Wound or Holy Flash is a good option as well. It is pretty fast but it attacks as if it was melee so it is not as troublesome as a warlock, treat it like a much stronger dragon lord. Energy walls are a good choice to keep them at bay while finishing off the Draken Warmasters that accompany them.

draken-warmaster.name: Draken Warmaster
draken-warmaster.title: Draken Warmaster
draken-warmaster.loc: Zao Palace, Chazorai, Razachai, and Zzaion.
draken-warmaster.desc: The mighty Draken Warmasters originate from ordinary lizard hatcheries. Still, in many regards Draken have many more similarities to dragons than to their lizard parents. It can only be speculated what has caused their change, but the first Draken were born in the first years of the reign of the dragon kings. In the armies of the lizard people, the strong and cunning Draken Warmasters often serve as leaders or elite units. Due to their immense power, they have little to fear and happily unleash their rage in battle. As revered members of the lizard society, they receive the best equipment the master craftsmen can supply, and they use it with skill and precision obtained in years of sedulous training. This combination of skill, natural prowess and superior equipment makes them the most valued and feared troops in the dragon empire. The raising and training of the Draken takes much time and dedication. There are rumours that Draken neither die nor get weaker when getting older, rather the opposite, they are supposed to become more and more powerful with every day. The most ancient of the Draken are said to form the 'Flame Guard', the personal elite bodyguard of the dragon emperor,…
draken-warmaster.beh: Chases its target and fights until death. Retargets often to the nearest target it has.
draken-warmaster.notes: This creature was added with the Christmas Update 2009. You may hunt 900 Draken Abomination, Draken Elite, Draken Spellweaver, Draken Warmaster combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Paiz the Pauperizer.
draken-warmaster.strat: Stay out of the wave, it doesn't do it often but hits hard. The wave is also very short. so staying diagonal to it is the best way to save supplies.

draptor.name: Draptor
draptor.title: Draptor
draptor.loc: North east of Dragonblaze Peaks in Zao during the announced dragons raid, up to 10 draptors per raid in [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=129.235-121.223-7-2-1-0&mark1=129.210-121.212-7-9&mark2=129.194-121.251-7-9&mark3=129.165-122.4-7-9&mark4=130.6-122.17-7-9&mark5=130.51-121.210-7-9&mark6=129.230-121.186-7-9&mark7=130.11-121.182-7-9 these spots]. Furthermore, 2 to 4 Draptors may also appear inside the Emperor's Castle in Razachai in two diferent [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=129.55-121.127-10-4-1-1&mark1=129.84-121.105-10-9&mark2=129.31-121.140-10-9 rooms]. This raid…
draptor.desc: The Draptor is a dangerous predator that is another result of the Zaoan breeding techniques. In the past it was common that proud leaders rode on powerful bred Draptors into battle or on parades. With the rise of the dragon kings it was seen as unfitting that a lizard would ride on a creature that somewhat resembled a majestic dragon. Nowadays, the Draptor is mostly a beast of war. Sometimes the trained Draptors are used to boost the ranks of the lizard armies. Since a Draptor is prone to fits of berserk rage, this is not a strategy which should be applied lightly. When the Draptor can be kept in line though, it is a powerful addition to the troops. With shredding claws and dreadful jaws, they tear and bite through the ranks of their enemies. Since the Draptors lay eggs but do not breed them, they seek out hidden spots to place their clutches. Again and again such hidden eggs are found by travelling adventurers who take them with them as food or out of curiosity without knowing what they have found there. That way the eggs of the Draptors sometimes travel to foreign lands. It is only a question of time until this aggressive predator will conquer new areas where it will assert its…
draptor.beh: Very fast, comparable to a level 180 character.
draptor.notes: It can be tamed. Use a Harness or a Music Box on it to tame it.
draptor.strat: They are somewhat similar to Wyrms, but a bit stronger and faster.

drasilla.name: Drasilla
drasilla.title: Drasilla
drasilla.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #7. Drasilla has a feminine name, suggesting that she is female. There are three other known dragon females: Grand Mother Foulscale, Gelidrazah the Frozen, and Kalyassa. Next #8.
drasilla.strat: Drasilla is very similar to a regular dragon. Just do like you would do if you were going to solo a dragon, not much strategy needed just keep diagonal. You could use a Dragon Necklace to reduce fire damage a bit.

dread-intruder.name: Dread Intruder
dread-intruder.title: Dread Intruder
dread-intruder.desc: The Dread Intruders were the first creatures that were encountered when the first destruction vortexes showed up. For a short while, they also comprised the largest group of the new enemies. However, this didn't last long and today only the most knowledgeable explorers still know about this fact. In many regards the Dread Intruders are considered as pure embodiments of the new threat. They were the first creatures who have been captured by aspiring scientists. By examining this enemy, they learnt about the Dread Intruder's fleeting nature as well as the fact that this creature cannot exist very long without the support of a nearby destruction vortex. Dangerous and highly volatile, the Dread Intruder was even assumed to slightly bend reality itself. In-depth studies, however, revealed that this is rather an optical effect caused by the sheer load of destructive energy accumulated in these creatures. Still, it can't be denied that the laws of nature seem to be weakened by its very presence. Even if a certain degree of probability is applied, one cannot deny the countless reports about flickering lights, distorted sound, or objects that suddenly show minor damages or even changed…
dread-intruder.notes: Those that are located outside around the vortexes, do not yield any experience points. It looks identical to Dread Minions.
dread-intruder.strat: It's strongly advised to wear as much Energy Damage protection as possible, most of the damage dealt by Extra Dimensionals creatures comes from this element. Even though the Dread Intruder does not deal any Life Drain damage, the rest of Otherworld monsters do, so you should also consider wearing a Garlic Necklace or Necklace of the Deep and put a Bone Fiddle in the extra slot.

dread-minion.name: Dread Minion
dread-minion.title: Dread Minion
dread-minion.notes: These creatures are summoned by Pillars of Summoning. Looks identical to Dread Intruders.
dread-minion.strat: Kill them quickly before they accumulate.

dreadbeast.name: Dreadbeast
dreadbeast.title: Dreadbeast
dreadbeast.beh: Try to hit you with their Drown Hits.
dreadbeast.notes: They are constantly summoned in Hellgorak's Room.
dreadbeast.strat: Convince it and use it to kill the boss of the room at The Inquisition Quest.

dreadful-disruptor.name: Dreadful Disruptor
dreadful-disruptor.title: Dreadful Disruptor
dreadful-disruptor.loc: Otherworld (Edron). Shares a Varying Monster Spawn with a Stabilizing Dread Intruder, . The respawn rate is 4 to 5 minutes, and is not affected by Rapid Respawn.

dreadmaw.name: Dreadmaw
dreadmaw.title: Dreadmaw
dreadmaw.loc: Northen part of Muggy Plains, near the rice fields and .
dreadmaw.notes: Dreadmaw is the Killer Caimans' boss.
dreadmaw.strat: Kill it like an ordinary Killer Caiman.

dreadwing.name: Dreadwing
dreadwing.title: Dreadwing
dreadwing.beh: Running away while having red hp.
dreadwing.notes: One of the Isle of Strife's Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.
dreadwing.strat: Sudden Death runes won't work on her.

drillworm.name: Drillworm
drillworm.title: Drillworm
drillworm.loc: Drillworm Caves ( ), Lower Spike, Lost Dwarf version of the Forsaken Mine, Oramond Factory Raids and Warzone 4.
drillworm.desc: Drillworms are aggressive beasts from the depths of the earth. It is assumed that they are a distant relative of the common rotworm, but no medical examination could prove this. In fact, studies have revealed that the Drillworm is, in fact, quite different from the rotworm regarding its movement, behaviour as well as its organs. It possesses two powerful legs which, in some circumstances, may also serve as arms. The Drillworm's set of teeth is only a secondary tool compared to the highly corrosive acid in its mouth, which serves as both saliva and digestion fluid. While the teeth usually are used to crush or get hold of something, the acid is used for quickly dissolving earth and stone, transforming it to a mud-like mass that can be gobbled up by the Drillworm, thus allowing it to pass through. The body of a Drillworm is quite resilient, despite its colourless, almost translucent skin through which its massive muscles can be seen. Although blind by normal standards, its eye-like organs are highly effective heat sensors, and its antennae, which are usually feeling the stone surfaces, can sense even the most slightest of vibrations. These organs grant the creature extremely sharp…
drillworm.beh: Drillworms chase their opponents. They retarget very often.
drillworm.notes: Combines strong melee with nasty waves. Treat it like a Lizard High Guard.
drillworm.strat: Stay diagonal. Spawns in the vicinity of Giant Spiders, Earth Elementals and Wyverns. Knights: Stay diagonal always. At 100+ with decent skills these are no problem. Make sure to heal constantly and try to avoid fighting multiples. Sorcerers and Druids: Can easily bring them down by running them and using fire-based attacks. Remember not to stay in front of them because their poison beam deals very high damage. A good strategy is to throw Fire Walls to run them safely and avoid luring more monsters.
