The Firestartes were imprisoned in the dungeons beneath Shadowthorn. They are heavily guarded because the elves fear the Firestarters' wrath and the havoc they will surely wreak if ever released.
firestarter.strat: Try to get close to them, they are less likely to hit harder. Hide around corners and make them come to you. Consider them Elf Scouts using fire attacks. Sorcerers and Druids can kill them easily with ice attacks.

fish.name: Fish
fish.title: Fish (Creature)
fish.loc: Fiehonja - Ancient Ancestorial Grounds - Deepling Outpost - Deepling Temple Complex - Drowned Library
fish.desc: There are various types of Fish in Tibia. Ordinary Fish dwell in many lakes, ponds and of course Tibia's seas. They can be caught with a fishing rod or, once the ability of exploring the underwater worlds of Tibia has been acquired, be observed in their natural environment.
fish.notes: It is a living Fish. It will become an edible Fish when it dies.
fish.strat: Just kill them, they drop dead pretty much right away.

flameborn.name: Flameborn
flameborn.title: Flameborn
flameborn.notes: Hellspawn's boss. Part of the Paw and Fur Society tasks of Grizzly Adams. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. The portal which leads to the boss is in northwest of Restricted Area of Magician Quarter, .

flamecaller-zazrak.name: Flamecaller Zazrak
flamecaller-zazrak.title: Flamecaller Zazrak
flamecaller-zazrak.loc: Muggy Plains, south of the Temple of Equilibrium (Zao), , and on the mountain north of Chaochai, .
flamecaller-zazrak.notes: Lizard Dragon Priest's boss, spawns with 0-2 Lizard Legionnaires and 0-2 Lizard High Guards.
flamecaller-zazrak.strat: Kill it quickly, since it can be annoying with its strong attacks, invisibility and fast self-healing. Area runes and spells are useful to use against this creature to cancel its commonly used invisibility. Paladins should be 80+ with assassin stars before trying to solo, but it's better to kill with a partner if you're under level 100. Knights should use chase opponent option and use Fierce Berserk and Great Health Potion when needed. Lower leveled mages should kill using Sudden Death Runes and Avalanche as well as Mana Shield.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.title: Flamethrower
flamethrower.beh: Flamethrowers shoot Fire Attacks at their targets. They are fixed in position, unable to move.
flamethrower.strat: Get away from them as fast as you can. They rarely retargets. If you are killing a pharaoh, get a blocker to absorb damage. You may also use a Demon Skeleton/Fire Devil/Fire Elemental to block the damage, because they are immune to Fire-Based Attacks.

flamingo.name: Flamingo
flamingo.title: Flamingo
flamingo.loc: Tiquanda, Shattered Isles, Gardens of Night ( , unreachable).
flamingo.desc: The Flamingo is a beautiful but rather useless bird. Its meat is not edible and only its feathers might have some value. Chasing this shy but fast bird is not recommended since you can quickly run in one of the predators of the jungle, and to expose yourself to this danger is not worth it. Some wealthy persons like to adorn their gardens with those lovely birds, and since it is quite difficult to catch a Flamingo alive, these animals achieve good prices on the market.
flamingo.beh: They always run when a player is on screen.
flamingo.strat: Just attack them, they don't attack.

fleabringer.name: Fleabringer
fleabringer.title: Fleabringer
fleabringer.loc: Steppe of Zao. Can be found in , in , on the surface around and possibly other places. Spawns with 2-5 Insect Swarms.
fleabringer.strat: Any vocation above level 25 can kill up close, but lower level Mages and Paladins should keep their distance.

fleshcrawler.name: Fleshcrawler
fleshcrawler.title: Fleshcrawler
fleshcrawler.notes: Ancient Scarab's boss. Part of the Paw and Fur Society tasks of Grizzly Adams. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. The portal which leads to the boss is in the deepest floor of a Larva Cave near the northwest exit of Ankrahmun. Its teleporter is located [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 129.20-128.26-11-2-1-1 here].
fleshcrawler.strat: Treat it like a slightly stronger Ancient Scarab. Mages under level 60 are recommended to use Mana Shield, since they could die instantly by an unfortunate combo. You can cast a Energy Wall Rune on the ground and run him around, that way no damage will be taken. Be sure to cast it straight, otherwise he can make a shortcut.

fleshslicer.name: Fleshslicer
fleshslicer.title: Fleshslicer
fleshslicer.notes: One of the new Hive Bosses. Part of the War Against the Hive Quest.
fleshslicer.strat: Separate it from other monsters, stand diagonally and take it down.

flickering-spirit-elemental.name: Flickering Spirit Elemental
flickering-spirit-elemental.title: Flickering Spirit Elemental
flickering-spirit-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Monk's part - Spirit Sphere.

flimsy-lost-soul.name: Flimsy Lost Soul
flimsy-lost-soul.title: Flimsy Lost Soul
flimsy-lost-soul.desc: Most souls that become lost in the afterlife are aimless wanderers without much conscience and awareness. They are often easy prey to the unnatural predators of the nether realms that feast on them in one way or the other. When not entirely destroyed by such vicious attacks those souls are changed forever. The 'leftovers' became more of an environmental hazard than anything else. Now completely barren of thought or purpose, they roam the planes before the afterlife with a hungry unawareness. Oblivious to anything but an unnameable greed they are drawn to live like moths to a candle. Their only purpose seems to be this need to devour, without even realising what it is that they want or need. Their hungry attacks aim to the life force of anything living and come close to damaging the very soul of the target. Perhaps with more sentience and purpose the attacks of the flimsy souls could drain and devour the souls of the living and actually change the state of their victims in horrible ways. Luckily such concurrences seem to be extremely rare but this is a development that is closely monitored by those who dabble into the knowledge of the netherworlds. The flimsy souls are…
flimsy-lost-soul.beh: Uses mana drain but only against druids. This mechanic was confirmed to be intended in a by Skerio on 23.01.2020.

floating-savant.name: Floating Savant
floating-savant.title: Floating Savant
floating-savant.desc: Floating savants are reanimated husks that are inhabited by the spirit of a deceased scholar. Technically they are created from the bodies of burnt out guardians of tales. Sometimes the guardians absorb too much or too dangerous knowledge so their minds become destroyed. Not to waste their nigh immortal bodies, they are salvaged to host the mind of a notable Zaothroth scholar of any race who reaches the end of his lifespan. Through secret arcane rituals the mind is extracted from the dying body and fused with the soulless shell of the guardian. The process is not without danger though and often the transfer shatters mind and soul of the scholar. For most followers of Zathroth taking that risk pales compared to the opportunity to pursuit their quest for knowledge for an eternity. The new physiology requires a long time of recuperating and adjusting for the savants. Especially the floating is a difficult art to master for most. While newly created floating savants retain their original personality, over the centuries their new body with little need for sleep, nutrition and worldly pleasures changes their behavior and outlook on the world significantly. Emotions and most ambitions…

flying-book.name: Flying Book
flying-book.title: Flying Book
flying-book.loc: One can be found and in each section of the Secret Library.
flying-book.desc: The flying books are a creation of the squid race. They developed special sets of runes to write down their psionic knowledge while encrypting it at the same time. Over time they figured out how to arrange the psionic runes to create certain effects. The hovering of the flying books was the very first breakthrough in this area. In the centuries that followed, the squid race honed their skills and created a own caste of 'authors' to create weaponized books with psionic powers that emulate spells. Most of these tomes are hidden from the eyes of foreigners in their hidden enclaves. But the rather common flying books accompanied their squid masters to many of the laces they went to. The flying books are so mundane and replaceable for the squids, that they don't take great care of them and just leave them behind when they leave an area. Sometimes skillful magicians managed to re-purpose the flying books and subvert their control by binding them to their own. Though not particular more powerful then comparable bind golems the sheer rarity of flying books outside the squid community make them a prestige object for many aspiring magic users. Warnings that those books might have been just…
flying-book.notes: It can be tamed using a Library Ticket .

foam-stalker.name: Foam Stalker
foam-stalker.title: Foam Stalker

ab.r: 367; 3 rounds increasingly bigger ring up to 5sqm

foam-stalker.desc: Foam stalkers are elemental water creatures. On Marapur they emerge from the spray of waterfalls cascading down from the mountains. Since they cannot survive on land for long, they quickly retreat below sea level after their emergence and thus populate the reef caves beneath and around Marapur. Because of their elemental bodies, it is often difficult to distinguish them from the water around them. As they roam the reefs, they often capture coral branches, flotsam, pearls or small fish with their swirling bodies. These objects can then be seen swirling around in their watery shapes.

football.name: Football
football.title: Football (Creature)
football.loc: It was first seen near the Rathleton Magistrate on the Test Server prior to the Summer Update 2014. It also spawned in Thais during the same Test Server.
football.beh: Constantly rolling around, does no damage.
football.notes: It is a Football moving out of own intentions.
football.strat: You can't kill it. Give up.

foreman-kneebiter.name: Foreman Kneebiter
foreman-kneebiter.title: Foreman Kneebiter
foreman-kneebiter.beh: Foreman Kneebiter chases the opponent until death.
foreman-kneebiter.notes: Foreman Kneebiter will disappear one hour after spawning.
foreman-kneebiter.strat: Knights: Knights should have good skills like 75/75. But it is recommended to have 80/80. Of course you don't know when you will meet him so you may die because of bad skills and a low amount of supplies. However a backpack of health potions should be enough. If you are Premium you should use Berserk-like Spells too. Sorcerers, the best way is to simply run using your best wand while shooting strike Spells like Death Strike if you are Premium. If you are non-premium you should still use your best wand and run. Using Fireball runes instead of Flame Strike/Death Strike is a good idea too. Just keep distance. Druids should use their best rods like a Underworld Rod or a Hailstorm Rod combined with Flame Strike/Death Strike. If you are non-premium, use Fireball runes. Mages can shoot Sudden Death runes. It's easier and faster. Paladins need good skills. Use royal spears combined with either Ethereal Spear or Fireball runes.

foreshock.name: Foreshock
foreshock.title: Foreshock
foreshock.beh: After taking some damage he will transform into Aftershock and vice versa.
foreshock.notes: A boss in the Heart of Destruction Quest.

forest-fury.name: Forest Fury
forest-fury.title: Forest Fury
forest-fury.loc: Forest Fury Camp, Dryad Gardens and in the Forest Fury version of the Forsaken Mine.
forest-fury.desc: The forest furies are the tragic product of careless experiments with the waters of Ashar'tel. Inspired by the rebellious amazons of Carlin, some young and restless elven maiden founded a sisterhood of their own. The futility of their protest against the rigid elven society and it's rule soon drove them to foolhardy dangerous ways of protest that bordered on criminal acts and endangered them of becoming outcasts. In an desperate attempt to hold her sisterhood together, their leader Emana Greenskull staged the theft of several amphora with the waters of Ashar'tel, branding the sisterhood as outcasts and binding her followers to her by taking from them the option to peacefully return to the society. With little knowledge about the water, but convinced it contained power, the elders refused the younger ones, Emana and her sisters inhibited themselves with the water. At first they truly felt the surge of power that they expected. But the water became like a drug the them and slowly changed their very nature and mutated them into something else. Convinced that the voices they heard in their inhibition were revelation from nature itself, the sisters embraced their change and even…
forest-fury.strat: Similar to a Hunter (albeit more durable), but has two annoying debuff attacks that are especially harmful to Paladins, who are recommended to take it out before any Wilting Leaf Golem. Mages should kill it with fire. For knights it is recommended to use a two handed weapon because of their shielding skill reduction that makes shields almost useless and furies are usually accompanied by Wilting Leaf Golems, which fight in close combat.

fox.name: Fox
fox.title: Fox
fox.loc: Forests of Edron, Cormaya, possibly other places.
fox.desc: Foxes are medium-sized, omnivorous mammals that live in the forests and mountains of Tibia. They are smaller than wolves and unlike many canids, foxes are not always pack animals. Typically, they live in small family groups, but some are known to be solitary. They eat insects, small reptiles, birds, mice, eggs and berries.
fox.beh: They fight in close combat until death.
fox.notes: They are sometimes summoned by Werefoxes.
fox.strat: Just kill them like you would kill a Wolf.

frazzlemaw.name: Frazzlemaw
frazzlemaw.title: Frazzlemaw

ab.r: reducing about 40-80% of your base speed

frazzlemaw.loc: Lower Roshamuul, Guzzlemaw Valley, the entrance to Upper Roshamuul.
frazzlemaw.desc: Frazzlemaws are fast, fierce and above all - biting creatures. Once scented, it is not easy for a human being to escape them. Basically a ball of teeth, they have neither eyes nor ears, they are simply upon this world to feast. Their arch rivals are the equally fast and ferocious silencers. They usually avoid each other as both have strengths and weaknesses which would outmaneuvre one against the other. They share some kind of strange religion with their larger siblings, the guzzlemaws.
frazzlemaw.notes: It is essentially a big mouth; it eats anything it finds. They are Guzzlemaws' smaller cousins. Along with the Guzzlemaws they worship a god called the Overmaw.

freakish-lost-soul.name: Freakish Lost Soul
freakish-lost-soul.title: Freakish Lost Soul
freakish-lost-soul.desc: Freakish lost souls are some of the more self aware souls which, caught in their own cycle of damning thoughts, will still posses some form of animalistic instincts of self preservation. In a subconscious way they have learned to fight back the many attackers and predators that roam the nether realms. Still they often lack the power or finesse to fend off their attackers and are left scarred and changed forever. Somewhat battle-hardened they change over time and become an own subcategory of entity. On the surface they are like animals while in their core they are just another tormented soul, captured in this ghostly shell they subconsciously animate. In the contrary to flimsy lost souls, freakish souls like animals can actually learn things and react purposely, albeit with rather limited intelligence. In rare occasions a spiritualist was able to reach the trapped consciousness in a freakish lost soul and had a form of limited conversation, which rendered the instinctive side of the soul inactive for the remainder of the contact. As soon as the contact is broken, however, the animal takes over again and reacts extremely angry and hostile, using all of its capabilities to attack…
freakish-lost-soul.beh: Uses mana drain but only against druids. This mechanic was confirmed to be intended in a by Skerio on 23.01.2020.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.title: Frenzy
frenzy.notes: Appears with The Rage and with the World Devourer in the Heart of Destruction Quest.

frost-dragon.name: Frost Dragon
frost-dragon.title: Frost Dragon
frost-dragon.loc: Okolnir, Razachai, Ice Witch Temple, Frost Dragon Tunnel, Yakchal Crypt (only during Yakchal's awakening ritual), Dragonblaze Peaks, Deeper Banuta, Chyllfroest.
frost-dragon.desc: The constant consumption of strange magical particles which were strongly connected to the element of ice changed this type of dragons into a new breed over time. Even though they are still young compared with other dragons, they carry a strong dragon heritage and the consumed particles fuelled their strength even more. Their arrogance does not allow them to be something less than other dragons and so their temper is even worse than that of their dragon cousins. The feeling to have to prove themselves all the time makes them reckless and aggressive and with that even more dangerous. Frost Dragons usually get along well with other dragons for a while. However, mixed communities often suffer from prejudices and lethal infights between the species. Though the mostly younger Frost Dragons often lack the refined magic abilities of their cousins, they are usually more powerful when it comes to physical abilities. Their newly gained control over the element ice easily makes up for their missing command of fire. They still possess a quite impressive resistance against fire from their dragonic heritage. Unlike other dragons, the Frost Dragons do not live alone or in small families. Instead…

frost-dragon-hatchling.name: Frost Dragon Hatchling
frost-dragon-hatchling.title: Frost Dragon Hatchling
frost-dragon-hatchling.loc: Okolnir, Factory Quarter (Yalahar), Dragonblaze Peaks, Ice Witch Temple, Frost Dragon Tunnel, Chyllfroest.
frost-dragon-hatchling.desc: The offspring of the mighty frost dragons does not get pampered much by their parents. Exposed to the harsh climate, the Frost Dragon Hatchlings are taught the hard way the well-known rule of survival of the fittest. Only the most resistant and healthiest survive the first months. The always hungry hatchlings compete for food and shelter. Moreover, elder dragons too pose a constant threat as they do not shrink from devouring their own offspring in times of need. Constantly in need to raise their status in the pecking order of their lairs, the Frost Dragon Hatchlings improve their skills and become probably more lethal opponents than the ordinary adult dragon might be. Only rarely they hunt in the wilderness; it is much more likely to encounter the hatchlings in their lairs, supporting their relatives in their fight against intruders who are foolish enough to set a foot in the frost dragons' territory. The hatchlings tend to attack rather swiftly and deadly as they have to see to it that they get their food and loot before somebody else of their kin steals the prey.
frost-dragon-hatchling.beh: They are slow and attack with waves.
frost-dragon-hatchling.notes: Fairly low hp, gives good experience but not good loot. After Update 8.2, they drop a rare spellbook.
frost-dragon-hatchling.strat: For any vocation, keep diagonal to avoid the waves. Treat them like a normal dragon. They commonly attack with Avalanche and Ice Wave simultaneously. Mages who are Level 35 and under should use Mana Shield. Summons work do well when facing these; it is best to run them and use Energy Damage. Paladins should run these, just like a Wyvern, by shooting and avoiding the wave attacks. The Exori con spell is of tremendous benefit here, so use it often. Likewise, Flash Arrows are well-suited to employ against this reptile. A level 37 Paladin with 67 Distance Fighting using a normal Bow can, for example, expect to use 13 of these energy arrows per kill, on average. As hatchlings are so stingy with their loot, and the cost of these specialized arrows so high, this is hardly economical, but it certainly makes for good Powerleveling. An alternate strategy is to come at them with Royal Spears and a very good shield, e.g. 31 defense, and use Exori con continuously. In any event, bring lots of Health and Mana Potions, or expect a trip to the Temple. Knights will typically Melee them and lure with caution, as other Hatchlings and even Frost Dragons are found together. Skills of 70/70 and a good…

frost-flower-asura.name: Frost Flower Asura
frost-flower-asura.title: Frost Flower Asura
frost-flower-asura.desc: Asuri are demonic creatures who usually hide their true face and appear in the form of beautiful women. Though they can take different shapes they favour a seductive appearance, for example in the form of young dancers. These demonesses are driven mainly by greed and envy. They enter the mortal world because they begrudge humans and other peoples their vigour, beauty and happiness. They seek to destroy positive feelings as love, contentment and mirth, because herefrom they gain their energy. An asura especially stalks men she regards as handsome and happy. These victims are lured into gorgeous palaces full of riches and conveniences, inhabited by several asuri. There they ensnare the men with amusements such as wine, music, dance and intoxicating substances that indulge their senses and make them submissive and weak-willed. Then the asuri divest them of vitality and beauty. When an asura gets weary of her victim or if captives unexpectedly oppose the demonesses, these unfortunates come to know the true face of the palace: As the asuri show a beautiful face outwardly and are in truth terrible demons, likewise the palace, behind its marvelous veneer, is full of prison cells, torture…

frost-giant.name: Frost Giant
frost-giant.title: Frost Giant
frost-giant.loc: Tyrsung (in the Jotunar mountain), Formorgar Glacier (single spawn), Mammoth Shearing Factory, Chyllfroest.
frost-giant.desc: Frost Giants are an extremely ancient race that inhabits the most northern parts of the world. Far to the north where it is cold enough to freeze even air, this race has its original home. In ancient times, when the gods waged war on each other, the world climate was shifting often. At this time, some tribes of the Frost Giants wandered to the south, following the biting cold and expanding their territory. Entire kingdoms crumbled under their feet. The Frost Giants became the ruler of the frozen waste and their icy kingdom grew every day. One day though, the seemingly eternal winter ended. Temperatures were rising again and most Frost Giants fled to the northern home of their ancestors. However, some of them became trapped on their retreat, cut off by the ocean that once used to be a frozen surface which could easily be crossed. Many of those unlucky Frost Giants perished either by the warm temperatures or by enemies who easily overwhelmed them in their weak condition. Some, however, were able to find refuge at places just cold enough to sustain their existence. Still those places are not well suited as they are much too warm for Frost Giants. Cut off from the northern Frost Giant…
frost-giant.beh: Frost Giants fight to the death, they can push objects and can't be pushed.
frost-giant.notes: Similar to a Cyclops Drone. They are the male counterpart of Frost Giantesses.
frost-giant.strat: Treat these like a Cyclops Drones.

frost-giantess.name: Frost Giantess
frost-giantess.title: Frost Giantess
frost-giantess.loc: Tyrsung (in the Jotunar mountain), Formorgar Glacier (single spawn), Mammoth Shearing Factory, Chyllfroest.
frost-giantess.desc: The Frost Giantesses are even more ill-tempered and aggressive than their male counterparts. In the North, it is a running gag that the Frost Giantesses are supposed to be the real reason why the frost giants are humourless and easily provoked. As a matter of fact, the frost giants are, compared to their female counterparts, rather dull-witted. The Frost Giantesses usually employ weapons more often than the male giants.
frost-giantess.beh: She likes to keep distance between her and the target, while throwing boulders.
frost-giantess.notes: They are the female counterpart of Frost Giants.
frost-giantess.strat: Run to them and attack or use a distance weapon or runes. Be careful when chasing them as they can lure you into more groups of frost giants.

frost-servant.name: Frost Servant
frost-servant.title: Frost Servant
frost-servant.loc: Ice Witch Temple, second floor, in the centre when Zushuka has spawned.
frost-servant.beh: Frost Servants chase their opponent and try to obstruct them from defeating their master, Zushuka.
frost-servant.strat: There is no reason to kill Frost Servants unless they are blocking your path to the ice pillar or the altar. You must kill Zushuka to stop the Frost Servants from spawning. You can use Energy Wall Runes to stop the Frost Servants from blocking you while you destroy the pillars. For more, see the strategy of Zushuka.

frost-spider.name: Frost Spider
frost-spider.title: Frost Spider
frost-spider.loc: Ice Witch Temple, second floor, in the centre when Zushuka has spawned.
frost-spider.beh: Frost Spiders chase their opponent and try to obstruct them from defeating their master, Zushuka.
frost-spider.notes: They are weaker than Crystal Spiders but they come in masses. When they are killed they will shortly be replaced by another.
frost-spider.strat: There is no reason to kill Frost Spiders unless they are blocking your path to the ice pillar or the altar. You must kill Zushuka to stop the Frost Spiders from spawning. You can use Energy Wall Runes to stop the Frost Spiders from blocking you while you destroy the pillars. For more, see the strategy of Zushuka.

frost-troll.name: Frost Troll
frost-troll.title: Frost Troll
frost-troll.loc: Bittermor, Edron Troll Cave, Folda, Formorgar Glacier, Formorgar Mines, Krimhorn, Ragnir, & Senja.
frost-troll.desc: Frost Trolls are a variety of normal trolls that live in the holes and dungeons of the ice islands in the north-west of Tibia. Like their cousins, they hunt animals and seek treasures. But they are a bit stronger than them and can be quite dangerous to inexperienced adventurers.
frost-troll.notes: They are stronger than regular Trolls.
frost-troll.strat: Just attack them, there's no big difference between them and Trolls. They are strong to Fire Damage so be careful. Frost Trolls usually appear with other monsters, such as Badgers, Polar Bears, Winter Wolves and Mammoths.

frostfur.name: Frostfur
frostfur.title: Frostfur
frostfur.beh: Fights until death in close combat.
frostfur.strat: Very weak. Treat him like a strong wolf. Just attack it.

frozen-raubritter.name: Frozen Raubritter
frozen-raubritter.title: Frozen Raubritter
frozen-raubritter.loc: Inside the boss room of the Court Warlock.

fruit-drop.name: Fruit Drop
fruit-drop.title: Fruit Drop
fruit-drop.desc: These candy creatures are downright cheerful fellows. When they roam Candia's surface, they like to play hide and seek in the lollipop fields or between the peppermint trees. If they work in the chocolate mines, they are in charge of adding fruit essences and extracts to the chocolate, to enhance and add flavour to the mix. They are very friendly and sweet (both figuratively and literally), and enjoy working with the different fruits and experimenting with new flavour combinations. They add the special touches to the chocolate, such as fruit peels, extracts, and essences. Fruit drops are creative and innovative, always looking for ways to make the chocolate mixture more delicious and pleasing to the senses. The fruit drops and their mint drop cousins also keep the big ice cream machine underneath the gingerbread palace going.

fugue.name: Fugue
fugue.title: Fugue
fugue.kind: Members of the Order of the Lion
fugue.notes: It's one of the Usurper leaders trying to take control of the Order of the Lion. Part of The Order of the Lion Quest.
fugue.strat: Fugue is similar in strength to Grand Master Oberon, though its many summons can make the fight more dangerous. For a small team or even a duo with a blocker and healer it isn't very complicated and should be rather straightforward damage dealing. Without a blocker, or at lower levels (<400), a good strategy is to pull Fugue outside of the room and close the door, protecting yourself from the Usurpers. After that, you can also use the stairs to go down in case of an emergency or to heal your Special Summon, if using it. Bear in mind that Fugue disappears if it's not killed a few minutes after it spawns, which can hinder the solo strategy with stair-hopping ineffective.

fungosaurus.name: Fungosaurus
fungosaurus.title: Fungosaurus
fungosaurus.loc: Possibly at Sparkling Pools, Crystal Enigma and Monster Graveyard.
fungosaurus.notes: They can appear if a Primal Pod is not dealt with in time, or during the fight against The Primal Menace if a Primal Pack Beast is not killed in 20 seconds after spawning. A Fungosaurus will despawn if it is not killed within 5 minutes of spawning.
fungosaurus.strat: If they appear during the hunt you should deal with them as you would with the other creatures, just being extra careful with its Root and Fear spells. During the fight against The Primal Menace, they should not be a priority, since you will have to keep killing other Primal Pack Beasts in order to continue the fight.

furious-fire-elemental.name: Furious Fire Elemental
furious-fire-elemental.title: Furious Fire Elemental
furious-fire-elemental.notes: Furious Fire Elementals are entities consisting only of fire. They have been spotted in a cave in Hellgate where it's far too hot to survive for very long. Part of The Repenters Quest.
furious-fire-elemental.strat: Kill them quickly before they can deliver too much damage. It is recommended to run towards them, since they do their distance attacks less often.

furious-morshabaal.name: Furious Morshabaal
furious-morshabaal.title: Furious Morshabaal

ab.n: Ice Chain (damage increases for each player hit)

furious-morshabaal.loc: Morshabaal appears inside a teleporter that spawns at the stone circle in the northwest of Edron, . Only characters of level 150 or higher can enter
furious-morshabaal.notes: It is a stronger version of Morshabaal and Enraged Morshabaal and shares most of its properties with them, except that it takes less damage and reflects more damage.

furious-scorpion.name: Furious Scorpion
furious-scorpion.title: Furious Scorpion
furious-scorpion.beh: It fights in close combat but also throws arrows from distance.
furious-scorpion.notes: Part of The Secret Library Quest.
furious-scorpion.strat: You will be teleported into the room on the eastern side. As you walk to the west into the room, 4 Skeleton Elite Warriors, 2 Undead Elite Gladiators, and the Furious Scorpion will spawn in the room with you. You can use Energy Bomb Runes on path to protect yourself from the creatures so you only have to deal with the boss. Be careful for the other creatures in the room as they will still do distance damage. You have 5 minutes to kill the boss, loot the chest and leave through the teleport to the south.

furious-troll.name: Furious Troll
furious-troll.title: Furious Troll
furious-troll.beh: Fights to the death in close combat, often summoning Mechanical Fighters.
furious-troll.notes: They can be found in an area accessible during the Royal Rescue Quest.
furious-troll.strat: Kill Furious Trolls first and fast, don't waste time on mechanical fighters (unless you are trapped) because trolls will summon new ones nearly instantly.

fury.name: Fury
fury.title: Fury
fury.loc: Pits of Inferno (Apocalypse's Throne Room), The Inquisition Quest (The Shadow Nexus, Battlefield), Vengoth, Fury Dungeon, Oramond Fury Dungeon, The Extension Site, Grounds of Destruction and Halls of Ascension.
fury.desc: These female demons are known to enrage themselves into such hatred and fury that their hair starts to burn and tiny flames sprout all over their body. Although of deceptive beauty, the Fury is a bloodthirsty monster that knows no remorse. A Fury will not listen to logical arguments or accept surrender. Fight is everything they think about and care for. Her hands can turn into fiery claws that can shred a shield to pieces with ease and their incredible strength belies their slender and fragile stature. A Fury's hatred is so strong that it provides them with an unearthly resilience which can only be stopped by death. Literally too hot-headed to lead any sizeable force into battle, the demons employ them on missions of carnage and chaos. Even when not in combat, they tend to destroy things just for the fun of it. After all a Fury is a creature of hatred and destruction. Some demons employing the services of Furies keep them chained until the very last moment. Needless to say that this treatment drives the Fury in an even greater frenzy. Other demons enjoy to lock up prisoners in a cell with a handful of Furies and to watch the spectacle.

fury-of-the-emperor.name: Fury of the Emperor
fury-of-the-emperor.title: Fury of the Emperor
fury-of-the-emperor.notes: Part of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.

ab.n: Armageddon when saying Back in black!

ab.r: 10000 only once and when on red hp

gaffir.name: Gaffir
gaffir.title: Gaffir
gaffir.kind: Members of the Order of the Cobra
gaffir.notes: It's an Order of the Cobra boss. Part of the Grave Danger Quest.

gang-member.name: Gang Member
gang-member.title: Gang Member
gang-member.loc: Throughout the Foreigner, Factory, and Trade Quarters in Yalahar.
gang-member.desc: Even small cities often have gangs roaming its streets, pressing money from travellers and shop owners alike. Some gangs might follow a noble cause or only consist of some youths that banded together for protection, but in the harsh reality of Tibia, most gangs are nothing than urban bandits. Usually led by one or two powerful and charismatic individuals, they claim parts of the city as their territory. The borders of these territories are often disputed among gangs and are subject of violent and bloody fights. The inhabitants that live in such a territory mostly have arranged themselves with the situation, accepting it as given as the rule of the local king. Gang Members are usually encountered in groups, especially in greater cities with warring gangs. They tend to talk a lot about respect and honour but this is rather to comfort themselves, trying to forget how low they have come and what harm they do to the people around them. When it comes to combat they are all cowards, one way or the other. While some of them might fight to the bitter end, most will flee from it when the going gets rough.
gang-member.beh: Will run with 35 or less hp.
gang-member.notes: Usually found along with other Gang Members and Outlaws. Their melee attack is quite strong.
gang-member.strat: Similar to Nomads and Bandits. Easy to kill by players above level 20. Also good training Creatures for Knights with Skills around 60/60.

gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
gargoyle.title: Gargoyle
gargoyle.loc: Meriana Gargoyle Cave, Ankrahmun Tombs, Mal'ouquah, Goroma, Deeper Banuta, Formorgar Mines, Vengoth, Farmine Mines, Upper Spike and Medusa Tower.
gargoyle.desc: Although Gargoyles are a common sight all over Tibia, the origin of this remarkable species remains clouded in mystery. In fact, a reward offered by the great wizard Cyrius the Half-Bald to those who could solve the mystery was never claimed. However, one or two interesting facts have been discovered. It is widely agreed today that Gargoyles prefer dark places,which is why they are typically found in dreary dungeons and other subterranean complexes. There they breed and hunt, using their uncanny ability to blend in with the stony surfaces of their lairs.
gargoyle.beh: They seem to retarget on the player with the highest level around.
gargoyle.notes: They can be used as a training monster, but they heal very slowly. It's better to train with two if you can and switch targets when one has low health. You may hunt 200 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
gargoyle.strat: They are easier than a Cyclops, but rarely come without other creatures.

gazharagoth.name: Gaz'haragoth
gazharagoth.title: Gaz'haragoth
gazharagoth.loc: Spawns every day at Server Save on top of the central mountain in Upper Roshamuul (+2 floor, ), until killed for the first time. Once this happens, spawns rarely as a raid in the Roshamuul Prison (-5 floor, ).
gazharagoth.beh: Gaz'haragoth fights his opponents in close combat. Gaz'haragoth has many announced abilities: * - Announced rarely. Five seconds after being announced, Gaz'haragoth will cast his ultimate attack. This attack always deals 30,000 Energy Damage. When he casts it, there will be another announcement: * - Announced very often. When announced, Gaz'haragoth casts his explosion, which deals 1000 Ice Damage. * - Announced every time he is hit if he is not at his summon capacity. When he announces this, Gaz'haragoth will attempt to summon up to 2 Minions of Gaz'haragoth. It will fail if Gaz'haragoth has no room to summon. * - In about 8 seconds, Gaz'haragoth will heal himself for 300,000. When he does, another message is announced:
gazharagoth.notes: Gaz'haragoth is a Demon Prince who was once of overseeing Roshamuul, until the explosion of the Dream Catcher mutated him into his current form. After a world breaks Roshamuul's wall, Gaz'haragoth is found on top of the mountain at the center of the island, and will remain there until it is defeated. Upon defeat, Gaz'haragoth is cast to the Roshamuul Prison lowest levels, where it will be imprisoned in a secure room. Even so, eventually he gathers considerable strength and can be fought again. Before he appears, the following message is broadcast in white text to all players of the world he spawns in: :
gazharagoth.strat: Gaz'haragoth has a large energy UE, announced 5 seconds before its execution. He also summons multiple minions of Gaz'haragoth which act independently of him. Care must be taken while navigating Gaz'haragoth's lair, as the minions transform into Strange Vortices, leading to Gaz'haragoth's Nightmare. The strategy to defeat Gaz'haragoth is similar whether he is fought on top of the mountain or locked in the prison. The primary difference lies in the player's levels, as the initial encounter will likely involve lower-level characters. === Luring and Trapping === * Lure Gaz'haragoth to a corner, preferably near a ramp, to provide shooters with a quick escape route. * Trap Gaz'haragoth using Magic Walls and Wild Growth, leaving enough space for him to summon one or more minions of Gaz'haragoth. * Once trapped, kill the summoned minions to free the luring knight. On Open PvP servers, players can also pass through another player's wall. * After the knight escapes, fully trap Gaz'haragoth to immobilize him and focus all firepower on the boss. === Critical Phase === * When the team has managed to defeat Gaz'haragoth's health down to 12.5%, he will use his nightmares to heal himself. * At…

gazer.name: Gazer
gazer.title: Gazer
gazer.loc: Hellgate bonelord cave, Vandura Bonelord Cave, also anywhere Elder Bonelords exist, as summons.
gazer.desc: Gazers are the spawn of the bonelords. Sometimes a bonelord splits up a part of itself that functions like a slimy egg which evolves into a Gazer at incredible speed. Right from its 'birth', the Gazer owns some basic intelligence which it has been inherited by its parent bonelord. Still it has only vague memories, and also no concrete knowledge but rather some instinct of an underdeveloped magic. It is said that elder bonelords can spawn Gazers even without producing an egg, but this offspring is usually flawed and dies rather quickly.
gazer.notes: A baby Bonelord, summoned by Elder Bonelords.
gazer.strat: If there are more than one Summoned Gazers, it is useful to use Great Fireball to kill them quickly. Mostly a mere nuisance, their strength is comparable to that of a Chakoya Windcaller.

gazer-spectre.name: Gazer Spectre
gazer-spectre.title: Gazer Spectre
gazer-spectre.desc: The Dire Spectres arrived as phantoms to this world. Born from dark fragments of lost souls, they are not bound to this plane, nor do they have a past. They long for a physical existence and their sole goal is to anchor themselves to our world. They are literally pure evil woven from bad spare parts of souls and feed on the life energy of any living creature. The most powerful dire spectres are the oldest. Those who clung to this plane for long enough, eventually gained adequate power to control and coordinate other spectres. Those are the most dangerous and resourceful and should be treated with the utmost care. Gazer Spectres are also called "Watchers" and function as scouts among large groups of their kin. They are versatile distance fighters and their strong 'gaze' is not to be trifled with.
gazer-spectre.beh: Reflects Fire Damage. Does not change target unless challenged or its way is blocked.
gazer-spectre.strat: It's two strong attacks are fired from a distance, so you should be careful even if they aren't at melee range. Avoid using Fire Damage at all costs since it will reflect it back to you 66% stronger.

gelidrazah-the-frozen.name: Gelidrazah the Frozen
gelidrazah-the-frozen.title: Gelidrazah the Frozen
gelidrazah-the-frozen.loc: On Okolnir, after starting the quest you can enter the teleport right here .
gelidrazah-the-frozen.notes: This boss can only be fought when First Dragon Quest is active.
gelidrazah-the-frozen.strat: Treat it like a stronger Frost Dragon, kill it with Sudden Death Runes.

general-murius.name: General Murius
general-murius.title: General Murius
general-murius.notes: General Murius is the leader of Markwin's army of Minotaurs. He can most often be found supporting the minotaur troops in Mintwallin. You can use an Obsidian Knife on his corpse in order to get a Minotaur Leather. He is thought to be an allusion of General Marius, who was a general in Ancient Rome.
general-murius.strat: One way to kill it is with a blocker and SD's. Another way to kill it is with Firebomb runes (look at the screenshot). Stand in the Lvl 30 door in Markwin's room, firebomb the fields infront the door, wait for General Murius to come close, go behind the door, wait for General Murius to go few steps away, lure him again by going in the door, and so on. General Murius will run through the fire all the time and after a while he will die. You only need lvl 30 to enter the door, but other doors would also work.

ghastly-dragon.name: Ghastly Dragon
ghastly-dragon.title: Ghastly Dragon

ab.r: starting up from 46-63 hp per turn

ghastly-dragon.loc: Ghastly Dragon Lair, Corruption Hole, Razachai including the Inner Sanctum, Zao Palace, Deeper Banuta (single spawn, ), Chyllfroest.
ghastly-dragon.desc: Ghastly Dragon is the best translation one can come up with for the unpronounceable word that the lizard people use for this creature. It seems the Ghastly Dragon is not a sub-race of the dragons but some sort of intended transformation. Sages assume that Ghastly Dragons are the failed result of a self-initiated transformation of some ancient dragon. While probably the original aim is to reach some state of transcendence, the failed outcome is a creature trapped between the spirit world and the mortal realm. The failed transformation often dangerously maddens the dragon creature. Even those who against all odds manage to retain their sanity have to cope with the knowledge that they turned in some, even in their own eyes, abominable creature instead in the intended ascended being. This leads to the fact that also the few sane specimens are usually not less aggressive and destructive than their mad fellows. Although the legends of the lizard folk also tell about some extremely wise and benevolent Ghastly Dragons, most of them that have been encountered are dangerous and powerful. The transformation of their bodies has changed their abilities significantly. They can draw upon immense…
ghastly-dragon.beh: These creatures run at low health, and a very good thing about them is that they don't change attack often.
ghastly-dragon.notes: Its damage is similar to a Plaguesmith's, but with stronger attacks, especially the curse, so don't let your hp drop below 1500 and do not underestimate them. This creature was added with the Christmas Update 2009. Their head looks the same as that of a Wyrm. You may hunt 500 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Ethershreck.
ghastly-dragon.strat: All vocations: The Ghastly Dragon's death attacks should be less effective if you wear a Death/Butterfly Ring or Koshei's Ancient Amulet/Cobra Amulet. Depending on your vocation, you can use one of the following: Skullcracker Armor, Robe of the Underworld, or Divine Plate. It is also advisable not to fight a Ghastly Dragon while cursed, as they will make you receive 20% more Death damage from time to time. Be careful, otherwise you can take up to 1721~ curse damage. A good tactic if you have a mage or paladin in the party is to use fire bombs or fire walls. As long as someone is next to it, it will not leave even when it is in low hp to run. Knight: It is strongly not recommended to hunt them for profit due to a lack of ability to cure curse. You will find yourself healing the curse damage even after the Ghastly Dragon is dead. You should be at least level 140 (160+ if you are going to hunt them in Zao Palace) because it is common to encounter 2 or more Ghastly Dragons together. Using any death protection will help to decrease its curse attack. Paladin: You must be at least 130 level with a distance skill of 90+ to solo this creature without waste. Use Assassin Stars (Much more…

ghazbaran.name: Ghazbaran
ghazbaran.title: Ghazbaran
ghazbaran.loc: Formorgar Mines, in the pit with the Juggernaut.
ghazbaran.beh: Ghazbaran runs away in low health. He also casts a defense spell on himself which will temporarily reduce every attacker's skill (depending on what he hits with) to 0. He will only remain in the realm for 4 hours.
ghazbaran.notes: Ghazbaran - the "Lord of Blades", is a member of the Triangle of Terror. The cultists in the Formorgar Mines are said to be trying to revive the frozen demons in there to conjure the mighty archdemon. They are melting the ice in his name. The first time he appeared after the test server was on the server of Julera on July 4, 2007. The first time he died was on the server of Candia on September 22, 2007. Ghazbaran can be seen with at least 5 Deathslicers, 2 Juggernauts, 2 Furies, and 1 Demon. The furies and demon appear to spawn with Ghazbaran, along with some of the deathslicers. Some of the deathslicer are summoned by Ghazbaran.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.title: Ghost
ghost.loc: Ghost Ship, Drefia, Ankrahmun Tombs, Mount Sternum Undead Cave between Thais and Kazordoon, Dark Cathedral, under Treasure Island, Isle of the Kings, Grothmok tunnels (in Dwarven Mines), Goroma, Ramoa, Lich Hell, Upper Spike.
ghost.desc: Ghosts have been spotted in the haunted ruins of Drefia on Darama. Some people say that they are the souls of the former inhabitants, which died in that horrible disaster destroying the once beautiful city. Indeed they are supernatural in some way, as no physical weapon can hit them, and their shivering touch makes their opponents loose some vitality.
ghost.notes: These Creatures are immune to Physical Damage, however, they can be damaged by weapons that have been enchanted or come with natural enchantments such as a Fire Axe or a Fire Sword. They are not weak to Holy Damage, unlike most other undead creatures.
ghost.strat: Use Full Defense mode and shoot runes, Wand, Rod or enchanted weapon that use fire, ice, energy or holy element. They move slowly, so running from them is not difficult. A good strategy for knights hunting in tombs (where it's common to encounter ghosts) is to bring a fire sword/axe or another enchanted weapon, that way you don't need to waste any Runes.

ghost-of-a-planegazer.name: Ghost of a Planegazer
ghost-of-a-planegazer.title: Ghost of a Planegazer
ghost-of-a-planegazer.beh: Stays at a distance shooting its magic.
ghost-of-a-planegazer.strat: If you decide to kill it, get a team of 3+ players using Fire spells and weapons (such as Flaming Arrows), as well as Fire Elementals.

ghostly-apparition.name: Ghostly Apparition
ghostly-apparition.title: Ghostly Apparition
ghostly-apparition.loc: They may appear at Vengoth Castle hall and Treasure Hunt Island.
ghostly-apparition.beh: Ghostly Apparitions keep distance from their targets.
ghostly-apparition.notes: Ghostly Apparitions may appear in groups of 2 to 5 at Vengoth Castle's hall. They will eventually disappear. They may also appear at Treasure Hunt Island during .
ghostly-apparition.strat: It cannot be killed. To avoid them, do not stay inactive at the castle hall.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.title: Ghoul
ghoul.loc: Ancient Temple in the Skeleton area, way to Mintwallin, Old Mintwallin Quest, Alatar Lake, Magician Tower, Mount Sternum Undead Cave, Ghostlands, Hellgate, Maze of Lost Souls, below Point of No Return in Outlaw Camp, Plains of Havoc in Necromant House, Drefia and Drefia's underground caves, Edron ghoul hill, Venore Amazon Camp underground, Venore Swamp Troll cave, Ghostship between Venore and Darashia, Triangle Tower, Dark Cathedral, Ankrahmun tombs, Forgotten Tomb, Isle of the Kings, Treasure Island, Nargor Undead Cave, Helheim, Lion's Rock, The Witches' Cliff (only accessible during a…
ghoul.desc: Ghouls are undead monsters that live in the holes and dungeons of Tibia. They are quite strong and extremely dangerous if they crop up in packs. Hiding in the darkness, they wait for incautious adventurers. They can heal themselves and suck life energy out of their opponents.
ghoul.notes: Unlike most of their undead counterparts, Ghouls leave bloodstains when damaged.

ghoulish-hyaena.name: Ghoulish Hyaena
ghoulish-hyaena.title: Ghoulish Hyaena
ghoulish-hyaena.beh: Can sprint extremely fast for a short time.
ghoulish-hyaena.strat: Despite their weak appearance Ghoulish Hyenas can be very dangerous to lower levels.

giant-spider.name: Giant Spider
giant-spider.title: Giant Spider
giant-spider.loc: Plains of Havoc, Point of no Return in Outlaw Camp, Ghostlands, Hellgate, Mintwallin Secret Laboratory, Mad Mage Room deep below Ancient Temple, Mount Sternum Undead Cave, Green Claw Swamp, Maze of Lost Souls, Crusader Helmet Quest in the Dwarf Mines, Mushroom Gardens, west drillworm cave, Edron Hero Cave, Edron Orc Cave, on a hill near Drefia ( ), on a hill north-west of Ankrahmun (inaccessible), Forbidden Lands, Deeper Banuta (2 small spawns, and ), Malada, Ramoa, Arena and Zoo Quarter, second floor up of Cemetery Quarter, beneath Fenrock, Vengoth Castle, Vandura Mountain, in a cave in…
giant-spider.desc: Giant Spiders live in holes in the mountains of Tibia. They are among the most powerful monsters and are so fast that it is nearly impossible to flee. They can summon poison spiders and throw poison fields.
giant-spider.beh: When using haste, Giant Spiders have similar speed to that of a level 80 character. They chase their prey relentlessly, spit poison fields around and summon Poison Spiders. Be careful, as the summoned spiders will sometimes appear in front of you, blocking your path. Giant Spiders will push or kill the Poison Spiders they summon in order to reach you and attack you with melee. Be sure to kill these spiders off first as they will break your shielding. Giant Spiders have a terrifyingly low attention span, switching targets often. Common lure in the Plains of Havoc.
giant-spider.notes: Giant Spiders used to be one of the most feared monsters, mainly because of the locations they could be found in. Some years ago, they were often being lured to Venore, Dwarf Bridge, and the roads near it. They were commonly found in places one would never expect to find such a beast. Giant Spiders used to be immune to fire but now they are weak to it. You may hunt 500 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face The Old Widow.
giant-spider.strat: Giant Spiders seem to enjoy changing targets, the blocker should use Challenge if they have Premium Account and should stand between the Giant Spider and the shooters. This makes retargetting less likely. While blocking you should also kill the Poison Spiders so they don't break your shield. Note also that they have the ability to destroy Fire Fields with their own Poison Fields if you're planning on hunting them with Fire Bombs or Fire Walls. There are two very good places for a first solo kill, one in the , use Levitate or Parcels, it has low space to run (recommended for Knights); keep in mind than other player can move the parcels or you could be caught without mana and be unable to escape with Levitate. The second (for all vocations) is on a small island in the [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=127.255-124.230-7-4-1-1&mark1=127.242-124.230-7-20&mark2=127.253-124.230-7-6&mark3=127.215-124.234-7-12 Green Claw Swamp], with a fairly decent space to run and stairs to escape in case of an emergency. The entrance is near Wyda's house (the skull in the map), on the way you will find creatures like Rotworms, Witches, Wasps, etc Knights can kill them with a good weapon and…

giant-spider-7-4.name: Giant Spider 7.4
giant-spider-7-4.title: Giant Spider 7.4
giant-spider-7-4.notes: This creature can only be seen during the Tibia Anniversary celebration.
giant-spider-7-4.strat: Lure it to the bridge, otherwise it will heal itself completely after every assigned hit. Explosive Barrels can be used to kill these monsters.

giant-spider-brood-7-4.name: Giant Spider Brood 7.4
giant-spider-brood-7-4.title: Giant Spider Brood 7.4
giant-spider-brood-7-4.notes: This creature can only be seen during the Tibia's Anniversary.
giant-spider-brood-7-4.strat: Lure it to the bridge, otherwise it will heal itself completely after every assigned hit. Explosive Barrels can be used to kill these monsters.

giant-spider-brood-7-6.name: Giant Spider Brood 7.6
giant-spider-brood-7-6.title: Giant Spider Brood 7.6
giant-spider-brood-7-6.notes: This creature can only be seen during the Tibia's Anniversary.
giant-spider-brood-7-6.strat: Lure it to the bridge, otherwise it will heal itself completely after every assigned hit. Explosive Barrels can be used to kill these monsters.

giant-spider-brood-8-1.name: Giant Spider Brood 8.1
giant-spider-brood-8-1.title: Giant Spider Brood 8.1
giant-spider-brood-8-1.notes: This creature can only be seen during the Tibia's Anniversary.
giant-spider-brood-8-1.strat: Lure it to the bridge, otherwise it will heal itself completely after every assigned hit. Explosive Barrels can be used to kill these monsters.

giant-spider-drone-7-4.name: Giant Spider Drone 7.4
giant-spider-drone-7-4.title: Giant Spider Drone 7.4
giant-spider-drone-7-4.notes: This creature could only be seen during the Tibia's 20th Anniversary.
giant-spider-drone-7-4.strat: Lure it to the bridge, otherwise it will heal itself completely after every assigned hit. Explosive Barrels can be used to kill these monsters.

giant-spider-hatchling-7-4.name: Giant Spider Hatchling 7.4
giant-spider-hatchling-7-4.title: Giant Spider Hatchling 7.4
giant-spider-hatchling-7-4.notes: This creature can only be seen during the Tibia's Anniversary.
giant-spider-hatchling-7-4.strat: Lure it to the bridge, otherwise it will heal itself completely after every assigned hit. Explosive Barrels can be used to kill these monsters.

gingerbread-man.name: Gingerbread Man
gingerbread-man.title: Gingerbread Man
gingerbread-man.desc: As the name says, gingerbread men are comprised entirely of gingerbread dough, baked and hardened, their limbs and physique crafted to look like a humanoid figure. Their faces, painted with icing, show a cheerful expression and they possess a rather kind and caring disposition. Gingerbread men are crafted and molded out of dough and sugar by truffles who are either bored or lonesome. Then they mould a little figure out of gingerbread dough as a friend and playmate. Although the resulting gingerbread men eventually go their own ways and explore beautiful Candia, they usually form a lifelong friendship with the truffles that have baked them.

girtablilu-warrior.name: Girtablilu Warrior
girtablilu-warrior.title: Girtablilu Warrior
girtablilu-warrior.desc: The Girtablilu, also known as Scorpion Men, have the head, torso and arms of a man and the lower body of a scorpion. The reclusive creatures are a subspecies of the Anuma, magical beasts that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh and were created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. It is said that the entire continent was once given to them by the gods. But the Anuma conferred the dominance over Kilmaresh to the humans, in an effort to let them take responsibility of their own. However, after the religious war between the worshippers of Suon and Fafnar and the cataclysm that severed the continent, the Anuma took the reign over Kilmaresh back - for the humans' own benefit as they said. It is told that the girtablilu were first created by the sun god Suon in order to serve him and his sister Fafnar. They stood guard outside the gates of Suon's and Fafnar's temple high in the sky above Tibia, in a time when the divine siblings had not yet fallen out with each other. The scorpion men opened the doors for Suon and Fafnar as they traveled out each day, and closed the doors after them when they returned at night. They also protected the entrance the Land of Darkness. Ancient writings tell that…
girtablilu-warrior.strat: Their Sudden Death Berserk can deal a lot of damage. Mages shoud keep distance to avoid being bursted down.

gladiator.name: Gladiator
gladiator.title: Gladiator
gladiator.loc: Trade Quarter, Arena and Zoo Quarter
gladiator.desc: Gladiators are professional warriors. Some of them are desperate or unscrupulous beings that willingly joined the ranks of the Gladiators, however, most Gladiators were forced into service by masters who had some sort of power over them. Already the training of the Gladiators is cruel and lethal and causes many dead bodies. In the past, the Gladiator profession seems to have been more noble than today and people came mainly to watch the impressive fighting skills. Nowadays, however, Gladiator fights are brutal and bloody battles which mostly end deadly. Only a few arenas have specialised in harmless fights which end after the first blood was spilled. Several cities have banned arena fights as they are too dangerous. When the games in Yalahar had become more and more cruel in order to distract the masses from other problems, more and more Gladiators were replaced with criminals and mercenaries of various races. At some point, the Gladiators rebelled and tried to take over the city. Even though the revolt failed in the end, the arena quarter was lost to the revolting forces. The Gladiators could not maintain some sort of leadership, though, and their community quickly splintered…
gladiator.beh: Runs at very low health, can't move items and can be pushed.
gladiator.strat: Behaves just like a Wild Warrior, though has the same HP and exp as a Tortoise and gives slightly better loot. Use the same strategy to kill him.

glitterscale.name: Glitterscale
glitterscale.title: Glitterscale
glitterscale.notes: Part of A Father's Burden Quest. Its corpse cannot be skinned or looted. Its respawn time can differ, but might go as low as 3 minutes 10 seconds.
glitterscale.strat: A little bit stronger than a regular Dragon.

gloom-maw.name: Gloom Maw
gloom-maw.title: Gloom Maw
gloom-maw.desc: Some beasts are born in darkness, others are forged in it. The Gloom Maws belong to the latter. Their origin is shrouded in secrecy and screams, birthed not in the wilds, but in blood-drenched breeding pits deep within the Norcferatu stronghold. It is said that these monstrosities were bred from ancient, winged horrors smuggled from the domain of the Blood God himself, then force-fed corrupted vitae, mutilated, and subjected to a brutal process of survival through slaughter. Only the most vicious survived. Only the most relentless were permitted to grow. And grow they did. Now, towering over men and horses alike, the Gloom Maws prowl the night skies. Their wings span wide as war banners, their claws thicker than scimitars, their fanged maws large enough to swallow a man whole. They are both beast and siege engine, terror and transport. Many Norcferatu commanders ride them into battle, believing the sheer horror they invoke weakens enemy morale before a single spell is cast or blade drawn. The Gloom Maw is more than a mount - it is a living weapon, a symbol of the grotesque ambition at the heart of the Norcferatu's campaign. And when it descends, it brings not just death - but…

gloom-wolf.name: Gloom Wolf
gloom-wolf.title: Gloom Wolf
gloom-wolf.desc: The gloom wolf differs from an ordinary wolf in some respects. On the one hand it is significantly bigger and stronger, on the other hand it has inky black fur and glowing red eyes. Because of its appearance and its unusual strength there are numerous tales about the gloom wolf not being an ordinary animal but rather a kind of dire wolf or even a spawn of shadow. Some tell that it emerges from black magic or that usual wolves are transformed to gloom wolves by wicked spells. Others claim that gloom wolves come into being at places where many wolf packs were killed as a kind of avenging shadow creatures, similar to ghosts.

gloombringer.name: Gloombringer
gloombringer.title: Gloombringer
gloombringer.loc: Temple of Light, during certain circumstances in the Lightbearer event.
gloombringer.strat: It is not advised to kill this monster, they are not intended to do so and give bad loot and experience.

glooth-anemone.name: Glooth Anemone
glooth-anemone.title: Glooth Anemone
glooth-anemone.loc: Rathleton Sewers, Underground Glooth Factory, Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon
glooth-anemone.desc: The glooth anemone is a strange plant creature that is considered a parasite. The thing is, that this parasite is actually by far bigger then it's hosts. The glooth anemone mimics the harmless plant, also known as glooth anemone. The latter is a major food source and habitat for the gloothworms which are essential for Rathleton's economy. The glooth anemone creature in able to deceive the gloothworms into accepting it as a host and then devours the glooth that their produce. Not does it devour more glooth then the tiny worms can spare without perishing, the glooth anemone also somehow forces the gloothworms to produce excessive amounts of glooth, which often drains them to death even before they can die through glooth starvation. Due to this destructive nature the glooth anemone had to cope with the extermination of it food source that it causes in it's own. The glooth anemone copes with that problem by being mobile. Their mobility has brought up speculations that it's rather a creature, posing as lant then a creature that evolved from the harmless and docile glooth anemone to a predatory parasite. While in the past the glooth anemone was a minor nuisance, the glooth-production…

glooth-bandit.name: Glooth Bandit
glooth-bandit.title: Glooth Bandit
glooth-bandit.desc: Glooth Bandits, as they also call themselves, hang out at the more or less abandoned tunnels and sewers under Rathleton. As usual bandits they try to gain something of value for themselves, but they are also highly interested in new glooth-based inventions and weapons. Glooth Bandits are often in the possession of a wide variety of weapons, their armour has usually at least one glooth-based component. They set up their hideouts in secluded and often dangerous caves, tunnels and sewers. Involved in many illegal activities, they can be found in the service of all kind of persons that want some dirty work performed. Mostly though, the theft of new glooth weapons is their main purpose.
glooth-bandit.beh: The Glooth Bandit will chase down its foes, firing arrows if they try to escape.
glooth-bandit.notes: The Glooth Bandits are a criminal gang. Their main operation is to steal valuable resources for their mastermind's research into mutated glooth. They are oblivious to their mastermind's activities and goals.
glooth-bandit.strat: Knights: Try to not get surrounded by a lot of them, as they tend to take a while to kill between their good amount of Hit Points, physical resistance and Self-Healing on top of dealing high, constant damage. They can be hunted with good profit around level 150 if care is taken.

glooth-battery.name: Glooth Battery
glooth-battery.title: Glooth Battery
glooth-battery.loc: Second floor of the Underground Glooth Factory, south side.
glooth-battery.strat: Paladins and mages can easily take this without taking the strong poison storm damage.

glooth-blob.name: Glooth Blob
glooth-blob.title: Glooth Blob
glooth-blob.loc: Oramond/Western Plains, Lower Rathleton, Glooth Factory, Underground Glooth Factory, Rathleton Sewers.
glooth-blob.desc: The glooth blob is the result of careless experiments with glooth and lesser critters like rats, insects and birds. Whatever the original purpose of the experiments may have been, the outcome was a slimy mass of semi sentient glooth. To make matters worse the products of the experiments were deemed a failure and discarded. That way several test subjects escaped and multiplied by splitting themselves after they gained a certain amount of size. The experiments were stopped and the magistrate ordered the files about them to be securely hidden and classified highly confidential. It seems in the beginning there were several strains that could be considered glooth blobs but eventually only one discernible strain seems to have survived. The blobs are often drawn to glooth sources though they seemingly not actively absorb it. Only in times before they split they actively consume glooth and glooth residue in great masses so it is assumed glooth is necessary for their reproduction. It is speculated though, that the glooth could possibly substituted by something else but the magistrate put an end to further investigations in that matter. Though the glooth blob is not actively aggressive it…
glooth-blob.strat: Watch closely which blob is the mother blob to prevent killing summons. Using area attacks can be useful if you don't know which blob is the original one.

glooth-bomb.name: Glooth Bomb
glooth-bomb.title: Glooth Bomb
glooth-bomb.loc: Second floor of the Underground Glooth Factory, south side.
glooth-bomb.beh: It will attack someone that is in its melee range.
glooth-bomb.notes: The Bomb travels north, leaving Fire Fields in its wake. It does not destroy or remove objects in its path—instead, it walks over them, including Magic Walls, Wild Growth trees, and enemy monsters (without harming them). While it cannot pass through players, it will forcefully push them 2 squares ahead of itself. Upon reaching the northern walls of the Underground Glooth Factory, the Bomb explodes, dealing 1000 damage to everyone nearby and destroying the southern plant wall, allowing monsters to pass through. You will obtain the achievement Robo Chop when you help to defeat a Glooth Bomb.
glooth-bomb.strat: Gather a team of 10 or more players to kill it. It's strong to all damage types, so use your best weapons and spells on it. Be careful with the other creatures around, specially if there's a raid happening. Watch out for the Glooth Batteries as their area spell can cause quite a lot of damage.

glooth-brigand.name: Glooth Brigand
glooth-brigand.title: Glooth Brigand
glooth-brigand.desc: Glooth Brigands, as they also call themselves, hang out at the more or less abandoned tunnels and sewers under Rathleton. As usual bandits they try to gain something of value for themselves, but they are also highly interested in new glooth-based inventions and weapons. Glooth Brigands are often in the possession of a wide variety of weapons, their armour has usually at least one glooth-based component. They set up their hideouts in secluded and often dangerous caves, tunnels and sewers. Involved in many illegal activities, they can be found in the service of all kind of persons that want some dirty work performed. Mostly though, the theft of new glooth weapons is their main purpose.
glooth-brigand.beh: The glooth brigand will chase down its foes, firing arrows if they try to escape.
glooth-brigand.notes: The Glooth Bandits are a criminal gang. Their main operation is to steal valuable resources for their mastermind's research into mutated glooth. They are oblivious to their mastermind's activities and goals.
glooth-brigand.strat: Knights: Try to not get surrounded by a lot of them, as they tend to take a while to kill between their good amount of Hit Points, physical resistance and Self-Healing on top of dealing high, constant damage. They can be hunted with good profit around level 150 if care is taken.

glooth-fairy.name: Glooth Fairy
glooth-fairy.title: Glooth Fairy
glooth-fairy.beh: Fights in close range, often will stop chasing a fleeing character and walk around aimlessly for 2-3 seconds before retargetting passing through fire fields to attack a nearby player.
glooth-fairy.notes: Access granted through the Rathleton Quest, where it can only be faced if it was the most voted one for the period. Talk to Flora to spend 1 voting right to enter its lever room. When the lever is pulled, a message will appear ( ) and anyone inside the room will be teleported to the boss room after 1 minute. Be aware that when entering its lever room, you can not leave, teleport, or logout, and the only way to leave it is to pull the lever. The lever will only reset to its regular position after 16 minutes and 40 seconds have passed, so it is also important to not enter the lever room if it is not ready, or you will be stuck until the cooldown has passed. The fight itself is limited to 15 minutes. Looks identical to a Glooth Golem.
glooth-fairy.strat: Entrap him with Fire Field Runes, then strike, avoiding his beams. When he is deep in the red health, he will heal for about 12.5% of his total health (around 7,500 HP). So, focus your strongest attacks on him before he heals. However, he can only do this three times, so you can also just proceed with your attacks until he has been killed. Another strategy is to use a Fire Wall Rune in the middle of the room and two Energy Wall Runes in the shape of a box while luring him over the energy fields while avoiding his melee attacks.

glooth-golem.name: Glooth Golem
glooth-golem.title: Glooth Golem
glooth-golem.loc: Glooth Factory, Underground Glooth Factory, Rathleton Sewers, Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon, Oramond Dungeon (depending on Magistrate votes).
glooth-golem.desc: The glooth golems that many see as the epitome of Rathletons science are indeed based on cryptic designs that were found in excavations under the city. The odd design patterns were secreted away and studied for years by the best of Rathletons scientists. Not fully understanding the concepts they adapted the few ideas they were able to grasp and integrated them into Rathletons machinery. Only with the discovery of glooth and glooth-based material and power the adaptation of the strange designs advanced dramatically. Still most designs still were rather crude and huge but some daring inventors dared to dream the impossible. Not truly knowing what principles they were applying they begun to rebuild some mechanisms on the excavated designs. This lead to the creation of the first machine men. This machines were first only mocked designs that had to be operated and powered remotely but again it was the glooth that proved to be the saviour. It provided not only a means to supply the automatons with power but also enabled the scientists to give them a fixed set of orders and behaviour patterns. Though not able to handle more complex situations the glooth powered golems provided…
glooth-golem.beh: In spite of the experience received from this creature, its fighting capabilities can easily match a War Golem's or Behemoth's.
glooth-golem.strat: All Vocations: These creatures frequently come in groups with other Glooth Golems, Rustheap Golems, Glooth Anemones and Devourers. Be extremely careful as their very frequent Blood Rage and Skill Reducer Beam can maximize the melee damage output from both themselves and other creatures, overwhelming those who are unprepared. Staying diagonal at all times is recommended if possible.

glooth-horror.name: Glooth Horror
glooth-horror.title: Glooth Horror
glooth-horror.notes: He is the second "boss" of the Hero of Rathleton Quest. Weakened Glooth Horrors will split into 2 Glooth Horrors. When slain, the Glooth Horror will turn into 2 Strong Glooth Horrors.

glooth-generator.name: Glooth-Generator
glooth-generator.title: Glooth-Generator
glooth-generator.strat: Kill it before it explodes, you have around 14-15 seconds to do so.

gnarlhound.name: Gnarlhound
gnarlhound.title: Gnarlhound
gnarlhound.loc: Zao Steppe, Gnarlhound Caves. Four inaccessible ones can be seen in Telas's basement.
gnarlhound.desc: Gnarlhounds are aggressive beasts with a frightening set of askew teeth. As distant relatives of the hyaena, their jaws are strong and can crush bones with ease. Rather a coward, the Gnarlhound forgets quite fast about its fear when it gets angry, and it takes only little to anger one of those beasts. Their aggressiveness often offsets their cowardice and suppresses the impulse to flee. Instead they transfer it into wild and vicious behaviour which often looks quite similar to canine madness. The Gnarlhound was one of the mammals that the lizard people raised as livestock to meet the ever-growing need of food. This led almost to the extinction of the wild population of Gnarlhounds. After the collapse of the southern areas, the Gnarlhounds turned feral once again. Missing any major competition in the food chain, the Gnarlhound population grew as quickly as that of the orcs. Sharing the same habitat, both races clashed quite often. In the end, most Gnarlhounds accepted their place in the pecking order beneath the orcs. Ever since, they seem to have some agreement from which post sides benefit. The Gnarlhounds serve the orcs as hunting animals, beasts of burden, mounts, and…
gnarlhound.beh: They usually haste towards you upon first sight, but are not that powerful.
gnarlhound.notes: Gnarlhounds are a good food source in the plains of Zao and they're fairly easy to kill, so if you need food before going anywhere, just kill a few of them on your way to stock up. They are the Zao edition of normal Tibia's bears and wolves, only merged together. They are really fast, so if you are in a hurry and leaving all weak monsters behind, pay attention to those creatures, because you can accidentally lure a lot and take some damage. Be careful when hunting them in Gnarlhound Caves because if you run into a Lancer Beetle on lower levels you will take a lot of damage. This creature was added with the Christmas Update 2009. You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
gnarlhound.strat: Any vocation above level 25 can kill up close, but lower level Mages and Paladins should keep their distance. Knights can hunt them at lvl 15 with skills 55/50 without problems.

gnomevil.name: Gnomevil
gnomevil.title: Gnomevil
gnomevil.beh: Gnomevil attacks the player dealing the most damage.
gnomevil.notes: Gnomevil was a member of the Gnomes who turned evil. It is said that his size "grew with evilness".
gnomevil.strat: Gnomevil's low healing capabilities and relatively weak offensive make him the easiest warzone boss to kill, despite being the boss of the second. Gnomevil's toughest move is his melee. His beams cause mana drain, electrification and burning, making him easier for knights to block. If trapped, Gnomevil's damage can be countered with relative ease. The general strategy is to have 3-4 players (preferably knights) block Gnomevil's adjacent squares and have the shooters fire until he's dead. The player being attacked by Gnomevil (usually the highest level mage) should position themselves behind the main blocking knight, so that Gnomevil is most commonly facing them, absorbing the beams for the other knights to save mana. Challenge is probably a bad idea while Gnomevil is trapped because it would direct strong melee damage to the knight for a single turn, before Gnomevil again retargets to the highest damage dealer. For small team, it's recommended to trap boss where he spawn with 1 or 2 blockers and all shooters should stay north west of boss, this way boss wont chase them if one of blockers stand 1sqm north of his spawn position.

gnorre-chyllson.name: Gnorre Chyllson
gnorre-chyllson.title: Gnorre Chyllson
gnorre-chyllson.notes: Is the boss of Warlord Level, Pit #7. Next #8.
gnorre-chyllson.strat: Although he shoots beams and waves, BE SURE THAT HIS FIELD ATTACKS are very strong. Keeping in diagonal helps to avoid waves. Also is recommended to use Protection Amulet to reduce physical damage. Knights should use Fierce Berserk since it is weak to Physical Damage. Paladins may use Assassin Stars.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.title: Goblin
goblin.loc: Femor Hills, north east of Carlin, Edron Goblin Cave, Rookgaard (Premium Area), Maze of Lost Souls and Fenrock.
goblin.desc: Goblins are human-like creatures that live in small tribes in the hills in the centre of Tibia. They are ugly, stinking beings that mainly live on tubers and roots. They are weak but cunning fighters and use their slings to ambush and rob travellers.
goblin.notes: They closely resemble Trolls but throw Small Stones and provide slightly better items.
goblin.strat: Be careful in Rookgaard, because they can hit hard! You can hunt them profitable from Level 6 with decent equipment. In Mainland they are usually hunted for Small Stones which is the Paladin's popular light training weapon. After update 8.5, the small stones drop rate has been reduced.

goblin-assassin.name: Goblin Assassin
goblin-assassin.title: Goblin Assassin
goblin-assassin.loc: Femor Hills, Edron Goblin Cave and Fenrock.
goblin-assassin.desc: All goblins employ stealth and treachery as legitimate means to win a battle. This goes so far that the goblin culture actually encourages and adores such methods. Though Goblin Assassins are hardly anything else than 'wannabe assassins', they are indeed the most tricky and cunning of their kind. They use everything at their disposal for fighting including dirty trick. They enjoy stealthy attacks and the use of paralysing poison to eliminate their enemies. Amongst their kind, they are revered as heroes. They often hold high positions, gained by trickery to get rid of other contenders for leadership. Every goblin chieftain has a bunch of assassins as close advisors. Since the king knows that his advisors would gladly stab him in the back to succeed him as chief, he plays a difficult game of playing off the Goblin Assassins against each other and sending them on suicidal missions to get rid of them. So, being a Goblin Assassin is a mixed blessing. It is desirable as it ensures a position of power which all goblins long for. At the same time, it is a threat for a goblin's life.
