Even though they do not have a lot of health, their defence alone is very strong, they possess some physical damage resistance on top of that, they hit very hard in close range and reduce melee and shield skills quite often. In general, it is not advised to hunt ice golems as a knight. However, if you are level 60+, have a Scrapper-level weapon and good skills (at least…

ice-horror.name: Ice Horror
ice-horror.title: Ice Horror
ice-horror.notes: Part of The Roost of the Graveborn Quest. Icy Crypt Rune can drop only after the quest has been fully completed. Its cooldown can be reset by using a Icy Horns.

ice-overlord.name: Ice Overlord
ice-overlord.title: Ice Overlord
ice-overlord.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Paladin's part - Ice Sphere.
ice-overlord.beh: Behaves similar and looks like a Massive Water Elemental.
ice-overlord.notes: * Since Summer Update 2009, it always drops Flawless Ice Crystal.
ice-overlord.strat: Stay diagonal to avoid its ice beam. Use Assassin Stars and Exori San. A team of 2–3 players is recommended to defeat 3 or more Ice Overlords. A paladin can typically solo 2 overlords per 8 ice soils. In the south-east corner, there is a spot where you can stand diagonally so the overlord cannot hit you with the beam. It is preferable to kill the last overlord in this position.

ice-witch.name: Ice Witch
ice-witch.title: Ice Witch
ice-witch.loc: Ice Witch Temple, tower in Krimhorn, caves around Hrodmir ('camps' area), Formorgar Glacier deepest mines, Magician Quarter in Yalahar (Level 60 Requirement Door).
ice-witch.desc: Ice Witches are fallen shamans who rose from the ranks of the raiders and learned their arts from their head shaman. They rely on some strange kind of substance or drug to maintain their powers over ice and cold. Several of them serve the raider tribes with their magic, others are on missions for their sinister leader and can be encountered almost everywhere in the North. Again others became renegades and work only for their own agenda. Those renegade witches are even more hostile and dangerous. Ice Witches make use of icy variants of known spells and are schooled in the basics of shamanism and nature magic. This strange blend of sorcery and animism hints that they have been influenced by both magical schools in some way. It is speculated that a sorcerer might have tried to 'convert' shamans to the conventional ways of teachings and shared some wisdom with them.
ice-witch.notes: This creature fights much like a Necromancer, however doesn't summon, but paralyzes instead and have a tough armor. Be warned, if you're turned into a snowman your invisibility will be canceled. Ice Witch had 540 Hit points before Summer Update 2009. Ice Witches heal a lot, it could be a good idea to team with a mage to shoot Thunderstorms at groups. Since summer update 2009 all loot from this creature became rare drops, most witches you kill will be empty, so you'll be hunting for a while to get anything from them.
ice-witch.strat: Hunt it like a necromancer, however, because it use more melee attacks, summoning a demon skeleton doesn't work as well as it does for Necromancers. Try to corner it and kill it fast. Knights: Run up to her and melee her fast. Paladins: Try to trap the witch in the corner and stand 1 sqm away on the diagonal (this will avoid ice waves and maximize your damage). Mages: Approach her and use Energy Strike or Death Strike and rod/wand to kill her.

icecold-book.name: Icecold Book
icecold-book.title: Icecold Book
icecold-book.desc: Most icecold books are creations of a long gone race of cryomancers. This race casted their spells always with the books as conduit and amplifier. Therefore they bound powerful spirits of frost and ice into their tomes. The levitating books accompanied them as companions and tools at once. With the vanishing of their creator race, the icecold books became inert. Hungry for the knowledge contained in them, they were stolen and experimented upon. The only way found to unleash their considerable power, was to empower them with a will of their own and bind certain arcane crystals attuned to icemagic into them as an energy source. Thus the books became self-sustained entities that had access to at least some of the ancient spells bound to them. They follow an icecold, yet somewhat malignant logic and can be reasoned with to some degree. Since their creators seemed to have had some deeper connection to Zathroth, they easily ally with his forces. Still they act on their own and might behave strongly unpredictable. Almost indistinguishable from them are newer creations that were attempts to recreate them with modern magic. Though less powerful and less intelligent, these copies are highly…

iceplume-strider.name: Iceplume Strider
iceplume-strider.title: Iceplume Strider
iceplume-strider.desc: Iceplume striders are constructs made from ice and shaped like long-legged birds. They bear a distant resemblance to the moas that inhabit Marapur. They are hollow and can be filled with various liquids: mana fluid, acid, blood - whatever the asuri find useful. The frost flower asuri created these constructs by shaping them from ice and enhancing them with moonsilver. Now they guard and patrol the old asura citadel beneath the Emerald Gardens of Marapur. Despite their fragile appearance, iceplume striders move with surprising speed and precision. With each step, their bodies crack faintly, shedding sharp tiny fragments of ice. When they attack, they strike with their long, pointed beaks, injecting their victims with the fluids they have been filled with.

ichgahal.name: Ichgahal
ichgahal.title: Ichgahal
ichgahal.notes: One of the bosses in the Rotten Blood Quest.

iks-ahpututu.name: Iks Ahpututu
iks-ahpututu.title: Iks Ahpututu
iks-ahpututu.notes: When an Iks Chuka, Iks Aucar, or Iks Pututu dies near one of the Crossed Spears in Iksupan, there's a chance that 5 Iks Churrascan will spawn. These Churrascan must be swiftly dealt with, as they will disappear if not killed within 15 seconds. However, once all 5 Churrascan are successfully eliminated within the time limit, a single Iks Ahpututu will spawn. It's important to note that, unlike the Churrascan, once the Iks Ahpuputu appears, it will not disappear after 15 seconds if not killed immediately. Therefore, players must focus on defeating the Iks Churrascan within the 15-second window to ensure the appearance of the formidable Iks Ahpuputu.
iks-ahpututu.strat: It will use one or more spells every turn at the same time of its autoattack. Sometimes it will chain 2 or 3 spells at once, dealing relatively high burst of damage. It will use its earth attacks about twice as often as the fire ones, so earth protection can make facing them safer for lower levels.

iks-aucar.name: Iks Aucar
iks-aucar.title: Iks Aucar
iks-aucar.desc: The Iks were an ancient civilization of proud warriors, builders and artists long lost to the world of Tibia. Their origins lie far from the known continents, only fragments of obscure lore and cultural remains tell of their history and legacy. A great catastrophe at the evolutionary height of their society led to exile and the scattering of surviving Iks in various parts of Tibia centuries ago. The Aucar are cursed remnants of the once proud Iks warrior caste. They are expertly trained in melee combat, formidable foes utilizing a rich set of effective moves and artistic flexibility. They are slower than other Iks but make up for this with raw power and aggressiveness.

iks-chuka.name: Iks Chuka
iks-chuka.title: Iks Chuka
iks-chuka.desc: The Iks were an ancient civilization of proud warriors, builders and artists long lost to the world of Tibia. Their origins lie far from the known continents, only fragments of obscure lore and cultural remains tell of their history and legacy. A great catastrophe at the evolutionary height of their society led to exile and the scattering of surviving Iks in various parts of Tibia centuries ago. The Chuka are cursed remnants of the stealthy backbone of Iksian warfare. Their light spears and poisoned arrows would often tip the battle in favour of their leaders. Used with proficiency and wile, they could lure their foes into vulnerable positions to strike swiftly and almost completely silent. Combined with the protection and power provided by their brothers in arms, the Chuka were a powerful asset for the armies of the Iks.

iks-churrascan.name: Iks Churrascan
iks-churrascan.title: Iks Churrascan
iks-churrascan.notes: When an Iks Chuka, Iks Aucar, or Iks Pututu dies near one of the Crossed Spears in Iksupan, there's a chance that 5 Iks Churrascan will spawn. These Churrascan must be swiftly dealt with, as they will disappear if not killed within 15 seconds. However, once all 5 Churrascan are successfully eliminated within the time limit, a single Iks Ahpututu will spawn. It's important to note that, unlike the Churrascan, once the Iks Ahpuputu appears, it will not disappear after 15 seconds if not killed immediately. Therefore, players must focus on defeating the Iks Churrascan within the 15-second window to ensure the appearance of the formidable Iks Ahpuputu.
iks-churrascan.strat: Kill it fast before it disappears.

iks-pututu.name: Iks Pututu
iks-pututu.title: Iks Pututu
iks-pututu.desc: The Iks were an ancient civilization of proud warriors, builders and artists long lost to the world of Tibia. Their origins lie far from the known continents, only fragments of obscure lore and cultural remains tell of their history and legacy. A great catastrophe at the evolutionary height of their society led to exile and the scattering of surviving Iks in various parts of Tibia centuries ago. The Pututu are cursed remnants of the warrior priests of the Iks. Their knowledge of arcane powers, nature's mysteries and intricate rituals provides them with a variety of deadly skills in combat. Their role in ancient Iks society was to be servants and an executive to high priests, Ahpututu. Shortly before the collapse of the Iks society, they often carried out their will with cold consequence and cruelty.

iks-yapunac.name: Iks Yapunac
iks-yapunac.title: Iks Yapunac
iks-yapunac.loc: Iksupan Last Stand, Iksupan Occupied Sanctuary, Iksupan Undercity, Iksupan Waterways
iks-yapunac.desc: The Iks were an ancient civilisation of proud warriors, builders and artists long lost to the world of Tibia. Their origins lie far from the known continents, only fragments of obscure lore and cultural remains tell of their history and legacy. A great catastrophe at the evolutionary height of their society led to exile and the scattering of surviving Iks in various parts of Tibia centuries ago. The Yapunac are stronger than most of their brethren and wield sacred ceremonial gear that enhance their combat prowess. They rank as some of the highest Iks warriors in the hierarchy and can be seen as a group of ancient special forces. Now long dead and controlled by their evil benefactors, they are a seemingly unstoppable force to be reckoned with.

imperial.name: Imperial
imperial.title: Imperial
imperial.loc: Arean Outskirts. Shares a Varying Monster Spawn with Deer and Stag.
imperial.desc: While red deer is known as a stag or hart, an imperial has a specific type of antler, known as a 14-pointer. On the Isle of Ada, home of Eldoran the Ambitious and his knights, there have been sightings of a specifically rare breed with silver gray fur. While it is allowed to hunt deer on the isle, the knights of the Stag have strict rules concerning the population of their game. Knights only hunt as many deer as needed or to keep their number in check in regards to nature and the other wildlife roaming their homeland. The silver imperial is said to have the most tender venison and majestic fur which some of the knights of the Stag use to garnish their armour. Not out of vanity, but out of respect.

incineron.name: Incineron
incineron.title: Incineron
incineron.notes: One of the Isle of Strife Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

incredibly-old-witch.name: Incredibly Old Witch
incredibly-old-witch.title: Incredibly Old Witch
incredibly-old-witch.beh: Like a common Witch, she keeps a distance from you but doesn't run away completely. She also switches targets often.
incredibly-old-witch.strat: She does not do any damage nor can she be killed. Part of Donkey taming method.

infected-weeper.name: Infected Weeper
infected-weeper.title: Infected Weeper
infected-weeper.loc: A total of 8 infected weepers spawn in Warzone 2, you can see the exact locations [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=129.27-124.202-11-2-1-1&mark1=129.26-124.215-11-21-1&mark2=129.35-124.172-11-21-3&mark3=129.63-124.191-11-21-3&mark4=128.251-124.226-11-21-1 here].
infected-weeper.strat: They are needed to break the wall to enter the teleport leading to Gnomevil room. Good idea is to trap them and after you clean the path to walls that are needed to break, lure them.

infernal-demon.name: Infernal Demon
infernal-demon.title: Infernal Demon
infernal-demon.desc: The infernal demons are fresh shock troops that arrived in Zarganash only recently. Mostly oblivious to the hostile environment and haughty with the self-image of superiority, these demons fear nothing and no one and see themselves as the new rulers of the realm by right, born out of might. Little do they know yet, about the transforming horrors that await them and will erode even their arrogance. For now they delight the torture and mayhem that they can wreak in the plane, seemingly mostly unsupervised by their superiors. More often than not those superiors used the assignment to Zarganash as a method to get rid of troublemakers and malcontents of all kinds. Of course this leads to high levels of internal power struggles and its quite common that small cabals are formed to acquire some temporary power, only to be on each other's throats as soon they notice the slightest weakness of their so-called allies. While evil and treacherous in their core anyway, the madness that gets an ever growing hold on them makes them dangerous even to their own kind. While they retain their conscience they more and more become victims of sudden urges, ideas that are not entirely their own but the…
infernal-demon.beh: It retargets very frequently and usually on the character with the lowest maximum health in its view. In most cases, that would be a Sorcerer or a Druid.
infernal-demon.notes: A Bag You Desire only drops for players who possess at least one of Goshnar's Taints . The more taints a player has, the higher the chance of receiving the bag. It is always dropped inside a Reward Container, ensuring it won't be left behind in the creature's corpse and can always be retrieved from the Reward Chest in the Adventurers' Guild.

infernal-frog.name: Infernal Frog
infernal-frog.title: Infernal Frog
infernal-frog.loc: Isle of Evil, Fading Isles, Gloom Caverns, Kazordoon Surroundings, Laguna Islands, Meriana, Port Hope Surroundings, Silent Waters, Silvertides, Sparkling Lagoon, Stardance Mountains
infernal-frog.strat: Just kill it, but take care if your level is lower than 45, because a group of them and other Isle creatures can make you waste some potions, even if they don't have a lot of attack power by themselves.

infernal-phantom.name: Infernal Phantom
infernal-phantom.title: Infernal Phantom
infernal-phantom.desc: Zarganashs hostile environment gave birth to an own breed of phantom that differs by the hazards that help to form them from the tormented souls they once were. The infernal phantom absorbed that much demonic energy that there is little to distinguish them from demons at all. With demonic incursion in Zarganash the amount to demonic residue has increased dramatically and what was once a rare occurrence is now a common sight in certain areas. Though their form follows that of other phantoms for all other regards they are more a demon than ghost. Yet as anything, Zarganash got a hold of, they can never break free from the realm and are trapped not only in the depths of the nether realms but also in their accursed state of ghostly denizens of Zarganash. Some described them as demonic entities trapped in ghostly bodies but in the end it's only a twisted mimicry that drives them. Ironically their emulation of demonic cruelty and behaviour doesn't differentiate them much from other phantoms at all. The key difference towards demons is that they lack any allegiance to the demonic hoards and the essence that fuels them is something entirely different. In combat their comparatively high…
infernal-phantom.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.

infernalist.name: Infernalist
infernalist.title: Infernalist
infernalist.loc: Magician Quarter (2+5?), Hero Cave (2), Demona (2), Fury Dungeon.
infernalist.desc: At all times, doomsday cults have found followers. Infernalists are usually high-ranking followers of such cults that like to take things into their own hands. Instead of waiting for the apocalypse to come, they actively aim for their goal of total destruction. Though Infernalists used to be eager students of magic, they discarded a good deal of spells in their repertoire in favour of more destructive and flashy spell effects. It is surely not astonishing that their favourite element is fire, as these spells are not only highly destructive put also have some glamorous effects. Infernalists are easily won over for any task that causes destruction. They lack any form of patience though and often leave one job to join another. Several Infernalists work as mercenaries and some even find employment in armies. However, their short temper and their eagerness to start arguments about minor incidents make them bad employees. Even the cults they belong to are not very fond of them. For this reason, they are often sent on dangerous or even suicidal missions in the hope that they will never return. Despite all the destruction they have caused and enemies they have made, in the end, most…
infernalist.notes: Behaves similar to a Warlock. The difference is that Infernalists can make several combos.
infernalist.strat: Similar to Warlocks however these are more Fire based. Druids as low as level 60 can kill them relatively easily by summoning a Demon Skeleton and using Ice Strike and Hailstorm Rod to kill them. You can even try killing them as a level 28 mage but it's proven to be a huge waste of supplies (requiring 100+ Mana Potions, 100+ Icicles and 60+Intense Healing Runes). Magma Set is recommended. You can also try wearing Dragon Necklace, although they will wear off really fast since you're almost constantly on fire while hunting them. From about level 90 it becomes possible to kill one using just a Hailstorm Rod and Ice Strike although it can still be wasteful until higher levels. To make visible cast Envenom. Knights should attack them as soon as possible with a two-handed weapon since they are weak to physical attacks melee and in defence. Try to trap them in a corner, as they can be an annoyance when they are running around everywhere. When blocking Infernalists it is normally more efficient to use full offence rather than full defence. Running in their direction and using Groundshaker is a good way to make them visible again, you can also use Whirlwind Throw shortly after they go…

infernatil.name: Infernatil
infernatil.title: Infernatil
infernatil.loc: Unknown. Has been summoned by a Customer Support member on the private test server.
infernatil.notes: It is a Member of the Ruthless Seven, the incendiary of hell.
infernatil.strat: Haste, Charge, Strong Haste, Boots of Haste, Time Ring and Run!

infernoid-blob.name: Infernoid Blob
infernoid-blob.title: Infernoid Blob
infernoid-blob.desc: Forged from molten debris and corrupted with pure hatred and malice, these infernal entities feed on chaos and destruction. Their true origin remains unknown, yet sightings of these creatures have increased since the last great earthquake. Rumours claim that they are connected to a new demonic force, seeking to prove its raging power and establish dominance. The infernoid blob outlines a round lava-shaped entity encasing a core of concentrated rage. Though it appears smaller than other similar entities, this molten creature is far from harmless. It can unleash an array of fire attacks and occasionally radiate a scorching area of pure heat around itself, burning anything that comes to close.

infernoid-hound.name: Infernoid Hound
infernoid-hound.title: Infernoid Hound
infernoid-hound.desc: Forged from molten debris and corrupted with pure hatred and malice, these infernal entities feed on chaos and destruction. Their true origin remains unknown, yet sightings of these creatures have increased since the last great earthquake. Rumours claim that they are connected to a new demonic force, seeking to prove its raging power and establish dominance. The infernoid hound is often referred to as the helldog of the layers beneath. Legends tell of demonic figures training their hounds to obey every command, as they function as the first line of personal proctection. It is unclear whether the hounds were created in their current form or if their master corrupted them into bloodhungry hunters while also setting them apart from the typically fiery forms of other infernoids.

infernoid-soul.name: Infernoid Soul
infernoid-soul.title: Infernoid Soul
infernoid-soul.desc: Forged from molten debris and corrupted with pure hatred and malice, these infernal entities feed on chaos and destruction. Their true origin remains unknown, yet sightings of these creatures have increased since the last great earthquake. Rumours claim that they are connected to a new demonic force, seeking to prove its raging power and establish dominance. The infernoid soul seems to be closely related to other elementals, though it appears to be a weaker version of other entities that can be found in the most dangerous Tibian areas. Nearly every casual equipment melts on impact, making it difficult to fight and even harder to survive. This is especially true as surrounding lava or fire seems to empower their abilities and strength.

infernoid-spiritual.name: Infernoid Spiritual
infernoid-spiritual.title: Infernoid Spiritual
infernoid-spiritual.desc: Forged from molten debris and corrupted with pure hatred and malice, these infernal entities feed on chaos and destruction. Their true origin remains unknown, yet sightings of these creatures have increased since the last great earthquake. Rumours claim that they are connected to a new demonic force, seeking to prove its raging power and establish dominance. The infernoid spiritual is an enhanced and armoured version of its pure soul, empowered by even more evil magic or hatred towards intruders or enemies alike. It attacks with a multitude of fire spells, burning everything in its path to eliminate its prey. The spiritual is often tasked with protecting important areas or valuable resources.

ink-blob.name: Ink Blob
ink-blob.title: Ink Blob
ink-blob.loc: Secret Library earth, fire and ice sections.
ink-blob.desc: It is said said great authors put a part of their hearts, sweat, blood and souls into their masterpieces. This is often more than true for works on arcane knowledge. Some works become like entities on their own and begin to feed on the energy of their creator. Sometimes they consume even more energy than a mere arcane book can contain. Such overloaded books begin to 'bleed' out some of the lifeblood and essence they contain in the form of magic ink. While a single book can merely produce some inconsequential droplets of soul-ink, a large number of books that provide such ink might pool into a greater blob. This combined essence quickly gains a form of sentience of their own and feeds on lesser pools to grow in size and power. Since they become very protective towards the books that spawned them and they still feel some kind of mystical connection to, they are usually rather seen as useful than just a mere nuisance, though they are always quite hostile towards strangers. Since in theory they can absorb unlimited amounts of essence pools and grow to abominably sizes, they are commonly culled by the keepers of the libraries that spawn them and split into lesser, better manageable…
ink-blob.strat: Despite having considerably less HP than the creatures it's found with, Ink Blobs deal the most damage, so they should be the main focus during pulls to eliminate the threat. Since they don't walk over Energy, Energy Bomb Runes can be helpful for shooters in some situations, but it won't protect you from most of the other creatures around.

inkwing.name: Inkwing
inkwing.title: Inkwing
inkwing.notes: Part of the Between the Lines Quest.

inky.name: Inky
inky.title: Inky
inky.loc: At Yalahar, Sunken Quarter. When entering the Sunken Quarter step down from the underwater hill and head to south-east, there you should find stairs which takes you down to the boss. The boss is behind a sealed door, so make sure you have the access to that room.
inky.strat: Treat this boss exactly the same as you would treat normal Quara Constrictor, you can run around objects.

insane-siren.name: Insane Siren
insane-siren.title: Insane Siren
insane-siren.desc: The dream-born are a reclusive race of creatures that are shrouded in mystery. Only recent events led to a contact that shed some light on these peculiar beings. There seem to be two distinctively different kinds of dream-born, that align themselves with either the winter or the summer. Though there are conflicting reports about that alignment, the current theory is that there are two rivaling courts exists though it's still possible that there is just one court that changes in accordance to the seasons. In the few recorded encounters, the dream-born claimed to live in realms that their god created with his dreams. Given their obvious kinship to the common elves it's of course far more likely that they are just descendants of elves that fled the godwars into some kind of pocket dimension. They usually shun outsiders and rarely leave their own realm at all. What little information could be gathered about them suggests a lifestyle akin that of the other elves, though they seem to lack a cast system and have a feudal oriented society. Due to their isolation they developed odd quirks like the overemphasising of seasons, that hints at a primitive, animistic world-view. It's still…
insane-siren.strat: It's the strongest of the Summer Dreamelves, so be careful around them. If possible, avoid staying in front or near them since you can avoid most of its attacks this way.

insect-swarm.name: Insect Swarm
insect-swarm.title: Insect Swarm
insect-swarm.loc: Zao Steppe, Northern Zao Plantations, and the Horestis Tomb (only when the curse of Horestis is not active)
insect-swarm.desc: Insect Swarms come in many sizes and forms. Two swarms can consist of entirely different insects. The most common swarms are harmless. Some of the more aggressive insects though already pose a threat by their sheer number. Such swarms can be encountered almost everywhere, however, usually they are attracted by places of decay. The term Insect Swarm describes a common threat. While not strictly evil, Insect Swarms are often aggressive and dangerous. One of the greatest dangers of an Insect Swarm is that it can be encountered almost everywhere and often unexpectedly. Sometimes, rather harmless insects form swarms out of coincidence and disperse after a while. However, if someone provokes the forming of such swarm, he better prepares for the worst. Attracted to blood and decay, Insect Swarms are often drawn to weakened creatures that might even fall under their attacks.
insect-swarm.notes: Looks the same as a Berrypest and a Vermin Swarm.
insect-swarm.strat: Just kill it; this monster is a little stronger than a minotaur, so you should not have any problems defeating it.

insectoid-scout.name: Insectoid Scout
insectoid-scout.title: Insectoid Scout
insectoid-scout.desc: Sightings of Insectoid Scouts are a relatively new phenomenon. After several skirmishes of the creatures with Tibian natives, a few things about them can be considered as verified facts. The Insectoid Scouts are not aggressive in the sense that they are attacking towns or settlements, instead, they are usually found in rather remote areas. When encountered though, they are rather violent and attack everyone relentlessly. Despite their build, they are rather tough and extremely strong. Their behaviour suggests that they are looking for something or spying on someone. This behaviour earned them the nickname 'scouts', and military officials of the major powers are all concerned that they might be indeed forerunners for something bigger and more sinister.
insectoid-scout.notes: Insectoid Scouts are Insectoid Workers weakened due to a large distance from the Hive. They appear during the Insectoid Invasion World Change.
insectoid-scout.strat: Distance fighting vocations can lure it back to the Sheep pen near Tokel and kill them from behind the gate.

insectoid-worker.name: Insectoid Worker
insectoid-worker.title: Insectoid Worker
insectoid-worker.desc: Due to their versatility and resilience, the Insectoid Workers are the most commonly encountered of the Hive Born. They seem to be relatively expendable and are used as foragers and scouts in the widest sense. They test the strength of their enemies and sometimes, they are sent in great numbers to bring down a dangerous foe without risking the more valuable warriors. Usually the Insectoid Workers are chosen to become one with the hive structures to grant them their unnatural life. As expendable creatures they are encountered quite often, but their brethren show little regard for them. It has been observed in battles that they are devoured by wounded hive creatures to regain strength. They seem to depend less on the hive than other Hive Born. Although they lose strength and health when away from the hive, they survive for extended periods and so they are for now the only Hive Born that have been encountered elsewhere in the world. It is assumed that their appearance might serve the creation of new hives but so far no new hive has been established. In the hive area, they are often paired with waspoids in scouting missions and hit and run tactics. In the war of the hive against the…
insectoid-worker.notes: Was implemented at the Winter Update 2011.

instable-breach-brood.name: Instable Breach Brood
instable-breach-brood.title: Instable Breach Brood
instable-breach-brood.desc: The Instable Breach Brood is a weaker version of Breach Broods.
instable-breach-brood.notes: The creature has two versions with the same name. Only the ones inside the Vortex itself count for bestiary and drop loot. The ones in the entrance, necessary to slay to enter the Vortex, do not.
instable-breach-brood.strat: Be careful not to lure too many creatures as the dungeon has lots of them. Use Earth damage if possible or Holy/Physical otherwise.

instable-fire.name: Instable Fire
instable-fire.title: Instable Fire
instable-fire.loc: Dwelling of the Forgotten, at the Too Hot to Handle Lava Fishing mission.
instable-fire.beh: Runs away from players very fast.

instable-sparkion.name: Instable Sparkion
instable-sparkion.title: Instable Sparkion
instable-sparkion.desc: The Instable Sparkion is a weaker version of Sparkions.
instable-sparkion.notes: The creature has two versions with the same name. Only the ones inside the Vortex itself count for bestiary and drop loot. The ones in the entrance, necessary to slay to enter the Vortex, do not.
instable-sparkion.strat: Be careful not to lure too many creatures as the dungeon has lots of them. Use Earth damage if possible or Holy/Physical otherwise.

irahsae.name: Irahsae
irahsae.title: Irahsae
irahsae.loc: Drefia, behind the portal , during the Rise of Devovorga World Quest. Can be fought on Vengoth during Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change.
irahsae.beh: Fights at close combat, runs away at very low hp. Does not retarget from the blocker, even when taking massive damage from the shooters.
irahsae.notes: It's wearing a large Cobra Crown. One of its speeches, scientia potentia est, is a Latin phrase meaning "knowledge is power". All players who sufficiently damage it during the last minute of the fight will receive the Slayer of Irahsae achievement.
irahsae.strat: Similar to a Fury, but weaker. A 4 person team is enough to safely bring down this monster. With a blocker, and 3 shooters, you should be fine. Irahsae will stand in close combat to the blocker at all times until it is very close to its death. If possible, get at least 2 Master Sorcerer's who can shoot Sudden Death Runes, because of the massive death damage this creature takes. A royal paladin or an elder druid would come in handy, to either inflict damage, or heal the blocker with Heal Friend. Irahsae is not too strong, but the blocker could take considerably high combos of up to 700 damage, maybe more. An Elite Knight of level 55 and higher with good skills and a good set should be able to survive blocking this monster us Strong Health Potions. Amount of waste will depend on how fast the shooters can bring it down. Once it starts to run, make sure all mages shoot Sudden Death at Irahsae before it hides and heal.

irgix-the-flimsy.name: Irgix the Flimsy
irgix-the-flimsy.title: Irgix the Flimsy
irgix-the-flimsy.notes: It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.

iron-servant.name: Iron Servant
iron-servant.title: Iron Servant
iron-servant.desc: After a great gathering of not so great mages planning to do great things, it was decided to launch the production of helpful servants to speed up the process of being - great. Each of them had his own special field. One was a master of manipulating all kinds of ore with his bare mind, another was able to wield powerful energies, and again another would know how to use the strangest of substances in Tibia to his benefit. All of them combined their knowledge to create their own loyal servants. Several prototypes were made. Some constructed of metal, others of gold or even diamond but all of them were based on flesh and bone. Some of them were faulty from the start. It is said that one of the mages even used whole armies of servants to take care of his experiments.
iron-servant.strat: Focus on coordinated wave clearing. Make sure your team communicates which creatures remain, as the next wave won't spawn until all current Servants are defeated. Ensure to maintain steady damage output and reposition to avoid getting surrounded, especially in larger rooms.

iron-servant-replica.name: Iron Servant Replica
iron-servant-replica.title: Iron Servant Replica
iron-servant-replica.notes: It is a replica of an Iron Servant, with some changes.

ironblight.name: Ironblight
ironblight.title: Ironblight
ironblight.desc: Ironblights are strange creatures that are highly magnetic. They follow unseen magnetic currents in the earth in their slow wanderings. They also emit magnetic fields of their own, sometimes moving iron-rich earth and stones seemingly at will. In the right surroundings, Ironblights can even walk on walls and ceilings. Oddly enough, their prolonged proximity to iron lets it rust at an unnatural rate. Therefore dwarfs are particularly interested in keeping the Ironblights away. In the past, successful extermination campaigns have eradicated Ironblight presences from their mines for quite a while. The Ironblights are usually as patient and slow as the stone they resemble, only to surprise the incautious with bursts of speed and aggression from one second to the next. The Ironblights are immensely irritated by the magnetic fields that most sentient beings seem to emit. The highly sensitive creatures experience pain and agony in the vicinity of people. Yet this seems to kick in only at a certain low range, far too late to avoid the cause of discomfort. Therefore Ironblights often threaten bases of underground dwellers. Young gnomes had the habit of challenging each other as to who can…
ironblight.notes: It can be tamed. Use an Iron Loadstone or a Music Box on it to do so.

island-troll.name: Island Troll
island-troll.title: Island Troll
island-troll.desc: The Island Trolls are by no means more courageous than their cousins all over the world. Quite weak, they are usually easily defeated. However, their existence on remote isles is a clear proof for the versatility of the troll race. Their lifestyle does not differ much from that of other trolls. They prefer to roam in caves and form small tribes and clans.The only notable difference to other trolls might be their habit to collect all sorts of things and to hoard them. This might come from the lack of resources on the isles or, as some suggest, from some religious background. Considering the disinterest in the topic trolls, no one bothered yet to investigate that further.
island-troll.beh: Island Trolls retreat in low health.
island-troll.notes: Island Trolls are similiar to Trolls and have similar loot, they hold a Marlin and use it as a weapon. But it's a food.
island-troll.strat: Just attack them. Be careful with Scorpions and Crabs that also dwell on Goroma with the Island Trolls.

jagged-earth-elemental.name: Jagged Earth Elemental
jagged-earth-elemental.title: Jagged Earth Elemental
jagged-earth-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Druid's part - Earth Sphere.
jagged-earth-elemental.strat: Run around and use Flame Strike. Maybe use Great Fireball if there are more then two. If you feel like bringing a rod, take a hailstorm rod because they are least resistant to ice.

jailer.name: Jailer
jailer.title: Jailer
jailer.notes: During the Test Server when this creature was released, its creator Lionet [http://forum.test.tibia.com/forum/?action=thread&postid=17641#post17641 explained] what's behind its story: :He basically not only oversaw but "tortured" a lot of poor souls in his time in Edron, too and (probably, not much is known) also later in the bastion. As was his duty, as was custom at the time and thought appropriate. However, he is clearly one of the actually evil characters in the whole Order. Not a very high rank, not very high standards, he was not really a valued member of the Order but more of a necessity at that time. As you know, most other members of the Order have been fallen to a kind of curse (the Zao corruption they brought from that then unknown continent). He has as met a different fate (as you can also judge by his looks). He basically is now a weak (as is fitting to his former role and in comparison to the strong knights) hollow husk of a man that is doomed to die "easily" at the hands of all the heroes conquering the bastion (the players). By now he probably has already died as many deaths as he has taken lives when he was still among the living and this will never stop, it is…

jaracal.name: Jaracal
jaracal.title: Jaracal
jaracal.desc: The jaracals are six-legged feline predators native to Marapur. They are equally at home in the dense jungle and along the submerging coastline of the Emerald Gardens. Their additional limbs grant them remarkable balance, allowing them to change direction very quickly and to outmaneuver almost any prey. Jaracals are patient hunters, stalking their targets silently before striking. Their keen senses and sharp instincts make them difficult to surprise. Despite their ferocity, though, they can be tamed. Those who earn their trust may find them to be loyal and capable companions.
jaracal.notes: Can be tamed by using a Skewered Fish on it.

jaul.name: Jaul
jaul.title: Jaul
jaul.loc: Fiehonja, southern pit of the Ancestral Grounds.
jaul.beh: He combos a lot, walks pretty fast, and re-targets a lot.
jaul.notes: Jaul, Protektor Profundis, is one of the three depth lords. Reachable in third stage of Liquid Black Quest, he is the strongest deepling boss. "KENH!!" translates to "Intruder!!", and "QJELL AFAR GOU JEY!!" translates to "Qjell watch over us!!". Jaul cannot be blocked from spawning. Teams can stay in its room for 20 minutes, the timer starts when entering the teleport. Re-entry is denied after players gain experience from it. Thus, teams can earn a few minutes by jumping out and in its lair when the first boss is on deep red HP.
jaul.strat: Get a decent level blocker or two (250+ is enough), one healer for each of the blockers and several damage dealers and just kill it with your strongest attacks. Note that knights are not only meatshields and should also attack as they do high amount of damage too. Bronze Amulet is recommended because of the Mana Drain Jaul does.

jellyfish.name: Jellyfish
jellyfish.title: Jellyfish
jellyfish.desc: Even without a brain - or even any form of bones for that matter - they are fascinating creatures. They emit a strange glow and can be seen even in the darkest depths of the Tibian seas, which also makes them a target for many of the larger inhabitants of the deep. Over time they developed a strong sense of danger and will flee as soon as anything other than their reflection approaches.
jellyfish.notes: Was implemented at the Winter Update 2011.
jellyfish.strat: Just kill them to make sure they're not breaking your shielding while attacking harder monsters.

jesse-the-wicked.name: Jesse the Wicked
jesse-the-wicked.title: Jesse the Wicked
jesse-the-wicked.notes: Part of the Bank Robbery Mini World Change. Jesse is the thief that robs the Thais bank. He spawns with 4 Smugglers.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.title: Juggernaut
juggernaut.loc: Deep in Pits of Inferno (Apocalypse's throne room), The Dark Path, The Blood Halls, The Vats, The Hive, The Shadow Nexus, a room deep in Formorgar Mines, Roshamuul Prison, Oramond Dungeon, Grounds of Destruction and Halls of Ascension.
juggernaut.desc: If there is a seemingly unstoppable force in the ranks of demon kind, it is the infamous Juggernaut. Thought to become extinct in the great wars of the gods, recent sightings of Juggernauts have proven those rumours wrong. Raised in the playpens of the deepest hells, where only the most powerful can survive, about 90% of the Juggernaut population is killed before it reaches adulthood. Those who are not torn into pieces by their merciless brethren or other creatures, grow to enormous, frightening killing machines. Juggernauts are known to be able to slash the head of a dragon with one hit, while fighting back a half-dozen of other dragons. The earth trembles where a Juggernaut walks, heralding the incoming of doom. Seemingly being made up only of armor and muscles, the Juggernaut is incredibly powerful and fast, killing the first opponent and walking to the next in a mere blink. Serving as one-creature armies, the Juggernauts are some of the most powerful weapons at the disposal of the demonlords.
juggernaut.strat: They are very basic creatures, but their immense strength makes them quite scary .Try to keep your distance from it, especially as any vocation other than Knights. Their melee is devastating, and they will often combo their basic attack with giant boulders easily comboing for over 1400 physical damage. If you need to keep your distance from them, using energy walls can be effective to gain ground of them, as well as using energy bombs on the floor and standing in the middle can provide a safe spot from them, provided you are not damaging them since they will cross energy fields to defend themselves.

jungle-moa.name: Jungle Moa
jungle-moa.title: Jungle Moa
jungle-moa.loc: All around Marapur including the Emerald Gardens, Fading Isles, Murmuring Wilderness, Silent Waters, Sparkling Lagoon, Stardance Mountains.
jungle-moa.desc: Jungle moas are large birds with striking, colourful plumage that live on the jungle-covered island of Marapur. Because of their strong legs, with which they can move quickly on land, one might think that moas are incapable of flight. In fact, however, they are good flyers and prefer to build their nests in the high mountainous areas of the island. Moas are herbivores and feed mainly on buds, leaves and the fruits of jungle plants. Unusual for birds of this size, many moas have a preference for shiny or glittering objects. If they spot these and can snatch them without major risk, the birds will often steal such items and hide them in their nests. Moa eggs are of an intense red colour, which is why the shells are popularly used by the nagas of Marapur for jewellery and decorations. Both, moa eggs and meat, are also a popular source of food for the mountain nagas.

juvenile-bashmu.name: Juvenile Bashmu
juvenile-bashmu.title: Juvenile Bashmu
juvenile-bashmu.desc: Juvenile Bashmu are the younger versions of Bashmus.
juvenile-bashmu.notes: Both versions of Bashmu are able to inflict damage over time upon a player, which is poison and electrify at the same time. The status of being electrified isn't shown on the status bar however, only the poisoning, but you can see that the charges of lightning pendant or strange amulet slowly disappear. To dispose of being electrified and poisoned, player must simply use Cure Poison spell or wait till these effects wear off.

juvenile-cyclops.name: Juvenile Cyclops
juvenile-cyclops.title: Juvenile Cyclops
juvenile-cyclops.loc: Dawnport's northwest part, floor -3. One in the Crystal Dungeons, floor -2.
juvenile-cyclops.beh: They will not retarget to other players unless the player hides behind of across another player. They kill or move creatures and items that are in their way, therefore items are not effective in blocking their path.
juvenile-cyclops.notes: A young Cyclops, but still a worthy foe. The strongest creature you can meet on Dawnport.
juvenile-cyclops.strat: They hit hard and are hard to hit. A Knight should block and can shoot a poison field rune under them, while other vocations shoot it. Solo knights will have a very tough time with their high defense. It's discouraged to try to kill them alone. Mages, Should attack them with Earth Damage, wand or rod, Light Stone Shower Rune will also help.

kalyassa.name: Kalyassa
kalyassa.title: Kalyassa
kalyassa.notes: This boss can only be fought when First Dragon Quest is active.
kalyassa.strat: Mages: Mana shield is recommended since it can combo 2000+. It avoids crossing energy fields, but it's a moot point given how often it spams fire bombs.

katex-blood-tongue.name: Katex Blood Tongue
katex-blood-tongue.title: Katex Blood Tongue
katex-blood-tongue.strat: Combos specially with a summoned Werehyena can deal a lot of damage. Low level knights can avoid this by dropping Fire Bomb Runes and running around using Whirlwind Throw and Groundshaker approaching to do melee damage once it reaches yellow health or is separated from its summoned Werehyena

kerberos.name: Kerberos
kerberos.title: Kerberos
kerberos.loc: Goroma (look at spoiler for more info).
kerberos.notes: Hellhound's boss. Part of the Paw and Fur Society tasks of Grizzly Adams. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. The portal which leads to the boss is in depths of Goroma. The entrance of the cave is [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 125.97-127.120-7-2-1-1 here]. Follow the patches to reach boss: Kerberos is in north of last cave. level 154 killing Kerberos (Boss)]]
kerberos.strat: Their melee attack is considerable much weaker than their wave attacks (which are fatal if combined) so it's best to block it while standing diagonal. Magic Walls, Wild Growth or Energy Wall Runes can be used to help you to staying diagonal and preventing you from the wave attacks. These creatures are very strong so don't underestimate them! Paladins Should use Assassin Stars and cast Divine Missiles while wearing some Stone Skin Amulets. At lower levels use Energy Rings, stay at meele range, don´t run and heal with Great Spirit Potions or Strong Mana Potions trying to stay at full mana all the time. Mages can try to block them without mana shield at level 200+ with some amount of luck while being quick with your healing spells, while shooting Sudden Death runes. Also it's recommended to wear some Stone Skin Amulets to reduce the Physical Damage, alternatively Might Rings. Kerberos is weak for Ice Damage and Holy Damage, so use ice or holybased attacks.

killer-caiman.name: Killer Caiman
killer-caiman.title: Killer Caiman
killer-caiman.loc: Northern Zao Plantations, Souleater Mountains, Muggy Plains, Killer Caiman Cave in the Zao Steppe ( ), Chyllfroest.
killer-caiman.desc: The Killer Caimans are the product of selective breeding by the lizard people over several centuries. Once rather harmless caimans, today resilient beasts - the selection changed them according to the whims of their lizard masters. In ancient times, the caiman breeding was a pastime of the royalty and a strong caiman was a vital prestige object. Caiman battles were arranged to show off and to settle conflicts. Over the years, caimans escaped or were given as present to loyal subjects who set them free or interbred them with escaped beasts. This way, they slowly found their way back into the wilds. Later lower caste lizards captured them and they became widespread pets. The Killer Caiman that is found nowadays in Zao has surpassed its ancestors in all ways. As if they weren't already dangerous enough, the royalty of the lizard people still possesses caiman hatcheries where they breed even stronger and more resilient versions of the Killer Caiman.
killer-caiman.beh: These creatures fight in close combat using melee and are frequently using haste.
killer-caiman.notes: They are usually found in groups and with some High Class Lizards. This creature was added in the Christmas Update 2009. You may hunt 250 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
killer-caiman.strat: Killer Caimans are very fast when they use Haste, so they can catch up quickly even if they just appeared on the screen. They are very easy to be overlooked due to camouflage and lizards that they are close to. They can drop a lot of money in Gems and Obsidian Lances. You can easily make a fast profit here. Knights: At about level 80, you can hunt these easily with just Mana Potions and Recovery and Wound Cleansing with very little cost. Just attack them, and keep mana for Berserk if there are three or more. Paladins: Keep distance at all cost but also be careful not to let yourself get swarmed by other creatures. A good idea is to find a large area of grass/stones and run around it while shooting. Mages: Use Wand of Starstorm/Underworld Rod along with Flame Strike and/or Energy Wave/Great Energy Beam if you are a sorcerer or Strong Ice Wave if you are a druid. They are only 5% weak for energy, so it's still better to use Great Fireball instead of Thunderstorm (Thunderstorm does 10% less average damage).

killer-rabbit.name: Killer Rabbit
killer-rabbit.title: Killer Rabbit
killer-rabbit.loc: Isle of Evil and Deeper Ingol
killer-rabbit.strat: Killer Rabbits have weak armour and have no resistances and weaknesses, so you can use any weapon/runes you want. It is wise to kill it fast and to use area of effect spells/runes like Berserk, Great Fireball, Avalanche or Divine Caldera if it summons its own copies. This monster can only be found on the Isle of Evil along with other evil creatures.

king-zelos.name: King Zelos
king-zelos.title: King Zelos
king-zelos.notes: He is the final boss of the Grave Danger Quest and a former Thaian king. He is mentioned in some books: The History of King Zelos part one and part two, as well as About Nargol the Impaler.
king-zelos.strat: Its elemental weakness depend on the team performance during the boss fight. The longer it takes for the team to reach Zelos, the stronger it will be. Nevertheless, Fire is always the best element to be used against it. If the team has defeated the 4 minibosses before Zelos quickly enough, the strategy is easy. The blocker should always stay diagonal, preferably at the right side of the room near the wall so the boss doesn't face the team. The shooters should stay diagonal to avoid the Hex beam and shoot Fireball Runes for maximum single-target damage. The second blocker can either attack from distance while blocking the 3 Risen Soldiers or stay near the boss, which is more dangerous but will increase the damage output.

knight-familiar.name: Knight Familiar
knight-familiar.title: Knight Familiar
knight-familiar.beh: Stands shooting at a distance of 4 sqm from the player's target. Every turn it will shoot only one of its abilities.
knight-familiar.notes: When looking at a summoned Knight Familiar, the summoner's character name and how long it will take for the summon to disappear is shown. It can be summoned by Knights of level 200 or higher by using the Summon Knight Familiar spell. All the experience that is expected to be 'gained' by the summon goes to the player, meaning there is no shared exp between the summon and its summoner, like with the normal Summon Creature spell. It will follow players at their speed and will go up and down stairs and holes with them. It lasts for 15 minutes with a 30 minutes cooldown. It can go with you to a Protection Zone. If the summoner logs out, it will disappear stopping the countdown of its timer, and will reappear when the summoner logs in again.

knights-apparition.name: Knight's Apparition
knights-apparition.title: Knight's Apparition
knights-apparition.loc: The Mirrored Nightmare, after Mirror Images are attacked.
knights-apparition.desc: These knights belong to a group of (five) apparitions, which Mirror Images can turn into.
knights-apparition.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.

knowledge-elemental.name: Knowledge Elemental
knowledge-elemental.title: Knowledge Elemental
knowledge-elemental.desc: Some knowledge is so powerful it can't be contained within a single mind. Even if contained in specially created books, a bit of the knowledge always leaks out. It is said that even minor books leak their knowledge a little. If enough books in an area leak such knowledge, it interacts with other sublime knowledge in an area. Eventually the concentration of knowledge leads to the existence of what in lack of better terms is called a knowledge elemental. It is raw knowledge and power set free. It has only a mockery of sentience, truly no more than an irritating and misleading mirroring of knowledge fragments. The knowledge has only one purpose: to be known. Yet it's heavily fractured and raw, not fathomable to an ordinary mind at all. In their attempts to insert itself to others, the knowledge elemental becomes an aggressive threat, as it attempts are harmful and even lethal. The sudden outbursts of knowledge are disrupting and destructive, often taking the shape of spell-like effects. Magicians usually have to exorcise such manifested knowledge from their libraries. Given the relative commonness at certain areas, many libraries accept then as a given and rather use spells to ward…

kollos.name: Kollos
kollos.title: Kollos
kollos.desc: The behemoth of the Hive Born is a living tank and siege engine. Its great strength is usually used to build and dismantle hive structures. Their armor seems almost impenetrable and when they begin to move and gain some momentum, they are near to unstoppable. Astonishingly, their enormous carapace is hollow to a great extent. Sometimes, material or even smaller hive creatures are transported in these hollow spots. On other occasions, they transport eggs or nourishing goo under their carapace. Is is rumoured that the hollow carapace enables them to float on the water and serves other Hive Born as makeshift raft, but such reports are rare and rather dubious. Until now, no one has encountered a Kollos away from the hive so such rumours are probably just exaggerations. On rare occasions, though, it has been at least observed that a group of Kollos builds bridges or ladder-like structures with their bodies which are used as passage by other Hive Born. Another observation seems more disturbing, though: Sometimes it seems that the Hive Born fight more coordinated and almost strategically intelligent when they are close to certain Kollos. This led to speculations that another, still…
kollos.notes: Comes in groups amongst other Hive Born.
kollos.strat: They are a lot slower than creatures of similar strength (such as Behemoths) so shooters can easily solo them as long as no Spidris is nearby.

kongra.name: Kongra
kongra.title: Kongra
kongra.loc: In Banuta, northeast of Port Hope, Arena and Zoo Quarter.
kongra.desc: The mighty Kongras are like mountains made of flesh and muscles. These enormous apes are incredibly strong and quite agile for their mass and size. They seem to be the warriors of the apes that live in the deepest jungle and raid the human settlements from time to time. In its anger a Kongra is able to rip out small trees and to break bones as if they weretwigs. The sight of an enraged, storming Kongra can make even an experienced warrior tremble. The dark and massive figure reaches a threatening speed in its attacks. Relying mainly on its strength, a Kongra rarely uses any weapons. Occasionally, the ape warrior uses stones of different sizes or branches as makeshift weapons, but usually it relies on its hammer-like fists and the clout of its powerful arms.
kongra.notes: These apes like to hit hard and often appear along with Sibangs or Merlkins. You may hunt 300 Kongra, Sibang, Merlkin combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
kongra.strat: Druids and Sorcerers: Since these apes are usually in groups with Sibangs and Merlkins, it is best to use a wand/rod against the Kongra, and use Avalanches to damage as many other apes as possible, low lvls (-30) can try to use one or two Monks and hit them with ice or death wands/Rods. Not really worth the effort as they have very high hitpoints and take too much mana/runes considering the little exp they yield. Knights should not have much trouble with Kongras, but they will break your shielding while the sibangs attack you with stones. Paladins should use trees to run in circles and shoot them down, or get a shield and a throwing weapon, and run in circles around them.

koshei-the-deathless.name: Koshei the Deathless
koshei-the-deathless.title: Koshei the Deathless

ab.r: 1-52 (lasts for 21~ turns for a total of 319~ damage)

koshei-the-deathless.beh: Will try to kill you while summoning a Bonebeast.
koshei-the-deathless.notes: When you enter in his room he will respawn if you haven't defeated him yet. He can't die unless you know what to do. If you kill him, he will respawn again. Gives no loot or experience. This book and its sequel give an overview of Koshei's history.
koshei-the-deathless.strat: To all vocations: The use of Garlic Necklace is recommended. Even though he has many hit points, he is quite easy to defeat with a 45+ character. His self healing is really troublesome (you could end up doing 8000 damage while Koshei heals 5000 hp, before you defeat him). Mages should stay away and using their wand/rod and Exori flam or GFB runes since fire is Koshei's weakness. He sometimes does high damage so Mana shield is recommended for Mages around level 45. Paladins stay away while shooting bolts / arrows / throwing weapons and Exori San (Holy Damage). Some Health Potions would be good. Make sure to have enough mana for Exura, as the Bonebeast can Paralyze you. Knights will have a very hard time with this one, as he has many life draining attacks, coupled with the fast healing. Not recommended for Knights under level 70 (Fierce Berserk), unless you are experienced. It's also recommended to bring a shooter to help with the killing. As a knight a 20-40 Mana Potions and a few Strong Health Potions are needed as he hits hard. Also a good idea to wear a Garlic Necklace, as it has many Life Drain attacks. Note: that he will respawn shortly after you've killed him, unless you know…

kraknaknork.name: Kraknaknork
kraknaknork.title: Kraknaknork
kraknaknork.loc: Rookgaard Orc Fortress (during a quest), and in his own dimension, accessed only once after the tutorial.
kraknaknork.strat: Trap him in a corner and kill him.

kreebosh-the-exile.name: Kreebosh the Exile
kreebosh-the-exile.title: Kreebosh the Exile
kreebosh-the-exile.beh: He is more vicious than a regular Efreet, fights in close combat.
kreebosh-the-exile.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #2. Next #3.
kreebosh-the-exile.strat: To all vocations it is heavily recommended to wear a Dwarven Ring because you may exit the arena by mistake or not be able to reach the next pit if you are heavily drunk (note that drunk lasts for several minutes so you will be affected in the next pits as well). Druids and Sorcerers: Use Magic Shield and use SD while running to kill fast before he summons. Knight: As you do not need to move while fighting him, wear a skill ring (Sword Ring, Axe Ring, Club Ring) rather than a Dwarven Ring. If you are drunk after the battle, equip a Dwarven Ring. You should also use Exori and Blood Rage to kill faster. If you are lucky, he will not summon any Green Djinns. Paladins: Run in circles and shoot if he has 2 summoned djinns you may run arround them to avoid get hit by the boss berserk and melee. Be careful, because he can summon both djinns at the same time, breaking up your shielding and making powerful combos that might kill you in a second.

kroazur.name: Kroazur
kroazur.title: Kroazur
kroazur.beh: Deals approximately 70% physical damage, 20% death damage, and 10% earth damage.
kroazur.notes: You can kill this boss once every 2 real-life hours. Part of the Threatened Dreams Quest.
kroazur.strat: Mages and paladins below level 150 can use field runes to keep it at a distance while attacking. The room is also quite large, making it easy to maneuver around.

kusuma.name: Kusuma
kusuma.title: Kusuma
kusuma.strat: Start by stepping on the Energy Vein located to teleport to the room just south of this tile. Kusuma avoids energy fields, which can be used to your advantage. If you're struggling to handle her damage and are using ranged attacks, consider placing energy fields around the room to limit her movement and give yourself more control while kiting her.

lab-assistant.name: Lab Assistant
lab-assistant.title: Lab Assistant
lab-assistant.beh: It follows you in melee distance.
lab-assistant.notes: When it dies it will spawn either a Blue, Green or a Red Container. They can be found during one of the tasks of The Cradle of Monsters Quest.
lab-assistant.strat: Lure them next to the Tube with the lower amount of points so you don't have to push the containers very far.

lacewing-moth.name: Lacewing Moth
lacewing-moth.title: Lacewing Moth
lacewing-moth.beh: The Lacewing Moth will follow and target other wild creatures, but will not be attacked by them. It's very weak and not a real threat.
lacewing-moth.notes: It can be tamed using a Turquoise Tendril Lantern.
lacewing-moth.strat: If your purpose is to tame it, clear the spawn around it (carefully not to kill the Lacewing Moth), and then just use the Turquoise Tendril Lantern on it (it will run most times). It's very easy to kill and will die before the other creatures it spawns with.

lady-tenebris.name: Lady Tenebris
lady-tenebris.title: Lady Tenebris
lady-tenebris.loc: A dungeon , accessible through the Death Portal and the Old Masonry.
lady-tenebris.beh: Fights in close combat. Every couple minutes she will teleport players into the middle of the room and after a few seconds she will cast an ultimate explosion around her (7sqm radius) that deals up to 2500 Death Damage.
lady-tenebris.notes: This is one of the bosses in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.

ladybug.name: Ladybug
ladybug.title: Ladybug
ladybug.loc: The Hive surface during the Hive Born World Change's third stage.
ladybug.desc: The unassuming Ladybug seems harmless enough. When left alone to mind their own business, they tend the eggs, repair the delicate structures of the hive and feed other Hive Born creatures with biomass. They do this quite peacefully and without any haste or urgency. When confronted with strangers, though, the Ladybugs show an aggressiveness that rivals that of their bigger brethren and belies their unassuming appearance. They are probably the least dangerous of the Hive Born and are quite territorial. Ladybugs live only for about a week and decay quite fast into a mass that can be easily devoured by other hive creatures or absorbed by the hive. Sometimes they sacrifice themselves and die seemingly on purpose to heal wounded hive structures. Astonishingly enough, unlike other hive creatures, Ladybugs show no great difference in their behaviour when separated from the hive for an extended period of time. While other creatures become increasingly aggressive and eventually mutilate themselves or simply wither and die, the Ladybugs show no such behaviour. Quite the contrary, Ladybugs separated from the hive are reported to live considerably longer and behave more like the common giant…
ladybug.beh: It's very slow, tries to get close to you while attacking with poison.
ladybug.notes: Can be tamed by using a Four-Leaf Clover on it.
ladybug.strat: They are very weak and not a threat compared to the other Hive Born creatures, any attack will suffice.

lamassu.name: Lamassu
lamassu.title: Lamassu
lamassu.desc: Lamassu have the body of a bull, feathered wings and a human head. The noble and stern creatures are a subspecies of the Anuma, magical beasts that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh and were created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. It is said that the entire continent was once given to them by the gods. But the Anuma conferred the dominance over Kilmaresh to the humans, in an effort to let them take responsibility of their own. However, after the religious war between the worshippers of Suon and Fafnar and the cataclysm that severed the continent, the Anuma took the reign over Kilmaresh back - for the humans' own benefit as they said. Lamassu are willing to assist mortal creatures in combat, if they are convinced that those under their protection are worthy and pure of heart. They never shy away from a conflict and will fight to the last breath rather than to retreat or surrender. Lamassu are capable of flight yet prefer to stay on the ground, roaming Kilmaresh's steppe and - more often - ruins. They prefer deserted cities and abandoned temples as their homesteads. Some lamassu even live underground to guard old graveyards and catacombs. They regard themselves as wardens of those…

lancer-beetle.name: Lancer Beetle
lancer-beetle.title: Lancer Beetle
lancer-beetle.loc: Zao Wailing Widow Cave, Muggy Plains (during raid), Razachai, Northern Zao Plantations, Northern Brimstone Bug Cave, Chyllfroest.
lancer-beetle.desc: The vile Lancer Beetle is the only creature that actually seems to thrive with the growing corruption of Zao. In former times a nuisance at best, the Lancer Beetles almost doubled their size and multiplied their dangerousness beyond compare. Within a few years, the vermin became a veritable threat. Campaigns to eradicate this pest by both, the orcs and the lizards, failed to bring a lasting change to the Lancer Beetle population. Not really a swarm insect, Lancer Beetles usually live in small colonies. For unknown reason though, at certain times, they unite to build enormous swarms to devastate whole areas with their ravenous hunger. Guided by an unseen force, they crawl together even from the most remote spots. Without an apparent leader or queen, they seem to share a unique instinct and will to devour and destroy. Usually such swarms are met with resistance by the natives, and sharp battles for survival are fought against such swarms. Often enough, such fights can be compared with an attempt to stop a river with bare hands though. The sheer number of the beetles ready to replace one of their slain kin seems endless. However, after a while, as suddenly as it has formed, the swarm…
lancer-beetle.notes: You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
lancer-beetle.strat: Standing diagonally using Koshei's Ancient Amulet will reduce damage. It is not recommended to hunt before reaching level 40. Mage: They are easy to just block while healing but it is less of a waste to run them using Flame Strike. Druids should use an Ice Damage Rod and Sorcerers a Fire Damaging Wand. A Terra Set will reduce damage further. Paladins: Should kill them quickly as their Poison Missile reduces Distance skill.

larva.name: Larva
larva.title: Larva
larva.loc: Larva Caves, Ankrahmun Tombs, Lion's Rock, Mother of Scarabs Lair, Gardens of Night ( , unreachable).
larva.desc: The Larva of the Daramian desert scarab is a small, yet poisonous insect that usually avoids the sun and dwells only underground. Lacking the hard shells which protect older scarabs and moving rather slowly, they do not pose a too dangerous threat to a well armed warrior. However, in greater numbers they can bring down even a capable foe. Since they usually prefer to remain with their siblings, it is unfortunately not rare to encounter a pack of them at once.
larva.notes: They have low defense and are found in large groups, making them good for leveling. Looks the same as a Parasite.
larva.strat: Just kill them, they're not strong. Knights: Use the same tactic as always, weapon and shield, just treat it like a Rotworm. Paladins: Can hunt larvae with spears and a shield from a low level, perhaps dragging spears to a spawn would be helpful. Mages: Should use low level wands/rods to save mana unless you are using Mana Potions. If you do, then a level 19+ wand/rod will help you kill these much faster, if you don't care about the waste. You can also wear any item from the Terra Set or a Silver Amulet to avoid the damage from their poison. Mages could also use a melee weapon while rune making or spend mana on hasting to get to the Larva faster, as the cave's ground makes you walk slowly.

last-planegazer.name: Last Planegazer
last-planegazer.title: Last Planegazer
last-planegazer.notes: Part of the Opticording Sphere Quest.

latrivan.name: Latrivan
latrivan.title: Latrivan
latrivan.loc: Through the teleport in The Battlefields.
latrivan.beh: Walls of the room is lines with shredderthrowers. Also Golgordan, his brother, is in the same room.
latrivan.notes: The walls of the room is filled with Magicthrowers, Flamethrowers, Plaguethrowers and Shredderthrowers. Also Golgordan, his brother, is in the same room. It's one of the bosses of The Inquisition Quest.

lava-golem.name: Lava Golem
lava-golem.title: Lava Golem
lava-golem.desc: In the deepest depths of Tibia daring explorers sometimes find ruins that were probably ancient even at the dawn of mankind. Not much has been left by the ravages of time. Pictograms can be found in some places which show a civilised octopus-like race which apparently once dwelt in the deep. On those portrayals the race is served by creatures that look like the Lava Golems we know today. It seems the Lava Golems were once creations, servants or pets of that long extinct race. The fact that the Lava Golems of our time are now in service of 'those below' can be interpreted in many ways. Given the facts, it is most likely that the octopus creatures were conquered and annihilated by 'those below' and their creatures enslaved by the vile conquerors. Now the Lava Golems serve as faithful and unquestioning minions of their new masters. The Lava Golems are astonishingly passionless in their duty, usually doing nothing more than they were ordered to do. They quite obviously lack the destructiveness and rage that seems inherent in the other servants of 'those below'. Their masters coped with this issue by obviously giving them a set of rather broadly defined and extremely destructive orders…
lava-golem.strat: Paladins should use their crystalline arrows/prismatic bolts/assassin stars to take down this creatures. If they hunt this kind of creatures, it's recommended use energy walls. For druids and sorcerers is recommended to use sudden death runes to kill this strong creature.

lava-lurker.name: Lava Lurker
lava-lurker.title: Lava Lurker
lava-lurker.desc: The lava lurker seems like a creature just created for mayhem and destruction. It's a creature that seems to be in a constant, highly agitated frenzy, hell-bent on hurting, destroying and devouring. Though arguably more an elemental then a creature the lurker is mostly encountered close to volcanic activity, some even claim to be born or created by it. Despite it's aggressive nature it can become dormant for an unknown time and even blend it with other lave or magma environment being perfectly camouflaged. It's unknown it's actively lurks for prey in this state or becomes somehow awake as soon as a potential victim comes close but the outcome is the same. The lava lurker coms into action and viciously attacks every potential victim like the raging fire that might have given birth to it. With no obvious organs it is unknown how lukers feed. Due to their eagerness to burn and sear thing, it's assumed that ashes of organic matter gives then some sort of sustenance. Though it's theorized that the lurker reproduces like the common slime, this is only wild speculation and not backed up by any evidence at all. The whole comparisons to slimes might be highly misleading and create more…
lava-lurker.notes: Not only are these creatures immune to Fire, they actually get healed by it.
lava-lurker.strat: Hunting these creatures should be avoided since they have a lot of health and only drop one cheap item. If you decide to do so, avoid getting swarmed and try to keep your distance (unless you are a knight, of course) since they are very slow.

lava-puddle.name: Lava Puddle
lava-puddle.title: Lava Puddle (Creature)
lava-puddle.notes: Appears during one of the missions of the Primal Ordeal Quest.

lavafungus.name: Lavafungus
lavafungus.title: Lavafungus
lavafungus.desc: Though probably a naturally occurring creature, the lavafungi are abominations in gnomish eyes. The fungi are a somewhat civilised race that allied with Those Below for their own sinister purposes, The lavafungi obviously propagate in the deepest bowels of earth where its usually so hot, that they are never encountered by races not accustomed to such an intense heat. Only recently, howevr, they have been forced to leave their breeding grounds and to join the forces of Those Below. The constant exposure to an environment that is significantly too cold for their taste puts the already dangerous lavafungi into a constant bad mood that they tend to vent off on their opponents. The fungi that are encountered in battle are only the lowest ranking members of their race and there are hints that colonies of more advanced lavafungi exist in the realm of Those Below. It is speculated that the fungi that are part of the army and advance forms are part of a lower, less educated caste of the fungi and the 'real' lavafungi wield sophisticated weaponry and armour. The lava fungi encountered in the armies of Those Below are seen as disposable and easily replaced. They are often used as garrison…

lavaworm.name: Lavaworm
lavaworm.title: Lavaworm
lavaworm.desc: The lavawarom is a creature of the deepest depths of Tibia. Not only does this creature survive the deepest and hottest places in Tibia, it thrives in it. Deep probes of the gnomes proved that there are countless lava pools, virtually brimming with lavaworms of all sizes. Though probably a very distant cousin of the rotworm, the lavaworm has little in common with its supposed relative. The lavaworm comes in several sizes but the smaller, juvenile speciems can't survive outside of their lava pools for long and the larger versions seem to loose heath too fast and are prone to become immobile stone structures until they gain enough internal heat and shed their outer stone-shell. Only the adolescent lavaworms leave their pools regularly and are herded into the armies of Those Below. They are as aggressive as many minions of Those Below, but lose interest in a fight easily and sometimes even seem to forget what they are doing. They make only weak additions to the troops as they often wander off, are easily distracted and too dumb to understand the concept of an enemy. They become somewhat more effective when they are settled to a specific area where they might serve as a kind of guard…

leaf-golem.name: Leaf Golem
leaf-golem.title: Leaf Golem
leaf-golem.loc: Dryad Gardens, Leaf Dungeon in Hellgate, Lair of the Treeling Witch, Forest Fury Camp and in the Forest Fury version of the Forsaken Mine.
leaf-golem.desc: Leaf Golems are a compilation of twigs, leaves and bark that are inhabited by lesser spirits of nature. Sometimes the spirits create the golems on their own, to act as a vehicle or tool to interact with the physical world. More often tough Leaf Golems are spirits that have been bound into such constructs by some druidic power. Mighty druids often employ the help of leaf golems spontaneously. They are created on the fly and often are discarded when a task has been performed. such discarded golems often disassemble on their own and the spirit is set free, sometimes they decide to roam the world on their own. Leave Golems are intelligent, but their thinking is based on the spiritual world and completely alien to the denizens of the physical world. Therefore it is impossible to communicate with them in any form. As spirits they seem to care little for the integrity of a physical body and they often seek to destroy living beings, presumably to set their seemingly entrapped spirit free. Even if they might mean no true harm, their attacks are threatening and lethal nonetheless. The leaf golem is a random and undecided fighter, oblivious to what might be most effective in a given…
leaf-golem.beh: A Leaf Golem will push or kill weaker creatures which block access to the player it is targetting.
leaf-golem.strat: It's a rather weak creature, roughly comparable to a Swampling. Players will have little to no trouble taking it down, however, low level Druids should avoid hunting them as they are pretty strong to earth damage.

leiden.name: Leiden
leiden.title: Leiden
leiden.loc: Boss room of Barkless Cult Trial Zone under Ab'Dendriel
leiden.notes: Part of the Cults of Tibia Quest.
leiden.strat: Healing this boss by casting Mass Healing and using Ultimate Healing Rune (Item) is the fastest way to kill it. Avoid using elemental damage as it heals the boss. There is also an alternative way to kill the boss by attacking Wine Cask (Creature) which will summon Liquor Spirits which will then cast area spells that will damage Leiden. Turns into Ravenous Hunger on death.

lersatio.name: Lersatio
lersatio.title: Lersatio
lersatio.beh: He fights till death. Uses Invisibility very often.
lersatio.notes: Lersatio was once a normal person and a citizen of Carlin. He, his brothers Arthei, Marziel, and Boreth, and Arthei's wife Kala, travelled to Yalahar in order to find a new home. From that moment on Marziel started keeping a diary. Lersatio is a vain vampire who dreams to see his face in a mirror again, which is why he awakens when you break the mirrors near him.
