massive-fire-elemental.notes: Mostly found with Hellfire Fighters in the Demon Forge. A two spawn also exists in the deeper parts of Banuta.

massive-water-elemental.name: Massive Water Elemental
massive-water-elemental.title: Massive Water Elemental
massive-water-elemental.loc: Calassa, Frozen Trench, Water Elemental Dungeon through the water channels, before Zugurosh in The Inquisition Quest.
massive-water-elemental.desc: Massive Water Elementals are considerably bigger, meaner and more powerful than their smaller brethren. They usually live in the deep seas and it was never heard that they have ever left the sea at all. It is speculated that they draw a significant portion of their power from the surrounding sea and that they might turn into normal water elementals if they ever left the sea for a longer period. Massive Water Elementals are extremely powerful and can stand a considerable amount of damage. Using their liquid form, they can pass each terrain with ease and they usually try to get their prey as fast as they can, crushing it with their tremendous strength. Having immense magical powers, no one within sight can escape their ferocious attacks. Sometimes Massive Water Elementals seem to ally with energy elementals, particularly if a storm is approaching. It is unknown whether such alliances are formed by chance or if they are planned. Be that as it may, it is surely one of the worst nightmares that one can experience when two types of elementals attack a ship or a seaport while a violent storm is raging.
massive-water-elemental.beh: Massive Water Elementals are as fast as a Level 100 character.
massive-water-elemental.notes: Their corpses become a puddle of water, which can be looted but not moved. You can also fish their fresh corpses to obtain one of the following: *Nothing *Giant Shimmering Pearl *White Pearl *Small Sapphire *Small Emerald *Leviathan's Amulet
massive-water-elemental.strat: All vocations: Remember to bring your Helmet of the Deep when hunting these! It blocks 100% of their strongest attack, the water bomb. The heavy weight of the helmet will be easily compensated as it will save you from their most deadly combos. Mages should use Energy-Based Attacks and run. Paladins should run away from them in most cases, but if you have to fight use a good bow and flash arrows. Knights should run away from them in most cases, but if you have to fight use spells to kill them fast.

maw.name: Maw
maw.title: Maw
maw.beh: Keeps distance while shooting low amounts of damage and healing himself.
maw.notes: One of the Hive Bosses Part of the War Against the Hive Quest
maw.strat: Separate him from other monsters and treat him as weak Hive Overseer without summons.

mawhawk.name: Mawhawk
mawhawk.title: Mawhawk

ab.n: Ultimate Explosion (announced when in very low health)

mawhawk.loc: Mawhawk's Lair, east part of the Guzzlemaw Valley, ramp to his lair appears as a world change.
mawhawk.notes: When summoning Guzzlemaws, Mawhawk says " ". When it says " ", it will cast his Ultimate Explosion in 5 seconds. You can find the loot of this creature in a Reward Container. Starting at server save, there is a chance of Mawhawk spawning every 10 minutes. For example, if Mawhawk spawned at , as long as he was killed within 10 minutes, the next chance of him spawning will be at .

maxxenius.name: Maxxenius
maxxenius.title: Maxxenius
maxxenius.beh: It does not retarget very often, but will frequently transform its target on an Energy Elemental. It uses its Energy Beam and Wave very often, frequently on the same turn, which may result in a high combo.
maxxenius.notes: It's one of the bosses of The Dream Courts Quest.
maxxenius.strat: Players should wear energy protection against this boss. There are two key points to be aware of when fighting Maxxenius: 1. Maxxenius is healed by Energy Damage, so this element shouldn't be used by players. Furthermore, there are Generators that constantly use an Energy spell around them, and the outer tiles of the room will also pulsate with an energy spell. Thus, Maxxenius must be blocked away from these fields. The north-west area of the room is ideal for that, but i can also be done on the east side of the room. 2. During the fight, Maxxenius will frequently transform its target in an Energy Elemental. About 10 seconds after the transformation, the player will "explode" dealing 1000-1500 energy damage around him (2 fields radius). Thus, in order to avoid healing the boss, this player should move away from it. This can be done easily if there are 2 Knights and the one that isn't transformed Challenges Maxxenius so the other one can run away. In case no second Knight is available, the same result can also be achieved but the players will have to force Maxxenius to change target without using Challenge.

mazoran.name: Mazoran
mazoran.title: Mazoran
mazoran.loc: Grounds of Fire, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.
mazoran.beh: It fights in close range and does not retarget often.
mazoran.notes: He is the minion of Infernatil.
mazoran.strat: This boss is one of the easiest of its peers. The main danger when facing Mazoran is the floor, which will become Lava that deals 1500 Fire Damage every minute or so. Thus, the safest strategy for the team is to position in one of the sides of the room and avoid moving. During the fight, Rages of Mazoran will also spawn when the floor becomes lava - they can be easily killed with Ice area attacks.

mazzinor.name: Mazzinor
mazzinor.title: Mazzinor
mazzinor.notes: Part of The Secret Library Quest.

meadow-strider.name: Meadow Strider
meadow-strider.title: Meadow Strider
meadow-strider.notes: They are a weaker Marsh Stalker. They are one of the weaker creatures of Dawnport, but still strong for a new character.
meadow-strider.strat: Watch out because they can hit a lot to the bare-equipped player. Run them on attack to avoid being hit by more monsters. Consider killing the weaker Mountain Trolls and Troll-Trained Salamanders first because they add to the damage taken for this comparatively long fight.

mean-lost-soul.name: Mean Lost Soul
mean-lost-soul.title: Mean Lost Soul
mean-lost-soul.desc: Mean lost souls managed to retain a certain level of consciousness. Instead of coming to terms with the reasons they got lost, they embrace their conflicts and hatred. They are driven by malicious intents and roam the nether realms almost in a predatory way. Some of them manage to evolve into more malicious forms after a long time of existence. This is often encouraged by a dark mentor that already acquired such a state. Such mentors tend to gather a cultish following of mean lost souls that serve as their minions and army. Others band together in loose-knit groups of mutual benefit. Though relatively rare, their conscious efforts or assignments lead them into the more populated areas of the netherworlds that raise the chance to encounter them significantly. They often relish into inciting other kinds of lost souls to join them in their attacks by means unknown to modern researchers. The malicious component of the mean lost souls seem to be a vital and driving factor in their existence. If in some way pacified, the mean lost souls revert to an instinctive state of mind out of which they sometimes cant switch back. Mean lost sous seem strongly attracted to the world of the living…
mean-lost-soul.beh: Uses mana drain but only against druids. This mechanic was confirmed to be intended in a by Skerio on 23.01.2020.

mean-termite.name: Mean Termite
mean-termite.title: Mean Termite
mean-termite.beh: They will run away from you.
mean-termite.notes: Part of the Journey mission of A Pirate's Tail Quest.
mean-termite.strat: Kill them as fast as possible.

meandering-mushroom.name: Meandering Mushroom
meandering-mushroom.title: Meandering Mushroom
meandering-mushroom.desc: An unsettling sight to behold, the Meandering Mushroom is a fungoid mass driven by instinctive needs to devour and spread rot. Its existence is solely dedicated to the relentless pursuit of sustenance, causing everything it touches to wither and decay. With each step it takes, a sickly miasma emanates from its cap, suffusing the air with a putrid stench. Though lacking intelligence, its insatiable hunger propels it forward, leaving a trail of blighted landscapes and twisted flora in its wake. The Meandering Mushroom is drawn to sources of life, consuming them with a ravenous hunger, and ensuring that the realm's decay perpetuates unabated.

mearidion.name: Mearidion
mearidion.title: Mearidion
mearidion.notes: Mearidions are ranged creatures with consistent single target damage. They attack with death damage.

mechanical-fighter.name: Mechanical Fighter
mechanical-fighter.title: Mechanical Fighter
mechanical-fighter.loc: Beregar, the Mad Technomancer's laboratory in Kazordoon, and can also be summoned by Furious Trolls
mechanical-fighter.beh: Follows the victim without mercy but still runs in low health.
mechanical-fighter.notes: Unlike most other traps, you can kill this creature.
mechanical-fighter.strat: Kill it as fast as possible.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.title: Medusa

ab.n: 1 to 5 Life Drain Terra Strikes simultaneously

medusa.loc: Vandura Mountain (single spawn), Talahu (Medusa Cave), Deeper Banuta, Medusa Tower
medusa.desc: Although Medusae are relatively rare, even the earliest Tibian historians have mentioned them in their writings. There has been much speculation as to what exactly Medusae actually are and several theories were propagated. Legends have recounted stories of ancient priestesses punished in horrible ways for their vanity, creatures created as a result of forbidden rituals and some even have it that Medusae are the offspring of mankind and demons. While none of these stories is actually true, they do reflect the fact that Medusae are not regarded as a natural phenomenon, in fact, that their very existence is the result of a perversion of nature. This aspect of these stories does in fact reflect reality. Recent research conducted with the help of daring adventurers has shed a great deal of light upon the origin of Medusae. It has been discovered that they are in fact elemental creatures of earth. They are, or, more accurately, were spirits of nature and earth, probably closely related to dryads. Such spirits are known to be bound to specific places. Their appearance and nature is a reflection of the place they are bound to. While this is their strength it is also their vulnerability,…
medusa.notes: Medusa is a mythological creature that can transform people who look directly into her eyes to stone. (See also: Medusa in Wikipedia). You may hunt 500 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Gorgo.

mega-dragon.name: Mega Dragon
mega-dragon.title: Mega Dragon
mega-dragon.desc: Mega Dragons are bred to be the new ruling class of dragonkind, a reflection of the ancient dragon Nimmersatt's grand vision and himself. These colossal and conceited creatures, adorned with three heads, are constantly engaged in fierce battles for supremacy. Their internecine struggles are exacerbated by their shared belief that they are the epitome of excellence. It doesn't help they were taught to be the best of the best as each head tends to see those words as addressed to himself only. Rarely do the heads find accord, but when they do, the Mega Dragon ascends rapidly in power. Whenever one of their kind becomes overly influential, it is prone to draw the attention of Nimmersatt. In theory such dragons should be all what Nimmersatt envisioned then to be. However, this often triggers his vanity, leading to the unfortunate fate of the influential dragons being invited to his dinner table - as lunch. Nimmersatt's casual disregard for the potential consequences of his actions may prove detrimental to his ambitions of dragon dominance, but in his eyes, Nimmersatt is always right.

megasylvan-sapling.name: Megasylvan Sapling
megasylvan-sapling.title: Megasylvan Sapling (Creature)
megasylvan-sapling.beh: It cannot move. When killed the corpse becomes a Lump of Dirt.
megasylvan-sapling.strat: As part of the Adventures of Galthen Quest, four Megasylvan Saplings appear in the corners of Megasylvan Yseldas boss room. To receive the Violet Tulip, the Saplings must be kept alive—either by using Ultimate Healing Runes or by having a Druid cast Mass Healing on them. In some cases, if your party deals damage quickly enough, the Saplings’ initial health may be sufficient for them to survive without direct healing, as long as Megasylvan Yselda is quick enough. To make Megasylvan Yselda vulnerable to attacks, say the words . This will weaken her defenses, allowing you to deal damage.

megasylvan-yselda.name: Megasylvan Yselda
megasylvan-yselda.title: Megasylvan Yselda
megasylvan-yselda.loc: In the Forest of Life through the Sleeping Carnisylvan .
megasylvan-yselda.notes: She's a metamorphing form of Yselda, betrothed of Kesar the Younger and future Queen of Bounac. Part of the Adventures of Galthen Quest.
megasylvan-yselda.strat: To make Megasylvan Yselda vulnerable to attacks, you must say the words . This will weaken her defenses, allowing you to deal damage. Additionally, to complete the Adventures of Galthen Quest - Galthen and the Lost Queen, you must heal the four Megasylvan Saplings, which are located in each corner of the boss room. You can do this by using Ultimate Healing Runes or by having a Druid cast Mass Healing on them. This step is required in order to receive the Violet Tulip. However, if your team deals enough damage quickly, the Saplings’ initial health may be sufficient for them to survive without healing, as long as Megasylvan Yselda is defeated fast enough.

memory-of-a-carnisylvan.name: Memory of a Carnisylvan
memory-of-a-carnisylvan.title: Memory of a Carnisylvan
memory-of-a-carnisylvan.beh: Keeps 4 sqm distance from its target.
memory-of-a-carnisylvan.notes: This creature seems to be a weakened version of Poisonous Carnisylvan.
memory-of-a-carnisylvan.strat: A level 60+ mage (even unpromoted) can easily hunt these creatures for 250k+ raw exp/h. Wear Terra Set and bring lots of Great Fireballs and Fire Bombs. Free account players should take Fireballs as well. Summon 2 Demon Skeletons, which are immune to earth damage and heal them from time to time. Since the Carnisylvans will run away from the skeletons, you can maneuver them to pull a bunch of Carnisylvans, each doing no damage unless trapped. Finish them with GFB + Great Fire Wave. At level 60 you should take care not to be attacked by more than one mob at a time and heal often. Another strategy is to burn the ground with runes and run (in circles) away from your summon which is followed by the Carnisylvans.

memory-of-a-lizard.name: Memory of a Lizard
memory-of-a-lizard.title: Memory of a Lizard
memory-of-a-lizard.notes: It's a weakened Lizard High Guard.

memory-of-a-werelion.name: Memory of a Werelion
memory-of-a-werelion.title: Memory of a Werelion
memory-of-a-werelion.notes: It's an altered version of a Werelion, which seems to have increased HP, but reduced damage.

menace.name: Menace
menace.title: Menace
menace.notes: One of the Isle of Strife's Arena Masters. Can be skinned to obtain Lizard Leather. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

menacing-carnivor.name: Menacing Carnivor
menacing-carnivor.title: Menacing Carnivor
menacing-carnivor.desc: This species as the name already says exclusively feeds on raw meat. The very special way of digesting its prey leads to very unique products a hunter can obtain. The items of interest are little glass plates that arise in the so called process of glassification. They are coveted materials for craftsmanship. During their development, they go through various stages which ultimately manifest in specific habits and appearance.
menacing-carnivor.strat: Be careful when fighting them as they usually come in large packs and followed by the other Carnivora.

mental-nexus.name: Mental-Nexus
mental-nexus.title: Mental-Nexus
mental-nexus.notes: It's part of the fight against The Brainstealer boss of the Too Hot to Handle Quest.

mephiles.name: Mephiles
mephiles.title: Mephiles
mephiles.beh: He will attack at a certain distance. Therefore, if you approach him, he will run away.
mephiles.notes: It's the third floor boss. Use his body to get a random reward before you use the body of Evil Mastermind, otherwise you may not get any item. Is an allusion to the demon Mephistopheles that appears in literature as a stock character version of the Devil.
mephiles.strat: Corner him and kill it fast.

mercurial-menace.name: Mercurial Menace
mercurial-menace.title: Mercurial Menace
mercurial-menace.desc: The Mercurial Menace is a distant relative of the ordinary wyvern. Albeit aside from the shape of its silhouette similarities quickly end. The reflective skin of the Mercurial Menace does not only provide an ample physical protection, but it also shrouds the fast moving flyer with a shroud of irritating light reflections that can confuse opponents and let many attacks only hit thin air. Yet this additional protection comes with added weight that makes airborne manoeuvres vastly more difficult and the Mercurial Menace quickly becomes hard pressed to maintain greater heights even if needed. There seems to be a yet to be discovered island at some remote spot in the gnomerean seas, where they return to breed and raise their young. This somewhat seem to restrict them to certain areas of Gnomprona and stop them from spreading too far. As the Mercurial Menaces seems to spend only little time there at all such a place is probably some inhospitable yet safe piece of rock. Their seemingly erratic movement and attack patterns add to the confusion, which is one of the most dangerous tools of this flying predator. It moves swiftly, attacks, retreats a little only to attack again in the next…

mercury-blob.name: Mercury Blob
mercury-blob.title: Mercury Blob
mercury-blob.desc: This silver fluid is actually some sort of residue of magical experiments involving teleporting and travelling to other dimensions. Actually, they are part of the usually unseen membrane that separates different states of existence such as dimensions, spheres and worlds. Sometimes, while something is passing from one state of existence to another, parts of the membrane are spilled into one of the worlds involved. Even if it is hard to believe, this residue seems to own some sort of intelligence or at least some instinct. However, it is also possible that a Mercury Blob has an incredibly high intellect which has a concept that we simply cannot grasp. Though the residue interacts with objects and people in our world, there seems no true purpose in its actions. Whenever it meets a human being it seems to start an attack; however, no malice can be attributed to this behaviour. It is doubtful whether the residue is aware of the harm it causes or the concept of harm at all. Maybe the attacks are a form of communication attempts. Sadly, these attempts are often lethal for mortals, and so it is strongly advised to fight back with all means. Its ability to produce a copy of itself might be…
mercury-blob.beh: Like a Slime, will advance towards its prey in attempt to overwhelm it by summoning more Mercury Blobs.
mercury-blob.strat: Kill it like a Slime, being wary of geting surrounded by its Summons. Don't try to run around this monster, because when it makes you Drunk, you will be unable to escape.

merikh-the-slaughterer.name: Merikh the Slaughterer
merikh-the-slaughterer.title: Merikh the Slaughterer
merikh-the-slaughterer.loc: Magician Quarter (Yalahar), past the teleport on the top floor, which is located .
merikh-the-slaughterer.notes: Try to stay away unless you want to be surrounded by his summons. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Note: The mission rewards are given before facing this boss, but he must be fought before you can re-take the task.
merikh-the-slaughterer.strat: The biggest problem to fight this boss is reaching his location, as the upper floor of the djinn tower is FULL of efreets, with their summons, they can bring down a level 80 knight in a strong combo if all are lured to the stairs, bring the best potions you can drink and heal whenever your hp gets lower than 800, Elven Amulet is STRONGLY recommended to go up this last floor (although the efreets will deplete it within 5 seconds average), might ring can be useful for lower level vocations, it's not recommended to go up the last floor for levels below 80. You can consider this boss as a stronger Efreet with a lot of hitpoints. Any vocation should kill him quickly before his summons increase total damage. Paladins should run and use Assassin Stars. Mages should simply attack him with SD's and/or Ice Strike. Knights: Since moving is not necessary while fighting him, you bring a strong two handed weapon and wear a Sword, Axe, or Club Ring while fighting him and wear your Dwarven Ring later. Also, bring along some mana potions to attack him with berserk, heal if your hp gets below 500, and 800 if he has both summons.

merlkin.name: Merlkin
merlkin.title: Merlkin
merlkin.desc: Even a few of the ape people are able to command some kind of strange magic. It is hard to say which role the Merlkins play in the ape society, but they are probably described best as some kind of primitive witch doctors. It is another mystery how those primitives were able to develop any kind of magic at all, but considering the fact that those apes raid the human settlements to steal their tools, it is very likely that they have also stolen their knowledge about magic. Their ability to wield magic hints at a greater intelligence than that of their cousins with whom they seem to live in an uneasy peace. Animosities between the different breeds have been reported, so it is unlikely that the Merlkin are a kind of elite among the apes. Still they work together with the other ape races and their strange magic combined with the skills of the others form very effective attack forces.
merlkin.beh: Merlkin can be very tricky because they can spam you with attacks and walk away. They will try to keep a short distance from you, but they are easy to catch since they do not run very fast. They can move items that are in their way and Retarget. They have the ability to bring down even a high level player.
merlkin.notes: The Merlkin are the magic users of the apes. They can best be described by being some kind of primitive witch doctor. Considering the fact that those apes raid the human settlements to steal their tools, it is very likely that they have also stolen their knowledge about magic. Their ability to wield magic hints at a greater intelligence than that of their cousins (the Sibang and the Kongra) with whom they seem to live in an uneasy peace. Still, the Merlkins work together with the other ape races and their strange magic combined with the skills of the others form very effective attack forces. After the christmas update 2008, the merlkin could be seldom much stronger, so take care! You may hunt 300 Kongra, Sibang, Merlkin combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
merlkin.strat: Always kill the Merlkins in a group of apes first, since they can do the most damage, and can spam you with distance attacks. Knights should drive it in a corner and kill it with a two-handed weapon. Other vocations should use Bolts, Icicle runes, or Avalanches to kill them fast.

metal-gargoyle.name: Metal Gargoyle
metal-gargoyle.title: Metal Gargoyle
metal-gargoyle.loc: Workshop Quarter, Glooth Factory, Underground Glooth Factory, Abandoned Sewers, Oramond Dungeon (depending on Magistrate votes), Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon.
metal-gargoyle.desc: The metal gargoyles are a common sight in the city of Rathleton. Visitors are rarely aware though that they serve another purpose then pure decoration. In fact, the gargoyles are wards and vessels for the various spirits that plague the whole isle. The first gargoyles were build as mere wards, covered with barely visible engravings of protective runes. They were placed all over the city and did at least ease the pressure of disturbing spirits a bit. Still exorcists were needed to drive out spirits from homes, places and people. Those brave people faced the problem that even exorcised spirits tended to reappear quite soon and they had to look for a more permanent solution. They needed a vessel to keep the spirits captured and bound. The gargoyles, already prepared to repel spiritual power became their first choice. Newly constructed gargoyles were no longer placed in the city immediately but stored until needed by exorcists. Then the exorcist would bind the spirit into the gargoyle, where it would be trapped by the wards. When an exorcist decided a gargoyle had reached it keeping potential, the gargoyle was finally placed at its final resting place. This procedure though was not…
metal-gargoyle.beh: Metal gargoyles can retarget. This may causes shooters in a team hunt to be cursed or killed.
metal-gargoyle.strat: Treat them as dragons. Stand diagonal if possible to avoid damage from the beam. Life Drain protection is advisable when hunting them alongside Rustheap Golems. They are very slow, so you shouldn't have any problems with keeping distance as a mage or a paladin.

michael-the-stalwart.name: Michael the Stalwart
michael-the-stalwart.title: Michael the Stalwart

loot.i: Personal Letter of Michael the Stalwart I
Personal Letter of Michael the Stalwart II
Personal Letter of Michael the Stalwart III

michael-the-stalwart.strat: Keep it moving, as standing still will increase the counter visible next to his name. The higher the counter, the higher the damage it deals. At the maximum 10 stacks, he will deal approximately 50% more damage.

midnight-asura.name: Midnight Asura
midnight-asura.title: Midnight Asura
midnight-asura.desc: Asuri are demonic creatures who usually hide their true face and appear in the form of beautiful women. Though they can take different shapes they favour a seductive appearance, for example in the form of young dancers. These demonesses are driven mainly by greed and envy. They enter the mortal world because they begrudge humans and other peoples their vigour, beauty and happiness. They seek to destroy positive feelings as love, contentment and mirth, because herefrom they gain their energy. An asura especially stalks men she regards as handsome and happy. These victims are lured into gorgeous palaces full of riches and conveniences, inhabited by several asuri. There they ensnare the men with amusements such as wine, music, dance and intoxicating substances that indulge their senses and make them submissive and weak-willed. Then the asuri divest them of vitality and beauty. When an asura gets weary of her victim or if captives unexpectedly oppose the demonesses, these unfortunates come to know the true face of the palace: As the asuri show a beautiful face outwardly and are in truth terrible demons, likewise the palace, behind its marvelous veneer, is full of prison cells, torture…

midnight-panther.name: Midnight Panther
midnight-panther.title: Midnight Panther
midnight-panther.desc: For a long time the Midnight Panther was considered a myth like the Unjaga or the Yeti. Seemingly, the old lizard civilisation of Tiquanda has hunted these beasts almost to extinction. That way it made its way into legends and myths. As master of stealth and surprise, it strikes from the shadows, unexpected and deadly. The death of the victims were usually associated with one of the many other dangers of the jungle. Only a daring expedition of the Explorer Society that tried to uncover the myth of the Midnight Panther brought home proof of its existence. Many members of the expedition paid this discovery with their lives. As living myth, the Midnight Panther is attributed with many magic abilities and skills. Given the short and violent confrontation of the expedition with a Midnight Panther, none of those claims could be verified. For this reason, many facts concerning the Midnight Panther are still only speculation. All that can be taken as a fact is that the Midnight Panther is extremely rare, reclusive and dangerous.
midnight-panther.beh: It will hit you with melee and if you try to tame it, it may dissapear (run away). They will kill weaker creatures to reach you. The panther is a quick creature.
midnight-panther.notes: Midnight Panthers are a very rare spawn in Tiquanda (approximately once every 3 days). You can tame the Midnight Panther by using a Leather Whip or a Music Box on it. There is no specific time of the day for it to spawn, like any other boss, it's absolutely random. Interestingly, when slain, the creature name changes: .

midnight-spawn.name: Midnight Spawn
midnight-spawn.title: Midnight Spawn
midnight-spawn.loc: Forbidden Lands around [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=128.251-127.50-7-4-1-1 the Lightbringer's basin].
midnight-spawn.notes: Appears as a raid for five minutes after a player lights the Lightbringer's Basin and receives the following message
midnight-spawn.strat: Bring a Dwarven Ring to avoid luring other strong creatures like Behemoth or Massive Earth Elemental. Use Energy Bombs to protect yourself from them and the Behemoths.

midnight-warrior.name: Midnight Warrior
midnight-warrior.title: Midnight Warrior
midnight-warrior.loc: Plains of Havoc around [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=128.61-126.104-7-2-1-1 the Lightbringer's basin].
midnight-warrior.notes: Appears as a raid for five minutes after a player lights the Lightbringer's Basin and receives the following message
midnight-warrior.strat: They are quite slow when they don't haste, although their melee is pretty high. You can try to trap them or simply lure them to a narrow point, and then just GFB them to death.

mimar-haffar.name: Mimar Haffar
mimar-haffar.title: Mimar Haffar
mimar-haffar.notes: This is the first form of Mimar Haffar. It appears during the Make Believe Quest. Its final form, Mimar Haffar (Final), is seen in the second phase of the final battle of the quest. It is a boss available for the Boss Difficulty System, and its fight can vary in difficulty and reward according to players' choices.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.title: Mimic
mimic.loc: Third dream in the Dream Realm
mimic.notes: They are shape shifters. Legends say they shapeshift into items that are of your inner-most desire. They were summonable for a short period.
mimic.strat: They don't attack and you can't kill them either, so simply just watch them or ignore them.

mindmasher.name: Mindmasher
mindmasher.title: Mindmasher

ab.n: makes you drown for some time
summons four weak copies of himself

mindmasher.beh: Summons copies of himself to attack with. Both him and his summons can go invisible. Its summons are extremely weak to physical damage.
mindmasher.notes: One of the Hive Bosses Part of the War Against the Hive Quest
mindmasher.strat: Separate from other monsters and simply take him down, he's not too strong.

minion-of-gazharagoth.name: Minion of Gaz'haragoth
minion-of-gazharagoth.title: Minion of Gaz'haragoth
minion-of-gazharagoth.loc: Spawned by Gaz'haragoth in his arena.
minion-of-gazharagoth.notes: Looks the same as a Demon Outcast. They are spawned by Gaz'haragoth but they act as independent monsters. When slain, they turn into Strange Vortexes which lead to the Nightmare of Gaz'haragoth.

minion-of-versperoth.name: Minion of Versperoth
minion-of-versperoth.title: Minion of Versperoth
minion-of-versperoth.notes: They replaced the Lava Golems spawning with Versperoth in update 9.61 (August 9) probably because of potential farming abuse. They appear to be the same as Lava Golems, save for giving no Loot or Experience.

minor-timedisplaced-anomaly.name: Minor Timedisplaced Anomaly
minor-timedisplaced-anomaly.title: Minor Timedisplaced Anomaly (Rookgaard)
minor-timedisplaced-anomaly.notes: It's one of the bosses which awards Theons as part of Tibia's 25th Anniversary. The combined Loot Statistics of this boss and the other two with the same name can be seen here.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.title: Minotaur
minotaur.loc: Mino Hell (Rookgaard), Two outside Bear Room Quest, (Rookgaard) and also 2x on the premium side, Mintwallin, Folda, Minotaur Pyramid, Outlaw Camp, Kazordoon minotaur cave, Plains of Havoc, Elven Bane, Deeper Fibula Dungeon (level 50+ to open the door), Ancient Temple, Maze of Lost Souls, Thais Minotaur Camp, Foreigner Quarter.
minotaur.desc: Minotaurs are cross-breeds of humans and bulls. They live in great caves where they even build proper towns. Furthermore, they arrange troops that repel every intruder from their empire. Minotaurs are average fighters, but organised as a military squad they can be quite dangerous.
minotaur.notes: A strong half-human, half-bull creature. These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. You have around 5% chance to get a Minotaur Leather from a dead body. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.
minotaur.strat: If you are in Rookgaard, avoid attacking them alone, unless you have Small Health Potions. In the mainland, they should not pose a major threat to a prepared adventurer.

minotaur-amazon.name: Minotaur Amazon
minotaur-amazon.title: Minotaur Amazon
minotaur-amazon.loc: Underground Glooth Factory, Oramond Minotaur Camp, Oramond Dungeon
minotaur-amazon.desc: The minotaur amazons are an all-female minotaur sect that revere the great mother, also known as holy cow. They consider themselves as the mothers of the minotaur nations and are extremely protective about them. In former days the amazon were respected healer-preachers of their faith and even tiny settlements often had a crone, providing knowledge and healing to those in need. Less prone to rage then their male counterparts they often worked as spiritual advisors and were responsible to calm those lost in their rage. Since the latter could be quite dangerous the amazons always received some form of combat training. After years of peaceful stagnation, the raising threats and pressure to minotaur societies led to a change though. Ralda, a wandering priestess took it upon her to renew their faith and change it through new doctrines. The peaceful and rather passive role switched gradually into a more protective and active one. The combat training became more emphasized and the amazons began to accompany their people into battles. This change gained more and more in momentum by it success and was at last adapted even by societies that never had come into contact with Raldo themselves.…
minotaur-amazon.beh: It fights from a distance throwing spears at its target.
minotaur-amazon.notes: These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.
minotaur-amazon.strat: Watch out when its health becomes red because it will run away and chasing it may lure you into more creatures.

minotaur-archer.name: Minotaur Archer
minotaur-archer.title: Minotaur Archer
minotaur-archer.loc: Ancient Temple, way to Mintwallin, Folda Underground Cave, Outlaw Camp, Plains of Havoc, Kazordoon Minotaur Tower, Daramian Minotaur Pyramid, Deeper Fibula Dungeon (level 50+ to open the door), Hero Cave, Foreigner Quarter and Elvenbane.
minotaur-archer.desc: Minotaur Archers form the artillery of the minotaurs' army. Using their crossbows they shoot bolts at their enemies. Many adventurers have died in the hail of missiles. Usually, they are accompanied by other types of minotaurs.
minotaur-archer.notes: A powerful minotaur. Popular to Summon as it is almost as deadly as a Fire Devil and requires less mana. These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.
minotaur-archer.strat: Run towards them and don't let them attack from a distance. Usually in company of Minotaur Guards and Minotaur Mages. Be careful, as this creature is strong and can kill an inexperienced player pretty quickly. Stealth Rings can be a big help when facing many of these.

minotaur-bruiser.name: Minotaur Bruiser
minotaur-bruiser.title: Minotaur Bruiser
minotaur-bruiser.notes: A weaker Minotaur. Created for Dawnport to introduce new players to the game. Minotaur Bruisers come in groups with other Minotaurs (Poachers, Occultists, and Minotaurs), as well as Wasps, and Poison Spiders. Care must be taken because the magi of their kind, Occultists, are very strong in comparison.

minotaur-cult-follower.name: Minotaur Cult Follower
minotaur-cult-follower.title: Minotaur Cult Follower
minotaur-cult-follower.desc: The Minotaur Cult Follower is a stronger version of Minotaurs.
minotaur-cult-follower.beh: It looks like a regular Minotaur but it's much stronger. You can skin its corpse using an Obsidian Knife to get a Minotaur Leather.
minotaur-cult-follower.strat: If possible, keep your distance to avoid its melee attacks.

minotaur-cult-prophet.name: Minotaur Cult Prophet
minotaur-cult-prophet.title: Minotaur Cult Prophet

ab.n: Mass Healing that also heals his allies

minotaur-cult-prophet.desc: The Minotaur Cult Follower is a stronger version of Minotaur Mages.
minotaur-cult-prophet.beh: Unlike Minotaur Mages, they fight in close combat. They can heal themselves as well as their allies.
minotaur-cult-prophet.notes: It looks like a Minotaur Mage but it's much stronger and attacks at close range. You can skin its corpse using an Obsidian Knife to get a Minotaur Leather.
minotaur-cult-prophet.strat: If possible, keep your distance to avoid its melee attacks. Be careful because it can use high damage combos.

minotaur-cult-zealot.name: Minotaur Cult Zealot
minotaur-cult-zealot.title: Minotaur Cult Zealot
minotaur-cult-zealot.desc: The Minotaur Cult Follower is a stronger version of Minotaur Guards.
minotaur-cult-zealot.notes: It looks like a Minotaur Guard but it's much stronger. You can skin its corpse using an Obsidian Knife to get a Minotaur Leather.
minotaur-cult-zealot.strat: If possible, keep your distance to avoid its melee attacks. When in close combat stay diagonal to avoid its beam.

minotaur-guard.name: Minotaur Guard
minotaur-guard.title: Minotaur Guard
minotaur-guard.loc: Ancient Temple, Mintwallin, Minotaur Pyramid, Maze of Lost Souls, Folda, Cyclopolis, Deeper Fibula Dungeon (level 50+ to open the door), Hero Cave, underground of Elvenbane, Plains of Havoc, Kazordoon Minotaur Cave, Foreigner Quarter.
minotaur-guard.desc: Minotaur Guards form the heavy troops of the minotaurs' army. They are tough short-range fighters but vulnerable by distance fighting weapons. Watch out for archers that are usually placed in the second row behind them.
minotaur-guard.beh: Minotaur Guards will kill weaker creatures to reach a player. They can also retarget.
minotaur-guard.notes: These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.

minotaur-hunter.name: Minotaur Hunter
minotaur-hunter.title: Minotaur Hunter
minotaur-hunter.loc: Oramond/Southern Plains, Minotaur Hills, Oramond Dungeon (depending on Magistrate votes), Underground Glooth Factory
minotaur-hunter.desc: The minotaur hunters are not committed to hunt for food but rather to act as scouts and eliminate dangers for the minotaur society. Expert trackers and big game hunters they shun other distance weapons then the spear. They are equally skilled in throwing their spears as in wielding them in battle and as they are trained in some minotaur form of paladin knowledge they are able to conjure them on their own in time of need. A hunter's training begins early in life and requires a certain dedication as the tests of skill and endurance are increasingly challenging from year to year. Each year a number of candidates is rejected and sent to other duties often to the army where their skills are welcome. So many minotaur soldiers possess some grade of schooling in outdoorsmanship. Those who pass all tests are welcomed into the local hunters' lodges. As other societies in minotaur civilization, the hunters are rather secretive about the rituals and secret knowledge of their lodges so little is known beyond the obvious. Only fully accepted hunters are taught the last secrets of the lodges, as certainly several spells to hone their skills. They are also schooled in the anatomy of different…
minotaur-hunter.notes: These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.
minotaur-hunter.strat: Their explosion attack is where you'll probably get most damage from. They are usually not a huge threat when they're alone but in groups they quickly become very dangerous. It is suggested to take out any other creatures present before attempting to kill the Minotaur Hunter as they can flee and lure you into an army of other minotaurs. When they haste they are about as fast as a level 160. An energy wall thrown behind their back will block their escape.

minotaur-idol.name: Minotaur Idol
minotaur-idol.title: Minotaur Idol
minotaur-idol.notes: It looks like a Glooth Powered Minotaur or a Moohtant with different colours. 12 Minotaur Statues will come to life in the form of Minotaur Idols after you enter The False God's room during the Cults of Tibia Quest.
minotaur-idol.strat: Treat it as a strong melee creature and kill it fast before the other statues come to life.

minotaur-invader.name: Minotaur Invader
minotaur-invader.title: Minotaur Invader
minotaur-invader.loc: Second floor Glooth Underground Factory, east side during the Minotaurs raid.
minotaur-invader.beh: Fights in close combat similar to an Execowtioner.
minotaur-invader.notes: When the enemy wall has been breached, the Minotaur Invader's role begins. Many of these will spawn all over the east side of the Glooth Underground Factory, second floor, in many waves throughout the hour.
minotaur-invader.strat: Just kill them, they are similar to Execowtioners but weaker. Watch out for Glooth Powered Minotaurs, which cannot be killed unless you lure them to special Glooth Extractors, and for Minotaur Totems, which heal all creatures around it.

minotaur-mage.name: Minotaur Mage
minotaur-mage.title: Minotaur Mage
minotaur-mage.loc: Cyclopolis, Mintwallin, Maze of Lost Souls, Dark Pyramid, Folda (hidden cave), Kazordoon (The Horned Fox's hideout), the Plains of Havoc, Point of No Return south of Outlaw Camp, Elvenbane, the depths of Fibula Dungeon (level 50+), cave east from Dwarf Bridge, Foreigner Quarter, Rookgaard Minotaur Hell (not reachable).
minotaur-mage.desc: Minotaur Mages are the elite of the minotaurs' army. With their magic they support the other troops in a fight. They can create energy fields and shoot fireballs or magic missiles. As they are weak short-range fighters, guards will protect them while they operate from the second row.
minotaur-mage.notes: These creatures are usually found with Minotaur Guards because of their low defense. These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.

minotaur-occultist.name: Minotaur Occultist
minotaur-occultist.title: Minotaur Occultist
minotaur-occultist.notes: They are a weaker Minotaur Mage, but one of the tougher monsters in Dawnport.

minotaur-poacher.name: Minotaur Poacher
minotaur-poacher.title: Minotaur Poacher
minotaur-poacher.notes: They are a weaker Minotaur Archer. Unlike the Minotaur Archer however it does not keep a distance. It will shoot bolts but try to fight in close combat.

minotaur-totem.name: Minotaur Totem
minotaur-totem.title: Minotaur Totem
minotaur-totem.loc: Second floor Glooth Underground Factory, east side during a minotaurs raid.
minotaur-totem.beh: They do not move and stand still casting its mass healing spell constantly.
minotaur-totem.strat: They are weak to Death Damage and will die quickly if two or more players focus on it. Killing it solo is also possible as long as you can deal more damage than it heals. Kill them before the other creatures otherwise you won't be able to kill anything.

mirade.name: Mirade
mirade.title: Mirade (Creature)
mirade.notes: Appeared during Tibia's 15th and 20th Anniversary celebrations as well as on January 7 and 8, 2018 (unintended), in a raid at a random time once a day. The following message will appear: Then, 20 minutes later she will spawn:

mirror-image.name: Mirror Image
mirror-image.title: Mirror Image
mirror-image.desc: The mirror images are beyond any classification yet. They don't register to divination magic at all and defy any mundane attempts to examine them more closely. A calculated malice seems to guide them all and their evil intentions are too obvious to be dismissed as random actions. Their malleable forms are elusive and unstable, so guided by their inherent evil, they choose another form to confront their victims. Legends of Zarganash tell about a time when the mirror images walked the realm like gods and took the shape of whatever their intended victims most desired or feared most. At some point in the distant past, however, something happened. Be it a shift in the flows of power, the intervention of one of Zarganashs most powerful denizens or something else completely, no one can tell. Whatever the cause has been, the powers of the mirror images were greatly diminished. Still cruel and dangerous they were only a mere shadow of their glorious past and their shifting powers only included a far lesser array of horrible shapes. Some obscure texts seem to claim that the mirrored images can be summoned through blasphemous rituals, even into the mortal realm. Such rituals should be able…
mirror-image.beh: Attacks from distance ranged until it transforms into an apparition.
mirror-image.notes: The first time you deal damage to this creature it will transform into one of the five following apparitions: Druid's Apparition, Knight's Apparition, Paladin's Apparition, Sorcerer's Apparition or Monk's Apparition. It is most likely that it will transform into your vocation's apparition. Althought it is possible to deal damage to Mirror Images (i.e attacking exclusively with Familiars), it is likely to be impossible to kill one without forcing a transformation into a vocation apparition as they never go under 1 hit point.
mirror-image.strat: Knights can take advantage of them being ranged and use Chivalrous Challenge on them before they transform into an apparition. Furthermore, if there are too many creatures around, you can avoid hitting the Mirror Images so they stay ranged while attacking the blocker.

misguided-bully.name: Misguided Bully
misguided-bully.title: Misguided Bully
misguided-bully.loc: Misguided Camp accessible via Outlaw Camp's portal .
misguided-bully.desc: The Misguided are members of a cult, worshipping power above all. Bullies, thiefs and all sorts of cutthroats are attracted by it. The true motives of their leader are unknown but none of them is up to any good. Watch your back when dealing with these individuals, the truly deceived are not to be trifled with.

misguided-shadow.name: Misguided Shadow
misguided-shadow.title: Misguided Shadow
misguided-shadow.loc: The Humans Cult hideout under the Outlaw Camp.
misguided-shadow.beh: Fights in close combat until death.
misguided-shadow.notes: This demon possesses the Misguided Bullies and the Misguided Thieves.

misguided-thief.name: Misguided Thief
misguided-thief.title: Misguided Thief

ab.n: 4 sqm radius Mass Mana Drain around himself

misguided-thief.loc: Misguided Camp accessible via Outlaw Camp's portal .
misguided-thief.desc: The Misguided are members of a cult, worshipping power above all. Bullies, thiefs and all sorts of cutthroats are attracted by it. The true motives of their leader are unknown but none of them is up to any good. Watch your back when dealing with these individuals, the truly deceived are not to be trifled with.
misguided-thief.notes: Misguided Thieves wear the Store exclusive Ranger Outfits.

mitmah-scout.name: Mitmah Scout
mitmah-scout.title: Mitmah Scout
mitmah-scout.loc: Iksupan Last Stand, Iksupan Occupied Sanctuary, Iksupan Undercity, Iksupan Waterways
mitmah-scout.desc: With a long history of invading a colourful palette of the exotic civilisations in different dimensions, the Mitmah are intruders, marauders, thieves. They robbed whole continents of their cultures and legacy, stole treasure, art and even whole monuments and structures including their inhabitants all and sundry. Yet they see themselves as benefactors. Vanguards of art and culture, history and the legacy of all kinds of ancient beings. Creators of unforgettable experiences and builders of museums and exhibitions accross an interdimensional array of countless exotic realms. The scouts of the Mitmah are fast and versatile, yet protected by a solid coat of metal armour. As all Mitmah are not born warriors but rather cowardly manipulators, they hide in cases of metal and let their magic do the work for them. From the outside this doesn't take away from the fact, however, that they are absolutely not to be trifled with and still pose a formidable threat.

mitmah-seer.name: Mitmah Seer
mitmah-seer.title: Mitmah Seer
mitmah-seer.loc: Iksupan Last Stand, Iksupan Occupied Sanctuary, Iksupan Undercity, Iksupan Waterways
mitmah-seer.desc: With a long history of invading a colourful palette of the exotic civilisations in different dimensions, the Mitmah are intruders, marauders, thieves. They robbed whole continents of their cultures and legacy, stole treasure, art and even whole monuments and structures including their inhabitants all and sundry. Yet they see themselves as benefactors. Vanguards of art and culture, history and the legacy of all kinds of ancient beings. Creators of unforgettable experiences and builders of museums and exhibitions accross an interdimensional array of countless exotic realms. The Mitmah seer is a specifically vile specimen which utilises his magical abilities to a maximum while hiding inside a fortified metal case of unknown origin. Seemingly impenetrable they wield their arcane powers efficiently and with finesse.
mitmah-seer.notes: The attacks consist of roughly 50% Physical damage, 35% Death damage, and 15% Energy damage.

mitmah-vanguard.name: Mitmah Vanguard
mitmah-vanguard.title: Mitmah Vanguard
mitmah-vanguard.beh: The boss teleports and casts energy UE for up to 6k energy damage while the arena shields are up, it also casts a full-screen root, immobilizing all within the vicinity. Additionally it can break through magical defenses such as magic walls and wild growths.
mitmah-vanguard.notes: Defeating the boss for the first time will grant you the achievement Museum Goer, as well as the second addon for the Ancient Aucar Outfits.
mitmah-vanguard.strat: Keep at a distance - Energy UE when close

modified-gnarlhound.name: Modified Gnarlhound
modified-gnarlhound.title: Modified Gnarlhound
modified-gnarlhound.loc: South of Stonehome, deep under Telas's house, .
modified-gnarlhound.notes: It is possible to tame this creature by using a Golem Wrench on it. Because of their high resistances, they are useful for training Distance and Melee skills using weapons that deal elemental damage. Despite not being really immune to Physical Damage, their extremely high armor makes it hard to damage them using pure physical attacks. You need to complete the Shadows of Yalahar Quest to access them.

mole.name: Mole
mole.title: Mole
mole.notes: You can tame a Mole by using a Candle Stump on it.

monk.name: Monk
monk.title: Monk (Creature)
monk.loc: Edron Hero Cave, Triangle Tower near Thais, Maze of Lost Souls, Deeper Dark Cathedral, Isle of the Kings, Trade Quarter.
monk.desc: In ancient times, long before Edron has been re-discovered, some Monks, followers of the evil god Zathroth, founded a monastery in the dungeons deep below the surface. They are not well disposed towards the explorers that are now coming there, and will attack every intruder fiercely. They are skilled fist fighters and can heal themselves.
monk.beh: Monks chase the enemy until death.
monk.notes: Mystical creatures, they heal themselves about every 10 seconds, which makes them great as summons. They move items in their way. Commonly used for training of knights and paladins. This is one of two monsters that can be summoned but not convinced (if you exclude summonable poisonous creatures and the Juvenile Cyclops). The other one is the Gozzler. They can also be summoned by the Man in the Cave.
monk.strat: Something important while killing Monks is the time. You have to attack as fast as possible or they will heal themselves and you will need to use more Arrows/Runes or in the case of Knights you will receive more damage and maybe use more healing potions or spells. Quite high defense, so low skilled knights with one-handed weapons should stay away from these, as they will heal faster than you will damage them. If necessary to kill, consider using runes.

monk-of-the-order.name: Monk of the Order
monk-of-the-order.title: Monk of the Order
monk-of-the-order.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement.
monk-of-the-order.desc: The monks of the Order of the Lion are dedicated to their cause. Their main focus being helping and supporting the good citizens of Bounac, their life is comprised of hard labour and deprivations. But also the joy and laughter of the people.

monks-apparition.name: Monk's Apparition
monks-apparition.title: Monk's Apparition
monks-apparition.loc: The Mirrored Nightmare, after Mirror Images are attacked.
monks-apparition.desc: These monks belong to a group of (five) apparitions, which Mirror Images can turn into.
monks-apparition.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.

monstor.name: Monstor
monstor.title: Monstor
monstor.notes: It's the fifth floor boss. Use his body to get a random reward before you use the body of Evil Mastermind, otherwise you may not get any item. Probably an allusion to The Incredible Hulk.
monstor.strat: The stairs that goes up can be used so you get hit only by 2 monsters, try to trap yourself there with 2 gargoyles and shoot monstor with distance attacks.

moohtah-warrior.name: Mooh'Tah Warrior
moohtah-warrior.title: Mooh'Tah Warrior
moohtah-warrior.loc: Oramond/Southern Plains, Minotaur Hills, Oramond Dungeon (depending on Magistrate votes), Underground Glooth Factory
moohtah-warrior.desc: The mooh'tah warriors are elite soldiers that dedicated their life to the philosophical teachings of this ancient minotaur philosophy. While each minotaurs is taught the basic principles of the mooh'tah only a few chosen are able to follow its teachings truly. They basic principles are meant to help the minotaurs to ease their inner rage, which is considered as unclean and offensive. The ultimate goal is to not only master the inner anger but dissolve it into spiritual energy. The ultimate idea is instead of dedicating energy to fight the anger, in the end the anger becomes additional energy and therefore supply of enormous power. Since the true path of mooh'tah requires not only dedication but also time and resources, it's usually the nobility that can afford to indulge the studies. While the first lessons are basic and primary consists of philosophic teachings, soon also the body is honed. Beginning with breathing techniques and continuing with the correct way to move, the training becomes over the years more and more martial. As the first lessons teach the spirit and the body to become one, the higher teachings concern the flow of magic and making a weapon a part of their body.…
moohtah-warrior.notes: These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.
moohtah-warrior.strat: Fairly slow creatures. However, they should not be underestimated in close combat. Stay diagonal to avoid their beams.

moohtant.name: Moohtant
moohtant.title: Moohtant
moohtant.loc: Oramond Mountain Hideout, Oramond Minotaur Camp (northern camp), Underground Glooth Factory, Oramond Dungeon
moohtant.desc: Minotaurs are born with a great inner rage that constantly threatens to drive them over the edge and turn them into berserkers that know no friend or foe, all the less concern for their own health or even some form of strategy. This state of mind is considered unclean by the minotaurs and their society had come up with several ways to cope with this problem. Yet no minotaur would foolishly deny that this inner rage is a constant companion in a minotaurs life. Sometimes this rage manifests in especially cruel ways. Some tragic minotaurs are born 'into the rage' as the minotaurs say. They never have a chance to battle their inner rage but are born into the world with fierce anger and bloodlust. Those young calves are taken into custody by special trainers, most of the high ranking mooh'tah masters. They train the youngsters to at least control somewhat of their rage and funnel it into certain tiresome and draining tasks. This upbringing with mining, hauling and woodcutting from the earliest age combined with the constant burning energy in them, lets them grow out of the proportions of normal minotaurs. Often easily twice as high as a minotaur this veritable giants are more beast…
moohtant.notes: These creatures can be skinned with an Obsidian Knife. See also: Minotaur Leather/Skinning.
moohtant.strat: This creature's strength can be compared with a Behemoth or a Destroyer. A Garlic Necklace is affordable and will greatly reduce the power of their Life Drain Bomb. Paladins: Throw fire walls on the ground and run around them while healing constantly, for their distance attacks are strong. Don't let them touch you, and if that happens, be ready to cast salvation, because their melee attacks may hit a lot. Usually they are no problem for a paladin level 120+, due to their slow speed, altough they can be killed by lower levels if there's no more creatures onscreen. Knights: Not a very recommendable creature for Knights, as they do quite heavy damage and take some time to kill, risking being swarmed by other Minotaurs. If you still wish to do so, try to lure them away so you don't get surrounded by Mooh'Tah Warriors, Execowtioners or distance fighters, specially Worm Priestesses, which can deal a lot of damage while you try to kill the Moohtant.

moohtant-wallbreaker.name: Moohtant Wallbreaker
moohtant-wallbreaker.title: Moohtant Wallbreaker
moohtant-wallbreaker.loc: Oramond Underground Glooth Factory, second floor, east side during a raid.
moohtant-wallbreaker.notes: Moohtant Wallbreakers are bred to become living siege weapons. They are an unstoppable force and will destroy anything in their paths. They are sent to breach the Underground Glooth Factory Plant, and will do so unchallenged. The Moohtant Wallbreaker will walk directly west until he reaches the plant. He will push all players in his way backward, walk over all fields, magic walls and wild growth trees. He will stand on his allies if he must, although they surprisingly get out unharmed.
moohtant-wallbreaker.strat: The Moohtant Wallbreaker is the boss of the minotaur raids. The objective of the raid is to kill it before it reaches the Plant wall. If it does, it will explode and the wall will be destroyed, damaging players standing near it for 1000 hitpoints. It moves at a rate of about 1 tile per 10 seconds, which gives about 50 minutes(?) to kill the Wallbreaker. Focus all of your firepower on it before it's too late!

moonsilver-custodian.name: Moonsilver Custodian
moonsilver-custodian.title: Moonsilver Custodian
moonsilver-custodian.notes: Part of the Make Believe Quest.

moonsilver-guardian.name: Moonsilver Guardian
moonsilver-guardian.title: Moonsilver Guardian
moonsilver-guardian.notes: Part of the Make Believe Quest.

moonspawn-blightspitter.name: Moonspawn Blightspitter
moonspawn-blightspitter.title: Moonspawn Blightspitter
moonspawn-blightspitter.desc: The blightspitter appears to be a specialized variant of the moonspawn, adapted to spread its influence across a wider area. It expels viscous matter that clings to surfaces and continues to corrupt them over time. The terrain around such creatures often shows signs of prolonged exposure, marked by decay and instability. Unlike other variants, it does not rely solely on proximity to pose a threat. Its presence alone can alter the conditions of a battlefield in subtle but persistent ways.

moonspawn-juggernaut.name: Moonspawn Juggernaut
moonspawn-juggernaut.title: Moonspawn Juggernaut
moonspawn-juggernaut.notes: It spawns as part of a raid that occurs every 30 minutes.

moonspawn-oozecrown.name: Moonspawn Oozecrown
moonspawn-oozecrown.title: Moonspawn Oozecrown
moonspawn-oozecrown.desc: The oozecrown manifests as a swollen accumulation of growth, layered with shifting and unstable matter. It seems less concerned with movement and more with expansion, slowly reshaping its surroundings. Its surface pulses irregularly, suggesting ongoing internal processes that are not fully understood. Areas under its influence tend to become difficult to traverse, as if the environment itself resists intrusion. Those who approach too closely may find themselves overwhelmed by its unpredictable nature.

moonstone-excavator.name: Moonstone Excavator
moonstone-excavator.title: Moonstone Excavator
moonstone-excavator.desc: Moonstone Excavators are tasked with the physical labor required to extract fragments of the fallen stone. They work with steady persistence, often ignoring exhaustion or discomfort. Their focus seems fixed on the task at hand, as if repetition alone holds meaning. Though not trained fighters, they will defend their work when disturbed. It is unclear how much of their behavior is discipline, and how much is influence.

moonstone-miner.name: Moonstone Miner
moonstone-miner.title: Moonstone Miner
moonstone-miner.notes: Part of the Make Believe Quest.

moonstone-overseer.name: Moonstone Overseer
moonstone-overseer.title: Moonstone Overseer
moonstone-overseer.desc: Overseers coordinate the excavation efforts, ensuring that progress continues without interruption. They observe both workers and surroundings with careful attention, intervening when necessary. Their authority is rarely challenged, suggesting a strict hierarchy within the operation. Unlike the laborers, they show a clearer awareness of their role and its importance. Their presence often keeps the otherwise chaotic activity under control.

morgaroth.name: Morgaroth
morgaroth.title: Morgaroth
morgaroth.notes: Morgaroth, the schemer, is an Archdemon and also a member of the Triangle of Terror. Morgaroth was first sighted on Arcania on August 07, 2006. It was first killed on Aldora and Titania on September 6, 2006. When it appears, all players on the world receive 3 messages that are broadcasted exactly 6 minutes apart. Morgaroth spawns when the last message appears, exactly 12 minutes after the first message.

morguthis.name: Morguthis
morguthis.title: Morguthis
morguthis.beh: Malicious; will make all efforts to destroy intruders.
morguthis.notes: Morguthis, Arkhotep's general, was sentenced to be locked away after his part in the conspiracies against the pharaoh. He is guarded by 8 Shredderthrowers. One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.
morguthis.strat: He will melee with anyone in close proximity, this allows distance attackers better chances to defeat him quickly.

morik-the-gladiator.name: Morik the Gladiator
morik-the-gladiator.title: Morik the Gladiator
morik-the-gladiator.loc: The Arena Quarter. Arena second floor east area, .
morik-the-gladiator.beh: Same as a Gladiator. Runs at very Low Health.
morik-the-gladiator.notes: Spawns when using the armor decoration in Morik's room. Part of the In Service of Yalahar Quest.
morik-the-gladiator.strat: Shoot from the door so you can only get hit by 2 monsters. Recommended to wear a Protection Amulet to lower the physical damage he inflicts. Knight: Can easily kill him with lvl 40 and skills 65/65. Bring your best weapon and shield, as Morik hits quite hard, it's best to fight him in balance as he tends to hit for quite some damage, exori whenever he summons a gladiator to hit both at the same time, DO NOT LET HIM HAVE 2 SUMMONS!!! 2 summons will break your shielding quite easily and Morik will hit you for major damage, make sure to bring him down fast or you will waste many potions.

mornenion.name: Mornenion
mornenion.title: Mornenion

ab.n: Distance Arrows (similar to an Elf Scout)

mornenion.notes: Part of the Bank Robbery Mini World Change. Mornenion is the thief that robs the Venore bank.
mornenion.strat: Same as with an Elf Scout.

morshabaal.name: Morshabaal
morshabaal.title: Morshabaal
morshabaal.loc: Morshabaal appears inside a teleporter that spawns at the stone circle in the northwest of Edron, . Only characters of level 150 or higher can enter.
morshabaal.strat: Morshabaal has 3 stages with increasing strength: * Morshabaal * Enraged Morshabaal * Furious Morshabaal It will always have a counter next to its name: * This counter starts at 25 with a green icon and decreases 1 per second * When it reaches 0, a new counter starts, with a red symbol, from 5 to 0 * If Morshabaal is attacked during the red counter phase, it will change to the next stronger form The stronger forms of Morshabaal take less damage and do more Damage Reflection, so the team must always focus on keeping it in the regular Morshabaal stage. Even though it is still possible to deal damage to it in the enraged form, it will not be very efficient. When it is in Furious stage, it will take very little damage and reflect a lot more of it, so teams should avoid reaching this stage as it is both dangerous and expensive to fight it. While being targeted, the blockers will slowly build up a counter next to their name as well. When this counter reaches 20, the character will take more damage and Morshabaal will heal more through Lifesteal. The counter can be decreased by letting another blocker be the target. The common strategy for killing Morshabaal is the following: The…

mould-phantom.name: Mould Phantom
mould-phantom.title: Mould Phantom
mould-phantom.desc: Zarganash's hostile environment gave birth to an own breed of phantoms that differ by the hazards that help to form them from the tormented souls they once were. Spirits, soaked with decay and putrefaction, the mould phantoms are the heralds of rot. Wither is what they breathe, decay what accompanies them. They lack any true sentience, though their processing of captured souls through a disgusting version of composting, they sometimes appear to interact with their environment on purpose. This is yet only a random illusion though. The true self of the mould phantom is of a wandering zone of decay. More a natural disaster than an entity. There is some interaction between mould phantoms but this seems to follow more natural laws, shared amongst their kind and not by sentient decisions. Other such interactions are their attraction to living things. Their nature draws them to the living to spread their decay to them and share their rot. Even here they don't hurt the living on some kind of purpose but by inherent attributes of their rotten existence. They are drawn to certain places in Zarganash and though the unschooled eye see little difference in this places to other, they can be…
mould-phantom.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.
mould-phantom.strat: The safest strategy to hunt them is to turn them into melee creatures using Chivalrous Challenge or Divine Dazzle and have them be blocked by the Knight with the other creatures.

mountain-troll.name: Mountain Troll
mountain-troll.title: Mountain Troll
mountain-troll.strat: Kill it as you would kill anything else. Possibly the weakest attacking monster on Dawnport.

mozradek.name: Mozradek
mozradek.title: Mozradek
mozradek.loc: In a small cave north of Issavi
mozradek.notes: It's one of the bosses of Kilmaresh Quest.
mozradek.strat: Use Ice Damage and avoid its waves.

mr-punish.name: Mr. Punish
mr-punish.title: Mr. Punish
mr-punish.loc: Pits of Inferno in Tafariel's Throne room.
mr-punish.notes: Mr. Punish has first been sighted and killed on Solera, Dec 26th 2006. He is the boss of the Dark Torturers. 's on Pandoria.]]
mr-punish.strat: Block him with Magic Wall or Wild Growth Runes to trap it because he is very fast. You need one good blocker only. The shooters must shoot Sudden Death Runes or Death Strike.

muddy-earth-elemental.name: Muddy Earth Elemental
muddy-earth-elemental.title: Muddy Earth Elemental
muddy-earth-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Druid's part - Earth Sphere.
muddy-earth-elemental.strat: Run around and use Flame Strike. It's good to use Great Fireball if there are more than two. If you feel like bringing a rod, take a hailstorm rod because they are least resistant to ice.

muglex-clan-assassin.name: Muglex Clan Assassin
muglex-clan-assassin.title: Muglex Clan Assassin
muglex-clan-assassin.loc: Edron Goblin Den, Edron Surroundings, Muglex Clan Camp
muglex-clan-assassin.notes: * Was added to the Bestiary and to new hunting places with the advent of Newhaven. Drops different loot depending on the Vocation of the player who dealt the most damage.

muglex-clan-chief.name: Muglex Clan Chief
muglex-clan-chief.title: Muglex Clan Chief
muglex-clan-chief.notes: Final boss of the main starting quest in Newhaven. Drops different loot depending on the Vocation of the player who dealt the most damage.

muglex-clan-footman.name: Muglex Clan Footman
muglex-clan-footman.title: Muglex Clan Footman
muglex-clan-footman.loc: Edron Goblin Den, Edron Surroundings, Muglex Clan Camp
muglex-clan-footman.notes: Was added to the Bestiary and to new hunting places with the advent of Newhaven. Drops different loot depending on the Vocation of the player who dealt the most damage.

muglex-clan-scavenger.name: Muglex Clan Scavenger
muglex-clan-scavenger.title: Muglex Clan Scavenger
muglex-clan-scavenger.notes: Spawns with other Muglex Clan goblins (Footmen, Assassins) and, on the deeper floors of their cave, Lesser Fire Devils, Crazed Dwarves and Dwarf Miners. They aren't particularly strong but they do come in groups.
muglex-clan-scavenger.strat: Focus on the assassins first because they are more threatening. Otherwise, just kill them using your standard technique.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.title: Mummy
mummy.loc: Drefia, Darama's Dark Pyramid, Draconia, Mount Sternum Undead Cave, Green Claw Swamp, Venore Amazon Camp underground, Helheim, Upper Spike, all Tombs, Mother of Scarabs Lair, Dark Cathedral, Lion's Rock.
mummy.desc: Mummies are undead monsters that can be found in the ancient pyramids and ruins in the north of Tibia. No one knows where they come from, but they guard the burial chambers and attack every adventurer trying to get the legendary treasures. Their scaring sight can paralyze the bravest fighters, and they try to drain life energy off their shocked victims. Be aware of their poisonous daggers!
mummy.notes: Be careful as a low level because they can use quite heavy paralyze sometimes. Mummies are worth the trouble though because of their relatively good loot.
mummy.strat: A good strategy for distance fighters hunting this monster (druids, sorcerers, or paladins) is this: If you are paralyzed, and can still move about as fast as the mummy, continue running it until either the paralyze wears off or it paralyzes you again. One exura will cancel out all paralysis. However, obstructions or lag can result in the mummy catching up and attacking the player. GFBs and explosions are useful in case of a tight situation.

munster.name: Munster
munster.title: Munster
munster.loc: Rookgaard, Free Account Main Rat Caves, on the second floor.
munster.beh: Munster runs when seriously injured also moves object that are in his way. If a weak creature is blocking its path, Munster will kill it in order to reach target.
munster.notes: It is a Rat Boss that is generally made for lower levels to kill. Looks like a regular Cave Rat. Spawns with 2 Rats and 3 Cave Rats.
munster.strat: Kill the summoned Rats, then proceed to kill Munster.

murcion.name: Murcion
murcion.title: Murcion
murcion.notes: One of the bosses in the Rotten Blood Quest.

murderous-ghost.name: Murderous Ghost
murderous-ghost.title: Murderous Ghost
murderous-ghost.notes: Murderous ghosts are faced during Dark Trails Quest.
murderous-ghost.strat: Ignore them. If they trap you, just push them away or become invisible.

murmillion.name: Murmillion
murmillion.title: Murmillion
murmillion.notes: Murmillions are tanky melee creatures. They attack with physical damage and cast paralyze.

muse-of-penciljack.name: Muse of Penciljack
muse-of-penciljack.title: Muse of Penciljack
muse-of-penciljack.beh: Likely the same as a Vampire Bride

museum-stone-rhino.name: Museum Stone Rhino
museum-stone-rhino.title: Museum Stone Rhino
museum-stone-rhino.loc: Museum of Tibian Arts (only at Night)

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.title: Mushroom
mushroom.loc: Summoned by and within the boss rooms of Ichgahal and Murcion.
mushroom.notes: Explodes after a few seconds, or shortly after a player passing at its side.

mushroom-sniffer.name: Mushroom Sniffer
mushroom-sniffer.title: Mushroom Sniffer
mushroom-sniffer.beh: Mushroom sniffers follow players very slowly but are never hostile.
mushroom-sniffer.notes: This creature looks the same as a Pig and is needed to sniff out Truffles in the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.
mushroom-sniffer.strat: Just ignore them unless you are doing the task they're involved in. Be wary, as 2 or more of these can easily trap you against other threats.

mutated-bat.name: Mutated Bat
mutated-bat.title: Mutated Bat
mutated-bat.loc: Cemetery Quarter (around 10 underground on the west side along with banshees, and 4 bats on the church roof), Alchemist Quarter (4 found on top of roofs), Arena and Zoo Quarter (2 under the arena with other mutated creatures), Razachai, Northern Zao Plantations, Souleater Mountains, Middle Spike, Vengoth and Vengoth Castle, entrance of the Temple Complex.
mutated-bat.desc: Modern scientists found out that the common bat has the inherent power of transformation. For this reason, bat blood is high-priced among alchemists and probably also explains the bats connection to vampires in some way. Due to certain influences by contaminated food or magical radiation, some bats transformed into horrible beasts. These beasts are well-known as Mutated Bats. Unlike intended mutations that origin from experiments, the mutation of bats seem to happen rather spontaneous. Mutated Bats seem to lack the fertility of other mutated species as it is was never heard that they brought up offspring. The transformation into a giant-sized mutated bat seems to put some strain on the bats, turning them incredibly aggressive. Only the company of other Mutated Bats seems to calm them a little. Lonely Mutated Bats can become so aggressive that they attack their own shadow until they die of exhaustion. In certain areas with a high magical contamination, the Mutated Bat has become a dangerous plague. Swarms of those bats have killed whole small villages in a single night. Moving only in the darkness, they devastate the land like a swarm of locusts until they are stopped by military…
mutated-bat.beh: Runs away in deep yellow health.
mutated-bat.notes: A stronger mutated form of a bat. They have powerful attacks so low level players are advised to avoid them. After Summer Update 2009 they have slightly weaker poison shot, poison at melee and can no longer make you drunk. You may hunt 400 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Bruise Payne.
mutated-bat.strat: Knights: try to stay diagonal to avoid poison wave, better hit them in full attack since most damage you'll take will come from poison. Make sure to trigger chase enemy as soon as it starts running away, so you kill them faster. Also have exana pox ready to cast as soon as you kill to avoid heavy damage from poison.

mutated-human.name: Mutated Human
mutated-human.title: Mutated Human
mutated-human.loc: Alchemist Quarter and Factory Quarter (Yalahar), Robson's Isle, Tiquanda Laboratory.
mutated-human.desc: Mind and body of these poor creatures have been twisted in an agonising and horrible way. Once humans, there is nothing left than pain and hatred. Their blurred minds rarely allow them planned actions. Their mutations were caused by contaminated material or magical radiation. In most cases, this has led to more or less slow and painful deaths, but in some cases the subjects managed to survive. If they retained some degree of sentience, they would rather wish to be dead, though. Due to the mutation, hardly anything of the original physiology is still intact, and sometime during the mutation process, the mind collapses in an act of self-defence. Having endured unimaginable conditions, the mutated bodies are highly resilient and extremely strong. Packs of Mutated Humans can easily dismantle whole neighbourhoods within a single night. Driven by animal-like instincts, the mutants often form packs in which the alpha mutant leads his brethren on hunts and raids. Mutated Humans usually hunt for food rather than for plunder. Still, driven by old instincts, they tend to carry away everything they come across, only to drop it again a few minutes later, not even remembering what they had…
mutated-human.beh: Mutated Humans fight until death and can not be pushed.
mutated-human.strat: Standing diagonal won't help you avoid their wave because it's very wide (counting from the caster it's 3, 5 and 7 sqm). However diagonal position is useful to not get hit by their Earth Strike which poisons you heavily. You can only get hit by it if you stand directly in front of the creature, they will not target you with it like sorcerers and druids can with their strike spells. Paladins: Run and shoot, they do not have very high defense and can be killed quickly by any paladin with distance fighting of 65+. They are similar to Cyclops with the addition of poison damage and death wave attacks. Divine Caldera is useful when facing a large pack of them. Knights: Just close in on them and attack with melee. If you are hunting them, expect getting poisoned many times, therefore using exana pox is a waste of mana. Avoid packs of 5 or more. They can bring your hitpoints down quickly. Mages: Sorcerers can use a fire or energy wand and Flame/Energy Strike. Druids can use the same spells, but their ice rods will deal slightly less damage than a sorcerer's wands. GFB and Thunderstorms are helpful when facing several Mutated Humans at once. They drop a lot of gold, so it is unlikely that…

mutated-rat.name: Mutated Rat
mutated-rat.title: Mutated Rat
mutated-rat.loc: Alchemist Quarter, Arena and Zoo Quarter (Inside the arena with other mutated creatures), Razachai, Vampire Castle on Vengoth, Robson's Isle, Mushroom Gardens, Souleater Mountains, Northern Zao Plantations, Middle Spike.
mutated-rat.desc: Mutated Rats usually grow out of rats eating contaminated remains of experiments. Given the rats' ferocious appetite and the thoughtless disposal of residues by alchemists, Mutated Rats are not as uncommon as one might like. They are subject of many rumours and legends as they are hardly met during daytime. This makes it somewhat hard to give an adequate description of their attitudes and abilities.
