It is certain that their behaviour usually does not change much due to the mutation other than becoming more daring. Rumour has it that depending on their sources of food - the disgusting details will be left out here - they might get frightening intelligent and live much longer than usual rats. Mutated Rats always take the leadership over the common rats in their area. Being the leader, the Mutated Rats rarely leave the deepest lairs but are served and fed by their smaller brethren. In combat they are rarely seen without the company of ordinary rats that seem to serve as their soldiers. They are definitely more powerful and even vital than their smaller kin but they are still not much of a threat for an experienced fighter. It is also said that some of them actually become immortal…
mutated-rat.beh: Fights to death, paralyzing more often if you keep distance. Moves and kills weaker monsters.
mutated-rat.notes: They are similar to Bonebeasts, but a bit weaker. Added in the Christmas Update 2008. You may hunt 400 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Esmeralda.
mutated-rat.strat: Paladins: These can be soloed easily at level 50+ with 75+ distance. Try to run around to avoid their melee, as they can hit pretty hard. Knights: Try to face only one at a time by "dancing" around, using obstacles and other monsters to your advantage. Easy monster at level 65, but in order to do the Mutated Rat task and don't waste, it is recommended at least level 75 with 80/80 skills and good equipment. Mages: At level 50 you can just use Flame Strike and occassionally Exura if you are paralyzed. You can also try at level 40 or even less, but heal as soon as your HP gets below 300, it can be pretty risky. Druid should use Northwind Rod or Hailstorm Rod and Flame Strike to get them down fast.

mutated-tiger.name: Mutated Tiger
mutated-tiger.title: Mutated Tiger
mutated-tiger.loc: Alchemist Quarter, Arena and Zoo Quarter (Inside with other mutated creatures), Muggy Plains, Souleater Mountains, Northern Zao Plantations and entrance of the Temple Complex.
mutated-tiger.desc: A Mutated Tiger is the result of outrageous experiments. In most cases, the mutation is rather a by-product of another process that aims at stealing the cat's vitality and agility to produce a youth potion that is of great demand among the wealthy and powerful all over the world. Although some of the most resilient tigers survive this horrible draining-process, they turn incurably mad and wild. In addition, these rare individuals become much more vital and stronger than they have ever been in their former lives. To the dismay of some excited alchemists, who had tried to drain those beasts to gain even more powerful potions, the vital force of Mutated Tigers is toxic. This, however, did not stop the alchemists to undertake further gruesome experiments. After surviving these cruel experiments, the beasts reached a point beyond madness and rage. They are the incarnation of pain and agony, and seem to want to spread them both as much as possible. With their increased power, it becomes more and more difficult to have them in their laboratories. Sometimes, thoughtless alchemists release the beasts into the wild, when it becomes too dangerous to keep them. Others are sold to arenas, zoos…
mutated-tiger.notes: Be weary that these creatures use invisible frequently, so you may run into more than you think when approaching them. Despite staying invisible for a short amount of time, if grouped, their combos can bring down even decent skilled players. You may hunt 250 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
mutated-tiger.strat: Treat them like a dragon and watch out for the waves. They are pretty easy. Knights: Should move in fast before their waves can do damage to you, and make sure you retarget it once it has become visible. Try to avoid two or more as their waves become harder to evade due to creature placement.

mutated-zalamon.name: Mutated Zalamon
mutated-zalamon.title: Mutated Zalamon
mutated-zalamon.loc: East of Zao and south of Dragonblaze Peaks, two floors below Zalamon.
mutated-zalamon.notes: Introduced in Summer Update 2010. Part of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.
mutated-zalamon.strat: Trap him as fast as you can, knights will have to use challenge a lot since he tends to switch very often. Fire and Energy Bombs will be helpful here.

mycobiontic-beetle.name: Mycobiontic Beetle
mycobiontic-beetle.title: Mycobiontic Beetle
mycobiontic-beetle.desc: The Mycobiontic Beetles are creatures that have not only adapted but thrived in the decaying aura of the putrid realm over countless generations. These beetles possess an otherworldly resilience and ferocity, making them a formidable force in the fallen realm. Their exoskeletons shimmer with an eerie iridescence, hinting at the corruption that permeates their bodies. Through their prolonged exposure to the decaying essence of the realm, these beetles have absorbed its malevolent energy, making them next to natural monsters in their power and tenacity. They scuttle through the desolate landscapes, their chitinous shells resonating with the ominous whispers of the decaying realm, as they hunt and seek to further their dominance in this nightmarish realm.

naga-archer.name: Naga Archer
naga-archer.title: Naga Archer
naga-archer.desc: Nagas have the lower bodies of enormous snakes with a humanoid torso and head. They possess four arms and are able to use all of them simultaneously - be it to fish, weave, wield weapons or perform special gestures called yukti to cast spells. They typically hold their heads and torsos off the ground while moving, but they can increase their speed by lowering their bodies. On their torsos they like to wear beautiful silken clothes or ornate armour as well jewelry like rings, bracelets and bangles on their arms. The lower snake body is usually free of clothing, but will be protected with armour if necessary. Nagas are resistant to poison and have a natural affinity for spellcasting, being born with an inherent understanding of the art of magic. Much like most snake and reptile species, they dislike cold climates.Nagas are an old, powerful and proud race who live on the jungle island Marapur since several millennia and built up a remarkable culture there. Their cities are said to be filled with gems, gold and other earthly treasures. Their power makes them potentially dangerous to humans. However, many of them act rather benevolent towards the two-legs, as they call the humanoid…

naga-warrior.name: Naga Warrior
naga-warrior.title: Naga Warrior
naga-warrior.desc: Nagas have the lower bodies of enormous snakes with a humanoid torso and head. They possess four arms and are able to use all of them simultaneously - be it to fish, weave, wield weapons or perform special gestures called yukti to cast spells. They typically hold their heads and torsos off the ground while moving, but they can increase their speed by lowering their bodies. On their torsos they like to wear beautiful silken clothes or ornate armour as well jewelry like rings, bracelets and bangles on their arms. The lower snake body is usually free of clothing, but will be protected with armour if necessary. Nagas are resistant to poison and have a natural affinity for spellcasting, being born with an inherent understanding of the art of magic. Much like most snake and reptile species, they dislike cold climates.Nagas are an old, powerful and proud race who live on the jungle island Marapur since several millennia and built up a remarkable culture there. Their cities are said to be filled with gems, gold and other earthly treasures. Their power makes them potentially dangerous to humans. However, many of them act rather benevolent towards the two-legs, as they call the humanoid…

nargol-the-impaler.name: Nargol the Impaler
nargol-the-impaler.title: Nargol the Impaler
nargol-the-impaler.notes: It's part of the final battle of the Grave Danger Quest.
nargol-the-impaler.strat: Trap it at the center of the room and attack it. When it dies, use as much firepower as possible to quickly kill its Regenerating Mass before Nargol recovers himself.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.title: Necromancer
necromancer.loc: All the Tombs, Lich Hell, Drefia, Medusa Shield Quest room, Old Fortress, Old Masonry, beneath Fenrock, Cemetery Quarter, Magician Quarter, Mother of Scarabs Lair.
necromancer.desc: Necromancers are powerful magicians who pursue studies on undead creatures in the haunted ruins of Drefia on Darama.Nobody knows what they intend to use their perilous knowledge for and which dreadful secrets they already have discovered, but adventurers, who have managed to escape from their realm, report that they are able to summon several kinds of undead creatures like skeletons, ghouls, and mummies. They can heal themselves and they know how to drain life energy off their opponents. Although they are quite strong fighters, they prefer distance fighting, namely shooting magic missiles and letting their summoned servants fight for them.
necromancer.notes: You may hunt 4000 of these along with Priestesses, Blood Hands, Blood Priests and Shadow Pupils as a task for Lugri. Upon completion of the task you will face Necropharus. The task can be repeated several times but only grants you 40,000 experience points from the second time and onwards.

necromancer-servant.name: Necromancer Servant
necromancer-servant.title: Necromancer Servant
necromancer-servant.beh: Stays away from you and runs at low health.
necromancer-servant.notes: Part of the Gravedigger of Drefia quest. Acts very similar to a regular Necromancer, with which they share their appearance.
necromancer-servant.strat: Just treat it like a regular Necromancer.

necropharus.name: Necropharus
necropharus.title: Necropharus
necropharus.loc: Halls of Sacrifice (task boss, teleporter located ), Lich Hell (room with Vampires), Medusa Shield Quest room, Hero Cave Grim Reapers, Oasis Tomb ( ).
necropharus.notes: Is the Necromancer's boss, and looks the same as a Necromancer.

neferi-the-spy.name: Neferi the Spy
neferi-the-spy.title: Neferi the Spy
neferi-the-spy.loc: Through a teleport located near Issavi's boat, .
neferi-the-spy.notes: It's one of the minibosses of Kilmaresh Quest, Wanted mission.

neutral-deepling-warrior.name: Neutral Deepling Warrior
neutral-deepling-warrior.title: Neutral Deepling Warrior
neutral-deepling-warrior.beh: It will also attack Brokul, so use that in your favor.
neutral-deepling-warrior.notes: They are part of The Secret Library Quest.
neutral-deepling-warrior.strat: Try to get it to target Brokul instead of you.

nibblemaw.name: Nibblemaw
nibblemaw.title: Nibblemaw
nibblemaw.desc: Just like Feyrist, Candia is not completely immune to the invasion of nightmare monsters from neighboring Roshamuul. However, unlike in Feyrist, the nightmares do not arrive in Candia unchanged: they have transformed and are now made entirely of sweets. When guzzlemaws or frazzlemaws arrive in Candia, they are transformed into giant balls of peppermint with teeth made of the hardest chocolate imaginable. Their thick sugar coating makes them highly resistant to weapon attacks. This sweet transformation may make them look rather cute, but don't be fooled: They are still dangerous predators who prey on the more peaceful inhabitants of Candia. They seem to particularly like the industrious little workers in the chocolate mines, so they pose a serious threat to Candia's chocolate supply and are always a thorn in the side of the Sugar Plum Fairy.

nigel-neverguess.name: Nigel Neverguess
nigel-neverguess.title: Nigel Neverguess
nigel-neverguess.loc: Boss room of the Adventurer Group.
nigel-neverguess.notes: Part of The Roost of the Graveborn Quest. Member of the Adventurer Group, representing a Monk.

night-harpy.name: Night Harpy
night-harpy.title: Night Harpy
night-harpy.desc: Compared to their congeneric sisters, these nocturnal creatures only ever hunt at night. Their feathers blend with the inky black of the night and wrap them into a cloak of darkness whilst stalking their unsuspecting prey. They attack in flocks and with swift precision before disappearing into the dark as quickly as they came. There numbers have grown lately and they have started to nest ever closer to and even larger settlements. Their roost often conceals a collection of valuable objects, shiny stones and other treasure. This stash is well-hidden, however, and the only time they leave it unguarded is in the dead of night.

nightfiend.name: Nightfiend
nightfiend.title: Nightfiend
nightfiend.desc: Nobody yet knows whence the nightfiends came from, but it may be the depths of the earth, or even your most feared nightmare. They arrived in Drefia in the wake of the vampire nobles, and they seem to be the fiercer cousins of the manbats, but darker, stronger and even more vicious. Some surmise that the nightfiend might be the result of strange experiments with vicious manbats in Drefia, where both species have first been sighted. Some speculate that they are a sort of bodyguard or pet for the vampire nobles that reside there, but considering the nightfiends' strength, the latter seems unlikely. In any case, nightfiends are fierce fighters that will be aided by manbats if attacked. The first man to see a nightfiend was the only survivor of a large exploration party searching for a lost artefact, and barely made it out in one piece.
nightfiend.notes: This creature can only be found when The Pale Count raid occurs in Drefia and his lair becomes accessible.

nighthunter.name: Nighthunter
nighthunter.title: Nighthunter
nighthunter.desc: The mist covered air over Gnomprona hosts only little diversity in wildlife. The most common occurrence is the common bat, though they tend to stay in the upper layers of the mist for some reason. There they feast on the many flying insects that inhabit the mist but in turn become the major prey to the nighthunters. The name nighthunter seems inappropriate in an area that is shrouded in a constant gloom by blowing mists and clouds. Yet for some odd reason the nighthunters prefer to strike when the local mists occasionally darken, even if only slightly. Then their level of activity rises dramatically. This might hint at a day and night cycle that might have existed in Gnomprona in a distant past, yet that leaves to wonder how and why such a thing should have existed. Another theory suggests, that a lack of light mitigated some of the irritation powers of the mercurial menaces, the nighthunters prime competitors in the skies. Some Gnomish sages theorise that in the distant past a now extinct progenitor race, related to the Naga, at one point fled from the ground, where it was accustomed to day and night cycles, into the bowels of earth where they used their magic to recreate some…
nighthunter.beh: It retargets to character with the lowest maximum health in its view. In most cases, that would be a Sorcerer or a Druid.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.title: Nightmare
nightmare.loc: Pits of Inferno, Formorgar Mines, Cemetery Quarter, Edron (In multiple places during The Inquisition Quest), Alchemist Quarter, Vengoth Castle, Deeper Banuta (small spawn, ), Krailos Ruins and Grounds of Deceit.
nightmare.desc: One thing that always eludes the demons and their powers are dreams. The gift of dreaming is only granted to mortals. Still some demons lurk at the borders of dreams, watching, drooling with hatred and greed. Sometimes a dreamer gets some distant feeling of those unwelcome spectators. Such dreams often turn into nightmares. The chaos and fear, that is caused by nightmares, allow the lurking demons to steal some of the essence of these dreams. By eating more and more of this substance, demons gain certain characteristics which are normally not at disposal of demons. To some extent they are even able to haunt the dreams of the mortals, although their influence is only indirect and limited. Their physical form reflects their constant travel to a place they do not belong to and takes the shape of a ghostly horse creature. Their powers in the lands of the living are somewhat more substantial and often involve to weaken mortals and to steal their life force.
nightmare.notes: You may hunt 400 Nightmare and Nightmare Scion combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Tormentor.

nightmare-of-gazharagoth.name: Nightmare of Gaz'haragoth
nightmare-of-gazharagoth.title: Nightmare of Gaz'haragoth
nightmare-of-gazharagoth.notes: Looks the same as a Terrorsleep. You will find them by stepping in a Strange Vortex, created when Gaz'haragoth's minions are slain.
nightmare-of-gazharagoth.strat: Ignore them and run to the portal in the south-east. These creatures have instant respawn, after you killed them, they spawn again in a moment, so they should be avoided at any cost.

nightmare-scion.name: Nightmare Scion
nightmare-scion.title: Nightmare Scion
nightmare-scion.loc: Cemetery Quarter, Alchemist Quarter and in the Arena and Zoo Quarter (unreachable), Vengoth Castle, Formorgar Mines, Lower Spike, Robson Isle (single respawn), Krailos Ruins.
nightmare-scion.desc: It is highly unlikely that the so-called Nightmare Scion is actually the offspring of a nightmare. Some people say that the Nightmare Scions are a completely different breed than the nightmares, others claim that they are the same breed, only weaker due to injuries or some sort of demonic disease. A common theory states that the Nightmare Scions are the prototype of the actual nightmare. Just like this theory, also another one assumes that nightmares do not breed, but that all nightmares come into existence through the same process. Those creatures that do not possess the full amount of power turn into Nightmare Scions. It is not known, yet if Nightmare Scions can become true nightmares by ageing or maybe by accumulating power in some way. They are usually found in the company of nightmares and seem to get along with each other quite well for demonic races. What a Nightmare Scion lacks in raw power, it tries to make up with wickedness. They are exceptionally cruel and love to prey on weaker foes. In general, they occur in great numbers to be safe. This seems not only to combine their power but also their wickedness. Nightmare Scions love to stalk their victims in the shadow for…
nightmare-scion.notes: Added in the Christmas Update 2008. You may hunt 400 Nightmare and Nightmare Scion combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Tormentor.
nightmare-scion.strat: Just like every other creature that runs in low health, try to cast a strong spell or rune to prevent it from running too far, and try not to lure any other creatures. And also know that Nightmare Scions are really fast, so it's best to finish them off quickly or trap in a place where they can't run away.

nightslayer.name: Nightslayer
nightslayer.title: Nightslayer
nightslayer.notes: Appears as a raid for five minutes after a player lights the Lightbringer's Basin and receives the following message
nightslayer.strat: Pretty straightforward creature, similar to a Cyclops Smith in strength.

nightstalker.name: Nightstalker
nightstalker.title: Nightstalker
nightstalker.loc: Cemetery Quarter, Vengoth Castle, Vandura Mountain, Robson Isle.
nightstalker.desc: Nightstalkers have haunted the dreams and stories of children since the dawn of mankind and probably even before that. Like some other demonic creatures, they seem to feed, at least partially, on the fear of their victims. Divination magic revealed that they are no native denizens of our realm, however, the question where Nightstalkers actually come from is still unanswered. They are cunning and intelligent creatures that are even able to talk our language. They prefer lairs in dark and abandoned places like ruins and caves. Sometimes, Nightstalkers form small colonies, but most of them are notorious loners. Sages speculate that the Nightstalkers' wish for loneliness results from their life cycle. At certain stages in their life, they leave the company of their kin to become lonely prowlers that secretly stalk the settlements of civilised creatures to haunt particularly their children. During these stages, Nightstalkers seem to dematerialise, almost like ghosts. They feed on the fears of those around them and adopt features derived from these subconscious fears. Luckily, Nightstalkers also gain a certain vulnerability in this state. After some while, Nightstalkers gradually…

noble-lion.name: Noble Lion
noble-lion.title: Noble Lion
noble-lion.desc: Lions are beasts of prey that dwell in the deserts and savannahs of Tibia. They live together in prides and are dangerous predators, because they are very quick and try to kill their prey with a single bite. The lion is a popular symbol of royalty as well as of courage and bravery. The Noble Lion is the undoubted king among his lesser siblings. Among with the already impressive Roaring Lions the majestic and powerful Noble Lions dwell in caves and ruins rather than in the desert.They are the biggest and strongest type of lions, also varying in appearance and behavior. Their fur has a golden shimmer and their eyes remind of radiant emeralds. Also they act in a more intelligent way when preying and therefore are more dangerous than the customary lion. Some sages think the Noble Lions are a sort of mystical beings from olden times because they are so often found in the ruins of ancient sanctuaries or buried temples. Whether they are the wardens of these sacred sites or were themselves a subject of worship is a secret that has still to be revealed. As far as is known they sometimes allow particularly worthy heroes to ride them into battle.
noble-lion.notes: It can be tamed through using The Lion's Heart on a Noble Lion. You can obtain The Lion's Heart as a reward from the Lion's Rock Quest.

nomad.name: Nomad
nomad.title: Nomad (Basic)
nomad.loc: Desert around Darashia and Ankrahmun, Nomad Cave, Foreigner Quarter
nomad.desc: Most of the hardened desert Nomads are hospitable and honest people but some of them have become bitter due to the way they are treated by the city dwellers. Especially Ankrahmun's claim of power over the whole desert was a thorn in the side of those proud tribes. Some of them look upon the desert as their own land and don't welcome any trespassers. Others who lost their herds to famines or raids of the henchmen of the Pharaoh have turned to banditry. Be that as it may, these few Nomads have become a serious threat to the unwary traveller. They are not enough to form a raiding party of some size, but small groups of Nomad bandits can be encountered almost everywhere in the desert nowadays.
nomad.notes: Plays white Musical Notes when they attack. The parchment they drop is needed to begin a quest.
nomad.strat: Similar to Wild Warriors and Bandits. Easy to kill by players above level 15. But be careful not to lure more of them, when the Nomad starts to run away.

norcferatu-heartless.name: Norcferatu Heartless
norcferatu-heartless.title: Norcferatu Heartless
norcferatu-heartless.desc: Devotion or delusion? The Heartless don't care. These orc-dhampir hybrids, known as the Norcferatu Heartless, have taken the blood cult's rituals to new extremes. In an act of misplaced piety and symbolic purification, they have literally removed their own hearts. This brutal rite, performed with crude blades and guided by superstition, is said to sever emotional weakness and fear of death. Whether or not it truly grants them any advantage is debatable, most experts agree it does absolutely nothing. And yet, the legend persists. The removed hearts are preserved in unholy amphorae, bound in iron and blood-sigil wards. Some wear them on chains. Others hide them in shrines. None dare destroy them, for the Heartless believe their soul still resides within. In combat, they are unstoppable fanatics. Melee brutes with unnatural resilience, they charge headlong into enemy lines, impervious to pain and utterly indifferent to their own survival. Their bodies are riddled with scars, not from battle, but from self-inflicted mutilation, each one a badge of loyalty to a cause that offers no redemption.

norcferatu-nightweaver.name: Norcferatu Nightweaver
norcferatu-nightweaver.title: Norcferatu Nightweaver
norcferatu-nightweaver.desc: A perversion of orcish shamanistic tradition, the Norcferatu Nightweaver is a vile caster who fuses blood magic with forgotten rites of shadow worship. While their ancestors once were seers and spiritual leaders of their clans, this new generation has embraced the darkness so deeply they no longer distinguish between vision and nightmare. The Nightweavers call upon the shadows not as allies, but as limbs, tendrils, and mouths, extensions of their own warped minds. Where light ends, their power begins. They weave illusions of safety, then stab through them with blades made of dark. They blind their enemies with sudden bursts of pitch-black fog, only to appear behind them with a whisper and a dagger dipped in cursed vitae. To them, darkness is not the absence of light - it is a living force, eager to consume. Their robes reek of ancient blood. Their eyes glow faintly with the crimson of their many sacrifices. The rituals they perform are often seen as madness by outsiders, but to the Nightweavers, every scar is a syllable in an eternal chant. In battle, they are not only dangerous, they are utterly unpredictable. They will warp the battlefield itself into a reflection of their…

norgle-glacierbeard.name: Norgle Glacierbeard
norgle-glacierbeard.title: Norgle Glacierbeard
norgle-glacierbeard.notes: Is the boss of Warlord Arena Pit #3. Next #4.
norgle-glacierbeard.strat: To all vocations keep diagonal to avoid waves. Druid or Sorcerer: Use Magic Shield and SD or more risk you can use Death Strike and heal. Knight: Melee and Exori. Paladin: Shoot and Ethereal Spear.

northern-pike.name: Northern Pike
northern-pike.title: Northern Pike (Creature)
northern-pike.loc: Fiehonja - Deepling Outpost - Deepling Temple Complex - Drowned Library You can find (3 in , 2 at , 2 at , and 1 at ) aswell as several other locations.
northern-pike.desc: This very rare fish is not a common sight, not even to the eyes of experienced fishermen. With a healthy dose of luck, the Northern Pike can be caught in many lakes across Tibia. Given the ability of going underwater, the adventurous explorer can also experience these frail creatures in their natural habitats. Catching them without a fishing rod, however, can be a challenging task.
northern-pike.beh: Quickly swims away from hostile foes.
northern-pike.notes: It is a living Northern Pike. When dead it may reappear as a Slippery Northern Pike. If you kill again, they have a chance to turn into a Northern Pike (fish).
northern-pike.strat: Just kill them, they won't harm you.

novice-of-the-cult.name: Novice of the Cult
novice-of-the-cult.title: Novice of the Cult
novice-of-the-cult.loc: Liberty Bay Cult Cave, Formorgar Mines, Yalahar Magician Quarter, in the caves on top of the Hrodmir mountains.
novice-of-the-cult.desc: The members of the lowest rank of the sinister cult still lack any greater powers but are eager to prove themselves worthy. Their inherent cowardice is somewhat compensated by first signs of fanaticism. Determined to protect their cult, they are capable but not too impressive opponents. What they lack in strength, they try to make up with quantity. Usually Novices of the Cult band together for a fight, often accompanied by a member of a higher rank whom they protect with their lives. Quite clueless about the true agendas and teachings of the cults, they are seen as disposable shock troops by their superiors.
novice-of-the-cult.beh: Runs when low on hp, can't be pushed.
novice-of-the-cult.notes: They usually come 1-2 at a time, certain areas can have up to 5 Novices at a time, with Tarantulas, a Dark Monk, and very often with one or two Witches. If you are a free account user and want to look as if wearing a premium outfit, just use the Creature Illusion spell.
novice-of-the-cult.strat: Knights just hit with weapon, pally/mages shoot with rod/wand or distance weapon. Sometimes HMM or even LMM can help loads. Summoning a Fire Elemental or a Demon Skeleton will help alot if you are low level mage.

noxious-ripptor.name: Noxious Ripptor
noxious-ripptor.title: Noxious Ripptor
noxious-ripptor.desc: The Noxious Ripptor is a prime example for the gnompronean fauna. A primal beast and probably the ancestor of at least one surface creature and its subspecies. It's a feral predator whose aggressiveness supersedes that of all of its descendants. The Ripptors are known to attack everything that moves, even if just fed or even feeding. They seem to forget anything else as soon as a new target for their aggression shows up. This aggressive behaviour is seemingly randomly extended to members of their own species from time to time. Sudden attacks and fight between two or more Noxious Ripptors are quite common and differently to other such occurrences in the animal kingdom, might lead to the death or dismembering of the fighting creatures. In battle they show little regard to their own safety and no Noxious Ripptor will ever retreat from a fight once it begun. Only another distraction may draw a Ripptor from its current prey. The noxious part of their name comes from their disgusting ability to vomit balls of toxic residue that they can seemingly produce in abundance. They use it to shower their victims from afar while closing in as they obviously just want to ultimately rip and tear…

nymph.name: Nymph
nymph.title: Nymph
nymph.desc: Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age nor illness. On Feyrist, nymphs can be encountered by lone travelers where their music might be heard, and the traveler could spy on their dancing or bathing in a stream or pool. Such encounters could be dangerous, though, as nymphs generally dislike to be stalked. These fae have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. Nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.

obujos.name: Obujos
obujos.title: Obujos
obujos.beh: He walks on all kinds of fields, he has strong ice beam/wave.
obujos.notes: Obujos, Defensor Profundis, is one of the three depth lords. Reachable in third stage of Liquid Black Quest. He is the second strongest deepling boss. Obujos cannot be blocked from spawning. Teams can stay in its room for 20 minutes, the timer starts when entering the teleport. Re-entry is denied after players gain experience from it. Thus, teams can earn a few minutes by jumping out and in its lair when the first boss is on deep red HP.
obujos.strat: Trap him in narrow path in south part of his arena and block him with Wild Growth to avoid re-target. Do not let him walk around, because he may recover his health quickly. Bronze Amulet is highly recommended as Obujos does Mana Drain attacks about every second turn. Druids should use their strongest Ice Damage spells because this boss is weak on ice.

ocyakao.name: Ocyakao
ocyakao.title: Ocyakao

ab.n: Death Life Drain Ball around itself
Freezing Explosion Ball around itself (Freezes you)

ocyakao.beh: Fights until death, follows you. Damaging him makes him say "Grrrr! Kisavuta!" and triggers his AoE life drain attack.
ocyakao.strat: Spawns together with large group of other Chakoyas. There are 5 waves in total, each 5 seconds apart. The first 4 waves contain Chakoyas, and on the 5th wave Ocyakao spawns (20 seconds after the first wave). It is advisable to use Thunderstorm Runes to get rid of his minions, or invisibility to hide from them. Comparable to an Orc Leader.

ogre-brute.name: Ogre Brute
ogre-brute.title: Ogre Brute

ab.n: Dizzyness Ball of 3x3 SQM on target

ogre-brute.desc: Ogres are large, downright monstrous in appearance, considerably dwarfing even tall orcs. They have a plump, corpulent body, chunky hands and feet and a small, seemingly neckless head. An average adult ogre stands over twelve feet tall, and his waist circumference is almost the half of his height. Most ogres are bald and only rarely have facial hair. They use wooden clubs as weapons, banded, studded or spiked with iron; but stone hatchets or fork-like weapons are also common. While missile combat with bows or crossbows is too difficult for them, they are good at throwing heavy things, particularly boulders. They mature more quickly than humans, reaching adulthood at the age of twelve. Ogres live in tribes that inhabit the steppe and grassland of Krailos, for the most part dwelling in big leather tents or stone huts, though some ogre tribes still have nomadic tendencies. Leader of a tribe is usually the strongest male ogre. The chieftain is supported by an ogre-shaman. If the shaman is female, the two are often, but not necessarily, a couple. The chieftain is responsible for all decisions concerning the hunt and martial matters while the shaman is responsible for all affairs…
ogre-brute.strat: Ogre Brutes are fairly slow but have a very strong melee, and although they dont use the smoke exori or the distance fighting very often, it can combo its abilities dealing very heavy damage. Be on guard as it uses its paralyze ball and drunkness wave often. It is suggested to wear a dwarven ring if you are a low level mage or paladin. It is weak to Energy Damage, if you are a mage you can use energy type attacks.

ogre-rowdy.name: Ogre Rowdy
ogre-rowdy.title: Ogre Rowdy
ogre-rowdy.loc: Kilmaresh Central Steppe, Kilmaresh Southern Steppe, Green Belt, Kilmaresh Mountains (underground).
ogre-rowdy.desc: The Ogre Rowdy is a stronger version of Ogre Savages.

ogre-ruffian.name: Ogre Ruffian
ogre-ruffian.title: Ogre Ruffian
ogre-ruffian.loc: Kilmaresh Central Steppe, Kilmaresh Southern Steppe, Green Belt, Kilmaresh Mountains (underground).
ogre-ruffian.desc: The Ogre Ruffian is a stronger version of Ogre Brutes.

ogre-sage.name: Ogre Sage
ogre-sage.title: Ogre Sage
ogre-sage.loc: Kilmaresh Central Steppe, Kilmaresh Southern Steppe, Green Belt, Kilmaresh Mountains (underground).
ogre-sage.desc: The Ogre Sage is a stronger version of Ogre Shamans.

ogre-savage.name: Ogre Savage
ogre-savage.title: Ogre Savage
ogre-savage.desc: Ogres are large, downright monstrous in appearance, considerably dwarfing even tall orcs. They have a plump, corpulent body, chunky hands and feet and a small, seemingly neckless head. An average adult ogre stands over twelve feet tall, and his waist circumference is almost the half of his height. Most ogres are bald and only rarely have facial hair. They use wooden clubs as weapons, banded, studded or spiked with iron; but stone hatchets or fork-like weapons are also common. While missile combat with bows or crossbows is too difficult for them, they are good at throwing heavy things, particularly boulders. They mature more quickly than humans, reaching adulthood at the age of twelve. Ogres live in tribes that inhabit the steppe and grassland of Krailos, for the most part dwelling in big leather tents or stone huts, though some ogre tribes still have nomadic tendencies. Leader of a tribe is usually the strongest male ogre. The chieftain is supported by an ogre-shaman. If the shaman is female, the two are often, but not necessarily, a couple. The chieftain is responsible for all decisions concerning the hunt and martial matters while the shaman is responsible for all affairs…
ogre-savage.strat: Simply kill it, make use of its weakness to Energy Damage.

ogre-shaman.name: Ogre Shaman
ogre-shaman.title: Ogre Shaman
ogre-shaman.desc: Ogres are large, downright monstrous in appearance, considerably dwarfing even tall orcs. They have a plump, corpulent body, chunky hands and feet and a small, seemingly neckless head. An average adult ogre stands over twelve feet tall, and his waist circumference is almost the half of his height. Most ogres are bald and only rarely have facial hair. Ogres live in tribes that inhabit the steppe and grassland of Krailos, for the most part dwelling in big leather tents or stone huts, though some ogre tribes still have nomadic tendencies. Leader of a tribe is usually the strongest male ogre. The chieftain is supported by an ogre-shaman. If the shaman is female, the two are often, but not necessarily, a couple. The chieftain is responsible for all decisions concerning the hunt and martial matters while the shaman is responsible for all affairs…
ogre-shaman.strat: Paladins can use Holy Damage attacks, since it is weak to this type. Other vocations should just chase and kill it.

omnivora.name: Omnivora
omnivora.title: Omnivora

ab.n: green sparkle area attack on itself

omnivora.desc: The Omnivora is a strange offshoot of the Carniphila plant. This strain had an especially short life cycle, which allowed it to react rapidly to changes due to the fast production of new generations. It is assumed that some of those Carniphilas adapted to a more mountainous terrain, and settled in deep and dark valleys. Finding less soil and relying more on their carnivorous nature, they slowly compensated the lack of minerals through an enhanced digestion system which allowed them to consume bones and stones that the ordinary Carniphila would leave over. Less dependent on sunlight, the ancestors of the Omnivora found their way into the eternal darkness of subterranean areas. This they found to be a new habitat they were ideally suited for. The Omnivora quickly spread via tunnels and underground streams which carried their seeds. Only the fierce predators of the underground, who found the Omnivora a delicacy, stopped the population from exploding. Over time, the Omnivora adapted itself again and became highly toxic and inedible, but also less fertile. This led to a more stable population, but also to the Omnivora becoming the predator instead of the prey. The plants had developed…
omnivora.strat: Stay diagonal, the death beam is most deadly.

omrafir.name: Omrafir
omrafir.title: Omrafir
omrafir.beh: Omrafir chases his target and fights in close combat. He seems to attack his targets persistently, moving diagonally through summons that obstruct him. He summons Flames of Omrafir immediately when others are slain.
omrafir.notes: Omrafir heals continuously. These heals are strengthened when he steps on a fire field as well as when he takes any fire damage ex:Great fireball,flame strike,fireball rune, saying " ". Omrafir casts a very strong fire beam a few seconds after saying " ". When Omrafir drops to about 50% of health, the server will continuously check whether Flame of Omrafir have been killed or not. If any flames have been killed, Omrafir will despawn and 9 Hellfire Fighters will appear all over the room. Once all Hellfire Fighters have been killed Omrafir respawns in the center of the room. However, this scenario will not happen more than three times. Omrafir uses the new reward system.
omrafir.strat: There are two ways of succeeding in the killing of Omrafir. First of all you have to trap Omrafir in a corner using Wild Growth Runes or Magic Wall Runes and make sure you do not stand in the range of his strong fire beam as it has been confirmed to hit a high level mage for close to 13k dmg with mana shield. Then you can choose between these two ways of killing: Short: Once he is trapped kill him using single-target attacks such as Ice Strike, Icicle Runes or Sudden Death Runes and make sure you do not kill a single flame. If you managed not to kill a single flame he will fight until death without exploding. Long: Once he is trapped attack him using the spells and runes you would like. This time you do not have to pay attention to his flames. Keep attacking him until he exploded a total of three times and then kill him as he will not explode a fourth time no matter if you kill his flames again or not. NOTE: Apparently he always explodes in the last hit (one time at least).

omruc.name: Omruc
omruc.title: Omruc
omruc.beh: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.
omruc.notes: Omruc was sentenced to be locked away, after his part in the conspiracies against the pharaoh, Arkhotep. One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.
omruc.strat: He keeps distance from players and attacks with distance weapons. Make sure to GFB the stalkers every now and then, because they will heavily break your shielding. Firebombing him may also prove useful, as he will unlikely change his position and mages will know where to aim runes when he becomes invisible. He is guarded by 2 stalkers, 6 magicthrowers and 6 shredderthrowers.

oozing-carcass.name: Oozing Carcass
oozing-carcass.title: Oozing Carcass
oozing-carcass.desc: The Oozing Carcasses are wretched beings that were once fervent followers of the blood god. Now reduced to rotting shells, their existence is sustained by the remnants of a twisted, semi-sentient decay. Within their decrepit forms, a murky ichor oozes incessantly, a grotesque manifestation of the unholy influence that has befallen them. These semi-living monstrosities shuffle through the desolate landscapes, their movements accompanied by a nauseating squelching sound. While their minds have been reduced to fragmented memories and impulses, the Oozing Carcasses still retain a flicker of their former loyalty, instinctively drawn to areas of concentrated decay where they gather in macabre communion.

oozing-corpus.name: Oozing Corpus
oozing-corpus.title: Oozing Corpus
oozing-corpus.desc: Among the fallen followers of the dead blood god, the Oozing Corpus represents a morbid manifestation of eternal decay. These abominations, even after eons, continue to ooze self-feeding decay, a testament to their cursed existence. Their bodies, once robust and filled with vitality, have been reduced to grotesque amalgamations of putrefaction and rot. Every movement is accompanied by a nauseating sludge, as if the very essence of decay seeps from their pores. The Oozing Corpuses, their minds fragmented and trapped in an eternal torment, mindlessly wander the fallen realm, perpetuating the cycle of decay as they leave a trail of foulness in their wake.

orc.name: Orc
orc.title: Orc
orc.loc: Ulderek's Rock, Edron Orc Cave, Ancient Temple, Ice Islands, Venore Orc Cave, Rookgaard Orc Fortress, Rookgaard main cave, Fibula Dungeon, Elvenbane, Foreigner Quarter, Zao Orc Land.
orc.desc: Orcs are a very ancient race that once ruled the whole of Tibia. Later, they were expelled from the upper world by other races, and now they live in the dungeons of Tibia. They are human-like and very wily. Organised as paramilitary squads they can be quite dangerous.
orc.notes: Good monsters to level on in Rookgaard. A single Orc that rarely spawns in the Orc Fort drops an Old and Used Backpack.
orc.strat: You should be at least Level 4 to fight them. Be careful when hunting them at low levels, as they might come together with Orc Spearmen.

orc-berserker.name: Orc Berserker
orc-berserker.title: Orc Berserker
orc-berserker.loc: Orc Fort, Dwacatra, Orc Peninsula, Elvenbane, Edron Orc Cave, Plains of Havoc, below Point of No Return in Outlaw Camp, Maze of Lost Souls, Cyclopolis, Desert Dungeon, Ancient Temple, Foreigner Quarter, Zao Orc Land.
orc-berserker.desc: Orc Berserkers are very strong fighters. Their favourite tactic is the assault, where they can use their velocity and their halberds to kill their victim with a single stroke. Having survived their attack, watch out for other types of orcs that are usually in their company.
orc-berserker.beh: Orc Berserkers fight to the death and use close combat to kill their enemies, they will also push/kill other creatures to get to you.
orc-berserker.notes: These are dangerous creatures, their attack is very strong, but their defense skill is poor and it is better to fight one than trying to escape because they can run really fast. Warning! Most players under level 20 will die if they meet one. Orc Berserkers can also drop Orc Tusks during raids of the Machinery of War Quest.
orc-berserker.strat: Stealth Rings can be life savers when coming across these creatures at low levels. With all vocations these can be handled easily with care. The Halberds they drop allow for good profit for all vocations. Knights, recommended skills: at least 60/60 with decent equipment and should be prepared to use Health Potions. Knights can also use spells like Whirlwind Throw, Front Sweep and Berserk to kill Berserkers faster and/or deal with more than one of them at a time. Remember: the longer a Berserker lives, the more damage you take. Mages should consider using Magic Shield or Invisible. However, at level 25+ with a decent magic level it is not hard to just use earth attacks and Intense Healing for this creature, but if they do an exceptionally big hit you can always use health/mana potions, Halberds make it easy to profit. But be careful with Invisibility, as Orc Leaders, Orc Warlords and Orc Shamans can still see you. If you find them together with Orc Shamans, kill the Shamans first so that the summoned Snakes don't break your shielding or get in your way. Also a good summon for Mages, however healing runes may be recommended, since they lose health easily. Paladins Should use a one…

orc-cult-fanatic.name: Orc Cult Fanatic
orc-cult-fanatic.title: Orc Cult Fanatic
orc-cult-fanatic.desc: The Orc Cult Fanatic is a stronger version of Orc Leaders.

orc-cult-inquisitor.name: Orc Cult Inquisitor
orc-cult-inquisitor.title: Orc Cult Inquisitor
orc-cult-inquisitor.desc: The Orc Cult Inquisitor is a stronger version of Orc Berserkers.
orc-cult-inquisitor.beh: They are similar to Orc Berserkers but much stronger. They fight to the death.

orc-cult-minion.name: Orc Cult Minion
orc-cult-minion.title: Orc Cult Minion
orc-cult-minion.desc: The Orc Cult Minion is a stronger version of Orc Spearmen.

orc-cult-priest.name: Orc Cult Priest
orc-cult-priest.title: Orc Cult Priest
orc-cult-priest.desc: The Orc Cult Priest is a stronger version of Orc Shamans.

orc-cultist.name: Orc Cultist
orc-cultist.title: Orc Cultist
orc-cultist.desc: The Orc Cultist is a stronger version of Orc Warriors.

orc-leader.name: Orc Leader
orc-leader.title: Orc Leader
orc-leader.loc: Orc Fort, Edron Orc Cave, South of the temple in PoH, Maze of Lost Souls, Cyclopolis, Zao Orc Land.
orc-leader.desc: Orc Leaders are the commanders of the orcs' army. They are quite clever and know how to arrange the different troops - warriors, berserkers, spearmen, and shamans - to form powerful squads. They themselves are quite strong fighters that use even throwing knives.
orc-leader.beh: Orc leaders fight to the death and chase their enemies while throwing Throwing Knives at them.
orc-leader.notes: These dangerous creatures can throw strong Knives to kill the enemy if they try to escape. Orc Leaders can also drop Orc Tusks during raids of the Machinery of War Quest.
orc-leader.strat: Knights: you should have skills 75/75 to hunt them. Low levels with low skills should stay away from these but if necessary to fight then combine your melee with Whirlwind Throw or Berserk. Paladins: you should run while shooting royal spears, and Ethereal Spear. Mages: you should use earth or death or wands/rods to kill them. If you are premium you should use Terra Strike or Death Strike to help minimize waste.

orc-marauder.name: Orc Marauder
orc-marauder.title: Orc Marauder
orc-marauder.desc: The war in Zao required a high degree of mobility. The answer to this request was the mounted archer. However, it took some time to make this solution palatable to the savage orcs. Barely able to control their blood lust, the orcs easily forgot their intention to stay away from the enemy and steered their mounts into the fray. Those who managed to withstand such urges were often seen as cowards and were widely shunned by other orcs. Only with the coming of their new leaders such prejudices changed. The few scattered Orc Marauders were combined and received additional training. Some of the smarter orcs were picked to support the ranks of the riders and once their effectiveness was proven, the acceptance of the Orc Marauders among the orcs grew continuously. Used more efficiently, these new units of the orcish horde made the difference that was necessary to tune the tones of war at least for a while. The Orc Marauders attacked the lizard armies from afar. Slowly the casualties drained the strength of the lizard armies and the attacks of the orcs became bolder and bolder. The attacks usually started with Orc Marauders weakening the defensive lines. When the main body of the orcs…
orc-marauder.notes: These mounted archers was the answer to high degree mobility. However, because of the orcs lust for blood, staying at a distance from the enemy proved a difficult task to maneuver. Before, those orcs which managed to restrain themselves from such urges were often shunned and called cowards. With the coming of new leaders such prejudice as these have since changed. The remaining Orc Marauders joined together and have since received additional training and have become what they now are today. Now only the most daring orcs are now chosen as Orc Marauders. As unlike the War Wolves, gnarlhounds are not bound to a specific rider, they are shared throughout the tribe and picked at random before a raid. Orc Marauders treat their skin to a mixture of excrements and herbs to avoid them being ripped to shreds by their own mounts. This creature was added with the Christmas Update 2009.
orc-marauder.strat: They stay at a distance of the target and run away with great haste (faster than a lvl 55) from you. Use Haste or something similar to chase them.

orc-rider.name: Orc Rider
orc-rider.title: Orc Rider
orc-rider.loc: Orc Fort, Orc Peninsula, near Dark Cathedral, Zao Orc Land.
orc-rider.desc: Orc Riders are orcish elite troops mounted on grim war wolves. Their fearsome steeds make them fast and agile while their heavy lances can deal impressive damage. Orc Rider patrols can mostly be found in the plains of Tibia where the terrain is ideal for mounted combat. It is very difficult to run away from a pack of Orc Riders once you have had the misfortune to meet them.
orc-rider.beh: Orc Riders fight to the death.
orc-rider.notes: These mounted orcs are strong but can be tricked with Invisibility. They don't drop Wolf Paws. Orcish Axes can be looted easily and sold for a good price to NPCs. Orc Riders also drop Orc Tusks during raids of the Machinery of War Quest.
orc-rider.strat: If you are a Mage, use Invisible and runes, Stoneshower or GFB are useful because Orc Riders are usually found in groups. Premium mages should try to use Terra Strike to minimise waste.

orc-shaman.name: Orc Shaman
orc-shaman.title: Orc Shaman
orc-shaman.loc: Edron Orc Cave, Temple of Xayepocax, below Point of No Return in Outlaw Camp, Venore Orc Cave, Maze of Lost Souls, Orc Fort, north west of Thais, Elvenbane, Plains Of Havoc, Foreigner Quarter, Zao Orc Land.
orc-shaman.desc: Orc Shamans are the magicians among the orcs. They support the other troops during a fight. They can shoot fireballs and magic missiles. They even summon snakes to set them on their enemies. Moreover, they can heal themselves.
orc-shaman.beh: An Orc Shaman will run when in low health.
orc-shaman.notes: Magical Orcs. Rather weak. Minotaur Mages are superior. Orc Shamans can also drop Orc Tusks during raids of the Machinery of War Quest.
orc-shaman.strat: Unless you're surrounded by four or more of these Orcs (in which case you just GFB), don't bother killing the Snakes to avoid breaking your shielding, because an Orc Shaman attacks with unblockable Magical Damage. Kill the Orc Shaman and the Snakes will die instantly. Shamans do not push objects, so trapping them in a corner is a good idea if they annoy you when hunting stronger creatures.

orc-spearman.name: Orc Spearman
orc-spearman.title: Orc Spearman
orc-spearman.loc: Orc Fortress, Folda Dungeon, Edron Orc Cave and around it, Ancient Temple, Venore Orc Cave, below the Point of No Return in Outlaw Camp, Plains of Havoc, North of Thais in the Orc Peninsula, Elvenbane and Orc Camp in Foreigner Quarter. Also found in Rookgaard West plains, Zao Orc Land.
orc-spearman.desc: Orc Spearmen are the distance fighters among the orcs. Their spears are deadly weapons, but they are weak short-range fighters. Usually, they are accompanied by other types of orcs, so that they can hide behind them and attack their enemies from the second row.
orc-spearman.beh: They will retarget to the nearest player.
orc-spearman.notes: This Orc attacks with spears that can deal high damage for lower level players.
orc-spearman.strat: If you are in Rookgaard don't fight them unless you are level 7+ or you have good equipment and Small Health Potions, they appear in groups and with Orcs. On the premium side; there are two single spawns of these creatures, if you trap them in a corner they aren't so hard and will start use their weaker melee attack. In Mainland, If you are fighting them in caves like Ancient Temple in Thais, try to lure them to a safer places, as they are usually accompanied with Orcs and Orc Warriors which, can be deadly for an inexperienced player.

orc-warlord.name: Orc Warlord
orc-warlord.title: Orc Warlord
orc-warlord.loc: Orc Fortress, Foreigner Quarter, Zao Orc Land.
orc-warlord.desc: Fiercer than the dreaded orc berserker and more powerful even than the mighty orc leader, the Orc Warlord is the true terror of all civilised races. Orc Warlords are the strongest fighters of their race who have managed to rise to the highest ranks through treachery and murder. Even though they are extremely skilled fighters who can cut a man in two with a single stroke of their mighty blades, Orc Warlords prefer to use their superior speed and cunning to overcome their enemies. They avoid open combat whenever they can, sneaking up on unwary adventurers from behind or throwing their vicious shuriken instead.
orc-warlord.beh: The Orc Warlord will chase the enemy while throwing stars. They retarget and will kill weaker creatures to reach you.
orc-warlord.notes: As the most powerful orcs, they aren't called Warlords for nothing. They are tough creatures but drop good loot. They are usually found leading groups of Orc Leaders and Orc Berserkers. They can hit pretty nasty, so be ready to heal.
orc-warlord.strat: To beat these powerful creatures you will need a good team with high-skilled Knights, some Paladins and Mages with a high Magic Level. The best way to kill them is from a distance because their Throwing Stars are weaker than their melee. Knights with skills 90/90 and a Scrapper Arena weapon can kill them fairly easily. As with all creatures that use invisibility, stay alert with an exori ico to turn them visible again. Its attacks can be compared to a Giant Spider's. Orc Warlords are more profitable to hunt since Orcish Axes have become sellable, and now make up the most valuable part of the loot. Orc Warlords, notably those from raids, can yield different loot: * Orc Tusk from Orc Warlord in raids of the Machinery of War Quest. * Amazon Armor, Amazon Helmet and Amazon Shield from Orc Warlord in raids on Femor Hills.

orc-warrior.name: Orc Warrior
orc-warrior.title: Orc Warrior
orc-warrior.loc: Ancient Temple in Thais, Orc Fort, below Point of No Return in Outlaw Camp and inside a mountain north of it, Orc Peninsula, Folda, Edron Orc Cave, Maze of Lost Souls, Elvenbane Castle, Foreigner Quarter, Zao Orc Land.
orc-warrior.desc: Orc Warriors are the simple fighters among the orcs. They are weaker than berserkers, but using their sabres or daggers they can be quite dangerous in the small corridors of the dungeons. Watch out for other types of orcs - like spearmen or shamans - which might hide in the second row.
orc-warrior.notes: A Strong and better armored orc.
orc-warrior.strat: Dangerous for ill-equiped or lower levels. Knights, from level 10 with decent skills (50/50) these should be easy. Paladins, just kill these while running to get hit less, and heal when needed. Mages, could do with decent equipment, and a level 13 wand or rod, just run them around and try to avoid their melee, have exura and exura gran to heal when needed.

orchid-frog.name: Orchid Frog
orchid-frog.title: Orchid Frog
orchid-frog.loc: Meriana, Laguna Islands, and other Shattered Isles.
orchid-frog.beh: Fights to the death. Can't be pushed.
orchid-frog.notes: Very fast. The main danger here is when they come with other enemies (and other colored) frogs are fast enough to get to you first and break your shielding and leave you wide open to other monster's attacks.
orchid-frog.strat: On the Laguna Islands, many types of frogs, tortoises, and toads can swarm you. Low level players may want to have GFBs to clear these swarms.

orclops-bloodbreaker.name: Orclops Bloodbreaker
orclops-bloodbreaker.title: Orclops Bloodbreaker
orclops-bloodbreaker.desc: Where brute strength meets undying hunger, the Orcclops Bloodbreaker is born: an abomination forged in defiance of nature and sanity. These hulking cyclopean creatures were once part of the warbeast caste of orcish culture, bred for combat and conquest. Now, enhanced with the cursed gift of vampirism, they have become juggernauts of destruction. Their single eye, now blood-red and constantly weeping ichor, burns with ceaseless rage. Their transformation was not without complications. Their bodies, already struggling to balance their mixed orc-cyclops heritage, twisted under the strain of undeath. Flesh split, bones swelled, and old scars reopened as they reawakened with newfound purpose and immeasurable pain. This agony is what drives them. It fuels their every strike, every roar, every bloody step forward. A Bloodbreaker is a nightmare on the battlefield. Their strength is matched only by their cruelty. With one massive blow, they can crush a grown man into pulp. With another, they can tear down fortified gates. They do not fight with tactics. They fight with hate. Though initially hesitant, the Norcferatu master permitted their creation to offset the rebellion brewing among the…

orclops-doomhauler.name: Orclops Doomhauler
orclops-doomhauler.title: Orclops Doomhauler
orclops-doomhauler.desc: Orclops Doomhaulers are the elite of the orclopses. They make up with cunning what they lack in strength in comparison with the ravager. Before they join a fight, they lead the ravagers from behind, usually using a unique weapon called doomcrusher to weaken the foe from afar. Orclops Doomhaulers choose one of their own as leader. The orclops ravagers accept the elected doomhauler's rules without complaint. There is not much to decide in the simple lives of orclopses. For this reason, the main duty of such a leader is to put hunting parties together and to assign them to specific areas. It is also a leader's decision in which direction the tribe will move next. Orclops Doomhaulers inherited some of the smithing skills of the cyclopes. This makes them the primary craftsmen of their tribes. They are particularly proud of their personal doomcrushers and they spend a significant amount of time to construct and maintain them. Apart from that they create the few weapons and tools needed by their tribe. However, since orclopses prefer to live a simple life, the doomhaulers' cunning is often seen as a burden rather than a gift. Occasionally a doomhauler tries to initiate a trade with local…
orclops-doomhauler.notes: Part of the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.

orclops-ravager.name: Orclops Ravager
orclops-ravager.title: Orclops Ravager
orclops-ravager.desc: The orclops is a newly discovered breed of orc which, after having been bred extensively by the orcs as war machines, very quickly lost its attraction to the point of extinction. The strength of a cyclops and the brutality of an orc did not mix well. The orclopses were prone to fits of rage and frequent rampages that cost the life of many a tribesman. Although stories of ancient battles mention whole battalions of orclopses, using them was deemed to be too dangerous to be worth the effort. In times of peace, feeding a single orclops was an onerous task for a tribe and feeding half a dozen of them drained a hunting ground empty. As a result, having an orclops became a status symbol for some warlords and all but died out as a subspecies. However, it can be regarded as ironic that a human secret society brought the orclopses back from the brink of extinction. Although the Brotherhood of Bones specialised in necromancy, some of them were eager to employ different kinds of weapons, minions and allies in their wars against the Nightmare Knights. Allying themselves with the Bloody Tooth orc tribe, they provided the orc shamans with the means to breed a better kind of orclopses. Even…
orclops-ravager.notes: Part of the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.

orcus-the-cruel.name: Orcus the Cruel
orcus-the-cruel.title: Orcus the Cruel
orcus-the-cruel.beh: Comparable to a regular Orc Leader.
orcus-the-cruel.notes: Greenhorn challenger. ← #9 Cursed Gladiator #10 Orcus the Cruel
orcus-the-cruel.strat: Low levels should focus on healing and shooting rather than running around, because Orcus the Cruel is quite fast. Use magic shield and fire hmms, wand/rod/spears/exori. Higher level players just kill it.

orewalker.name: Orewalker
orewalker.title: Orewalker
orewalker.desc: The Orewalker is a creature of fire and heat. To be more precise, what seems to be the physical body of the Orewalker is just magma, stone and ores, held together by a spirit of heat and fire. The non-corporeal beings create the bodies by sheer force of will, which in turn serve as some kind of anchor in the physical world. If their bodies are destroyed, they are hurled back into the spirit realm from which they originate. It is hard to comment on the Orewalkers' intelligence and intentions, since they seem to be so unfamiliar with the world. Given the fact that they serve in the armies of those below, it is assumed that the Orewalker spirits are called from beyond and more or less forced into a physical body before being unleashed with some rudimentary orders. The spirits are probably highly intelligent, but given the differences between the worlds it seems impossible for any form of communication other than forcing them to do something. It is not known whether they follow those below for their own unfathomable reasons or are reluctant, perhaps even rebellious helpers. Given the treatment of other minions by those below, a form of slavery seems most likely, but an unholy alliance…

orshabaal.name: Orshabaal
orshabaal.title: Orshabaal
orshabaal.loc: North of Edron near the Dragon Lair in the stone circle ( ).
orshabaal.notes: It's a Demon Lord - lesser of the Demon Overlord (which are yet to plague Tibia) but still dangerous. Whenever you think the world is safe and all the monsters have been killed, when you least expect it, Orshabaal surfaces. It is a Demon Lord who normally hides very deep down in the depths of The Edron Hero Cave. Its magical and physical powers are overwhelming! Many brave heroes have fallen by the great fireball and energy beam it utilizes. To make matters worse, it flees when it reaches red health, and if the adventurers are not fast enough in killing it, Orshabaal's vile healing magic will allow it to return to the fray. Whenever it chooses to raid a world it won't come alone, it brings a lot of Demons as company to help spread death and disaster. Even though Orshabaal has since lost his title of strongest monster, he remains the most infamous, due to his spawn location on the surface (the Triangle of Terror hide deep below the surface, and Ferumbras sits at the very top of his citadel). You are able to use Blessed Wooden Stake on his corpse as well as on all his summoned demon's corpses, in order to get Demon Dust. Sometimes Orshabaal gets trapped by his own Demons because he…
orshabaal.strat: Nowadays, Orshabaal will most likely die in a few seconds because of the high number of players who will be waiting for it. In such cases, the best strategy is try to position yourself around its spawn location and attack it as soon as possible when it appears. If the server is new, or if there are few players online, you may use the strategy that was for a long time the only way to kill this once-fearsome boss. Lure it to the famous spot near the entrance of Cyclopolis. When it is at red health, shoot Magic Walls so it cannot run away. The blocker should party mode with the shooters and get the loot as soon as possible after killing it. Since it is likely the blocker will not be able to heal quickly enough when Orshabaal performs a strong combo, it is advised to have at least a few mages using Ultimate Healing or Exura Sio on the blocker. A good strategy is luring Orshabaal into a place that you can block only him between 2 trees, or in a corridor where 1-2 Demons limit its movement, helping avoid the line-of-sight attacks. Also its possible to use a medium level char (or a low level) as bait to lure him in a place where he will get trapped by his summons, after that people can…

outburst.name: Outburst
outburst.title: Outburst
outburst.beh: He will transform into Charging Outburst after taking some damage. This will occur a few times.
outburst.notes: A boss in the Heart of Destruction Quest.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.title: Overcharge
overcharge.notes: Portion of the 5-man team will be split it in order to face Overchargers. Typically, 2 player and 3 players together. 5 Overchargers need to be killed in order to proceed to Anomaly.
overcharge.strat: All Voc: Focus all your strong spells to deal as much damage as possible in 4 rounds (8 seconds).

overcharged-energy-element.name: Overcharged Energy Element
overcharged-energy-element.title: Overcharged Energy Element
overcharged-energy-element.notes: Expensive and hard to kill for low level knights, after Summer Update 2009 it is not strong against Physical Damage anymore but it is still not so easy to hunt because of combos for over 600 hitpoints.
overcharged-energy-element.strat: Attack it with melee and Whirlwind Throw, Berserk or even Fierce Berserk when more elementals come. Be careful and try to lure one at a time (move forward slowly, and when you see it run back few squares). Do the quest with friends - at least 3 people so one of you will break elemental's shielding to speed up killing. Remember to bring food, because they don't drop any food.

overseer-osverger.name: Overseer Osverger
overseer-osverger.title: Overseer Osverger
overseer-osverger.notes: Only spawns at night time. If not killed, disappears at day time.

owin.name: Owin
owin.title: Owin (Creature)
owin.loc: Grimvale, during Full Moon (12 th -14 th of each month), .
owin.notes: You might encounter Owin like this when it is full moon on Grimvale.
owin.strat: Face it like a stronger Wereboar.

paiz-the-pauperizer.name: Paiz the Pauperizer
paiz-the-pauperizer.title: Paiz the Pauperizer
paiz-the-pauperizer.loc: Razachai, behind the teleport located (access gained during ).
paiz-the-pauperizer.beh: Chases you quickly and fights until death.
paiz-the-pauperizer.notes: He's the Draken's boss. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
paiz-the-pauperizer.strat: First of all, try to stay diagonal at all times, as his wave is very strong. Mages should use ice-based spells, while Paladins can use Sharpshooter,Assassin Stars and Ethereal Spear. It's a hard creature for Knights, and one should use a weapon combined with Berserk based spells all the time to kill it fast.

paladin-familiar.name: Paladin Familiar
paladin-familiar.title: Paladin Familiar
paladin-familiar.beh: Stands shooting at a distance of 2 sqm from the player's target. Every turn it will shoot only one of its abilities.
paladin-familiar.notes: When looking at a summoned Paladin Familiar, the summoner's character name and how long it will take for the summon to disappear is shown. It can be summoned by Paladins of level 200 or higher by using the Summon Paladin Familiar spell. All the experience that is expected to be 'gained' by the summon goes to the player, meaning there is no shared exp between the summon and its summoner, like with the normal Summon Creature spell. It will follow players at their speed and will go up and down stairs and holes with them. It lasts for 15 minutes with a 30 minutes cooldown. It can go with you to a Protection Zone. If the summoner logs out, it will disappear stopping the countdown of its timer, and will reappear when the summoner logs in again.

paladins-apparition.name: Paladin's Apparition
paladins-apparition.title: Paladin's Apparition
paladins-apparition.loc: The Mirrored Nightmare, after Mirror Images are attacked.
paladins-apparition.desc: These paladins belong to a group of (five) apparitions, which Mirror Images can turn into.
paladins-apparition.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.

panda.name: Panda
panda.title: Panda
panda.loc: South of Port Hope around Trapwood, as well as a lone specimen in the Arena Quarter.
panda.desc: The cute looks of the Panda is misleading. Above all, the Panda is a bear and as such short-tempered and fast in its attacks. It is just as strong as other bears, and the only major difference to its conspecifics is its habitat. Panda bears that were caught and shipped to Thais died quickly and even though magic was used, no Panda survived more than a week away from its home. It is found most often in the southern regions of Tiquanda. Considering that they share their territory with the vile dworcs and other savage creatures, it is quite obvious that they are fierce fighters.
panda.notes: Pandas are an endangered species, they can only be found in small numbers in Tiquanda. It can be tamed using Bamboo Leaves or a Music Box on it..

parasite.name: Parasite
parasite.title: Parasite
parasite.notes: Summoned by Infected Weepers. Looks the same as a Larva.
parasite.strat: Lure them and their masters to the crystal columns near the end of the warzone.

parder.name: Parder
parder.title: Parder
parder.loc: All around Marapur including the Emerald Gardens, Fading Isles, Moonfall, Murmuring Wilderness, Silent Waters, Sparkling Lagoon, Stardance Mountains.
parder.desc: The parder is a wild cat inhabiting the jungle-covered isles of Marapur. Its fur is of a dark ochreous ground-color, obliterated by a dark-brown blotched pattern on legs and flanks. A dark stripe also runs from the head across the neck and back. Parders are good climbers, but due to the omnipresence of water they have also developed into good swimmers and like to catch fish. For the nagas, the medium-sized predatory cats hardly pose a threat. They do, however, prey on humanoid bipeds.
parder.strat: Approximately 90% of the damage taken will be physical. Most of the time you can ignore Parders.

parrot.name: Parrot
parrot.title: Parrot
parrot.loc: In the jungle of Tiquanda, Liberty Bay, the Shattered Isles, and as a house pet in Meriana.
parrot.desc: The most intelligent bird in the known world is the colourful Parrot. It is even possible to teach it a few words. It is disputed if the bird is actually aware of what it is saying, after all a Parrot is at most as smart as an orc or a troll. The bird is usually unaggressive and in the wilderness it flees as soon as someone approaches it. Caught Parrots can be tamed and trained though. It takes some patience to teach them some simple sentences but the patience is ultimately rewarded with a funny companion whose buffoonery amuses its owner.
parrot.beh: A parrot flies very fast and usually flies away from Players.
parrot.notes: The most intelligent bird in the known world is the colourful parrot. These birds has learned several words every year, from being accompanied and trained by humans. It is disputed if the bird is actually aware of what it is saying, but it is of course an enjoyable characteristic. The bird is usually unaggressive and in the wilderness it flees as soon as someone approaches it.
parrot.strat: Haste and go on follow attack, else you may not be able to catch them.

party-skeleton.name: Party Skeleton
party-skeleton.title: Party Skeleton
party-skeleton.notes: New players test different weapon types on these creatures. Sometimes they may appear to be teleporting, but this is actually caused by magical boundaries preventing them from leaving the party tents.
party-skeleton.strat: Just follow the guidelines from the Guide NPCs on how to attack them.

penciljack.name: Penciljack
penciljack.title: Penciljack (Creature)
penciljack.notes: Appeared during Tibia's 15th and 20th Anniversary celebrations, in a raid at a random time once a day. The following message will appear: Then, 20 minutes later he will spawns:

penguin.name: Penguin
penguin.title: Penguin
penguin.loc: In and north of Formorgar Glacier, Nibelor, Helheim, Grimlund, south of Svargrond, Chyllfroest.
penguin.desc: The Penguin is an evil bird species that sacrificed its ability to fly to some dark Penguin god in exchange for unknown but doubtlessly sinister rewards. The scheming Penguins gather in large groups to plot their vile plans which likely involve the sinking of ships and the downfall of man in general. The dark nature of the Penguin probably lead to its salty, oily and almost inedible taste. Still the northmen insist that Penguins provide valuable resources which only proves their backward and barbaric character. Considering their cruel and cunning disposition, one can only guess what the Penguins are really up to. Perhaps it was them who have been responsible for the years of the serpents or maybe they are even the driving force behind the maritime quara. Though usually physically weak, the power of their dark god sometimes manifests in the form of a so-called Dire Penguin - a dreadful beast that is known to cut of a grown man's arm with one bite of its beak. Driven by the desire to conquer and to destroy and gifted with incredible strength, it roams the ice in search of prey. This luckily rare monster is an immense threat to all unwary adventurers who approach a Penguin colony…
penguin.beh: They like to fight in close combat.
penguin.strat: Just attack them. To save time, you might want to gather tons of them and kill with an AoE spell/rune.

percht.name: Percht
percht.title: Percht
percht.strat: You can try to stay diagonal of them to prevent their beam attacks, but their GFB attack is the strongest and can't be avoided this way.

phantasm.name: Phantasm
phantasm.title: Phantasm
phantasm.loc: Pits of Inferno, The Inquisition Quest, Deeper Banuta (single spawn, ) and Grounds of Deceit.
phantasm.desc: Phantasms are said to be the dreams of madmen. Abducted from their dreamers on the backs of nightmares, they are unpredictable allies of chaos. Obviously destructive, their complete and absolute madness makes it hard to control them. However, some of the demonlords enjoy their service since their essence is quite close to the souls of mortals that those demons cherish. Some Phantasms are not created by the deeds of demons, but break loose from their mad dreamers by happenings in the world of the mortals or due to things that cannot be understood by those of sane minds. All Phantasms are able to shift from the realm of dreams to the real world and back at will, although their mental disposition makes it rarely a conscious decision. Still their physical form is an illusion and intangible. Their state of existence grants them some ghostly powers that they use to affect minds. Only the most powerful and mad Phantasms exists for a longer time. Their energy constantly leaking away, most of them fade into nothingness after a while if they cannot substitute this energy by stolen life forces.
phantasm.beh: Attacks target and summons weaker phantasms rapidly.
phantasm.notes: Their summoned phantasms have only 65 HP and are immune to Earth Damage, but they can do a lot of damage. Phantasms' boss is Countess Sorrow located in Bazir's throne room.
phantasm.strat: Mages should use energy strikes or energy wave to kill them fast. It is also recommended to shoot GFBs to kill the summons.

phrodomo.name: Phrodomo
phrodomo.title: Phrodomo
phrodomo.loc: Ghostlands, behind the portal , during the Rise of Devovorga World Quest. Can be fought on Vengoth during Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change.
phrodomo.beh: Phrodomo will focus on the enemy with the highest attack until it's death.
phrodomo.notes: All players who deal sufficient damage during the last minute of the fight will receive the Slayer of Phrodomo Achievement. One of its speeches, MORS CERTA, HORA CERTA., is Latin for Death is certain; the hour is fixed.
phrodomo.strat: Physical resistant equipment such as Stone Skin Amulets and Might Rings are a good choice to bring along. It is a good idea to use Magic Walls or Wild Growth runes to trap it. Fire attacks work well so using Firebombs and summoning Fire Elementals can also help a lot. Smaller teams can expect a wait as this creature has a lot of health. Knights can try to block it at level 170 or higher.

pig.name: Pig
pig.title: Pig
pig.loc: Rookgaard, Orc Fort, under Femor Hills with Goblins, some farms like The McRonald's Farm, Liberty Bay slums and Nargor, Foreigner Quarter in Yalahar, Isle of the Kings, cells in Tafariel's throneroom in Pits of Inferno, Gardens of Night ( , unreachable).
pig.desc: Pigs are domestic animals which are kept by farmers. They stem from wild boars and have been raised by humans for a long time to gain meat. They are absolutely peaceable and eat or sleep the whole day. However, the farmers will be upset if you kill one of them.
pig.beh: Pigs don't attack and run from people.
pig.notes: They can be found at farms like the McRonald's Farm, in Thais. Pigs are the best among the creatures whom do not give experience because they almost always drop Meat, good when you have no Mana and you are in hard places (like Nargor), you can trap then with the map geography or some items and kill them. They are slow and walk in groups.

pigeon.name: Pigeon
pigeon.title: Pigeon
pigeon.loc: Streets of Venore, Gardens of Night.
pigeon.desc: The Pigeon has turned into a massive nuisance that plagues most cities. Apparently drawn to the centres of civilisation, Pigeons prosper on the garbage often thoughtlessly thrown away. Every attempt to exterminate the Pigeon has proven futile in the end. The only successful attempt has been made by the Thaian magic guild that had giant crystal spheres hovering atop the Thaian guard towers. The crystal spheres pulsed periodically in all colours of the spectrum and scared the Pigeons away. But the inhabitants of Thais grew deeply annoyed by the flashing lights, and even the claim that the crystals added a unique sight to Thais could not prevent the people demanding their being removed. In the end, the crystal spheres were dismantled and returned to the guild house. Still people complained to the king to do something against the pressing pigeon problem. Yet no bounty nor poison campaigns yielded the result they hoped for.
