Meanwhile, the people have begun to accuse each other of feeding pigeons, and the term 'pigeon friend' has become a common insult. King Tibianus had several people flogged who had claimed the king might be in league with the pigeons, and things are increasingly…
pigeon.notes: This creature was implemented during the Winter Update 2012.
pigeon.strat: You can just kill them, they won't attack you. Or you could leave them be.

pillar.name: Pillar
pillar.title: Pillar (Zugurosh)
pillar.notes: They don't harm your Hitpoints like similar traps.

pillar-of-dark-energy.name: Pillar of Dark Energy
pillar-of-dark-energy.title: Pillar of Dark Energy
pillar-of-dark-energy.loc: Boss rooms of Bakragore, Chagorz, and Vemiath.
pillar-of-dark-energy.notes: It is summoned by Vemiath, Chagorz, and Bakragore. It chains players who stands directly next to it, causing a chain spell that jumps up to 4 SQMs and deals damage according to the fight's characteristics. The chain spell sets 11 stacks to all characters hit by it. The stacks will cause damage per second to the players, each tick decreasing the number of stacks by one. In case a player with stacks gets hit by one of the bosses' beams, all the remaining stacks deal damage to the player at once and the number of stacks is reset.

pillar-of-healing.name: Pillar of Healing
pillar-of-healing.title: Pillar of Healing
pillar-of-healing.notes: When its health hits zero it becomes a Destroyed Pillar. Found during the Carlin Cult of the Cults of Tibia Quest.

pinata-dragon.name: Piñata Dragon
pinata-dragon.title: Piñata Dragon
pinata-dragon.beh: It does not move and cannot be pushed.
pinata-dragon.notes: It was introduced to celebrate Tibia's 20th Anniversary between January 5 and January 31, 2017. When 30 Old Rags are fed to the Sewing Table in Thais these dragons will spawn for one hour at several spots around Thais while also giving an Experience bonus of 15%. The following message will appear right before the Piñata Dragons spawn: :

pirat-bombardier.name: Pirat Bombardier
pirat-bombardier.title: Pirat Bombardier
pirat-bombardier.desc: It takes an unhealthy amount of foolishness or bravery to handle the unstable substance that green powder is. The pirat bombadiers seem to have plenty of both of them. Couple this with a love for fire and explosions and you get the dangerous mixture of which the pirat bombardiers consist. Whenever there is any task that involves fire, destruction and chaos, the bombardiers are the rats to be sent. And they are not shy to volunteer, as after a string of deadly mishaps before the heydays of pirat-dom, they are not allowed to handle their explosives without permission. So whenever they are ordered to employ their deadly weapons, their whole destructive potential is unleashed with glee. It is said that their favourite diet is the very cheese the green powder mold is growing on and over time the oldest bombardiers become explosive on their own. This myth is yet to be verified since the usual bombardiers behaviour isn't suited for a long live and old age. In fact the life of a bombardier is usually short and fiery. Even without bombs the bombardiers are discernable by burn marks, ashed fur and smouldered whiskers. Even without explosives at hand this pirats have a penchant for…
pirat-bombardier.beh: Attacks from a distance. If you get into melee range, they use a strong physical attack, but their weapon breaks after two hits. After that, they only use Energy Damage.
pirat-bombardier.notes: They will only ever make two melee hits.
pirat-bombardier.strat: Be careful of their strong melee attack at the start of the fight. Use Earth Damage against them, and consider using items with Energy Resistance. It is not clear if its chain attack hits more than one player, it may hit players diagonally up to 4sqm.

pirat-cutthroat.name: Pirat Cutthroat
pirat-cutthroat.title: Pirat Cutthroat
pirat-cutthroat.loc: Pirat Mine, The Wreckoning, Krailos Steppe.
pirat-cutthroat.desc: The rank and file crew of the Coyrm pirats consists mainly of cutthroats. Drawn to the seas by promises of cheese and plunder, young Corym join the ranks of the pirats in great numbers. When they realize that the life of a pirat is not the land of cheese and honey that was promised, it's already too late to leave. The sea demands a high death toll amongst the recruits and the crews have to be replenished constantly. Luckily enough for the pirat captains the lure of their promises is strong enough to ensure a steady stream of conscripts so that they simply don't care. Equipped with only the most basic weapons and armour a cutthroat is usually highly depended on his scavenging skills to steal and improvise better equipment, in their desperate battle to survival. A pirats life is cheap and this is employed by their superiors to the fullest. Why waste expensive green powder on an enemy, that can also be brought down is you only throw enough cutthroats against them. Any halve seasoned pirat is aware of this and tries it's best to raise through the ranks, so it will be them, who sends others to their deaths. While there is a lot backstabbing and treachery amongst those most lowly of…
pirat-cutthroat.beh: Fights in close combat. They use a strong physical attack, but their weapon breaks after two hits.
pirat-cutthroat.notes: They will only ever make two melee hits. As they frequently drop ice rapiers, it could be assumed that they use them as weapons, however their melee attacks are 100% physical damage.
pirat-cutthroat.strat: Be careful of their strong melee attack at the start of the fight. Use Earth Damage against them, and consider using items with Energy Resistance.

pirat-mate.name: Pirat Mate
pirat-mate.title: Pirat Mate
pirat-mate.desc: The life of a pirat is often bloody and short. Those who survive more than a few seasons on the high seas become battle hardened veterans and are commonly promoted to more responsible positions. A pirate that acquires such a status will never grew bored in letting their ship mates know about it. As battle-hardened veterans of many campaigns they know how to wield their weapons with a certain amount of skill and finesse and how to use their expendable crews to the fullest. In a crew that has to be ambitious to survive, they have to be the most ambitious and resourceful of the bunch and walk over many corpses on their bloody way to the top. This leaves little space to make any friends though short lived alliances in a common goal are not uncommon. Each alliance ends in a foreseeable backstabbing though. As it isn't wise to keep enemies and competitors alive the death toll amongst aspiring mates is particularly high. Yet this unnatural selection leads to especially skilled and shrewd mates in the long run. The mates have little restraint to further their own agendas by sacrificing loads of underlings if this ensures to reach their goals. Their constant bullying enforces the pecking…
pirat-mate.beh: They use a strong physical attack, but their weapon breaks after two hits.
pirat-mate.notes: They will only ever make two melee hits. As they frequently drop ice rapiers, it could be assumed that they use them as weapons, however their melee attacks are 100% physical damage.
pirat-mate.strat: Be careful of their strong melee attack at the start of the fight. Use Earth Damage against them, and consider using items with Energy Resistance.

pirat-scoundrel.name: Pirat Scoundrel
pirat-scoundrel.title: Pirat Scoundrel
pirat-scoundrel.desc: The pirat scoundrels prefer others to make their paws dirty and rely on distant combat tactics to wear an enemy down. They are usually chosen from the more intelligent and skilled recruits although some pirate captains tend to pick them on a whim. Their usual functions on board of the pirat ships are diverse and a bit more challenging then that of ordinary sailors. As 'specialists' they enjoy a certain amount of status amongst the crews that allows them to fight in the second row. By skill and training they become over time mildly accomplished distance fighters, although their ability is somewhat hampered by their nervous and cowardly behaviour, that invalidates any even slightly more complicated tactics. Without the backup of a hefty amount of cutthroats, the scoundrels quickly become nervous and confused. always eyeing and opportunity for a tactical retreat. Even with the support of fighters their constant shifting and moving has them miss more than one good shot. Their greater survivability is paid by a lower share of the loot. Though in theory they are the same crew rank as the common cutthroats, the latter look with disdain on the scoundrels that in their eyes survive on…
pirat-scoundrel.beh: If you get into melee range, they use a strong physical attack, but their weapon breaks after two hits. After that, they only use Energy Damage.
pirat-scoundrel.notes: They will only ever make two melee hits.
pirat-scoundrel.strat: Be careful of their strong melee attack at the start of the fight. Use Earth Damage against them, and consider using items with Energy Resistance.

pirate-buccaneer.name: Pirate Buccaneer
pirate-buccaneer.title: Pirate Buccaneer
pirate-buccaneer.loc: Nargor, Tyrsung (on the ship), Yalahar (Foreign Quarter), Krailos Steppe and The Cave.
pirate-buccaneer.desc: The Pirate Buccaneer has already proven himself as skilled fighter that often functions as squad leader in raids. He displays an enormous arrogance and loves to bully his underlings. Some Pirate Buccaneers have already gained some fame and they do not feel good at all to stand in the shadow of their captains. They also fear to be outshone by other buccaneers. Usually not loved but feared by their crew members, they often duel each other and always look for an opportunity to exploit any weakness that their captain might show. By getting a good share of the plunder, their equipment is quite good and they usually wield some decent weapons and a good armor. Their daring and skilful manoeuvres impress friend and foe alike.
pirate-buccaneer.beh: Retargets often and will always attack the weakest Player they see and will switch back quickly even if Challenged by an Elite Knight.
pirate-buccaneer.notes: They appear in pirate Raids in small groups of 2 Pirate Buccaneers and 2 Pirate Cutthroats.
pirate-buccaneer.strat: Knights: To kill one of those, it is recommended to have at least 65/65 skills and level 40 or higher. Paladins: A recommended level to be for hunting this creature is level 40 or above with around 75 distance. Just run this creature like any other pirate and make sure you don't run it into another spawn. A shield and a throwing weapon helps to reduce the damage but bolts or arrows can be used too.

pirate-cook.name: Pirate Cook
pirate-cook.title: Pirate Cook
pirate-cook.desc: Pirates are the crime lords of the sea, always seeking to claim the wealth of others. Every ship requires a loyal crew, usually consisting of former sailors, escaped prisoners and treasure hunters alike. Each member has a specific role ensuring the ship remains functional and prepared for battle, even during the harshest conditions on the open sea. Pirate cooks are often inexperienced deckhands or low-ranking sailors seeking new adventures at sea. Food aboard a pirate ship can become scarce and cooks are known to hide sought-after rations from others to avoid hunger themselves. Despite their title, the cook commonly had to perform amputations after battle when no real surgeon is available. This task earned them the feared nickname "sea butcher". Their experience with blades makes them surprisingly capable fighters in close combat.
pirate-cook.notes: Upon dying, there is a chance it will say one of the phrases below and drop one of the corresponding foods: * &frame=0 Cheese: * &frame=0 Fish: * &frame=0 Meat: * &frame=0 Orange: * &frame=0 Roll:

pirate-corsair.name: Pirate Corsair
pirate-corsair.title: Pirate Corsair
pirate-corsair.loc: Nargor, Trade Quarter, Foreigner Quarter (Dock), Krailos Steppe (During a World Change).
pirate-corsair.desc: The Pirate Corsairs are the leaders of the pirates. They command their own ships and rule their crews with an iron hand. Of course, one has to pay the price for having so much power. A Pirate Corsair must always watch his back for vengeful or ambitious crewmen, or for attacks of other corsairs. To climb to such a position of power in a ruthless society like that of the pirates, one has to be remorseless, cunning and lethal. Everybody that had the chance to observe a Pirate Corsair in combat, knows that they did not obtain their position by chance. They are competent fighters that are often accompanied by some henchmen to lead a surprise attack on their unsuspecting opponents. They exploit any weakness of their enemies and use every dirty trick they are able to master. Their fighting skills are backed by their weapons and armor which are, of course, the best the pirates were able to loot during their many years of piracy.
pirate-corsair.beh: They will pursue their opponent while using distance attack with Throwing Stars, they run in very low health and will always attack the weakest Player they see and will switch back quickly even if Challenged by an Elite Knight.
pirate-corsair.notes: The strongest class of pirates you will come across. They look fearsome and can deal a lot of damage if you are not careful. Usually they are found with large groups of other pirates. Deadly as a Vampire, maybe more so level 40+ recommended.
pirate-corsair.strat: If hunting a certain area littered with an assortment of Pirates with Pirate Corsairs there too, make sure the other Pirates run (by hitting them down to an extremely low hp), to avoid being swarmed. Convincing other corsairs in the area can really prove effective as it'll cost less mana and resources to heal them rather than yourself. Mages: Mages should use Flame Strike, Ice Strike or Death Strike with a blocker or solo with mana shield and/or runes to bring them down faster. Watch out when you running after them or away from them, you might encounter more Pirates. Paladins: These should be dealt with care if you are below level 50. While running these creatures make sure you don't run into another spawn of pirates. Take them down as fast as possible; use attack spells if necessary, such as Ethereal Spear, or Divine Missile for less mana usage but mind their slight resistance to holy damage; on that note though, you can also fire at a longer range with Holy Missile. Be careful of their throwing star attacks, if you forget to heal in between hits you might be killed. Using a throwing weapon with a shield helps alot to take less damage; still, they can do 300+ combos with just…

pirate-cutthroat.name: Pirate Cutthroat
pirate-cutthroat.title: Pirate Cutthroat
pirate-cutthroat.loc: Nargor, Tyrsung (on the ship), Yalahar, Krailos Steppe and The Cave.
pirate-cutthroat.desc: The Pirate Cutthroat has often lived a pirate's life for some years. It proves their competence that they managed to survive for so long. On the other hand, the necessity to prove themselves to be invaluable members of the crew put them up to take incredible risks. Reckless against themselves and others, they employ tactics that everyone else would call crazy or suicidal. Eager to rise in the pirates' ranks, they take risks that everybody else would avoid. Their all-out attacks are a product of this attitude as are their usage of highly explosive weapons which are almost as dangerous to the user as to his opponent. Combine this attitude and armament with their love for incredible amounts of alcohol and an ill temper and you get a good impression of the Pirate Cutthroat and the danger he poses.
pirate-cutthroat.beh: Always attacks the weakest Player they see and will switch back quickly even if Challenged by an Elite Knight.
pirate-cutthroat.notes: Large groups should be avoided as the damage adds up quickly.
pirate-cutthroat.strat: They often come in groups of 2 or 3 and can break your shielding very easily. The best way to hunt them is to be in teams or go as a single paladin. A paladin of level 35 or higher can take all pirates easily except for Pirate Corsairs who have nasty Throwing Stars. Pirate Cutthroat's pistol shots (single square explosions) are the only thing a paladin has to worry about and it isn't frequently used. They often miss, as well.

pirate-ghost.name: Pirate Ghost
pirate-ghost.title: Pirate Ghost
pirate-ghost.loc: Drefia, Goroma, Nargor Undead Cave, hidden caves under Treasure Island, Liberty Bay ruins (single spawn), The Cave (single spawn) and Chyllfroest (unreachable).
pirate-ghost.desc: Considering the lifestyle of a pirate, it is no real surprise that several of them end up as cursed souls - never able to acquire some sort of afterlife. Bound to the world of the living, they continue their evil lifework of spreading fear and of murder. Almost impossible to be hurt, they pursue their victims with reckless malice that is frightful on its own. They posses several powers that are common to ghosts, but they seem to be slightly more accustomed and adapted to murder than others of their kind. While other ghosts seem more concerned about themselves and their dire fate, the Pirate Ghost actually seems to enjoy to inflict pain on the living ones. Some say, making others suffer lets them better bear their own misery.
pirate-ghost.notes: These chilling phantoms haunt the underground chambers on Nargor and can also be found on Goroma and Treasure Island. Like their weaker counterparts, Ghosts, they are immune to all physical damage. They offer good experience for Mages, because they are easier to kill in comparison to Undeads like Demon Skeletons. They also give decent loot for the expense.
pirate-ghost.strat: They aren't very fast so you can use runes from a distance (preferably HMMs), while larger groups should be disposed of with well-aimed GFB. Mages will do best with Energy Strike, as this will give better profit than HMMs. Also field spells won't be as effective as on regular Ghosts since they heal quite a lot.

pirate-gunner.name: Pirate Gunner
pirate-gunner.title: Pirate Gunner
pirate-gunner.desc: Pirates are the crime lords of the sea, always seeking to claim the wealth of others. Every ship requires a loyal crew, usually consisting of former sailors, escaped prisoners and treasure hunters alike. Each member has a specific role ensuring the ship remains functional and prepared for battle, even during the harshest conditions on the open sea. The pirate gunner operates the ship's artillery, often requiring a handful of men to operate a single cannon as they were in charge of aiming, firing, resetting, swabbing and loading the cannons. These weapons play a big part in naval battles, where the fight for precious treasure often cost many lives. Not only are these gunmen experts in ship-to-ship combat, they are often skilled at hand-to-hand fighting and also know there way around throwable explosives, which could devastate anything on impact.

pirate-marauder.name: Pirate Marauder
pirate-marauder.title: Pirate Marauder
pirate-marauder.loc: Nargor, Tyrsung, Yalahar, Krailos Steppe, The Cave.
pirate-marauder.desc: Coming from the lowest classes of society, it is easy to recruit those low-life guises into the pirates crews. Often already criminals before their career as a pirate, it is no big step for most of them to live a pirate's life. Lured by tales about freedom and treasuries, they become quickly disillusioned when facing reality. No better than a common bandit on land, Pirate Marauders care little for the health or the lives of others. Due to their living conditions they have turned into bitter and angry people who try to strike back at life by tormenting and suppressing others whenever possible. As weapons they use everything that they can purloin and loot and serves the purpose. Their agility makes up for their lack of armor. Fairly weak and cowardly, it is rather their number than their skill that might pose a threat.
pirate-marauder.beh: They will always attack the weakest Player they see and will switch back quickly even if Challenged by an Elite Knight.
pirate-marauder.notes: Most common kind of Pirate crew you can find on Nargor island. With somewhat stronger attack and weaker defense, Marauders can fall in the same category as Cyclops.
pirate-marauder.strat: They rarely use their weak distance attack so Paladins can kill them easily from afar. Also, Knights and Mages shouldn't have much difficulty except to watch out for being drawn into larger groups (especially by stronger pirates that often wait in the second row) and surrounded.

pirate-navigator.name: Pirate Navigator
pirate-navigator.title: Pirate Navigator
pirate-navigator.desc: Pirates are the crime lords of the sea, always seeking to claim the wealth of others. Every ship requires a loyal crew, usually consisting of former sailors, escaped prisoners and treasure hunters alike. Each member has a specific role ensuring the ship remains functional and prepared for battle, even during the harshest conditions on the open sea. The pirate navigator is responsible for piloting the ship even through the most dangerous of uncharted waters, a task that requires many years of experience, as maps and charts are often unreliable or nonexistent. The whole crew relies on the navigator's expertise in currents, coastlines and astronomy in order to reach their destined treasure without vanishing into the abyss.

pirate-quartermaster.name: Pirate Quartermaster
pirate-quartermaster.title: Pirate Quartermaster
pirate-quartermaster.desc: Pirates are the crime lords of the sea, always seeking to claim the wealth of others. Every ship requires a loyal crew, usually consisting of former sailors, escaped prisoners and treasure hunters alike. Each member has a specific role ensuring the ship remains functional and prepared for battle, even during the harshest conditions on the open sea. The pirate quartermaster serves as the captain's right hand and holds the second most authority. They are responsible for managing resources like food and water and maintaining order among the crew. Therefore, the quartermaster also had the authority to punish members for not obeying commands, in rare cases even resulting in sentencing a troublemaker to walk the plank. In combat, the quartermaster is fighting from a distance while supporting his wounded crew with healing.

pirate-ship.name: Pirate Ship
pirate-ship.title: Pirate Ship
pirate-ship.notes: Fought during part of the 20 Years a Cook Quest.

pirate-skeleton.name: Pirate Skeleton
pirate-skeleton.title: Pirate Skeleton
pirate-skeleton.loc: Nargor Undead Cave, Goroma, Treasure Island, Drefia, The Cave, Chyllfroest.
pirate-skeleton.desc: As cursed as the dreadful pirate ghosts but lacking their willpower, these unlucky former pirates float along the corridors as mindless undead killing machines. While personal guilt or curses of their victims might be the main reason for their sad existence, many of the Pirate Skeletons also own their being to their former captains who changed into powerful ghosts after they lost their human life. Again others are said to be the creation of necromancers or similar dark creatures. Still they seem more accustomed to killing and fighting than several other undead. Having constantly to fear to lose their lives a whole lifetime long seems to have created some fighting instincts that are still present in their old bones. More a mindless machine than anything else, they are rather weak when being on their own. Their threat increases significantly if being accompanied by a pirate ghost. Headed by a pirate ghost, Pirate Skeletons seem to obtain some of the malicious intelligence of their leaders.
pirate-skeleton.notes: They are not very strong because they have rather weak melee and no Life Drain. They give the same exp as Ghouls, but have more hitpoints and little bit more defense. They drop Spooky Blue Eyes which is nice decoration.
pirate-skeleton.strat: Any vocation with the least bit of decent equipment should have no problems facing them as they deal pretty low damage in general.

pixie.name: Pixie
pixie.title: Pixie
pixie.desc: Pixies are small nature spirits and mythical creatures inhabiting the forests and plains of Feyrist. They are generally benign, but at times, they may also display mischievous traits. Like most of the fae, pixies love dancing and are often gathering in larger groups to dance on secluded glades. Pixies are rather small, reaching about the height of a very young human child. They have pointed ears, colourful hair and fragile butterfly or dragonfly wings. These wings give them the ability to fly and a pixie's feet rarely touch the ground. Their clothing consists of fresh leaves and flower petals. Pixies love flowers, butterflies, shimmering beetles, gems and other colourful things as well as the taste of honey, sweetened oat and ripe grapes. Pixies emerge from mortals' dreams about friends and family.
pixie.beh: They keep a distance of about 4 fields.

plagirath.name: Plagirath
plagirath.title: Plagirath
plagirath.loc: Grounds of Plague, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.
plagirath.strat: Do not run to the center of its room to avoid luring too many Disgusting Oozes. The blocker should try to trap it near a wall while the shooters stay distant to avoid the area damage. During the fight, it's recommended to avoid running around since the Disgusting Oozes use a very strong paralyze spell and will constantly spawn around the room. All shooters should attack mainly with Great Fireball Runes in order to kill the summons around the blocker. During the fight, Plagirath will sometimes transform its target into a Bog Raider. When this transformation runs out after about 10 seconds, the transformed player will "explode" receiving 1500 damage and that will also hit the players around him. Since running around the room is not recommended, shooters should stay distant from the blocker and when the transformation happens everyone should make sure they have enough mana and health to take the explosion. Note that once Plagirath dies, the Disgusting Oozes will not disappear, so leaving the boss room must also be done carefully and in an organized manner. Killing the boss near the exit will make this last step safer.

plaguesmith.name: Plaguesmith
plaguesmith.title: Plaguesmith
plaguesmith.loc: Pits of Inferno, Formorgar Mines, Edron Demon Forge (The Vats, The Foundry), Magician Quarter, Alchemist Quarter, Roshamuul Prison, Grounds of Plague and Halls of Ascension.
plaguesmith.desc: There is nothing that pleases the dreaded Plaguesmiths more than rot and decay. These cowardly demons are constantly scheming and plotting to bring despair and diseases to the world of the mortals. They enjoy the painful torments their poisons and plagues inflict on other beings. They rely on a disgusting diet that consists of poisonous, morbid and corrosive fluids. Their main capability lies in the creating of poisons and plagues as well as to transform usually insubstantial things like despair, pain and agony into substantial tools and weapons. Although their physique makes them powerful fighters, their inherent cowardice prohibits them to rise in the ranks of demon kind. They tend to use others to do the dirty work and operate behind the scenes. More often though, they end up forced into the service of a more powerful creature. Still they are rarely seen in the realm of men. More often they stay in the realm of demons and supply their masters and servants alike with new weapons to spread poison and sickness.

plaguethrower.name: Plaguethrower
plaguethrower.title: Plaguethrower
plaguethrower.loc: Stone Tomb and Boreth's room in the Vengoth Castle.
plaguethrower.strat: Run away from them or simply summon a creature immune to Earth Damage.

planedweller.name: Planedweller
planedweller.title: Planedweller
planedweller.beh: Planedwellers move very slow but have a very powerful haste.
planedweller.notes: They are very hard to kill unless they are weakened by using an Old Fanfare or Old Lute on them, which reduces their healing.
planedweller.strat: Weaken them using the old musical instruments and then just attack with the best you got.

planestrider.name: Planestrider
planestrider.title: Planestrider
planestrider.notes: It looks like a cyborg face. When its health gets below 80%, it loses its nose and looks like this: It's a boss of the Opticording Sphere Quest.
planestrider.strat: Stand at a distance and attack.

plant-abomination.name: Plant Abomination
plant-abomination.title: Plant Abomination
plant-abomination.strat: Kill it quickly so it does not heal the boss. If it's not killed after a few seconds it will explode dealing Earth Damage.

poacher.name: Poacher
poacher.title: Poacher
poacher.loc: South of Elvenbane and Ab'Dendriel, Ferngrims Gate, Northeast of Carlin, Edron Hunter Camps, Yalahar - Trade Quarter and Foreigner Quarter, Poacher Caves.
poacher.desc: Several criminals and outcasts of society hide in the wilderness to live on roots, mushrooms, animals and everything else which is somehow edible. Those who survive the first hard months eventually become quite skilled Poachers. Making little difference between animals and humans, they see anything as fitting prey which they manage to kill. Some of them work as pathfinders and trackers for some bandits, others gather in small hunting packs just like wild animals. Again others are loners - close to insanity who turn into beings that the locals call 'wild men'. Poachers can be found almost everywhere. They hunt deer and wolfs in the woods as well as rats and insects in caves. Knowing that travellers posses useful equipment and money, they don't even shrink away from murder and thievery. Poachers have little to lose and often disregard their own safety. Hoping for a lucky shot, they even attack much stronger opponents. Poachers are most dangerous when the victims are taken by surprise while being on a hunting trip. It almost seems as if they could smell the blood of a wounded adventurer as they tend to appear when someone is in a fierce fight with some wild beast. Travelling…
poacher.beh: They shoot arrows while approaching you, and will use melee once they get close enough.
poacher.notes: New creature in the Winter Update 2007.
poacher.strat: Treat them as a weak hunter.

poison-spider.name: Poison Spider
poison-spider.title: Poison Spider
poison-spider.loc: Found in various caves and plains around Tibia (including Rookgaard).
poison-spider.desc: Poison Spiders live in the forests and dungeons of Tibia. They usually hunt small animals, but with their poisonous bite they can even kill animals that are bigger than them. Therefore, and as they always crop up in packs, they are quite dangerous for badly equipped adventurers.
poison-spider.notes: Poison Spiders are a bit stronger than regular Spiders in that they hit harder and can poison you with venom a little stronger than that of a Snake's. It is not advisable to attack one below Level 4. Giant Spiders summon up to two Poison Spiders to break shielding and enable much stronger hits.
poison-spider.strat: Losing one or two Hitpoints per turn due to poison is not worth using an Antidote spell or potion. Just eat Food to counter the poison, even if you are in Rookgaard.

poisoned-raubritter.name: Poisoned Raubritter
poisoned-raubritter.title: Poisoned Raubritter
poisoned-raubritter.loc: Inside the boss room of the Court Warlock.

poisonous-carnisylvan.name: Poisonous Carnisylvan
poisonous-carnisylvan.title: Poisonous Carnisylvan
poisonous-carnisylvan.desc: Carnisylvans were once humans, exposed to a dark ritual at birth they unwillingly abandoned their former lives to morph into tree-like shadow beings. Some time after coming of age they wander away to fall into a neverending slumber deep underground. Standing in pitch-black darkness, sleeping still, dreaming quaint dreams of death they await the time of joint uprising. Some are born to be chosen custodians of their siblings, awake and sentient. Poisonous carnisylvans will spit their venomous guile upon all intruders. Like acid, their demonic saliva is not only toxic but also burns the skin and flesh to the bone.

polar-bear.name: Polar Bear
polar-bear.title: Polar Bear
polar-bear.desc: Polar Bears live at the ice islands in the north-west of Tibia. They are nourished by fish and small animals. They are stronger and more aggressive than their brown cousins. Avoid their powerful stroke and attack them with distance fighting weapons.
polar-bear.notes: They are a bit stronger than Bears.
polar-bear.strat: They are weak, but be careful when they attack in groups if you are low level.

poodle.name: Poodle
poodle.title: Poodle
poodle.beh: It follows you like a Cat or a Dog.
poodle.notes: Can be summoned by players, but doesn't appear to exist by itself.

pooka.name: Pooka
pooka.title: Pooka
pooka.desc: Pookas are nature spirits in animal form, looking like big hares with a faintly glittering fur. They are benign but mischievous, for sure with good reason regarded as the tricksters among the fae. Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. If a traveller talks to a pooka, it may steal something from him or transform him into another creature temporarily. Yet, it is as likely that the pooka offers a present or grants an useful spell. Pookas are capricious and fickle creatures. They can also take the form of human children and as such they often try to fool visitors to Feyrist. However, their human shape includes various animal features, such as ears or a tail. The transformed pooka will try to hide these traits, but observant travelers can tell there is something going on. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and gold. Lately, some pookas on Feyrist are tainted by a mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia. They were transformed into twisted pookas who are chasing their brethren and playing tricks that are outright wicked rather than just prankful.

poor-soul.name: Poor Soul
poor-soul.title: Poor Soul
poor-soul.strat: This creature doesn't deal very high damage, but it will consume charges of Stone Skin Amulets and Might Rings the players will likely be wearing. Make sure a shooter has them and lure them so A Greedy Eye can kill it. For more details on the boss fight, see Soul War Quest.

possessed-tree.name: Possessed Tree
possessed-tree.title: Possessed Tree
possessed-tree.loc: A dungeon , accessible through the Desecrated Glade.
possessed-tree.notes: It looks like a Haunted Treeling. It can be destroyed by the Mounted Thorn Knight in one blow.

preceptor-lazare.name: Preceptor Lazare
preceptor-lazare.title: Preceptor Lazare
preceptor-lazare.notes: It's a boss of the Order of the Falcon. He is Mentioned in Grey Plague Research (Book). Part of The Secret Library Quest.

priestess.name: Priestess
priestess.title: Priestess
priestess.loc: Hero Cave, Drefia ruins, Lich Hell, Tombs, Magician Quarter in Yalahar, Vengoth Castle, Hellgorge.
priestess.desc: Priestesses came to Edron together with the monks. They are also followers of the evil god Zathroth but they roam the dungeons instead of having a home. Like the monks, they will fiercely attack every intruder into their holy realm. They are weak fighters, but have a lot of magic abilities. They shoot magic missiles at their enemies and drain mana off them, summon ghouls as reinforcements, and heal themselves.
priestess.notes: You may hunt 4000 of these along with Necromancers, Blood Hands, Blood Priests and Shadow Pupils as a task for Lugri. Upon completion of the task you will face Necropharus. The task can be repeated several times but only grants you 40,000 experience points from the second time and onwards.

priestess-of-the-wild-sun.name: Priestess of the Wild Sun
priestess-of-the-wild-sun.title: Priestess of the Wild Sun
priestess-of-the-wild-sun.loc: Issavi Sewers, Kilmaresh Mountains, Kilmaresh Catacombs.
priestess-of-the-wild-sun.desc: Once, the inhabitants of Kilmaresh worshipped the two sun gods Suon and Fafnar and attached great importance to the fact that the worship of both deities was always in balance. However, there came a time when a group of Fafnar's adherers became more and more influential and aggressive until this sect postulated the sole worship of Fafnar. This resulted in a religious war between the Fafnar followers and those who fought for the duality of the two sun gods. Ultimately, the war was ended by a major natural disaster that split off the eastern peninsula from the western part of the land mass. This was interpreted as a demonstration of divine wrath. It was rumoured that Suon had shattered the continent in his anger about the humans' misdeeds. From that day on, the old empire was in shambles and the worship of Fafnar is now forbidden in the new empire. But the cult of Fafnar still exists on Kilmaresh, albeit in secret. Her followers go to great lengths to strengthen Fafnar's influence and try to re-establish her worship. To achieve their goals they are not above using either infiltration or violence. The Priestesses of the Wild Sun are a special branch of Fafnar's clerics. They serve…

prince-drazzak.name: Prince Drazzak
prince-drazzak.title: Prince Drazzak

ab.n: Teleports everyone in the room to him

prince-drazzak.loc: Boss pit of Roshamuul Prison ( ), a team of 5 players can enter his room with a Golden Prison Key (north switchplates, ).
prince-drazzak.beh: while wearing 30% Earth Protection.]] Very erratic. At completely random times he will shout , and 5 seconds later he will cast a large area ability dealing massive damage to said vocation(s) while shouting . When he shouts , all players in the room are teleported next to him. His retargeting is also rather frequent.
prince-drazzak.notes: Five people are required to even enter his room in the first place. Apparently, there is a connection between Prince Drazzak and Variphor. You will receive the achievement Noblesse Obliterated after killing this boss.
prince-drazzak.strat: All vocations should wear as much protection against Death Damage as possible, followed by protection against the vocation's element (see abilities). The boss is resistant to damage and heals a lot. Shooters should keep the boss and the blocker and stay on the limit of range to make sure they are outside the Ultimate Explosion range.

professor-maxxen.name: Professor Maxxen
professor-maxxen.title: Professor Maxxen
professor-maxxen.notes: It's the final boss of the Hero of Rathleton Quest.
professor-maxxen.strat: Treat him as a stronger Walker, however be careful with the explosion mechanics of his room.

psychic-spirit-elemental.name: Psychic Spirit Elemental
psychic-spirit-elemental.title: Psychic Spirit Elemental
psychic-spirit-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Monk's part - Spirit Sphere.

putrid-mummy.name: Putrid Mummy
putrid-mummy.title: Putrid Mummy
putrid-mummy.desc: The Putrid Mummy is a stronger and poisonous version of Mummies.
putrid-mummy.beh: They fight in close combat but move very slowly.
putrid-mummy.strat: It's stronger than a regular Mummy. Its high Fire Damage and Holy Damage weaknesses make these elements ideal to use on these creatures. Mages and Paladins under level 200 should watch out for their paralysis since a group of them can be dangerous at this level range.

pythius-the-rotten.name: Pythius the Rotten
pythius-the-rotten.title: Pythius the Rotten (Creature)

ab.r: +20% death damage per turn; last 34~ turns; around 2700 total damage

pythius-the-rotten.notes: The Curse starts at 1 and normally stops after 34~ turns, but if he curses you again the 34 turns starts over from the damage it currently did. So the longer he keeps cursing you the higher the damage will get. The damage increases with 20% each turn. In the turn 34 it will look like this 366 then 439. Some people have died getting hits of 1400+ per turn. In the reward room make sure you heal or use mana shield if the damage is higher than your hp and wear any death protection equipments or you might die. Paladins can simply use Cure Curse to remove it. Also: On the floor under some trash there's a Guardian Shield a Spike Sword and a Knight Axe. If you have the skills you could pick them them up while killing Pythius.
pythius-the-rotten.strat: The room you face it in is large enough to run it. A Poison Bomb Rune can be used at the corner, so that the summoned Undead Gladiator cannot attack you with melee. You need a Golden Mug to reach it.

quara-constrictor.name: Quara Constrictor
quara-constrictor.title: Quara Constrictor
quara-constrictor.loc: Calassa, Frozen Trench underwater sites, Yalahar (Sunken Quarter).
quara-constrictor.desc: The strange Quara Constrictors have kraken or squid like qualities due to manipulations that are found on all members of the quara race. They are quite intelligent and seem to be, together with the quara hydromancer, the leaders of this sinister race. Their tentacles make them dangerous foes. They allow the Quara Constrictor to attack more than one target at once and to grapple or strangle their helpless prey. Using the same abilities like electric eels, they are also able to stun their enemies for a short time. To stand a better chance to defeat them, you should try to fight them on land where they are somewhat weaker than swimming in water. Only few of them exist and since they are somewhat cowardly by nature, you don't meet them too often in combat. If forced to fight, they are quite capable to defend themselves. They often surprise their enemies with dirty tricks and an iron resolve. This subspecies seems to be somehow responsible for modifying and altering the other quara. How exactly this is done and to which extent the Quara Constrictor is involved in these transformation processes is unknown.
quara-constrictor.beh: Quara Constrictors are slow, and run away at 30 hp. Sometimes they use more than two of their abilities at once.
quara-constrictor.notes: It is a fusion of quara and a squid. After update 8.5 they became profitable (they drop more gps now). You may hunt 600 Quara Constrictor, Quara Hydromancer, Quara Mantassin, Quara Pincher, Quara Predator combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Thul.
quara-constrictor.strat: Kill them first as they are the weakest among other Quaras but deal a lot of damage with magical attacks. Since they're slow, shooters won't need much space to run. Knights: Try to avoid other quaras and just melee it. Exori if you are surrounded by 3 or more quaras. Mages: You can take it down pretty quickly with energy strike and HMMs, but be ready to cast a healing spell. Paladins: Attack from distance or use shield and throwing weapon.

quara-constrictor-scout.name: Quara Constrictor Scout
quara-constrictor-scout.title: Quara Constrictor Scout
quara-constrictor-scout.loc: Malada, Arena Quarter, Treasure Island Eastern Caves, Hrodmir Quara Scout Caves, Quara Grotto, Oramond.
quara-constrictor-scout.desc: The Quara Constrictor Scout is a weaker version of Quara Constrictors.
quara-constrictor-scout.notes: A weaker version of Quara Constrictors. This monster can be seen during raids on Liberty Bay. You may hunt 400 Quara Constrictor Scouts, Quara Hydromancer Scouts, Quara Mantassin Scouts, Quara Pincher Scouts and Quara Predator Scouts combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
quara-constrictor-scout.strat: Paladins: They are easy to kill from distance. Mages: Use energy strike. Knights: Their defence is very low and they deal quite low damage.

quara-hydromancer.name: Quara Hydromancer
quara-hydromancer.title: Quara Hydromancer
quara-hydromancer.desc: Although less altered than the other quara subspecies, the Quara Hydromancer poses no smaller threat. People often underestimate them for their bloated bodies. However, their strength lies not in exotic body traits but in their dark minds. They are the priests and witchdoctors of the quara. Their legacy is the dark magic of their long extinct masters. Although their power is only a fraction of the power that once ruled the murky depths of the ocean, it is still enough to be more than a match for the unsuspecting adventurer. The only chance of a more balanced fight is to challenge them ashore where they are somewhat weaker than in their maritime habitat. They wield powerful curses with ease and they can combine their sinister powers for old, forbidden rituals that call upon darkness and doom to do their bidding.
quara-hydromancer.beh: Quara Hydromancers fight until death. They use paralyze pretty often which can be deadly, considering you are already very slow underwater.
quara-hydromancer.notes: As the magic user of the quaras, it wields powerful cold bubble attacks which deal Ice Damage. In addition, it uses distance Life Drain and a Life Drain beam. You may hunt 600 Quara Constrictor, Quara Hydromancer, Quara Mantassin, Quara Pincher, Quara Predator combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Thul.
quara-hydromancer.strat: All vocations should stay diagonal. Knights: should run up to it and use a good two handed weapon and full attack because of the Hydromancers weak defense and melee. Stay diagonal to avoid its beam attack. Heal if paralyzed. Mages: should run out of its range and use Energy Strike/Terra Strike. Paladins: should run away from it, hitting it with Bolts or Royal Spears. Be careful though, you might run into other Quaras.

quara-hydromancer-scout.name: Quara Hydromancer Scout
quara-hydromancer-scout.title: Quara Hydromancer Scout
quara-hydromancer-scout.loc: Malada, Hrodmir Quara Scout Caves, Quara Grotto, Oramond.
quara-hydromancer-scout.desc: The Quara Hydromancer Scout is a weaker version of Quara Hydromancers.
quara-hydromancer-scout.beh: Watch for their healing ability since they heal themself at average level.
quara-hydromancer-scout.notes: Has the same life, gives the same exp and has the same magic power as the normal Quara Hydromancer, but loot has a lower drop chance. You may hunt 400 Quara Constrictor Scouts, Quara Hydromancer Scouts, Quara Mantassin Scouts, Quara Pincher Scouts and Quara Predator Scouts combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
quara-hydromancer-scout.strat: They are easy to handle one-on-one but you rarely find them without others. Big groups of Quara occasionally raid. Liberty Bay or the plantations. All vocations: stay diagonal to avoid beam attacks. Paladins: try to keep distance and use Light Healing to remove paralysis. Mages: keep a distance and use energy strike. It is also recommended to use Mana Shield if fighting in close quarters with this creature. Knight: Kill them fast or their exori-like attacks and their beams will hurt you quite a lot.

quara-looter.name: Quara Looter
quara-looter.title: Quara Looter
quara-looter.desc: Quara Looters occupy the lowest rung of Quara society, seen as impure and tainted by their own kind, shunned and reviled, forced to eke out a desperate existence in small, roving bands or by allying themselves with less discerning Quara. Their tragic fate often leads them to serve as expendable shock troops for their Plunderer overlords, who treat them with only a modicum of respect. Quara Looters are a pitiable breed, forever caught in a web of prejudice and exploitation, yet they persevere, driven by the faint hope of finding a better life amidst the darkness. They vent their frustration and pain in fits of violence and senseless cruelty. While bowing only to strength and violence, they will harrass and exploit any creature they consider more weak than themselves.
quara-looter.notes: Quara Looter casts a chain damage to players and its damage is calculated based on how many players it hits. The more players it hits, the more damage it will deal. Because of that it is considered the most dangerous quara in Podzilla as it can deal unexpected high damage to those running in the area as a group.

quara-mantassin.name: Quara Mantassin
quara-mantassin.title: Quara Mantassin
quara-mantassin.desc: The shrewd Quara Mantassins are often not recognised until it's too late. Like all quara, they have undergone massive modifications of their bodies which have made them an own subspecies. Especially in their native, maritime habitat, they are masters of camouflage and disguise. However, also on land they are known for stealthy sneak attacks. But away from their natural element, the water, they are weaker and easier to defeat. Usually they serve their race in special operations and they are the ones that target the leaders of their enemies in big battles. With an arsenal of tricks the Quara Mantassin are quite capable on their own. Their love for covert operations gives them their place in the quaran warfare but they are not seen too often in open battles. On the other hand, a Quara Mantassin that you do not see is four times deadlier than a Quara Mantassin that you do see.
quara-mantassin.beh: This creature is extremely fast upon using haste, and runs away at 40 hp. It casts invisibility quite often also.
quara-mantassin.notes: Quara Mantassins are used to destroy the leaders of the Quaras enemies (which basically means all non-quara and Hydro-Elementals) ranks, and are also used as spies and assassins for special operations. You may hunt 600 Quara Constrictor, Quara Hydromancer, Quara Mantassin, Quara Pincher, Quara Predator combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Thul.
quara-mantassin.strat: This type of quara does not pose any major threat to an experienced player with the right runes and equipment, since its melee attack is relatively weak. Knight: you should wait for them to get to you, and simply use melee with full attack and a shield. When it turns invisible use Groundshaker, Whirlwind Throw, or Thunderstorm to get it visible again or just wait because the invisibility lasts for a short amount of time unless it casts it again. Mages: should use energy based attacks. If it runs away in deep red, shoot it with Heavy Magic Missile or area runes. It's safe to fight two at once, provided you're ready to cast a healing spell. Paladins: should use shield and a throwing weapon as Mantassins are very fast and if you use crossbow or bow it could cause you significant damage.

quara-mantassin-scout.name: Quara Mantassin Scout
quara-mantassin-scout.title: Quara Mantassin Scout
quara-mantassin-scout.loc: Malada, Water Elemental Cave near Port Hope, Hrodmir Quara Scout Caves, Quara Grotto.
quara-mantassin-scout.desc: The Quara Mantassin Scout is a weaker version of Quara Mantassins.
quara-mantassin-scout.notes: This monster can be seen during a quara raid in Liberty Bay. An easier version of Quara Mantassins. You may hunt 400 Quara Constrictor Scouts, Quara Hydromancer Scouts, Quara Mantassin Scouts, Quara Pincher Scouts and Quara Predator Scouts combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
quara-mantassin-scout.strat: Paladins: Just kill them, or you can use them so they block other quaras way so they can't reach you and you can kill the stronger quaras first. Mages: Use energy strike and always try to keep a distance and don't run into other quaras. Knight: They are very easy to kill, they deal low damage and their defense is low.

quara-pincher.name: Quara Pincher
quara-pincher.title: Quara Pincher
quara-pincher.desc: Transformed into a living and walking fortress, there is little a Quara Pincher has to fear. Seemingly unstoppable, they attack stoically without remorse or hesitation. It is rumoured that the grip of their pincers can break a good sword into pieces. Being aware of the facts that they are somewhat clumsy and rather simpleminded, gives one an advantage whenever fighting a Quara Pincher. Another chance to win a fight against them is to duel them ashore where they are much weaker than in water, their natural habitat. Quara Pinchers are usually encountered along with other quara who probably serve as their superiors and leaders. In larger battles the Quara Pinchers fortify the positions of the troops and provide cover for the other quara while they move forward.
quara-pincher.notes: Hard to get down because of its heavy armor. It is the slowest of the quaras, equal to the speed of a lvl 95-100 (without Boots of Haste). You may hunt 600 Quara Constrictor, Quara Hydromancer, Quara Mantassin, Quara Pincher, Quara Predator combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Thul.
quara-pincher.strat: Paladins: Run while firing HMMs or Divine Missiles. Mages: A level 75+ can kill it without Mana Shield, using Energy Strike or Terra Strike and healing spells. This is risky though, especially if you face more than just the single pincher. Knights: Use your best spells to kill them fast since they can hurt a lot.

quara-pincher-scout.name: Quara Pincher Scout
quara-pincher-scout.title: Quara Pincher Scout
quara-pincher-scout.loc: Malada, Hrodmir Quara Scout Caves, Quara Grotto, Oramond.
quara-pincher-scout.desc: The Quara Pincher Scout is a weaker version of Quara Pinchers.
quara-pincher-scout.notes: It has very strong defense against physical attacks, but they are very slow. It has half the hit points and yields half the experience of the regular Quara Pincher. This monster can be seen during Liberty Bay Quara raids. You may hunt 400 Quara Constrictor Scouts, Quara Hydromancer Scouts, Quara Mantassin Scouts, Quara Pincher Scouts and Quara Predator Scouts combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
quara-pincher-scout.strat: Paladins: Run around and shoot spells or runes to kill them fast. Mages: Use energy strike or runes. Knights: Their armor and defense is high, the highest among all quara scouts. You'll need a good weapon and high skills to even hurt them. They also deal high damage (in relation to other quara scouts).

quara-plunderer.name: Quara Plunderer
quara-plunderer.title: Quara Plunderer
quara-plunderer.desc: Quara Plunderers are opportunistic and cunning outcasts who thrive on chaos and exploitation. Having their vile temper better under control than most of their kind, they are able to engage in strategic planning and even negotiations. Often amassing small bands of fellow outcasts, these plunderers use their wicked intellect and innate cruelty to launch devastating raids against their targets. Within the depths, Quara Plunderers are feared for their ability to capitalize on the weaknesses of their adversaries, taking advantage of any opportunity to seize wealth and power. Their relentless ambition and brutal tactics make them a formidable foe in the tumultuous world beneath the waves. It's not unheard of for plunderers to turn on their employers in moments of weakness.

quara-predator.name: Quara Predator
quara-predator.title: Quara Predator
quara-predator.loc: Calassa, Frozen Trench, Sunken Quarter, Alchemist Quarter (unreachable), The Inquisition Quest, Seacrest Grounds.
quara-predator.desc: Even more bloodthirsty than the other quara and even feared by their own kind for their murderous frenzy, Quara Predators are usually found in the first lines of a battlefield whenever the quara decide to fight their sworn enemies (which basically means all non-quara). Obviously a mixture of quara and sharks, they share the most disgusting and most lethal attributes of both. Ruthless and vicious they know no mercy and no surrender. Quara Predators are known to fight until the last spark of life leaves their bodies. Sometimes they even fight against each other after slaying all enemies in sight.On shore they are somewhat weaker, losing their speed and agility, but their huge jaws are still fatal.
quara-predator.notes: Bloodthirsty Quaras that even fight other Quaras after a battle. They look like a shark. You may hunt 600 Quara Constrictor, Quara Hydromancer, Quara Mantassin, Quara Pincher, Quara Predator combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Thul.
quara-predator.strat: This creature's melee damage is equivalent to that of a Behemoth. Be careful if you are running them because they are very fast when they haste. Paladins: can solo them at level 70 using Poison Walls or at 120 by running around objects. Mages: can kill them using Energy Strike while a knight blocks, or solo at level 80 using poison walls. Knights:not a very good creature for knights to solo. Use Challenge frequently if you are blocking as it retargets often. Casting Inflict Wound early helps a lot. Cycle between using Brutal Strike and Whirlwind Throw to get the creature down as cheap as possible. Also watch out for other quaras that might break your shielding! Nowadays Quara Predators are very easy to kill because of the introduction of energy imbuements and elemental melee weapons.

quara-predator-scout.name: Quara Predator Scout
quara-predator-scout.title: Quara Predator Scout
quara-predator-scout.loc: Malada, Hrodmir Quara Scout Caves, Quara Grotto, Oramond.
quara-predator-scout.desc: The Quara Predator Scout is a weaker version of Quara Predators.
quara-predator-scout.notes: This monster can be seen during the quara raid on Liberty Bay. They look like a shark. You may hunt 400 Quara Constrictor Scouts, Quara Hydromancer Scouts, Quara Mantassin Scouts, Quara Pincher Scouts and Quara Predator Scouts combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
quara-predator-scout.strat: Predator scouts are a bit weaker than pincher scouts. Paladins: can kill them by running and shooting bolts and runes or royal spears and divine missile. They are easy to kill from a distance. Mages: can kill them with Energy Strike. Knights: Their defense is quite low so you will hurt them often but you will need some time to kill them due to their high amount of hit points.

quara-raider.name: Quara Raider
quara-raider.title: Quara Raider
quara-raider.desc: Quara Raiders are the embodiment of unbridled greed and savagery, even among their own ruthless kin. These crab-like creatures possess a hardened exoskeleton and immense strength, making them a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. Their insatiable lust for wealth and bloodshed has led to their exile from Quara society, leaving them to roam the depths in search of plunder. As mercenaries, Quara Raiders are employed to strike fear in the hearts of the enemy. Their sheer ferocity makes them difficult to control or employ in any subtle tactics. Cunning employers often attempt to contain their fury, only unleashing these terrifying creatures upon their enemies when the time is right.

quara-saboteur.name: Quara Saboteur
quara-saboteur.title: Quara Saboteur
quara-saboteur.notes: Part of the Journey mission of A Pirate's Tail Quest.
quara-saboteur.strat: Do not let them attack the Raccoon Supplies, make sure there's a knight to Challenge them away.

queen-nostalgia.name: Queen Nostalgia
queen-nostalgia.title: Queen Nostalgia (2)
queen-nostalgia.notes: This creature can only be seen during the Tibia's Anniversary.
queen-nostalgia.strat: Lure it to the bridge, otherwise it will heal itself completely after every assigned hit. Explosive Barrels can be used to kill these monsters.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.title: Rabbit
rabbit.loc: In most grass areas of Tibia, for example on Tutorial Island.
rabbit.desc: Rabbits live in the meadows and forests of Tibia where they are nourished only by blades of grass. People often hunt these absolutely peaceable and very shy animals for their skins from which tanners can make fine clothes. But you must be very quick in order to catch them.
rabbit.notes: In the days surrounding the Easter holiday, rabbits can also drop Blue, Green, Purple, Red and Yellow Coloured Eggs. Before 2006, rabbits dropped regular Eggs around Easter. They no longer drop these. Fresh Dead Rabbits can be sold to Tom in Rookgaard for 2 gp.
rabbit.strat: They are very easy to kill, even for the most inexperienced Tibians. It may help to use the chase opponent button as they will always try to run away from you. You can use a Kitchen Knife or Obsidian Knife in its corpses during the Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest and the daly task Lucky Charms, in order to get 0-2 Rabbit's Foot.

radiant-acolyte.name: Radiant Acolyte
radiant-acolyte.title: Radiant Acolyte
radiant-acolyte.desc: Acolytes represent those newly drawn into the influence of the cult, still adapting to its structure and expectations. Though not yet fully attuned, they already display signs of change in both demeanor and perception. Their confidence often exceeds their experience, suggesting a strong reliance on belief rather than skill. They are encouraged to observe and emulate those above them, gradually aligning themselves with the cult's ideals. In time, those who endure may advance beyond this stage.

radiant-inquisitor.name: Radiant Inquisitor
radiant-inquisitor.title: Radiant Inquisitor
radiant-inquisitor.desc: Inquisitors are entrusted with identifying flaws within both individuals and the environment. Their scrutiny goes beyond the obvious, as if they are trained to perceive subtle inconsistencies others would overlook. They employ controlled applications of power, focusing on precision rather than excess. Among the cult, they are both respected and feared, as their judgment is rarely questioned. Those who come under their attention seldom remain unaffected.

radiant-paragon.name: Radiant Paragon
radiant-paragon.title: Radiant Paragon
radiant-paragon.desc: Paragons are regarded as exemplars of the cult's teachings, shaped through discipline and unwavering belief. Their actions are deliberate, almost ceremonial, as if each movement serves a purpose beyond combat. They do not waste effort, nor do they act without intent. Among the cult, they are often seen as proof that the path of devotion leads to refinement. Facing one can feel less like confronting an opponent and more like being measured against an unseen standard.

radiant-templar.name: Radiant Templar
radiant-templar.title: Radiant Templar
radiant-templar.desc: Templars act as the disciplined arm of the cult, tasked with maintaining stability in uncertain conditions. Their movements are controlled and efficient, leaving little room for hesitation or error. They rely on coordination and consistency rather than brute force, making them difficult to overwhelm. Within the cult's structure, they are valued for their reliability and endurance. Their presence often marks areas where order must be upheld without compromise.

radiant-warden.name: Radiant Warden
radiant-warden.title: Radiant Warden
radiant-warden.desc: Radiant Wardens serve as enforcers of order wherever they are stationed. They move with measured precision, reacting swiftly to anything that deviates from the expected pattern. Their behavior suggests constant observation rather than simple vigilance. It is said that they are trained to recognize even the smallest irregularities, as if guided by a deeper understanding of the cult's doctrine. Those who draw their attention rarely remain unnoticed for long.

radiant-zealot.name: Radiant Zealot
radiant-zealot.title: Radiant Zealot
radiant-zealot.desc: Zealots embody absolute conviction, acting without hesitation or visible doubt. Their dedication appears to remove the need for caution, allowing them to commit fully to their purpose. They are often found at the forefront of conflict, where their resolve is most apparent. Within the cult, such individuals are seen as proof of unwavering faith. Encounters with them are marked by intensity, as they rarely retreat once engaged.

radicular-totem.name: Radicular Totem
radicular-totem.title: Radicular Totem
radicular-totem.notes: These totems cannot be killed. Their attacks are always used clockwise, with warning beams being used a few seconds before the earth wave. The totem has a counter next to its name which increases when creature dies next to it, and each stack makes the next wave 10% stronger. Waves from this totem can be blocked using Magic Wall Runes.

rage-squid.name: Rage Squid
rage-squid.title: Rage Squid
rage-squid.desc: In the psionic gifted race that in a lack for a better term in spoken language were dubbed 'Squids', strange and unfamiliar casts were created. One of the lowest casts are used as a kind of dumpster for unwanted and disturbing thoughts and emotions. Those unfortunate squids are forcefully filled with thoughts and emotions that are no their own. Picked from the ranks of the weakest and most instable of the squid race they soon fall victim to madness while their minds are more and more shattered. Even in this state the broken being, no longer comprehending what's happening to them are further used and flooded with foreign brain patterns. A good part of the caste withers away and dies in the process. Some though mysteriously manage to survive. Over time their own frustration and anger adds up with those that are dumped into them and this dangerous mixture is only contained by a more and more fragile mind. Sooner or later those minds just snap. This is usually noticed by their handlers far in advance and the unfortunate creatures are extracted to undergo a gruesome procedure to alter their minds and brain pattern. After all the lobotomys and inductions there is little left over then…
rage-squid.strat: Use a lot of Fire Damage protection when hunting them. Be careful with the Ink Blobs around the spawn and if possible trap them outside of your hunting route. Blockers must be very careful when in front of them due to their cross-shaped spell that deals a lot of Fire Damage and can be used at the same time as the Strike and Bersek or Fireball.

ragiaz.name: Ragiaz
ragiaz.title: Ragiaz
ragiaz.loc: Grounds of Undeath, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.
ragiaz.beh: When you defeat one of his Death Dragon summons before reaching the Bone Capsule stage, it will immediately respawn with the message .
ragiaz.strat: After a certain amount of damage, he becomes a Bone Capsule in order to regenerate (20k-50k? hp), so kill the capsule quickly.

raging-fire.name: Raging Fire
raging-fire.title: Raging Fire
raging-fire.notes: These are encountered in the narrowing lava room.
raging-fire.strat: You must kill these and use their bodies (on?) with the limited time and space you have. For the first wave, you have 60 seconds to kill 6; for the second, you have 50 seconds to kill 5; for the third, you have 40 seconds to kill 4. 30 seconds after killing the third wave you will be teleported to the next area and receive the achievement Go with da Lava Flow.

raging-mage.name: Raging Mage
raging-mage.title: Raging Mage
raging-mage.beh: Fights in close combat. Tries to escape when his health drops to red.
raging-mage.notes: Was introduced in the Summer Update 2011, through The Mage's Tower World Change, see the world change page for details.

raging-raubritter.name: Raging Raubritter
raging-raubritter.title: Raging Raubritter
raging-raubritter.loc: Inside the boss room of the Court Warlock.

rahemos.name: Rahemos
rahemos.title: Rahemos
rahemos.beh: Malicious, he will make all efforts to destroy intruders.
rahemos.notes: Rahemos, a great conjurer, was sentenced to be locked away, after his part in the conspiracies against the pharaoh. He is guarded by a Warlock and a Magicthrower. He spawns even with players in his room. One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.
rahemos.strat: He uses strong magic attacks, so use blockers to run around him and distance fighters to fire on him. Due to his high magic resistance and notable weakness to physical damage, it is highly recommended for mages to use Explosion runes (Druids can combine this with Physical Strike). Higher level knights can easily solo Rahemos with a couple of quick Fierce Berserks, Front Sweeps and an Annihilation spell. A Demon Skeleton can be summoned to draw attention from the Magicthrower as well as deal extra damage to Rahemos.

rat.name: Rat
rat.title: Rat
rat.loc: Rookgaard and Mainland, in most sewers and caves near towns. They can be found almost everywhere in Tibia.
rat.desc: Rats live in the sewers of each town, in holes, and in dungeons. Cropping up in masses they are a real plague, and the governments pay head money for dead Rats. They are quite weak, but in packs they can be dangerous for badly equipped adventurers.
rat.beh: Rats attack at a close range using Melee.
rat.notes: You can also sell dead rats to NPCs Seymour, Billy and Tom on Rookgaard for additional cash. Also Baxter in thais buy rats for 1gp. It is said that rats are Servants of Urgith. Looks the same as a Ghost Rat.
rat.strat: Any Vocation: Just attack them, they shouldn't be a problem to a level 8+ (if it isn't a raid). No Vocation: Be careful with them, if many rats come to you, try to stand in a place where only 1 or 2 rats can attack you and try to avoid getting trapped by them.

raubritter-chastener.name: Raubritter Chastener
raubritter-chastener.title: Raubritter Chastener
raubritter-chastener.desc: In the heyday of the order, the Stags were a ragtag bunch of all kinds of scoundrels, daredevils. Not only did they have a firm code of honour, they also adhered to strict rituals and cultivated a powerful magic school. The chasteners were the prime keepers of the lore and magical heritage of the Order of the Stag. In heated battles and conquests across the lands of Tibia, they were the first line of defense conjuring devastating elemental spells and erecting powerful magical shields while also leading the charge at the turn of many a battle, when morale was low and the flesh weak.

raubritter-marksman.name: Raubritter Marksman
raubritter-marksman.title: Raubritter Marksman
raubritter-marksman.desc: Even before the dark influence of the warlock, the ranged skills of these marksmen were unmatched while their cunning prowess in battle saved the order countless times. As hard as the arrows of raubritter marksmen hit, the speed of their swift attacks prevents countermeasures and forces adversaries into their defence. Opening such tactical windows, these snipers allowed fellow knights to fall in quickly and press the attack. Through the spells of their dark master, they became even more dangerous: high-powered fighting machines, unscrupulous and far from feeling pain the way a human does.

raubritter-skirmisher.name: Raubritter Skirmisher
raubritter-skirmisher.title: Raubritter Skirmisher
raubritter-skirmisher.desc: Once proud knights of the Order of the Stag, these battle-hardened veterans are tough and experienced. When the warlock was marshalling his puppet forces, these relentless warriors formed the forefront. Spearheading most of the attacks on the bastion of the order, these skirmishers are often the first and the last terrifying sight of a poor guardsman standing watch during the onslaught. Once they locked-in on an enemy, they are hard to get away from and even harder to bring down. Due to the warlock's spells, they are not only controlled to willingly fulfill his every request but also further protected against a variety of physical and magical attacks.

ravenous-lava-lurker.name: Ravenous Lava Lurker
ravenous-lava-lurker.title: Ravenous Lava Lurker
ravenous-lava-lurker.loc: Gnome Deep Hub in the Gnomish area.
ravenous-lava-lurker.notes: Not only are these creatures immune to Fire, they actually get healed by it. Their relatively low power relative to their experience reward makes them popular targets for players who are focused entirely on gaining experience, regardless of waste.
ravenous-lava-lurker.strat: Mages can avoid their melee attack by blocking them off using a Crate or Parcel. Using Avalanche Rune as they often come in groups.

raxias.name: Raxias
raxias.title: Raxias
raxias.loc: On the small island just north of Feyrist.
raxias.notes: It's a Faun micro-boss. You may face it if you shipwreck when taking a shortcut route with captain Charles from Port Hope to another city.
raxias.strat: Treat it like a slightly stronger Faun. If you are a low level, stay diagonally and use a Dwarven Ring to avoid getting Drunk.

razzagorn.name: Razzagorn
razzagorn.title: Razzagorn
razzagorn.loc: Grounds of Destruction, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.
razzagorn.strat: When he summons Eruption of Destructions kill them first, otherwise Razzagorn becomes stronger.

reality-reaver.name: Reality Reaver
reality-reaver.title: Reality Reaver
reality-reaver.desc: Unless other creatures from beyond, the Reality Reaver seems to follow regular patterns of behaviour, as it does not cause the random destruction in the same way that others of its kind do. However, just because the Reality Reaver possesses a form that follows predictable patterns to an extend which other beings do not, it is not yet in possession of sentience. This being said, the Reality Reaver is just as malignant as the rest of its ilk. However, it has certain characteristics that are more often found in ordinary creatures, whereas the other "newly created" are closer in nature to a tornado or a wildfire. For instance, it has been reported that it creates small flocks of its own kind in order to attack in a pack. Still, even a single Reality Reaver is a force to be reckoned with. The Reality Reaver seems somewhat more stable than the rest of its kind. While the others regularly dissolve and re-form, even in the realm beyond, the Reality Reaver is more anchored in our reality and with that, one step further towards our plane of existence. It cannot be foreseen what this means for our future. Whether or not the current crisis can be averted, one thing is certain; an invasion of…
reality-reaver.beh: Often goes invisible out your visual range, pay attention to your surroundings so it won't sneak on you.
reality-reaver.notes: Those that are located outside around the vortexes, do not yield any experience points.
reality-reaver.strat: It's strongly advised to wear as much Energy Damage protection as possible, most of the damage dealt by Extra Dimensionals creatures comes from this element. Otherworld monsters also deal a lot of Life Drain damage, so you should also consider wearing a Garlic Necklace or Necklace of the Deep and put a Bone Fiddle in the extra slot.

realityquake.name: Realityquake
realityquake.title: Realityquake
realityquake.beh: He spawns after defeating Foreshock and Aftershock.
realityquake.notes: A boss in the Heart of Destruction Quest.

redeemed-soul.name: Redeemed Soul
redeemed-soul.title: Redeemed Soul
redeemed-soul.loc: Tainted Caves in the Green Claw Swamp (under the right conditions).
redeemed-soul.desc: If someone knows how to free a tainted soul he may transform it into a redeemed soul. Souls delivered in such a way are by all means thankful towards their liberator. Unlike the aggressive tainted souls, they are not only peaceable but even timid, wherefore they leave quickly and vanish shortly after their liberation.
redeemed-soul.beh: It avoids combat and doesn't attack in any way. Its strong healing capabilities will heal it back to full health every time.
redeemed-soul.strat: Don't bother fighting them unless you want to complete its Bestiary entry or gain Weapon Proficiency. They run, don't attack and give no loot, so they shouldn't cause many problems. Be mindful that they vanish 30 seconds after spawning, are resistant to physical damage and self-heal frequently, so they might despawn before you can kill them if you don't use elemental damage.

reflection-of-a-mage.name: Reflection of a Mage
reflection-of-a-mage.title: Reflection of a Mage
reflection-of-a-mage.notes: It's somehow related to the Raging Mage and very similar to it in power. It is part of the Opticording Sphere Quest.
reflection-of-a-mage.strat: It's very weak and shouldn't pose any threat if you are planing on killing the other bosses that spawn in the same room.

reflection-of-mawhawk.name: Reflection of Mawhawk
reflection-of-mawhawk.title: Reflection of Mawhawk
reflection-of-mawhawk.notes: It's somehow related to the Mawhawk and very similar to it in power. It is part of the Opticording Sphere Quest.
reflection-of-mawhawk.strat: Treat it like a regular Mawhawk, though the fight should be easier without the summons and other Guzzlemaws.

reflection-of-obujos.name: Reflection of Obujos
reflection-of-obujos.title: Reflection of Obujos
reflection-of-obujos.notes: It's somehow related to Obujos and very similar to it in power. Part of the Opticording Sphere Quest.
reflection-of-obujos.strat: Treat it like you would with Obujos. You'll need a level 250+ Elite Knight to block it and must be careful with its combos. It retargets often, but you can trap it between the glass walls north of the room to stop it from moving, as long as the blocker can take the wave damages. Highly recommended to bring a teammate because of the fast healing.

regenerating-mass.name: Regenerating Mass
regenerating-mass.title: Regenerating Mass
regenerating-mass.notes: It's Nargol the Impaler's regenerating mass during the Grave Danger Quest.
regenerating-mass.strat: Trap the location where it spawns before hand and then deal as much damage as possible, you only have 30 seconds to kill it or the boss will respawn.

rejana.name: Rejana
rejana.title: Rejana (Creature)
rejana.notes: Appeared during Tibia's 15th and 20th Anniversary celebrations as well as on January 7 and 8, 2018 (unintended), in a raid at a random time once a day. The following message will appear: Then, 20 minutes later she will spawns:

renegade-knight.name: Renegade Knight
renegade-knight.title: Renegade Knight
renegade-knight.loc: Old Fortress (north of Edron), Old Masonry, Forbidden Temple (Carlin)
renegade-knight.desc: By far not all renegade knights are truly knights at all. Though several of them were indeed once knights that for one reason or another fell into disgrace, a greater number of them is recruited by henchmen of aforementioned knights who 'knighted' them on the field. Though in no way having a valid claim on that title, they are still called that way even by their enemies. Over time, the number of sellswords and ruffians outgrew that of the original knights, but as the degradation of the latter continued, too, often the differences vanished completely. Renegade knights tend to give their bands flashy titles and keep up the pretension of a knightly order, even though their traditions are rather a cruel mockery of the original concepts of such orders. What all renegade knights have in common is usually a lot of combat experience, regular training and decent weapons and armor. Usually, they behave no better than ordinary bandits if not even worse, depending of the ideals of their chosen 'order' which might involve torture and sacrifice to some dark powers. Though rarely encountered alone, they seldom fight in a battle formation, and prefer to engage enemies aggressively on their own,…
renegade-knight.strat: It's practically just a Hero with a slightly different set of resistances.

renegade-orc.name: Renegade Orc
renegade-orc.title: Renegade Orc
renegade-orc.loc: Zao Orc Land in the basement of the northern fort.
renegade-orc.notes: This creature was added with the Christmas Update 2009. Part of An Uneasy Alliance Quest.
renegade-orc.strat: Knight and Paladin must have skills over 65/65, better if 75/75, so you don't risk wasting. And use the same strategy like for an Orc Leader.

renegade-quara-constrictor.name: Renegade Quara Constrictor
renegade-quara-constrictor.title: Renegade Quara Constrictor
