renegade-quara-constrictor.loc: Seacrest Grounds when Seacrest Serpents are not spawning.
renegade-quara-constrictor.strat: Treat it as a regular Quara Constrictor.

renegade-quara-hydromancer.name: Renegade Quara Hydromancer
renegade-quara-hydromancer.title: Renegade Quara Hydromancer
renegade-quara-hydromancer.loc: Seacrest Grounds when Seacrest Serpents are not spawning.
renegade-quara-hydromancer.strat: Treat it as a regular Quara Hydromancer.

renegade-quara-mantassin.name: Renegade Quara Mantassin
renegade-quara-mantassin.title: Renegade Quara Mantassin
renegade-quara-mantassin.loc: Seacrest Grounds when Seacrest Serpents are not spawning.
renegade-quara-mantassin.strat: Treat it as a regular Quara Mantassin.

renegade-quara-pincher.name: Renegade Quara Pincher
renegade-quara-pincher.title: Renegade Quara Pincher
renegade-quara-pincher.loc: Seacrest Grounds when Seacrest Serpents are not spawning.
renegade-quara-pincher.strat: Treat it as a regular Quara Pincher.

renegade-quara-predator.name: Renegade Quara Predator
renegade-quara-predator.title: Renegade Quara Predator
renegade-quara-predator.loc: Seacrest Grounds when Seacrest Serpents are not spawning.
renegade-quara-predator.strat: Treat it as a regular Quara Predator.

retching-horror.name: Retching Horror
retching-horror.title: Retching Horror
retching-horror.loc: All over the surface of Upper Roshamuul and Nightmare Isles.
retching-horror.desc: The Retching Horror is an abomination of dreams, twisted and contorted. It feeds on smaller dreams and creatures like a parasite, creeping up on them and swallowing them whole. Retching Horrors do not digest their prey, but absorb it, building it into themselves and perverting everything about it, trying to block out the eternal pain they are suffering, but only adding to it with every new victim. Occasionally, they cough up horrible diseased dreams and pains, items, flies, arrows; and if they wish, they speak with different voices to ensnare and terrify their prey. Their fingers are live white worms that they use to plunge into living flesh and suck out body fluids, filling the victim afterwards with their own chitinous glue before swallowing it. Their mouth is surrounded by pallid tendril-feelers that they use to sniff out particular delicacies, and they can smell prey several miles off. As their flesh is raw, they dislike being touched, being constantly in pain, and so keep a little distance to their victims.
retching-horror.strat: Similar to a Choking Fear, with which they are often in company. Might look strong from its many abilities, but rarely utilizes half of them. Knights are best suited to deal with these.

retros-treasure.name: Retros Treasure
retros-treasure.title: Retros Treasure
retros-treasure.notes: Appears after defeating Lord Retro and holds the loot.

rewar-the-bloody.name: Rewar the Bloody
rewar-the-bloody.title: Rewar the Bloody
rewar-the-bloody.notes: It's part of the final battle of the Grave Danger Quest.
rewar-the-bloody.strat: The challenge during the fight against Rewar is keeping it vulnerable. If one of the Fetters is alive, the boss will not take any damage, thus the Fetters must be killed as quickly as possible. The best way to do this is to position the players in a way that the boss never moves when it change forms and also that both Fetters get hit simultaneously when a Great Fireball Rune is thrown at the center of the room. This way, damage to one of them will always be dealt when the runes are thrown and no attack turns will be wasted.

rhindeer.name: Rhindeer
rhindeer.title: Rhindeer
rhindeer.desc: The Rhindeer are impulsive creatures that are just as easy to scare as they are to fall into severe fits of rage. The mix-up of species of such a vastly different mindset hasn't done any good to their state of mind. They are, however, highly territorial creatures that will defend their turf aggressively. While in theory mostly consisting of herbivores, aside from their human part, they display an unexplainable amount of cruelty and aggression. They establish a kind of pecking order in their herds and bully weaker creatures into submission. On the other hand, the subordinance of the other herd's leader guarantees the loyalty of their herd too. In the social order of Ingol, that has been established by Dr. Marrow and his assistants, the Rrihndeers function as heavy workers as well as soldiers, guardsmen and police force. Their subordinance to the boar men has led to resentments of the former to the latter and often leads to violent clashes that the boar men only leave victorious because the rihndeers in lieu cooperate and coordinate better. Curiously enough due to an unexplainable oddity in their physiology, the rindeers are very fond of sugar and sweets. Yet their body reacts to…

ribstride.name: Ribstride
ribstride.title: Ribstride
ribstride.loc: Ankrahmun Peninsula Tomb, on the 6th floor ( ). You will need a Scarab Coin to pass through the teleporter.
ribstride.notes: Bonebeast's boss. Part of the Paw and Fur Society tasks of Grizzly Adams. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. The portal which leads to the boss is in -6 floor of the Peninsula Tomb (after teleport - you'll need a Scarab Coin), [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 129.85-128.32-13-2-1-1 here]. You can find different interesting objects in his cave, such as: a Delicate Vase daily spawn, Strange Carving, Hieroglyph Banner, Pharaoh Banner, Hieroglyphs, Carving of a Scorpion, Scorpion Pillar.

rift-brood.name: Rift Brood
rift-brood.title: Rift Brood
rift-brood.notes: Summoned by Azerus in the final room of the In Service of Yalahar Quest.

rift-invader.name: Rift Invader
rift-invader.title: Rift Invader
rift-invader.notes: Apppears in the Ferumbras' Ascension Quest.

rift-scythe.name: Rift Scythe
rift-scythe.title: Rift Scythe
rift-scythe.notes: Summoned by Azerus in the final room of the In Service of Yalahar Quest. In Fenrock after the teleport for the quest Shadows of Yalahar Quest.
rift-scythe.strat: Similar to Grim Reapers, with its strong beam attack you should stay diagonal.

rift-worm.name: Rift Worm
rift-worm.title: Rift Worm
rift-worm.notes: Summoned by Azerus in the final room of the In Service of Yalahar Quest, Fenrock after the teleport for the quest Shadows of Yalahar Quest.
rift-worm.strat: Kill them first, because of the annoying mana drain.

ripper-spectre.name: Ripper Spectre
ripper-spectre.title: Ripper Spectre
ripper-spectre.desc: The Dire Spectres arrived as phantoms to this world. Born from dark fragments of lost souls, they are not bound to this plane, nor do they have a past. They long for a physical existence and their sole goal is to anchor themselves to our world. They are literally pure evil woven from bad spare parts of souls and feed on the life energy of any living creature. The most powerful dire spectres are the oldest. Those who clung to this plane for long enough, eventually gained adequate power to control and coordinate other spectres. Those are the most dangerous and resourceful and should be treated with the utmost care. Ripper Spectres are most dangerous at close-range. They pack a mean punch and will make you rethink the term "phantom" when engaging with any of their kind.
ripper-spectre.beh: Fights in close combat. Reflects Earth Damage. Does not change target unless challenged or its way is blocked.

risen-soldier.name: Risen Soldier
risen-soldier.title: Risen Soldier
risen-soldier.notes: It supports the bosses of the final battle of the Grave Danger Quest.

roaming-dread.name: Roaming Dread
roaming-dread.title: Roaming Dread
roaming-dread.desc: Of all necromantic bone constructs, few are as unstable, or as terrifying, as the Roaming Dread. It's a grotesque colossus reanimated from the remnants of a long-lost race. Its bones glow with a sickly green shimmer, as if charged with volatile necromantic energies. The creature's frame is barely held together, twitching and lurching with each step, as though collapse or detonation were imminent. Some scholars of the dark arts even claim, the Roaming Dread was not merely reanimated, but reforged from bones and corrupted shadows.

roaring-lion.name: Roaring Lion
roaring-lion.title: Roaring Lion
roaring-lion.loc: Lion's Rock a few floors down.
roaring-lion.desc: Lions are beasts of prey that dwell in the deserts and savannahs of Tibia. They live together in prides and are dangerous predators, because they are very quick and try to kill their prey with a single bite. The lion is a popular symbol of royalty as well as of courage and bravery. The Roaring Lion fits this image perfectly. This majestic and powerful animal is a special type of lion that prefers to dwell in caves and ruins rather than in the desert. Not only are they bigger and stronger than ordinary lions, they also vary in appearance and behavior. Their fur has a golden shimmer and their eyes remind of shiny jewels. Also they act in a more intelligent way when preying and therefore are more dangerous than the customary lion. Some sages think the Roaring Lions are a sort of mystical beings from olden times because they are so often found in the ruins of ancient sanctuaries or buried temples. Whether they are the wardens of these sacred sites or were themselves a subject of worship is a secret that has still to be revealed.
roaring-lion.strat: All Vocations be at least Level 40+ as you will also be running into Ancient Scarabs. It is recommend for Mages & Paladin to bring energy bomb/walls as the Roaring Lions & Ancient Scarabs must walk around it.

roaring-water-elemental.name: Roaring Water Elemental
roaring-water-elemental.title: Roaring Water Elemental
roaring-water-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Paladin's part - Ice Sphere.

robby-the-reckless.name: Robby the Reckless
robby-the-reckless.title: Robby the Reckless
robby-the-reckless.notes: Part of the Bank Robbery Mini World Change. Robby is the thief that robs the Carlin bank.
robby-the-reckless.strat: Just kill him. He's not very strong.

rocko.name: Rocko
rocko.title: Rocko
rocko.notes: One of the Isle of Strife Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

rocky.name: Rocky
rocky.title: Rocky
rocky.notes: Greenhorn challenger. ← #7 Axeitus Headbanger #8 Rocky #9 Cursed Gladiator →
rocky.strat: Knights: melee it, he should not be a problem since he doesn't do much damage. Paladins: run around shooting. Druid/Sorcerer: Use your fire or death rod/wand while running around or Flame Strike it. He isn't really fast and he doesn't do much damage. It behaves like a normal Gargoyle.

rogue-naga.name: Rogue Naga
rogue-naga.title: Rogue Naga
rogue-naga.loc: Boss room of Timira the Many-Headed.

ron-the-ripper.name: Ron the Ripper
ron-the-ripper.title: Ron the Ripper
ron-the-ripper.loc: Pirate Raids, spawning in the eastern fortress. Task Boss -
ron-the-ripper.notes: One of the Pirate Raid leaders, he's the responsible for invading the fortress located east from Liberty Bay. You get a chance to kill him in the Killing in the Name of... Quest after killing 3000 pirates for Raymond Striker. The teleporter is located [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 124.233-128.85-1-4-1-1 here].
ron-the-ripper.strat: Knights should use Berserk or Fierce Berserk. If you see there are too many players fighting to kill the boss, focus all your attacks on him and try to get the most Experience to loot the Ron the Ripper's Sabre.

rootthing-amber-shaper.name: Rootthing Amber Shaper
rootthing-amber-shaper.title: Rootthing Amber Shaper

ab.n: Chain (Decreases with increasing number of targets hit)

rootthing-amber-shaper.desc: Amber Shapers are the priestly caste of a race of plant creatures that dwell within a colossal, living plant. They are human-sized beings that have dedicated their lives to the collection and shaping of the sacred resin produced by their gargantuan home. This resin is the lifeblood of their species, and the Amber Shapers use it to craft the most prized religious artifacts of their kind. Lesser, flawed amber is used in the creation of tools and other mundane items and furniture. Revered as the spiritual and artistic elite of their plant people. They dwell within chambers carved from the colossal plant itself, adorned with layers of amber that resonate to the giant plant with a low hum. These chambers are sanctuaries of tranquility, filled with the sweet fragrance of sap and the soft murmur of the living plant. Unlike their more physically-inclined brethren, Amber Shapers rely on their magical prowess in battle, casting powerful spells to fend off threats. They are crucial to the spiritual and material well-being of their kind, and the mastery over the precious amber through their deep connection with the natural world.

rootthing-bug-tracker.name: Rootthing Bug Tracker
rootthing-bug-tracker.title: Rootthing Bug Tracker

ab.n: Chain (Decreases with increasing number of targets hit)

rootthing-bug-tracker.desc: Bug Trackers are the versatile workforce of the plant people, occupying the roles of hunters, gatherers, and farmers within their peculiar society. Although they are human-sized beings, their forms are more insectoid, allowing them to fulfill their tasks with unmatched efficiency. These adaptive creatures possess a unique connection to the complex network of flora and fauna that thrive within their colossal plant home, enabling them to locate the most abundant resources and hunt down any potential threats. They maintain the delicate balance of their ecosystem, ensuring that their people have a steady supply of food and materials. When not tending to their duties, they hone their skills in combat, preparing to protect their civilisation from harm.
rootthing-bug-tracker.notes: Rootthing Bug Tracker casts a chain damage to players and its damage is calculated based on how many players it hits. The less players it hits, the more damage it will deal. Because of that it is considered the most dangerous rootthing in Podzilla as it can deal unexpected high damage to those running in the area, or luring creatures when team hunting.

rootthing-nutshell.name: Rootthing Nutshell
rootthing-nutshell.title: Rootthing Nutshell
rootthing-nutshell.desc: Nut Shells are the formidable guardians of the plant people, serving as the fighter caste within their intricate society. Standing taller and broader than their brethren, these living fortresses boast an incredibly dense, bark-like exoskeleton that provides unparalleled protection from harm. From a young age, Nut Shells are groomed to become the pinnacle of strength and resilience, undergoing rigorous training to hone their combat skills. As the first line of defense against any threats to their colossal plant home, Nut Shells are equipped with a variety of natural weapons and armor. Their powerful limbs can deliver crushing blows, while sharp, thorn-like protrusions provide formidable offense and defense. With unyielding determination, Nut Shells stand ever-vigilant, ready to lay down their lives for the safety of their people and the preservation of their amber-centered civilization.

rorc.name: Rorc
rorc.title: Rorc
rorc.loc: Rorc Plains and in the Rorc version of the Forsaken Mine.
rorc.desc: The rorcs are the creation of a power-hungry orc shaman who used water of Ashar'tel stolen from the forest furies, to emulate their fearsome strength and fury in his own warriors. His nomad tribe of orcish raiders employed a tamed variety of terrorbirds as mounts. The careless usage of the mystical water somehow mutated and fused rider and mount to a fearsome new creature, an entirely new breed of orcs, the rorcs. The shaman's delight was short lived as the changed minions were not amused by their treatment. They used their newfound prowess and scorn to overthrow and supposedly kill the shaman. Since then, the rorcs have sought out recognition by their orcish brethren. Some inherent urge drove them to seek out their own flock and reunite with them. Other orcs first greeted them with contempt. But after a first attempt of extermination failed miserably at the claws of the rorcs, the orcish warchiefs began to reconsider. For now, the rorcs are grudgingly allowed to live at the fringes of orcish territory in an uneasy alliance with their brethren. If the rorcs can prove their worth, they might be allowed to join the orcish ranks and bolster their armies. If the two breeds separate,…

rot-elemental.name: Rot Elemental
rot-elemental.title: Rot Elemental
rot-elemental.loc: Rathleton Sewers, Glooth Factory, Lower Rathleton, Oramond/Western Plains, Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon
rot-elemental.desc: The so called rot elemental is of course out of the scale of normal elemental classification. Though it shares several attributes with other elementals, it lacks other distinctive features and instead has in those areas more in common with spirits or even the undead. As a matter of fact, the existence of rot elementals is another phenomenon, connected to the necromantic smog of the Rathleton area but it could be encountered at other sites that were soaked with necromantic energy at one time. Actually the ghostlands and the plains of havoc are places that have seen at least manifestations of such creatures although up to today none of them endured for a longer time. So there are obviously other facts at work in the creation and stabilization of rot elementals. As far as modern science knows, the elementals are created at sites with a considerably number of waste and carrion. This fact is disputed by the theory that the manifestation just seeks out the greatest concentration of such matter rather than needing a certain amount of it. Be it as it may, some kind of spirit is drawn to such places and makes itself felt by and overwhelming presence of decay. Mould grows extremely fast and…
rot-elemental.strat: Treat them like somewhat stronger Water Elementals.

rotspit.name: Rotspit
rotspit.title: Rotspit

ab.n: Poison Bomb hit on a target

rotspit.notes: One of the Hive Bosses Part of the War Against the Hive Quest
rotspit.strat: Separate it from other monsters and simply kill it. It's not too strong alone.

rotten-golem.name: Rotten Golem
rotten-golem.title: Rotten Golem
rotten-golem.desc: Though technically actual golems, there seems to be no creator connected to them. Now and then the golems could be observed appearing from seemingly nothingness. They show an intelligent design but seem to lack a specific purpose. The unknown creator, if existent at all, has yet to be identified. Some speculate this creator might be some avatar of rot and decay, somehow connected to the feared pale worm, that is still stuck in its infancy. The rotten golems are seen as the first, mostly purposeless actions of this enigmatic entity. Given their destructive and malignant nature this does not bode well for the nature of its nascent creator. The golems roam certain areas of Zarganash which are ripe with rot and decay, providing an ample and fertile ground for their creation. Their behaviour is aggressive and malignant, yet more sustained by a curious cruelty than any direct malevolence. While only spotted rarely in the past, sightings of rotten golems have become more and more common recently, though their appearance seems to be limited to certain areas that they prefer. A greater spread of the rotten golems is nothing to dismissed though, given that there seems to be an increase of…
rotten-golem.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.

rotten-man-maggot.name: Rotten Man-Maggot
rotten-man-maggot.title: Rotten Man-Maggot
rotten-man-maggot.desc: Sharing a connection with its bloated counterpart, the Rotten Man-Maggot is a revolting creature held together by additional layers of rot and decay. Its body, a macabre tapestry of putrid flesh and decomposing matter, seems on the verge of disintegration. Foul-smelling gases seep from its decaying form, creating a noxious cloud that precedes its arrival. Like a grotesque puppet, the Rotten Man-Maggot moves with a sickening gait, its movements accompanied by the squelching of decayed flesh. Its jagged, skeletal appendages lash out with surprising speed, fueled by an unholy strength drawn from the very rot that binds its form. It is a macabre testament to the twisted nature of the fallen realm, embodying the horrors that lurk within its darkest corners.

rottie-the-rotworm.name: Rottie the Rotworm
rottie-the-rotworm.title: Rottie the Rotworm
rottie-the-rotworm.loc: May spawn in the Poison Spider cave or in the Katana Quest on Rookgaard. Seems to spawn often but for short periods of time.
rottie-the-rotworm.beh: Weaker than a Rotworm. Does not push objects nor kill weaker creatures. It is not immune to earth, therefore you can kill it with poison arrows.
rottie-the-rotworm.notes: Boss monster that sometimes spawns on Rookgaard, introduced in Summer Update 2009.
rottie-the-rotworm.strat: This creature is very similar to Rotworm.

rotworm.name: Rotworm
rotworm.title: Rotworm
rotworm.loc: Almost everywhere, like Ancient Temple, Vandura, Folda dungeon, Fibula Dungeon, caves connecting Edron and Cormaya, Venore Swamp Troll cave, Thais Troll cave, Ferngrims Gate, Dwarf Mines, Hellgate, below the graves in eastern Rookgaard, spider cave in western Rookgaard, cave northeast of Ab'Dendriel, Darashia Rotworm Caves, Liberty Bay, Fenrock, below Green Claw Swamp and some other places.
rotworm.desc: Rotworms are a very ancient race that lives in the dungeons of Tibia. They dig in the earth and wait for unconscious victims which they devour in one piece. In packs they are quite dangerous even for experienced adventurers.
rotworm.beh: Rotworms move slowly and have no distance attack, so they are not very deadly unless you are surrounded. In large groups they can be dangerous.
rotworm.notes: This is the most commonly hunted monster in Tibia and you will never be very far from a rotworm cave. You can buy rotworms from Humgolf in Kazordoon, although you need a drilling license to do so. Also common for training at lower skill levels.
rotworm.strat: If you cannot kill them fast or withstand attacks from several rotworms at once, never let yourself get trapped in a corner, as you cannot push rotworms. Really easy to hunt for all Vocations. Druids and Sorcerers can hunt them easily with Snakebite Rod or Wand Of Vortex because these use very little Mana and rotworms drop food so you can constantly regenerate. Knights and Paladins can hunt them with no great trouble even at 30/30, but low-leveled characters (for example players at level 8 who can't use Exura or Exura Ico yet) should be careful not to get trapped, as rotworms are not pushable. These vocations also often use rotworms for training, but they may quickly become insufficient because of their weak defense. If you are in Rookgaard, do not hunt them alone without good equipment like Chain Armor, Legion Helmet and a Copper Shield. It also helps to bring parcels (or boxes, while in Rookgaard) with you, since then you can take only one or two at a time by blocking them with objects.. Using Bow or Spears instead of melee is also a good strategy.

rotworm-queen.name: Rotworm Queen
rotworm-queen.title: Rotworm Queen
rotworm-queen.loc: Darashia Rotworm Caves (around ), Edron Rotworm Cave (around ), Liberty Bay - Rotworm Cave (around ), Hellgate (around ).
rotworm-queen.beh: Acts much like a Carrion Worm. Appears with 2 Carrion Worms and 3 Rotworms.
rotworm-queen.notes: The strongest version of a Rotworm, it seems to spawn randomly in Rotworm and Carrion Worm Caves. The Sacred Casket (Book) says that the substance inside the Jewel Case (Nomad) can potentially attract these creatures, as it has already proven to attract regular Rotworms and Carrion Worms. This is a reference to the Dune series of books wherein desert-dwelling sandworms, on which rotworms are based, are heavily attracted to melange spice. Despawns after 2 hours.
rotworm-queen.strat: No strategy needed. Treat it like a Carrion Worm. Recommended to be level 16 before trying to kill one.

rukor-zad.name: Rukor Zad
rukor-zad.title: Rukor Zad

ab.n: Distance Fighting with Poison Arrows and Throwing Stars

rukor-zad.loc: Dark Cathedral, in the room with the Demon Trophies, .

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.title: Rupture
rupture.notes: One of the bosses in the Heart of Destruction Quest.
rupture.strat: Every few minutes during the fight, Rupture will summon a Damage Resonance. When he does, immediately stop attacking him and focus on killing the Resonance, since every time he is hit while the Damage Resonance is spawned will cause him to gain several thousand hitpoints back. For this same reason, do not use damage over time effects on him (such as Inflict Wound), since these hits will also cause him to heal.

rustheap-golem.name: Rustheap Golem
rustheap-golem.title: Rustheap Golem
rustheap-golem.loc: Workshop Quarter, Glooth Factory, Underground Glooth Factory, Oramond Dungeon (depending on Magistrate votes), Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon.
rustheap-golem.desc: Another curious side-product of the so called necromantic smog that often plagues the Rathleton area, the rustheap golem is seemingly somewhat of the mutated poltergeist. Whereas a poltergeist usually haunts a specific place as invisible force that moves unliving objects, in this case the poltergeist seems to be fused with several items of scrap and litter into an undead creature that never had lived at all. Obviously this process is extremely painful for the poltergeist as is the whole further existence as rustheap creature. It seems that rotting and decaying objects over the time become charged with more and more necromantic residue energy, that they become spiritually sticky for some forms of spirits. Those imbued parts of junk eventually stick themselves to an unwilling spirit host and attract even more imbued junk over the time until the whole spirit soaked into a pile of necromantic junk. Thereby the poltergeists that are usually bound to a place or an object become mobile on their own but under the price of constant pain and strain as they feel their new junk body decay. Their answer to their misery is usually to lash out at everyone they might encounter. It is said that…
rustheap-golem.strat: It might be a good idea to bring a Garlic Necklace or Necklace of the Deep to counter their strong Life Drain attacks. Knights and Paladins are best suited to deal with these, as they are weak to Physical Damage. Diagonal is advisable to avoid their waves.

sabretooth.name: Sabretooth
sabretooth.title: Sabretooth (Creature)
sabretooth.desc: This huge cat would have been an apex predator at any other place. In Gnomeprona it's just another hunter, competing for food and sometimes ending up as such for other, even more vicious predators. Yet the sabretooth adapted quite well to the harsh environment, having numerous litters of kits frequently and being very protective towards their offspring, the predatory cats don't take long to reach adulthood. The young sabretooth's are extremely agile, fast and stealthy. Still a lot of them fall prey to one of the other primal hunters. Despite all their abilities and the protection provided by their mother, only a small fraction of them reaches adulthood at all. A fully grown Sabretooth, however, often lives a long life and has astonishing regenerative abilities that let them survive wounds that would have left other creatures dying or maimed. As such wounds still leave their distinctive marks, some of the more recognizable cats could be re-recognized and thereby verified to reach relatively long life spans. As the first expeditions to Gnomprona are a relatively recent things further date on that matter had to be gathered though. They tend to have small lairs hidden deeply in…

sacred-snake.name: Sacred Snake
sacred-snake.title: Sacred Snake
sacred-snake.loc: Dawnport, inside a dungeon at the southern beach.
sacred-snake.notes: Similar to the Snake, but it has loot and cannot be pushed by players.

sacred-spider.name: Sacred Spider
sacred-spider.title: Sacred Spider

ab.n: Poisons you up to 4 hp per turn

sacred-spider.strat: These spiders are relatively strong, so be cautious when you're a lower level. They use their poison spit very often, which makes it tricky even for Knights to kill it.

salamander.name: Salamander
salamander.title: Salamander
salamander.loc: Venore swamp area, Venore Salamander Cave, Drefia.
salamander.desc: The Salamander is a creature that is quite common in swamp areas. In this harsh environment only the most aggressive and capable individuals can survive, so that the relatively harmless Salamander has evolved into a creature that can scare off at least some attackers. However, a Salamander is still an easy prey and so it often relies on the protection granted by its colouring. The diet of the Salamanders are smaller insects that are often found in abundance in their habitat. Only this allows for the continued survival of the Salamander species while surrounded by more powerful predators. The Salamanders are considered very distant relatives of the dragons, an assumption that is based solely on the fact that they are lizards and have a penchant to collect hoards. The so-called 'hoards' of the Salamanders usually consist only of a few shiny things they have gathered in the swamp, typically junk discarded or lost by adventurers in the area. Still, sometimes they are hunted by foolhardy soldiers of fortune who dream about an easy way to acquire some exotic treasure. Due to their tasting odd, Salamanders are hunted by trolls and orcs for food when times are dire. Sometimes local…
salamander.strat: Similar to but considerably weaker than Larvas.

salamander-trainer.name: Salamander Trainer
salamander-trainer.title: Salamander Trainer
salamander-trainer.notes: It presumably trains the Salamanders on Dawnport. Its name and abilities suggest it has an important role, but it isn't involved in any of the quests.
salamander-trainer.strat: It has massive defense, so knights will struggle to damage it, especially with its fast healing. Mages have an advantage here. It is a good creature to train skills on.

sand-brood.name: Sand Brood
sand-brood.title: Sand Brood
sand-brood.notes: They will spawn at 4 points in the room during the phase when Sand Vortexes are active. They look the same as Larvae and can be enraged.
sand-brood.strat: Just kill these as fast as possible. Be careful when Sand Vortex are close by if doing area damage. 9 of these must be killed to make The Sandking reappear. It is recommended to push their corpses to the walls so The Sandking won't heal as easily.

sandcrawler.name: Sandcrawler
sandcrawler.title: Sandcrawler
sandcrawler.loc: Zao Steppe, Raging Mage tower, Ankrahmun Desert, Darashia Desert, Drefia.
sandcrawler.desc: The Sandcrawler originates from the coasts of some remote small isle. Once confined to this isle, the semi-aquatic insect became an accidental traveller on ships which restocked their supplies on this isle. This led to the spreading of Sandcrawlers all over the known world. Extremely adaptive, they are mainly encountered in sand areas and despite their semi-aquatic nature, they are often found in the seemingly hostile climate of deserts and other desolate places. The Sandcrawler can endure extreme climates and periods of starvation with ease. They are not overly aggressive but they also know no fear. When they focus on one thing, their efforts are relentless and untiring. They usually do not prey on bigger creatures, and there is no aggression in their attacks, just frightening determination. Since they do not build huge colonies but rather live in small groups, it is wise to destroy each nest entirely to prevent further spreading of these creatures. Although they usually live in sandy areas, they often also move to more fertile areas. In their recklessness, they often cause much harm, and only a few Sandcrawlers can destroy a whole field.
sandcrawler.notes: Because the Sandcrawler Shell is required to prepare the Pot of Blackjack during the Hot Cuisine Quest, Sandcrawlers can be worthwhile to hunt, as their shells may sell for up to 10,000 - 20,000 during the event.

sandstone-scorpion.name: Sandstone Scorpion
sandstone-scorpion.title: Sandstone Scorpion
sandstone-scorpion.desc: The scorpion was the symbol of the ancient dynasties of the southern desert. For the early civilisation it was the embodiment of war and deadliness. The symbol of the scorpion is found at many different sites. Statues of scorpions used to be quite common in temples. Ancient mystics filled some of these statues with actual spirits of scorpions, or at least with something of what they thought to be such spirits. The repeated binding of spirits into the statues granted them some resemblance to living scorpions. Even when the mystics disappeared, the Sandstone Scorpions persisted. Forgotten in ancient tombs, they endured the ravages of time. Since every grain of sand in the statues is imbued with spirit energy, the sandstone bodies can be destroyed but not killed. Given some time, the seemingly dead body will crumble into sand that moves with a wind that no other can feel to some place where it will reform its former body to continue its existence. The poison they use is rather spiritual than physical. The study of this poison led to the refinement of antidote magic as we know it today. Instead of countering poison with the help of regenerative powers as it was custom practice in the…
sandstone-scorpion.notes: Can be tamed by using a Scorpion Sceptre on it. These creatures typically come in groups.

scar-tribe-shaman.name: Scar Tribe Shaman
scar-tribe-shaman.title: Scar Tribe Shaman
scar-tribe-shaman.notes: They are a weaker Orc Shaman.
scar-tribe-shaman.strat: Try to trap it so that it cannot lure you into more creatures. It may be a good idea to kill melee creatures before killing the shaman

scar-tribe-warrior.name: Scar Tribe Warrior
scar-tribe-warrior.title: Scar Tribe Warrior
scar-tribe-warrior.notes: They are a weaker Orc Warrior.

scarab.name: Scarab
scarab.title: Scarab
scarab.loc: Ankrahmun Tombs, the sand around Ankrahmun (use a shovel), deep in Larva Caves, the path leading to Chor, beneath Fenrock, Lion's Rock, Mother of Scarabs Lair.
scarab.desc: The Scarab is in general associated with buried secrets and wisdom, which made this beetle an important religious symbol for the city of Ankrahmun. Typically found in their underground lairs, they also inhabit sacred places such as temples or tombs. Scarabs protect their charge with ferocious intent. They will attack anyone who dares to intrude their area and will not relent until the threat is eliminated. Their shells are immensely hard and sometimes weapons might get caught in their chitinous armor. They are able to concentrate their poison in a deadly cloud of nauseating fumes that especially cover their retreat if overwhelmed.
scarab.beh: Scarabs will push or kill weaker creatures in its path, like larvae.
scarab.notes: There is a small chance killing a Scarab will spawn a Scorpion in its place, if Horestis has been recently killed during The Mummy's Curse World Change. When this happens, the message " " will appear.
scarab.strat: Knights At around lvl 25 with skills 55/50 with healing when required. Paladins At around lvl 20 With skills 55/45 these can be quite good exp as long as you're not cornered too often. Mages might do better to avoid them because of the very poor Exp/HP Ratio, however could be a good and cheap option if mages hunt them with Wand of Inferno or Underworld Rod.

scarlett-etzel.name: Scarlett Etzel
scarlett-etzel.title: Scarlett Etzel
scarlett-etzel.kind: Members of the Order of the Cobra

ab.n: Poison Ultimate Explosion when damaged in the locked state

scarlett-etzel.notes: She is a daughter of Cadwgan Etzel and Ansegild. She is a sister of Oberon and Kesar Etzel, and a half-sister of Eldoran Etzel. She is the leader of the Order of the Cobra.
scarlett-etzel.strat: Scarlett is initially immortal. In order to maker her vulnerable, you have to use the Galthen's Chestplate which appears on a trophy stand near the throne. When you do that, Scarlett will stop moving and become vulnerable for 8 seconds. There is a faster way to dealing damage to her, however: Scarlett will take 7500 damage if she's attacked while the four mirrors around her are facing her. Note that she will also use her Ultimate Poison Explosion at the same time, dealing 7500 Earth Damage to the players around. Only one player should attack her, however, since she will instantly become invulnerable and attacking Scarlett Etzel when she is not vulnerable will heal her in 5000 hitpoints. Thus, the recommended step by step for beginners is: # Lure Scarlett away from the mirrors you will use (preferably to the south) and run back to "lose" her. # Throw Galthen's Chestplate to the center of the mirrors. # Rotate (use) the four mirrors so they face the center of the square where Scarlett is. # Lure Scarlett back to the mirrors and quickly use Galthen's Chestplate. # Wait a couple of seconds to make sure she already stopped moving, then move away and attack her once so she takes the…

scissorion.name: Scissorion
scissorion.title: Scissorion
scissorion.notes: Scissorions are high single target damage melee. They attack with physical and earth damage. They also make themselves invisible from time to time.

scorn-of-the-emperor.name: Scorn of the Emperor
scorn-of-the-emperor.title: Scorn of the Emperor
scorn-of-the-emperor.notes: Introduced in Summer Update 2010. Part of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.

scorpion.name: Scorpion
scorpion.title: Scorpion
scorpion.loc: Near Thais Troll Cave, Plague Spike, Drefia, Jakundaf Desert, Green Claw Swamp, beneath Folda, Maze of Lost Souls, Plains of Havoc, Venore and Ankrahmun Dragon Lairs, beneath Edron Graveyard, Ancient Temple, Hellgate, Mad Mage Room, Ankrahmun Tombs, Treasure Island, Mal'ouquah, Ramoa, Cyclopolis, Ghostlands, Vengoth, Lion's Rock.
scorpion.desc: Scorpions live in the swamps and deserts of Tibia. They usually hunt small animals but when they get excited they even attack humans. Their very poisonous sting penetrates even thick armor so that they can be a great threat when they attack surprisingly. As their defence is quite weak you should strive to do the first strike.
scorpion.notes: They are dangerous for inexperienced players as they can inject powerful poison, which deals around 315 damage total. Good for poisoning weak enemies when summoned, but remember that a lot of creatures are immune to poison. It is common to see Player Killers pushing players to Scorpions, like on top of the Plague Spike in Optional PvP worlds.
scorpion.strat: If you are hunting Scorpions, use distance fighting or runes. You can use Parcels or other objects to block them and kill them from distance. If you want to fight them with melee, buy the Antidote spell.

sea-captain.name: Sea Captain
sea-captain.title: Sea Captain
sea-captain.desc: Pirates are the crime lords of the sea, always seeking to claim the wealth of others. Every ship requires a loyal crew, usually consisting of former sailors, escaped prisoners and treasure hunters alike. Each member has a specific role ensuring the ship remains functional and prepared for battle, even during the harshest conditions on the open sea. The sea captain is the respected leader of the pirate crew, capable of commanding, navigating and leading the way of the dangerous crew to their desired wealth. Often depicted wearing a tricorne and fine coat, the captain would lead the attack, showing off their remarkable skills in close-quarters sword fighting to anyone bold enough to fight back.

sea-serpent.name: Sea Serpent
sea-serpent.title: Sea Serpent
sea-serpent.loc: Sea Serpent Area and Seacrest Grounds.
sea-serpent.desc: The legendary Sea Serpent is a mysterious and powerful creature. For a long time Sea Serpents were exiled into the world of fairy tales just like the bogeyman or the man in the cave. However, during the years of the serpents, it became shockingly clear that Sea Serpents are a horrible reality. For many years, hordes of Sea Serpents made the ship passage between Carlin and Svargrond impassable. Then, almost over night, they vanished as suddenly as they had appeared. Still, sightings of Sea Serpents are not uncommon nowadays. Sea Serpents are omnivores but prefer meat over seaweed and tang. They hunt seals, sharks, octopuses and small whales, and occasionally also quara. The quara are in a strange relationship with the Sea Serpents. Some of them worship single Sea Serpents like gods, while others organise large hunting parties to exterminate Sea Serpents that enter their territory. Normally, Sea Serpents are afraid of the strange ships humans tend to travel with. Some of them, however, seem to have overcome their fear. Those Sea Serpents attack ships with all their strength, and they are able to destroy even the biggest ships that cruise the seas. If they are able to wreck a whole…
sea-serpent.beh: It heals very fast, fights to death. They are really fast when they use their haste.
sea-serpent.notes: You may hunt 900 Sea Serpents and Young Sea Serpents combined as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Leviathan.
sea-serpent.strat: Sorcerers: Stay diagonal at all times, and use a Wand of Starstorm/Wand of Voodoo/Wand of Defiance with Energy Strike. If you see a second or third appear, run to a safe location where you can easily levitate or go up a floor in case it gets too dangerous. You can also use Great Energy Beam and/or Energy Wave if you see more than one, but be careful not to get waved by both too often, because two or more can drop even the most experienced mages quickly. Recommended for levels 90+, possible with magic shield at 60+, solo. Druids: Stay diagonal at all times, and use a Springsprout Rod/Underworld Rod with Physical Strike. If you see a second or third appear, run to a safe location where you can easily levitate or go up a floor in case it gets too dangerous. You can also use Terra Wave if you see more than one, but be careful not to get waved by both too often, because two or more can drop even the most experienced mages quickly. Recommended for levels 90+, possible with magic shield at 60+, solo. Paladins: You'll need decent skills to solo these monsters, somewhere around 80/70. Since they're weak to physical damage, use Ethereal Spear over your Divine Missile, because it will hit…

seacrest-serpent.name: Seacrest Serpent
seacrest-serpent.title: Seacrest Serpent
seacrest-serpent.loc: Seacrest Grounds when Quara Renegades are not spawning.
seacrest-serpent.desc: Few have seen the mighty Seacrest Serpents and lived to tell the tale. Sailors whispered of strange lights at the bottom of the sea, and of horrible maned sea serpents guarding sunken treasures, roaming the bottom of the ocean amidst long-lost shipwrecks and the ruins of an ancient city. In truth, the Seacrest Serpents much prefer to stay deep below the waves most of the time, but sometimes, Oramond sailors have reported sightings of the seacrest serpents breaking through the waves in a horrible storm, dancing to the lightning light and destroying any ship unfortunate enough to be caught up between them. Fiercely territorial and aggressive, Seacrest Serpents attack anything that looks edible or threatening. They only tolerate some of their smaller brethren and critters like jellyfish or sharks who live off their waste and pick their teeth clean for them. Not unlike dragons, seacrest serpents love things that glitter, and preferably build a nest in sunken ships or amidst a hoard of gold, in which to hatch their young. Sailors surmise that in the mating season, these giant serpents take down fully laden ships on purpose in order to attract a partner.
seacrest-serpent.notes: These creatures can be compared with Medusae without the paralyze, but with much higher average damage. They almost always follow their Melee with a Sudden Death, making their average damage each turn really high.
seacrest-serpent.strat: Use death-reduction items to decrease incoming damage, and stay diagonal to avoid their waves. Their beams aren't avoidable if you are adjacent to the creature. Knights: This creature's melee tends to be very high on top of dealing heavy Death Damage. A combination of Koshei's Ancient Amulet, Moon Mirror, Butterfly Ring and maybe a Skullcracker Armor/Yalahari Armor can be used to reduce incoming damage from them. Avoid fighting more than two at time because their damage really adds up, specially if accompanied by Sea Serpents. Standing diagonal may be useful as well.

seagull.name: Seagull
seagull.title: Seagull
seagull.loc: Various locations, sighted in the Shattered Isles, Venore, Thais, Femor Hills, Cormaya, Edron Troll-Goblin Peninsula, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Fibula, Drefia, Factory Quarter, bordering Orc Fort, Rookgaard Premium Zone (not reachable), Ab'Dendriel elf caves, Northern coast of Tibia between Dalbrect and Northport.
seagull.desc: The seagull is a harmless bird that can be found at the coasts of the realms. Although not dangerous, a single low-flying seagull is often seen as a bad omen by sailors. Whereas a flock of seagulls normally announces the proximity of land, they are often referred to as the vultures of the seas. Old sea dogs claim that seagulls actually know when a storm will come and so they gather in anticipation of the feast that will be held with the remains of the storm. The flesh of seagulls is inedible which sailors see as another proof of the ill nature of seagulls. Some claim they are the spies of evil sorcerers or even malignant spirits.
seagull.beh: Non-offensive creature, they always run when a player is close.
seagull.strat: Fast winged creatures. Since they don't attack you, it's not necessary to kill them.

security-golem.name: Security Golem
security-golem.title: Security Golem
security-golem.loc: The Orc Cult boss room under the Edron Orc Cave.
security-golem.notes: It looks like a War Golem.

serpent-spawn.name: Serpent Spawn
serpent-spawn.title: Serpent Spawn
serpent-spawn.loc: Deeper Banuta, Forbidden Islands: Talahu (Medusa Cave) and Kharos (at level -1), Razachai, Deep below the Crystal Lakes in Foreigner Quarter, Cult's cave in the Magician Quarter, Medusa Tower.
serpent-spawn.desc: The hideous Serpent Spawn is rumoured to be the creation of some ancient serpent god once worshipped by the lizardmen of Tiquanda. In ancient times, this creature, chosen by the gods, was a vital part of the lizard culture and the centre of numerous gruesome rituals. With the downfall of the lizard civilisation, the Serpent Spawn became more and more uncontrollable, and finally started to become a threat to the lizards themselves. As if their minds had been darkened by a madness that mirrored the turmoil in the lizard society, they made no difference between friend or foe and their lethal wrath struck both. By making the most holy places of the lizards inaccessible, they sealed the fate of the lizard civilisation during the apes' revolt. It is rumoured there are still species of the Serpent Spawn around. Still guarding the sacred places with eternal vigilance, they are waiting for their creator to rise again and to lead them once more to reign the jungle of Tiquanda on the god's behalf. Being servants of the serpent god, they are blessed with magic abilities and their serpent heritage grants them enormous physical strength and constitution.
serpent-spawn.beh: Serpent Spawns run on low health, and often retarget.
serpent-spawn.notes: Although this creature was implemented in Summer Update 2005, players could only face it after Christmas Update 2005. It was possible to cast Creature Illusion on this monster between these two major updates. You may hunt 800 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face The Noxious Spawn.
serpent-spawn.strat: They hit hard with their waves, so try to keep diagonal to avoid Earth Wave and Musical Notes, a good idea is to bring Garlic Necklace, since Musical Notes do Life Drain damage. Blockers should use a firebomb or energybomb while shooters stay away of its beams, as the creature retargets very often and runs on low health, try to finish them quickly when they start running, as following them into a group of Serpent Spawns could be lethal. Paladins: A level 150+ Paladin should have no problem soloing these. Just use Assassin Stars and Divine Missile combined with Light Healing and Divine Healing if your hp runs too low. It can be hard to avoid the waves by running, especially in the narrow passages of some of the places where they reside so it may be easier to just sit there and take the melee hits so you don't get waved. They run on low hp, but this isn't really a problem for Paladins. There will usually be profit in loot. Knights: If you're a level 150+ Knight, you should be able to solo these quite comfortably. Always stay diagonal so you don't take their waves, then just combine your melee with Whirlwind Throw to take them down in reasonable time, heal with Wound Cleansing and if…

servant-golem.name: Servant Golem
servant-golem.title: Servant Golem
servant-golem.beh: If you are near this creature it will follow you. It will DESTROY objects to reach you.
servant-golem.notes: The Servant Golem can neither be harmed, nor does it deal any damage. Therefore it can neither be killed, nor does it drop any loot. Can't be pushed!
servant-golem.strat: No strategy needed, as it doesn't do any damage nor can it be killed. Make sure it doesn't trap you in a 1 sqm passage specially in Pvp/Pvp-enforced worlds since you can easily be trapped by pk at the bridge just north of the entrance. In Non-Pvp worlds you can't be trapped by the Servant Golem since there are no other monsters and cannot be trapped.

shaburak-demon.name: Shaburak Demon
shaburak-demon.title: Shaburak Demon
shaburak-demon.notes: The Shaburak Demons are in war with the Askarak Demons.
shaburak-demon.strat: Avoid their beams and waves and kill them with earth or physical based attacks.

shaburak-lord.name: Shaburak Lord
shaburak-lord.title: Shaburak Lord
shaburak-lord.notes: These creatures will only spawn when their side in on the winning hand in the Arak War.

shaburak-prince.name: Shaburak Prince
shaburak-prince.title: Shaburak Prince
shaburak-prince.notes: These creatures will only spawn when their side in on the winning hand in the Arak War. Killing 100 of these will grant you the Shaburak Nemesis achievement.

shadow-hound.name: Shadow Hound
shadow-hound.title: Shadow Hound
shadow-hound.notes: Appears as a raid for five minutes after a player lights the Lightbringer's Basin and receives the following message

shadow-of-boreth.name: Shadow of Boreth
shadow-of-boreth.title: Shadow of Boreth
shadow-of-boreth.notes: This boss is only found when summoned by Arthei.

shadow-of-lersatio.name: Shadow of Lersatio
shadow-of-lersatio.title: Shadow of Lersatio
shadow-of-lersatio.notes: This boss is only found when summoned by Arthei.

shadow-of-marziel.name: Shadow of Marziel
shadow-of-marziel.title: Shadow of Marziel
shadow-of-marziel.notes: This boss is only found when summoned by Arthei.

shadow-pupil.name: Shadow Pupil
shadow-pupil.title: Shadow Pupil
shadow-pupil.loc: Drefia, mostly in the vicinity of .
shadow-pupil.desc: The Shadow Masters worship the more ephemeral aspect of the Dark Powers, and are extremely secretive to the point of never being seen. Only the Shadow Pupils, their apprentices, mingle with other students of the Dark Arts, and it is rumoured that they use the shadows of things and beings as a means of travel and transport, and can heal themselves by feeding off them. Rumours are indeed all that there is to know for sure about the shadow pupils. The shadow pupils themselves are uncommunicative to the point of being cryptic, and when addressed either reply very monosyllabically or ambiguously, as if answering something, or someone, else. They can be found where light and darkness intermingle, and seem to be monitoring things as well as building some strange shades, shrines or artificially interlaced bone piles of yet unknown use. Often, they are seen to draw strange faces or gruesome, half animal half demon-like shapes on the floors, that none dare step on. The other dark summoners suspect those to be portals to a shadow realm, and that the shadow order plots for total dominion and seeks to cloak the world in some strange unlight. Some even say that the shadow pupils are in fact not…
shadow-pupil.notes: You may hunt 4000 of these along with Necromancers, Priestesses, Blood Hands and Blood Priests as a task for Lugri. Upon completion of the task you will face Necropharus. The task can be repeated several times but only grants you 40,000 experience points from the second time and onwards.

shadowpelt.name: Shadowpelt
shadowpelt.title: Shadowpelt
shadowpelt.loc: After an Earth Portal inside Cormaya's were-beasts cave, .
shadowpelt.notes: It's a leader of the Werebears. Part of the .
shadowpelt.strat: Treat it like a stronger Werebear.

shadowstalker.name: Shadowstalker
shadowstalker.title: Shadowstalker
shadowstalker.notes: One of the Hive Bosses Part of the War Against the Hive Quest
shadowstalker.strat: Separate it from other monsters and simply kill it. It's very weak when it's alone. You can use some Field Runes or Utori Spells in order to dispose his Invisibility

shaper-matriarch.name: Shaper Matriarch
shaper-matriarch.title: Shaper Matriarch
shaper-matriarch.loc: Old Masonry, Astral Shaper Ruins, small dungeon under the Formorgar Mines .
shaper-matriarch.desc: As a subterranean race spread all over the world, the Shapers had become subject to gnomish espionage. Although the gnomes claim to have no useful knowledge about the ancient Shaper wisdom and technology, they were willing to share a great deal of their information about the Shapers' social structures. The Shaper Matriarch is a creature of vile cunning. They are the last keepers of oral knowledge from a time of fortune long past. They harbour an immense hatred for other creatures because they blame them for the downfall of their race. In their twisted view of the world, everything belonged to their race once. For this reason, it is only logical for them to take back what they believe is rightfully theirs. Mercilessly they punish every other race for their losses. They enjoy trapping and torturing other creatures. Very often they can be seen guiding small herds of Shaper followers to lay ambushes and place traps around their lairs. The Shaper Matriarchs are able to use ancient artefacts and fractures of once complicated and potent spells to harm their opponents. However, they lack true magical abilities, or even a deeper understanding of what they are doing. Their status amongst…
shaper-matriarch.strat: Try to avoid her wave, she hits hard with it.

shard-of-corruption.name: Shard of Corruption
shard-of-corruption.title: Shard of Corruption
shard-of-corruption.beh: Does not run when in low health.
shard-of-corruption.notes: A big and resistant creature, its stone skin protects it from almost every element.
shard-of-corruption.strat: Paladins and Mages should stay at a distance and shoot. Sorcerers should use Ice Strike along with an energy-based wand (preferably Wand of Starstorm); Druids should do the same, but with a Hailstorm Rod. Keep an eye on your hp bar as it uses its distance attack frequently.

shard-of-magnor.name: Shard of Magnor
shard-of-magnor.title: Shard of Magnor
shard-of-magnor.notes: It's part of the final battle of the Grave Danger Quest.
shard-of-magnor.strat: Defeating Magnor isn't very complicated and the players should just attack it, specially with Fire Damage. When it dies, 4 Shards of Magnor will spawn, sharing the same health pool. They die rather quickly, but care must be taken since when dying they explode dealing high Life Drain damage. To mitigate the damage taken by the blockers, they can split the Shards between then and block them far away from each other. Shooters should also stay far from the boss to avoid this damage

shardhead.name: Shardhead
shardhead.title: Shardhead
shardhead.loc: Formorgar Glacier, behind the teleporter located .
shardhead.notes: Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
shardhead.strat: Mages and Paladins just run and shoot. It will be easier to defeat it if you use an Energy Wall Rune. Knights fight it like a normal Ice Golem but beware it can do damage similar to a Giant Spider.

shark.name: Shark
shark.title: Shark
shark.loc: Fiehonja, Seacrest Grounds, Krailos Steppe underwater cave.
shark.desc: Sharks are some of the most fearful killers that roam the black depths of the seas. They rarely sleep, they focus solely on their prey once they have chosen a victim, and they have enough energy to pursue even the swiftest creatures as they swim fast and extremely efficiently. Beware if you ever encounter a sleeping shark, chances are it is awake and you are just the meal it is resting for.
shark.beh: It swims at full speed against its prey to attack it with its strong melee.
shark.notes: Was implemented at the Winter Update 2011.
shark.strat: They are extremely fast when hasted so don't try to outrun them. They are weak compared to deeplings, so try to kill sharks first (if no spellsinger is in sight) so they dont break your shielding and block your path.

sharpclaw.name: Sharpclaw
sharpclaw.title: Sharpclaw
sharpclaw.loc: After a teleport inside Edron's were-beasts cave, .
sharpclaw.notes: It's a leader of the Werebadgers. Part of the
sharpclaw.strat: Treat it like a stronger Werebadger.

sharptooth.name: Sharptooth
sharptooth.title: Sharptooth
sharptooth.loc: At Yalahar, Sunken Quarter. When entering the Sunken Quarter step down from the underwater hill and head to north-east, there you should find stairs which takes you down to the boss. The boss is behind a sealed door, so make sure you have the access to that room.
sharptooth.beh: Acts like a normal Quara Predator; It also retargets often.
sharptooth.notes: It hits very hard so take care (its melee is stronger than a Behemoth).
sharptooth.strat: A strong knight should block, and a 'sioer' to heal the knight (and other questers), and whoever needs to do the quest deal the damage. Party buffs are helpful. All a Sharptooth uses is melee, so it is not required to stay diagonal. For people with no blocker is good to shoot from the door and go out to heal and repeat.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.title: Sheep
sheep.loc: In Rookgaard Sheep field, Greenshore and other farms like the one in Thais, east of Carlin. They can also be found wandering the fields of Edron, and some can be found along with a Black Sheep with the Hunter in Femor Hills.
sheep.desc: Sheep are domestic animals which are kept by farmers and herdsmen. They have been raised by humans for a long time to gain meat and wool. They are absolutely peaceable and live as herds in sheepfolds or on pastures. However, the owners will be upset if you kill one of them. A Tibian saying states that there is a black sheep in every herd.
sheep.notes: Sheep are very useful to get meat from to regain hp or mp. They are cousins of the Black Sheep found around Tibia.
sheep.strat: Just attack them, they are slow.

shell-drake.name: Shell Drake
shell-drake.title: Shell Drake
shell-drake.desc: Shell drakes are bizarre creatures that appear in some fairy tales. They are an absurd combination of dragon and snail. Their long, snake-like necks emerge from a giant snail shell standing on bird legs. Their mouths are pointed and beak-like, and they have three horns. Two dragon wings emerge from the large snail shell. Like dragons, shell drakes can breathe fire that can destroy all life in their vicinity. Although the middle of their bodies consists of a snail shell, don't be fooled: Shell drakes can move extremely fast when they want to. According to legend, they are the guardians of the forgotten paths that lead through the dark forests of Tibia.

shimmying-butterfly.name: Shimmying Butterfly
shimmying-butterfly.title: Shimmying Butterfly
shimmying-butterfly.loc: Roshamuul Cistern, enclosed cavern, appears when using Pendulum on Shiversleep and Broken Dreams on Half-Buried Faces.
shimmying-butterfly.beh: Follows its target around but does not harm them.
shimmying-butterfly.notes: When a Shiversleep is hypnotized, it believes itself to be a butterfly: the Shimmying Butterfly.
shimmying-butterfly.strat: Leave them alone. If you kill them, the Dream Butterfly will curse you (very minor damage) when you next speak to it.

shiversleep.name: Shiversleep
shiversleep.title: Shiversleep
shiversleep.loc: 3 in Roshamuul Cistern, an enclosed chamber.
shiversleep.notes: They are the overlords of their brethren, but they struggle to control them. They are similar in strength or even weaker than their breathren. When you enter the chamber you are ambushed by 3 of them.
shiversleep.strat: Use the Pendulum on them and then enter the Instable Vortex on the west of the chamber. They will turn into a Shimmying Butterfly. You have limited time to do this.

shock-head.name: Shock Head
shock-head.title: Shock Head
shock-head.loc: Sparsely in eastern Lower Roshamuul ( ) and southern Guzzlemaw Valley ( ).
shock-head.desc: The shock head is a strange hybrid mix of a demon and a nightmare creature. It is impossible to tell if these creatures were once bred on purpose or if they are just some strange freak of nature. Their demonic nature gives them a more physical and reality-bound body, as well as the ability to breed. Their nightmarish origin bestows them several unique abilities and the resistance to the nightmare-ridden areas of Roshamuul. The shock head is disturbingly well suited to survive even in environments most hostile to life. To describe it as omnivore is an understatement since it does not only devour plants, meat and carrion without prejudice, it also consumes minerals, blood, life energy and even dreams. Its digestive system compresses everything that is not exploitable into rocklike structures that can be spat out like a bullet. Probably due to natural selection, the shock head population is extremely resilient, aggressive and dangerous. The regenerative powers of these creatures have captured the attention of alchemists that are trying to use several parts of the shock head as substitutes in health potions. Their eye-like organs are not used for vision, but as a weapon that can…
shock-head.notes: Can be tamed with a Nightmare Horn.
shock-head.strat: Always stay diagonal. Despite this monster having an Energy-related name, it does not walk over Energy Fields. This monster is very undesirable to kill as it gives bad Loot and Experience for its difficulty. Recommended to tame and only kill during the quest.

shredderthrower.name: Shredderthrower
shredderthrower.title: Shredderthrower
shredderthrower.loc: Ancient Ruins Tomb, Madareth's Circle Room.
shredderthrower.beh: Shredderthrowers fights until death. They are unable to move.
shredderthrower.strat: Get away from them as fast as you can.

shrieking-cry-stal.name: Shrieking Cry-Stal
shrieking-cry-stal.title: Shrieking Cry-Stal
shrieking-cry-stal.desc: Another strange elemental creature of Gnomprona is the shrieking cry-stal. This unassuming creature that can actually be easily mistaken for an ordinary inanimate crystal which ironically made them prey of the Emerald Tortoises and other mineral eating inhabitants of gnomprona. Those creatures are in for a nasty surprise as the Shrieking Cry-stals are driven by a malicious, yet alien intelligence as it seems and are more than able to fight back. The level or alienness of this intelligence is not known and hard to pinpoint. With lacks of means to interact with their environment it's almost impossible to gauge such things. At least it seems highly probable that they have a limited form of communication with each other and can join forces in a common goal. Still not all predators are warded off easily and now and then a Shrieking Cry-stal ends up in the bowels of another subterranean monster. Enthusiastic gnomish crystallomancers were more then eager to study this strange creature. One of their more disturbing findings is, that the Shrieking Cry-stals are not feasting on the corpses of their victims, but a residual energy that lingers on said corpses. Though final proofs are needed…

shulgrax.name: Shulgrax
shulgrax.title: Shulgrax
shulgrax.loc: Grounds of Damnation, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.
shulgrax.beh: This boss reduces melee skills very frequently and this reduction is strong, so the blocker can't perform significant damage most of the time.
shulgrax.notes: He's the minion of Tafariel. Inside the "Dark Torturer Seal".

sibang.name: Sibang
sibang.title: Sibang
sibang.loc: In Banuta, north-east of Port Hope.
sibang.desc: The Sibang seems playful and harmless but this impression is misleading. They use their incredible agility to attack enemies from a safe distance and to swiftly evade counter-attacks. Their hit-and-run tactic proves especially effective in the familiar territory of the jungle. Attacking suddenly from the cover of trees, they throw volleys of different projectiles and then retreat to safety to prepare for their next attack. Ever curious and adventurous, they are the apes that are most often away from their homes. Sometimes they serve as scouts and spies to prepare a bigger assault. Using trees like humans are using roads, it is nearly impossible to catch them.
sibang.beh: They are very fast and throw stones. They do not run in low health and fight at distance. Their distance attacks have a long range and can reach you from off-screen. They can Retarget.
sibang.notes: They are usually found in large groups with Kongra and Merlkin. You may hunt 300 Kongra, Sibang, Merlkin combined, as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
sibang.strat: Knights should be very careful around these. They run quickly, and if you chase them you will risk being swarmed with more apes. If you are not quick enough to catch them on open ground, using buildings to get them to come to you is a good idea. Paladins It's a good idea to hunt them with Enchanted Spears since its range is long enough to kill a sibang without you needing to chase it - Royal Spears do not have a large enough range to hit without chasing. Using a shield is highly recommended in either case due to the presence of Kongras nearby. Druids and Sorcerers should use Ice Strike and Wand of Decay/Necrotic Rod or Hailstorm Rod. Ice Wave can also be effective as sibangs are within its range. Chasing not recommended as you risk being swarmed by more apes. They can move items that are in their way. Take advantage of the buildings in Banuta, and try to trap them in corners.

sight-of-surrender.name: Sight of Surrender
sight-of-surrender.title: Sight of Surrender
sight-of-surrender.loc: Dark Grounds, Guzzlemaw Valley (if less than 100 Blowing Horns tasks have been done the day before, [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=131.71-126.229-7-2-1-0&mark1=131.2-126.200-7-9&mark2=130.234-126.219-7-9&mark3=131.58-126.206-7-9&mark4=131.67-126.232-7-9&mark5=131.99-126.211-7-9&mark6=131.117-126.219-7-9&mark7=131.101-127.32-7-9&mark8=131.146-127.18-7-9 spawn locations]) and the Silencer Plateau (when Silencer Resonating Chambers are used there).
sight-of-surrender.desc: Called "sight of surrender" because whatever they lay their sight on, will cease to exist in a matter of moments. They are loners, usually appearing solitary but will not hesitate to attack in groups. They see themselves as some kind of custodians of the walls of Roshamuul and rarely depart from their seemingly self-imposed duty of guarding what belongs to them. Fighting them is extremely dangerous and wearisome as they are extraordinary battle-hardened with near impenetrable armor and only one weak spot - their eye. They will always try to force everything in the sight to surrender so there is either victory or...
sight-of-surrender.notes: Certain conditions needs to be met in order to open the stage in which the Sights of Surrender area will become available. The Sight of Surrender is one of the most powerful regular creatures in game.
sight-of-surrender.strat: Be very careful when running or hunting in the Guzzlemaw Valley if there are Sights of Surrenders spawning. Not only they deal considerable damage, their huge health pool and high self healing means they take a long time to die. They are not worth hunting for Experience, but if in case you decide to kill them during regular hunts or for loot, a minimum of 2 players is recommended to take them down faster. Avoid staying in front of them and mind the other creatures in the area. It's usually best to first clear everything around it using AoE attacks and them focus on the Sight of Surrender using single target attacks.

silencer.name: Silencer
silencer.title: Silencer
silencer.loc: All over the Roshamuul surface and Nightmare Isles.
silencer.desc: The silencers are roaming in packs and will hunt down everything which is too loud for their sensitive ears and does not belong to their kin. Of course, only if their victim is smaller or weaker. It is rumoured that they actually communicate with each other. They seem to call other silencers for help or even organise themselves in some way. However, if they are aggravated in any way, they are extremely tough and unpredictable adversaries.
silencer.beh: Retargets rarely. Has a pretty high speed.
silencer.strat: A largely melee-based creature, its most dangerous feature is the Magic Level debuff missile. Mages, especially, might want to avoid hunting these solo. Be careful because their Magic Level debuff (and thus the reduced ability to heal) coupled with comboes from other monsters can easily kill a level 150. Can be trapped easily by field runes.

silver-rabbit.name: Silver Rabbit
silver-rabbit.title: Silver Rabbit
silver-rabbit.loc: A lot of places on the Ice Islands and one on Rookgaard (unreachable).
silver-rabbit.desc: The Silver Rabbit is the northern cousin of the common brown rabbit. It's a harmless and peaceful herbivore that survives even the hazards of the icy north. Its survivability is actually that good that it might have had become a plague in this area were it not for the numerous hunters that prey on this species.
silver-rabbit.notes: Winter version of the Rabbit. In the days surrounding the Easter holiday, silver rabbits can also drop Blue, Green, Purple, Red and Yellow Coloured Eggs.

silverfrost-sentinel.name: Silverfrost Sentinel
silverfrost-sentinel.title: Silverfrost Sentinel
silverfrost-sentinel.desc: The silverfrost sentinels are hulking constructs with four arms, made of translucent ice, reinforced with moonsilver. The frost flower asuri created them as guardians of their old citadel beneath the Emerald Gardens of Marapur. They are hollow and can be filled with various liquids: mana fluid, acid, blood - whatever the asuri find useful. Their bodies are very robust, and cracks that form across their surface from incoming attacks quickly seal themselves. In combat, they rely on slow, devastating blows and waves of intense cold to freeze their enemies.

sineater-inferniarch.name: Sineater Inferniarch
sineater-inferniarch.title: Sineater Inferniarch
sineater-inferniarch.desc: As pure manifestations of fury and chaos, beings driven by their ancestral hunger to consume and corrupt all they touch, all inferniarchs florish in evil. But the Sineater is a grotesque and fearsome demon that specifically feeds on the corruption within souls. With the ability to ignite cursed flames wherever sin has taken root, these creatures have spread across the known world, feeding off the tainted. Alarmingly, their presence is not limited to any one region, indicating that corruption is far more widespread than most are willing to admit. They cannot function near pure souls or on holy ground, which they avoid like the plague. It is said that those pure of heart can walk freely past a Sineater unscathed, but for the wicked, the flames that follow in the Sineater's wake are inescapable and devouring. Where there is darkness in the soul, the Sineater thrives, growing stronger with each sin it consumes.

sir-baeloc.name: Sir Baeloc
sir-baeloc.title: Sir Baeloc
sir-baeloc.notes: It's one of the bosses of Grave Danger Quest.
sir-baeloc.strat: Do not use Death Damage since it heals the boss. It's recommended that you keep killing the summons since they are quite strong. In order to kill it, you'll have to kill its brother Sir Nictros at the same time, otherwise they will heal each other.

sir-leonard.name: Sir Leonard
sir-leonard.title: Sir Leonard
sir-leonard.notes: Final boss of Between the Lines Quest.

sir-leopold.name: Sir Leopold
sir-leopold.title: Sir Leopold
sir-leopold.notes: It spawns on the 23rd day of each month, exactly 30 minutes after Server Boot. Raid messages: Sir Leopold appears
sir-leopold.strat: Important: Do not summon Familiars when fighting Sir Leopold. His mitigation increases when they are present.

sir-valorcrest.name: Sir Valorcrest
sir-valorcrest.title: Sir Valorcrest
sir-valorcrest.beh: Summon as many Vampires as he can and tries to kill his enemy with strong melee attacks and makes you drunk. He fights to the death and doesn't run away in low health - This could be because of the fact that he seems to be a Knight Vampire due to his high melee damage, name, and honorable fighting style (Fights to the death).
sir-valorcrest.notes: Spawns with 0-4 Vampires, you will notice FAR more vampires close to the stairs than usual at the Vampire cave when this creature spawns. You can use a blessed wooden stake on his corpse in order to get Vampire Dust.
sir-valorcrest.strat: Knights: It IS possible to solo this creature for a knight of level 80+ (it's still not recommended, however) using defensive fighting, Great Health Potions and Exori, just take around 150-200 Great Health Potion and about 50-80 Mana Potions to do this, because killing him is expensive so do this only if you REALLY want to kill him, in order to do this lure him to the stairs, then make sure he's at melee range and attack him with your best weapon and use Exori as often as you can to deal damage to him and get rid of the Vampires surrounding you, as damage will decrease once you kill the Vampires that regularly spawn in the cave as you will only have to fight his summons. It's best to make them run away, as they won't respawn and you can focus on fighting Sir Valorcrest, just keep using Great Health Potions as often as you can, whether you need them or not, as a strong combo can give you a free trip to the Temple. If your health goes below 200 it's recommended to go upstairs to heal and then go back. Mages should have a blocker and shoot with fire spells, but other elements work too. Paladins: Same strategy as mage, blocker and shoot with bolts/Enchanted Spears while using Divine…

siramal.name: Siramal
siramal.title: Siramal (Creature)
siramal.notes: Appeared during Tibia's 15th and 20th Anniversary celebrations as well as on January 8, 2018 (unintended), in a raid at a random time once a day. The following message will appear: Then, 20 minutes later he will spawns:

sister-hetai.name: Sister Hetai
sister-hetai.title: Sister Hetai
sister-hetai.loc: Through a teleport located inside the Kilmaresh Catacombs, .
sister-hetai.notes: It's one of the minibosses of Kilmaresh Quest, Wanted mission.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.loc: In many dungeons around Tibia, like the Ancient Temple and Ghostlands. Also found in Rookgaard tombs and north east of Port Hope, in the jungle of Tiquanda, beneath Fenrock and in the desert Tombs, Vengoth Castle.
skeleton.desc: Skeletons are undead monsters that live in the dungeons of Tibia. It is rumoured that they are the bodies of dead adventurers that have been revived by some evil power. Cropping up in packs and occasionally accompanied by other undead creatures like ghouls, they are quite nasty opponents, particularly because they are able to drain life energy off their opponents.
skeleton.notes: They can be found in various regions (including Rookgaard) and are a excellent source of loot. Also, they can be summoned by an angry bonelord or by a mage using either the Animate Dead or Summon Creature spells.
skeleton.strat: Every item they drop besides torches and bones can be sold to NPCs for a good amount. Be sure to add them to your lootbag, especially the helmets. In Rookgaard, they are the best possible creatures to hunt (for both money and experience) at level 6 and above.

skeleton-elite-warrior.name: Skeleton Elite Warrior
skeleton-elite-warrior.title: Skeleton Elite Warrior
skeleton-elite-warrior.desc: The Skeleton Elite Warrior is a stronger version of Skeleton Warriors.
skeleton-elite-warrior.strat: Paladins can start hunting those around level 120 with high risk (200+ recommended), just lure it to the entrance of the cave and throw a Energy Wall Rune to run around it. Because of their strong melee, knights should stay away from them until level 200 with a healer. Mages should get a blocker or use their summon after level 200 with mana shield.

skeleton-warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton-warrior.title: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton-warrior.loc: Island of Destiny, Drefia, Ghostland, Edron Vampire Crypt, and beneath Fenrock.
skeleton-warrior.desc: While animated skeletons possess no intelligence at all and are only driven by some universal evil, a Skeleton Warrior is indeed an independent and intelligent creature. Most Skeleton Warriors came into existence by free choice of will. Many of them used to be heroes or dutiful soldiers in life who volunteered to become the eternal guardian of some object or place. During their life, they were prepared for their eternal guard duty: they were trained in meditation, tattooed with powerful magic runes, and participated in arcane rituals. After their death, they are dressed in their best ceremonial armor which has further enchantments. For a while the corpse is as inanimate like any other corpse. Instead of rotting, these corpses slowly become mummified in the course of time. At some point, which may take years to reach, the Skeleton Warrior will rise into its undead existence. As Skeleton Warriors are unable to communicate, it is unknown where their consciousness resides in the time between death and resurrection. It is assumed by mages that the risen Skeleton Warrior usually begins his guard duty in a more or less sane state of mind. In the course of years, the once devoted warrior…
skeleton-warrior.notes: It is somewhat unique in that it is an undead creature that drops food.

skunk.name: Skunk
skunk.title: Skunk
skunk.loc: Unannounced raid in Edron outside the depot, Tiquanda, Shattered Isles, Liberty Bay, south gate of Thais.
skunk.desc: Legend has it there was once a race of mischievous black rodents who were close cousins of the squirrels. They loved to fool around and to tease others all day long. However, one day they went too far. Angered by one of their tricks, a powerful fairy cursed the whole race. From that fateful moment on, these creatures were marked with a white stripe and,more importantly, with an overwhelming stench that was unbearable to most creatures who live and breathe.
