However, it did not take the clever critters long to work out that they could use their nauseating stench as a weapon of self-defence. Today, these rodents are known as Skunks, and few creatures dare to anger them because of their feared smell.
skunk.notes: They are weak but their poison hits can't be blocked.

slick-water-elemental.name: Slick Water Elemental
slick-water-elemental.title: Slick Water Elemental
slick-water-elemental.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Paladin's part - Ice Sphere.
slick-water-elemental.strat: If you don't mind using 210 cap you can use Helmet of the Deep to block water based attack. Paladins: You can hunt these easily using a combination of Enchanted Spear/Assassin Star and Divine Missile. Simply treat this as you would treat a Water Elemental.

slim.name: Slim
slim.title: Slim
slim.beh: It looks exactly like and uses same array of attacks as a Bonebeast.
slim.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #5. Next #6.
slim.strat: Druid or Sorcerer: Use Flame Strike and Exura running it around. Knight: Just melee and use Exori if you need to kill it fast. Paladin: Run in Circles and attack with Divine Missile if needed.

slime.name: Slime
slime.title: Slime
slime.loc: Ancient Temple under the Rotworm area, under White Flower Temple, Mount Sternum Undead Cave on the last floor, Thais Troll Cave, Bonelord cave in Drefia, Green Claw Swamp, Dwarf Mines, Villa Scapula, Ankrahmun Tombs, Dark Cathedral, north of Port Hope, Deeper Banuta, on Folda on the floor above the Water Elementals, Hellgate, Vengoth, Alchemist Quarter, Yalahar and Carlin sewers, Ghostlands, Desert Dungeon, Dusalk's Troll Clan Cave, Nargor, and in a cave northeast of Ab'Dendriel.
slime.desc: Slimes are not real creatures but very strange entities which occur in the dungeons of Tibia. They move by flowing rather than walking. Their favourite tactic is to enclose an enemy by separating and floating around him. Their attack is quite heavy, but their defence is weak. Upon their death, they turn into a cloud of poisonous gas that vanishes quickly into thin air.

slippery-northern-pike.name: Slippery Northern Pike
slippery-northern-pike.title: Slippery Northern Pike
slippery-northern-pike.loc: Quirefang, rarely spawns when Northern Pikes are killed.
slippery-northern-pike.beh: Similar to fish, they try to avoid all players.
slippery-northern-pike.notes: There's a chance a Northern Pike (item) will appear when its killed.
slippery-northern-pike.strat: They are just like fish. Simply attack them.

slug.name: Slug
slug.title: Slug
slug.loc: South-east of Venore , Swamp Troll Cave.
slug.desc: What an embarrassing defeat to be ambushed and beaten by a Slug. However, this scenario has become a shocking truth. Several forms of Slugs have been raised like cattle by various races such as the orcs and goblins since the dawn of time. It is questionable whether some of the prehistoric Slug rancher came up with the idea to breed some kind of battle Slugs or if some free roaming Slugs adapted to the constant danger by other races. It is quite likely that both effects went hand in hand. Anyhow, the Slug as we know it today was the result of this process. The Slug might not be a fearsome fighter but it has adapted to the constant threat to their race by developing resilience and an acid spitting capability that at least keeps their hunters somewhat at bay. Nevertheless, Slugs are still the favourite diet of several races and especially orcs consider Slug acid a spice. Most other giant Slug races are only known from orc and goblin myths since today's Slug successfully took over most habitats including even some from other races. This led to the incident known as the great Slug plague. In a rare and (unintentionally) combined effort of humans, dwarfs, elves, orcs, goblins and…
slug.beh: Slugs are unsurprisingly, very slow. They will use their distance attack until they are close enough for melee.
slug.notes: Can be tamed by using Slug Drug on it.
slug.strat: Their melee is comparable to a Carrion Worm but they can cause surprising amounts of damage with their distance Earth attack. Be careful not to have more than one hitting you at once if you are low level.

smuggler.name: Smuggler
smuggler.title: Smuggler
smuggler.loc: Around Dark Cathedral, Tiquanda Bandit Caves, the Outlaw Camp, Tyrsung, Yalahar, Nargor and The Cave.
smuggler.desc: Although the main goal of the common Smuggler is easy profit by circumventing taxes and embargoes, or by trading forbidden goods, they do not flinch from murdering and robbing those who find out about their operations. Smugglers can be found at hidden spots close to larger cities or in remote hideouts where they store their goods. Even though they are usually not well equipped for combat, their determination not to lose profit makes them still opponents to be reckoned with. Only lightly armoured, they usually try to retreat if they get seriously hurt or outnumbered.
smuggler.beh: Smugglers run in low health. Smugglers will occasionally change targets; although this only occurs if another player is close to the Smuggler. They can also move parcels, crates or boxes that are in their way.
smuggler.strat: Same as Wild Warrior but a bit weaker. Like Wild Warriors and Bandits (all 3 found in Dark Cathedral) these are easy to kill one at a time, but in large groups they can damage low levels fast.

smuggler-baron-silvertoe.name: Smuggler Baron Silvertoe
smuggler-baron-silvertoe.title: Smuggler Baron Silvertoe
smuggler-baron-silvertoe.strat: You could try to go invisible using Utana Vid or by using a Stealth Ring.

snail-slime.name: Snail Slime
snail-slime.title: Snail Slime
snail-slime.notes: Fire Damage will heal it. It looks like a Slime.
snail-slime.strat: Lure it far from The Count of the Core and kill it.

snake.name: Snake
snake.title: Snake
snake.loc: In almost all grassy areas of Tibia. Also found in Rookgaard.
snake.desc: Snakes live in the grasslands and forests of Tibia where they hunt small animals. Their tactic is to hide in the grass and pop up when a victim approaches. Relying on their poisonous bite they even attack humans when they feel cornered.
snake.notes: A snake is a weak monster that can envenom others with its bite. The poison condition inflicted by snakes does about 15 damage total which is something to watch out for for lower levels. They are also summoned by Orc Shamans. Some players use the snakes summoned by Orc Shamans for training. They Trap the Orc Shaman in a way he cannot shoot any magic missiles at them and then basically have an endless supply of constantly spawning snakes. Lizard Snakecharmers drop Dead Snakes as loot.
snake.strat: Snakes are very weak monsters; they have the weakest defense. Even with fist fighting skill 10, you can kill a snake rather easily. Just be aware of the damage poison might do when you're fighting a snake at a lower level.

snake-god-essence.name: Snake God Essence
snake-god-essence.title: Snake God Essence
snake-god-essence.loc: East of Zao and south of Dragonblaze Peaks, two floors below Zalamon.
snake-god-essence.notes: Introduced in Summer Update 2010. Part of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.
snake-god-essence.strat: Trap him as fast as you can, knights will have to use challenge a lot since he tend to switch very often. Fire and Energy Bombs will be helpful.

snake-thing.name: Snake Thing
snake-thing.title: Snake Thing
snake-thing.loc: East of Zao and south of Dragonblaze Peaks, two floors below Zalamon.
snake-thing.notes: Introduced in Summer Update 2010. Part of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.
snake-thing.strat: Trap him as fast as you can, knights will have to use challenge often since this creature tends to switch very often. Fire and Energy Bombs will be helpful here.

son-of-verminor.name: Son of Verminor
son-of-verminor.title: Son of Verminor
son-of-verminor.loc: Deep in the Pits of Inferno, in Verminor's throne room. Also in the Demon Forge (The Vats and The Hive).
son-of-verminor.desc: It is said that the dark lord of decay, Verminor, one of the Ruthless Seven, oozes the very essence of destruction. The power of that demon is so immense that some of his ooze gained a sort of sentience over the years. Instinctively devouring more and more of the demonic ooze, it grows in proportions and sentience unless a semi-intelligent creature is formed that is known as Son of Verminor. The most powerful of them are recognised by their progenitor as his kin and serve as his minions. Usually not more than an almost mindless mass of decay and hunger, they can be used by their dark master almost like puppets to fulfil his unholy duties. It is assumed that they not only function as the long arm of their master, but also as his eyes, enabling him to sight what is happening in the vicinity of his 'son'. When encountered in the realm of man, Sons of Verminor are usually just a shambling ever-hungry mass that tries to consume everything that it can catch. Because of the mindless destruction they tend to cause, they are seldom summoned by the servants of the demons. The Sons of Verminor are usually used to make places as inhospitable as possible. Sometimes a greater number of them is…
son-of-verminor.strat: Kill it fast using ice, holy, or death runes/spells and Exori Gran.

sopping-carcass.name: Sopping Carcass
sopping-carcass.title: Sopping Carcass
sopping-carcass.desc: The Sopping Carcasses are unfortunate followers who seemingly had not the luck to die with their fallen god but were instead taken over alive by decay and rot, likely eons ago. Their desiccated bodies are trapped in a state of perpetual decay, perpetually soaked in a putrid sludge that oozes from their withering flesh. The scent of decay hangs heavy in the air around them, a nauseating reminder of their eternal torment. These wretched beings shuffle aimlessly through the fallen realm, their existence a testament to the relentless grip of decay and the insidious nature of the realm they inhabit. Despite their deteriorating forms, the Sopping Carcasses possess a twisted vitality, fueled by the foul energies that course through their veins. They lash out with clumsy yet potent attacks, driven by an instinctual desire to spread the corruption that has consumed them.

sopping-corpus.name: Sopping Corpus
sopping-corpus.title: Sopping Corpus
sopping-corpus.desc: The Sopping Corpuses, unlike their brethren, are the only semi-undead rot creatures in the fallen realm that retain remnants of their original dark souls embedded within. These cursed entities are eternal prisoners of the decay that befell their withering bodies, forever trapped in a state of half-life. Their forms, ravaged by time and decay, exude an aura of despair and sorrow, as if their tortured existence weighs heavily upon their rotting souls. Their movements are slow and agonizing, their bodies oozing with a mixture of decaying matter and a sinister, otherworldly essence. The Sopping Corpuses emit pitiful moans and wails, their voices carrying the anguish of lost souls trapped in an unending cycle of decay and torment. Those who encounter these pitiable creatures cannot help but feel a sense of profound sadness and pity for their cursed existence.

sorcerer-familiar.name: Sorcerer Familiar
sorcerer-familiar.title: Sorcerer Familiar
sorcerer-familiar.beh: Attacks the player's target from melee distance casting Challenge and self-healing very often.
sorcerer-familiar.notes: When looking at a summoned Sorcerer Familiar, the summoner's character name and how long it will take for the summon to disappear is shown. It can be summoned by Sorcerers of level 200 or higher using the Summon Sorcerer Familiar spell. All the experience that is expected to be 'gained' by the summon goes to the player. So there is no shared experience between the summon and its summoner, like with the normal Summon Creature spell. It will follow players at their speed and will go up and down stairs and holes with them. It lasts for 15 minutes with a 30 minutes cooldown. It can go with you to a Protection Zone. If the summoner logs out, it will disappear stopping the countdown of its timer, and will reappear when the summoner logs in again.
sorcerer-familiar.strat: The Sorcerer Familiar can be very useful for low level Sorcerers as a free blocker and damage boost. Due to its timer/cooldown mechanic, you cannot have 100% uptime of it, so it's important to beware when it's about to disappear as all creatures will change target. Since it's main function is to act like a blocker, it's not recommended to use it when hunting with a Knight as it will Challenge the creatures away from him, reducing the knight's damage output. Learning how to manage the summon can be tricky at first, as you cannot force it to cast its challenge spell. You should be prepared to block the creatures you're going to fight for a few turns until the Sorcerer Familiar challenges them, since its spell use is quite erratic. Similarly, it's possible that it doesn't use the spell for a few seconds, allowing the creatures to retarget. An important strategy when using the Sorcerer Familiar to block several creatures is to always change your target to the creature that will die last, because if the Sorcerer Familiar doesn't have a target it will run back to its master, bringing the creatures its blocking with it. At higher levels, the Sorcerer Familiar is used mostly in…

sorcerers-apparition.name: Sorcerer's Apparition
sorcerers-apparition.title: Sorcerer's Apparition
sorcerers-apparition.loc: The Mirrored Nightmare, after Mirror Images are attacked.
sorcerers-apparition.desc: These sorcerers belong to a group of (five) apparitions, which Mirror Images can turn into.
sorcerers-apparition.beh: This creature fights in close range.
sorcerers-apparition.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.

soul-scourge.name: Soul Scourge
soul-scourge.title: Soul Scourge
soul-scourge.notes: It's part of the Grave Danger Quest and assists Duke Krule
soul-scourge.strat: You can kill them with area attacks while attacking the boss but they should't be your main focus.

soul-spark.name: Soul Spark
soul-spark.title: Soul Spark
soul-spark.loc: Upper deck of the Ghost Ship.
soul-spark.notes: Appears during the A Pirate's Death to Me World Task. Looks the same as a Wisp and a Spirit of Light.
soul-spark.strat: Kill it fast or just ignore it.

soul-broken-harbinger.name: Soul-Broken Harbinger
soul-broken-harbinger.title: Soul-Broken Harbinger
soul-broken-harbinger.desc: The dream-born are a reclusive race of creatures that are shrouded in mystery. Only recent events led to a contact that shed some light on these peculiar beings. There seem to be two distinctively different kinds of dream-born, that align themselves with either the winter or the summer. Though there are conflicting reports about that alignment, the current theory is that there are two rivaling courts exists though it's still possible that there is just one court that changes in accordance to the seasons. In the few recorded encounters, the dream-born claimed to live in realms that their god created with his dreams. Given their obvious kinship to the common elves it's of course far more likely that they are just descendants of elves that fled the godwars into some kind of pocket dimension. They usually shun outsiders and rarely leave their own realm at all. What little information could be gathered about them suggests a lifestyle akin that of the other elves, though they seem to lack a cast system and have a feudal oriented society. Due to their isolation they developed odd quirks like the overemphasising of seasons, that hints at a primitive, animistic world-view. It's still…

souleater.name: Souleater
souleater.title: Souleater
souleater.loc: Razachai, Northern Zao Plantations, Souleater Mountains, Deeper Banuta (many on all floors from the onward), Spirit Grounds (intermediate)
souleater.desc: The corruption in Zao comes in many different ways. Often, the corruption which is visible is the least dangerous. Sometimes, however, the corruption rather touches the soul than the body. Sometimes, this goes unnoticed by those affected and those close to them. Sometimes, this leads to erratic behaviour, morbid fascinations, or a violent temper. Sometimes, the corruption goes unnoticed for a whole lifetime. Only in death those who are touched by the corruption learn the horrid truth about their nature. The taint in their soul twists their nature and refuses them the afterlife that awaited them. They are bound to the realm of the mortals in an ethereal form, tormented by an eternal hunger and plagued by their twisted vision of the world around them. They perceive the world as rotten and flawed, worth to be destroyed. Everything that exists is a pain to them, particularly if it is alive. Destruction and total oblivion seem to be the only salvation for them. Since their new ethereal body is inherently flawed, they constantly burn up spiritual energy in a rate that leaves them in a constant state of hunger. To satisfy this hunger, they feed on the vital force and soul energy of…
souleater.notes: This creature was added with the Summer Update 2010. They usually come in groups with other Souleaters, Mutated Bats, Mutated Rats, Mutated Tigers or Death Blobs.
souleater.strat: Mages use Flame or Energy Strike while running away and their Wand or Rod. Avoid getting trapped by lots of them. Knights and Paladins are advised to not hunt these creatures since they are very strong against Physical. Running and shooting might lead to groups which are deadly, so beware, also you can use Helmet of the deep when blocking to prevent Drowning damage.

spark-of-destruction.name: Spark of Destruction
spark-of-destruction.title: Spark of Destruction
spark-of-destruction.loc: The various boss rooms in the Otherworld.
spark-of-destruction.notes: Appears together with the bosses of the Heart of Destruction Quest.

sparkion.name: Sparkion
sparkion.title: Sparkion
sparkion.desc: The Sparkions are some of the more stable creatures from beyond, only surpassed by the reality reaver. It took several weeks to defeat an already severely injured Sparkion. Even though they seem to be closest to mindless automatons, they often show very specific individual patterns of behaviour which they do not share with other Sparkions. Some even argue that Sparkions do not exist at all, but only a group of very similar, yet different forms of unlife. On the other hand, most Sparkions show at least some common characteristics, such as strength or the tenacity with which goals are being pursued. While many of the new creatures often act irrationally, the Sparkion rarely stops before it has finished what it started. Then again it must be said that the goal of a Sparkion can be anything, e.g. the extinction of all life in a certain area - and this does not necessarily look purposefully for an outsider. It is one of the most disturbing characteristics of the Sparkion to destroy and devastate everything around it, leaving a formless mass of matter which resembles the realm of the Sparkion's origin. Warnings are voiced that the vortexes need to be stopped; otherwise, swarms of…
sparkion.notes: Those that are located outside around the vortexes, do not yield any experience points.
sparkion.strat: It's strongly advised to wear as much Energy Damage protection as possible, most of the damage dealt by Extra Dimensionals creatures comes from this element. Otherworld monsters also deal a lot of Life Drain damage, so you can also consider wearing a Garlic Necklace or a Necklace of the Deep and put a Bone Fiddle in the extra slot.

spawn-of-despair.name: Spawn of Despair
spawn-of-despair.title: Spawn of Despair
spawn-of-despair.loc: Temple of Light, during certain circumstances in the Lightbearer event.
spawn-of-despair.strat: It is not advised to kill this monster, they are not intended to do so and give bad loot and experience.

spawn-of-the-schnitzel.name: Spawn of the Schnitzel
spawn-of-the-schnitzel.title: Spawn of the Schnitzel
spawn-of-the-schnitzel.beh: They follow you but don't cause any damage.
spawn-of-the-schnitzel.notes: Part of The Great Schnitzel Hunt during the Orcsoberfest event.
spawn-of-the-schnitzel.strat: Kill them and take the Schnitzel Meat Grinder to use on The Great Schnitzel.

spawn-of-the-welter.name: Spawn of the Welter
spawn-of-the-welter.title: Spawn of the Welter
spawn-of-the-welter.loc: When summoned, in Hydra Mountain large spawn, .
spawn-of-the-welter.notes: They are Eggs which are not killed quickly enough. They are slightly weaker than a Hydra.
spawn-of-the-welter.strat: Kill them quickly, or they will heal The Welter.

spectre.name: Spectre
spectre.title: Spectre
spectre.loc: Pits of Inferno, The Crystal Caves and The Soul Wells in The Inquisition Quest, Drefia Grim Reaper Dungeons, Vengoth Castle, Grounds of Despair and Oramond Fury Dungeon.
spectre.desc: The more powerful a soul has been in its lifetime, the more powerful it will be as a ghost. The more malicious and intelligent a soul has been in its lifetime, the greater the variety of powers it can demand as a ghost. For most ghosts it takes great effort to maintain some sort of sentience. Most end as drifting memories of the past, driven by emotions they do no longer understand. But some sinister beings are aware of the fate that looms above them. They research forbidden knowledge and forge dark pacts in time. This allows them to rise as a sentient and powerful form of ghost, known to those with mystical knowledge as Spectre. Spectres usually posses some being that functions as shell that they have prepared during lifetime. Often they use beings to which they have a strong emotional bond like family members. In the long run, the Spectres' puppets die away and leave the Spectre stranded in the world of mortals without a suitable host. Some succumb to madness when recognising it, others turn their frustration into hatred towards humanity. Being enemies of all things alive, they both pose a great threat to mortals.
spectre.beh: Returns quickly after it heals itself.
spectre.notes: This creature, despite it's lack of health, has deadly attacks which can deal enough damage to give you a free trip back to the Temple.
spectre.strat: A Sorcerer or Druid with 110+ level can use Energy Strike to solo a Spectre easily. Dwarven Ring is recommended, as it causes Drunkenness a lot (if you don't want to use it be sure to not to run in their Great Musical Bomb). Higher level Sorcerers (160+) can use Rage of the Skies to kill many at once as you can kill a Spectre by 2 hits. Note: it is posible to hunt them in inquisitions at level 110 as sorc if you get a friend making the hands runing away and clean the hffs. if you do so try only get 1 spectre and use normal energy strike. Really good exp and big profit is possible even at low level.

spellreaper-inferniarch.name: Spellreaper Inferniarch
spellreaper-inferniarch.title: Spellreaper Inferniarch
spellreaper-inferniarch.desc: Once thought extinct and only known to a few scholars, the sudden reappearance of inferniarchs has sparked fear among scholars and sorcerers alike. This is foremost caused by the dreaded Spellreapers. A quiet menace, the Spellreaper preys not on flesh, but on magic itself. While individually their power to suppress magical abilities is minor, in groups, they can silence entire armies of sorcerers. Their presence on the battlefield is marked by a disquieting void where spells falter, and enchantments unravel. These creatures serve as a grim reminder of the fragility of magic, leeching it from the world and reducing even the most accomplished mages to mere mortals. Often found in infernal circles, the Spellreapers surround their prey, draining their magical essence until nothing remains. It is said that the true terror of these beings lies in their hunger for more. Each bit of stolen magic makes them ever stronger, until they are nearly impossible to overcome.

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.title: Sphinx
sphinx.loc: Nykri Delta, Kilmaresh Central Steppe, Kilmaresh Southern Steppe, Kilmaresh Catacombs
sphinx.desc: Sphinxes have a leonine body, big feathered wings and human heads with their faces being a mix of humanoid and feline. The enigmatic creatures are a subspecies of the Anuma, magical beasts that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh and were created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. It is said that the entire continent was once given to them by the gods. But the Anuma conferred the dominance over Kilmaresh to the humans, in an effort to let them take responsibility of their own. However, after the religious war between the worshippers of Suon and Fafnar and the cataclysm that severed the continent, the Anuma took the reign over Kilmaresh back - for the humans' own benefit as they said. As all Anuma, sphinxes are highly intelligent and allegedly immortal, though they can die by lethal violence. Some of them love riddles, others are more interested in stories, poems or songs. Many sphinxes are benevolent, yet some are rather merciless and dangerous. All of them can be short-tempered if they feel that a human being will not accept their well-meant guidance. Sphinxes are physically powerful but possess inherent magical skills as well. They tend to test the worth of those seeking their help by…

spider.name: Spider
spider.title: Spider
spider.loc: Almost everywhere, in grass areas, sewers like Carlin sewers, caves like as Ancient Temple, Rookgaard and the Tiquanda Tarantula Caves.
spider.desc: Spiders live in the forests and dungeons of Tibia. They usually hunt small animals, but do not shrink back from attacking animals that are bigger than them. When they crop up in packs, they can even become dangerous for badly equipped adventurers.
spider.notes: Spiders are weak creatures and therefore good for gaining experience points at very low levels in Rookgaard. Donald McRonald of Thais will buy spider corpses for 2 gp. Note that he only buys regular spider corpses, not Poison Spider corpses.

spider-queen.name: Spider Queen
spider-queen.title: Spider Queen
spider-queen.loc: Can only be found in the in Rookgaard.
spider-queen.beh: Runs at you and will start to wrap you in silk and will take you too her web.
spider-queen.notes: The Spider Queen is immune to physical damage such as melee which is often used in Rookgaard. Nor will your skills advance if you attempt to train on it.
spider-queen.strat: The best way to avoid the Spider Queen is using a Greasy Stone so that it cannot smell you.

spidris.name: Spidris
spidris.title: Spidris
spidris.desc: The Spidris serve several purposes in the hive. They act as guardians and warriors and also as garbage disposal. They are known to devour any refuse and corpses in the range of the hive. The distinction between their purposes seems artificial, though. For the hive their purpose is probably only one - to get rid of unwanted stuff. They fulfil all their tasks with frightening precision and diligence. Their endless assaults wear down any resistance and their senses are even more keen than those of other hive creatures. They are perfect war machines that know no fear or mercy, yet, they display some cunning traits to retreat or to lure an opponent into ambushes when outnumbered or hard-pressed. The enigmatic appearance of the Spidris touches something subconsciously in the human mind and strikes fear into the hearts of those who encounter them on the battlefield. The fighting style of the Spidris is considered exceedingly cruel and unnecessarily destructive. They are known to waste a considerable amount of time to mutilate the bodies of slain enemies before continuing the fight. In the fight against the Deeplings, the Spidris are often used in the later phases. When the enemy is…
spidris.beh: Similar to a Destroyer or Behemoth.
spidris.notes: Usually found with a large amount of Spitters and other Spidris, occasionally also a couple of Kollos.
spidris.strat: Treat it like a Destroyer. Since they are rarely found alone, it is recommended for players to hunt them in a team. Mages are recommended to use Energy or Strong Ice Wave together with Avalanches when they come in hoards. Retargets fairly often, so blockers need to be alert. Watch out for other Hive Born that may emerge from any direction!

spidris-elite.name: Spidris Elite
spidris-elite.title: Spidris Elite
spidris-elite.loc: The Hive: east tower (beyond gates), west tower (including beyond gates), also anywhere Hive Overseers are found (as summons), Hive Outpost.
spidris-elite.notes: Spidris Elite are rarely met in The Hive. They are also summoned by Hive Overseers.
spidris-elite.strat: Take care of them as you would with a normal Spidris, only with stronger attacks.

spiky-carnivor.name: Spiky Carnivor
spiky-carnivor.title: Spiky Carnivor
spiky-carnivor.desc: This species as the name already says exclusively feeds on raw meat. The very special way of digesting its prey leads to very unique products a hunter can obtain. The items of interest are little glass plates that arise in the so called process of glassification. They are coveted materials for craftsmanship. During their development, they go through various stages which ultimately manifest in specific habits and appearance. The adolescent carnivor has already breeded a massive protective dorsum. So its name is spiky carnivor. Not only the appearence changes at that age but also the way of hunting. This species attacks its opponents mainly from distance, using its spikes as fatal projectiles. For hunters that prefer close combat it is a challenge to drive them into a corner. Distance fighters won't have that problem.
spiky-carnivor.strat: Be careful when fighting them as they usually come in large packs and followed by the other Carnivora.

spirit-of-earth.name: Spirit of Earth
spirit-of-earth.title: Spirit of Earth

ab.r: poisons up to 13 hp per turn

spirit-of-earth.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #8. Next #9.
spirit-of-earth.strat: To all vocations: try to keep diagonal to take less damage. Druid or Sorcerer: Run around using Ice Strike and a wand/rod possibly shooting icicle and SDs. Knight: Melee and Exori. Paladin: If you are fast enough try to run from him while shooting and using Ethereal Spear.

spirit-of-fire.name: Spirit of Fire
spirit-of-fire.title: Spirit of Fire
spirit-of-fire.notes: Last boss of Scrapper level Pit #10. Though it resembles a Hellfire Fighter it is much weaker than one.
spirit-of-fire.strat: It's Recommended to use Protection Amulet to reduce physical damages. Druid or Sorcerer: Use Magic Shield and shoot SD as fast as you can if your level is lower than 50. If your level is 45 or lower use 1 to 4 SSA to make mana last longer since almost all the damage you take is melee. At level 70 or higher you can use Ice Strike and Exura. Knight: Use melee and Exori and Strong Health Potions. Make sure your health is always high because this boss can take even experienced knights down with big combos. Paladin: Use Shield, Ethereal Spear and maybe even Icicle to kill him fast.

spirit-of-water.name: Spirit of Water
spirit-of-water.title: Spirit of Water
spirit-of-water.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #9. Next #10.
spirit-of-water.strat: Treat it like a strong water elemental. For all vocations it is wise to use a Helmet of the Deep since this will block the drown damage. Mages: Run around using an energy wand/death rod shooting energy strike. Heal often. Without Helmet of the Deep, use Magic Shield and kill with SD as fast as you can, or you will be dead very quickly. Knights: Melee and Exori trying to keep your HP constantly full. Paladins: Use a Shield and Ethereal Spear, bring plenty UHs.

spirit-overlord.name: Spirit Overlord
spirit-overlord.title: Spirit Overlord
spirit-overlord.loc: The Elemental Spheres Quest, Monk's part - Spirit Sphere.
spirit-overlord.notes: * Since it's release with the Monk Vocation Update, it always drops a Reality Splinter.

spit-nettle.name: Spit Nettle
spit-nettle.title: Spit Nettle
spit-nettle.loc: Tiquanda, Trapwood, the outskirts of Chor and Forbidden Lands, Alchemist Quarter in Yalahar, Tiquanda Laboratory.
spit-nettle.desc: A rather strange plant of the jungle in Tiquanda is the Spit Nettle. To some extent this plant is a sentient being that attacks everything that approaches it. Most jungle dwellers seem to have developed some strategy to coexist with that plant. Outsiders however are immediately attacked with poisonous thorns that the nettle spits from a sack beneath its blossoms. It seems it has an endless supply of thorns and we have not heard yet of a nettle that has run out of them. It is not quite clear why a plant would attack in such a manner, but most likely it is some sort of self-defence that is unparalleled in the plant world. The lizard people have cultivated that plant to defend their dwellings. So utmost caution is advised when you encounter a colony of those plants, some angry 'gardener' could be just around the corner.
spit-nettle.beh: Does not move and cannot be pushed. All its attacks are at a distance and earth-damage.
spit-nettle.notes: They can attack you from a long distance even before you can see them on your screen! Some spawns are behind walls or plants, so you cannot reach them to attack with melee. In these cases, you need to use distance attacks to kill them.
spit-nettle.strat: Druids and Sorcerers: Try not to use Energy attacks on them. It is better to avoid them, as they only give 20 exp have a good defence and can do some serious damage, which can be dangerous for a low level.

spite-of-the-emperor.name: Spite of the Emperor
spite-of-the-emperor.title: Spite of the Emperor
spite-of-the-emperor.notes: Introduced in Summer Update 2010. Part of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.

spitter.name: Spitter
spitter.title: Spitter
spitter.desc: Although the spittle of these creatures servers as a formidable weapon in combat, the Spitters original purpose for the hive seems to be entirely different. The Spitter can obviously produce quite different kinds of spittle. The most often observed feature is the ability to use some kind of gooey spittle that can trap smaller opponents and that becomes hard and resilient when drying up. It is often used to repair hive structures on the fly or even to erect some structures such as barricades when used by larger groups of Spitters. Since it takes some time to harden, it is only annoying and disgusting for bigger opponents such as humans, for this reason this kind of spittle is rarely seen in combat. In battle, they rather use their corrosive spittle. The use of this kind of spittle outside of war is somewhat up to speculations. It seems possible that it is used to dissolve hive structures that are no longer needed. The dissolved structures can be devoured by several of the hive creatures and later be used as construction material again. Adventurers that made forays into the deeper hive observed a third use of the spittle which seems the most important for the hive. The Spitters are…
spitter.notes: Was implemented at the Winter Update 2011.
spitter.strat: Usually found in large groups with other Hive Born. Take them down first if you're fighting them alongside Crawlers or Waspoids, but leave them for last if battling Spidris or Kollos.

splasher.name: Splasher
splasher.title: Splasher
splasher.loc: At Yalahar, Sunken Quarter. When entering the Sunken Quarter step down from the underwater hill and head to south-west, there you should find stairs which takes you down to the boss. The boss is behind a sealed door, so make sure you have the access to that room.

spyrat.name: Spyrat
spyrat.title: Spyrat (Facing South)
spyrat.loc: Raids in Darashia - , Liberty Bay - and Port Hope - .
spyrat.beh: Does not move from where it spawns, shoots area attacks from a distance, will attack with melee if you get close to it.
spyrat.notes: Spawns in raids during A Pirate's Tail Quest.
spyrat.strat: Use distance or rune attacks if possible as their melee attacks are quite high.

squid-warden.name: Squid Warden
squid-warden.title: Squid Warden
squid-warden.desc: The squid warden is a member of a servant race of the god Zathroth that communicates telepathically and has no pronounceable name on their own. They underwent generations after generations of strict breeding programs of their leaders. This lead to an extreme specialised cast-like system in which the squid warden served as a kind of police force. Favouring secret knowledge as source of power, they follow a complex set of rules and laws that are not commonly known. They are often found patrolling extremely important and holy places dedicated to Zathroth and his principles. Bread as enforcers they have a formidable array of offensive powers, can not be bribed and hardly reasoned with. They seamlessly blend magic and their natural telepathy with frightening efficiency and seem impervious to pain thanks to their willpower. Due to their for outsiders incomprehensible behavior patters that follow their own secret rules, they are not well-liked by other Zathroth worshipers. The higher ranks in the cult, however, employ them nonetheless and willingly accept a few casualties in the own ranks when someone breaks the unspoken rules of the wardens. Though able to communicate with others than…
squid-warden.strat: Use as much Ice Damage protection as you can, because this will be the biggest part of the damage when fighting these creatures.

squidgy-slime.name: Squidgy Slime
squidgy-slime.title: Squidgy Slime
squidgy-slime.loc: Horestis Tomb during one of the states of The Mummy's Curse World Change. As summons, anywhere where Slimes can be found.
squidgy-slime.notes: These are summoned by Slime, being a weaker version of it. The only wild spawns of this creatures are conditioned to the state of The Mummy's Curse World Change.

squirrel.name: Squirrel
squirrel.title: Squirrel
squirrel.loc: North of Carlin, Northwest of Thais, East of Kazordoon, Yalahar, Dawnport, Edron Hunters Camp, Plains of Havoc and other Tibian woods.
squirrel.desc: The impish Squirrel is said to be a distant relative of skunks and leprechauns. The original diminutive Squirrels grew to enormous proportions after eating nuts from Crunor's blessed trees of life. The legend goes that the first Squirrels who ate the nuts became immortal and grew to Squirrels as large as houses over the time. Hunters avoid preying on Squirrels. The little rodents are not only extremely swift, but there is also a legend that says that the giant Squirrels take bloody revenge on all killers of their descendants. Anyway, Squirrels are also considered as force of good which puts them in opposition to the evil penguins. There seems to be a blood feud between Squirrels and penguins which is proven by the fact that you never encounter Squirrels and penguins in the same area.
squirrel.beh: Squirrels are as fast as a level 130.
squirrel.strat: Try to trap them against walls or trees or, failing that, use any area attack rune, because catching one can be extremely difficult.

stabilizing-dread-intruder.name: Stabilizing Dread Intruder
stabilizing-dread-intruder.title: Stabilizing Dread Intruder
stabilizing-dread-intruder.desc: The Stabilizing Dread Intruder is a weaker version of Dread Intruders.
stabilizing-dread-intruder.notes: Those that are located outside around the vortexes do not yield any experience points.
stabilizing-dread-intruder.strat: Be careful, they can easily combo a level 110 knight if they are with 3 or more.

stabilizing-reality-reaver.name: Stabilizing Reality Reaver
stabilizing-reality-reaver.title: Stabilizing Reality Reaver
stabilizing-reality-reaver.desc: The Stabilizing Reality Reaver is a weaker version of Reality Reavers.
stabilizing-reality-reaver.notes: Those that are located outside around the vortexes do not yield any experience points.
stabilizing-reality-reaver.strat: You can solo one at level 100, but if they come with more than 3 even level 110 is not enough.

stag.name: Stag
stag.title: Stag
stag.desc: A stag is truly a king in his own way. Hunting deer is a common practice throughout the realms of Tibia and their mighty antlers are the crown jewel of many a huntsman's trophy collection. There was a time when hunting these majestic beasts was a given right to every Tibian citizen. However, many lords and kings have since prohibited hunting deer on their lands, declaring the grounds these delicate beings roamed as protected forests. Owning these lands meant owning its deer. Breaking such laws was punishable by death which made hunting there not exactly a reliable source of income. Except for cunning poachers and a few vagabonds with nothing to lose. Stolen venison was not easy to turn into cash and you could easily find other animals to hunt or eat. Who would say no to a fresh rotworm stew, an acquired taste but easily made and far from a criminal offense. The stag and its venison became quite a rare commodity, and rightfully so.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.title: Stalker
stalker.loc: Triangle Tower, Drefia, Edron Hero Cave in the Warlock room, White Flower Temple, Ghostlands, Shadow Tomb, Ancient Ruins Tomb, Tarpit Tomb, Stone Tomb, Mountain Tomb, Peninsula Tomb, Oasis Tomb, Yalahar Trade Quarter and Isle of the Kings.
stalker.desc: Stalkers are persons that are permanently invisible. They sneak up to their victim, and attack it suddenly. Some of these assassins have been spotted at Edron. They stab with their daggers and suck life energy out of their opponents, but if the first strike is not deadly, they are weak fighters.
stalker.notes: Humans that can quickly go invisible. They sneak up on intruders and try to kill them quickly.
stalker.strat: You can't attack this creature with melee while it is invisible. The only way to defeat them is with Magic or by making them visible again by attacking them with area runes (Avalanche, Explosion, GFB, Stone Shower or Thunderstorm), making them walk over a trap, an area spell like Berserk or using Cancel Invisibility. Sometimes they don't go invisible right away or at all and can be meleed. If you can't do anything but melee you can take stalkers by going down/up stairs or a cliff and waiting until they are visible, then attacking them. Knights: Make them visible using one of the runes above or use Berserk, Groundshaker or Fierce Berserk, then attack them with melee. They are weak in defense, so a knight can easily kill one. The will also work to kill stalkers, even if they are invisible. Paladins: Make them visible using one of the runes above or use Divine Missile or Divine Caldera and attack with distance. Mages: Make them visible using one of the runes above or an attack spell. Another good idea, since stalkers always stick by you, is to hotkey one of the runes above and set the target as yourself. Since it doesn't harm you. Keep an eye on your hp bar, as it is hard to tell how…

stalking-stalk.name: Stalking Stalk
stalking-stalk.title: Stalking Stalk
stalking-stalk.desc: The stalking stalks are more of a carrion exploiter by planting their seeds into fertile corpses. And they don't shun away from creating such corpses by physical force at all.With quite an arsenal of natural weaponry they actively attack when they are 'fertile'. While out of seeds to spread, the stalking stalks become inert and hide in the thickets by perfect mimicry, becoming inanimate and appearing as a perfect copy of a number of other plants common in Gnomprona. This ability has fascinated scientists as the stalking stalk seems not limited to one form to shift into. There are experiments in progress that try to find out how exactly this ability works and how the limits are defined. Specific stalks seem to be limited to a set amount of other plants to mimic, though those might vary from stalk to stalk. To entice the stalks to shift into any plant which is not native to Gnomprona have not yet met any success at all.Their resilient seeds are even more dangerous to the carrion eaters of Gnomprona. The seeds often resist most digestive tracts of the local creatures, but more often than not begin to sprout while still in the stomachs of such creatures. The blooming stalk takes root…

stampor.name: Stampor
stampor.title: Stampor
stampor.loc: Stampor Cave on the Muggy Plains ( ), Chyllfroest.
stampor.desc: Scientists have various theories about the nature of the Stampor. Some of them see the Stampor as holy animal of a long forgotten god. Others claim that the Stampor must be some surviving experiment of an ancient and now extinct race. Another faction sees the Stampor as an ordinary animal with a high affinity to the element earth. All of them base their theories on the Stampor's astonishing abilities which nonetheless seem rather natural and not based on magic at all. Be it as it may, the Stampors that have been encountered were quite powerful and often a threat to travellers. This is not caused by an unusual aggressiveness of the Stampor, but rather on their stupidity and bad eyesight. They seem to mistake unknown intruders as members of other Stampor herds which they try to drive off. While a Stampor is very resilient and tough and can easily withstand the 'friendly poking' and spitting, for an ordinary human such friendly warnings can become life-threatening. They seem to be drawn to places aligned to elemental earth in some way and there were sightings of Stampors in areas to which they would be physically unable to travel. Of course this only fuelled rumours and the above…
stampor.beh: This creature changes target easily and can swap back just as fast. Blocker/shooter teamhunts are discouraged due to their erratic behavior.
stampor.notes: Stampors are a tameable creature. You may hunt 600 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Tromphonyte.
stampor.strat: Mages: Can hunt them from level 80 and above. Sorcerers should use Wand of Voodoo and Druids, Springsprout Rod in combination with Earth Strike. Be careful as they can come in groups of two, keep Exura Gran ready incase you need it. Another strategy, if you are a Mage, is to lure 4-6 Stampors and kill them using Stone Shower Runes, this is recommended for Druids/Sorcerers above level 110. You do not need to stand diagonal in order to avoid any waves although, their Berserk may cause a lot damage, it is advised to keep some distance. In the cave you will walk slow because of the bad ground so when there are many use Strong Haste to outrun them. Knights and Paladins should not hunt these monsters due to their skill reduction ability, which is used quite frequently.

starving-wolf.name: Starving Wolf
starving-wolf.title: Starving Wolf
starving-wolf.loc: East, west and south-west of the Femor Hills.
starving-wolf.notes: They will spawn when an excessive amount of White Deer has been killed the previous day. You can lure them into a Magic Wolf Trap, which will turn it into a Captured Wolf. You can hand these in with Benevola.

stone-devourer.name: Stone Devourer
stone-devourer.title: Stone Devourer
stone-devourer.desc: The Stone Devourer is a creature that the dwarfs thought to be extinct, after they had exterminated all Stone Devourers they encountered in their caves and mines. The Stone Devourers have not been seen for centuries. Only recently have they resurfaced and sadly proven that the creatures the dwarfs encountered in the past were either a lesser variation or merely their juvenile forms. The true Stone Devourers are certainly more dangerous than those of the dwarven chronicles. They are underground dwellers displaying extreme aggressiveness and destructiveness. They often live in packs led by an alpha male. Oddly enough, the alpha seems to accept the submission of certain other races, which are then integrated into their packs. They are also alarmingly not territorial. Their packs wander the depths aimlessly, devouring and destroying everything in their way. The stone devourers are extremely resilient towards environmental conditions and seem not to mind to camp in areas that are extremely hazardous to other creatures. Therefore they often surprise wanderers who are familiar with the surroundings by attacking from unexpected places.

stone-golem.name: Stone Golem
stone-golem.title: Stone Golem
stone-golem.loc: Maze of Lost Souls, in and around Ashta'daramai, Formorgar Mines, Mad Technomancer room, Dark Cathedral, Demona, Goroma, Tarpit Tomb, Peninsula Tomb, Deeper Banuta, Forbidden Lands, Beregar Mines, Farmine Mines, Drillworm Caves, 2 caves on Hrodmir ( and ), Orc Fortress (single spawn, ) and Medusa Tower.
stone-golem.desc: Stone Golems are kind of living rocks. All their limbs are out of stone, and they live on stones. They live in the dungeons of Edron, where they find their favourite food, granite with quartz. Normally, they are peaceful, but they can get very angry about adventurers trampling on their food and try to slay the intruder using their incredible power.
stone-golem.beh: Stone Golems chase their opponents, and will not run from a fight.
stone-golem.notes: Big and Resistant creatures, their stone skin protects them from almost every element. You may hunt 200 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
stone-golem.strat: They don't take off high damage, a medium leveled knight should be able to block them easily. Paladins should run and shoot. Mages should just run around and use Ice Strike along with their strongest ice wand/rod. Treat it like a strong cyclops.

stone-rhino.name: Stone Rhino
stone-rhino.title: Stone Rhino
stone-rhino.desc: The stone rhino is a strange, reclusive beast that lives in remote areas. Despite its threatening appearance, it's a mostly harmless herbivore that tends to itself. Sadly, the stone rhino is also highly territorial and easily provoked. The stone rhino sees everything as a threat and doesn't hesitate to attack. In addition to its remarkable size and strength, stone rhino is also armed with a dangerous horn on its nose which makes it a formidable opponent. With this weapon the stone rhino is able to fend off most of its natural enemies with ease. However, some super predators like dragons hunt the stone rhino for the challenge and keep its population low. The stone rhinos prefer spots of grassland in the wilderness where they can lazily graze the whole day undisturbed. Some individuals and groups have even adapted to a life in the woods, although this only happens rarely. The stone rhino seems rather clumsy and slow when watched from afar. However, more than one explorer has been surprised by the eruption of speed and force a stone rhino can burst into as soon as it gets angry. To anger a stone rhino is not only a particularly stupid thing to do, it is also quite easily…
stone-rhino.notes: You may attempt to tame one by using an Astral Shaper Rune on the rhino, which can earn you the Stone Rhino (Mount) along with the achievement Rhino Rider. Note that a failed attempt will not cause the Stone Rhino to disappear but the Astral Shaper Rune will become an Inert Astral Shaper Rune
stone-rhino.strat: These creatures can only harm you in close combat, so maintain your distance unless you're a knight. If you plan to hunt them, a Dwarven Ring can help you avoid Drunkenness.

stonecracker.name: Stonecracker
stonecracker.title: Stonecracker
stonecracker.loc: Stonecracker spawns near the stairs which lead to the Behemoth Quest room. It's also possible that it spawns after the level 30 door (as shown in the image) with 3 Behemoths. There were rumours at one time that it dropped Earthborn Titan Armor which appear to be false.
stonecracker.beh: This boss behaves similar to a Behemoth, only with stronger attacks and the ability to heal itself.
stonecracker.notes: Appeared the first time with Summer Update 2008. He is a random spawn with no announcement. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. The portal which leads to the boss is upstairs in west tunnel of the deepest floor of Cyclopolis ( ).
stonecracker.strat: Fairly easy for a level 80 knight to block.

stonerefiner.name: Stonerefiner
stonerefiner.title: Stonerefiner
stonerefiner.beh: They use physical and earth type damage to beat their opponents.
stonerefiner.notes: With an insatiable and voracious appetite for minerals, Stonerefiners live away from the sunlight, in dark caves where their sight is at its best. Strong and fast, they use their strong jaws & dangerously sharp teeth to attack those that challenge them. Their acid spit -capable of breaking down even rock- will deal earth damage similar to a stone shower. Additionally, they can cause tremors similar to a knights Berserk. Their scaley skin is grey from their mineral & rock diet and their eyes are bloodshot red. It is said that these reptiles evolved from the water, you can see their bodies are still reminiscent of a fish - especially the tail and skull. They had to evolve to walk on land for access to better minerals, as well as to evade stronger predators. DO NOT underestimate these creatures, adventurer. They may look weak, but they are deceptively strong, particularly for rookie players. If in groups, even an experienced player can find themselves in trouble. Invisibility or a stealth ring is your friend here, to evade them and avoid getting trapped to a most certainly painful death.
stonerefiner.strat: Mages 30+ can face them using ice strike and fire strike spells or using avalanche, icicle, great fireball and fireball runes since they are weak against those elements. It's highly recommended for noob players to wear an Energy Ring or use Magic Shield (if you are mage) 'cause they tend to be in groups of 3-5 and can hit high combos. Using runes to kill'em in groups it is recommended. Paladins and Knights 40+ should defeat them quickly because they're weak against physical damage. Elite Knights can lure more at a time and Exori them to speed up xp gain. Lower level players with good skills can level up quickly using stealth rings since they can't sense invisibility.

streaked-devourer.name: Streaked Devourer
streaked-devourer.title: Streaked Devourer
streaked-devourer.desc: It seems highly likely that the streaked devourers are a more adolescent version of the usually more numerous cave devourers. It's debatable if the factor in this change is really physical age or just the amount or quality of devoured material, but such thoughts become pointless when confronted with a ravenous mass of teeth that want to destroy you. Their power and ferociousness are strengthened over time as is their toughness. It's still driven by eternal hunger and shows no more restraint in following it's primal impulses than his younger self did. Before entering the transformation into a streaked devourer, the creature swells to twice its size and becomes rather slow. In such a phase it's extremely vulnerable and can hardly fight back. The transformation takes place in a couple of weeks in which the devourer retreats to a remote spot. In the end of the transformation the devourer sheds its old skin which had dried up and wrinkled away over time. Sometimes a devourer that is transitioning into the next phase becomes immobile and over time turns more and more into stone. It is probable that such specimens lack the right minerals to go through the whole transformative process to…

strong-glooth-horror.name: Strong Glooth Horror
strong-glooth-horror.title: Strong Glooth Horror
strong-glooth-horror.notes: He is the second "boss" of the Hero of Rathleton Quest. Glooth Horror will split into 2 Strong Glooth Horrors. When slain, the Strong Glooth Horror will turn into 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors.

sugar-cube.name: Sugar Cube
sugar-cube.title: Sugar Cube
sugar-cube.desc: The small living sugar cubes of Candia are delicate creatures fashioned entirely out of sugar crystals. Some roam carefree across the sweet, colourful surface of their world, but many also work in the underground chocolate mines. Industrious but sometimes clumsy, the sugar cubes mine the raw, unrefined chocolate and refine it into creamy, delicious goodness. They mix it with other ingredients, use machinery and tools to shape it, and package it for storage and distribution. The sugar cubes are known for being diligent and hardworking, but often clumsy due to their rectangular shape. Sometimes they fall into milk or cacao lakes and need help getting out. They also can be very talkative and prone to getting distracted while working. But apart from that, they are definitely the force that keeps Candia's chocolate production going.

sugar-cube-worker.name: Sugar Cube Worker
sugar-cube-worker.title: Sugar Cube Worker
sugar-cube-worker.desc: Sugar Cube Workers are especially industrious Sugar Cubes.

sugar-daddy.name: Sugar Daddy
sugar-daddy.title: Sugar Daddy
sugar-daddy.notes: Despite his sweet looks, this foe should not be underestimated, especially since you can only face him on your own. Besides his regular attacks, this boss will also spawn sugary minions under certain conditions. During these phases, you will suffer from the condition Powerless that prevents you from using attack spells and attack runes while it is active. You should try to take out these slippery creatures quickly or you will give Sugar Daddy the opportunity to experience a real sugar rush that will considerably increase the danger of this boss encounter.
sugar-daddy.strat: Sugar Daddy spawns 5 summons at approximately 3/4 health, 1/2 health, and 1/4 health. During that time, you will be Powerless and can only attack with auto-attacks. If you fail to kill all 5 summons in 15 seconds, the Hexed effect will last for 1 minute and the boss will heal some life, making the battle harder. After killing him you can use a Spoon or any Secret Agent Tools on his body to recover full life and mana. A good strategy—albeit time-consuming—is to fill the boss room as much as possible with Fire Bomb runes (it takes around 47 to fill the entire room); this tactic kills all the boss's spawns, making it effective for a Knight tackling this boss.

sugar-mommy.name: Sugar Mommy
sugar-mommy.title: Sugar Mommy
sugar-mommy.loc: Can be found in the Dessert Dungeons ( ), but only on the weekends, from Friday's server save to Monday's server save.

sulphider.name: Sulphider
sulphider.title: Sulphider
sulphider.desc: The peculiar flora and fauna of Gnomprona hosts a tremendous amount of unique life forms. The discovery of the land in the depths of Tibia sparked a debate, if it rather preserves or created the special creatures encountered there. The current consensus seems to be something in-between. It seems likely that many of the gnompronean life forms are primordial ancestors of creatures encountered elsewhere in the world. Yet it seems likely that centuries of generations, tempered by the harsh primeval land have left their mark and changed the creatures over the course of time. The sulphur spider seems to belong to one of the latter cases. At first classified by some to be an elemental and less an actually creature, closer inspections of slain spiders have disproven this by far and wide. In fact these spiders are probably the progenitors of many of the gigantic spiders that can be found all over the world. Despite their visual familiarity to creatures like the crystal spiders they share more in arrangement of their organs with the well-known giant spider. This turned former scientific theories upside down and now scientists lean towards the theory that the sulphider is the evolution of a…

sulphur-scuttler.name: Sulphur Scuttler
sulphur-scuttler.title: Sulphur Scuttler
sulphur-scuttler.loc: Muggy Plains. Its teleporter is located .
sulphur-scuttler.notes: Brimstone Bug's boss. Part of the Paw and Fur Society tasks of Grizzly Adams. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
sulphur-scuttler.strat: Treat it as you would treat a regular Brimstone Bug.

sulphur-spouter.name: Sulphur Spouter
sulphur-spouter.title: Sulphur Spouter
sulphur-spouter.desc: The sulphur spouter seems to be an elemental and less an actually creature by classification. While other fringe theories suggest that the spouters are just heaps of sulphur possessed and animated by some kind of nature spirit and more related to fairies and pixies there is no proof to support such claims. Whatever their true origin might be, they are on the intelligence level of an animal and able to act on purpose and with an agenda in a limited way. Why this agenda usually seems to involve violence and destruction is not known though. The spouter seems not to rely on any form of sustenance but it seems somewhat to 'recharge' in proximity to naturally occurring sulphur. Therefore the spouter are usually found close to natural occurrences of sulphur like volcanic cracks. There are some vague hints that the sulphur spouters are not native to Gnomprona but migrated there from somewhere else. They seem to be relatively 'new' to the area, though new in the case of such primordial place still means an enormous amount of time to mortal creatures. As their corpses leave distinctive marks on earth, e4xcacvations revealed that such marks are missing in the deepest layers where still bones…

superior-death-minion.name: Superior Death Minion
superior-death-minion.title: Superior Death Minion
superior-death-minion.notes: An evolved form of the Greater Death Minion. Try to kill these before they become even stronger.

svoren-the-mad.name: Svoren the Mad
svoren-the-mad.title: Svoren the Mad
svoren-the-mad.notes: Is the boss of Warlord level Pit #5. Next #6
svoren-the-mad.strat: To all vocations keep diagonal to avoid waves. Recommended to use Protection Amulet.

swamp-troll.name: Swamp Troll
swamp-troll.title: Swamp Troll
swamp-troll.loc: Port Hope Swamp Trolls, Venore Swamp Troll Cave, all around north area of Port Hope, small spawn north-west of Venore and in cave south-east of Thais ( ), also one in Foreigner Quarter.
swamp-troll.desc: Swamp Trolls are a variety of normal trolls that live in the swamps in the east of Tibia. Like the other tribes of trolls, they hunt animals and seek treasures. But they are a bit stronger and they soak their claws with the extracts of some poisonous herbs they collect in the swamps in order to envenom their opponents. So they can be quite dangerous to inexperienced adventurers.
swamp-troll.beh: They run when they are with low health.
swamp-troll.notes: They are a bit stronger than Trolls and Frost Trolls and they can poison you, but they are not immune to earth themselves which means Druids with Snakebite Rods or Terra Rods are able kill them rather easily, although not recommended for level 13- Druids. After the 8.2 summer update they now drop Spears as loot which makes them a good choice for low level Paladins to hunt. At least some Swamp Trolls around Venore worship the Football according to the book Holy Book of Swamptrolls.
swamp-troll.strat: Just attack them, there's no big difference between them and Trolls. Always have food, because the poison can be annoying for low levels. Low level mages can wear a Terra Hood to block their 1 HP per turn poison.

swampling.name: Swampling
swampling.title: Swampling
swampling.loc: Lair of the Treeling Witch, Venore swamp area, Venore Salamander Cave, Tiquanda Laboratory.
swampling.desc: The Swamplings are probably somehow related to the haunted treelings that appear in the realm of the living only on special occasions. They are a mixture of plant and animal and are at least partially intelligent. Though it will not react to attempts of communication in any other way than by attacking, it is considered to be an established fact that the Swampling has some ability to react and plan ahead in ways unknown to most animals. Swamplings are known to build simple traps, set ambushes and to make use of the surroundings to kill their prey. Though it seems that Swamplings can live on water and fertile soil for indefinite periods of time, they prefer to spice up their diet with the corpses of once living beings. The Swamplings seem to prefer intelligent beings to mere animals as their prey. It is assumed that the cause for this is not necessity, but rather the Swampling's evil nature. The Swampling population in the known world has survived many attempts to purge them from certain areas or from existence as a whole by the sentient races. Even the most successful attempts have only managed to drive them back for a while though. It has to be assumed that the Swampling seeds…
swampling.strat: Just kill it like you would any other creature.

swan-maiden.name: Swan Maiden
swan-maiden.title: Swan Maiden
swan-maiden.desc: Swan maidens are a kind of fae who can shapeshift from a young elven or human female into a beautiful swan. The magical item allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. If this cloak is taken from a swan maiden, she is stuck in the shape she had at the time of the theft. She will only be able to shapeshift again when she regains her cloak. On Feyrist it is always hard to tell whether a swan swimming on a lake is an ordinary animal or a swan maiden in her bird shape. Swan maidens protect the wilds of their secret realm from intruders and live in small flocks along secluded lakeshores. It is told that a swan maiden can transform a willing human or elven virgin into a swan maiden herself. Swan maidens emerge from mortals' dreams about flying.
swan-maiden.beh: Swan Maidens try to attack their opponents at a distance using their spells.
swan-maiden.strat: Wearing a Bronze Amulet could be a good idea in order to counter their commonly used mana drain attack. Otherwise they're not that strong and your biggest worry should be running into groups of other Feyrist creatures while chasing them.

swarmer.name: Swarmer
swarmer.title: Swarmer
swarmer.desc: Swarmers are usually encountered in greater numbers. They emit pheromones to coordinate their efforts, and even when their fast movements seem aimless and unprovoked sometimes, they always serve some hidden purpose. With the help of pheromones and touch, they seem to have some form of communication with each other. They are often seen to act as one, effortlessly moving in patterns that often mirror those of the other Swarmers. This strange connection of the Swarmers seems not to extend to their hive brethren, though. It has been observed that irritated Swarmers attacked other hive creatures and sometimes even devour them. When in a food frenzy, they are often compared to the feared piranhas. Swarmers seem always eager to collect biomass for the hive one way or the other. This often means the devouring of living matter, be it plants, garbage or living creatures. Brought back to the hive, it is stored as a putrid, half-digested mass. It is assumed that Swarmers also feed other Hive Born, particularly the kollos. Swarmers are assumed to be the most numerous of the Hive Born although not necessarily the ones most often encountered. Daring adventurers that have torn down hive…
swarmer.notes: Was implemented in the Winter Update 2011.
swarmer.strat: Runs away really fast, so if you're planning on killing them it might be a good idea to block the way with a Fire Wall rune.

swarmer-hatchling.name: Swarmer Hatchling
swarmer-hatchling.title: Swarmer Hatchling
swarmer-hatchling.notes: Was implemented at the Winter Update 2011. It is a "baby" Swarmer and can be seen by using a Swarmer Drum to summon one. Use a Flask of Dissolved Chitin on it to "feed" it then it will "burrow" back to Orockle for the "Dissolve Chitin" mission in the the War Against The Hive Quest.

tainted-soul.name: Tainted Soul
tainted-soul.title: Tainted Soul
tainted-soul.loc: Tainted Caves in the Green Claw Swamp.
tainted-soul.desc: If an unlucky mortal gets lost in the swamps and meets his death there, often his soul is unable to find peace. It haunts the bogs as a wraith or ghost light in search of peace and salvation. Such hapless souls may be captured and cursed by evil witches or warlocks, thus transforming into tainted souls that aggressively and enviously attack everything they encounter. There are tales though that it is possible to redeem even these tainted souls.
tainted-soul.notes: They are souls tainted by the witch Ekatrix. They can be redeemed by using a Sacred Antler Talisman on them. The process of tainting and redeeming them is described in How to Curse a Soul. You must redeem 100 of them to fight the boss Ekatrix in The Tainted Souls Quest.
tainted-soul.strat: They yield no experience and very poor loot, so they aren't worth hunting unless if you want to complete its Bestiary entry or gain Weapon Proficiency. If you have a Sacred Antler Talisman, you can use it to redeem them. After using the Sacred Antler Talisman and the Redeemed Soul is spawned, the Tainted Soul can persist for up to two seconds and killed without interrupting the Redeemed Soul spawn, the later which can be killed for its own Bestiary and to gain Weapon Proficiency as well, so it is possible to progress both bestiaries and count progress to access Ekatrix chamber.

tame-terror-bird.name: Tame Terror Bird
tame-terror-bird.title: Tame Terror Bird
tame-terror-bird.notes: Looks the same as a Terror Bird

tamed-frazzlemaw.name: Tamed Frazzlemaw
tamed-frazzlemaw.title: Tamed Frazzlemaw
tamed-frazzlemaw.loc: The ground floor of the Stag Bastion.
tamed-frazzlemaw.notes: It can be tamed using a Marinated Sturgeon.

tamru-the-black.name: Tamru the Black
tamru-the-black.title: Tamru the Black
tamru-the-black.notes: This boss, just like Ayana the Crimson Curse and Owin, only spawns during Full Moon. It has a random spawn time between 30 to 60 minutes.

tanjis.name: Tanjis
tanjis.title: Tanjis

ab.n: Self Healing about once per turn

tanjis.beh: Tanjis will target the player hitting him for the most damage. Typically, this is a high level Paladin. He will not retarget to a player blocking his path.
tanjis.notes: Tanjis, Expeditus Profundis, is one of the three depth lords. He is the most harmless but most frequently appearing of the deepling guardians. Access to his lair is earned by helping to repair the ramp to the Ancestral Grounds, during the Liquid Black Quest. Teams may enter each guardian's lair once for each time they make a sufficient attempt to repair the ramp to the Ancestral Grounds. However, access to any further guardians is revoked if players open any treasure chest outside of their lairs. Tanjis spawns each 3-10 minutes, depending on players online, and cannot be blocked from spawning. Teams can stay in its room for 20 minutes, the timer starts when entering the teleport. Re-entry is denied after players gain experience from it. Thus, teams can earn a few minutes by jumping out and in its lair when the first boss is on deep red HP. Tanjis always drops exactly one item: Depth Ocrea, Ornate Mace, or Ornate Shield. Players who receive experience from killing Tanjis will be able to open the treasure chest outside of his lair, to receive Trophy of Tanjis, 20 Platinum Coins, Necklace of the Deep, Warrior's Shield and either Tanjis' Sight or 10 Black Pearls.
tanjis.strat: You will need a lot of firepower, perhaps 4 or more players of level 150+. It is highly recommended that all team members use Bronze Amulets due to his retargeting behavior. The general strategy is to trap Tanjis and fire at him until he is dead. Trapping Tanjis can be difficult. Because of his re-targeting behavior, the shooters are advised to stand away from Tanjis while the blocker lures and traps him. The environment makes trapping him difficult also, knights will almost always be forced to stand in waves/beams because Wild Growth will not last long enough. Once trapped, it's a battle against his healing. Tanjis will attack shooters very frequently, even when trapped. Shooters can expect to be hit with strong Mana Drain and Ice-based attacks every 2-5 turns. Shooters are recommended to position themselves away from other team members, or move to another location when they find themselves being targeted (but be mindful of his waves). This avoids unnecessary mana/health loss for the other members.

tarantula.name: Tarantula
tarantula.title: Tarantula
tarantula.loc: Tiquanda Tarantula Caves, Spider Caves, Corym Mines, Trapwood ground level and underground, in 2 small caves South of Thais, Dark Cathedral, single spawn on top of Crocodile den north of Port Hope ( ), Plains of Havoc, underground Liberty Bay, Nargor Undead Cave and other constituents of the Shattered Isles, Green Claw Swamp ( ), first floor up in the big building in the Cemetery Quarter, Robson Isle, Vengoth. After the summer update of 2008, tarantulas can be seen on the beginner's island of Rookgaard.
tarantula.desc: The Tarantula is another nasty variant of the spider family. It is not bound to a certain habitat, so it can be encountered in caves, forests and ruins alike. Therefore it poses a threat everywhere but in the coldest or volcanic areas. It is aggressive and dangerous and it is not choosier in its diet than in its habitat. Anything is seen as prey and sometimes they even cannibalise creatures of their own species. Its poisonous fangs are more than enough to make these beasts a constant threat to the settlers but many extermination campaigns have driven them back from the centres of civilisation. Still the sight of a single Tarantula is usually enough for a town to hire some scouts and mercenaries to examine the area more closely.
tarantula.notes: Tarantulas usually spawn in groups with other weaker monsters or together with a Giant Spider (in the Plains of Havoc, for example). Kill the weaker monsters off first so they do not break your shielding. Also note that tarantulas are dangerous in groups due to their ability to haste and surround their prey. GFBs work nicely to kill the tarantulas and the other creatures. You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Hide.
tarantula.strat: Knights: Can kill them with little waste of potions with around 60/60. It is important to continuously move in circles to avoid being hit by more than 2 at a time to achieve optimal efficiency. With good skills like 80/80 and level 35+(and if waste doesn't matter) you could lure some together and use Exori. Normally two Exoris are enough to kill them. Like this you can kill them faster as usually and finish a Grizzly Task fast. Paladins: A Level of 20 is recommended to outrun them and around 50 distance to not waste ammunition. A level 25 paladin with skills 60/50 can handle 2 of them with no problem. Mages: Wand or rod and runes or spells to kill faster. Flame Strike (Sorcerer and Druid) is the preferred spell (due to tarantula's highest weakness to fire) for those looking to optimize their stamina. Sorcerers can use Fire Wave and Druids can use Ice Wave to kill a group of Arachnids.

tarbaz.name: Tarbaz
tarbaz.title: Tarbaz

ab.n: Wall Breaker (destroys Magic Walls and Wild Growths)

tarbaz.loc: Grounds of Despair, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.

tarnished-spirit.name: Tarnished Spirit
tarnished-spirit.title: Tarnished Spirit
tarnished-spirit.desc: Tarnished spirits are foul ghosts, tainted by nameless crimes they committed in life that do not permit them to rest in peace. They are feeble, sickly things that stalk dark and doomed places, trying to find victims to whisper their evil deeds to and feeding off their life force. Though not very strong, they seek to harm adventurers in their mean, petty ways, and will stalk them until slain. Tarnished spirits relish in the gloom of crypts, graveyards and other places of death, although they are often driven out to the borders by stronger undead creatures, where they linger and wait for prey.
tarnished-spirit.strat: Kill them like a regular Ghost. Don't let them trap you without an appropriate elemental attack.

tazhadur.name: Tazhadur
tazhadur.title: Tazhadur
tazhadur.loc: Darashia Dragon Lair last floor, at the middle of the stone circle, .
tazhadur.notes: This boss can only be fought when First Dragon Quest is active.
tazhadur.strat: All players should stand diagonal from Tazhadur, whenever possible, to avoid the Fire Wave. Mages level 200- should cast Magic Shield and stay away from it, avoiding Fire Wave and close combat.

teleskor.name: Teleskor
teleskor.title: Teleskor
teleskor.loc: Rookgaard, in a cave on the south-west side of the premium area, under a tree, . The boss spawns on the lowest floor of the cave.
teleskor.beh: Does not run in red health, can not be blocked with objects. Will kill other skeletons to get to you
teleskor.notes: New creature implemented in the Summer Update 2008. His name is clearly an anagram of 'Skeletor'.
teleskor.strat: Just a regular skeleton, only a bit stronger.

teneshpar.name: Teneshpar
teneshpar.title: Teneshpar
teneshpar.loc: Folda, behind the portal , during the Rise of Devovorga World Quest. Can be fought on Vengoth during the Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change.
teneshpar.notes: It can't be looted and its corpse cannot be moved. It respawns where its corpse is. All players who sufficiently damage it during the last minute of the fight will receive the Slayer of Teneshpar achievement.
teneshpar.strat: Sorcerers and Druids: Glacier Set will reduce Ice Damage, but this is not necessary. You will need to heal after each hit as Teneshpar has various strong attacks, and using Magic Shield is recommendable. Heal the blocker and throw all the fire, ice, energy and earth spells you have at it. Knights and Paladins: Since this creature is immune to Physical Damage, you'll have a hard time killing it. It's advised to throw several Fire Bombs on the floor next to each other and then make Teneshpar chase you back and forth on the middle row. Also bring some Great Fireball Runes to deal some extra damage. If the fire fields get weaker, just cover them with some new Fire Bombs. Knights and Paladins of level 130 or above killing Teneshpar during Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change should wear Firewalker Boots (PvP) to minimise the damage they take from their fields.

tentacle.name: Tentacle
tentacle.title: Tentacle
tentacle.loc: Captain Jack Rat's boat near Rascacoon.
tentacle.notes: It's one of Tentugly's many tentacles. Part of the Tentugly fight of A Pirate's Tail Quest.

tentacle-of-the-deep-terror.name: Tentacle of the Deep Terror
tentacle-of-the-deep-terror.title: Tentacle of the Deep Terror
tentacle-of-the-deep-terror.notes: After a few waves of Glooth Anemone, 4 tentacles will spawn together in the boss room.
tentacle-of-the-deep-terror.strat: To spawn the first boss, Deep Terror, you must slay all 4 tentacles within 10 seconds of the first kill. This means that you shouldn't focus on a single tentacle but instead weaken all of them equally. First and foremost, make sure all 4 tentacles are near each other. They can spawn away from each other and/or target different people; the knights should group the tentacles so that they are not far apart. When they are grouped, the team should use area attacks as much as possible. Single-target attacks (e.g. Paladin shots, wand/rod/melee attacks) should be directed at the tentacle with the highest health, which would mean changing targets every few seconds. The tentacles will retreat at low health which can make things harder, so when the tentacles are low in health the mages are recommended to use their ultimate spells to cover a big area and weaken the running tentacles.
