If this fails to kill the tentacles, chase them and finish them off individually. If you fail to kill them all within the 10 seconds, they will spawn anew and you have another chance. However, keep in mind that you have 10 minutes inside the room, which does not get reset and does include the fight with the Deep…

tentuglys-head.name: Tentugly's Head
tentuglys-head.title: Tentugly's Head
tentuglys-head.loc: The boat between Rascacoon and The Wreckoning.
tentuglys-head.notes: It's one of the bosses in A Pirate's Tail Quest.
tentuglys-head.strat: Just focus on killing it when it appears, otherwise deal with its tentacles.

terofar.name: Terofar
terofar.title: Terofar
terofar.notes: It is extremely difficult boss for paladins and knights due to his skill reducing abilities.
terofar.strat: All vocations: Due to his strong abilities and melee it is advised to use prismatic rings along with Prismatic Necklace, Gill Necklace or Stone Skin Amulets. Mages: Enter with Energy Ring and Stone Skin Amulet equipped. In the best case scenario, you will summon a monster that will reach Terofar before you do, so he's the one to be inflicted with a curse. If that doesn't work, you should keep an eye on the death hits you get and once it starts hitting over 300, you may want to put an Energy Ring again until the curse is gone. Keep Terofar on diagonal all the time, so you can avoid his waves, keep summoning Fire Devils in case they die, and just shoot it down with your Wand of Defiance/Glacial Rod and Sudden Death Runes. It will take around 10 minutes before it dies even if you are a high level. It's also wise to carry few Mastermind Potions along and drink one of them each time you failed to react fast enough and got yourself hitted with Skill lowering wave. Paladins: You can start killing it pretty smooth around 400 level. Just stay on diagonal, keep on using Sharpshooter along with Great Spirit Potions and shoot it down with Infernal Bolts, Sudden Death Runes and occasional…

terramite.name: Terramite
terramite.title: Terramite
terramite.loc: Steppe of Zao, Lion's Rock, Zao Terramite Caves, Darama Terramite Cave, Terramite Breeding Tunnels. Also raids desert north of Ankrahmun.
terramite.desc: The Terramites share the same fondness for wood like their smaller cousins, the termites. Sadly their appetite extends to all other kind of organic substances, including livestock and sentient beings. Given the insatiable appetite of a Terramite colony, the potential for destruction caused by an unhindered population is extreme. Both, the orcs and the lizard people, consider the Terramites as delicacies. Usually the Terramites are content with the things they find in the underground but if the colony is starving, some scouts are sent out to look for more fertile areas. They consider each and everything they find in the earth as potential food, and the unlucky fellow that curiously explores one of their mounds, learns soon enough about their warlike welcome for any intruder. Unlike other insects, Terramites are generalists and lack the distinction between workers, warriors and queens. This makes it rather difficult to extinguish a colony. It is unknown what - instead of a queen - holds a colony together, but a Terramite colony seems to run effectively even without a leader.
terramite.notes: You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.

terrified-elephant.name: Terrified Elephant
terrified-elephant.title: Terrified Elephant
terrified-elephant.loc: East of Port Hope, close to the Deeper Banuta shortcut, .
terrified-elephant.beh: These creatures will kill monsters in their way to get to you. They can also retarget.
terrified-elephant.notes: Only appears during the Stampede Mini World Change. Terrified Elephants are extremely fast when charging (as fast as a level 200 player), but the charge only lasts for about 5 seconds, after which they go back to being rather slow. Kill 5 of them to receive the achievement Trail of the Ape God.
terrified-elephant.strat: Knights should fight them with an one-handed weapon and shield. Paladins should attack them from a distance with a one handed weapon and shield, but will not be able to outrun them while they are actively charging. Be careful if running from them once their charge has worn off as you may run into more of them or other creatures like Carniphila that spawn nearby. Mages should use their best wand/rod and use Great Fireball or Thunderstorm if surrounded.

terror-bird.name: Terror Bird
terror-bird.title: Terror Bird
terror-bird.loc: Around Port Hope, Arena and Zoo Quarter in Yalahar, few on Zao steppes.
terror-bird.desc: The ferocious Terror Bird is a terrifying hunter that usually lives in less dense areas of the jungle. Unlike other birds, it is a huge carnivorous animal that cannot even fly. Sages have already wondered if such an unusual creature can be natural or if it rather has its source in evil wizardry. On the other hand, nests of Terror Birds have been found, so this theory does not seem to be very likely. Be that as it may, the name of this feared hunter is more than justified. The aggressive bird attacks everything that comes in its sight with rage that does indeed inspire fear and dread. The carnivorous Terror Bird seems to regard everything as its rightful prey and its sharp beak often proves it right. Its inability to fly is made up by strong muscular legs that allow the bird to run at an astonishing speed and that serve also well as additional weapons.
terror-bird.beh: Terror birds move quickly toward their target and do not flee when wounded.
terror-bird.notes: They are faster but a bit weaker than a Cyclops. These creatures will kill other monsters and move objects to get to you. They can be tamed to a mount (Racing Bird) by using a carrot on a stick.
terror-bird.strat: A knight with decent skills can melee them. Other vocations should run and shoot them, avoiding contact.

terrorsleep.name: Terrorsleep
terrorsleep.title: Terrorsleep
terrorsleep.loc: Roshamuul Mines (down ), Roshamuul Cistern (down ), Nightmare Isles (Nightmare Teddy quest floor).
terrorsleep.desc: The terrorsleep is sweating dread incorporated. It thrives in darkness, breeds under your bed and nourishes on your fear. Terrorsleeps avoid the sunlight as it stuns and disorientates them. They do not see as we do, but sense other creatures' body warmth and fear. Hungry, toothed mouths protrude on their head instead of eyes. Using their mouths like augers, they bite open their victims and bathe in their bloody carcass like birds in a water pool. Terrorsleeps have very light and flexible bones and can squeeze through anywhere. They particularly like to slither and slime through dark, dank places, searching and sniffing out anything warm, alive; feeding on its fear, coveting its warmth, sucking out its life force. Their whitish belly is swollen with terror juices that foam up as gooey, frothy saliva hanging in threads and webs from their bared teeth. Touching it instils horrible paranoia and paralyses the victim so that the terrorsleep can devour it. Their putrid, blood-soaked wings they use to stabilise themselves and to swim or soar through darkness to reach ever deeper, isolated places. Once you are in darkness, you are never safe from a terrorsleep. There are surmises that the…
terrorsleep.strat: Knights: You will have a hard time with these. They are very resistant to physical and heal frequently. On top of that, they will almost constantly deal heavy damage. Be wary of their debuff which will reduce your melee skills, because they use it often and it adds up. The best strategy to is to keep an eye on your melee skill and use Fierce Berserk, Front Sweep, or Berserk when your skill isn't reduced, while challenging them, to prevent them escape on deep red health. The fight will typically last a little while so be careful not to lure more. The best melee element against them is energy, so sanguine razor and soulmaimer work well there.

thaian.name: Thaian
thaian.title: Thaian
thaian.notes: It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.

thaians-ghost.name: Thaian's Ghost
thaians-ghost.title: Thaian's Ghost
thaians-ghost.notes: It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.

thalas.name: Thalas
thalas.title: Thalas
thalas.beh: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.
thalas.notes: Thalas, the royal alchemist, was sentenced to be locked away, after his part in the conspiracies against the pharaoh. You can camp this monster by summoning DS to absorb the towers shots and staying in the south of the room. One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.
thalas.strat: He will attack with distance magic attacks, so use blockers to corner him and distance fighters to fire on him. He is guarded by 4 Necromancers and 12 Plaguethrowers (6 around Thalas and 6 more near the teleport).

thanatursus.name: Thanatursus
thanatursus.title: Thanatursus
thanatursus.loc: Haunted Temple, Court of Winter, Court of Summer, Dream Labyrinth
thanatursus.desc: The thanatursus is one of the few nightmare-twisted creatures that could establish itself as a new species. These creatures, that once probably just were common bears, became dangerous predators of berserk-like frenzy. The thanatursus is a carnivore that doesn't even shun away from carrion. In the contrary: it's known that the deformed bears often drag their kills into lairs, where they rot for a while before they are eaten. It seems the thanatursus does so for a more practical reason though. Observations lead to the theory that a thanatursus does absorb certain traits and even physical characteristics from their eaten prey. This seems to be more intense, the more fresh the devoured creature is. The natural instinct of the bear-creature seems to be to hide the carrion away for a later date, but if a fight with a victim drags on and drains more energy and blood then usual, the thanatursus is more likely to feast on it immediately. This probably leads to it mostly absorbing traits from more formidable foes and become more and more powerful over time. An average, grown up thanatursus combines the power and appearance of a couple of their prey. Some of them develop horns, similar to…
thanatursus.beh: Fights in close combat. Does not retarget unless challenged or its path to the initial target is blocked.
thanatursus.strat: They have a lot of health, so take your time with them. Mages should use Sudden Death Runes if there's only one Thanatursus due to their high Death Damage weakness.

thawing-dragon-lord.name: Thawing Dragon Lord
thawing-dragon-lord.title: Thawing Dragon Lord
thawing-dragon-lord.loc: One spawn in the Falcon Bastion, .
thawing-dragon-lord.beh: The Thawing Dragon Lord uses both Ice and Fire attacks. However, the Ice Crystal Bomb is used almost every turn, significantly increasing melee damage, resulting in nearly 1,000 damage each turn, regardless of positioning.
thawing-dragon-lord.notes: In order to find this special creature, you must first wake it by using the Frozen Dragon in its room, after having talked to the Crowned Tree. Upon spawning the Thawing Dragon Lord, you will have 10 minutes to kill it. After 10 minutes have passed, the creature, if alive will vanish and the room will become frozen once again.
thawing-dragon-lord.strat: Stay diagonal to it as it because its strongest attack is the Fire Wave that deals massive damage.

the-abomination.name: The Abomination
the-abomination.title: The Abomination

ab.n: All Die Plus Shaped (across whole room)

the-abomination.loc: The Abomination appears inside his own room under the Ice Islands, . Information on how to get there is explained under Notes above.
the-abomination.notes: The Abomination is a raid boss that spawns approximately every 180 days. When this raid happens, it starts with the Abominable Spawn appearing in 4 out of 10 possible locations. The miniboss on the 4 locations share the same health pool and it seems to be required to have players in all rooms to defeat it. The remaining portals will bring you to empty rooms. The possible locations are: * Hellgate: go down the hole and down two more levels to find the portal . * Dark Cathedral: go to the undead creatures are east of the entrance, , then go south to find the portal . * Krailos: inside the Wailing Widow's on the second floor . * Zao Steppe: inside the Lancer Beetle's on the second floor, . (You need part of A Father's Burden Quest to enter). * Gnomebase Alpha: go down the ramp near the portal to the Warzones, then down again and the portal will be to the west, . * Ankrahmun: enter the Larvae cave and go down to the lowest floor with Scarabs, . * Beregar: from the wagon room at the mines, go down, through the south door and down again, . * Edron Cyclopolis: all the way towards the main Behemoths area, then to the south corridor and up the ramp, . * Svargrond Formorgar Mines: take the…
the-abomination.strat: Secondary blockers should lure Abominable Servants and Abomination Cultists to one side of the room (for example, the east side) while the main blocker lures The Abomination to the opposite side. It's important that nobody tries to block The Abomination and one or more Abominable Servants at the same time as their presence seems to increase The Abomination's attack power. The cultists must be kept away or else Abomination will devour them and refill his health. This way, shooters and healers will stay closer to the center of the room. It's advised to stand in diagonal of it in order to avoid its plus-shaped attack that goes along the entire room (if you are further from the Abomination, even outside of its vision, but still standing directly in front of it vertically or horizontally, you'll get hit). When The Abomination says a vocation's name, every character from that vocation should retreat for a few seconds (6-8?) until it casts an area spell that affects character from the said vocation. When it mentions the knight vocation, the main blocker is advised to retreat to the north, not luring it into the shooters and healers. When it says " ", a 10-second timer will be visible…

the-armored-voidborn.name: The Armored Voidborn
the-armored-voidborn.title: The Armored Voidborn
the-armored-voidborn.loc: The Orc Cult hideout in the Edron Orc Cave
the-armored-voidborn.notes: Part of the Cults of Tibia Quest.
the-armored-voidborn.strat: It's strong to all damage dealt by players, but can be damaged by Containment Crystals which will use an area spell that hurts it when they are attacked. Once the Crystals kill it, it transforms into The Unarmored Voidborn which can be killed by players.

the-axeorcist.name: The Axeorcist
the-axeorcist.title: The Axeorcist
the-axeorcist.notes: One of the Isle of Strife's Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

the-big-bad-one.name: The Big Bad One
the-big-bad-one.title: The Big Bad One
the-big-bad-one.loc: Edron, spawns somewhere around with 0-2 War Wolves.
the-big-bad-one.strat: Just kill it like a War Wolf.

the-blazing-time-guardian.name: The Blazing Time Guardian
the-blazing-time-guardian.title: The Blazing Time Guardian
the-blazing-time-guardian.loc: Deep below north-west of Edron, (accessible through the Astral Shaper Dungeon behind the Holy Portal).
the-blazing-time-guardian.beh: Cycles through three phases: starts as The Time Guardian, transforms into The Freezing Time Guardian, reverts to The Time Guardian, then shifts to The Blazing Time Guardian before returning to The Time Guardian.
the-blazing-time-guardian.notes: The Blazing Time Guardian, The Freezing Time Guardian, and The Time Guardian all share a common Health pool, they are among one of five mini bosses in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
the-blazing-time-guardian.strat: Use Ice Damage, which will cause Time Wasters to spawn. Lower-level teams should be careful of doing much damage during this phase, as spawning too many Time Wasters can be dangerous. Also, note that to kill a Time Waster, players must use the corpse of a Lost Time on the Time Waster. Using Fire Damage in this phase heals the boss.

the-blightfather.name: The Blightfather
the-blightfather.title: The Blightfather
the-blightfather.notes: It is the Lancer Beetles' boss that spawns with their raid in Muggy Plains (30 minutes after the initial raid message).
the-blightfather.strat: Simply kill it. The Blightfather is as strong as an ordinary Lancer Beetle, just faster.

the-bloodtusk.name: The Bloodtusk
the-bloodtusk.title: The Bloodtusk
the-bloodtusk.loc: North-west of Svargrond. Reached after levitating 5 floors up on the passage to the glacier , then heading north and entering the portal located .
the-bloodtusk.notes: According to Grizzly Adams, "The citizens of Svargrond live in fear because of a frightfully bad-tempered mammoth they call 'Blood Tusk'." Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
the-bloodtusk.strat: Kill it like a normal Mammoth, it is slightly stronger and have more hp but it's not too hard to kill them. Mages and Paladins be prepared to take some extra damage, he is hard to outrun in his small ice cave.

the-bloodweb.name: The Bloodweb
the-bloodweb.title: The Bloodweb
the-bloodweb.notes: Crystal Spider's boss. Part of the Paw and Fur Society tasks of Grizzly Adams. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. When you kill The Bloodweb you'll receive the achievement Arachnoise. The portal which leads to the boss is inside the Formorgar Glacier, [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords 125.123-121.210-4-2-1-1 here].
the-bloodweb.strat: Treat it like a Crystal Spider with twice its usual strength. It will be easier for Mages and Paladins to defeat it if they use an Energy Wall Rune.

the-book-of-death.name: The Book of Death
the-book-of-death.title: The Book of Death
the-book-of-death.loc: In the Secret Library with Ghulosh.
the-book-of-death.notes: Part of The Secret Library Quest.
the-book-of-death.strat: Attack it until it's red HP and then leave it there until Ghulosh' Deathgaze spawns. Then kill it so a Concentrated Death spawns and you can kill the Deathgaze.

the-book-of-secrets.name: The Book of Secrets
the-book-of-secrets.title: The Book of Secrets
the-book-of-secrets.notes: It looks the same as a Book of Lies, which may be an indication that it shouldn't be taken seriously. Part of The Secret Library Quest.

the-collector.name: The Collector
the-collector.title: The Collector
the-collector.loc: Vega, in a cave below the stony pond.
the-collector.notes: The Collector "lives solely to collect all kinds of rare gems, crystals and minerals. Offering an item it does not already own, reportedly allows passage into its lair." (Spectulus).
the-collector.strat: Knights with 50/50 with the equipment given to you on Island of Destiny will be able to kill it. - Sorcerers, Druids and Paladins should get distance from it and kill it while running. Try to always keep walking on the ice, so it won't hurt you. Be careful Low-Level players, his attacks really hurt.

the-corruptor.name: The Corruptor
the-corruptor.title: The Corruptor
the-corruptor.beh: Drops different loot depending on the Vocation of the player who dealt the most damage.

the-count.name: The Count
the-count.title: The Count
the-count.loc: Green Claw Swamp, beneath the Blood Herb Quest area.
the-count.notes: It is not possible to summon him from his coffin without the associated quest.
the-count.strat: Kill him as fast as possible, since he does really high combos (up to 700) when a banshee is summoned. He probably isn't a creature to be hunted. He's strong, dangerous and doesn't drop any valuable item other than a Vampire Shield. If you release him and don't kill him, you can not release him again, so you will have to buy The Ring of the Count from a player or from Black Bert to continue The Inquisition Quest. If you put 3 garlic necklaces on the counters around the buried coffin, you can save yourself a lot of trouble. After that, you use the upper part of the coffin and The Weakened Count appears (looks the same as regular vampire and causes the same damage). This strategy is highly recommended to use!

the-count-of-the-core.name: The Count of the Core
the-count-of-the-core.title: The Count of the Core
the-count-of-the-core.beh: This monster heals when receiving Fire Damage, including the damage dealt by the monsters and mechanics in the room (Ember Beasts, the fire cannons, and Snail Slimes). It summons a Snail Slime after taking some damage.
the-count-of-the-core.notes: Part of the Dangerous Depths Quest.
the-count-of-the-core.strat: Trap him in a corner of the room with a player on every SQM at the range of 3 SQM of the boss, this will avoid it summoning Snail Slimes when taking damage. The Snail Slimes blow up when dying and deal 1730 Fire Damage in an small area. Druids and Sorcerers should avoid boss beams because it reduces Magic Level.

the-dark-dancer.name: The Dark Dancer
the-dark-dancer.title: The Dark Dancer
the-dark-dancer.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #3. Next #4.
the-dark-dancer.strat: Don´t take off your Dwarven Ring if you are using one from your last battle. It is very probable that you are still drunk, also its best to ignore the ghouls she summons. Druid or Sorcerer: use Magic Shield, and get a little closer to The Dark Dancer to corner her where you will know her position even if she goes invisible, shoot Explosion when invisible and SD when visible. Knight: Stay diagonal right next to her in a corner, use Exori to make her visible and melee her. Paladin: Use Explosion to make her visible and shoot, may be a good idea to shoot Ethereal Spear since most of your mana will be drained anyway.

the-diamond-blossom.name: The Diamond Blossom
the-diamond-blossom.title: The Diamond Blossom
the-diamond-blossom.notes: Part of The Secret Library Quest.

the-dread-maiden.name: The Dread Maiden
the-dread-maiden.title: The Dread Maiden
the-dread-maiden.notes: The Dread Maiden's is initially strong to all damage types, however, as the battle progresses it will be weakened to the point it takes damage in a normal way. It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.
the-dread-maiden.strat: The blocker should take The Dread Maiden to a corner of the room and keep it there. During the fight, Red, Green and Blue ghosts will spawn in the room. These ghosts must be lured to vortices of their respective color in order to weaken the boss and keep it weakened afterwards. Be careful not to lure the ghosts onto the wrong vortex as this will cause them to heal the boss or deal damage to you. This should be done by the shooters so the blocker can focus on keeping the boss standing still.

the-dreadorian.name: The Dreadorian
the-dreadorian.title: The Dreadorian
the-dreadorian.notes: One of the Isle of Strife Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.

the-end-of-days.name: The End of Days
the-end-of-days.title: The End of Days
the-end-of-days.notes: They appear in the fight against Magma Bubble during the Primal Ordeal Quest.
the-end-of-days.strat: Have the knight Challenge them as frequently as possible since they deal high damage and retarget very often. For more details, see Primal Ordeal Quest.

the-evil-eye.name: The Evil Eye
the-evil-eye.title: The Evil Eye
the-evil-eye.loc: North East of the Hellgate Library, .
the-evil-eye.notes: It's the Bonelords' Boss. It can cause Death Damage and all different kinds of Magical Damage. Always spawns with 5 Bonelords and 3 Elder Bonelords near it. When The Evil Eye is present in Hellgate, large clusters of Bonelords and Elder Bonelords (groups of 5 or 6) that are not normally present appear.
the-evil-eye.strat: Knights should rush in and kill it fast if you have no shooters. It has no Melee attack, so it will continue to use its distance attacks when you are up close. Be especially careful of the many Summons, and use Berserk to kill them if necessary. Using a Stealth Ring may be useful to avoid the Demon Skeletons' extra damage. Paladins Stay diagonal, hit them with your weapon, and exori san. Use potions if your health is low. Mages should use their wand to kill him. Avoid or ignore the summons and kill The Evil Eye first unless you are taking too much damage. It might be useful to run in circles to avoid getting hurt by the summoned Demon Skeletons and Ghosts. Also, using Invisible or a Stealth Ring might be useful to avoid the summons' damage.

the-false-god.name: The False God
the-false-god.title: The False God
the-false-god.notes: Part of the Cults of Tibia Quest.
the-false-god.strat: Focus all your firepower on it while running around the room to avoid the Sphere of Wrath.

the-fear-feaster.name: The Fear Feaster
the-fear-feaster.title: The Fear Feaster
the-fear-feaster.notes: It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.

the-first-dragon.name: The First Dragon
the-first-dragon.title: The First Dragon
the-first-dragon.notes: Part of the First Dragon Quest.

the-flaming-orchid.name: The Flaming Orchid
the-flaming-orchid.title: The Flaming Orchid
the-flaming-orchid.notes: As part of the Asura Palace Quest, access to the boss is granted every 20 hours but requires defeating 3 Cave Hydras and 2 Greater Fire Elementals each time you wish to enter.

the-forgemaster.name: The Forgemaster
the-forgemaster.title: The Forgemaster (Creature)
the-forgemaster.notes: Part of the fight against Arbaziloth, during the No Rest for the Wicked Quest. Depending on the fight's outcome, players can go to a separate room and talk to its NPC version in order to make use of the Doomforge.

the-freezing-time-guardian.name: The Freezing Time Guardian
the-freezing-time-guardian.title: The Freezing Time Guardian
the-freezing-time-guardian.loc: Deep below north-west of Edron, (accessible through the Astral Shaper Dungeon behind the Holy Portal).
the-freezing-time-guardian.beh: Cycles through three phases: starts as The Time Guardian, transforms into The Freezing Time Guardian, reverts to The Time Guardian, then shifts to The Blazing Time Guardian before returning to The Time Guardian.
the-freezing-time-guardian.notes: The Freezing Time Guardian, The Blazing Time Guardian, and The Time Guardian all share a common Health pool, they are among one of five mini bosses in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
the-freezing-time-guardian.strat: Use Fire Damage, which will also cause Lost Times to spawn; kill them and use their corpse on a Time Waster to eliminate them, as they are invulnerable to player damage. Using Ice Damage in this phase heals the boss.

the-frog-prince.name: The Frog Prince
the-frog-prince.title: The Frog Prince
the-frog-prince.beh: Spawns with 4 Green Frogs. unlike the Green Frog, he attacks players instead of running away from them. This creature runs away in dark yellow health with speed faster than that of a normal Green Frog.
the-frog-prince.notes: Its raid can not be blocked. Added in Summer Update 2008, spawns near Alatar Lake with another green frog. Looks the same as a Green Frog.

the-great-schnitzel.name: The Great Schnitzel
the-great-schnitzel.title: The Great Schnitzel
the-great-schnitzel.loc: Orcsoberfest Island. Reach its hideout by entering an Omnious Cauldron, whose locations are listed here. Use All Knowing Sausages to find out which location is currently active.
the-great-schnitzel.beh: It does not move and cannot be pushed.
the-great-schnitzel.strat: Do not attack him, doing so will cause Drunkenness. Kill the Spawn of the Schnitzel and use the Schnitzel Meat Grinder on it to hurt it 250 hp. After it reaches black HP bar, you will only deal 1 damage but still get Schnitzel Points.

the-hag.name: The Hag
the-hag.title: The Hag
the-hag.notes: Boss of Scrapper level Pit #4. Next #5.
the-hag.strat: To all vocations is heavily recomended to wear a Dwarven Ring even after you kill her, you may exit the arena by mistake or not be able to reach the next pit if you are heavily drunk. Also it's maybe a good idea to kill the Crypt Shamblers so The Hag may summon ghost, since blocking 2 Ghost do less damage. Druid or Sorcerer: use Magic Shield and get a little closer to The Hag so she gets into a corner where you will know her position even if she turns invisible, shoot runes to make her visible and wand/rod for faster kill. Knight: Stay diagonal right next to her in a corner, use Exori to make her visible and melee her. Paladin: Corner her and use Explosion, HMM or FB to make her visible and attack.

the-hairy-one.name: The Hairy One
the-hairy-one.title: The Hairy One
the-hairy-one.notes: Greenhorn challenger. ← #5 Colerian the Barbarian #6 The Hairy One #7 Axeitus Headbanger →
the-hairy-one.strat: Kill it with your normal weapon, no special strategy needed.

the-halloween-hare.name: The Halloween Hare
the-halloween-hare.title: The Halloween Hare
the-halloween-hare.loc: Wanders around Rookgaard, Dawnport and Mainland south of Dwarven Bridge. Keep in mind that the Hare can be lured far (as far away as Plains of Havoc).
the-halloween-hare.beh: It can't be pushed, but it can push objects. It will try to keep 4 squares from players. It retargets very quickly.
the-halloween-hare.notes: It spawns every year on October 31 in Rookgaard and Mainland since 2006, and in Dawnport since 2014. The Halloween Hare can neither be harmed, nor does it deal any damage. Therefore it can neither be killed, nor does it drop any loot. When near players it will "attack" the area around them occasionally with a non-damaging boulder which will change the appearance of all players in its radius into a Vampire, Ghost, Witch, Skeleton, Mummy, Pumpkin head. All changes per boulder are the same so all within the radius of one boulder will receive the same costume. This attack also can affect NPCs and creatures, including itself. You can not use it to train because it won't cause effect in your skills. You can take off your costume by watching time on any nearby clock or by taking a swim.
the-halloween-hare.strat: No strategy needed, as it doesn't do any damage nor can it be killed. Some players enjoy trapping and attacking it. Though, trapping him will reduce the frequency of its attacks.

the-handmaiden.name: The Handmaiden
the-handmaiden.title: The Handmaiden
the-handmaiden.loc: Pits of Inferno, in Pumin's Throneroom.
the-handmaiden.beh: Similar behaviour to the Hand of Cursed Fate.
the-handmaiden.notes: Pacera was the first server to kill it. The Handmaiden is the Hand of Cursed Fate boss.
the-handmaiden.strat: One Knight must have, at least 2500 or more Hitpoints to try to block this creature. Use Holy Damage, Ice Damage or Energy Damage to kill this boss.

the-horned-fox.name: The Horned Fox
the-horned-fox.title: The Horned Fox
the-horned-fox.loc: At the other side of the teleporter. The teleporter to him is located , at the way to the place where he spawned before the Killing in the Name of... Quest was introduced to Tibia, but just one floor further down. It is also marked when you complete the task of killing 5000 minotaurs so it isn't hard to find. The Horned Fox can also spawn randomly, e.g. at the top of the mountain , by the campfire in the cave , or in the room right before you enter the teleporter to the task version of The Horned Fox .
the-horned-fox.notes: He is one of the Minotaur bosses. He has a Secret Hideout near the Dwarf Mines of Kazordoon which he rarely visits. He is one of the few Minotaurs that has been proven to be able to write (as evidenced by this document). You can use an Obsidian Knife on his corpse in order to skin Minotaur Leather.
the-horned-fox.strat: Mages: Kill him fast with Ice Strike or Death Strike so you won't get much damage from him nor his summons. Ideally, use Invisibility so as not to receive any damage from his summons (if he has time to summon). Knights: Try to trap him in a corner so you know where he is when he goes invisible. When he goes invisible use Berserk. Use Stealth Ring so you don't receive damage from his summons. Paladins: Kill him fast and use Invisibility so you don't receive damage from his summons. Further, it is recommended that you run him so as to minimize damage.

the-hungerer.name: The Hungerer
the-hungerer.title: The Hungerer
the-hungerer.notes: Rare Spitter boss found on the bottom of the Hive Outpost in Liberty Bay, in a ~20-minute Varying Monster Spawn in which the common creatures are a Hive Overseer and a Spidris Elite, and the possible rare bosses are The Hungerer, The Manhunter, and The Mean Masher.

the-imperor.name: The Imperor
the-imperor.title: The Imperor

ab.n: Some kind of energy bomb around itself with unknown effect

the-imperor.loc: Pits of Inferno in Infernatil's Throneroom.
the-imperor.beh: It moves extremely fast, and it spams you with all kinds of hits.
the-imperor.notes: The Imperor is the Diabolic Imp boss. It was killed first time on Solera, later on Pacera and Refugia.
the-imperor.strat: Trap it in a corner and SD it really quickly. Avoid letting it escape, you will get lured in really big spawns. When it heals it can do really high damage together with the normal spawn when it starts with attacking again.

the-keeper.name: The Keeper
the-keeper.title: The Keeper
the-keeper.loc: Northern Zao in his lair, spawned by using poison on the purple plants.
the-keeper.beh: Behavior like that of a serpent spawn. Retreats at very low health.
the-keeper.notes: This creature was added in Summer Update 2010. Part of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest quest.
the-keeper.strat: Don´t fight it at all. Try to make it moving into the poison field spawning in the cave (causes 8000 damage every time).

the-lily-of-night.name: The Lily of Night
the-lily-of-night.title: The Lily of Night
the-lily-of-night.notes: Part of The Secret Library Quest.

the-lord-of-the-lice.name: The Lord of the Lice
the-lord-of-the-lice.title: The Lord of the Lice

ab.n: Summon 3 Brimstone Bugs or 3 Larvas at or 3 Insect Swarms once

the-lord-of-the-lice.loc: Grounds of Plague, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.
the-lord-of-the-lice.notes: It looks like Mutated Rats. It will yell when summoning creatures.

the-manhunter.name: The Manhunter
the-manhunter.title: The Manhunter
the-manhunter.notes: Rare Spidris boss found on the bottom of the Hive Outpost in Liberty Bay, in a ~20-minute Varying Monster Spawn in which the common creatures are a Hive Overseer and a Spidris Elite, and the possible rare bosses are The Hungerer, The Manhunter, and The Mean Masher.
the-manhunter.strat: Separate it from other monsters, stand diagonally and take it down.

the-many.name: The Many
the-many.title: The Many
the-many.beh: Treat it like a regular Hydra
the-many.notes: The Hydra boss has more health and heals faster than a normal Hydra, it is part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
the-many.strat: Treat it like a regular Hydra, but, unlike a regular hydra it doesnt walk into fire fields

the-masked-marauder.name: The Masked Marauder
the-masked-marauder.title: The Masked Marauder
the-masked-marauder.beh: He's strong. So, don't forget to use Stone Skin Amulets.
the-masked-marauder.notes: Is the boss of Warlord Level, Pit #6. Next #7
the-masked-marauder.strat: Be sure you can't run away from this monster. It is not so fast, but its distance attack is as lethal as a real Dark Torturer. To all vocations keep diagonal to avoid waves. Druid or Sorcerer: Use Magic Shield and SD. Knight: Melee and Fierce Berserk. Paladin: Shoot and use Divine Missile.

the-mean-masher.name: The Mean Masher
the-mean-masher.title: The Mean Masher
the-mean-masher.loc: Bottom floor of the Hive Outpost.
the-mean-masher.beh: Very similar to a Hive Overseer, it attacks from distance while using its summons to do melee damage.
the-mean-masher.notes: A rare Hive Overseer boss found on the bottom of the Hive Outpost in Liberty Bay, in a ~20-minute Varying Monster Spawn in which the common creatures are a Hive Overseer and a Spidris Elite, and the possible rare bosses are The Hungerer, The Manhunter, and The Mean Masher.
the-mean-masher.strat: Treat it like a slightly stronger Hive Overseer.

the-mega-magmaoid.name: The Mega Magmaoid
the-mega-magmaoid.title: The Mega Magmaoid
the-mega-magmaoid.notes: Part of the Too Hot to Handle Quest.
the-mega-magmaoid.strat: See Too Hot to Handle Quest.

the-monster.name: The Monster
the-monster.title: The Monster
the-monster.beh: Attacks in close range and doesn't retarget very often.
the-monster.notes: The Monster is a creation of Doctor Marrow. It's the final boss of The Cradle of Monsters Quest.
the-monster.strat: It's immune to all damage when its counter is at the maximum value of 20. The lower the counter is, the weaker The Monster will be. It can be weakened by forcing it to walk over the liquids spilled when the Alchemistical Containers in the room are destroyed.

the-moonlight-aster.name: The Moonlight Aster
the-moonlight-aster.title: The Moonlight Aster
the-moonlight-aster.notes: As part of the Asura Palace Quest, access to the boss is granted every 20 hours but requires defeating 2 Vicious Liches and 2 Vile Destroyers each time you wish to enter.

the-moonsnow-magnolia.name: The Moonsnow Magnolia
the-moonsnow-magnolia.title: The Moonsnow Magnolia
the-moonsnow-magnolia.notes: Part of Shards of a Broken Moon Quest. Its cooldown can be reset by using a Frozen Peacock Feather.

the-mutated-pumpkin.name: The Mutated Pumpkin
the-mutated-pumpkin.title: The Mutated Pumpkin
the-mutated-pumpkin.loc: Spawns west of Darashia either ( ), ( ), or ( ). Only during Halloween (Oct 31 - Nov 3).
the-mutated-pumpkin.notes: It spawns every 4 hours, beginning a few seconds after Server Open (not to be confused with Server Save) during Halloween — between the Server Saves of October 31 and November 3. When it appears, all players see the broadcast message: Once The Mutated Pumpkin is defeated, a portal east of Darashia appears for 30 minutes ( ). Players who participated in the fight can skin the corpse to earn the achievement Mutated Presents and receive one of the following rewards: 1 Spiderweb 1 Bat Decoration 1 Skeleton Decoration 1 Toy Spider 1 Pumpkinhead 1 Surprise Bag (Red) 1 Surprise Bag (Blue) 1–50 Pumpkins 1–50 Bars of Chocolate 20 Yummy Gummy Worms 50 Candy Canes 50 Candies When exiting the portal returns you to the Darashia Temple. After 5 minutes inside the reward room you're automatically removed with the message: :
the-mutated-pumpkin.strat: It moves very quickly and frequently changes targets. The best tactic is to trap it in a confined area to restrict its movement, then concentrate your attacks until it is dead.

the-nightmare-beast.name: The Nightmare Beast
the-nightmare-beast.title: The Nightmare Beast
the-nightmare-beast.beh: The boss will change targets frequently, so it's better to trap it in the spot west of the room where it won't be able to move to another target.
the-nightmare-beast.notes: It's the final boss of The Dream Courts Quest.
the-nightmare-beast.strat: The boss itself isn't very hard to deal with, though everyone should be careful because it can deal up to 1000 damage just using its distance attacks. In order to succeed in the fight, however, the team must be organized and take turns in using the Totem in the room to create Dream Catchers and remove the curse that is applied to one character at a time, otherwise this person will be kicked out of the room. If there are 5 players doing this in a previously determined order, the boss fight shouldn't be very complicated to kill using Sudden Death Runes and single-target ammunition. Most of its attacks seem to deal Death Damage, so protection against this element is probably the best to use during the fight.

the-noxious-spawn.name: The Noxious Spawn
the-noxious-spawn.title: The Noxious Spawn
the-noxious-spawn.loc: In a room in Deeper Banuta through a teleporter ( ).
the-noxious-spawn.notes: It is the Serpent Spawn boss. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
the-noxious-spawn.strat: This boss heals alot more than the normal serpent spawn. Also his waves and his beams are stronger than the normal ones, so you should stay diagonal to it. Knights should use Fierce Berserk and Blood Rage while avoiding waves and beams. Paladins should use Assassin Stars and Holy Missile while running around in the room. Druids and Sorcerers should use mana shield and Sudden Death Runes while running around in the room, from level 130 on you don't have to use mana shield.

the-obliverator.name: The Obliverator
the-obliverator.title: The Obliverator
the-obliverator.beh: Behaves just like a Demon, but is weaker without summons. The combo of Demon is more powerful. It does not run on low hp and it does not heal. The Obliverator is VERY DANGEROUS when summons 3 or 4 Fire Elementals.
the-obliverator.notes: Final boss of Warlord Level, in the last pit, Pit #10.
the-obliverator.strat: To all vocations stay diagonal. Druids and Sorcerer: Recommended to use Magic Shield while shooting Sudden Deaths or Icicles, also it can be good idea to use SSA to lower the melee damage and possibly use Avalanches to kill the summoned Fire Elementals while damaging The Obliverator at the same time. But be sure that Icicle will take more time and you'll get more damage. Knight: Melee and Exori Gran try to kill the Fire Elementals with Exori Gran too. You can shoot poison wall in diagonal direction and stand in a place that will force Obliverator to stay diagonal from you. Paladin: Shoot Assassin Stars and Exori San. Do not waste your mana with ultimate attacks (like Divine Caldera.)

the-old-whopper.name: The Old Whopper
the-old-whopper.title: The Old Whopper

ab.r: 3 sqm in front of himself; makes you ''very'' drunk

the-old-whopper.loc: The Old Whopper spawns before the level 30 door leading to the Behemoth Quest at floor -4 of Cyclopolis, ( ).
the-old-whopper.notes: Spawns with 2 cyclopes smiths. Disappears after 1 hour.
the-old-whopper.strat: It's a very easy creature, just kill it.

the-old-widow.name: The Old Widow
the-old-widow.title: The Old Widow
the-old-widow.loc: Its task teleport is located on the Plains of Havoc, . Sometimes it spawns outside with all the other Giant Spiders.
the-old-widow.notes: It's the Giant Spider's boss. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
the-old-widow.strat: To all vocations: stand at the most southern spot in the cave to make sure only The Old Widow can hit you, and its summons cannot. It is not a very good idea to try to outrun it, as its heavy paralysis and ability to haste make this very difficult. If you are lucky enough, a Giant Spider will stand in front of you, not The Old Widow, and then you will have an easy time killing it (for mages and paladins). Knights just kill the Giant Spider and then The Old Widow. If your level is below 90, it's wise to use Stone Skin Amulets (2-4 may be enough) and Might Rings to increase you chances. Mages: This is a hard monster to solo as a mage, try not to face it below level 80 as 2,000+ mana and the use of Great Mana Potions are recommended. Since it is a very fast creature, Wild Growth/Magic Walls will come in handy. Use Magic Shield because it can hit 600 easily. Unlike Giant Spiders, The Old Widow is strong to Fire Damage so Hell's Core will hit less. Take a Wand of Voodoo or Underworld Rod and attack it with Sudden Death runes while drinking plenty of Great Mana Potions. Terra Set is also recommended, although you might want to wear a Protection Amulet or Stone Skin Amulet rather than a…

the-pale-count.name: The Pale Count
the-pale-count.title: The Pale Count
the-pale-count.loc: During a raid under Drefia, initially . After reaching yellow health it teleports itself with full health to the lower floor and spawns in front of the mirror, . Entrance to this place, which is opened only during his raid, is located .
the-pale-count.notes: Affected by the boss chest loot system and special AI. When summoning a Nightfiend he says " ". Once the Pale Count reaches yellow health he will say " " and teleport himself downstairs at full health. When the Pale Count spawns, the following raid message appears: : Note about loot: *All participants will receive 1-199 Gold Coins and Vampire's Cape Chain. *All participants will receive one (and only one) of these: (1-9 Black Pearls 1-9 Small Amethysts 1-9 Small Diamonds 1-9 Small Emeralds 1-9 Small Rubies 1-9 Small Sapphires 1-9 Small Topazes) *Almost all participants will receive one (and only one) of these: (White Piece of Cloth Blue Piece of Cloth Red Piece of Cloth) *Almost all participants will receive one (and only one) of these: (Stealth Ring Ring of Healing) *Almost all participants will receive 1-5 Strong Health Potions. *Almost all participants will receive 1-5 Strong Mana Potions. *Almost all participants will receive a Vampire Lord Token.
the-pale-count.strat: The Pale Count fights at melee range and switches target often, a decent level knight should block it, using Challenge frequently. If there are many players waiting for it, then make sure you position yourself well and use your best attacks to have a higher chance of good loot.

the-pale-worm.name: The Pale Worm
the-pale-worm.title: The Pale Worm
the-pale-worm.notes: It's the final boss of the Feaster of Souls Quest, and shares it's health with A Weak Spot.

the-percht-queen.name: The Percht Queen
the-percht-queen.title: The Percht Queen

loot.i: The Crown of the Percht Queen (Ice)
The Crown of the Percht Queen (Fire)

the-percht-queen.notes: While it's frozen, it will be immune to damage and look like this: It's the boss of the Winterlight Solstice event.

the-pit-lord.name: The Pit Lord
the-pit-lord.title: The Pit Lord
the-pit-lord.notes: Is the boss of Warlord level Pit #4. Next #5
the-pit-lord.strat: The Pit Lord has no waves or beams, so you don't need to stand at a diagonal with him. Druid or Sorcerer: Throw 1-2 wall runes wall and run around them casting Ice Strike or using SD. It may be a good idea to use Magic Shield and/or Haste in case he moves too fast. Knight: Melee and Berserk. Paladin: Use wall runes, shoot and cast Divine Missile.

the-plasmother.name: The Plasmother
the-plasmother.title: The Plasmother
the-plasmother.beh: He run in low health and Summons up to 2 Defilers.
the-plasmother.notes: The Plasmother is the Defiler boss. It was killed first time on Furora.
the-plasmother.strat: Try to block it with a Knight and use Sudden Death or Death Strike. Wild Growth and Magic Wall will help your team a lot.

the-ravager.name: The Ravager
the-ravager.title: The Ravager
the-ravager.loc: Oramond, south in the Oramond Catacombs.
the-ravager.notes: He is healed whenever he steps on a Stone Tile with a lizard symbol. If you are trying to complete this boss for the bestiary, watch [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i4cnYrzK30Q this video].
the-ravager.strat: You can only fight this boss in teams of four. A balanced setup consists of 1 knight and 3 others to act as damage dealers. The Ravager begins the fight alongside 4 Greater Canopic Jars and is capable of summoning additional Canopic Jars throughout the encounter. These jars remain stationary, but if The Ravager is moved too far away from them, he will summon new jars closer to his current position. Because of this mechanic, controlling the boss's positioning is essential. At the start of the fight, the shooters should quickly destroy all Greater Canopic Jars while the knight manipulates The Ravager's movement to gather the regular Canopic Jars into a single area. Once the jars have been grouped together, the knight must position The Ravager just outside the jars' healing range while remaining close enough to prevent them from despawning. After the setup is complete, the team should focus entirely on trapping and killing The Ravager. Do not allow him to move out of position, as this may cause him to regain access to healing or summon additional jars. Ideally, the knight should stand diagonally adjacent to The Ravager while trapping him with Wild Growth Runes or Magic Wall Runes.…

the-red-knight.name: The Red Knight
the-red-knight.title: The Red Knight
the-red-knight.notes: It's part of the final battle of the Grave Danger Quest.
the-red-knight.strat: The Red Knight does not take any direct damage from players since its immune to all elements but Drown Damage. To kill it, you must kill the Vampiric Bloods near the boss. The vampires explode dealing Drown Damage which will damage The Red Knight. The players can use Diving Equipment to avoid this damage.

the-shatterer.name: The Shatterer
the-shatterer.title: The Shatterer
the-shatterer.loc: Grounds of Destruction, a Ferumbras' Ascendant Quest area.
the-shatterer.notes: Part of the Ferumbras' Ascendant Quest.

the-snapper.name: The Snapper
the-snapper.title: The Snapper
the-snapper.beh: The Snapper is a melee combatant so chases its opponent, but runs in very low health.
the-snapper.notes: Recently several citizens of Port Hope have vanished. It is rumoured that they were killed by a crocodile. The people call it 'Snapper'. Part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. It cannot be killed until Grizzly Adams lets you enter the teleporter.
the-snapper.strat: Kill it like a normal Crocodile. Paladins and Mages: There is a big rock in the middle they can run around and shoot at him from. Knights: If your level is lower than 20, bring potions because he has a high defense and you won't hit too much.

the-souldespoiler.name: The Souldespoiler
the-souldespoiler.title: The Souldespoiler
the-souldespoiler.loc: The Humans Cult hideout under the Outlaw Camp.
the-souldespoiler.notes: Part of the Cults of Tibia Quest.
the-souldespoiler.strat: Just attack this boss form with whatever you have. It won't take much damage but Freed Souls will start spawning. These do an area attack that will damage the boss so keep them close. Once three Freed Souls have spawned the boss will start dying quickly.

the-time-guardian.name: The Time Guardian
the-time-guardian.title: The Time Guardian
the-time-guardian.loc: Deep below north-west of Edron, (accessible through the Astral Shaper Dungeon behind the Holy Portal).
the-time-guardian.beh: Cycles through three phases: starts as The Time Guardian, transforms into The Freezing Time Guardian, reverts to The Time Guardian, then shifts to The Blazing Time Guardian before returning to The Time Guardian.
the-time-guardian.notes: The Time Guardian, The Freezing Time Guardian, and The Blazing Time Guardian all share a common Health pool, they are among one of five mini bosses in the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
the-time-guardian.strat: Focus on dealing steady Physical Damage, as this form is strong to other elemental types.

the-unarmored-voidborn.name: The Unarmored Voidborn
the-unarmored-voidborn.title: The Unarmored Voidborn
the-unarmored-voidborn.loc: The Orc Cult hideout in the Edron Orc Cave.
the-unarmored-voidborn.notes: This boss is probably Tibia's creature with the highest elemental weakness, but since it has a lot of hitpoints it still takes a while to kill it. When fighting it you'll easily see hits of 2000, 3000 and even up to 8000 when dealing Critical Hits. Part of the Cults of Tibia Quest.
the-unarmored-voidborn.strat: It spawns once The Armored Voidborn is killed. It's weak to all damage types so use your best attacks on him.

the-voice-of-ruin.name: The Voice of Ruin
the-voice-of-ruin.title: The Voice of Ruin
the-voice-of-ruin.loc: Corruption Hole. One spawn point is near the eye, , and the other spawn point is with the Ghastly Dragons, .
the-voice-of-ruin.notes: Spawns with 0-2 Lizard Chosens. Kill it the same way you'd kill a Lizard Chosen.

the-weakened-count.name: The Weakened Count
the-weakened-count.title: The Weakened Count
the-weakened-count.beh: Confronts you in close range combat. Does not run at low health.
the-weakened-count.notes: You can obtain some Vampire Dust when you use a Blessed Wooden Stake. Also note that you need to put 3 Garlic Necklaces on the counters around the coffin and click in the coffin to challenge it.
the-weakened-count.strat: It's like a normal Vampire so kill it as if you were killing a Vampire.

the-welter.name: The Welter
the-welter.title: The Welter

ab.r: 17000+ only once when on red hp

the-welter.notes: With him spawn 8? eggs, which hatch to produce Spawns of the Welter, which do very minor damage but heal every monster around it (including The Welter) for massive amounts.
the-welter.strat: When the raid starts, eggs will spawn in the lair. If you arrive to the lair in time to destroy the eggs, do so (not very likely unless you are hunting there). When the eggs create the spawns, the blockers should use Challenge on them and lure them away from the boss. Be careful when luring away because if you get trapped by them the only way out is to have someone come take them off of you - the spawns will heal themselves and all other monsters around them, you cannot reasonably expect to kill your way out of a trap. Make sure all spawns are lured away from the boss and that they will not roam around. If a spawn roams and finds you killing the boss, they will heal it back to full health very quickly. Once the spawns are away from the boss, focus all your firepower on it. It is soloable by luring the spawns away from the boss. However, due to the difficulty of that and the chance of spawns roaming to you, it is strongly recommend you bring a group. will heal itself once on red hp and a message will appear,while a Spawn of the Welter will disappear :

the-winter-bloom.name: The Winter Bloom
the-winter-bloom.title: The Winter Bloom
the-winter-bloom.notes: As part of the Asura Palace Quest, access to the boss is granted every 20 hours but requires defeating 1 Solitary Frost Dragon and 2 Greater Energy Elementals each time you wish to enter.

thief.name: Thief
thief.title: Thief (Creature)
thief.loc: Thieves' hideout during Nomads Land Quest, Former Trade Quarter during Top of the City Quest.
thief.beh: They sleep in cots. Will spot you when you move up close, and chase you away.
thief.strat: Keep your distance from their windows, and don't walk into the garbage they left behind.

thieving-squirrel.name: Thieving Squirrel
thieving-squirrel.title: Thieving Squirrel
thieving-squirrel.loc: It spawns when you use a Flask with Beaver Bait on a marked Dwarf Tree during The New Frontier Quest.
thieving-squirrel.strat: It moves extremely fast (even faster than a standard Squirrel) so kill it quick.

thornback-tortoise.name: Thornback Tortoise
thornback-tortoise.title: Thornback Tortoise
thornback-tortoise.loc: Laguna Islands, Meriana Gargoyle Cave and one on Nargor.
thornback-tortoise.desc: Everything that their more peaceful cousins lack in fighting prowess, the warlike Thornback Tortoises own all the more. Incredibly armed they come with a small but efficient array of distance attacks that compensate their lack of agility. Even though Thornback Tortoises are quite slow, they often manage to catch their enemies in close combat by incapacitating them. If it comes to one-to-one battles, they can face even the strongest opponents due to their incredible armor and their sheer strength.
thornback-tortoise.notes: Usually appears in large groups with Tortoises and Blood Crabs. You may hunt 300 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest.
thornback-tortoise.strat: Knights:You should bring some bps of Fire Fields, Just go down the hole and put Fire Fields beside you so only 1 creature can attack you at a time, you can be there forever if you bring enough supplies and are skilled enough. You should bring some Mana potions, they are cheap to heal with and you get some Magic Level % with them, Bringing health potions is advised too incase you get swarmed. Using a Fire Axe on this creature produces more damage than a royal axe and almost as much damage as a stonecutter axe due to this creatures high physical resistance and weakness to fire. Thornback Tortoises mostly attacks in groups with Tortoises and Blood Crabs, so be careful when jumping down holes. Not very good to hunt for mages because they will use a lot of mana/runes to deplete its high hitpoints. Mages should use summons. Mages could bring alot of Great Fireball runes with them, and try to gather a big group of monsters and fire them down. You can easily gain 700-1500 exp like this.

thornfire-wolf.name: Thornfire Wolf
thornfire-wolf.title: Thornfire Wolf
thornfire-wolf.notes: Can only appear during the Thornfire World Change. It can be transformed into a Crystal Wolf by luring it towards the Bog Temple.
thornfire-wolf.strat: Just attack it or change it into a Crystal Wolf.

thul.name: Thul
thul.title: Thul
thul.loc: Calassa, near and underneath the ship with the Coral Comb (two spawns), .
thul.beh: When he uses poison bomb he will poison himself but he is not weak or strong against earth damage. Thul will run at about 40 health (tested at 37, note that Quara Constrictors run at 40).
thul.notes: The Quara boss, it looks the same as a Quara Constrictor but is stronger. It always spawns with 2 Quara Hydromancers and 2 Quara Mantassins, except in the quest room where it spawns alone. Thul is a boss of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. The portal which leads to the boss is under the boat of Coral Comb in Calassa, .
thul.strat: Thul can be found in two areas: he is in the quest room when someone enters it and he can spawn just west of the teleport to it. Thul and his Massive Water Elemental summons do not cross energy fields unless they cannot reach you otherwise. It can be handy for paladins and mages to throw an energy wall toward the teleport (quest room Thul) and run over it to avoid close-combat attacks (they will all run around the coral). Note that Thul can poison bomb over energy walls, but will do so very rarely while chasing you around them.

tiger.name: Tiger
tiger.title: Tiger
tiger.loc: Tiquanda, Meriana, Arena and Zoo Quarter. Three unreachable ones are found in the Rookgaard Academy, below Ankrahmun (during the Nomads Land Quest), and on Charles's ship.
tiger.desc: The Tiger stalks through the jungle of Tiquanda, looking for its prey. It strikes by surprise, quickly and deadly. Fast and lethal, this fighting machine is a hurricane of teeth and claws when it comes to combat. Many hunters in the jungle suddenly became the hunted one when they crossed the path of this striped predator. Tigers are solitary creatures, although small Tiger families are not an uncommon view. Even though they are mostly hunting smaller mammals of the jungle, sometimes they are also after larger prey. They easily feel threatened and like most warlike creatures, they react on threats with violence. Tigers are agile and fast but lack endurance for longer pursuits. Still it is unlikely that a chosen victim manages to escape at all.
tiger.beh: They don't run when in low health.
tiger.notes: They're a bit stronger than a bear. These creatures will kill other monsters to get to you.
tiger.strat: Even if your melee skills are poor, with the proper equipment you will find absolutely no problem in killing these; just attack them.

time-keeper.name: Time Keeper
time-keeper.title: Time Keeper
time-keeper.loc: Deep below north-west of Edron, (accessible through the Astral Shaper Dungeon behind the Holy Portal).
time-keeper.notes: Appears with The Time Guardian during the Forgotten Knowledge Quest. It looks like a White Shade.

timedisplaced-anomaly.name: Timedisplaced Anomaly
timedisplaced-anomaly.title: Timedisplaced Anomaly (Banuta)
timedisplaced-anomaly.notes: It's one of the bosses which awards Theons as part of Tibia's 25th Anniversary. The combined Loot Statistics of this boss and the other two with the same name can be seen here.

timira-the-many-headed.name: Timira the Many-Headed
timira-the-many-headed.title: Timira the Many-Headed
timira-the-many-headed.loc: Emerald Gardens, an island of Marapur.
timira-the-many-headed.beh: Timira fights in close range, but her AoE and chain attacks will often affect other players in the room.
timira-the-many-headed.notes: It's part of the Within the Tides Quest. The first time a character defeats Timira, they will always get a Naga Basin from her loot.
timira-the-many-headed.strat: The final part of the fight against Timira is quite simple. If fighting with a lower level team, the blocker can trap Timira at the north-west corner of the room so it won't switch to the shooters. Most elements work well on Timira, although Sorcerers should avoid their waves as they'll do more damage by simply using Sudden Death Runes. For the strategies of the initial stages of the fight, see Within the Tides Quest.

tiquandas-revenge.name: Tiquandas Revenge
tiquandas-revenge.title: Tiquandas Revenge
tiquandas-revenge.loc: Deep in the Tiquandian Jungle, has been seen , and [http://tibia.wikia.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=128.76,128.16,7 here]. The portal to the boss for the special task is located .
tiquandas-revenge.notes: It's the Carniphila's boss. It looks and behaves like a Carniphila, but it is much stronger.
tiquandas-revenge.strat: If you are a Mage, it would definitely be smart to use Sudden Death Runes to kill this. You wouldn't want it to get close to you. The blocker (if there's any) should run it and absorb its distance attacks but not let it come to Melee. If you are a Knight the only and best strategy is to use best weapon and Fierce Berserk. If you are a Paladin use Assassin Stars if possible. Its Healing is extremely fast, much more than Hydra. This is not a regular spawn.

tirecz.name: Tirecz
tirecz.title: Tirecz
tirecz.beh: Fights until death, retargets very often.
tirecz.notes: The final Isle of Strife Arena Master. Part of The New Frontier Quest.
tirecz.strat: Knights: Stay diagonal. Avoid his waves and beams at all cost! Sorcerers, Druids and Paladins: kill at range. Don't get too close or in the way of the waves and beams.

toad.name: Toad
toad.title: Toad
toad.loc: The Laguna Islands, Arena and Zoo Quarter, Tiquanda/Tarantula Caves, Shadowthorn Bog God Temple, Northern Zao Plantations, Northern Brimstone Bug Cave, Tainted Caves.
toad.desc: Toads have little in common with harmless little frogs. Aggressive and poisonous, they seem to regard everything that is moving as some kind of lunch. They attack without hesitation and use their gluey and poisonous spittle to weaken the opponent before they challenge it in close combat. Ferocious like no other reptile, they develop a berserk rage in every battle. Even without teeth, they can bite with the crushing force of a giant clam or hit the enemy with there long tongues at lightning speed. They use their powerful legs to jump towards their opponents during which they are able to reach astonishing if not frightening speed. Given their ability to slow down opponents and to speed up themselves, it is quite likely that they can cope with almost every opponent in close combat.
toad.beh: Due to their haste it is hard to outrun them at lower levels. If you're trying to kill it with non self healing summons (such as a Fire Devil), watch out because they can retarget very fast.
toad.notes: As a curious note, Toads give same rare loot (War Hammer) and also the same experience points as Wild Warriors.
toad.strat: Try not to let them run away when they are low in hp, as they are fast and can lure you to even more Toads. Low level mages should avoid them since they are often found in groups and can spam small amount of damage quite fast while reducing your health significantly. Use GFB or other area effecting runes to quickly kill larger groups. If you're on ground level of the Laguna Islands, mages can run around for about 20 seconds quickly, lure about 20 toads and some other creatures this way and then use GFB, 2 (or even one) shots can be enough for about 1k exp.

tomb-servant.name: Tomb Servant
tomb-servant.title: Tomb Servant
tomb-servant.beh: Fights until slain. Will push other monsters in its way.
tomb-servant.strat: Kill it as you'd kill a Demon Skeleton.

tormented-ghost.name: Tormented Ghost
tormented-ghost.title: Tormented Ghost
tormented-ghost.notes: They appear when using a Ghost Charm on a certain tile. When you kill them, they turn into Ghost Residue.
tormented-ghost.strat: Kill them as you would kill normal ghosts.

tormentor.name: Tormentor
tormentor.title: Tormentor
tormentor.beh: Runs away in deep red, often using haste then.
tormentor.notes: He's the Nightmare's boss and part of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. In order to access the boss room you will need The Ice Islands Quest completed until mission 9 ("Formorgar Mines 1").
tormentor.strat: Treat it as a stronger Nightmare.

tortoise.name: Tortoise
tortoise.title: Tortoise
tortoise.loc: Laguna Islands, Fenrock, Port Hope and also can be found behind a wall below the center of Liberty Bay. These cannot be reached.
tortoise.desc: In the past, the once peaceful Tortoise of the Shattered Isles has been hunted by sailors and settlers until it was almost eradicated. It is disputed whether the Tortoise has learnt at last to defend itself or, as some members of the explorer's society claim, some kind of natural selection has set in that left only the meanest and most aggressive Tortoises. Be that as it may, nowadays the island Tortoises are quite capable to defend themselves. Heavy natural armor and a strong jaw make up for their slowness to some extent. Still their slowness is their major weakness and it is probably only a matter of time until humans rout them out in their last refuges on the isles.
tortoise.beh: These creatures fight until death. Since update 8.4 there have been rare spawns of powerful (but slow) tortoises, this is an anti-cheat measure taken by CIP.
tortoise.notes: They offer decent amount of money and experience for the effort.
tortoise.strat: They are slow and not too hard so they shouldn't be any problem for any vocation; you should be more careful of many Toads and Thornback Tortoises that usually accompany them. Use parcels if you are of a low level to avoid multiple attacks. You may come across an unusually slow tortoise who heals itself. It no longer hits as hard as it used to, but some testing suggests that it "trains" like a slime would. They have abnormally high hit points, and heal a lot, very quickly. This monster is designed to make Cheaters "stuck" on this monster, since they cannot kill it.

toxic-swarm.name: Toxic Swarm
toxic-swarm.title: Toxic Swarm
toxic-swarm.notes: It is encountered during the Too Hot to Handle Quest - Monster Killing.

trapped-soul.name: Trapped Soul
trapped-soul.title: Trapped Soul
trapped-soul.notes: Part of the Make Believe Quest.

travelling-merchant.name: Travelling Merchant
travelling-merchant.title: Travelling Merchant
travelling-merchant.loc: It can be found in Outlaw Camp during Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest.
travelling-merchant.notes: They spawn during the third mission of a quest and can (or could) be killed from outside the square.
travelling-merchant.strat: You must find the right spot to shoot over the barrier.

tremendous-tyrant.name: Tremendous Tyrant
tremendous-tyrant.title: Tremendous Tyrant
tremendous-tyrant.desc: The tremendous tyrants show signs of at least basic intelligence and are able to handle simple tools and probably even weaponry. Their primitive cunning combined with their cruelty, makes them packmasters in the ranks of the hordes from below. They seemingly trained the lesser and more primitive creatures to follow simple orders that the tyrants issue by light signals. To assure their dominance the tremendous tyrants sometimes cull their underlings by spectacular executions, that follow their cruel whims more than any strategic planning. As they are still vicious and wild they tend to lead from the front, not by plan but rather by attitude. It's not unheard of that a tremendous tyrant in frenzy completely forgets about his underlings and leaves them to their own devices. If a tremendous tyrant loses it's light organ, his capabilities to communicate are severely hampered. The organ usually grows back in a few weeks, yet some superiors have little patience with such underlings and executions of tyrants wounded that way are quite common. The tyrants are carnivorous and their behaviour suggests that they prey on the meat of strong opponents, often chasing away lesser minions to get…

tremor-worm.name: Tremor Worm
tremor-worm.title: Tremor Worm
tremor-worm.loc: Two floors down in the Underground Glooth Factory - (west side), only accessible during the raid. The closest spawn point is located . Additional spawn locations are , , and .
tremor-worm.beh: Every 10 seconds, it will vanish and reappear, although it can reappear multiple times in a row in the same location.
tremor-worm.notes: When killing this for the first time, you'll earn the Achievement Rumble in the Plant, provided you contribute significantly throughout most of the battle.
tremor-worm.strat: It is strongly recommended to remain stationary and concentrate your efforts at a single spawn location. Stay vigilant and be prepared to engage in combat immediately upon the spawn event. Mages are encouraged to summon creatures such as Fire Elementals or Fire Devils, while players above level 200 should utilize their ultimate summons. Additionally you can use your damage over time spells such as Inflict Wound, Holy Flash, Curse, Ignite, Electrify, and Envenom.

tremorak.name: Tremorak
tremorak.title: Tremorak
tremorak.notes: One of the Isle of Strife Arena Masters. Part of The New Frontier Quest.
tremorak.strat: Due to his very high defences, it's recommended to bring a fire enchanted weapon. This will help with bringing him down within the time limit. Bringing a soulfire rune is also a good idea.

troll.name: Troll
troll.title: Troll
troll.loc: In many dungeons around Tibia like the troll cave in Thais, south of Carlin (out the east exit and down the hole), Island of Destiny, Edron Troll Cave, and in Ab'Dendriel. Also found in Rookgaard.
troll.desc: Trolls are a human-like race that lives in small tribes in the holes and dungeons of Tibia. There they hunt animals and seek treasures over which they keep a jealous watch. They are weak and silly fighters, but as a squad they can become quite dangerous.
troll.notes: Many players prefer not to train on trolls since they run away when they have low hp. However, since they drop spears some paladins may hunt them with spears in an attempt to raise their distance fighting skill.
troll.strat: They are fairly weak; just attack them. Take precautions if you're lower than about level 7 on Rookgaard when approaching them and try to block the creature using parcels or chests. You could find yourself getting killed with several hitting you at once.

troll-champion.name: Troll Champion
troll-champion.title: Troll Champion
troll-champion.loc: Edron Troll-Goblin Peninsula, Ab'dendriel Shadow Caves, Thais South-East Troll Caves, Dusalk's Troll Clan Cave, Island of Destiny in Paladin's guild.
troll-champion.desc: Sometimes a hero rises even amongst cowards. Well, in the case of trolls the term hero might be a bit far-fetched. The Troll Champions receive their title mainly for their slyness and brutality. Raising in status seems great in the beginning but it quickly becomes a matter of survival. Even though cowardly, most trolls are incredibly greedy and envious. As a result, a troll with a special status has to fight for its life and to survive many attempts of backstabbing or arranged accidents by its brethren. Of course, every Troll Champion abuses shamelessly his privileges in his tribe. Therefore, it is only natural that a Troll Champion has to constantly watch his back and stay as fit and well-equipped as he can manage. This again makes him one of the toughest fighters of the tribe that other trolls turn to when in danger. Troll Champions are usually the leaders of small raiding parties or the personal bodyguards of the equally abusive chieftains. They love to bully weaker trolls and are hardly encountered without some henchmen that they can bully around and sacrifice in battles.
troll-champion.notes: Despite their appearance, not that much stronger than a regular troll.
troll-champion.strat: They have good melee so if you want to Train with them it is recommended you have 22+ Shielding.

troll-guard.name: Troll Guard
troll-guard.title: Troll Guard
troll-guard.loc: Rookgaard's central cave in the , north-west of Carlin during raids and Thais Knights' Guild arena during raids on Kingsday.
troll-guard.strat: Kill it like a normal Troll.

troll-legionnaire.name: Troll Legionnaire
troll-legionnaire.title: Troll Legionnaire
troll-legionnaire.loc: Old Beregar mines. In group with Furious Trolls almost all the time.
troll-legionnaire.beh: Keeps 4 squares distance and shoots Throwing Stars, turns invisible very often for about 20 seconds, heals frequently.
troll-legionnaire.notes: New creature in the summer update 2009. They can be found in an area accessible during making Royal Rescue Quest. Drops quite high amount of gold for such a monster, so hunting these might be profitable.
troll-legionnaire.strat: They will most likely be invisible all the time, as they re-cast invisibility and keep distance before the effect wears off (like Warlocks), therefore shoot area runes like Great Fireball or use spells like Divine Caldera. Alternatively, change floors for a while until they become visible again.

troll-marauder.name: Troll Marauder
troll-marauder.title: Troll Marauder
troll-marauder.notes: It's a considerably stronger and much rarer Mountain Troll.

troll-trained-salamander.name: Troll-Trained Salamander
troll-trained-salamander.title: Troll-Trained Salamander
troll-trained-salamander.strat: Just kill it. Good source of a Shovel which is not already given to you, and other minor equipment upgrades.

trollwut.name: Trollwut
trollwut.title: Trollwut
trollwut.loc: Thais Wolf Den - part of Ravenous Madness Quest

tromphonyte.name: Tromphonyte
tromphonyte.title: Tromphonyte
tromphonyte.loc: Cave below the Muggy Plains. The teleporter is located .
tromphonyte.beh: Stampor boss fought during the Killing in the Name of... Quest.

tropical-desolator.name: Tropical Desolator
tropical-desolator.title: Tropical Desolator
tropical-desolator.notes: Drops one Proficiency Catalyst the first time it is killed. Part of the Between the Lines Quest.
tropical-desolator.strat: Every 10 seconds, a random fruit will spawn counting down from 5 and then exploding in an area. Stay and keep the boss away to avoid their effects, which include: * Blastberry: deals around 1,250 Earth Damage. * Painapple: applies the Feared condition. * Blamana: explodes in a big area, healing the boss up to 7,000 if in range

true-dawnfire-asura.name: True Dawnfire Asura
true-dawnfire-asura.title: True Dawnfire Asura
true-dawnfire-asura.desc: Asuri are demonic creatures who can hide their true face and appear in the form of beautiful women. Although they often take on a seductive appearance, they show their true form as soon as there is no need for charade. In this case they appear as tall, beautiful women with four arms, fangs and glowing eyes. These demonesses are driven mainly by greed and envy. They enter the mortal world because they begrudge humans and other peoples their vigour, beauty and happiness. They seek to destroy positive feelings as love, contentment and mirth, because herefrom they gain their energy. An asura especially stalks men she regards as handsome and happy. These victims are lured into gorgeous palaces full of riches and conveniences, inhabited by several asuri. There they ensnare the men with amusements such as wine, music, dance and intoxicating substances that indulge their senses and make them submissive and weak-willed. Then the asuri divest them of vitality and beauty. When an asura gets weary of her victim or if captives unexpectedly oppose the demonesses, these unfortunates come to know the true face of the palace: As the asuri show a beautiful face outwardly and are in truth terrible…
true-dawnfire-asura.notes: They are the Dawnfire Asura in their true form.

true-feverbloom-asura.name: True Feverbloom Asura
true-feverbloom-asura.title: True Feverbloom Asura
true-feverbloom-asura.desc: Asuri are demonic creatures who can hide their true face and appear in the form of beautiful women. Although they often take on a seductive appearance, they show their true form as soon as there is no need for charade. true-frost-flower-asura.title: True Frost Flower Asura
true-frost-flower-asura.loc: Asura Palace, Asura Vaults, Asura Citadel

true-frost-flower-asura.notes: It's the true form of the Frost Flower Asura.

true-midnight-asura.title: True Midnight Asura
true-midnight-asura.loc: Asura Palace, Asura Vaults, Asura Citadel

truffle.name: Truffle
truffle.title: Truffle
truffle.desc: Truffles are small chocolate balls, closely related to sugar cubes and fruit drops. While the sugar cubes are the hard-working miners of the chocolate caves and the fruit drops are the refiners and decorators, the truffles are born bakers. They transform the mined and partially fruit-flavoured chocolate into sweet pastries such as cakes, biscuits, pralines and so on. They are therefore rarely seen down in the mines, but rather at the ovens in, around and under the gingerbread palace. That's where their delicious creations are made. When they are not working, they like to relax in the hot milk springs - but not for too long, so that they don't melt away.

truffle-cook.name: Truffle Cook
truffle-cook.title: Truffle Cook
truffle-cook.desc: Truffle Cooks are Truffles who are bakers and confectionists.

truffle-worker.name: Truffle Worker
truffle-worker.title: Truffle Worker
truffle-worker.notes: They appear in the fight against Sugar Daddy during the Threatened Dreams Quest - Sweet Dreams.

tunnel-devourer.name: Tunnel Devourer
tunnel-devourer.title: Tunnel Devourer
tunnel-devourer.notes: It is only encountered during the Too Hot to Handle Quest - Treasure Hunting.

tunnel-tyrant.name: Tunnel Tyrant
tunnel-tyrant.title: Tunnel Tyrant
tunnel-tyrant.desc: The tunnel tyrant is a creature that oddly resembles a creature in gnomish fairy tales. The beast of this tales is probably based on early encounters of gnomes with tunnel tyrant in a long forgotten past. This may hint that the tunnel tyrant might have been more common in areas closer to the surface but for what reason ever then vanished from the tracks of history for an untold time just to reappear in the recent invasions from below. Given the sheer numbers encountered, it's save to assume that the tunnel tyrant at least in our time isn't at the verge of extinction. Sadly enough they hold up to all the vicious and cruel things that the old tales attributed to them. It possesses a raw, bestial cunning and though not capable of speech like in the tales, they obviously posses some sort of intelligence. They often hold back in battle until they spot an opening or weakness and tend to let others do the dirty work and take the beating. They prefer fights where the odds are at their favour and like to ambush unsuspecting opponents. They rather wait for reinforcements then to attack on their own and often circle their opponent like a shark before ready to strike. In the armies of those…
tunnel-tyrant.beh: Tunnel Tyrants attack at close range and rarely retarget.
tunnel-tyrant.strat: Their attacks are not very powerful, but they often combo with several of them on the same turn and they always appear in groups of around 8 of them. Since their melee is not very powerful, Knights and Paladins can kill groups of them at close range, while mages should keep a distance, keeping in mind that a big part of their damage is ranged with different elements.

turbulent-elemental.name: Turbulent Elemental
turbulent-elemental.title: Turbulent Elemental
