turbulent-elemental.desc: The first turbulent elementals were originally sucked into Zarhanash by rifts and breaches in the lands of the living. As everything else they did not remain untouched by the realm, though. Usual drawing their power out of their natural element, they instead of fed on the rotten essence of Zarganash and quickly became more an element of despair than anything else. Through unfettered feeding on the vile energies of the realm, they quickly overcharge more and more and become unstable. At some point the element bursts into a veritable storm that breaches the realms and has the powers to suck in more elementals that might be drawn to the storm that occurs in their realm too. This is a highly dangerous process beyond their control, that more often than not leads to their own destruction and dispersion. Often their remainders are quickly devoured by other denizens of the realm, but sometimes they even manage to survive the process and reform. Given the number of existing turbulent elementals and the rarity of natural rifts that suck in new untainted elementals, it can be assumed, that the chances for a turbulent elemental to overcharge and cause a realm storm are somewhat common. With…
turbulent-elemental.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.

twisted-pooka.name: Twisted Pooka
twisted-pooka.title: Twisted Pooka
twisted-pooka.loc: Feyrist Meadows Night Only - Underground (all day).
twisted-pooka.desc: Twisted Pookas are stronger and more aggressive than Pookas.

twisted-shaper.name: Twisted Shaper
twisted-shaper.title: Twisted Shaper

ab.n: Mana Drain Blue Sparkle Area Attack on itself
Crystal Obelisk Effect on its target - Strong Paralysis

twisted-shaper.loc: Astral Shaper Dungeon, Astral Shaper Ruins, Old Masonry, small dungeon under the Formorgar Mines
twisted-shaper.desc: The Twisted Shapers are a testament to the tragedy which befell their ancestors. Even though they do no longer radiate their race's greatness of the past, the Twisted Shapers still have an instinctive talent for the abilities of their forefathers. Obviously more cunning and intelligent than the broken shapers, the Twisted Shapers almost seem like a different race. Still primitive and wild, they are the leaders and priests of their kind. They are the ones that preserve the remaining knowledge and everything else which is left of their civilisation - which is undoubtedly very little. The uncompromising upbringing turned them into cruel creatures. Perhaps they have a vague grasp of what their people have lost as they seem to view the world with spite and contempt. They seem to wield magic instinctively rather than to work real spellcraft. Just like a dragon who learns to breathe fire without thinking, the Twisted Shapers bend raw magic to their will and hurl it into their enemies. Most of their art is as twisted as they are themselves and their spell-like abilities rather destroy than create. Their destructive flashes are by far more powerful than their instinctive attempts to heal…
twisted-shaper.strat: Kill them fast, they are not strong but have an immense self-healing ability.

twisterror.name: Twisterror
twisterror.title: Twisterror
twisterror.notes: To summon this miniboss you must use 10 Spellreaper Staff Totem on the Sacrificial Altar found .

two-headed-turtle.name: Two-Headed Turtle
two-headed-turtle.title: Two-Headed Turtle
two-headed-turtle.desc: The two-headed turtle has its name for a rather obvious reason: it has two heads. As unusual as this is, the animal is otherwise a common, albeit very large, reptile. It is aquatic and lives mainly in the large reefs around and beneath Marapur. Although it feeds mainly on plants and fish, it can become aggressive and dangerous if you intrude on its territory. The territorial animals do not appreciate visitors. Naga mythology tells, why these turtles have two heads: In the conflict between asuri and nagas, they would not choose one side. While the nagas offered wisdom to the turtles, the asuri offered them food. Indecisive and hesitant, the animals turned their heads back and forth between the two parties so often that they ended up with two heads - and neither food nor wisdom.

tyrn.name: Tyrn
tyrn.title: Tyrn

ab.n: Self-Healing once when in red hp

tyrn.loc: Second floor of Drefia Wyrm Lair ( ) and Vandura Wyrm Cave ( ).
tyrn.beh: Tyrn chases its opponent. At low health, Tyrn will get a second wind and heal himself for about 5000-6000 health.
tyrn.notes: Tyrn is the boss of Wyrms and Elder Wyrms.
tyrn.strat: Kill the monsters around it first because this battle can be a long one. Otherwise, just focus all your power on killing him.

tzumrah-the-dazzler.name: Tzumrah the Dazzler
tzumrah-the-dazzler.title: Tzumrah the Dazzler
tzumrah-the-dazzler.loc: Forbidden Temple, near the altar of the last floor .
tzumrah-the-dazzler.beh: Just like an Enlightened of the Cult. But way stronger. Be careful of its fire beam and fire elementals.
tzumrah-the-dazzler.notes: Tzumrah The Dazzler is a miniboss who visits the Forbidden Temple once in a while to oversee the rituals. When Tzumrah is present, several Enlightened of the Cult that are not normally present appear at the last floor.

ugly-monster.name: Ugly Monster
ugly-monster.title: Ugly Monster
ugly-monster.notes: These creatures may spawn as you kill one of the Cobra minibosses. Some valuable items may appear on the floor as you attack them.
ugly-monster.strat: If you're elite knight, use Chivalrous Challenge against it every few turns and try to kill it quickly, before monster disappears, the best element against it would be two-handed physical weapon.

unaz-the-mean.name: Unaz the Mean
unaz-the-mean.title: Unaz the Mean
unaz-the-mean.notes: It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.

undead-cavebear.name: Undead Cavebear
undead-cavebear.title: Undead Cavebear
undead-cavebear.loc: Lich Hell, spots are marked [https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Mapper?coords=124.204-127.66-10-4-1-1&mark1=124.169-127.48-10-9&mark2=124.221-127.81-10-9&mark3=124.236-127.48-10-9 here].
undead-cavebear.desc: When the long forgotten ancestors of modern necromancers in dark caves sang their ritual chants, those ancient priests of death often rose one of the most fearsome beasts their race had to handle. They focused their powers to raise the mighty Undead Cavebear to unlife. This vicious beast was one of the masters that used to rule the mountains of old. In unlife it is bent to the will of their summoners and spreads fear and death in the ranks of their enemies. An Undead Cavebear used to be not only a tool and minion, it was a symbol of status and leadership, not unlike a sceptre. Once an integral part of necromancy, the primal powers that aroused the Undead Cavebears from death have been forgotten and discarded in favour of more subtle magic that allowed more complicated creations. In modern times the questionable honour of rediscovering the incantations belongs to ambitious researchers of the past. The bones they unburied and that belonged to powerful ancient necromantic priests were stolen and served as paraphernalia to summon ancient spirits and teach modern necromancers their arts. The raw and archaic enchantments quickly spread through the ranks of modern necromancers and so…
undead-cavebear.notes: Undead Cavebears are a semi-rare spawn in Lich Hell (Ramoa). You can tame them using a Maxilla Maximus. They usually spawn every 2-4 days (but it's also possible for them to spawn 2 days in a row), in three "waves": * One Undead Cavebear spawns on the eastern spot between 0 and 14 hours after the server save. * One or two Cavebears spawn on the middle spot 5 hours after the first one spawned. * Two or three Cavebears spawn on the western spot 5 hours after the second wave spawned. Their spawn cannot be blocked by standing in the screen.
undead-cavebear.strat: Just attack it, it has low armor.

undead-dragon.name: Undead Dragon
undead-dragon.title: Undead Dragon
undead-dragon.loc: Helheim (single, isolated spawn), Pits of Inferno (Ashfalor's throneroom), Demon Forge (The Shadow Nexus and The Arcanum), under Razachai (including the Inner Sanctum), Chyllfroest, Oramond Fury Dungeon and Grounds of Undeath.
undead-dragon.desc: Even though the mighty dragons can become 100 years and older, their lives also come to an end at some point. Just like some humans, also some dragons simply cannot let go though. Some of them acquire dark secrets in their long lives. Others forge dark pacts with necromancers and demons to rise again after death. It is said that the first Undead Dragons were created by the malicious bonelords who are known to meddle with undeath and necromancy. Created as a weapon in some ancient war, the first Undead Dragons proved to be so powerful that they could not be controlled by their masters. They broke free of the bonelords' subterranean bone fencings and wreaked havoc on their own. The escaped Undead Dragons served as role models for other dragons who longed for this seeming immortality. Even though only a few dragons walked the shadow path that ultimately led to the embrace of unlife, those who did began to transform into even more powerful and threatening beings which finally developed to Undead Dragons. More similar to the lich than the usual undead, they have kept more of their former personality and knowledge than undeads of other races are able to. Their new powers make easily up…
undead-dragon.beh: Chaotic and destructive, the Undead Dragon will destroy almost everything in its path with its wave attacks, though it will, similar to all creatures of dragon kind.
undead-dragon.notes: Incredibly powerful dragon skeleton, capable of destructive attacks deadlier even than those from a Demon. They appeared in the Winter Update 2006. Its boss is Dracola. You may hunt 400 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Upon completion of the task you will face Zanakeph.
undead-dragon.strat: Its attacks have the same range as the Dragons' Fire Wave but with other elements. This is one of the strongest creatures in the Pits of Inferno. Mages under 335 should have Magic Shield always on when facing these. They retarget and can kill you in one combo. Knights will waste on soloing these creatures before roughly level 300, so it is not recommended to choose their task on lower levels.

undead-elite-gladiator.name: Undead Elite Gladiator
undead-elite-gladiator.title: Undead Elite Gladiator
undead-elite-gladiator.desc: The Undead Elite Gladiator is a stronger version of Undead Gladiators.
undead-elite-gladiator.notes: It's a much stronger version of a Undead Gladiator.
undead-elite-gladiator.strat: All vocations should avoid their wave, it's small, so if you're hunting from a distance, you don't necessarily have to be diagonal, just keep a 4 SQM distance. Paladins can start hunting those around level 120 with high risk (200+ recommended), just lure it to the entrance of the cave and throw a Poison Wall Rune to run around it. Because of their strong melee and berserk, knights should stay away from them until level 200 with a healer. Mages should get a blocker or use their summon after level 200 with mana shield.

undead-gladiator.name: Undead Gladiator
undead-gladiator.title: Undead Gladiator
undead-gladiator.desc: A curse, necromancy or some magic plague has turned the Undead Gladiator in his current state. Unlike other undead, his will power and determination let him retain a certain degree of his former self. A few gladiators were even able to stay almost the complete same person considering personality and intelligence which makes them to especially fearsome opponents. Undead Gladiators can wield a large variety of weapons, and their undead state has even enhanced their fighting skills. Without any moral restraints, immune to pain, and tireless, an Undead Gladiator is a virtual fighting machine that wears down his opponent before he finishes them off in a burst of skilful attacks. Without the need for sleep or food, their existence has turned into a constant battle, a permanent test of their skills. They strive for perfection, but ironically, their undead state prevents them from enhancing their skills further or to train their body. So the emptiness of their existence is haunting them every moment, and feeds the rage and jealousy towards the living. Undead Gladiators often participate in gruesome duels with each other to test their skills in a macabre and tireless dance of death,…
undead-gladiator.notes: A very powerful melee creature with substantial hitpoints to survive many attacks. They can move as fast as a level 50 player so lower levels should avoid them. It's resistances do not comply with the resistances of most Undead, as this is the only undead creature that is weak against Death Damage and Earth Damage instead of being strong against/resistant to them. It is also the only undead creature strong against Holy Damage.
undead-gladiator.strat: Paladins: You should use a blocker or a mage with some mass spells to clear the floor of the arena first, and once that has happened, there is plenty of space to run the gladiators. Because of their high defense, you should use strong weapons, even with high skills. Knights: They hit very hard so skill levels of 80/80 and at least level 50 and good equipment is recommended. Only high level knights will profit, so try to get a druid to heal you. If you solo, it's usually wiser to fight 2 at a time instead of one, because you will be using exori/exori gran often just to get some damage through their great defense. Exori will hit both gladiators and will yield twice the experience for almost the same amount of mana. Sorcerers: Should use a Wand of Starstorm or Wand of Voodoo since these are elements they're weakest to for wands, and use Terra Strike. If it's too crowded and there are several gladiators on the floor, use energy wave to clear the groups while running them. If it gets too tough, you can go between the beds on the bottom floor to narrow them to one direct attack at a time. Recommended for levels 60+. Druids: Should use a Springsprout Rod and Terra Strike. The combination…

undead-jester.name: Undead Jester
undead-jester.title: Undead Jester

ab.n: Liquor Cream Cake causes heavy Drunkenness

loot.i: The Head of a Jester Doll
Part of a Jester Doll (Right Leg)
Part of a Jester Doll (Left Leg)
Part of a Jester Doll (Right Arm)
Part of a Jester Doll (Left Arm)
The Torso of a Jester Doll

undead-jester.loc: Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Edron, Kazordoon (floor -3, between entrance and depot), Liberty Bay, Port Hope (west, east and south across river from Depot), Svargrond, Thais, Venore, Yalahar.
undead-jester.notes: Raid occurs in different cities at different times. You will never know in which city until the raid is announced. Normally spawns near depot but also on other locations throughout the city. Raids occur during April fool's month, from the server save on April 1st until the server save on April 15th.
undead-jester.strat: Always wear a Dwarven Ring to avoid getting drunk, as it will save you considerable time when trying to reach them.

undead-mine-worker.name: Undead Mine Worker
undead-mine-worker.title: Undead Mine Worker
undead-mine-worker.loc: West of Edron in the Lost Mines.
undead-mine-worker.beh: They are the same as normal Skeleton Warriors.
undead-mine-worker.notes: Similarly to Undead Prospectors, these creatures are restless spirits of lost miners haunting a mine in Edron. This creature was added with the Christmas Update 2009.
undead-mine-worker.strat: They are very easy so treat it as you would a normal Skeleton Warrior. Just keep in mind they appear with Undead Prospectors which are a bit stronger.

undead-pet-of-chayenne.name: Undead Pet of Chayenne
undead-pet-of-chayenne.title: Undead Pet of Chayenne
undead-pet-of-chayenne.beh: Likely the same as an Undead Dragon
undead-pet-of-chayenne.strat: Ignore it and focus on killing Chayenne.

undead-prospector.name: Undead Prospector
undead-prospector.title: Undead Prospector
undead-prospector.loc: West of Edron, in a some Lost Mines.
undead-prospector.beh: In all aspects this creature is almost identical to Ghoul. So treat Undead Prospector the same as you would treat a normal Ghoul.
undead-prospector.notes: They are restless spirits of lost miners haunting a mine in Edron. Interesting enough, even though their location is connected to a quest, everyone can enter the mine and face these creatures. Since they don't have the Life Drain spell and they heal like Ghouls, these creatures are perfect for training.
undead-prospector.strat: Since they don't appear in packs, they can be killed easily as you would kill a single Ghoul.

undertaker.name: Undertaker
undertaker.title: Undertaker
undertaker.desc: This hunting Spider doesn't build intricate webs but in the past usually dug itself into the ground, to suddenly spring up, when alarmed through ground vibrations and drag their prey into their lairs. For these hunting tactics they earned the moniker 'Undertaker' by the first explorers to encounter them. With the more active volcano and earthquakes their sense for prey has become widely disturbed and they have mostly left their hidden lairs to freely roam the lands in search of prey. It has yet to be seen how this change of behaviour becomes their species as a whole and if its a viable tactic to survive. What can be said already, is that they became aggressive roaming predators that now are an even greater threat to all creatures in Gnomprona than before when their lairs could be spotted and avoided by keen senses. They are quite adapt at fighting which hints that their trap hunting habits were mostly a matter of convenience and less of necessity. Easily able to put up a fight, the Undertaker can compete with the other gnomepronean creatures eye to eye. Their underground lairs are not completely abandoned and they are still maintained. However, they now only serve as refuge,…

unexpected.name: Unexpected
unexpected.title: Unexpected
unexpected.loc: Spawned in Svargrond, Liberty Bay and Port Hope during 25th Anniversary raids.

ungreez.name: Ungreez
ungreez.title: Ungreez
ungreez.loc: Edron Hero Cave in the teleport just west of the Memory Stone for the Explorer Society.
ungreez.beh: This monster fights until the death, with its strong beam attack you should stay diagonal. ¨He walks through Energy and Poison Fields, although it is not immune to them.
ungreez.notes: Was implemented in the Summer Update 2008. Part of the Demon Hunter Outfits quest, you need to kill Ungreez to gain all experience for your first addon. Ungreez is Stronger than a Demon and its tolerance to attacks are the reason for it. You can use a Blessed Wooden Stake on Ungreez once slain to get a Demon Dust.
ungreez.strat: Just like a normal Demon, however, does not summon Fire Elementals. Knights try to use Exori Gran. It is strongly advised for knights under level 100 to have a blocker or a healer, since he heals often. Mages can easily solo them from level 45 and up, run from teleport to teleport and using Magic Shield and Sudden death runes to speed up the killing a little. You can also run it in the room, since the room is quite big. Ice spells/runes will also work. If you have blocker you don't need go outside the teleport to charge mana. Paladins should run or kill with a blocker while using Assassin Stars and Exori San. Paladins can kill Ungreez at lower levels with a blocker, using Enchanted Spear and exori san, be careful with great fireballs.

uninvited.name: Uninvited
uninvited.title: Uninvited
uninvited.loc: Spawned in Svargrond, Liberty Bay and Port Hope during 25th Anniversary raids.

unsolicited.name: Unsolicited
unsolicited.title: Unsolicited
unsolicited.loc: Spawned in Svargrond, Liberty Bay and Port Hope during 25th Anniversary raids.
unsolicited.notes: Weaker version of a Dragon Lord.
unsolicited.strat: Treat it as you would face a Dragon Lord.

unstable-spark.name: Unstable Spark
unstable-spark.title: Unstable Spark
unstable-spark.notes: Appears during the Heart of Destruction Quest before Realityquake.

unwanted.name: Unwanted
unwanted.title: Unwanted
unwanted.loc: Spawned in Svargrond, Liberty Bay and Port Hope during 25th Anniversary raids.
unwanted.notes: They're quite similar to a Giant Spider.
unwanted.strat: Mind that you can be easily get surrounded by them because they spawn in groups, and they move quite fast.

urmahlullu-the-immaculate.name: Urmahlullu the Immaculate
urmahlullu-the-immaculate.title: Urmahlullu the Immaculate
urmahlullu-the-immaculate.strat: Just trap it and attack it. It will become the Wildness of Urmahlullu before it dies. Part of the Kilmaresh Quest.

urmahlullu-the-tamed.name: Urmahlullu the Tamed
urmahlullu-the-tamed.title: Urmahlullu the Tamed
urmahlullu-the-tamed.strat: Just trap it and attack it. It will become the Wisdom of Urmahlullu before it dies.

urmahlullu-the-weakened.name: Urmahlullu the Weakened
urmahlullu-the-weakened.title: Urmahlullu the Weakened
urmahlullu-the-weakened.strat: Just trap it and kill it. Part of the Kilmaresh Quest.

ushuriel.name: Ushuriel
ushuriel.title: Ushuriel
ushuriel.loc: In the Demon Forge following the Hall of the Colossi. He is the first Demon Forge boss of The Inquisition Quest.
ushuriel.notes: He is a Ruthless Seven Servant, you must defeat him in order to proceed The Inquisition Quest. Ushuriel is merciless and cruel even by demon standards. Like many other powerful demons, he worked his way up the demonic hierarchy through murder and slaughter. Unlike some of his more reckless brethren, he was thoughtful enough to win powerful allies and to ensure that his enemies had no chance for revenge before his next move for more power. Where other demons perished because they underestimated their enemies and overestimated themselves, Ushuriel was prepared for the confrontation and let others do the dirty work. After investing much time to examine his opponents' powers, his strikes were swift and precise. Early in his career, he became a follower of the Ruthless Seven and gained prestige and might in their shadow. Loving it to kill and slaughter, he serves the Ruthless Seven as an executioner. Gifted with immense powers, Ushuriel usually just ignores any attacks and then starts to torment his target. His executions are lengthy procedures as he enjoys the fear and death struggle of his victims. As he is mostly confronted with helpless victims, it might confuse him if an opponent…
ushuriel.strat: It's very powerful, so bring a high level blocker (150+) and a couple of paladins and/or mages to shoot it. Druids are highly advised to heal the blocker. All players should wear Stealth Rings or use Utana Vid considering this boss is guarded by multiple Eyes Of The Seven which can deal up to 500 damage per turn, these are not immune to invisibility. Players who attempt to kill Ushuriel solo, should create energy fields with Energy Wall Rune on the ground and make him walk over them. Knights are advised to bring the strongest elemental melee weapon, for example Tagralt Blade, to hit him with Blood Rage and some exori attacks while running. Soloing Ushuriel will take some time though.

usurper-archer.name: Usurper Archer
usurper-archer.title: Usurper Archer
usurper-archer.kind: Members of the Order of the Lion
usurper-archer.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement.
usurper-archer.desc: The usurpers to the throne of the Lion laid siege to the town of Bounac. Their main goal being the fall of king Kesar, they are trying everything in their might to breach the old walls of the castle. Shamefully disregarding the very life and well-being of its inhabitants. The usurper archers are especially keen with the longbow and should not be underestimated even over the longest distances.

usurper-commander.name: Usurper Commander
usurper-commander.title: Usurper Commander
usurper-commander.kind: Members of the Order of the Lion
usurper-commander.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement.
usurper-commander.desc: The usurpers to the throne of the Lion laid siege to the town of Bounac. Their main goal being the fall of king Kesar, they are trying everything in their might to breach the old walls of the castle. Shamefully disregarding the very life and well-being of its inhabitants. The usurper commanders are battle-hardened veterans who guide their subordinates with wits and an iron fist.
usurper-commander.notes: Part of The Order of the Lion Quest.

usurper-knight.name: Usurper Knight
usurper-knight.title: Usurper Knight
usurper-knight.kind: Members of the Order of the Lion
usurper-knight.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement.
usurper-knight.desc: The usurpers to the throne of the Lion laid siege to the town of Bounac. Their main goal being the fall of king Kesar, they are trying everything in their might to breach the old walls of the castle. Shamefully disregarding the very life and well-being of its inhabitants.
usurper-knight.strat: Avoid stand in front, strongly advised to wear death resistance, can easily be found in groups of 3 or more.

usurper-warlock.name: Usurper Warlock
usurper-warlock.title: Usurper Warlock
usurper-warlock.kind: Members of the Order of the Lion
usurper-warlock.loc: Bounac, the Order of the Lion settlement.
usurper-warlock.desc: The usurpers to the throne of the Lion laid siege to the town of Bounac. Their main goal being the fall of king Kesar, they are trying everything in their might to breach the old walls of the castle. Shamefully disregarding the very life and well-being of its inhabitants. The warlocks are trained in battle-magic and well-versed in a variety of war tactics. There are fewer warlocks in the ranks of the usurpers but what they lack in numbers they make up for in ruthlessness.

utua-stone-sting.name: Utua Stone Sting
utua-stone-sting.title: Utua Stone Sting
utua-stone-sting.strat: Knights: Stay diagonal to avoid the Life Drain wave. Other vocations: Kite it, it's slow.

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.title: Valkyrie
valkyrie.loc: Amazon Camp (Venore), Amazon Camp (Carlin), Amazonia, single respawn to the north west of Thais, Foreigner Quarter in Yalahar.
valkyrie.desc: Valkyries are the upper caste of the amazons, communities of martial women living in the swamps in the east of Tibia. They are even stronger in close combat and use their spears skilfully for distance fighting. Every amazon who has proven her bravery by taking the skulls of thirteen opponents will be promoted to a Valkyrie.
valkyrie.notes: These creatures are stronger than an amazon and have better loot. Note that all female characters can dress like a Valkyrie. On worlds where Player Killing is allowed, this could be a problem, because someone might attack you, thinking that you are a Valkyrie.
valkyrie.strat: It is better to attack them from distance because their Spears are weaker than their Melee fighting. Usually found around Amazons and/or Witches.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.title: Vampire
vampire.loc: Drefia, Ghost Ship between Venore and Darashia, some Ankrahmun Tombs, Lich Hell, Serpentine Tower (unreachable), Ghostlands (unreachable). House between Plains of Havoc and Dark Cathedral, Hellgate (only during Zevelon Duskbringer raid), Edron Undead Cave, Vengoth Castle (and mountains before door), Edron Vampire Crypt.
vampire.desc: Vampires are undead creatures that live in the haunted ruins on Darama. They are very strong, and live on blood which they suck out of their victims. Dressed with long capes, which are black as night, they are hunting in the dungeons and, at night, even on the surface. Some people actually believe that they are able to fly, like bats which look like small vampires. Their scaring sight and their bloodcurdling cries have already paralysed many brave adventurers.
vampire.notes: You have a chance to obtain Vampire Dust when you use a Blessed Wooden Stake on a slain vampire's fresh corpse. See also Vampire Dust/Dusting.

vampire-bride.name: Vampire Bride
vampire-bride.title: Vampire Bride
vampire-bride.loc: Drefia and Vampire Castle on Vengoth, Edron Vampire Crypt.
vampire-bride.desc: Vampire Brides are the favoured few of the rare and elusive master vampires. While lesser vampires have often been turned by the spread of the curse, Vampire Brides were bitten almost exclusively by master vampires. At their lifetime, they have been women of extraordinary beauty who often had a strain of cruelty in their personality. As undead, they are powerful vampires of a haunting beauty that own a respectable array of abilities. They love to play cat and mouse with their chosen victim, and are rather picky in their choice whose blood they are going to drink. Also those that are not worthy as a blood donor are not safe from death, though. Quite the opposite, Vampire Brides love to cruelly torture their victims to death. Their cleverness makes many of them good magicians and alchemists. Some use magic or alchemy to look like a human and so make it easier to lay hands on their victims. They are vain creatures who love to surround themselves with small courts of undead in catacombs or under cities. It can take centuries before a Vampire Bride and its ghostly court are routed out by vampire hunters or the inquisition. Even then, the shrewd brides are often able to escape, ready to…
vampire-bride.strat: A common idea is to wear a Strange Talisman to reduce their often used HMM damage. Knight: Very easy for knights around level 100 with good skills (85/85). You can pull around 2-5 and Exori them down, and still make profit (using a Blessed Wooden Stake). You can face 1 at a time around level 80, but it won't be good exp or profit. Paladins: Just run them like any other monster but avoid luring more of them. Using Divine Missile would be useful when there is more than one. Mages: Treat them like normal Vampires with stronger attacks, so heal early. Using Flame Strike and Wand/Rod it the most common strategy. Wearing a Lightning Set can reduce their HMM damage as well.

vampire-pig.name: Vampire Pig
vampire-pig.title: Vampire Pig
vampire-pig.loc: Isle of Evil on the surface.
vampire-pig.strat: Just kill them fast. Knight and Paladin should have a weapon (one handed or two handed) with an attack over 35 and a semi-good shield to hunt this creatures. With 55/55 you could kill this creature, but 65/65 is needed for profit.

vampire-viscount.name: Vampire Viscount
vampire-viscount.title: Vampire Viscount
vampire-viscount.desc: Always with an air of style, insouciant and sniggering, the Viscount ambles through undeath looking for the next blood drink, entertaining fight or other pleasure to while away eternity. Viscounts can be charming in a casual way, but only to distract their prey until the final bite - they say it sours the flavour when their meal is scared or distressed. Masters of the rapier, they love to see their enemy bleed, heightening the pleasant anticipation of the kill while simultaneously letting their victim believe it could still win the fight. When hurt or when trying to impress his foe, the Viscount will eventually change form to scare his opponent away, and take on the shape of a vicious manbat.
vampire-viscount.notes: Use a Blessed Wooden Stake to collect Vampire Dust by Dusting. See also Vampire Dust/Dusting.
vampire-viscount.strat: They are practically just normal vampires with more health and can be treated as one. Paladins and Sorcerers should make sure to watch their HP though as their Bleeding effect can cause quite heavy damage. They're pretty much always found alongside regular Vampires and Vampire Brides, so wearing Garlic Necklace is recommended even if they don't cause any Life Drain damage on their own.

vampiric-blood.name: Vampiric Blood
vampiric-blood.title: Vampiric Blood
vampiric-blood.notes: It supports The Red Knight during the Grave Danger Quest.

vampiric-essence.name: Vampiric Essence
vampiric-essence.title: Vampiric Essence
vampiric-essence.notes: Part of the Bloody Tusks Quest, during the fight against Vladrukh.

varg.name: Varg
varg.title: Varg
varg.desc: The Vargs are a twisted legacy of the Norcferatu's former war wolves - once loyal beasts, now vile remnants of corrupted loyalty. When these creatures began to show agitation in the presence of their vampiric masters, something in their nature was changing. Perhaps it was the residue of their once proud spirit, or simply the side effects of unnatural feeding. Subjected to a strict and relentless regimen of Norcferatu blood, tainted further by the eldritch rituals of the Nightweavers, they began to mutate. Their bodies elongated, bones cracked and reformed, and leathery wings tore from their shoulders as if erupting in protest against their masters. What remains is a monster both majestic and terrifying - a bat-winged wolf-beast with a twisted snout and gleaming, ever-hungry eyes. The Vargs retained the pack instinct but twisted it into something more akin to a cult. They communicate in snarls and shrieks, flying in eerie synchronicity. Their airborne assaults are devastating, their accuracy uncanny, as if they could smell the heartbeat of their prey. Though once bound to their creators, the Vargs now serve only out of fear or bloodlust. Their loyalty is thin, their rage vast, and…

varnished-diremaw.name: Varnished Diremaw
varnished-diremaw.title: Varnished Diremaw
varnished-diremaw.desc: The varnished diremaws are seemingly a special breed of diremaws. Several gnomish reports suggest that this strain of diremaws was created on purpose, as veritable farms of varnished diremaws were encountered by gnomish strike forces. Though there's no denying, that this breed is more formidable then their predecessor, it raises the question why Those Below with all the creatures at their disposal feel a need to specifically breed and groom this creature. It's also unknown who might be the mastermind behind such breeding, as most actions of Those Below are driven by a seemingly alien logic, the breeding of sub species seems an almost mundane trait to associate them with. Some theories suggest that the varnished diremaws have some hidden properties that are yet unknown. Some suggest they are possibly more easy to control or serve as the ideal nourishment of some bigger, meaner creature but such theories are highly speculative at best. Others point out that the taste of warm red blood drives them into a frenzy, but this seems a weak argument to justify such efforts. The assumption that the varnished diremaws can track every prey once they tasted its blood are based on no valid…

vashresamun.name: Vashresamun
vashresamun.title: Vashresamun
vashresamun.notes: She was sentenced to be locked away, after her part in the conspiracies against the pharaoh, Arkhotep. She is the only female pharaoh. One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.
vashresamun.strat: She will melee with any in close proximity, this allows distance attackers better chances to defeat her quick. She is guarded by 2 Banshees, 4 Magicthrowers and 2 Shredderthrowers. She is the most harmless of the Pharaohs.

vemiath.name: Vemiath
vemiath.title: Vemiath

ab.n: Charge Consuming Beam (triggers damage of all charges)

vemiath.notes: One of the bosses in the Rotten Blood Quest.

venerable-foam-stalker.name: Venerable Foam Stalker
venerable-foam-stalker.title: Venerable Foam Stalker

ab.r: 367; 3 rounds increasingly bigger ring up to 5sqm

venerable-foam-stalker.loc: A single spawn at the Great Pearl Fan Reef second floor, .
venerable-foam-stalker.notes: It's a special Foam Stalker but with very similar characteristics.
venerable-foam-stalker.strat: Treat it as a regular Foam Stalker.

venerable-girtablilu.name: Venerable Girtablilu
venerable-girtablilu.title: Venerable Girtablilu
venerable-girtablilu.desc: Venerable Girtablilu are older and wiser than Girtablilu Warriors.

vermin-swarm.name: Vermin Swarm
vermin-swarm.title: Vermin Swarm
vermin-swarm.notes: Two of these will spawn when the The Sinister Hermit (Yellow) changes form to the The Sinister Hermit (Blue). It looks the same as an Insect Swarm and a Berrypest.
vermin-swarm.strat: Kill them quickly before more of them spawn.

verminor.name: Verminor
verminor.title: Verminor

ab.n: Great Earth Ball (on itself, ue size)

verminor.loc: Unknown. Has been summoned by a Customer Support member on the private test server. See The Ruthless Seven.
verminor.strat: Boots of Haste, Time Ring, Strong Haste and run.

versperoth.name: Versperoth
versperoth.title: Versperoth
versperoth.strat: Do not stand adjacent to it, it's pointless because it does not move and thus will not chase your shooters. To spawn it you must step on its dirt mount. When Versperoth spawns you have 20 seconds to deal as much damage as possible. After 20 seconds, Versperoth will disappear, and 10+ minions of Versperoth will spawn in the room. Versperoth will reappear 10 seconds later. This repeats until either your team or Versperoth dies. Excess minions will disappear after new ones spawn. When Versperoth is in the room, focus fire on it. When it disappears, focus on the minions most threatening to the team. Energy Walls can be used to protect shooters but they will cross if they retarget at the right time. Note that Versperoth does not heal itself.

vexclaw.name: Vexclaw
vexclaw.title: Vexclaw
vexclaw.loc: Grounds of Damnation, Grounds of Deceit, Grounds of Despair, Grounds of Destruction, Grounds of Fire, Grounds of Undeath, Halls of Ascension and Hell Hub
vexclaw.desc: The vexclaw belongs to a race that was once prized as personal bodyguards and strike force of many a demon prince. The size of its vexclaw retinue determined a prince's status and rank. It is said that this fact made the Vexclaws proud and lazy. After several vexclaw troops were bribed and switched sides in one of the many inter-demonic wars, the fame of the vexclaws quickly began to dwindle. In many courts, leaders of the vexclaw guard were challenged, defeated and replaced; and the new leaders of the bodyguards sooner or later replaced most of the vexclaw forces with more capable ones. Since the vexclaws no longer were seen as status objects, their princes didn't care to object. So the vexclaws fell into obscurity for a while, shunned by other demons or even hunted for sport. At their lowest point, the vexclaws were expendable mercenaries of hell which were hired and used as it pleased the demonic warlords in their fights. Then something changed. When the demon prince Drazzak was imprisoned, his own dungeons were opened and his former prisoners released. One of them was Turaxor, whom his fellow vexclaws called the Sleeping Lord. This vexclaw was so ancient that he was rumoured…

vibrant-phantom.name: Vibrant Phantom
vibrant-phantom.title: Vibrant Phantom
vibrant-phantom.desc: Zarganash's hostile environment gave birth to an own breed of phantoms that differs by the hazards that help to form them from the tormented souls they once were. Though in shape of little difference to other phantoms, the vibrant phantom in a spiritual sense is bloated, saturated and fat. It has absorbed many soul fragments and splinters and flourished in an unnatural way that is rare in Zarganash. But in the end the essence they devoured, bears the taint of Zarganash and unknown to themselves the vibrant soul is ultimately feasting on itself. This final atrocity, this ultimate trick, the deepest depth of the nether realm plays on them in the epitome of its perversion. Yet oblivious to their own nature the vibrant phantoms count them self to the winners in Zarganash and are at the top of the food chain. The many voices in their conscience are shoved away like annoying flies and the phantom enjoys its privilege and relative power. They actually interact with other vibrant phantoms and have built some form of community and even hierarchy. It's not uncommon for vibrant phantoms to band together in a common goal. In that way they are the most civilised of the phantoms, yet not less…
vibrant-phantom.notes: It only drops a Bag You Desire for players with at least one of Goshnar's Taints. The more taints you have, the higher the chance. The Bag is always dropped inside a Reward Container so there's no risk of leaving it behind in the creature's corpse.
vibrant-phantom.strat: The safest strategy to hunt them is to turn them into melee creatures using Chivalrous Challenge or Divine Dazzle and have them be blocked by the Knight with the other creatures.

vicious-ink-splash.name: Vicious Ink Splash
vicious-ink-splash.title: Vicious Ink Splash
vicious-ink-splash.loc: Fields of Glory, within Inkwing's boss room.

vicious-lich.name: Vicious Lich
vicious-lich.title: Vicious Lich
vicious-lich.notes: Killing two of these creatures is a requirement for accessing the room where The Moonlight Aster spawns as part of the Asura Palace Quest.

vicious-manbat.name: Vicious Manbat
vicious-manbat.title: Vicious Manbat
vicious-manbat.desc: An enemy not to be underestimated, the vicious manbat is swift and deadly, with a little magic ability that make it a dreaded foe. It is assumed by some of the wise in Tibia that the manbats are degenerated vampire viscounts unable to change back, or maybe some hellish breed between vampires and bats from a dark unnamed place. In appearance a more than man-tall giant blue bat with sharp claws and teeth, the manbat is both intimidating and grotesque. It will chase its victim relentlessly, slashing and clawing at it, and sometimes calling bats to its aid in order to harass and disorient its prey. Anyone unfortunate enough to encounter a manbat should be swift-footed and well-armed.
vicious-manbat.notes: This creature can only be found when The Pale Count raid occurs in Drefia and his lair becomes accessible.

vicious-squire.name: Vicious Squire
vicious-squire.title: Vicious Squire
vicious-squire.loc: Old Fortress (north of Edron), Old Masonry, Forbidden Temple (Carlin)
vicious-squire.desc: Lowlifes, bandits and cutthroats make up the bulk of the followers of the fallen knights and robber barons. With little regard for law and honour, these scrupulous beings follow profit, power and promises. Usually already on the run from some local law, they seek out the protection that the villainous knights offer them. They are the disposable muscle and arrow fodder their masters rely on for their crimes. They are equipped with the left-over scraps that their superiors don't mind about, and are easy prey for the whimsical justice of their dark lords. Still, they look down on the ordinary bandit and tend to justify their miserable existence by boasting of the accomplishments of their leaders, taking a perverted sort of pride in their services, and especially in the exploits of their leaders. This pride means nothing as soon as it is seriously tested, though. The so-called 'vicious squires' tend to flee from battle if there's not an immediate victory at hand; and should one of their superiors shows any sign of weakness, it is surely exploited in one way or another. Regardless of their similar behaviour to bandits, it has to be acknowledged that they are indeed better equipped, fed…
vicious-squire.strat: Usually found in groups alongside Renegade Knights and Vile Grandmasters, so area spells like Avalanche and Berserk might be a good idea in order to finish them off quickly so one can focus on the stronger creatures.

vile-destroyer.name: Vile Destroyer
vile-destroyer.title: Vile Destroyer
vile-destroyer.notes: Killing two of these creatures is a requirement for accessing the room where The Moonlight Aster spawns as part of the Asura Palace Quest.

vile-grandmaster.name: Vile Grandmaster
vile-grandmaster.title: Vile Grandmaster
vile-grandmaster.loc: Old Fortress (north of Edron), Old Masonry, Forbidden Temple (Carlin)
vile-grandmaster.desc: From all the knights that have fallen, the grandmaster has fallen the lowest and hardest. Once an epitome of virtues and skill, they have turned away and sought out forbidden wisdom or power that they valued over their former ideals. Seduced by dark secrets and lust for power that no man was meant to wield, they no longer respect what was once dear to them. Still, they value order and hierarchies and gather followers that they can corrupt to their own ways. Formidable combatants and equipped with spoils of their former exploits, they can easily overpower challengers to their leadership; and as long as they can provide their underlings with a twisted purpose and loot, they rule like they used to in their order. Sometimes they bow to a greater power, usually for the promise of even more power and knowledge. All grandmasters were pious and spiritual men in their former lives. This does not change with their fall, though the focus of their devotion is what changes significantly. With fanaticism and zeal they pursue their new dark goals and accept a life that becomes a perversion of all that was once dear to them. The new rites in which they indulge themselves are gruesome and cruel…
vile-grandmaster.strat: In the old fortress they are pretty much always found alongside Renegade Knights and Vicious Squires. A common tactic is throw down a Fire Bomb and stand in the middle of it, as that way only the creature you're attacking can reach you with melee. Otherwise its basically just a slightly stronger Hero and can be treated as one.

vok-the-freakish.name: Vok the Freakish
vok-the-freakish.title: Vok the Freakish
vok-the-freakish.notes: It's part of the Feaster of Souls Quest.

vortex-spawn.name: Vortex Spawn
vortex-spawn.title: Vortex Spawn
vortex-spawn.beh: A vortex spawn tries to keep distance from its target.
vortex-spawn.notes: This creature might be related to the Heart of Destruction Quest.

vulcongra.name: Vulcongra
vulcongra.title: Vulcongra
vulcongra.loc: Hot Spot (in Gnomebase Alpha), Lower Glooth Factory West, and Lower Spike.
vulcongra.desc: The Vulcongra is one of the fastest diggers underground. The attempts of the dwarfs to replace their digging rotworms with Vulcongras were met with little success due to the Vulcongras' untrainable nature. The Vulcongras are almost purely by its instincts. Their foremost need seems to be hunger. Vulcongras spend most of their time on finding and eating. Since they can eat almost everything from dust to stones, they are literally eating constantly without any need of sleep or water. As there seems to be no way to scare them off, Vulcongras often become a threat for gnomish holdings. As they do not seem to care what they eat, the Vulcongras shun away from nothing. They could equally destroy a gnomish house as they would devour precious tools or crystals. They stoically fight back any attackers. Even when not attacked, someone often finds himself at the centre of a Vulcongra's eating attention as it tries to sample some bites. They lack any evil intention,though. The gnomes are experimenting on driving them away with certain crystal frequencies or lights, without any notable success till now. The Vulcongra seem to be just too dumb to be affected by any scare tactic. The stupidity and…

wailing-widow.name: Wailing Widow
wailing-widow.title: Wailing Widow
wailing-widow.loc: Zao Wailing Widow Cave, Northern Zao Plantations, Northern Brimstone Bug Cave, Razachai, Chyllfroest, Krailos Spider Lair , Rookgaard (unreachable).
wailing-widow.desc: The Wailing Widow gained its name from its unusual hunting and attack methods. By letting its opisthosoma vibrate, the spider creates a variety of sounds that are used to lure or stun its prey. In addition to other more 'spider-like' abilities, they use this sonic manipulation in a way that reminds frighteningly of intelligence and purpose. Although they can survive in some kind of hibernation for unknown periods of time, they are known to be ravenously hungry whenever the opportunity arises. Such devoured extra food is almost immediately used for reproduction, and when such a population increase used up all food sources, they proceed to cannibalism, which is mirrored in their moniker 'widow'. With the decline of the lizard empire, also the regular extermination campaigns against spider nests were stopped. This and the population growth of their favourite prey, the lancer beetle, let the number of Wailing Widows steadily increase. Strangely enough, accompanied by their growth the once reclusive spiders became more and more bold, raiding settlements and attacking far greater prey than before. It is debated if they are influenced by the land's corruption itself, or by digesting the…
wailing-widow.notes: These can be found with Lancer Beetles in the Zao Wailing Widow Cave. These creatures can be particularly dangerous when you are fighting other creatures because they make you Drunk. The only rare item a Wailing Widow drops is the Wailing Widow's Necklace, which is useless aside from the fact that it is sellable for 3000 gold. Quest: You may hunt 400 of these as a task of the Killing in the Name of... Quest. Mount: It can be tamed by using a Sweet Smelling Bait with a chance of fail, or by using a Music Box with a 100% succes rate on it.
wailing-widow.strat: These creatures are typically found in groups. They aren't particularly strong so just focus on dealing damage quick. Knights: Knights are the best vocation as far as hunting these profitably goes. They use fairly weak attacks and their melee is pretty benign against a knight leveled 60 to 85. Paladins: Paladins should kill these last while hunting in the Zao Wailing Widow Cave or any other place with both Lancer Beetles and focus on their firepower on the Lancer Beetles first as they decrease distance fighting heavily. Aside from that, these should be very easy to kill and hunting them with Royal Spears should prove to be profitable. Mages: Sorcerers and Druids should group these creatures up along with other creatures nearby and use area spells and runes (such as Fire Wave, Ice Wave, and Great Fireball). When killing a lone Wailing Widow, Mages should use Fire Based attacks (such as Flame Strike and Fireball)

walker.name: Walker
walker.title: Walker
walker.loc: A few spawn in the Underground Glooth Factory in Varying Monster Spawns (for example and ), Glooth Factory, and Rathleton Sewers.
walker.desc: The walkers were once simple glooth driven machines that required an skilful operator to be used as transports. They were anther application of techniques learned in the creation of the glooth golems and similarly ill understood in their design principles. Yet they were by far more simple and reliable. This all changed when famous inventor Jaccus Maxxen returned from a years long travel through the world. The man that formerly was seen as shy and reclusive if not a bit strange returned as a changed man. People say a strange fire burnt in his eyes, a feverish shimmer that probably foreshadowed the things to come. He never spoke about the things he had seen or learned in his travels. All that he gave away were strange mocking comments about the futility of life and the things that foolish humanity had yet failed to grasp. In his first and last appearance before the conclave of scientists after his return he delivered a feverish speech so full of insults and hatred that he had to be removed after less then five minutes. He retreated into his laboratory never to be seen again. For month there was no contact with the outside world and by day and by night there was a constant noise of…
walker.notes: To tame this creature, use a Control Unit on it. For additional details, refer to the article on Walker (Mount). By successfully taming the Walker you will earn the achievement Gear Up. Semi-rare spawn in Oramond. Its been confirmed that respawn on some places with a rotative respawn, for example after killing 3 times the respawn (300 vote points required to acces this particular one).
walker.strat: Knights are advised to avoid fighting these creatures, as their very constant Skills and Shielding reduction can be a serious problem, specially if Rustheap Golems, Metal Gargoyles or worse, Glooth Golems are also present. If you insist in doing so, stay diagonal to avoid their strong Fire Beam.

walking-dread.name: Walking Dread
walking-dread.title: Walking Dread

ab.n: Wall Breaker (breaks Magic Walls and Wild Growths)

walking-dread.desc: The Walking Dread is a towering relic of ancient warfare. Unlike the volatile Roaming Dread, it glows with a cold blue hue that seems to sap warmth from the air and vitality from the living. Its hulking skeletal mass is assembled from the bones of colossal beings whose extinction predates memory. Every step it takes resonates like the echo of forgotten armies on the march. Ancient tales speak of whole legions of these undead, unleashed by bonelords to erase kingdoms from the map. Most were lost to the ages, ground down by the relentless march of time. Yet some of their once vast numbers still lie buried in forlorn places, beneath ancient battlefields and forgotten strongholds. When one is unearthed today, it carries with it the terror of those lost wars. To face a Walking Dread is to feel history itself bearing down, the weight of battles fought before the first mortal kingdoms even rose.

walking-pillar.name: Walking Pillar
walking-pillar.title: Walking Pillar

ab.n: Wall Breaker (breaks Magic Walls and Wild Growths

walking-pillar.desc: Fused by burning unlight, the Walking Pillars are towering monstrosities driven by a malicious purpose. These hulking entities are formed from an unholy union of colossal stones and the malevolent essence of the fallen realm. As they roam the desolate landscapes, their footsteps reverberate with a bone-rattling intensity, sending tremors through the ground. Burning with a dim, maleficent glow, their stony surfaces crack and shift, revealing glimpses of the volatile darklight contained within. The Walking Pillars possess an unrelenting determination, wielding their massive limbs to unleash devastating attacks upon any who dare cross their path. Their malevolent presence casts a foreboding shadow upon the land, a constant reminder of the ever-present dangers that lurk in the fallen realm.

wandering-pillar.name: Wandering Pillar
wandering-pillar.title: Wandering Pillar
wandering-pillar.desc: The Wandering Pillars, akin to their Walking counterparts, are infused with burning darklight that seems to consume and suck in energy and light. These enigmatic entities are rarely seen stationary, as if driven by an eternal restlessness. Their movements are unpredictable, as if guided by an inscrutable will, making them elusive and difficult to track. The air crackles with an otherworldly energy in their proximity, causing distortions in the ambient light and an unnerving sense of disorientation. Some whisper that the Wandering Pillars possess the ability to phase through reality, allowing them to traverse great distances in the blink of an eye. Encountering a Wandering Pillar is a disconcerting experience, leaving observers questioning the true nature of these enigmatic creatures.

war-golem.name: War Golem
war-golem.title: War Golem
war-golem.loc: Factory Quarter (40+ (4 Gear Wheels required per entry. Four machines line the platform to the right or left. Use one of the machines with the gearwheels present in your backpack. You will receive the message, "You insert all 4 gear wheels, thus adjusting the teleporter to transport you to the left side."), 8? , 2 , 1 , 4? during Shadows of Yalahar Quest (and many summons)), Fenrock ( ) and in Yalahar library ( ). Also spawn during the Azerus battle (last mission of the In Service of Yalahar Quest), Underground Glooth Factory and Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon last area.
war-golem.desc: War Golems used to serve as protectors and soldiers in the past of Yalahar. In our days, the remaining War Golems act as guards and bodyguards for high-ranking officials. Due to the high costs of their maintenance and the lack of staff required for repairs, War Golems are expensive and only seldom used, even if the problems of Yalahar are pressing. Created for war purposes, they utilise their golem abilities to the fullest. Heavily armored and enhanced with magic weaponry, the golems turn into behemoths of destruction. Only their simple-mindedness might be a weakness and hints that in former days the squads of War Golems were probably personally controlled by a Yalahari leader. War Golems are a rare sight. Most are stored away in the quarters of the Yalahari, a few are left and forgotten in abandoned areas of the city. Rumours persist that squads of War Golems were also deployed elsewhere in long forgotten wars. As they were never returned they are said to follow unknown orders of long dead commanders to the present day.
war-golem.beh: Like a Behemoth, but it's much faster and stronger.
war-golem.strat: All Vocations: These creatures are faster than a Behemoth, and very similar in many aspects. Once they've buffed up, they can hit nearly as hard, including some nasty energy attacks. Mages should start with a mass spell or two, such as Rage of the Skies for sorcerers to help clear out the Worker Golems these creatures usually spawn with. It might also be a good idea to throw an energy wall and have the War Golem run back and forth over it.

war-wolf.name: War Wolf
war-wolf.title: War Wolf
war-wolf.loc: Orc Fort, the Orc Peninsula, Magician Tower and northwest (tower) or south (underground) of Thais, Zao steppe (encaged), Vengoth.
war-wolf.desc: War Wolves are a race of fearsome beasts bred by orcs. They are much larger than their less dangerous cousins from which they evolved, reaching up to five feet in height, and in fact orcs often use them as mounts to ride on. However, War Wolves are dangerous opponents in their own right, endowed with awesome strength and vicious, razor-sharp teeth that can cut through armour and flesh alike. Also, War Wolves have proven to be so cunning in battle that some scholars believe these animals have acquired some kind of semi-intelligence. Of course these may only be rumours, but there can be no doubt that War Wolves hate all civilised races just as ardently as their masters do. A War Wolf will always fight to the death.
war-wolf.notes: These giant wolves are usually tamed by Orcs to fight mounted on them, they run fast.
war-wolf.strat: When attacking be careful because they attack in groups and sometimes are found with Orc Riders.

wardragon.name: Wardragon
wardragon.title: Wardragon
wardragon.desc: Wardragons are the result of Elder Dragon Nimmersatt's relentless efforts to create unstoppable engines of war. Lacking the capacity to feel fear and pain, these dragons are as unfeeling as they are relentless. They are like inexorable juggernauts on the battlefield, never swaying, never wavering. With their peculiar perception of time, they value a second in the past as much as a day in the present, rendering the concept of death meaningless to them. They relish in their great strength and sheer power. As wardragons are infertile and seem genderless, it is still an enigma how Nimmersatt is able to muster them in such great numbers. Theories are abound about a supposed wardragon queen or Nimmersatts knowledge of stashed away wardragons from the past. Wardragons are viewed as tools by their master, tools devoid of the comprehension that they are seen as disposable pawns in the grand machinations of dragons. Sometimes squads of them are deployed to just create havoc but usually they accompany other, more intelligent dragons as bodyguards or warriors.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.title: Warlock
warlock.loc: Demona, Ghostland (Banshee Quest area), Temple of Xayepocax, Oasis Tomb, Kharos, Magician Quarter, beneath Fenrock, The Arcanum, Old Masonry.
warlock.desc: Warlocks are among the most powerful magicians of Tibia, but they do their research not for the benefit of mankind but only for their own interests. Nobody, however, knows what their plans are, hiding deep in the dungeons of Tibia and attacking and killing every intruder of their sphere, so that hardly any information about them can permeate.Of course, Warlocks know a lot of fighting spells. They can shoot fire and energy in various forms, summon stone golems as vassals, paralyse their victims and drain mana off them. Moreover, they know how to heal themselves and how to make themselves invisible.
warlock.strat: A way to break Invisibility is by casting damage over time spells: Envenom, Curse, Inflict Wound, or Holy Flash.

warlord-ruzad.name: Warlord Ruzad
warlord-ruzad.title: Warlord Ruzad
warlord-ruzad.loc: Orc Fortress, in the tower near Orc Powder Quest Room, .
warlord-ruzad.beh: Treat like a strong Orc Warlord, but it Summons Orc Berserkers.
warlord-ruzad.strat: Be careful when facing this creature. Don't let him Summon, or you can die easily. The strategy is almost the same than an Orc Warlord. Using Stealth Rings or Invisibility would prevent you from being damaged by the summoned Orc Berserkers, but not the Orc leaders.

warm-fire.name: Warm Fire
warm-fire.title: Warm Fire
warm-fire.notes: It will target players but also Percht Minions.
warm-fire.strat: Do not kill it, use its warmth to weaken The Percht Queen.

wasp.name: Wasp
wasp.title: Wasp
wasp.loc: South of Thais, west of Ab'Dendriel, northeastern Cormaya, Green Claw Swamp between Kazordoon and Venore, Wasp Tower in Rookgaard, Wasp Towers in Darashia, all over Tiquanda, and all over Vandura, roaming around Marapur.
wasp.desc: Wasps are predacious insects that live in the grasslands and forests of Tibia. Using their poisonous sting they attack other animals. As they are very quick it is impossible to flee from them. If you hear their thrilling buzz, it is too late to escape. As their defence is quite weak you should try to do the first strike.
wasp.notes: They have good attack but low defense. They are really fast (like level 60) and it is hard to escape from them. They usually live in groups in towers or underground lairs. Their poison can deal up to 25 damage in total which can be dangerous for lower levels.
wasp.strat: Any Vocation Just attack them, they are weak for Level 8+ No Vocation Try not to get trapped by them. It's almost impossible to run from them, so if you see one and you are a low level or have poor equipment, run and try to get in a safe hole or ladder. This is the fastest monster you can face in Rookgaard.

waspoid.name: Waspoid
waspoid.title: Waspoid
waspoid.desc: The Waspoids are the ever-busy scouts of the hive. They are highly responsive to the hive's wishes and can be found almost everywhere in the vicinity of the hive. As soon as a Waspoid encounters something tasty or threatening, it uses its powerful pheromones to call for reinforcements. So encountering a single Waspoid often means that all Hive Born in the area are on their way to assist the Waspoid in a few heartbeats. Therefore it should be killed as fast as possible. The Waspoid itself is, strangely enough, not truly aggressive. However, it displays a rude curiosity that involves stinging and biting of the encountered object which, despite its unaggressive intention, leads to a fight. The wings of the Waspoid are known to emit a highly annoying noise that can unnerve even the most stoic mammal. Insects, however, seem to be magically attracted by the noise and experiments seem to prove that the Waspoids are able to gain some kind of influence over insects that are not native to the hive. The experiments suggest that the Waspoids can control and lure foreign insects to the hive. Since it has been deemed as too dangerous to continue such experiments, they have been forbidden and it…
waspoid.beh: Waspoids will retreat at low health, but will come back after healing themselves.
waspoid.strat: Pretty annoying creatures which can heal a lot. Focus all of your power on them. Most of the damage taken will come from their Poison Bomb.

water-buffalo.name: Water Buffalo
water-buffalo.title: Water Buffalo
water-buffalo.loc: It raids every four hours, starting at server save, in groups of one to three at various places around Venore swamp, especially near the southern production site. Some sightings have been , , , , , , , and .
water-buffalo.desc: Water buffaloes were once common inhabitants of swamps, but the large buffalo population proved to be an easy prey for the humanoid races. Against their long-ranged weapons, the slow buffaloes were defenceless. Hundreds of buffaloes were slaughtered notably during the construction of Venore. The vast buffalo population dwindled almost to the point of extinction, leaving only small packs. But what happened then is subject to speculation. The irrefutable facts are that from one day to the next, the remaining buffaloes simply had gone, vanished without a trace. Where just the day before buffaloes had been grazing, their footprints were found to end suddenly, as if they had disappeared into thin air. While this report was dismissed and the buffaloes simply thought extinct, all of a sudden they reappeared... in greater numbers and more healthy and aggressive than before. People began to form hunting parties to drive the aggressive animals away. But the hunt did not go too well and after a while, the buffaloes disappeared again, dissolving into rising mists, sometimes even right in front of the astonished hunters. Up to this day, there is no rational explanation for this occurrence.…
water-buffalo.notes: To obtain the Water Buffalo Mount, you have to use a Leech on a Water Buffalo. However, be aware that taming is not guaranteed on the first try, and the Leech can be consumed upon use, regardless of success.

water-elemental.name: Water Elemental
water-elemental.title: Water Elemental
water-elemental.loc: Water Elemental Cave in Port Hope, Water Elemental Dungeon, Deeper Banuta, Malada, Ramoa, Talahu, Folda (7 spawn on the 3rd floor), Water Elemental Cave in Outlaw Camp (only during the Down the Drain Mini World Change), Krailos Steppe underwater cave.
water-elemental.desc: Water Elementals are as powerful as a tidal wave and as moody as the sea that gave birth to them. Their interest in our existence is limited at best and they are usually summoned by sorcerers than materialising on their own. The apparently uncontrolled Water Elementals seem to follow no purpose that we mortals could comprehend. Some sorcerers believe that they react hostile to living creatures because they feel offended by all the water a living creature contains. Although enigmatic in their motivation, they are indisputably intelligent and possess an array of spells that centre around water, poison and cold.
water-elemental.notes: Their corpses become a puddle of water, which can be looted but not moved. You can also fish their fresh corpses to obtain one of the following (see: Water Elemental/Fishing Statistics): * Nothing * Giant Shimmering Pearl * White Pearl * Small Sapphire * Small Emerald * Leviathan's Amulet

weakened-demon.name: Weakened Demon
weakened-demon.title: Weakened Demon
weakened-demon.strat: Ignore it while you kill Kraknaknork.

weakened-frazzlemaw.name: Weakened Frazzlemaw
weakened-frazzlemaw.title: Weakened Frazzlemaw
weakened-frazzlemaw.desc: The Weakened Frazzlemaw is a weaker version of Frazzlemaws.
weakened-frazzlemaw.notes: It's a weaker version of a Frazzlemaw. You need to kill 200 Enfeebled Silencers and Weakened Frazzlemaws as part of the Threatened Dreams Quest.
weakened-frazzlemaw.strat: Avoid staying in front of it because its beam is its strongest attack, also be wary of your HP as the Bleeding damage ramps up quickly.

weakened-glooth-horror.name: Weakened Glooth Horror
weakened-glooth-horror.title: Weakened Glooth Horror
weakened-glooth-horror.notes: He is the second "boss" of the Hero of Rathleton Quest. Feeble Glooth Horror will split into 2 Weakened Glooth Horrors. When slain, the Weakened Glooth Horror will turn into 2 Glooth Horrors.

weakened-shlorg.name: Weakened Shlorg
weakened-shlorg.title: Weakened Shlorg
weakened-shlorg.notes: One of the raid bosses with special mechanics.
weakened-shlorg.strat: To start with he is invincible so you must use Smoking Coal on the basins in the room to make him a Weakened Shlorg then he is finally killable, its advised to run and kill this monster because he has strong physical attacks.

webster.name: Webster
webster.title: Webster
webster.notes: Is the boss of Warlord level Pit #1. Next #2.
webster.strat: To all vocations you don't need to be diagonal with this monster. Druid or Sorcerer: Use Magic Shield and SD or just Energy Strike and heal. Knight: Melee and Exori or Exori Hur. Paladin: Shoot and Divine Missile.

weeper.name: Weeper
weeper.title: Weeper
weeper.desc: The Weepers are more living minerals than anything else. Though the gnomes fiercely deny it, it can be assumed that the Weepers served as inspiration for the construction of the first crystal golems. As an oddity of life, Weepers physically share only a few characteristics with truly living beings. It is all the more astonishing that in appearance and behaviour they could be confused with biological live forms. This raises a lot of questions about the Weepers and is fuel to dozens of more or less educated guesses about their origin. Some speculations see them as surviving servants of a long extinct race. Others point out the possibility that they are the offspring of early gnomish experiments. Some see the Weepers more in the array of elemental beings, going so far as to say that the Weepers are the incarnation of a new and to date undiscovered element. They got their name from the fiery 'tears' that usually leak in what would be considered their eye region as well as the odd sobbing sounds it emanates. Weepers are extremely unpredictable in their behaviour. The only constant seems to be their hatred for biological life which they attack fiercely and without restraint.
weeper.strat: If hunting with mages, protect them. They will retarget almost every turn to the lowest level mage, even if they are unreachable (e.g. if a mage is on the other side of the warzone bars, the knight/paladin inside will not be attacked). Energy walls are useful to protect yourself from them. His beam is similar to Hellfire Fighter

werebadger.name: Werebadger
werebadger.title: Werebadger

ab.n: Life Drain Explosion similar to Thunderstorm area

werebadger.loc: Grimvale: -1 floor from ground level, also seen on surface during full moon (12th-14th of every month). Also in the Edron Lycanthropes Cave (accessed ) and in the Last Sanctum.
werebadger.desc: Werebadgers are humans under a curse - others claim infected with a disease - that causes them to transform into savage beasts. At the beginning, the transformation only takes place at full moon and the victim regains its human appearance the next morning. In the course of time, the transformation lasts longer and the full moon is no longer a necessary condition for the transformation. At a certain point, the beast takes over more and more often. Werebadgers aren't very strong and tough but quick and clever in compensation. They are no real predators, but may nonetheless be a danger to the careless. Their appearance is a mix between a badger and a human being. Like badgers, Werebadgers favour caverns as homesteads. The curse of the Full Moon, as it is frequently called, is usually spread by the infectious bite or scratch of other were-creatures. Forbidden books also tell about methods that allow to turn somebody into a were-creature with the help of dark rites. Some twisted individuals even call the curse upon themselves in the hope of using their new powers to avenge an injustice or insult.
werebadger.beh: Werebadgers fight to the death. They become invisible very often and drain mana pretty quick.
werebadger.notes: Werebadgers also drop Moonlight Crystals during the Full Moon.
werebadger.strat: Knight: Try to use your mana as fast as possible when fighting them, as they deplete it pretty quickly. Their melee isn't very strong, but you should be cautious with their waves, especially if you're fighting two at once. If possible, bring Koshei's Ancient Amulet and be ready to cast spells because they become invisible very, very often. They often come in packs so a Fire Wall or a Fire Bomb might come in handy in order to avoid having your shielding broken. Sorcerers should also use death damage protection such as Robe of the Underworld, same with Paladins and Divine Plate. Druids on the other hand are going to struggle against these and all non-paladin players should watch their HP as the damage caused by Cursed ramps up quickly.

werebear.name: Werebear
werebear.title: Werebear

ab.r: causes [[Bleeding]] starting from up 18 [[Hit Point|HP]] per turn

werebear.loc: Grimvale underground, Edron Lycanthropes Cave, and in the Last Sanctum east of Cormaya, .
werebear.desc: Werebears are humans under a curse - others claim infected with a disease - that causes them to transform into savage beasts. At the beginning, the transformation only takes place at full moon, and the victim regains its human appearance the next morning. In the course of time, the transformation lasts longer and the full moon is no longer a necessary condition for the transformation. At a certain point, the beast takes over more and more often. Werebears are strong and tough, yet a bit slow and clumsy. They are predators nonetheless, and their appearance is a mix between a bear and a human being. Like bears, Werebears favour caverns as homesteads and are not delighted with visitors. The curse of the Full Moon, as it is frequently called, is usually spread by the infectious bite or scratch of other were-creatures. Forbidden books also tell about methods that allow to turn somebody into a were-creature with the help of dark rites. Some twisted individuals even call the curse upon themselves in the hope of using their new powers to avenge an injustice or insult.
werebear.beh: Fairly slow, but hits hard (almost as hard as a Behemoth). Werebears rarely retarget, making them quite easy to tank.
werebear.strat: Avoid pulling more than two at a time. They don't do amazingly high comboes, but most of the damage they do is unavoidable (at least for a melee class). Ranged classes can simply kite them, making sure that they don't pull other creatures in the vicinity. Alternatively, they can drop a fire wall as Werebears won't cross them. Werebears run at low health. Knights: Make sure to take Werebears down first, as they inflict the most damage of all the creatures encountered alongside them. Standing diagonal won't help evade its Life Drain beam, so make sure you use Cure Bleeding after finishing them to avoid heavy damage from Bleeding.

wereboar.name: Wereboar
wereboar.title: Wereboar

ab.r: reduces [[Magic Level]] on mages; [[Melee]] skills on [[Knights]] and [[Distance Fighting]] on [[Paladins]] by 20-30%

wereboar.loc: Grimvale underground, were-beasts cave south-west of Edron (accessed ) and in the Last Sanctum east of Cormaya, ..
wereboar.desc: Wereboars are humans under a curse - others claim infected with a disease - that causes them to transform into savage beasts. At the beginning, the transformation only takes place at full moon and the victim regains its human appearance the next morning. In the course of time, the transformation lasts longer and the full moon is no longer a necessary condition for the transformation. At a certain point, the beast takes over more and more often. Wereboars are wild and boisterous, though a bit imprudent. They are not true predators, but in their ferocity and aggressiveness they are as dangerous as any beast of prey. Their appearance is a mix between a boar and a human being. The curse of the Full Moon, as it is frequently called, is usually spread by the infectious bite or scratch of other were-creatures. Forbidden books also tell about methods that allow to turn somebody into a were-creature with the help of dark rites. Some twisted individuals even call the curse upon themselves in the hope of using their new powers to avenge an injustice or insult.
wereboar.strat: Try to stand diagonal to them to avoid their Bleeding effect. Their Shielding reduction can be troublesome as it increases the damage outcome of both the Wereboar and other creatures, so be cautious.

werecrocodile.name: Werecrocodile
werecrocodile.title: Werecrocodile
werecrocodile.desc: Werecrocodiles are humans under a curse - others claim infected with a disease - that causes them to transform into savage beasts. At the beginning, the transformation only takes place at full moon, and the victim regains its human appearance the next morning. In the course of time, the transformation lasts longer and the full moon is no longer a necessary condition for the transformation. At a certain point, the beast takes over more and more often. Werecrocodiles are strong and bulky, yet a bit clumsy and not very quick on land. They are dangerous predators nonetheless and their appearance is a mix between a crocodile and a human being. Like crocodiles, Werecrocodiles favour warm and humid areas such as jungles with larger bodies of water as homesteads. They behave very aggressively towards intruders. The curse of the Full Moon, as it is frequently called, is usually spread by the infectious bite or scratch of other were-creatures. Forbidden books also tell about methods that allow to turn somebody into a were-creature with the help of dark rites. Some twisted individuals even call the curse upon themselves in the hope of using their new powers to avenge an injustice or insult.
werecrocodile.beh: Runs at you to get you into its melee range. Will normally use between one and three abilities per turn, dealing hard hitting combos sometimes.
werecrocodile.strat: Try to keep your distance from it unless you are a Knight. Its spells have a large damage range so it can deal very high damage combos from time to time, especially if given the chance to be in melee range. It moves rather slowly so its not hard to keep it away from you while running. If needed to tank in melee range, stay in diagonal to avoid the death wave.

werefox.name: Werefox
werefox.title: Werefox
werefox.loc: Edron Lycanthropes Cave (accessed ) and in the Last Sanctum east of Cormaya, .
werefox.desc: Werefoxes are humans under a curse - others claim infected with a disease - that causes them to transform into savage beasts. At the beginning, the transformation only takes place at full moon, and the victim regains its human appearance the next morning. In the course of time, the transformation lasts longer and the full moon is no longer a necessary condition for the transformation. At a certain point, the beast takes over more and more often. Werefoxes are quick and agile, yet not very strong or tough. They are predators and their appearance is a mix between a fox and a human being. Like foxes, Werefoxes favour subterranean caverns as homesteads and are sly and cunning. The curse of the Full Moon, as it is frequently called, is usually spread by the infectious bite or scratch of other were-creatures. Forbidden books also tell about methods that allow to turn somebody into a were-creature with the help of dark rites. Some twisted individuals even call the curse upon themselves in the hope of using their new powers to avenge an injustice or insult.
werefox.beh: They try to keep their distance while fighting you.

werehyaena.name: Werehyaena
werehyaena.title: Werehyaena
werehyaena.loc: Darashia Wyrm Hills (only during night), Hyaena Lairs.
